text.body:
[atha prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
bhairava uvāca
parā śrīparameśānīvadanāmbhojaniḥsṛtam | śrīyāmalaṃ mahātantraṃ svatantraṃ viṣṇuyāmalam || 1-1 ||
śaktiyāmalamākhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ stutihetunā | brahmayāmalavedāṅgaṃ sarvañca kathitaṃ priye || 1-2 ||
idānīmuttarākāṇḍaṃ vada śrīrudrayāmalam | yadi bhāgyavaśād devi(!) tava śrīmukhapaṅkaje || 1-3 ||
yāni yāni svatantrāṇi saṃdattāni mahītale | prakāśaya mahātantraṃ nānyatantreṣu tṛptimān || 1-4 ||
sarvavedāntavedeṣu kathitavyaṃ tataḥ param | tadā te bhaktavargāṇāṃ siddhiḥ sañcarate dhruvam || 1-5 ||
yadi bhakte dayā bhadre (!) vada tripurasundari mahābhairavavākyañca paṅkajāyatalocanā || 1-6 ||
śrutvovāca mahākālī kathayāmāsa bhairavam |
bhairavī uvāca
śambho mahātmadarpaghna kāmahīna kulākula || 1-7 ||
candramaṇḍalaśīrṣākṣa hālāhalaniṣevaka | advitīyāghoramūrtte raktavarṇaśikhojjvala || 1-8 ||
mahāṛṣipate deva sarveṣāñca namo namaḥ | sarveṣāṃ prāṇamathana śṛṇu ānandabhairava || 1-9 ||
ādau bālābhairavīṇāṃ sādhanaṃ ṣaṭkalātmakam | paścāt kumārīlalitāsādhanaṃ paramādbhutam || 1-10 ||
kurukullāvipracittāsādhanaṃ śaktisādhanam | yoginīkhecarīyakṣakanyakāsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-11 ||
unmattabhairavīvidyā(--)kālīvidyādisādhanam | pañcamudrāsādhanañca pañcabāṇādisādhanam || 1-12 ||
pratyaṅgirāsādhanañca kalau sākṣātkaraṃ param | haritālikāsvarṇavidyādhūmravidyādisādhanam || 1-13 ||
ākāśagaṅgā vividhā kanyakāsādhanaṃ tataḥ | bhrūlatāsādhanaṃ siddhasādhanaṃ tadanantaram || 1-14 ||
ulkāvidyāsādhanaṃ ca pañcatārādisādhanam | aparājitāpuruhūtācāmuṇḍāsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-15 ||
kālikāsādhanaṃ kaulasādhanaṃ ghanasādhanam | cacīkāsādhanaṃ paścāt ghargharāsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-16 ||
vimalāsādhanaṃ raudrītripurāsādhanaṃ tataḥ | sampatpradāsaptakūṭāsādhanaṃceṭīsādhanam | śaktikūṭādiṣaṭkūṭānavakūṭādisādhanam || 1-17 ||
kanakābhākāñcanābhāvahnyābhāsādhanaṃ tataḥ | vajrakūṭāpañcakūṭāsakalāsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-18 ||
tāriṇīsādhanaṃ paścāt ṣoḍaśīsādhanaṃ smṛtam | chinnādi(--)ugrapracaṇḍyādisādhanaṃ sumanoharam || 1-19 ||
ulkāmukhīraktamukhīsādhanaṃ vīrasādhanam | nānāvidhānanirmāṇaśavasādhanameva ca || 1-20 ||
kṛtvā devīsādhanañca kṛtvāhisādhanaṃ tataḥ | nakṣatravidyāpaṭalaṃ kālīpaṭalameva ca || 1-21 ||
śmaśānakālikādevīsādhanaṃ bhūtasādhanam | ratikrīḍāsādhanañca sundarīsādhanaṃ tathā || 1-22 ||
mahāmālāsādhanañca mahāmāyādisādhanam | bhadrakālīsādhanañca nīlāsādhanameva ca || 1-23 ||
bhuvaneśīsādhanañca durgāsādhanameva ca | vārāhīgāruḍīcāndrīsādhanaṃ paramādbhutam || 1-24 ||
brahmāṇīsādhanaṃ paścād haṃsīsādhanamuttamam | māheśvarīsādhanañca kaumārīsādhanaṃ tathā || 1-25 ||
vaiṣṇavīsādhanaṃ dhātrīdhanadāratisādhanam | pañcābhrābalipūrṇāsyā nārasiṃhīsusādhanam || 1-26 ||
kālindīrukmiṇīvidyārādhāvidyādisādhanam | gopīśvarīpadmanetrāpadmamālādisādhanam || 1-27 ||
muṇḍamālāsādhanañca bhṛṅgārīsādhanaṃ tataḥ | sakalākarṣaṇīvidyākapālinyādisādhanam || 1-28 ||
guhyakālīsādhanañca bagalāmukhīsādhanam | mahābālāsādhanañca kalāvatyādisādhanam || 1-29 ||
kulajākalikākakṣākukkuṭīsādhanaṃ mahat | ciñcādevīsādhanañca śāṅkarīgūḍhasādhanam || 1-30 ||
praphullābjamukhīvidyākākinīsādhanaṃ tataḥ | kubjikāsādhanaṃ nityāsarasvatyādisādhanam || 1-31 ||
bhūrlekhāśaśimukuṭā(--)ugrakālyādisādhanam | maṇidvīpeśvarīdhātrīsādhanaṃ yakṣasādhanam || 1-32 ||
ketakīkamalākāntipradābhedyādisādhanam | vāgīśvarīmahāvidyā annapūrṇādisādhanam || 1-33 ||
vajradaṇḍāraktamayīmanvārīsādhanaṃ tathā | hastinīhastikarṇādyāmātaṅgīsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-34 ||
parānandānandamayīsādhanaṃ gatisādhanam | kāmeśvarīmahālajjājvālinīsādhanaṃ vasoḥ || 1-35 ||
gaurīvetālakaṅkālīvāsavīsādhanaṃ tathā | candrāsyāsūryakiraṇāraṭantīsādhanaṃ tataḥ || 1-36 ||
kiṅginī pāvanīvidyā avadhūteśvarīti ca | etāsāṃ siddhavidyānāṃ sādhanādrudra eva saḥ || 1-37 ||
alakākaliyugasthāśaktiṭaṅkārasādhanam | hariṇīmohinīkṣiprātṛṣyādisādhanaṃ tathā || 1-38 ||
aṭṭahāsāghoranādāmahāmeghādisādhanam | vallarīkauraviṇyādisādhanaṃ paramādbhutam || 1-39 ||
raṅkiṇīsādhanaṃ paścād nandakanyādisādhanam | mandirāsādhanaṃ kātyāyanīsādhanameva ca || 1-40 ||
rajanīrājatīghonāsādhanaṃ tālasādhanam | pādukāsādhanaṃ cittāsādhanaṃ ravisādhanam || 1-41 ||
muninātheśvarīśāntivallabhāsādhanaṃ tathā | madirāsādhanaṃ vīrabhadrāsādhanameva hi || 1-42 ||
muṇḍālīkālinīdaityadaṃśinīsādhanaṃ tataḥ | praviṣṭavarṇālaghimāmīnādisādhanaṃ mahat || 1-43 ||
phetkārīsādhanaṃ bhallātakīsādhanamadbhutam | uḍḍīyāneśvarīpūrṇāgirijāsādhanaṃ tathā || 1-44 ||
saukarīrājavaśinīdīrghajaṅghādisādhanam | ayodhyāpūjitādevīdrāviṇīsādhanādbhutam || 1-45 ||
jvālāmukhīsādhanañca kṛṣṇajihvādisādhanam | pañcavaktrapriyāvidyānantavidyādisādhanam || 1-46 ||
śrīvidyābhuvaneśānīsādhanaṃ kāyasādhanam | raktamālāmahācaṇḍīmahājvālādisādhanam || 1-47 ||
prakṣiptāmantrikākāmapūjitābhaktisādhanam | śvāsasthāvāyavīprāptālelihānādisādhanam || 1-48 ||
bhairavīlasitāpṛthvīvāṭukīsādhanaṃ tathā | agamyā(--)ākulīmaulīndrāñjanamantrasādhanam || 1-49 ||
kulāvatīkulakṣiptāraticīnādisādhanam | śivākroḍāditaruṇīnāyikāmantrasādhanam || 1-50 ||
sādhanaṃ śailavāsinyā akasmāt siddhivardhanam | mantrayantrasvatantrādipūjyamānāḥ parātparāḥ || 1-51 ||
etāḥ sarvāḥ kaliyuge kālikā harakomalāḥ | mantrādyā yena siddhayanti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 1-52 ||
mahākāla śivānanda paramānandapāraga | bhaktānāmanurāgeṇa vidyāratnaṃ punaḥ śṛṇu || 1-53 ||
ādau vaiṣṇavadevasya mantrāṇāṃ nityasādhanam | tataste maṅgalaṃ mantrasādhanaṃ paramādbhutam || 1-54 ||
akasmādvihitā siddhiryena siddhyati bhūtale | bālabhairavayogendrasādhanaṃ śivasādhanam || 1-55 ||
mahākālasādhanañca tathā rāmeśvarasya ca | aghoramūrtte ramaṇāsādhanaṃ śṛṇu yatnataḥ || 1-56 ||
krodharājabhūtarājaekacakrādisādhanam | girīndrasādhanaṃ paścāt kulanāthasya sādhanam || 1-57 ||
baṭukeśādiśrīkaṇṭheśādisādhanameva ca | mṛtyuñjayasya raudrasya kālāntakaharasya ca || 1-58 ||
unmattabhairavasyāpi tathā pañcāsyakasya ca | kailāseśasya śambhośca tathā śūlina eva ca || 1-59 ||
bhārgaveśasya sarvasya mahākālasya sādhanam | surāntakasya pūrṇasya tathā devasya śaṅkara || 1-60 ||
haridrāgaṇanāthasya varadeśvaramālinaḥ | ūrdhvakeśasya dhūmrasya jaṭilasyāpi sādhanam || 1-61 ||
ānandabhairavasyāpi bāṇanāthasya sādhanam | karīndrasya śubhāṅgasya hillolamardakasya ca || 1-62 ||
puṣpanātheśvarasyāpi vṛṣanāthasya sādhanam | aṣṭamūrtteḥ kālamūrtteścandraśekharasādhanam || 1-63 ||
kramukasyāpi ghorasya kuberārādhitasya ca | tripurāntakamantrasya kamalākṣasya sādhanam || 1-64 ||
ityādisiddhamantrāṇāṃ mantrārthaṃ vividhaṃ mudā | uditaṃ tadviśeṣeṇa suvistārya śṛṇuṣva tat || 1-65 ||
indrādidevatā sarvā yena siddhyanti bhūtale | tatprakāraṃ mahādeva sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 1-66 ||
upavidyāsādhanañca mantrāṇi vividhāni ca | nānākarmāṇi dharmāṇi ṣaṭkarmasādhanāni ca || 1-67 ||
śrīrāmasādhanaṃ yakṣasādhanaṃ yogasādhanam | sarvavidyāsādhanañca rājajvālādisādhanam || 1-68 ||
mantrasiddhiprakārañca hanumatsādhanādikam | viṣajvālāsādhanañca pātālalokasādhanam || 1-69 ||
bhūtalipiprakārañca tattatsādhanameva ca | navakanyāsādhanañca aṣṭasiddhiprakārakam || 1-70 ||
āsanāni ca aṅgāni sādhanāni bahūni ca | kātyāyanīsādhanāni ceṭīsādhanameva ca || 1-71 ||
kṛṣṇamārjārasiddhiśca khaḍgasiddhistataḥ param | pādukājaṅghasiddhiśca nijajihvādisādhanam || 1-72 ||
saṃskāraguṭikāsiddhiḥ khecarīsiddhireva ca | bhūpraveśaprakāratvaṃ nityatuṅgādisādhanam || 1-73 ||
stambhanaṃ dāruṇaṃ paścādākarṣaṇaṃ munerapi | nānāvidhāni deveśa auṣadhādīni yāni ca || 1-74 ||
haritālādisiddhiśca rasapāradasādhanam | nānārasasamudbhūtaṃ rasabhasmādisādhanam || 1-75 ||
vṛddhasya taruṇākāraṃ sādhanaṃ paramādbhutam | vaijayantīsādhanañca caritraṃ vāsakasya ca || 1-76 ||
śivācaritramaśvasya caritraṃ vāyasasya ca | kumārīṇāṃ prakāraṃ tu vajrāṇāṃ vāraṇaṃ tathā || 1-77 ||
sampattisādhanaṃ deśasādhanaṃ kāmasādhanam | gurupūjāvidhānañca gurūsantoṣasādhanam || 1-78 ||
nijadevārādhanañca nijasādhanameva ca | vāruṇīpaiṣṭikīgauḍīkaitakīmādhvisādhanam || 1-79 ||
svadehagamanaṃ svarge martye martyaiśca durlabham | śarīravardhanañcaiva kṛṣṇabhāvasya sādhanam || 1-80 ||
nayanākarṣaṇañcaiva kālasarpasya darśanam | raṇakṣobhaprakārañca pañcendriyanivāraṇam || 1-81 ||
yogavidyāsādhanañca bhakṣaprasthanirūpaṇam | cāndrāyaṇavratañcaiva śṛṇu tadyogasiddhaye || 1-82 ||
yāmalāgreṇa śaṃsanti yāni sarvāṇi kāni ca | brahmāṇḍe yāni vastūni sarvatra durlabhaṃ śivam || 1-83 ||
ye'bhyasyanti mahātantraṃ bālādvā mantratopi vā | yāmalaṃ mama vaktrāmbhoruhasundarasaṃbhavam || 1-84 ||
atiguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ śabdaguhyaṃ nirākulam | nānāsiddhisamudrāṇāṃ gṛhaṃ yogamayaṃ śubham || 1-85 ||
śāstrajālasya sāraṃ hi nānāmantramayaṃ priyam | vārāṇasīpurapateḥ sadāmodaṃ sukhāspadam || 1-86 ||
sarasvatīdaivataṃ yat kālīṣu śikhare vṛtam | mahāmokṣaṃ dvāramokṣaṃ sarvasaṃketaśobhitam || 1-87 ||
vāñchākalpadrumaṃ tantraṃ śivasaṃskārasaṃskṛtam | aprakāśyaṃ kriyāsāraṃ sahasrastutirājitam || 1-88 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāma sahasranāmamaṅgalam | nānādravyasādhanādividhṛtāñjanarañjitam || 1-89 ||
kālīpratyakṣakathanaṃ kālīṣoḍhādisaṃpuṭam | mahācamatkārakaraṃ sthitisaṃhārapālakam || 1-90 ||
aṣṭādaśaprakārañca ṣoḍhāyāḥ saukhyamuktaye | ye jānanti mahākālaṃ yāmalaṃ kalipāvanam || 1-91 ||
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ kare tasya na saṃśayaḥ | tatprakāramahaṃ vakṣye nigamāgamamaṅgalam || 1-92 ||
yasmādrudro bhavejjñānī nānātantrārthapāragaḥ | yāminīvihitaṃ karma kulatantrābhisādhanam || 1-93 ||
mahāvīrahitaṃ yasmāt pañcatattvasvarūpakam | laṃghanaṃ nāsti me nātha asmin tantre sugopanam || 1-94 ||
tato yāmalamākhyātaṃ candraśekhara śaṅkara | rudrākṣaṃ sādhanotkṛṣṭaṃ śatayāgaphalapradam || 1-95 ||
manaḥsantoṣavipulaṃ yāmalaṃ parikīttītam | rurukādibhairavāṇāṃ brāhmīdevyāśca sādhanam || 1-96 ||
jāmbūnadalatākoṭihemadāsādhanaṃ yataḥ | manasāsādhanaṃ yatra laṅkālakṣmīprasādhanam || 1-97 ||
devatānāñca kavacaṃ nānādhyānavrataṃ mahat | antaryāgavidhānāni kalikālaphalāni ca || 1-98 ||
bhāti yatnaprabhākāraṃ prāyaścittavimarṣaṇam | paṭalaṃ triṃśatā vyāptaṃ ye paṭhanti nirantaram || 1-99 ||
avaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti yadyadicchati bhūtale | karmaṇā manasā vācā mahātantrasya sādhanam || 1-100 ||
karoti kamalānāthakarapadmaniṣevitam | jñātvā sarvadharaṃ tantraṃ sampūrṇaṃ lokamaṇḍale || 1-101 ||
prāpnoti sādhakaḥ siddhiṃ māsādeva na saṃśayaḥ | nānācakrasya māhātmyaṃ nānāṅkamaṇḍalāvṛtam || 1-102 ||
sarvajñasiddhiśatakaṃ khaṇḍakālīkulālayam | taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 1-103 ||
daivataṃ paramaṃ haṃsaṃ kālakūṭāśinaṃ prabhum | ādau dhyātvā pūjayitvā namaskuryād maheśvaram | prathamāruṇasaṅkāśaṃ ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitam | varadaṃ vāruṇīmattaṃ paramahaṃsaṃ namāmyaham || 1-104 ||
bhairava uvāca
yadi na paṭhyate tantraṃ yāmalaṃ sarvaśaṅkaram | tadā kena prakāreṇa sādhakaḥ siddhibhāgbhavet || 1-105 ||
kecicca buddhihīnāśca medhāhīnāśca ye janāḥ mandabhāgyāśca dhūrtāśca mūḍhāḥ sarvāpadāvṛtāḥ || 1-106 ||
prāpnuvanti kathaṃ siddhiṃ dayā jātā kathaṃ vada | teṣu mūrkheṣu hīneṣu śāstrārthavajīteṣu ca || 1-107 ||
jñānaṃ bhavati kenaiva nirmalaṃ dvaitavajītam | tatprakāraṃ vada snehād lokānāṃ puṇyavṛddhaye || 1-108 ||
bhairavī uvāca
karmasūtraṃ yaśchinatti pratyahaṃ tanusaṃsthitaḥ | sa paśyati jagannātha mama śrīcaraṇāmbujam || 1-109 ||
viśvamāveśasaṃskārabhinnabuddhikriyānvitāḥ ato māṃ nahi jānanti nānākāryotkaṭāvṛtāḥ || 1-110 ||
teṣāṃ śarīraṃ gṛhṇāti kāladūto bhayānakaḥ yaḥ karoti mahāyogaṃ tyāgasannyāsadharmavān || 1-111 ||
mandabhāgyaḥ paśoryoniṃ prāpnoti māṃ vihāya saḥ | mayi bhāvaṃ yaḥ karoti durlabho janavallabhaḥ || 1-112 ||
bhāvena labhyate sarvaṃ bhāvena devadarśanam | bhāvena paramaṃ jñānaṃ tasmād bhāvāvalambanam || 1-113 ||
bhāvañca sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ gūḍhaṃ sarvendriyasthitam | sarveṣāṃ mūlabhūtañca devībhāvaṃ yadā labhet || 1-114 ||
tadaiva sarvasiddhiśca tadā dhyānadṛḍho bhavet | akalaṅkī nirāhārī nivāsadhṛtamānasaḥ || 1-115 ||
nityasnānābhipūjāṅgo bhāvī bhāvaṃ yadā labhet | kriyādakṣo mahāśikṣānipuṇo'pi jitendriyaḥ || 1-116 ||
sarvaśāstranigūḍhārthavettā nyāsavivajītaḥ | teṣāṃ hastagataṃ bhāvaṃ vada bhāvaṃ yathā tanau || 1-117 ||
bhāvāt parataraṃ nāsti yenānugrahavān bhavet | bhāvādanugrahaprāptiranugrahān mahāsukhī || 1-118 ||
sukhāt puṇyaprabhāvaḥ syāt puṇyādacyutadarśanam | yadā kṛtasya darśanāmbhojadarśanamaṅgalam || 1-119 ||
yogī bhūttvā sūkṣmapadaṃ yogināmapyadarśanam | paśyatyeva mahāvidyāpādāmbhoruhapāvanam || 1-120 ||
gurūṇāṃ paramahaṃsānāṃ vākyaṃ trailokyapāvanam | śrutvā sādhakasiddhyarthaṃ yogī yogamavāpnuyāt || 1-121 ||
pañjare śukasārī ca patagāḥ pakṣiyonayaḥ | gṛhṇāti sādhakaḥ svargān mannāmavimalaṃ mahat || 1-122 ||
yāvat jñānasya sañcāraṃ tāvat kālaṃ kuleśvara | sādhakānāñca sādhūnāṃ nikaṭastho bhavennaraḥ || 1-123 ||
vidyābhyāsī na patati yadi buddhiparo bhavet | nahi cejjanma vyākhyārthaṃ nānāśāstrārthabhāṣaṇam || 1-124 ||
surajñānaṃ binā kiñcinnahi siddhyati bhūtale | mantraṃ śrīkāyasiddhiśca kathaṃ bhavati bhairava || 1-125 ||
sāṃkhyajñānaṃ vedabhāṣāvidhijñānaṃ tathā samam | śaktiṃ binā yathā śāktaṃ surajñānaṃ binā hi saḥ || 1-126 ||
ahitācārasampattirdaridrasya gṛhe yathā | sādhakasya gṛhe śaktirjñānācāravivecanā || 1-127 ||
jāyate yadi sāyujyapadanāśāya kevalam | yadyajñānaviśiṣṭā sā svaśaktiḥ śivakāminī || 1-128 ||
tadā na kuryād grahaṇā śaktisādhanameva ca | yadi kuryādasaṃskārāt saṃsargaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 1-129 ||
asaṃskṛtyādidoṣeṇa siddhihāniḥ prajāyate | śaktipradhānaṃ bhāvānāṃ trayāṇāṃ sādhakasya ca || 1-130 ||
divyavīrapaśūnāñca bhāvatrayamudāhṛtam | paśubhāve jñānasiddhiḥ paśvācāranirūpaṇam || 1-131 ||
vīrabhāve kriyāsiddhiḥ sākṣādrudro na saṃśayaḥ | divyabhāve vīrabhāve vibhinnamekabhāvataḥ || 1-132 ||
aṇḍaḥ pūrvaḥ sarvagataṃ divyabhāvasya lakṣaṇam | divyabhāve devatāyā darśanaṃ parikītītam || 1-133 ||
vīrabhāve mantrasiddhiradvaitācāralakṣaṇam | ādau bhāvaṃ paśoḥ prāpya rātrikarmavivarjayet || 1-134 ||
divase divase snānaṃ pūjānityakriyānvitaḥ | puraścaraṇavat kāryaṃ śucibhāvena siddhyati || 1-135 ||
paśubhāvaṃ vinā vīraḥ ko vaśī bhavati dhruvam | indriyāṇāñca damanaṃ damanaṃ śamanasya ca || 1-136 ||
yogaśikṣāniviṣṭāṅgo yatiryogaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvakṣaṇādabhyasataḥ prabhātāvadhi rātriṣu || 1-137 ||
sarvakālaṃ ca kartavyo yogaḥ sarvasukhapradaḥ | vāñchākalpataruṃ nityaṃ taruṇaṃ pātakāpaham || 1-138 ||
sādhayedavahitaṃ mantrī paśubhāvasthito yadi | yogabhāṣāvidhijñānaṃ sarvabhāveṣu durlabham || 1-139 ||
tathāpi paśubhāvena śīghraṃ siddhyati niścitam | gurūṇāṃ śrīpadāmbhoje yasya bhaktirdṛḍhā bhavet || 1-140 ||
sa bhavet kāmanātyāgī bhāvamātropalakṣaṇam | vīrabhāvo mahābhāvo na bhāvaṃ duṣṭacetasām || 1-141 ||
bhāvaṃ mandagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ rudramūrtyāḥ prasiddhyati | bhraṣṭācāraṃ mahāgūḍhaṃ trailokyamaṅgalaṃ śubham || 1-142 ||
pañcatattvādisiddhyarthaṃ mahāmohamadodbhavam | sarvapīṭhakulācāraṃ haṭhādānandasāgaram || 1-143 ||
kāruṇyavāridhiṃ vīrasādhane bhaktikevalam | jñānībhūttvā paśorbhāve vīrācāraṃ tataḥ param || 1-144 ||
vīrācārād bhavedrudro'nyathā naiva ca naiva ca | bhāvadvayasthito mantrī divyabhāvaṃ vicārayet || 1-145 ||
sadā śucidīvyabhāvamācaret susamāhitaḥ | devatāyāḥ priyārthañca sarvakarmakuleśvara || 1-146 ||
yadyattat sakalaṃ siddhyatyasmād dharmodayaṃ śubham | devatātulyabhāvaśca devatāyāḥ kriyāparaḥ || 1-147 ||
tad viddhi devatābhāvaṃ sudivyabhākprakītītam | sarveṣāṃ bhāvavargāṇāṃ śaktimūlaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 1-148 ||
bhaktiṃ kena prakāreṇa prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ | jñāttvā devaśarīrasya nijakāryānuśāsanāt || 1-149 ||
jñānaśca trividhaṃ proktamāgamācārasambhavam | śabdabrahmamayaṃ taddhi jñānamārgeṇa paśyati || 1-150 ||
paṭhitvā sarvaśāstrāṇi svakarmagāyanāni ca | kṛśe vivekamālambya nityaṃ jñānī ca sādhakaḥ || 1-151 ||
vivekasaṃbhavaṃ jñānaṃ śivajñānaprakāśakam | locanadvayahīnañca bāhyabhāvavivajītam || 1-152 ||
lokānāṃ parinirmuktaṃ kālākālaviloḍanam | nityajñānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ taṃ viddhi prāṇagocaram || 1-153 ||
mānuṣaṃ saphalaṃ janma sarvaśāstreṣu gocaram | caturaśītilakṣeṣu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām || 1-154 ||
na mānuṣyaṃ vinānyatra tattvajñānaṃ tu vidyate | kadācillabhyate janma mānuṣyaṃ puṇyasañcayāt || 1-155 ||
sopānībhūtamokṣasya mānuṣyaṃ janma durlabham | mānuṣeṣu ca śaṃsanti siddhayaḥ syuḥ pradhānikāḥ || 1-156 ||
aṇimādiguṇopetāstasmād devo narottamaḥ | vinā dehena kasyāpi puruṣārtho na labhyate || 1-157 ||
tasmāccharīraṃ saṃrakṣya nityaṃ jñānaṃ prasādhaya | mānuṣaṃ jñānanikaraṃ jñānātmānaṃ paraṃ viduḥ || 1-158 ||
munayo maunaśīlāśca munitantrādigocaram | mānuṣaḥ sarvagāmī ca nityasthānanirākulaḥ || 1-159 ||
(mitra)mantrajāpaṃ yogajāpaṃ kṛtvā pāpanivāraṇam | paraṃ mokṣamavāpnoti mānuṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1-160 ||
mayoktāni ca tantrāṇi madbhaktā ye paṭhanti ca | paṭhitvā kurute karma kṛtvā matsannidhiṃ vrajet || 1-161 ||
maduktāni ca śāstrāṇi na jñātvā sādhako yadi | anyaśāstrāṇi sambodhya koṭivarṣeṇa siddhyati || 1-162 ||
śuktau rajatavibhrāntiryathā bhavati bhairava | tathānyadarśanebhyaśca bhuktiṃ muktiñca kāṅkṣati || 1-163 ||
yatra bhogastatra mokṣo dvayaṃ kutra na siddhyati | mama śrīpādukāmbhoje sevako mokṣabhogagaḥ || 1-164 ||
bāhyadraṣṭā pragṛhṇāti ākāśasthitatejasam | brahmāṇḍajñānadraṣṭā ca deśāṇḍasthaṃ prapaśyati || 1-165 ||
ghaṭapratyakṣasamaye āloko vyañjako yathā | binā ghaṭattvayogena na pratyakṣo yathā ghaṭaḥ || 1-166 ||
itarād bhidyamāno'pi na bhedamupagacchati | puruṣe naiva bhedo'sti vinā śaktiṃ kathañcana || 1-167 ||
śaktihīno yathā dehī nirbalo yogavivajītaḥ | jñānahīnastathātmānaṃ na paśyati padadvayam || 1-168 ||
svabhāvaṃ nādhigacchanti saṃsārajñānamohitāḥ | abhipaśyati saśloko yadbhāvaṃ paribhāvyate || 1-169 ||
īśvarasyāpi dūtasya yamarājasya bandhanam | nidhanaṃ cānugacchanti dṛṣṭvā ca tanujaṃ dhanam || 1-170 ||
loko mohasurāṃ pīttvā na vetti hitamātmanaḥ | sampadaḥ svapnameva syād yauvanaṃ kusumopamam || 1-171 ||
taḍiccapalamāyuṣyaṃ kasyāpyajñānato dhṛtiḥ | śataṃ jīvati martyaśca nidrā syādardhahāriṇī || 1-172 ||
ardhaṃ harati kāminyāḥ śaktibuddhipratāpinī | asadvṛttiśca mūḍhānāṃ hantyāyuṣamahanīśam || 1-173 ||
bālyarogajarāduḥkhaiḥ sarvaṃ tadapi niṣphalam | strīputrapitṛmātrādisambandhaḥ kena hetunā || 1-174 ||
duḥkhamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ sa yasyāsti sa duḥkhitaḥ | asya tyāgaḥ kṛto yena sa sukhī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1-175 ||
sukhaduḥkhaparityāgī karmaṇā kiṃ na labhyate | lokācārabhayārthaṃ hi yaḥ karoti kriyāvidhim || 1-176 ||
brahmajñātāhamakhile ye japanti nirādarāḥ | sāṃsārikasukhāsaktaṃ brahmajñosmīti vādinam || 1-177 ||
tyajet taṃ satataṃ dhīraścāṇḍālamiva dūrataḥ | gṛhāraṇyasamāloke gatavrīḍā digambarāḥ || 1-178 ||
caranti gardabhādyāśca vratinaste bhavanti kim | tṛṇaparṇodakāhārāḥ satataṃ vanavāsinaḥ || 1-179 ||
hariṇādimṛgāścaiva tāpasāste bhavanti kim | śītavātātapasahā bhakṣyābhakṣyasamā api || 1-180 ||
caranti śūkarādyāśca vratinaste bhavanti kim | ākāśe pakṣiṇaḥ sarve bhūtapretādayo'pi ca || 1-181 ||
caranti rātrigāḥ sarve khecarāḥ kiṃ maheśvarāḥ | ājanmamaraṇāntañca gaṅgāditaṭanīsthitāḥ || 1-182 ||
maṇḍūkamatsyapramukhā vratinaste bhavanti kim | etajjñānaniviṣṭāṅgāḥ yadi gacchanti paṇḍitāḥ || 1-183 ||
tathāpi karmadoṣeṇa narakasthā bhavanti hi | kauṭilyālasasaṃsargavajītā ye bhavanti hi || 1-184 ||
prāpnuvanti mama sthānaṃ mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | ūdrdhvaṃ vrajanti bhūtāni śarīramativāhikam || 1-185 ||
nijadehābhiśāpena nānārūpo bhavennaraḥ | śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ || 1-186 ||
iha duścaritaiḥ kecit kecit pūrvakṛtaistathā | prāpnuvanti durātmāno narā rūpaviparyayam || 1-187 ||
gurupādavihīnā ye te naśyanti mamājñayā | gururmūlaṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ gururmūlaṃ parantapaḥ || 1-188 ||
guroḥ prasādamātreṇa siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ gururahaṃ devo mantrārtho'smi na saṃśayaḥ || 1-189 ||
bhedakā narakaṃ yānti nānāśāstrārthavajītāḥ | sarvāsāmeva vidyānāṃ dīkṣā mūlaṃ yathā prabho || 1-190 ||
gurumūlasvatantrasya gururātmā na saṃśayaḥ | ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ || 1-191 ||
ātmanā kriyate karma bhāvasiddhistadā bhavet | hīnāṅgī kapaṭī rogī bahvāśī śīlavajītaḥ || 1-192 ||
mayyupāsanamāsthāya upavidyāṃ sadābhyaset | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ vittaṃ rājyaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam || 1-193 ||
śubhārthaṃ samprayoktavyaṃ nānyacintā vṛthāphalam | nityaśrāddharato martyo dharmaśīlo narottamaḥ || 1-194 ||
mahīpālaḥ priyācāraḥ pīṭhabhramaṇatatparaḥ | pīṭhe pīṭhe mahāvidyādarśanaṃ yadi labhyate || 1-195 ||
tadā tasya kare sarvāḥ siddhayo'vyaktamaṇḍalāḥ | akasmājjāyate siddhirmahāmāyāprasādataḥ || 1-196 ||
mahāvīro mahādhīro divyabhāvasthito'pi vā | athavā paśubhāvastho mantrapīṭhaṃ vivāsayet || 1-197 ||
kriyāyāḥ phaladaṃ proktaṃ bhāvatrayamanoramam | tathā ca yugabhāvena divyavīreṇa bhairava || 1-198 ||
prapaśyanti mahāvīrāḥ paśavo hīnajātayaḥ | na paśyanti kaliyuge śāstrābhibhūtacetasaḥ || 1-199 ||
api varṣasahasreṇa śāstrāntaṃ naiva gacchati | tarkādyanekaśāstrāṇi alpāyuvīghnakoṭayaḥ || 1-200 ||
tasmāt sāraṃ vijānīyāt kṣīraṃ haṃsa ivāmbhasi | kalau ca divyavīrābhyāṃ nityaṃ tadgatacetasaḥ || 1-201 ||
mahābhaktāḥ prapaśyanti mahāvidyāparaṃ padam | sādhavo maunaśīlāśca sadā sādhanatatparāḥ || 1-202 ||
divyavīrasvabhāvena paśyanti matpadāmbujam | bhāvadvayaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahāsatphalakāṅkṣiṇām || 1-203 ||
athavā cāvadhūtānāṃ bhāvadvayamudāhṛtam | bhāvadvayaprabhāveṇa mahāyogī bhavennaraḥ || 1-204 ||
mūrkho'pi vākpatiḥ śreṣṭho bhāvadvayaprasādataḥ | ye jānanti mahādeva mama tantrārthasādhanam || 1-205 ||
bhāvadvayaṃ hi varṇānāṃ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ | bhāvuko bhaktiyogendraḥ sarvabhāvajñasādhanaḥ || 1-206 ||
unmattajaḍavannityaṃ nijatantrārthapāragaḥ | vṛkṣo vahati puṣpāṇi gandhaṃ jānāti nāsikā || 1-207 ||
paṭhanti sarvaśāstrāṇi durlabhā bhāvabodhakāḥ | prrajñāhīnasya paṭhanamandhasyādarśadarśanam || 1-208 ||
prajñāvato dharmaśāstraṃ bandhanāyopakalpate | tattvamīdṛgiti bhavediti śāstrārthaniścayaḥ || 1-209 ||
ahaṃ kartā'hamātmā ca sarvavyāpī nirākulaḥ | manaseti svabhāvañca cintayatyapi vākpatiḥ || 1-210 ||
saudāminītejaso vā sahasravarṣakaṃ yadā | prapaśyati mahājñānī ekacandraṃ sahasrakam || 1-211 ||
koṭivarṣaśatenāpi yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | ekakṣaṇamaṅghirarajo dhyātvā tatphalamaśnute || 1-212 ||
vicaredyadi sarvatra kevalānandavardhanam | kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ trikoṇādhārataijasam || 1-213 ||
jalabudbudśabdāntamanantamaṅgalātmakam | sa bhavenmama dāsendro gaṇeśaguhavatpriyaḥ || 1-214 ||
kaṃkālākhyā(--)sāṭṭahāsā(--)vikaṭākṣopapīṭhakam | vicaret sādhakaśreṣṭho matpādābjaṃ yadīcchati || 1-215 ||
jvālāmukhīmahāpīṭhaṃ mama priyamatarkavit | yo bhramenmama tuṣṭyarthaṃ sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 1-216 ||
bhāvadvayādinikaraṃ jvālāmukhyādipīṭhakam | bhramanti ye sādhakendrāste siddhā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1-217 ||
bhāvāt parataraṃ nāsti trailokyasiddhimicchatām | bhāvo hi paramaṃ jñānaṃ brahmajñānamanuttamam || 1-218 ||
koṭikanyāpradānena vārāṇasyāṃ śatāṭanaiḥ | kiṃ kurukṣetragamane yadi bhāvo na labhyate || 1-219 ||
gayāyāṃ śrāddhadānena nānāpīṭhāṭanena kim | nānāhomaiḥ kriyābhiḥ kiṃ yadi bhāvo na labhyate || 1-220 ||
bhāvena jñānamutpannaṃ jñānānmokṣamavāpnuyāt | ātmano manasā devyāgurorīśvaramucyate || 1-221 ||
dhyānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ proktaṃ mokṣamātmamanolayam | guroḥ prasādamātreṇa śaktitoṣo mahān bhavet || 1-222 ||
śaktisantoṣamātreṇa mokṣamāpnoti sādhakaḥ | gurumūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ gurumūlaṃ parantapaḥ || 1-223 ||
guroḥ prasādamātreṇa mokṣamāpnoti sadvaśī | na laṅghayed gurorājñāmuttaraṃ na vadet tathā || 1-224 ||
divārātrau gurorājñāṃ dāsavat paripālayet | uktānukteṣu kāryeṣu nopekṣāṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 1-225 ||
gacchataḥ prayato gacched gurorājñāṃ na laṅghayet | na śṛṇoti gurorvākyaṃ śṛṇuyād vā parāṅmukhaḥ || 1-226 ||
ahitaṃ vā hitaṃ vāpi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | ājñābhaṅgaṃ gurordaivād yaḥ karoti vibuddhimān || 1-227 ||
prayāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ śūkaratvamavāpnuyāt | ājñābhaṅgaṃ tathā nindāṃ gurorapriyavartanam || 1-228 ||
gurudrohañca yaḥ kuryāt tatsaṃsargaṃ na kārayet | gurudravyābhilāṣī ca gurustrīgamanāni ca || 1-229 ||
pātakañca bhavet tasya prāyaścittaṃ na kārayet | guruṃ duṣkṛtya ripuvannirharet parivādataḥ || 1-230 ||
araṇye nirjane deśe sa bhaved brahmarākṣasaḥ | pādukām āsanaṃ vastraṃ śayanaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca || 1-231 ||
dṛṣṭvā guruṃ namaskṛtya ātmabhogaṃ na kārayet | sadā ca pādukāmantraṃ jihvāgre yasya vartate || 1-232 ||
anāyāsena dharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ labhennaraḥ | śrīguroścaraṇāmbhojaṃ dhyāyeccaiva sadaiva tam || 1-233 ||
bhaktaye muktaye vīraṃ nānyabhaktaṃ tato'dhikam | ekagrāme sthitaḥ śiṣyo gatvā tatsannidhiṃ sadā || 1-234 ||
ekadeśe sthitaḥ śiṣyo gatvā tatsannidhiṃ sadā | saptayojanavistīrṇaṃ māsaikaṃ praṇamed gurum || 1-235 ||
śrīguroścaraṇāmbhojaṃ yasyāṃ diśi virājate | tasyāṃ diśi namaskuryāt kāyena manasā dhiyā || 1-236 ||
vidyāṅgamāsanaṃ mantraṃ mudrāṃ tantrādikaṃ prabho | sarvaṃ gurumukhāllabdhvā saphalaṃ nānyathā bhavet || 1-237 ||
kambale komale vāpi prāsāde saṃsthite tathā | dīrghakāṣṭhe'thavā pṛṣṭhe guruñcaikāsanaṃ tyajet || 1-238 ||
śrīguroḥ pādukāmantraṃ mūlamantraṃ svapādukām | śiṣyāya naiva deveśa pravaded yasya kasyacit || 1-239 ||
yad yadātmahitaṃ vastu taddravyaṃ naiva vañcayet | gurorlabdhvā ekavarṇaṃ tasya tasyāpi suvrata || 1-240 ||
bhakṣyaṃ vittānusāreṇa gurumuddaśya yatkṛtam | svalpairapi mahattulyaṃ bhuvanādyaṃ daridratām || 1-241 ||
sarvasvamapi yo dadyād gurubhaktivivajītaḥ | narakāntamavāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇam || 1-242 ||
gurubhaktyā ca śakratvamabhaktyā śūkaro bhavet | gurubhaktaḥ paraṃ nāsti bhaktiśāstreṣu sarvataḥ || 1-243 ||
gurupūjāṃ vinā nātha koṭipuṇyaṃ vṛthā bhavet || 1-244 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane sarvavidyānuṣṭhāne siddhimantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 1 ||
[atha dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ]
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi sarvadarśanavidyayā | sarvajña paramānando dayābīja bhayaṅkara || 2-1 ||
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śambho kulācāravidhiṃ śṛṇu | paśūnāṃ vratabhaṅgādau vidhiṃ prathamataḥ prabho || 2-2 ||
vratabhaṅge nityabhaṅge nityapūjādikarmaṇi | sahasraṃ prajapenmantrī vratadoṣopaśāntaye || 2-3 ||
nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam | devatādarśanaṃ pīṭhadarśanaṃ tīrthadarśanam || 2-4 ||
gurorājñāpālanañca devatānityapūjanam | paśubhāvasthito martyo mahāsiddhiṃ labhed dhruvam || 2-5 ||
paśūnāṃ prathamo bhāvo vīrasya vīrabhāvanam | divyānāṃ divyabhāvastu teṣāṃ bhāvāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 2-6 ||
svakulācārahīno yaḥ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ | niṣphalārthī bhavet kṣipraṃ kulācāraprabhāvataḥ || 2-7 ||
bhairava uvāca
kenopāyena bhagavatīcaraṇāmbhojadarśanam | prāpnoti padmavadane paśubhāvasthito naraḥ || 2-8 ||
tatprakāraṃ suvistārya kathyatāṃ kulakāmini | yadi bhaktirdṛḍhā me'sti yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || 2-9 ||
mahābhairavī uvāca
prabhāte ca samutthāya aruṇodayakālataḥ | niśāṣṭadaṇḍaparyantaṃ paśūnāṃ bhāva īritaḥ || 2-10 ||
prātaḥ śayyādikaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śayyāsthitaḥ paśuḥ | guruṃ sañcintayecchīrṣāmbhoje sāhasrake dale || 2-11 ||
taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ tejobimbaṃ mahāgurum | anantānantamahimāsāgaraṃ śaśiśekharam || 2-12 ||
mahāśubhraṃ bhāsurāṅgaṃ dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ vibhum | ātmopalabdhivīṣamaṃ tejasā śuklavāsasam || 2-13 ||
ājñācakrodrdhvanikaraṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatāṃ mukham | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṅgaṃ varābhayakaraṃ vibhum || 2-14 ||
praphullakamalārūḍhaṃ sarvajñaṃ jagadīśvaram | antaḥprakāśacapalaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 2-15 ||
ratnālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ devadevaṃ sadā bhajet | antaryāgakrameṇaiva padmapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 2-16 ||
ekāntabhaktyā praṇamedāyurārogyavṛddhaye | atha madhye japenmantramādyantapraṇavena ca || 2-17 ||
madhye vāgbhavamāyojya gurunāma tataḥ param | ānandanāthaśabdānte guruṃ ṅe'ntaṃ samuddharet || 2-18 ||
namaḥ śabdaṃ tato brūyāt praṇavaṃ sarvasiddhidam | mahāgurormanuṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 2-19 ||
vāksiddhirvadanāmbhoje gurumantraprabhāvataḥ | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ nityaṃ sahasraṃ vā tathāṣṭakam || 2-20 ||
prajapyārpaṇamākṛtya prāṇāyāmatrayañcaret | vāgbhavena tataḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmavidhiṃ mudā || 2-21 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ daśītaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 2-22 ||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 2-23 ||
devatāyāḥ darśanasya kāraṇaṃ karuṇānidhim | sarvasiddhipradātāraṃ śrīguruṃ praṇamāmyaham || 2-24 ||
varābhayakaraṃ nityaṃ śvetapadmanivāsinam | mahābhayanihantāraṃ gurudevaṃ namāmyaham || 2-25 ||
mahājñānācchāpitāṅgaṃ narākāraṃ varapradam | caturvargapradātāraṃ sthūlasūkṣmadvayānvitam || 2-26 ||
sadānandamayaṃ devaṃ nityānandaṃ nirañjanam | śuddhasattvamayaṃ sarvaṃ nityakālaṃ kuleśvaram || 2-27 ||
brahmarandhre mahāpadme tejobimbe nirākule | yogibhirdhyānagamye ca cakre śukle virājite || 2-28 ||
sahasradalasaṅkāśe kaṇīkāmadhyamadhyake | mahāśuklabhāsurārkakoṭikoṭimahaujasam || 2-29 ||
sarvapīṭhasthamamalaṃ paraṃ haṃsaṃ parātparam | vedoddhārakaraṃ nityaṃ kāmyakarmaphalapradam || 2-30 ||
sadā manaḥśaktimāyālayasthānaṃ padadvayam | śarajjyotsnājālamālābhirindukoṭivanmukham || 2-31 ||
vāñchātiriktadātāraṃ sarvasiddhīśvaraṃ gurum | bhajāmi tanmayo bhūttvā taṃ haṃsamaṇḍalopari || 2-32 ||
ātmānaṃ ca nirākāraṃ sākāraṃ brahmarūpiṇam | mahāvidyāmahāmantradātāraṃ parameśvaram || 2-33 ||
sarvasiddhipradātāraṃ gurudevaṃ namāmyaham | kāyena manasā vācā ye namanti nirantaram || 2-34 ||
avaśyaṃ śrīguroḥ pādāmbhoruhe te vasanti hi | prabhāte koṭipuṇyañca prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ || 2-35 ||
madhyāhne daśalakṣañca sāyāhne koṭipuṇyadam | prātaḥkāle paṭhet stotraṃ dhyānaṃ vā susamāhitaḥ || 2-36 ||
tadā siddhimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 2-37 ||
śirasi sitapaṅkaje taruṇakoṭicandraprabha| varābhayakarāmbujaṃ sakaladevatārūpiṇam | bhajāmi varadaṃ guruṃ kiraṇacāruśobhākula| prakāśitapadadvayāmbujamalaktakoṭiprabham || 2-38 ||
jagadbhayanivāraṇaṃ bhuvanabhogamokṣapradam | guroḥ pādayugāmbujaṃ jayati yatra yoge jayam | bhajāmi paramaṃ guruṃ nayanapadmamadhyasthita| bhavābdhibhayanāśanaṃ śamanarogakāyakṣayam || 2-39 ||
prakāśitasupaṅkaje mṛdulaṣoḍaśākhye prabhu| parāparaguruṃ bhaje sakalabāhyabhogapradam | viśālanayanāmbujadvayataḍitprabhāmaṇḍala| kaḍāramaṇipāṭalendubindubindukam || 2-40 ||
calācalakalevaraṃ pracapaladale dvādaśe | mahaujasamumāpatevīgatadakṣabhāge hṛdi | prabhākaraśatojjvalaṃ suvimalendukoṭyānana| bhajāmi parameṣṭhinaṃ gurumatīva vārojjvalam || 2-41 ||
gurvādyañca śubhaṃ madananidahanaṃ hemamañjarīsāra| nānāśabdādbhutāhlāditaparijanāccārucakratribhaṅgam | nityaṃ dhyāyet prabhāte aruṇaśataghaṭāśobhanaṃ yogagamya| nābhau padme'tikānte daśadalamaṇibhe bhāvyate yogibhiryat || 2-42 ||
yā mātā mayadānavādisvabhujā nirvāṇasīmāpure | svādhiṣṭhānaniketane rasadale vaikuṇṭhamūle mayā | janmoddhāravikārasuprahariṇī vedaprabhā bhāvyate | kandarpāpītaśāntiyonijananī viṣṇupriyā śāṅkarī || 2-43 ||
yā bhāṣānanakuṇḍalī kulapathācchāmābhaśobhākarī | mūle padmacaturdale kulavatī niḥśvāsadeśāśritā | sākṣātkāṅkṣitakalpavṛkṣalatikā sūdbhāṣayantī priyā | nityā yogibhayāpahā viṣaharā gurvambikā bhāvyate || 2-44 ||
ūdrdhvāmbhoruhaniḥsṛtāmṛtaghaṭī mododvalāplāvitā | gurvāsyā paripātu sūkṣmapathagā tejomayī bhāsvatī | sūkṣmā sādhanagocarāmṛtamayī mūlādiśīrṣāmbuje | pūrṇā cetasi bhāvyate bhuvi kadā mātā sadoddhrvāmagā || 2-45 ||
sthitipālanayogena dhyānena pūjanena vā | yaḥ paṭhet pratyahaṃ vyāpya sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥ || 2-46 ||
kalyāṇaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca kītīmāyuryaśaḥśriyam | sāyāhne ca prabhāte ca paṭhedyadi subuddhimān || 2-47 ||
sa bhavet sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kalpadrumakalevaraḥ | stavasyāsya prasādena vāgīśatvamavāpnuyāt || 2-48 ||
paśubhāvasthitā ye tu te'pi siddhāḥ na saṃśayaḥ | ādau sādhakadevaśca sadācāramatiḥ sadā || 2-49 ||
paśubhāvastato vīraḥ sāyāhne divyabhāvavān | eteṣāṃ bhāvavargāṇāṃ gururvedāntapāragaḥ || 2-50 ||
śānto dāntaḥ kulīnaśca vinītaḥ śuddhaveṣavān | śuddhācāraḥ supratiṣṭhaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ subuddhimān || 2-51 ||
āśramī dhyānaniṣṭhaśca mantratantraviśāradaḥ | nigrahānugrahe śakto vaśī mantrārthajāpakaḥ || 2-52 ||
nirogī nirahaṅkāro vikārarahito mahān | paṇḍito vākpatiḥ śrīmān sadā yajñavidhānakṛt || 2-53 ||
puraścaraṇakṛt siddho hitāhitavivajītaḥ | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyukto mahājanagaṇādṛtaḥ || 2-54 ||
prāṇāyāmādisiddhānto jñānī maunī virāgavān | tapasvī satyavādī ca sadā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2-55 ||
āgamārthaviśiṣṭajño nijadharmaparāyaṇaḥ | avyaktaliṅgacihnastho bhāvako bhadradānavān || 2-56 ||
lakṣmīvān dhṛtimānnātho gururityabhidhīyate | śiṣyastu tādṛśo bhūttvā sadguruṃ paryupāśrayet || 2-57 ||
varjayecca parānandarahitaṃ rūpavajītam | kuṣṭhinaṃ krūrakarmāṇaṃ ninditaṃ rogiṇaṃ gurum || 2-58 ||
aṣṭaprakārakuṣṭhena galatkuṣṭhinameva ca | śvitriṇaṃ janahiṃsārthaṃ sadārthagrāhiṇaṃ tathā || 2-59 ||
svarṇavikrayiṇaṃ cauraṃ buddhihīnaṃ sukharvakam | śyāvadantaṃ kulācārarahitaṃ śāntivajītam || 2-60 ||
sakalaṅkaṃ netrarogaiḥ pīḍitaṃ paradāragam | asaṃskāraṃ pravaktāraṃ strījitaṃ cādhikāṅgakam || 2-61 ||
kapaṭātmānakaṃ hiṃsāviśiṣṭaṃ bahujalpakam | bahvāśinaṃ hi kṛpaṇaṃ mithyāvādinameva ca || 2-62 ||
aśāntaṃ bhāvahīnaṃ ca pañcācāravivajītam | doṣajālaiḥ pūritāṅgaṃ pūjayenna guruṃ binā || 2-63 ||
gurau mānuṣabuddhiṃ tu mantreṣu lipibhāvanam | pratimāsu śilārūpaṃ vibhāvya narakaṃ vrajet || 2-64 ||
janmahetū hi pitarau pūjanīyau prayatnataḥ | guruvīśeṣataḥ pūjyo dharmādharmapradarśakaḥ || 2-65 ||
guruḥ pitā gururmātā gururdevo gururgatiḥ | śive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana || 2-66 ||
gurohītaṃ prakartavyaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ | ahitācaraṇād deva viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 2-67 ||
mantratyāgād bhavenmṛtyurgurutyāgād daridratā | gurumantraparityāgād rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 2-68 ||
gurau sannihite yastu pūjayedanyadevatām | prayāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā viphalā bhavet || 2-69 ||
guruvad guruputreṣu guruvat tatsutādiṣu | avidyo vā savidyo vā gurureva tu daivatam || 2-70 ||
amārgastho'pi mārgastho gurureva tu daivatam | utpādakabrahmadātrorgarīyān brahmado guruḥ || 2-71 ||
tasmānmanyeta satataṃ piturapyadhikaṃ gurum | gurudevādhīnaścāsmi śāstre mantre kulākule || 2-72 ||
nādhikārī bhavennātha śrīguroḥ padabhāvakaḥ | gururmātā pitā svāmī bāndhavaḥ suhṛt śivaḥ || 2-73 ||
ityādhāya mano nityaṃ bhajet sarvātmanā gurum | ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlaśuklamaṇiprabham || 2-74 ||
sarvakarmaniyantāraṃ gurumātmānamāśrayet | guruśca sarvabhāvānāṃ bhāvamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2-75 ||
niḥsandigdhaṃ gurorvākyaṃ saṃśayātmā vinaśyati niḥsaṃśayī gurupade sarvatyāgī padaṃ vrajet || 2-76 ||
khecaratvamavāpnoti māsādeva na saṃśayaḥ | sadgurumāśritaṃ śiṣyaṃ varṣamekaṃ pratīkṣayet || 2-77 ||
saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāpi jñātvā mantraṃ pradāpayet | śiṣyasya lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śubhāśubhavivecanam || 2-78 ||
anyathā vipradoṣeṇa siddhipūjāphalaṃ dahet | kāmukaṃ kuṭilaṃ lokaninditaṃ satyavajītam || 2-79 ||
avinītamasamarthaṃ prajñāhīnaṃ ripupriyam | sadāpāpakriyāyuktaṃ vidyāśūnyaṃ jaḍātmakam || 2-80 ||
kalidoṣasamūhāṅgaṃ vedakriyāvivajītam | āśramācārahīnaṃ cāśuddhāntaḥkaraṇodyatam || 2-81 ||
sadā śraddhāvirahitamadhairyaṃ krodhinaṃ bhramam | asaccaritraṃ viguṇaṃ paradārāturaṃ sadā || 2-82 ||
asadbuddhisamūhotthamabhaktaṃ dvaitacetasam | nānānindāvṛtāṅgaṃ ca taṃ śiṣyaṃ varjayed guruḥ || 2-83 ||
yadi na tyajyate vīra dhanādidānahetunā | nārakī śiṣyavat pāpī tadviśiṣṭamavāpnuyāt || 2-84 ||
kṣaṇādasiddhaḥ sa bhavet śiṣyāsāditapātakaiḥ | akasmānnarakaṃ prāpya kāryanāśāya kevalam || 2-85 ||
vicārya yatnāt vidhivat śiṣyasaṃgrahamācaret | anyathā śiṣyadoṣeṇa narakastho bhaved guruḥ || 2-86 ||
na patnīṃ dīkṣayed bhartā na pitā dīkṣayet sutām | na putraṃ ca tathā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ naiva dīkṣayet || 2-87 ||
siddhamantro yadi patistadā patnīṃ sa dīkṣayet | śaktittvena bhairavastu na ca sā putrikā bhavet | mantrāṇāṃ devatā jñeyā devatā gururūpiṇī || 2-88 ||
teṣāṃ bhedo na kartavyo yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥ | ekagrāme sthitaḥ śiṣyastrisandhyaṃ praṇamed gurum || 2-89 ||
krośamātrasthito bhaktyā guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet | ardhayojanataḥ śiṣyaḥ praṇamet pañcaparvasu || 2-90 ||
ekayojanamārabhya yojanadvādaśāvadhiḥ | dūradeśasthitaḥ śiṣyo bhaktyā tatsannidhiṃ gataḥ || 2-91 ||
tantrayojanasaṃkhyoktamāsena praṇamed gurum | varṣaikeṇa bhaved yogyo vipro hi gurubhāvataḥ || 2-92 ||
varṣadvayena rājanyo vaiśyastu vatsaraistribhiḥ | catubhirvatsaraiḥ śūdraḥ kathitā śiṣyayogyatā || 2-93 ||
yadi bhāgyavaśenaiva siddhamantraṃ labhet prabho | mahāvidyā triśaktyāśca gṛhṇīyāt tatkulāddhruvam || 2-94 ||
gurovīcāraṃ sarvatra tātamātāmahaṃ vinā | pramādācca tathājñānān ebhyo mantraṃ samācaran || 2-95 ||
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punardīkṣāṃ samācaret | sāvitrīmantrajāpañca lakṣyaṃ jāpyaṃ jagatpateḥ || 2-96 ||
viṣṇorvā praṇavaṃ lakṣyaṃ prāyaścittamiti smṛtam | aśaktaścenmahādeva cāyutaṃ prajapenmanum || 2-97 ||
daśasāhasrajāpyena sarvakalmaṣanāśinī | gāyatrīcchandasāṃ mātā pāparāśitulānalā || 2-98 ||
mama mūttīprakāśā ca paśubhāvavivajītā | phalodbhavaprakaraṇe brahmaṇāpadyate niśi || 2-99 ||
yadi bhāgyavaśād deva siddhamantraṃ guruṃ tathā | tadaiva tāntu dīkṣeta aṣṭaiśvaryāya kevalam || 2-100 ||
nirbījañca piturmantraṃ śaive śākte na duṣyati | jyeṣṭhaputrāya dātavyaṃ kulīnaiḥ kulapaṇḍitaiḥ || 2-101 ||
kulayuktāya dāntāya mahāmantraṃ kuleśvaram | tadaiva muktimāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 2-102 ||
kaniṣṭhañca ripuṃ cāpi sodaraṃ vairipakṣagam | mātāmahañca pitaraṃ yatiñca vanavāsinam || 2-103 ||
anāśramaṃ kusaṃsargaṃ svakulatyāginaṃ tathā | varjayitvā ca śiṣyāṃstān dīkṣāvidhimupācaret || 2-104 ||
anyathā tadvirodhena kāmanābhoganāśanam | siddhamantrañca gṛhṇīyād duṣkulādapi bhairava || 2-105 ||
sadgurorbhāvanecchannarūpe rūpe dhare śubhe | tatra dīkṣāṃ samākurvan aṣṭaiśvaryajayaṃ labhet || 2-106 ||
svapne tu niyamo nāsti dīkṣāsu guruśiṣyayoḥ | svapnalabdhe striyā datte saṃskāreṇaiva śuddhyati || 2-107 ||
sādhvī caiva sadācārā gurubhaktā jitendriyā | sarvamantrārtha tattvajñā suśīlā pūjane ratā || 2-108 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā jāpikā padmalocanā | ratnālaṅkārasaṃyuktā varṇābhūvanabhūṣitā || 2-109 ||
śāntā kulīnā kulajā candrāsyā sarvavṛddhigā | anantaguṇasampannā rudratvadāyinī priyā || 2-110 ||
gururūpā muktidātrī śivajñānanirūpiṇī | guruyogyā bhavet sā hi vidhavā parivajītā || 2-111 ||
striyā dīkṣā śubhā proktā mantraścāṣṭaguṇā smṛtā | putriṇī vidhavā grāhyā kevalā ṛṇakāriṇī || 2-112 ||
siddhamantro yadi bhaved gṛhṇīyād vidhavāmukhāt | kevalaṃ suphalaṃ tatra māturaṣṭaguṇaṃ dhruvam || 2-113 ||
sadhavā svaprakṛtyā ca dadāti yadi tanmanum | tato'ṣṭaguṇamāpnoti yadi sā putriṇī satī || 2-114 ||
yadi mātā svakaṃ mantraṃ dadāti svasutāya ca | tadāṣṭasiddhimāpnoti bhaktimārge na saṃśayaḥ || 2-115 ||
tadaiva durlabhaṃ deva yadi mātrā pradīyate | ādau bhaktiṃ tato muktiṃ samprāpya kālarūpadhṛk || 2-116 ||
sahasrakoṭividyārthaṃ jānāti nātra saṃśayaḥ | svapne tu mātā yadi vā dadāti śuddhamantrakam || 2-117 ||
punardīkṣāṃ so'pi kṛtvā dānavattvamavāpnuyāt | yadi bhāgyavaśenaiva jananī dānavatīnī || 2-118 ||
tadā siddhimavāpnoti tatra mantraṃ vicārayet | svīyamantropadeśena na kuryād gurucintanam || 2-119 ||
tathā śrīlalitā kālī mahāvidyā mahāmanoḥ sarvasiddhiyuto bhūttvā vatsarāt tāṃ prapaśyati || 2-120 ||
kālīkalpalatā devī mahāvidyādisādhane | gurucintā na kartavyā ye jānanti gurorvacaḥ || 2-121 ||
yadi mantraṃ vicāryāśu gṛhṇāti sādhakottamaḥ | anantakoṭipuṇyasya dviguṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 2-122 ||
vicārya cakrasārañca mantraṃ gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ | vaikuṇṭhanagare vāsasteṣāṃ janmaśatairapi || 2-123 ||
iti śrutvā mahādevo mahādevyāḥ sarasvatīm | uvāca punarānandapulakollāsavigrahaḥ || 2-124 ||
jñātuṃ cakraṃ ṣoḍaśañca cakrahastavarapradam | atyadbhutaphalopetaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam || 2-125 ||
śrī bhairava uvāca
kathayasva mahādevi kulasadbhāvaprāptaye | yadi me sukṛpādṛṣṭiḥ vartate snehasāgare || 2-126 ||
tvatprasādād bhairavo'haṃ kālo'haṃ jagadīśvaraḥ | bhuktimuktipradātā ca yogayogyo digambaraḥ || 2-127 ||
idānīṃ sarvavidyānāṃ dīkṣādyaṃ cakramaṇḍalam | akālakulahīnañcākaḍamañca kulākulam || 2-128 ||
śrībhairavī uvāca
tārācakraṃ rāśicakraṃ kūrmacakraṃ tathāparam | śivacakraṃ viṣṇucakraṃ brahmacakraṃ vilakṣaṇam || 2-129 ||
devacakraṃ ṛṇidhani ulkācakraṃ tataḥ param | vāmācakraṃ catuścakraṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ tato vadet || 2-130 ||
tathā kathahacakrañca kathitaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ prabho | etaduttīrṇamantrañca yaṃ gṛhṇanti narottamāḥ || 2-131 ||
teṣāmasādhyaṃ jagati na kimapi vartate dhruvam | kimanyat kathayāmīha devatādarśanaṃ labhet || 2-132 ||
sarvatragāmī sa bhavet cakrarājaprasādataḥ | sarvacakravicārañca na jānāti dvijottamaḥ || 2-133 ||
yajjānāti tadvicāryaṃ devatāprītikārakam | tārāśuddhiṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ koṣṭhaśuddhiṃ śivasya ca || 2-134 ||
rāśiśuddhiṃ traipurasya gopāle'kaḍamaḥ smṛtaḥ | akaḍamo vāmane ca gaṇeśe haracakrataḥ || 2-135 ||
koṣṭhacakraṃ varāhasya mahālakṣmyāḥ kulākulam | nāmādicakre sarveṣāṃ bhūtacakre tathaiva ca || 2-136 ||
traipuraṃ tāracakre ca śuddhaṃ mantraṃ bhajed budhaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ rāśisaṃśuddhaṃ śaivañcākaḍamaṃ smṛtam || 2-137 ||
kālikāyāśca tārāyāḥ haracakraṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | caṇḍikāyā bhavet koṣṭhe gopāle ṛkṣacakrakam || 2-138 ||
haracakre sarvamantrān ṛṇādhikyena cāśrayet | ṛṇādhikye śubhaṃ vidyād dhanādhikye ca no vidhiḥ || 2-139 ||
doṣān saṃśodhya gṛhṇīyānmadhyadeśe tu sādhakaḥ | pitṛmātṛkṛtaṃ nāma tyaktvā śarmādidevakān || 2-140 ||
śrīvarṇañca tato vidyācakreṣu yojayet kramāt | krameṇa śṛṇu tatsarvaṃ śubhāśubhaphalapradam || 2-141 ||
jāpakānāṃ bhāvukānāṃ śuddhaṃ siddhyati tatkṣaṇāt | mantramātraṃ prasiddhyeta bhaktānāmiti niścayaḥ || 2-142 ||
kulīnakulajātānāṃ dhyānamārgārthagāminām | mahāvidyā mahājñānaṃ saṃśuddhamapi sidhyati || 2-143 ||
siddhamantraprakaraṇe yaduktañca maheśvara | aṣṭasiddhikare tasya sāyujyapadamāpnuyāt || 2-144 ||
cakraṃ ṣoḍaśasārañca sarveṣāṃ mantrasiddhaye || 2-145 ||
vicārya sarvamantrañca yanmayā gaditaṃ hitam | ādau bālābhairavīṇāmakaḍamānmataṃ mayā || 2-146 ||
kumārīlalitādevyāḥ kurukullādisādhane | śrīcakraṃ phaladaṃ proktaṃ sarvacakraphalapradam || 2-147 ||
yoginyādisādhane ca tārācakraṃ mahatphalam | unmattabhairavīvidyādyādisādhananirmale || 2-148 ||
rāśicakraṃ koṭiphalaṃ nānāratnapradaṃ śubham | pratyaṅgirāsādhane ca ulkāvidyādisādhane || 2-149 ||
śivacakraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvacakraphalapradam | kālikācacīkāmantre vimalādyādisādhane || 2-150 ||
sampatpradābhairavīṇāṃ mantragrahaṇakarmaṇi | viṣṇucakre koṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 2-151 ||
chinnādiśrīvidyāyāḥ kṛtyādevyāśca sādhane | nakṣatravidyākāmākhyā brahmāṇyādi susādhane || 2-152 ||
brahmacakraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvavidyāphalaṃ labhet | koṭijāpyena yatpuṇyaṃ grahaṇāt tatphalaṃ labhet || 2-153 ||
vajrajvālāmahāvidyāsādhane mantrajāpane | guhyakālīsādhane ca kubjikāmantrasādhane || 2-154 ||
devacakraṃ śubhaṃ proktaṃ vākyasiddhipradāyakam | kāmeśvarīaṭṭahāsāmantrasādhanakarmaṇi || 2-155 ||
rākiṇīmandirādevī mandirāmantrasādhane | ṛṇidhanimahācakraṃ vicārya sarvasiddhidam || 2-156 ||
śrīvidyābhuvaneśānībhairavīsādhane tathā | pṛthvīkulāvatīvīṇāsādhane vāmanīmanoḥ || 2-157 ||
ulkācakraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ rājatvaphaladaṃ śubham | śivādināyikāmantre bālācakraṃ sukhapradam || 2-158 ||
phetkārīmantrajāpye ca uḍḍīyāneśvarī manoḥ | catuścakraṃ śataphalaṃ mahāmantraphalapradam || 2-159 ||
drāviṇīdīrghajaṅghādi jvālāmukhyādisādhane | nārasiṃhīsādhane ca sūkṣmacakraṃ phalodbhavam || 2-160 ||
hariṇī mohinī kātyāyanīsādhanakarmaṇi | vaiṣṇave ca tathā śaive devīmantre ca bhairava || 2-161 ||
akathahaṃ mahācakraṃ vicārya yatnapūrvakam | yo gṛhṇāti mahāmantraṃ sa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2-162 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahāyantroddīpane sarvacakrānuṣṭhāne mahāguruprakaraṇe bhāvanirṇaye bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 2 ||
[atha tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ]
bhairavī uvāca
atha cakraṃ pravakṣyāmi kālākālavicārakam | yadāśrito mahāvīro dīvyo vā paśubhāvavān || 3-1 ||
cakrarājaṃ pravicārya siddhamantraṃ na cālayet | prabalasya pracaṇḍasya prāsādasya mahāmanoḥ || 3-2 ||
śaktikūṭādimantrāṇāṃ siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet | varāhārkanṛsiṃhasya tathā pañcākṣarasya ca || 3-3 ||
mahāmantrasya kālasya candracūḍasya sanmanoḥ | napuṃsakasya mantrasya siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet || 3-4 ||
viṃśatyarṇādhikā mantrā mālāmantrāḥ prakītītāḥ | sūryamantrasya yogasya kṛtyāmantrasya śaṅkara || 3-5 ||
śaṃbhubījasya devasya siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet | cakreśvarasya candrasya varuṇasya mahāmanoḥ || 3-6 ||
kālītārādimantrasya siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet | tathāpi śodhayenmantraṃ praśaṃsāparameva tat || 3-7 ||
yatra praśaṃsāparamaṃ tatkāryaṃ daivataṃ smṛtam | praśaṃsā yatra nāstyeva tatkāryaṃ nāpi kārayet || 3-8 ||
atyantaphaladaṃ mantraṃ gṛhṇīyāt kularakṣaṇāt | dhanimantraṃ na gṛhṇīyād akūlañca tathaiva ca || 3-9 ||
gṛhītvā nidhanaṃ yāti koṭijāpyena siddhyati | mananaṃ viśvavijñānaṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārabandhanāt || 3-10 ||
yataḥ karoti saṃsiddhau mantra ityabhidhīyate | praṇavādyaṃ na dātavyaṃ mantraṃ śūdrāya sarvathā || 3-11 ||
ātmamantraṃ gurormantraṃ mantraṃ cānapasaṃjñakam | piturmantraṃ tathā māturmantrasiddhipradaṃ śubham || 3-12 ||
śūdro nirayamāpnoti brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatim | adīkṣitā ye kurvanti japapūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 3-13 ||
na bhavanti śriye teṣāṃ śilāyāmuptabījavat | devīdīkṣāvihīnasya na siddhirna ca sadgatiḥ || 3-14 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena guruṇā dīkṣito bhavet | vicāraṃ cakrasārasya karaṇīyamavaśyakam || 3-15 ||
adīkṣito'pi maraṇe rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | tasmāddīkṣā prayatnena sadā kāryā ca tāntrikāt || 3-16 ||
dīkṣāpūrvadine kuryāt suvicāraṃ prayatnataḥ | tatprakāraṃ prayatnena kāryaṃ parvatapūjita || 3-17 ||
ādāvakaḍame siddhirmantraṃ sañcārayed budhaḥ | rekhādvayaṃ pūrvapare madhye rekhādvayaṃ likhet || 3-18 ||
catuṣkoṇe catūrekhākaḍamaṃ cakramaṇḍalam | bhrāmayitvā mahāvṛttaṃ nirmāya varṇamālikhet || 3-19 ||
akārādikṣakārāntān klībahīnān likhettataḥ | ekaikamato lekhyān meṣādiṣu (vṛṣā?)mīnāntakān || 3-20 ||
vāmāvartena gaṇayet kramaśo vīravallabha | tantramārgeṇa gaṇayennāmādivarṇakādimān || 3-21 ||
meṣādito'pi mīnāntaṃ kramaśaḥ śāstrapaṇḍitaḥ | siddhasādhyasusiddhādīn punaḥ siddhādayaḥ punaḥ || 3-22 ||
navaikapañcame siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ ṣaḍdaśayugmake | susiddhastrisaptake rudre vedāṣṭadvādaśe ripuḥ || 3-23 ||
etatte kathitaṃ nātha akaḍamādikamuttamam | padmākāraṃ mahācakraṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitam || 3-24 ||
a ā varṇadvayaṃ pūrve dvitīye ca dvitīyakam | tṛtīye karṇayugmañca caturthe nāsikādvayam || 3-25 ||
pañcame nayanaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭhe oṣṭhādharaṃ tathā | saptame dantayugmañca aṣṭame ṣoḍaśasvaram || 3-26 ||
kavargañca pūrvadale dvitīye ca cavargaka | tṛtīye ca ṭavargañca caturthe ca tavargakam || 3-27 ||
pavargaṃ pañcame proktaṃ yavāntaṃ ṣaṣṭhapatrake | saptame śaṣasān likhya (la?)hakṣamaṣṭamake pade || 3-28 ||
sukhaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ yauvanāyuṣameva ca | vicārya cakramāpnoti putrattvañca svajīvanam || 3-29 ||
svīya(--)nāmākṣaraṃ tatra devanāmākṣaraṃ tathā | ekasthānaṃ yugasthānaṃ virodhaṃ dvividhaṃ smṛtam || 3-30 ||
jīvanaṃ maraṇaṃ tatra akārādisu patrake | likhitvā gaṇayenmantrī maraṇaṃ varjayet sadā || 3-31 ||
yatrāsti maraṇaṃ tatra jīvanaṃ nāsti niścitam | parasparavirodhena siddhamantrañca mūladam || 3-32 ||
jīvane jīvanaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvatra maraṇaṃ tyajet | kulākulasya bhedaṃ hi vakṣyāmi mantriṇāmiha || 3-33 ||
vāyvagnibhūjalākāśāḥ pañcāśallipayaḥ kramāt | pañcahrasvāḥ pañcadīrghāḥ bindvantāḥ sandhisambhavāḥ || 3-34 ||
kādayaḥ pañcaśaḥ (ṣakṣa)yādilasahakṣāntāḥ prakītītāḥ | sādhakasyākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ mantrasyāpi tadakṣaram || 3-35 ||
yadyekabhūtadaivatyaṃ jānīyātsakulaṃ hitam | bhaumasya vāruṇaṃ mitramāgneyasyāpi mārutam || 3-36 ||
pāthīvāṇāñca sarveṣāṃ śatrurāgneyamambhasām | endravāruṇayoḥ śatrurmārutaḥ parikītītaḥ || 3-37 ||
pāthīve vāruṇaṃ mitraṃ taijasaṃ śatrurīritaḥ | nābhasaṃ sarvamitraṃ syādviruddhaṃ naiva śīlayet || 3-38 ||
rekhāṣṭakaṃ hi pūrvāgraṃ rekhaikādaśamadhyataḥ | dakṣiṇottarabhāgena dakṣiṇāvadhimālikhet || 3-39 ||
kulākulañca kathitaṃ tārācakraṃ punaḥ śṛṇu | dakṣiṇottaradeśe tu rekhācatuṣṭayaṃ likhet || 3-40 ||
daśarekhāḥ paścimāgrāḥ kartavyāḥ vīravandita | aśvinyādikrameṇaiva vilikhettārakāḥ punaḥ || 3-41 ||
vakṣyamāṇakrameṇaiva tanmadhye varṇakān likhet | yugmamekaṃ tṛtīyañca vedamekaikayugmakam || 3-42 ||
ekayugmaṃ tathaikañca yugalaṃ yugalaṃ yugam | ekaṃ yugmaṃ tṛtīyañca candranetraṃ vividhaṃ vidhum || 3-43 ||
candrayugmaṃ candrayugmaṃ rāmavedaṃ gṛhe śubhe | varṇāḥ kramāḥ svarāṇyeva revatyaśvigatāvubhau || 3-44 ||
akāradvayamaśvinyāṃ devatāgaṇasambhavāḥ | ikāraṃ bharaṇī satyāṃ kṛtsnamusvarakṛttikā || 3-45 ||
rākṣasī kṛttikā bhūmau sarvavidhnavināśinī | nāsikāgaṇḍamantrañca rohiṇīśavarūpiṇī || 3-46 ||
oṣṭhamadhye mṛgaśirā devatā parikītītā | adharāntamārdrayā ca mānuṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam || 3-47 ||
dantayugmaṃ punarvasvācchāditaṃ mānuṣaṃ priyam | kaḥ puṣyā devatā jñeyā khagāśleṣā ca rākṣasī || 3-48 ||
maghāvakṣe ghaṅāntā ca tathā ca pūrvaphālgunī | chajottarā(--)phalgunī ca manuṣyāḥ parikītītāḥ || 3-49 ||
jhañahastā devagaṇā ṭaṭhacitrā ca rākṣasī | ḍasvātī devaramaṇī viśākhā ḍhaṇarākṣasī || 3-50 ||
tathadānurādhayā ca śobhitā devanāyikā | dha jyeṣṭhā rākṣasī jñeyā mūlānapapharākṣasī || 3-51 ||
pūrvāṣāḍhā mānusānī bakārākṣayamālinī | bhottarāṣāḍhayā martyo makāraḥ śravaṇaḥ mataḥ || 3-52 ||
dhaniṣṭhā yararakṣaḥ strīlasthā śatabhiṣā tathā | vaśapūrvabhādrapadā manujāḥ parikītītāḥ || 3-53 ||
tathottarābhādrapadā mānuṣī(--)maṅgalodbhavā | aṃ aḥ ḷhakṣarevatī ca devakanyāḥ prakītītāḥ || 3-54 ||
svajātau paramā prītirmadhyamā bhinnajātiṣu | rakṣomānuṣayornāśo vairaṃ dānavadevayoḥ || 3-55 ||
janmasampat vipat kṣemapratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ | mitraṃ paramamitrañca gaṇayecca punaḥ punaḥ || 3-56 ||
varjayejjanmanakṣatraṃ tṛtīyaṃ pañcasaptakam | ṣaḍaṣṭanavabhadrāṇi yugañca yugmakaṃ tathā || 3-57 ||
yadīha nijanakṣatraṃ na jānāti dvijottamaḥ | nāmādyakṣarasambhūtaṃ svatāramavirodhakam || 3-58 ||
vinīya gaṇayenmantrī śubhāśubhavicāravān | prādakṣiṇyena gaṇayet sādhakādyakṣarāt sudhīḥ || 3-59 ||
ityetat kathitaṃ nātha mamātmā puruṣeśvara | kulākulamanantākhyaṃ tārācakraṃ manorguṇa || 3-60 ||
tārāmantraṃ pradīpābhaṃ ratnabhāṇḍasthitāmṛtam | etadvicāre mahatīṃ siddhimāpnoti mānavaḥ || 3-61 ||
rāśicakraṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhilakṣaṇamuttamam | krameṇa deyā yugalā rekhā pūrvāparodgamā || 3-62 ||
tanmadhyato dvayaṃ dadyād rekhāgnidakṣiṇe tataḥ | agninairṛtivāyavīśakrameṇa rekhayet tathā || 3-63 ||
vilikhenmeṣarāśyādi mīnāntaṃ sarvavarṇakān | kanyāgṛhagatān śādivarṇānālikhya yatnataḥ || 3-64 ||
gaṇayetsādhakaśreṣṭho lagnādyāmavyayāntakān | svarāśidevakoṣṭhānāmanukūlān bhajenmanūn || 3-65 ||
rāśīnāṃ śuddhatā jñeyā tyajet śatrumṛtiṃ vyayam | svarāśermantrarāśyantaṃ gaṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 3-66 ||
sādhyādyakṣararāśyantaṃ gaṇayet sādhakākṣarāt | ekaṃ vā pañca navamaṃ bāndhavaṃ parikītītam || 3-67 ||
dviṣaḍdaśamasaṃsthāśca sevakāḥ parikītītāḥ | rāmarudrāśca munayaḥ poṣakāḥ parikītītāḥ || 3-68 ||
sūryāṣṭavedayuktāstu ghātakāḥ sarvadoṣadāḥ | śaktyādau tu mahādeva kulacūḍāmaṇiryatiḥ || 3-69 ||
varjayet ṣaṣṭhagehañca aṣṭamaṃ dvādaśaṃ tathā | lagnaṃ dhanaṃ bhrātṛbandhuputraśatrukalatrakāḥ || 3-70 ||
maraṇaṃ dharmakarmāyavyayā dvādaśarāśayaḥ | nāmānurūpameteṣāṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ diśet || 3-71 ||
vaiṣṇave tu mahāśatroḥ sthāne bandhuḥ prakītītaḥ | kūrmacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi śubhāśubhaphalātmakam || 3-72 ||
yajjñātvā sarvaśāstrāṇi jānāti paṇḍitottamaḥ | abhedyabhedakaṃ cakraṃ śṛṇuṣvādarapūrvakam || 3-73 ||
kūrmākāraṃ mahācakraṃ catuṣpādasamāvṛtam | muṇḍe svarā dakṣapāde kavargaṃ vāmapādake || 3-74 ||
cavargaṃ kītītaṃ paścād adhaḥpāde ṭavargakam | tadadhastu tavargaṃ syādudare ca pavargakam || 3-75 ||
yavāntaṃ hṛdaye proktaṃ sahāntaṃ pṛṣṭhamadhyake | lāṅgūle śatrubījañca kṣakāraṃ liṅgamadhyake || 3-76 ||
likhitvā gaṇayenmantrī cakraṃ kalimalāpaham | svare lābhaṃ kavarge śrīścavarge ca vivekadam || 3-77 ||
ṭavarge rājapadavīṃ tavarge dhanavān bhavet | udare sarvanāśaḥ syād hṛdaye bahuduḥkhadam || 3-78 ||
pṛṣṭhe ca sarvasantoṣaṃ lāṅgūle maraṇaṃ dhruvam | vaibhavaṃ (pṛṣṭha?)liṅgadeśe tu duḥkhañca vāmapādake || 3-79 ||
viruddhadvayalābhe tu na kuryāccakracintanam | viruddhaike dharmanāśo yugmadoṣe ca māraṇam || 3-80 ||
yatra devākṣarañcāsti tatra cennijavarṇakam | viruddhañcettyajet śatrumanyamantraṃ vicārayet || 3-81 ||
pṛthaksthāne yadi bhavedvarṇamālā maheśvara | yadi tat saukhyabhāvaḥ syāt saukhyaṃ nāpi vivarjayet || 3-82 ||
vibhinnagehe doṣaścet śubhamantrañca santyajet | iti te kathitaṃ devi(deva) dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam || 3-83 ||
yaḥ śodhayeccared varṇaṃ mantramālāmaheśvaraḥ | yadi śudhyati cakrendraṃ mantrasiddhipradaṃ śubham || 3-84 ||
śivacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi mahākālakuleśvara | avaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti śivacakraprabhāvataḥ || 3-85 ||
ṣaṭkoṇamadhyadeśe tu caturasraṃ likhed budhaḥ | tanmadhye vilikheccāru caturasraṃ savarṇakam || 3-86 ||
mastakasthatrikoṇe tu śivasaṃsthānamantrakam | dakṣiṇāvartamānena gaṇayet sarvamantrakam || 3-87 ||
viṣṇusthāne svamantrañca dvitīye ca trikoṇake | trikoṇe ca tṛtīye ca brahmasaṃsthānamantrakam || 3-88 ||
śaktimantrādisaṃsthānaṃ trikoṇādho mukhe tathā | nāyikāmantrasaṃsthānaṃ trikoṇādho mukhe tathā || 3-89 ||
nāyikāmantrasaṃsthānaṃ tadvāme durlabhaṃ śubham | tadūdrdhve ca trikoṇe ca bhūtasaṃsthānamantrakam || 3-90 ||
śivādho yakṣamantrasya saṃsthānamatidurlabham | viṣṇubrahmasandhideśe mahāvidyāpadaṃ dhruvam || 3-91 ||
svarasthānaṃ tathā varṇasthānaṃ śṛṇu mahāprabho | a(--)āvarṇaṃdvayaṃ śaive kavargañca sabindukam || 3-92 ||
viṣṇau netraṃ cavargañca ṭavargaṃ brahmaṇi śrutam | tavargaṃ nāsikāśaktau sarvamantrārthacetanam || 3-93 ||
nāyikāyāṃ pavargañca na yugaṃ parikītītam | bhūte yavāntaṃ vilikhedoṣṭhādharasamanvitam || 3-94 ||
praṇavaṃ yakṣamantre ca śakāraṃ parikītītam | adhodantaṃ piśāce ca ṣayuktaṃ bindubhūṣitam || 3-95 ||
śivo bījaṃ devamantre sakārañca sabindukam | mahāvidyādisaṃsthāne lakṣavarṇaṃ prakītītam || 3-96 ||
iti te kathitaṃ śambho śṛṇu varṇāṅka(ṅga)varṇanam | śive ekaviṃśatiśca dvātriṃśadviṣṇukoṇake || 3-97 ||
brahmaṇe ṣoḍaśādyañca śaktikūṭe yugāṣṭakam | nāyikāyāṃ vahnibāṇaṃ bhūte saptāṅkameva ca || 3-98 ||
yakṣe ca candravedañca piśāce'ṣṭavasuḥ smṛtaḥ | sarvadeve bāṇavedaṃ kṛtyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṣaṣṭhakam || 3-99 ||
madhye ṣaṣṭhe hutāśañca mahāvidyāgṛhe śubhe | sādhakasya ca sādhyasyaikāṅkaṃ sādhyamandire || 3-100 ||
sādhakāṅkamūrdhvadeśe sādhyāṅkaṃ gaṇayedadhaḥ | bhujayugmaṃ śive proktaṃ viṣṇau vāmāṣṭakaṃ tathā || 3-101 ||
ṛṣicandraṃ vidhau proktaṃ śaktau rāmāṣṭakaṃ tathā | nāyikāyāṃ vedabāṇaṃ bhūte'ṣṭanavamaṃ tathā || 3-102 ||
yakṣe yugmaṃ caturthaṃ ca piśāce vajrakāṣṭakam | śaktau vaśakṛtau jñeyau kṛtyā(la)yāṃ muniṣaṣṭhakam || 3-103 ||
yasmin yasmin gṛhasthā ye devatāstu mahāphalāḥ | ka0 | anāmākṣaradehasthamakṣaraṃ dviguṇaṃ smṛtam | sādhyāṅkena yojayitvā pūrayetṣaṣṭhapañcamaiḥ || 3-104 ||
tadgehaṃ grāhayed yatnāt devatādyakṣaraṃ yathā | ekaśeṣasthitaṃ varṇaṃ kuryānnāpi vivecanam || 3-105 ||
śuddhaṃ taddhi vijānīyādvicāramanyato'pi ca | ṣaṣṭhāṅkena ca vedāṅkaṃ tathā ca devavarṇakam || 3-106 ||
śaśāṅkaṃ miśritaṃ cāṅkaṃ dviguṇaṃ devatārṇakam | ka0 | paścāt kṛtvā tadaṅkañca haredrāmeṇa vallabha | yadi sādhyāṅkaṃ vistīrṇaṃ tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavet || 3-107 ||
sādhakāṅkañca vistīrṇaṃ yadi syājjāyate gṛhe | tadā sarvakuleśaḥ syād rudraśravaṇasaṃśayaḥ || 3-108 ||
dviguṇaṃ devatāvarṇaṃ sādhakāṅkena yojayet | varṇasaṃkhyāṅkamālikhya gaṇayet sādhakottamaḥ || 3-109 ||
rasabāṇena sampūrya saṃharet rasasaṃkhyayā | ātmāṅkamiśritaṃ paścād yadi kiñcinna tiṣṭhati || 3-110 ||
svīyābhidhānakāṅkasya dviguṇañcāpi yojayet | paścādanalasaṃkhyābhirharet saukhyāthīmuktaye || 3-111 ||
aṅkaṃ bahutaraṃ grāhyaṃ sādhakasya sukhāvaham | na grāhyaṃ sādhyavistīrṇami(ma?)tiśāstrārthaniścayam || 3-112 ||
vicārādasya cakrasya rājatvaṃ labhate dhruvam | samānāṅkena gṛhṇīyād guṇyāṅkaṃ varjayediha || 3-113 ||
avaśyaṃ cakramevaṃ hi gopanīyaṃ surāsuraiḥ | viṣṇucakraṃ pravakṣyāmi cakrākāraṃ sugopanam || 3-114 ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ śuddhaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvā phalapradam | śṛṇu nātha mahāviṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ maṅgaladāyakam || 3-115 ||
lakṣmīpriyamaṅkamayaṃ navakoṇaṃ mahāprabham | tadūrdhve ca tamālikhya tadūdrdhve'ṣṭagrahaṃ śubham || 3-116 ||
catuṣkoṇākāragehaṃ sandhau śūnyāṣṭakaṃ likhet | tadūrdhve ca tamālikhya cakrametaddhaneśvara || 3-117 ||
pūrve mahendrābharaṇamūdrdhvadeśollasatkaram | munirāmakhacandrādyamaṅkaṃ sarvasamṛddhidam || 3-118 ||
dakṣiṇe vahnibharaṇaṃ rasavede khayugmakam | tadadho rāmacakrañca saptaṣaṭsu ca rāmakam || 3-119 ||
tadadho nirṛte svarge yugāṅkaśūnyavedakam | kevalādho jaleśasya mandiraṃ sumanoharam || 3-120 ||
rāmeṣu śūnyabāṇāḍhyaṃ tasyāmevāyumandiram | bhujahastakharasāḍhyaṃ cakredamīśvarātmakam || 3-121 ||
navakoṇaṃ madhyadeśe pañcāṅgabhāgamālikhet | tanmadhye racayedvarṇaṃ pañcakoṇe trikoṇake || 3-122 ||
indrādho vilikhed dhīro varṇamādyañca saptakam | bhāge dakṣiṇakoṇeṣu ṛkārādaṅkakaṃ likhet || 3-123 ||
kakārādiṭakārāntaṃ tadadho vilikhed budhaḥ | tadvāme ṭhādimāntañca varṇalakṣaṇakāraṇam || 3-124 ||
tadūdrdhve yādivarṇañca cakrañca gaṇayettataḥ | pūrvakoṇapatiḥ śakro dvitīyeśau yamānalau || 3-125 ||
nirṛtirvaruṇaścaiva tṛtīyamandireśvaraḥ | caturthādhipatirvāyuḥ kubero nātha ityapi || 3-126 ||
pañcagehasyādhipatirīśo viśvavidāmbaraḥ | pañcakoṇe pratiṣṭhanti pañcabhūtāśayasthitāḥ || 3-127 ||
prāṇe siddhimavāpnoti cāpāne vyādhipīḍanam | samāne sarvasampattirudāne nirdhanaṃ bhavet || 3-128 ||
vyāne ca īśvaraprāptiretasmin lakṣaṇaṃ śubham | pūrvagehe mahāmantraṃ mantratyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ || 3-129 ||
sa tāvat sādhakaśreṣṭho viṣṇumārgeṇa śaṅkara | viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu yatnena sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 3-130 ||
saptākṣaraṃ tryakṣaraṃ ca daśamākṣarameva ca | pūrvagehe yadi bhavedādyākṣarasamanvitam || 3-131 ||
tadā bhavati siddhiśca sarvamevaṃprakārakam | ṣaṣṭhākṣaraṃ vedavarṇaṃ viṃśatyarṇaṃ mahāmanum || 3-132 ||
āmnāyādyakṣaraṃ vyāptaṃ saphalaṃ gaṇayed budhaḥ | tathāsmin mama gehe ca mantraṃ saptākṣaraṃ śubham || 3-133 ||
ṣaṣṭhākṣarañca gaṇayettriṃśadakṣarameva ca | ādyākṣarasamāyuktaṃ sādhyasādhakayorapi || 3-134 ||
ekasyāpi ca lābhe ca mantrasiddhirakhaṇḍitā | mantrākṣarādilābhañca avaśyaṃ gaṇayediha || 3-135 ||
nairṛte ca jaleśasya dvayakṣarañca navākṣaram | śūnyadevākṣaraṃ nātha gaṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 3-136 ||
tathātra akṣaraṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaramanaṃ tathā | pañcāśadakṣaraṃ mantraṃ mandire gaṇayet śubham || 3-137 ||
vāyukoṇe kuberasya mandire gaṇayettathā | dvāviṃśatyakṣaraṃ mantraṃ śūnyaṣaṣṭhamanuṃ tathā || 3-138 ||
pañcākṣaraṃ tārikāyāḥ śive pañcākṣaraṃ tathā | susaptamantragrahaṇe saphalaṃ parikītītam || 3-139 ||
īśānapañcakoṇe ca saphalañca navākṣaram | aṣṭākṣaraṃ hi vidyāyā gaṇayet sahitaṃ sudhīḥ || 3-140 ||
etaduktañca gaṇayedviruddhaṃ naiva śīlayet | prāṇamitraṃ samānañca samāno vyānabāndhavaḥ || 3-141 ||
etatsthitañca gṛhṇīyād doṣabhāk sa bhavet kvacit | ekadaiva priye prītirekagehe tathā priyam || 3-142 ||
gṛhītvā viṣṇupadavīṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ kṣaṇāt | yadi cakraṃ na vicārya ripumantraṃ sadā nyaset || 3-143 ||
nijāyuṣaṃ chinattyeva mūko bhavati niścitam | vicārya yadi yatnena sarvacakre priyaṃ hitam || 3-144 ||
mahāmantraṃ mahādeva laghu siddhyati bhūtale || 3-145 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane sarvacakrānuṣṭhāne siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhāvanirṇaye bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 3 ||
[atha caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrībhairavī uvāca
atha vakṣyāmi cakrānyat śṛṇu bhairava sādaram | yena hīnā na siddhyanti mahāvidyā varapradāḥ || 4-1 ||
tava cakraṃ brahmaṇā vyaktaṃ brahmacakramudāhṛtam | yasya jñānāt svayaṃ brahmā svabalena bhavaṃ sṛjet || 4-2 ||
akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ paraṃ brahmapadaṃ vraje | catuṣkoṇe catuṣkoṇaṃ tanmadhye ca catuścatuḥ || 4-3 ||
madhyagehaṃ veṣṭayitvā iṣṭaṃ mandiramuttamam | aṣṭakoṇe mahādeva ṣoḍaśasvaramālikhet || 4-4 ||
aṣṭakoṇaṃ veṣṭayittvā vṛttayugmaṃ likhet sudhīḥ | madhyagehe catuṣkoṇe kādikṣāntañca varṇakam || 4-5 ||
dakṣiṇāvarttayogena vilikhet sādhakottamaḥ | tadūdrdhve svagṛhe cāṅkaṃ vilikhya gaṇayet sudhīḥ || 4-6 ||
caturgehasyodrdhvadeśe yugmagehe kramāllikhet | sādhyasya sādhakasyāpi meṣādikanyakāntakam || 4-7 ||
adho likhettulādyantamiti rāśyādikaṃ śubham | tato likhed gehadakṣe yugmagehe maheśvara || 4-8 ||
tārakānaśvinī tārādyantān dakṣiṇato likhet | varṇakrameṇa vilikhed vedamandiramaṇḍale || 4-9 ||
ūdrdhvādhaḥ kramaśo lekhyamaṅgatāraṃ sureśvara | tato hi gaṇayenmantrī yojayitvā krameṇa tu || 4-10 ||
sukhaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ vṛddhiṃ kalahaṃ kāladarśanam | siddhimṛddhimaṣṭakoṇe viditvā ca śubhāśubham || 4-11 ||
gaṇayedrāśinakṣatraṃ manucāhaṃ vivarjayet | sukhe sukhamavāpnoti rājye rājyamavāpnuyāt || 4-12 ||
dhane dhanamavāpnoti vṛddhau vṛddhimavāpnuyāt | meṣo vṛṣamithunaśca karkaṭaḥ siṃha eva ca | kanyakā devatā jñeyā nakṣatrāṇi punaḥ śṛṇu || 4-13 ||
ūdrdhvayugmagṛhasyāpi dakṣavāme ca bhāgake | nakṣatrāṇi santi yāni tāni śṛṇu mahāprabho || 4-14 ||
aśvinī mṛgaśirāśleṣā hastānurādhikā tathā | uttarāṣāḍhikārdrā vā pūrvabhādrapadā tathā || 4-15 ||
dakṣāgrahastitāstārāḥ spaṣṭībhūtāśca devatāḥ | etāsāmadhipā ete rāśayo graharūpiṇaḥ || 4-16 ||
karkaṭakeśarī kanyādevatāḥ parikītītāḥ | eteṣāñcāpi varṇānāmadhipāśceti rāśayaḥ || 4-17 ||
kakārasya(ḍha?) khakārasya ñakārasya ṭakārapaḥ | dakārasya phakārasya yakārasya sakārapaḥ || 4-18 ||
nakārasyāpi patayo jñeyāśca kramaśaḥ prabho | saṃśṛṇu rohiṇīpuṣyā tathā cottaraphālgunī || 4-19 ||
viśākhā ca tathā jñeyā pūrvāṣāḍhā ca tārakā | tathā śatabhiṣātārā vāmamandiraparvagāḥ || 4-20 ||
etāsāmadhipā ete rāśayo graharūpiṇaḥ | meṣo vṛṣo mithunaśca īśvarāḥ parikītītāḥ || 4-21 ||
etadgehasthitaṃ varṇamete rakṣantyanityaśaḥ | kakārasya nakārasya ṛkārasya ukārapaḥ || 4-22 ||
akārasya pakārasya makārasya vakārapaḥ | hakārasyādhipā ete ṛddhimokṣaphalapradāḥ || 4-23 ||
dakṣiṇādhogṛhasyāpi devatā iti rāśayaḥ | tulā ca vṛścikaścaiva dhanuścaiva graheśvaraḥ || 4-24 ||
etāsāṃ tārakāṇāñca patayo gaditā mayā | bharaṇyārdramaghācitrājyeṣṭhāśravaṇavallabhāḥ || 4-25 ||
tathottarabhādrapadā vallabhāḥ rāśayo matāḥ | atha gehasthitaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṇu nātha bhayāpaha || 4-26 ||
yakārasya dakārasya ṭakārasya nakārapaḥ | dhakārasya vakārasya cakārasya yakārapaḥ || 4-27 ||
kṣakārapaṇakā ete rāśayaḥ parikītītāḥ | dhanavṛttipradā nityā nityasthānanivāsinaḥ || 4-28 ||
vāmādhomandirasyāpi vallabhā iti rāśayaḥ | makarādhastu koṣṭheṣu mīno rāśiphalasthitāḥ || 4-29 ||
etāni bhāni rakṣanti śūlapāśāsidhārakāḥ | punarvasuḥ kṛttikā ca tathābhaṃpūrvaphalgunī || 4-30 ||
svātī mūlā dhaniṣṭhā ca revatī vāmagehagāḥ | etāsāmadhipā ete jalasthā grahadevatāḥ || 4-31 ||
etān varṇān prarakṣanti gṛhasthā nava rāśayaḥ | dhakārasya jakārasya ṭakārasya takārapaḥ || 4-32 ||
nakārasya bhakārasya lakārasya takārapaḥ | kalahādimahādoṣakāladarśanakārakāḥ || 4-33 ||
rāśayo lokahā nātha tanmantraṃ parivarjayet | yadyekadevatāgehaṃ vibhinnañca suśobhanam || 4-34 ||
catuḥ sthānaṃ yugasthānaṃ sarvatrāpi niṣedhakam | ekagehasthitaṃ mantraṃ bahusaukhyapradāyakam || 4-35 ||
nāmna ādyakṣaraṃ nītvā rāśinakṣatravismṛtau | sabhāvaṃ sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kalahe kalahaṃ bhavet || 4-36 ||
ripuścenmūlanāśaḥ syāt kalaho'pi sureśvara | netrayugmaṃ svaraṃ pāti siṃho hi kanyakāṃ tathā || 4-37 ||
karṇayugmaṃ tulā pāti saṃyugaṃ vṛściko dhanuḥ | cayugaṃ makaraḥ pāti kumbho mīnaśca pāti hi || 4-38 ||
oṣṭhañca pāti ca tathā adharaṃ meṣa eva ca | dantayugmaṃ vṛṣaḥ pāti mithunaḥ śeṣago'kṣaraḥ || 4-39 ||
yasya ye ye rāśayaḥ syustasya tattacchubhaṃ smṛtam | ekarāśiḥ śubhaṃ nityaṃ dadāti ca manoratham || 4-40 ||
anyatra dukhadaṃ proktaṃ sādhakaḥ siddhibhāg bhavet | bhinnarāśau varjanīyaṃ kalahaṃ kāladarśanam || 4-41 ||
śrūyatāṃ śailajānātha cakraṃ śrītridaśātmakam | pūrvapaścimabhedena ṣaṭ ca rekhāḥ samālikhet || 4-42 ||
vāmādi dakṣiṇāntañca rekhā daśa samālikhet | pañcagehe pūrakāṅkaṃ sarvādhohārakāṅkakam || 4-43 ||
tanmadhye racayedakṣaṃ devatāgrahasaṃyutam | pūrakāṅkaṃ madhyagehe saptaṣīyuktamālikhet || 4-44 ||
taddakṣiṇe dvādaśañca taddakṣeṇa rasaṃ tathā | taddakṣe aṣṭadaśake taddakṣe ṣoḍaśasmṛtam || 4-45 ||
pūrakāṅkaṃ tato lekhyaṃ indrādyaṅkāśca dakṣataḥ | indragehe ca śatakaṃ vidhividyāphalapradam || 4-46 ||
dharmagehe śūnyasapta yugalaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ | anantamandire nātha śūnyāṣṭavasureva ca || 4-47 ||
kālīgṛhe śūnyavedavāmādyāṅkaṃ vilikhettataḥ | dhūmāvatīmandire ca śūnyakheṣu niśāpatim || 4-48 ||
indrādyā dakṣato lekhyā aṅkāścandrādhidevatāḥ | śūnyāṣṭacandrayuktañca sarvatra devatā likhet || 4-49 ||
tathāśvinīkumārau ca śūnyānalayugāyugau | tatpaścāt pūrvagehañca sahasrārkasamanvitam || 4-50 ||
tāriṇīmandirasthāṅkaṃ śūnyavedaṃ tathaiva ca | bagalāmukhīgehasthaṃ śūnyāṣṭacandrasaṃyutam || 4-51 ||
tataścandragṛhasyādho vāyurgehaṃ manoramam | randhravedātmakaṃ gehaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 4-52 ||
rāhugehaṃ mahāpāpaṃ śūnyaśūnyamunipriyam | paścādekatra hastañca khaśūnyayugalātmakam || 4-53 ||
ṣoḍaśīmandire śūnyamaṣṭacandrasamanvitam | mātaṅgīmandire śūnyarudracandrasamanvitam || 4-54 ||
vāyoradhovaruṇasya gṛhaṃ saptaśaśipriyam | taruṇī gehamadhye ca śūnyāṣṭakasamanvitam || 4-55 ||
budhagehasthitāṅkañca śūnyacandrayugātmakam | bhuvaneśīmandirasthaṃ śūnyāṣṭakaśaśipriyam || 4-56 ||
varuṇādhaḥ kuberasya gṛhasthaṃ ṣaṭ ca yugmakam | ānantabhairavī gehe daśakaṃ parikītītam || 4-57 ||
dharaṇīgṛhamadhye ca śūnyayugmendusaṃyutam | bhairavī gṛhamadhyasthaṃ śūnyayugalacandrakam || 4-58 ||
rāśigṛhasthitaṃ śūnyaṣīcandramaṇḍalasaṃyutam | kuberādhaḥ svakaṃ cakrasthitāṅkaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 4-59 ||
īśvarasya gṛhasthañca saptaśūnyayugātmakam | tiraskariṇyā gehasthaṃ sahasrāṅkasamanvitam || 4-60 ||
kiṅkiṇīmandiraṃ paścādaṣṭacandrasamanvitam | chinnamastāgṛhaṃ paścācchūnyāṣṭacandramaṇḍalam || 4-61 ||
vāgīśvarīgṛhaṃ paścāt saptamaṃ candramaṇḍalam | mahāphalapradātāraṃ dharmo rakṣati taṃ punaḥ || 4-62 ||
īśvarasya adhogehe baṭukasya gṛhaṃ tataḥ | śūnyāṣṭamādyaṃ svagṛhaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam || 4-63 ||
tatpaścāt ḍākinīgehaṃ khaśūnyamunisaṃyutam | hanti sādhakasaukhyaṃ hi kṣaṇādeva na saṃśayaḥ || 4-64 ||
svagṛhe svīyamantrasya phaladaṃ parikītītam | bhīmādevīgṛhaṃ paścāt khasaptacandramaṇḍalam || 4-65 ||
bhayadaṃ sarvadeśe tu varjayed gṛhāntaram | lakṣavarṇaṃ likhet śeṣagṛhe dve paṇḍitottamaḥ || 4-66 ||
indragehāvadhiṃ dhīro vakārādikavarṇakam | kṣakārāntaṃ likhettatra gaṇayet sādhakastataḥ || 4-67 ||
pūrakāṅkamūdrdhvadeśe hārakāṅkamadho likhet | nijanāmākṣaraṃ yatra tatkoṣṭhāṅkaṃ maheśvara || 4-68 ||
nīttvā ca pūjayedvidvān svasvagehordhvadeśagaiḥ | aṅkaistato harernātha adho'ṅke hāryaśeṣakam || 4-69 ||
vistārañceddevatāṅgastadaṅgaḥ śubhadaḥ smṛtaḥ | alpāṅgaḥ śubhadaḥ proktaḥ sādhakasya sukhāvahaḥ || 4-70 ||
ekākṣare mahāsaukhyaṃ tatrāpi gaṇayed vacaḥ | dhīrāṅkaḥ śūnyagāmī ca devatāṅkastathā vibho || 4-71 ||
tadā naiva śubhaṃ vidyādaśubhāya prakalpyate | eke dhanamavāpnoti dvitīye rājavallabhaḥ || 4-72 ||
tṛtīye jāpyasiddhiḥ syāccaturthe maraṇaṃ dhruvam | pañcame pañcamānaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhe duḥkhotkaṭāni ca || 4-73 ||
śaivānāṃ śāktavarṇānāmityaṅkaḥ parigṛhyate | vaiṣṇavānāṃ niṣedhe ca pañcamāṅko niṣedhakaḥ || 4-74 ||
yāsāṃ yāsāṃ devatānāṃ hiṃsā tiṣṭhati cetasi | tanmantragrahaṇādevāṣṭaiśvaryayuto bhavet || 4-75 ||
yaddevasyāśritā ye tu tadgṛhāṅkaṃ haranti te | ūdrdhvāṅkena pūrayittvā adho'ṅkena haretsadā || 4-76 ||
ṛṇidhanimahācakraṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ | darśanādeva koṣṭhasya jānāti pūrvajanmagam || 4-77 ||
devaṃ bahutarāṅgeṣu jñātvā siddhīśvaro bhavet | nijasevyāṃ mahāvidyāṃ gṛhītvā muktimāpnuyāt || 4-78 ||
koṣṭhaśuddhañca mantrañca ye gṛhṇanti dvijottamāḥ | teṣāṃ duḥkhāni naśyanti mamājñā balavattarā || 4-79 ||
koṣṭhaśuddhaṃ mahāmantraṃ phaladaṃ rudrabhairava | na hātavyaṃ mahāmantraṃ sadgurupriyadarśanāt || 4-80 ||
tatra koṣṭhaṃ na vicāryaṃ cejjānāti vicāryakam | mahāvidyā mahāmantre vicāryakoṭipuṇyabhāk || 4-81 ||
avicāre coktaphalaṃ dadāti kāmasundarī | koṣṭhānyekādaśānyeva devena pūritāni ca || 4-82 ||
akārādihakārāntaṃ likhet koṣṭheṣu tattvavit | prathamaṃ pañcakoṣṭheṣu hrasvadīrghakrameṇa tu || 4-83 ||
dvayaṃ dvayaṃ likhettatra vicāre khalu sādhakaḥ | śeṣeṣvekaikaśo varṇān kramaśastu likhetsudhīḥ || 4-84 ||
amāvarṇa dvayasyārddhāvadhistu kramaśo'ṅkakam | ādyamandiramadhye tu ṣaṣṭhāṅkaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ || 4-85 ||
dvitīye ṣaṣṭhacinhañca tṛtīye ca gṛhe tathā | caturthe gaganāṅkañca pañcame cakratrayaṃ tathā || 4-86 ||
ṣaṣṭhacāpe caturthañca saptame ca caturthakam | aṣṭame gaganāṅkañca navame daśamaṃ tathā || 4-87 ||
śeṣamandiramadhye tu trayāṅkaṃ vilikhettataḥ | ete nātha sādhyavarṇāḥ kathitāḥ kramaśo dhruvam || 4-88 ||
kathayāmi sādhakārṇaṃ sakalārthanirūpaṇam | ādyagehe dvitīyañca dvitīye ca tṛtīyakam || 4-89 ||
tṛtīye pañcamaṃ proktaṃ gaganaṃ vedapañcake | ṣaṣṭhe yugalamevaṃ hi saptame candramaṇḍalam || 4-90 ||
aṣṭame gaganaṃ proktaṃ navame ca caturthakam | vedañca daśame proktaṃ candramekādaśe tathā || 4-91 ||
sādhakārṇāḥ smṛtāḥ tvete varṇamaṇḍalamadhyagāḥ | sādhyavarṇān mahādeva svaravyañjanabhedakān || 4-92 ||
evaṃ hi sarvamantrārṇānamaṣṭādyaṅkaiḥ prapūrayet | ekīkṛtya haredaṣṭasaṃkhyābhiḥ kṣaṇavallabhe || 4-93 ||
yasyāpahasthitaṃ varṇaṃ tannebhavyaṃ manau śubhe | sādhakābhidhānavarṇā svaravyañjanabhedakān || 4-94 ||
pṛthak pṛthak saṃsthitāṃśca vyaktaṃ śṛṇu punaḥ punaḥ | dvitīyādyaṅkacandrānte saṃpūrvāṣṭabhirāharet || 4-95 ||
mantro yastvadhikāṅkaḥ syāttadā mantraṃ japet sudhīḥ | same'pi ca japenmantraṃ na japettu ṛṇādhike || 4-96 ||
śūnye mṛtyuṃ vijānīyāttasmācchūnyaṃ vivarjayet | dvitīyādyaṅkajālañca vaiṣṇave sukhadaṃ smṛtam || 4-97 ||
dvitīyādyaṅkajālañca vaiṣṇave sukhadaṃ smṛtam | dvitīyādyaṅkajālañca tathā vai parikītītam || 4-98 ||
indrādyaṅkaṃ tathā nātha saure śākte śubhapradam | tathā diksaṃkhyakāṅkañca sādhakasya śubhapradam || 4-99 ||
tadaṅkaṃ śṛṇu yatnena pūrvavat sakalaṃ smṛtam | sthalañcaiva vibhinnāṅkamūdrdhvādhaśca krameṇa tu || 4-100 ||
sādhyāṅkān sādhakāṅkāśca pūrayed gṛhasaṃkhyayā | guṇite tu hṛte cāpi yaccheṣaṃ jāyate sphuṭam || 4-101 ||
tadaṅkaṃ kathayāmyatra ekādaśagṛhe sthitam | indratārāsvargaravitithiṣaḍvedadāhanāḥ || 4-102 ||
aṣṭavasu navāṅkasthāḥ sādhyārṇaguṇitā iti | digbhūgiriśrutigajavahniparvatapañcamāḥ || 4-103 ||
vedaṣaṣṭhānalāṅkañca gaṇayet sādhakākṣarān | nāmādyakṣaramārabhya yāvanmantrākṣaraṃ bhavet || 4-104 ||
tatsaṃkhyāñca tridhā kṛtvā saptabhiḥ saṃhared budhaḥ | adhikaṃ ca ṛṇaṃ proktaṃ taccheṣaṃ dhanamucyate || 4-105 ||
athavānyaprakārañca kṛtvā mantraṃ samāśrayet | nāmādyakṣaramārabhya yāvat sādhakavarṇakam || 4-106 ||
tāvatsaṃkhyāṃ saptaguṇaṃ kṛtvā vāmairhared budhaḥ | śrīvidyetaravidyāyāṃ gaṇanā parikītītā || 4-107 ||
athavānyaprakārañca sakalān sādhakākṣarān | svaravyañjanabhedena dviguṇīkṛtya sādhakaḥ || 4-108 ||
sādhyayuktaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svaravyañjanabhedakam | aṣṭābhiḥ saṃharedaṅkaṃ śṛṇu saṃhāravigraham || 4-109 ||
pūrvacārakramaṃ samyak sarvatrāpi śubhāśubham | asya vicāramātreṇa siddhiḥ sarvārthasādhikā || 4-110 ||
pūrvajanmārādhitāyāṃ tāṃ prāpnoti hi devatām | athānyat sampravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 4-111 ||
ulkācakraṃ sarvasāraṃ mantradoṣādinirṇayam | matsyākāramūrdhvamukhaṃ sarvamantrādi vigraham || 4-112 ||
skandhadeśāvadhirnātha pucchaparyantameva ca | ekākṣarādimantrādidvādaśāntākṣarātmakam || 4-113 ||
vilikhet pṛṣṭhadeśe tu śubhāśubhaviśuddhaye | trayodaśākṣarān vātha ekaviṃśākṣarāntakam || 4-114 ||
netavyaṃ sādhakairmantraṃ pṛṣṭhasthamudarasthakam | tathā śrīśubhadaṃ proktaṃ kaṇṭhādipucchakāntakam || 4-115 ||
dvāviṃśādi catustriśadakṣarāntamanuṃ śubham | pucchasthaṃ nāpi gṛhṇīyāt mukhasthañca tathā dhruvam || 4-116 ||
śīrṣasthañcāpi gṛhṇīyāt tadakṣaraṃ śṛṇu prabho | pañcatriṃśādi dvicaturdvāviṃśadantameva ca || 4-117 ||
mastakasthaṃ śubhaṃ proktaṃ mukhavarṇān śṛṇu prabho | tricatvāriṃśadarṇādi ekapañcāśadantakam || 4-118 ||
mukhasthamantamaśubhaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt kadācana | pṛṣṭhasthaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nirarthakamahāśramam || 4-119 ||
śramagātrasya pīḍābhirdevatā kupyate'niśam | dvipañcāśadakṣarādi ekaṣaṣṭitamāntakān || 4-120 ||
varṇān pucchasthitānetān netrasthān śṛṇu vallabha | dviṣaṣṭitamavarṇādi catuḥṣaṣṭyakṣarāntakān || 4-121 ||
aṅkaṃ locanasaṃsthaṃ ca tato'nyaṃ rasanāsthitam | tatsarvaṃ śubhadaṃ proktametadanyatamaṃ smṛtam || 4-122 ||
vaiṣṇavānāñca śaivānāṃ śāktānāṃ mantrajāpane | tato'nyadevabhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām || 4-123 ||
atha vakṣye mahādeva cakrasāraṃ sudurlabham | rāmacakraṃ mahāvidyā sarvamandirameva ca || 4-124 ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ mantraṃ nijanāmasthamāśrayet | tadaiva siddhimāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvara || 4-125 ||
tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu krodhabhairava priyavallabha | navāṅkān pralikhed vidvān vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ || 4-126 ||
tanmadhye kramaśo dadyāt tathā saptadaśāṅkakān | dakṣiṇādikrameṇaivamuktavidyāḥ samālikhet || 4-127 ||
akārādikṣakārāntaṃ sarvasmin mandire likhet | bālādidevatāḥ sarvā bhrāmaryantāśca devatāḥ || 4-128 ||
asyākāśavidhe gehe sāntanityaṃ phalapradam | punavīlomamārgeṇa ādikṣāntārṇamandire || 4-129 ||
raktadantādi śrīvidyā mantrāntaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ | kṣakārādyanulomena akārāntaṃ likhet tataḥ || 4-130 ||
punastaccheṣavidyāśca śeṣagehe likhet sadā | kāyaśodhanamukhyādi śailavāsini mantrakam || 4-131 ||
pañcaviṃśatigehasthaṃ gaṇayet sādhakastataḥ | gṛhasthamaṅkaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yogīśavallabha || 4-132 ||
bālāgṛhādiśeṣāntaṃ munihastavidhau gṛhe | krameṇa śṛṇu tatsarvaṃ sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 4-133 ||
dakṣiṇāvartayogena gaṇayet kramaśo budhaḥ | vasusaptapañcameṣuvahnivedānalastathā || 4-134 ||
muniṣaṣṭhādyavedāśca sapteṣumunayastathā | pañcavedeṣuvasavo vedeṣuvahnayastathā || 4-135 ||
vahnivedāśca samproktā ākāśaṃ tadanantaram | ākāśānantare gehe analaṃ parikītītam || 4-136 ||
tatpaścāt sarvageheṣu sarvāṅkaṃ dakṣataḥ śṛṇu | vahni vahnivedavahni vedavahnaya eva ca || 4-137 ||
śravaṇākṣivedabāṇa vedeṣu saptakastathā | ṣaṣṭhāṣṭasaptamāḥ proktā vahnyagnīṣu munistathā || 4-138 ||
munīṣu bāṇavedāśca munyagnivahnayastathā | vahnivedabāṇasapta aṣṭāṅkavedabāṇakāḥ || 4-139 ||
pañcasaptānalāgniśca vahnīṣubāṇabāṇakāḥ | bāṇavedakāntavedakāntaśruticaturthakāḥ || 4-140 ||
rāmaṣīmuniṣaṣṭhāśca sapteṣu rāmavedakāḥ | vedasaptāṣṭavasavo navamāṣṭamasaptamāḥ || 4-141 ||
vahnyagnivedabāṇāśca vasvaṣṭānalavedakāḥ | saptāṣṭamāśca samproktā gṛhāṅkāḥ parikītītāḥ || 4-142 ||
yeṣāṃ manasi yā vidyā sadā tiṣṭhati bhāvane | tāmāśritya japedvidvān tadā sidhyati niścitam || 4-143 ||
svanāma devatānāma pūrayet ṣoḍaśāṅkakaiḥ | harennijagṛhasthena cāṅkena sādhakottamaḥ || 4-144 ||
kṛtaśeṣaṃ bahutaraṃ śubhaṃ devasya niścitam | alpāṅkasādhakasyāpi saukhyameva na saṃśayaḥ || 4-145 ||
uktakrameṇa gaṇayet sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ | mahāvidyānāyikādiyajñabhūtādisādhane || 4-146 ||
samproktaṃ cakrasārañca sarvatantreṣu gopitam | tataścakravicāreṇa siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 4-147 ||
catuścakraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva pārvatīpate | vāmadakṣiṇayogena rekhāpañcakamālikhet || 4-148 ||
pūrvapaścimabhedena rekhāḥ pañca samālikhet | catuṣkoṣṭhe dakṣabhāge catuṣkoṣṭhe ca mantravit || 4-149 ||
tadadhaśca catuṣkoṣṭhe tadvāmasthe caturgṛhe | pralikhet kramaśaścādye caturmandiramadhyake || 4-150 ||
śīghrañca śītalaṃ japtaṃ siddhañcāpi tataḥ param | akārañca ukārañca ḷsokāraṃ tataḥ param || 4-151 ||
ūdrdhvasthamiti varṇaṃ tu śītalasthaṃ śṛṇu prabho | akārañca ukārañca(ḷ ḹ)saukārañca tataḥ param || 4-152 ||
tadadho japagehasthaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṇu mahāprabho | ikārañca ṛkārañca ekārañca tataḥ param || 4-153 ||
siddhagehasthitaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṇu sarvasukhapradam | taddakṣiṇacaturgehe sthitān varṇān vadāmi tān || 4-154 ||
āhlādañca pratyayañca mukhañca śuddhamityapi | etatkulasthān sarvārṇān śubhāśubhaphalapradān || 4-155 ||
kakārañca ṛkārañca ṝkārañca ñakārakam | āhlādasthamiti proktaṃ prāptimātreṇa siddhidam || 4-156 ||
pratyayasthaṃ gakārañca ghakāraṃ ṭaṭhamityapi | mukhasthaṃ hi ṅakārañca cakāraṃ ḍaḍhamityapi || 4-157 ||
śuddhasthañca ukārañca jakāraṃ ṇatamityapi | tadadhaḥsthaṃ caturgehaṃ laukikaṃ sāttvikaṃ tathā || 4-158 ||
mānasikaṃ rājasikaṃ caturgehasthitaṃ tvimam | laukikasthaṃ thakārañca dakārañca makārakam || 4-159 ||
sāttvikasthaṃ dhakārañca lakārañca yakārakam | mānasikañca śṛṇu bho pakārañca phamityapi || 4-160 ||
śṛṇu rājasikatvañca bhakāraṃ vanamityapi | tannāmasthaṃ caturgehaṃ śṛṇu pañcānana prabho || 4-161 ||
suptaṃ kṣiptañca liptañca duṣṭamantraṃ prakītītam | ūdrdhvagehasthitā varṇamantrān gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ || 4-162 ||
varjayitvā suptamantraṃ kṣiptaṃ liptañca duṣṭakam | ehike siddhimāpnoti pare muktimavāpnuyāt || 4-163 ||
yadyabhāgyavaśātsuptādiṣu geheṣu labhyate | tadā mantraṃ śodhayed vai suptastambhitakīlitaiḥ || 4-164 ||
vaddhītairdoṣajālasthairaśubhaṃ bhūtaśuddhaye | bhūtalipyā puṭīkṛtyā japtvā siddhiṃ tato labhet || 4-165 ||
na tu vā varjayed gehaṃ catuṣkaṃ varṇaveṣṭitam | suptagehasthitaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṇu pañcānana prabho || 4-166 ||
vakārañca hakārañca tato'nyadgṛhasaṃsthitam | śakārañca lakārañca kṣiptagehasthitadvayam || 4-167 ||
dhakārañca kṣakārañca liptagehasthitaṃ dvayam | duṣṭagehasthitaṃ nātha śakāragaganaṃ tathā || 4-168 ||
nijaṃ saubhāgyayuktaṃ yattanmantraṃ tadupāśrayet | sūkṣmacakraṃ pravakṣyāmi hitāhitaphalapradam || 4-169 ||
etaduktākṣaraṃ śambho gṛhītvā japamācaret | vāmadakṣiṇamārabhya saptarekhāḥ samālikhet || 4-170 ||
bhitvā tadaṅkān mantrī ca rekhācatuṣṭayaṃ likhet | dakṣiṇādikrameṇaiva baddhamandiramadhyake || 4-171 ||
mantrākṣarāṇi vilikhedaṅkācāreṇa sādhakaḥ | tadaṅkaṃ śṛṇu yatnena narāṇāṃ bhuktimuktidam || 4-172 ||
prathame mandire nātha bhujāṅkaṃ vilikhettataḥ | viṣṇumantrādigehe ca vedāṅkaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ || 4-173 ||
tatpaścādaṣṭamāṅkaṃ ca bhujādhaḥ ṣaṣṭhameva ca | tadgehaṃ śaṅkarasyāpi tatpaścāddaśamaṃ gṛhe || 4-174 ||
tatpaścāddvādaśāṅkañca nāyikāsthānameva ca | ṣaṣṭhādhoyugalāṅkañca tatpaścādaṣṭamaṃ tathā || 4-175 ||
tadgṛhaṃ śambhunā vyastaṃ tatpaścādaṣṭamaṃ tathā | yugalādhogṛhe cāpi caturdaśākṣaraṃ tathā || 4-176 ||
taddakṣiṇe sūryagehaṃ catudrdaśākṣarānvitam | tatpaścāt ṣoḍaśāṅkañca punaraṅkaṃ likhettataḥ || 4-177 ||
taddakṣiṇe vedavarṇaṃ tatpaścādaṣṭamākṣaram | brahmamandiramevaṃ tat ṣoḍaśādhaḥ punaḥ śṛṇu || 4-178 ||
aṣṭamāṅkaṃ tato yugmamaṣṭādaśākṣaraṃ tataḥ | prathamasthaṃ dvitīyasthaṃ gṛhṇīyād śubhadaṃ smṛtam || 4-179 ||
tṛtīyasthaṃ mahāpāpaṃ sarvamantreṣu kītītam | dvitīyaṃ prathamaṃ duḥkhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sarvabhāgyadam || 4-180 ||
tṛtīyañca tathā nātha gṛhṇīyānnijasiddhaye | tṛtīye prathamaṃ bhadraṃ dvitīyaṃ duḥkhadāyakam || 4-181 ||
tṛtīyañca tathā proktamaṣṭākṣaragṛhaṃ bhayam | caturdaśākṣaraṃ bhadraṃ sūryamantraṃ dvitīyakam || 4-182 ||
tṛtīyasthaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅke mahākalyāṇadāyakam | aṣṭamūtīḥ ṣoḍaśāṅke caturthe śatrumāraṇam || 4-183 ||
tṛtīyagṛhamadhyasthaṃ brahmakalyāṇadāyakam | vasvakṣaraṃ sarvaśeṣagṛhamadhyasthameva ca || 4-184 ||
aṣṭamañca mahābhadraṃ kṣamaṃ cittabhayapradam | aṣṭādaśāṅkaṃ śubhadaṃ śeṣagehatraye tathā || 4-185 ||
yeṣāṃ yadakṣarāṇāñca mantraṃ cetasi vartate | etat śubhāśubhaṃ jñātvā mantravarṇaṃ tadābhyaset || 4-186 ||
viṣṇumantrasthitaṃ mantraṃ nāyikāsthaṃ śivasthakam | sūryasthaṃ brahmasaṃsthañca gṛhṇīyāt śākta eva ca || 4-187 ||
vaiṣṇavo viṣṇumantrārthaṃ śaivaḥ śivamupāśrayet | nāyikāmantrajāpī ca nāyikārṇaṃ sadābhyaset || 4-188 ||
sūryamantravicārārthī sūryamantraṃ samāśrayet | ekasthaṃ yugalasthānaṃ tṛtīyasthānameva ca || 4-189 ||
jñāttvā mantraṃ pragṛhṇīyāt anyathā cāśubhaṃ bhavet | etadanyatamaṃ mantraṃ divyavīreṣu gīyate || 4-190 ||
tataścakraṃ paśoruktaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ dhruvam | etaccakraprabhāveṇa paśurvīropamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4-191 ||
sarvasiddhiyuto bhūtvā vatsarāttāṃ prapaśyati || 4-192 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahāmantroddīpane sarvacakrānuṣṭhāne siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhāvanirṇaye bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 4 ||
[atha pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
mahākathahacakrārthaṃ sarvacakrottamottamam | yasya vicāramātreṇa kāmarūpī bhavennaraḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ prakāraṃ vīrāṇāṃ nāthaḥ tvaṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu | caturasre likhet varṇāṃścatuḥkoṣṭhasamanvite || 5-2 ||
catuḥkoṣṭhe catuḥkoṣṭhe catuścaturgṛhānvitam | mandiraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 5-3 ||
caturasraṃ likhetkoṣṭhaṃ catuḥkoṣṭhasamanvitam | punaścatuṣkaṃ tatrāpi likheddhīmān krameṇa tu || 5-4 ||
sarveṣu gṛhamadhyeṣu prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tu | akārādikṣakārāntaṃ likhitvā gaṇayettataḥ || 5-5 ||
candramagṃni rudravarṇaṃ navamaṃ yugalaṃ tathā | vedamarkaṃ daśarasaṃ vasuṃ ṣoḍaśameva ca || 5-6 ||
caturdaśaṃ bhautikañca saptapañcadaśeti ca | vahnīndukoṣṭhagaṃ varṇaṃ saṅketāṅkaiḥ mayoditam || 5-7 ||
etadaṅkasthitaṃ varṇaṃ gaṇayettadanantaram | nāmādyakṣaramārabhya yāvanmantrādimākṣaram || 5-8 ||
catubhīḥ koṣṭhairekaikamiti koṣṭhacatuṣṭayam | punaḥ koṣṭhagakoṣṭheṣu satyato nāmna āditaḥ || 5-9 ||
siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ susiddho'riḥ kramaśo gaṇayetsudhīḥ | siddhaḥ siddhyati kālena sādhyastu japahomataḥ || 5-10 ||
susiddho'grahaṇājjñānī śatrurhanti svamāyuṣam | siddhārṇo bāndhavaḥ proktaḥ sādhyaḥ sevaka ucyate || 5-11 ||
siddhakoṣṭhasthitā varṇā bāndhavāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ | japena bahusiddhiḥ syāt sevako'dhikasevayā || 5-12 ||
puṣṇāti poṣako'bhīṣṭo ghātako nāśayed dhruvam | siddhaḥ siddho yathoktena dviguṇaḥ siddhasādhakaḥ || 5-13 ||
siddhaḥ susiddhodrdhvajapāt siddhārirhanti bāndhavān | sādhyaḥ siddho dviguṇakaḥ sādhye sādhyo nirarthakaḥ || 5-14 ||
tatsusiddho dviguṇajapāt sādhyārirhanti gotrajān | susiddhasiddhodrdhvajapāttatsādhyo dviguṇādhikāt || 5-15 ||
tatsusiddho grahādeva susiddhāriḥ svagotrahā | ariḥ siddhaḥ sutān hanyādarisādhyastu kanyakāḥ || 5-16 ||
tatsusiddhistu patnīghnastadarirhanti gotrajān | yadi vairimanorhastasthitaḥ syāt sādhako bhuvi || 5-17 ||
tadante rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi kuryādevaṃ kriyādikam | tatprakāraṃ mahāvīra śṛṇuṣva girijāpate || 5-18 ||
vaṭapatre likhitvārimantraṃ srotasi nikṣipet | evaṃ mantravimuktaḥ syānmamājñāvaśahetunā || 5-19 ||
punaḥ prakāraṃ viprastu gavāṃ kṣīre mudānvitaḥ | droṇamite japenmantramaṣṭottarasamanvitam || 5-20 ||
pītvā kṣīraṃ manomadhye dhyātvā mantraṃ samuccaran | santyajannīramadhye tu vairimantrapramuktaye || 5-21 ||
punaḥ prakāraṃ vakṣyāmi trirātramekavāsaram | upoṣya vidhinānena pūjāṃ kṛtvā śanau kuje || 5-22 ||
sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi aṣṭottarasamanvitam | japitvā santyajenmantraṃ kṣīrasāgaramaṇḍale || 5-23 ||
athavā tadguroḥ sthāne cānyasthāne ca vā punaḥ | vicārya mantravarṇañca gṛhītvā mokṣamāpnuyāt || 5-24 ||
svapne yadi mahāmantraṃ prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ | tadā siddhimavāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara || 5-25 ||
tanmantraṃ kaulike nātha guroryatnena saṅgrahī | yadā bhavati siddhiḥ syāttatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 5-26 ||
