ariṃ vā devadeveśa yadi vigrāhayenmanum | anyamantraṃ vicāryaiva viṣṇoścaiva śivasya ca || 5-27 ||
śaktimantraṃ yadi ripuṃ tadā evaṃ prakārakam | ādāvante ca madhye ca oṃ vauṣaṭ svāhayānvitam || 5-28 ||
kṛtvā japtvā mahāsiddhiṃ kāmarūpasthitāmiva | prāpnoti nātra sandeho mamājñā varavaṇīnī || 5-29 ||
śṛṇu cakraphalaṃ nātha vicārācāramaṅgalam | prāsādañca mahāmantraṃ sadgurormukhapaṅkajāt || 5-30 ||
labhyate yadi bhāgyena siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ | tadabhāve siddhimantraṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalonmukham || 5-31 ||
mahācamatkārakaraṃ hṛdayollāsavarddhanam | svapne vā sadguroḥ sthāne prāptimātreṇa muktidam || 5-32 ||
tanmantraṃ varjayitvā ca ghorāndhakāraraurave | vasanti sarvakālaṃ ca mamājñāvaśabhāginī || 5-33 ||
tatraiva cakrasārādi vicāraṃ vyarthabhāṣaṇam | arimantraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvamantrottamottamam || 5-34 ||
koṭijanmājītaiḥ puṇyairmahāvidyāśrayī bhavet | svapne koṭikulotpannaiḥ puṇyakoṭiphalairapi || 5-35 ||
prāpnoti sādhako mantraṃ bhuktaye muktaye dhruvam | tataścakraṃ na vicāryaṃ vicārya maraṇaṃ bhavet || 5-36 ||
kintu cakravicārañca yadi svapne camatkṛtam | eteṣāṃ cakravarṇānāṃ vicārādaṣṭasiddhidam || 5-37 ||
vāyuṃ muktiṃ dhanaṃ yogasiddhimṛddhiṃ dhanaṃ śubham | dharmadehapavitrañca akāle mṛtyunāśanam || 5-38 ||
vāñchāphalapradaṃ gaurīcaraṇāmbhojadarśanam | bhuktiṃ muktiṃ harasthānaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 5-39 ||
eṣāṃ cakrādikālañca kramaśo gaṇitaṃ phalam | yadi sarvavicārañca karoti sādhakottamaḥ || 5-40 ||
tadā sarvaphalaṃ nityaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ | mahāvrataṃ vivekañca vicārāllabhate dhruvam || 5-41 ||
akasmāt siddhimāpnoti cakrarājaṃ vicārataḥ | sarve devāḥ praśaṃsanti cakramantrāśritaṃ jalam || 5-42 ||
vākyasiddhirbhavet kṣipraṃ prāṇāyāmādisiddhibhāk | sarveṣāṃ praṇamed bhūmau vicaret sādhako balī || 5-43 ||
iti te kathitaṃ nātha cakraṃ ṣoḍaśamaṅgalam | cakrāṇāṃ lokanādeva sāyujyapadamāpnuyāt || 5-44 ||
ato vicāraṃ sarvatra sarvacakrādimaṅgalam || 5-45 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane sarvacakrānuṣṭhāne | siddhitantraprakaraṇe pañcama paṭalaḥ] || 5 ||
[atha ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ]
bhairava uvāca
atha bhāvaṃ vada śrīde divyavīrapaśukramāt | paśūnāṃ paramāścaryabhāvaṃ śrotuṃ samutsukaḥ || 6-1 ||
icchāmyāhlādajaladhau sthito'haṃ jagadīśvari | yadi bhāgyavaśādājñāsāraṃ cintaya siddhaye || 6-2 ||
mahābhairavyuvāca
paśunātha vīranātha divyanātha kṛpānidhe | prakāśahṛdayollāsa candraśekhara tacchṛṇu || 6-3 ||
kālī kalālatākāraṃ tapasyādvayasaṅgatim | paśubhāvasthitāṃ nātha devatāṃ śṛṇu vistarāt || 6-4 ||
durgāpūjāṃ śivapūjāṃ yaḥ karoti paśūttamaḥ | avaśyaṃ hi yaḥ karoti paśuruttamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6-5 ||
kevalaṃ śivapūjāñca karoti yadi sādhakaḥ | paśūnāṃ madhyamaḥ śrīmān śivayā saha cottamaḥ || 6-6 ||
kevalaṃ vaiṣṇavo'dhīśaḥ paśūnāṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ | bhūtānāṃ devatānāñca sevāṃ kurvanti ye sadā || 6-7 ||
paśūnāṃ madhyamāḥ proktaṃ narakasthā na saṃśayaḥ | tvatsevāṃ mama sevāñca viṣṇubrahmādisevanam || 6-8 ||
kṛtvānyasarvabhūtānāṃ nāyikānāṃ mahāprabho | yakṣiṇīnāṃ bhūtinīnāṃ tataḥ sevā śubhapradā || 6-9 ||
yaḥ paśurbrahmakṛṣṇādi sevāṃ kurvanti ye sadā | tathā śrītārakabrahma sevādvaye narottamāḥ || 6-10 ||
teṣāmasādhyā bhūtādidevatāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ | varjayet paśumārgeṇa viṣṇusevāparo janaḥ || 6-11 ||
pravaktavyañca paṭale teṣāṃ teṣāṃ tatastataḥ | vidhinā vidhinā nātha kramaśaḥ śṛṇu vallabha || 6-12 ||
ataḥ prātaḥ samuttthāya paśuruttamapaṇḍitaḥ | gurūṇāṃ caraṇāmbhojamaṅgalaṃ śīrṣapaṅkaje || 6-13 ||
vibhāvya punarekaṃ hi śrīpādaṃ bhāvayed yadi | pūjayitvā ca vīraṃ vai upahārairna me stavaiḥ || 6-14 ||
trailokyaṃ tejasā vyāptaṃ maṇḍalasthāṃ mahotsavām | taḍitkoṭiprabhādīptiṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām || 6-15 ||
sārddhatrivalayākārāṃ svayambhūliṅgaveṣṭitām | uttthāpayenmahādevīṃ mahāraktāṃ manonmayīm || 6-16 ||
śvāsocchvāsadvayāvṛttiṃ dvādaśāṅgularūpiṇīm | yoginīṃ khecarīṃ vāyurūpāṃ mūlāmbujasthitām || 6-17 ||
caturvarṇasvarūpāntāṃ vakārādiṣasāntakām | koṭikoṭisahasrārkakiraṇāṃ kulamohinīm || 6-18 ||
mahāsūkṣmapathaprāntavāntarāntaragāminīm | trailokyarakṣitāṃ vākyadevatāṃ śambhurūpiṇīm || 6-19 ||
mahābuddhipradāṃ devīṃ sahasradalagāminīm | mahāsūkṣmapathe tejomayīṃ mṛtyusvarūpiṇīm || 6-20 ||
kālarūpāṃ sarvarūpāṃ sarvatra sarvacinmayīm | dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ śīrṣe sudhābdhau viniveṣṭitām || 6-21 ||
sudhāpānaṃ kārayitvā punaḥ sthāne samānayet | samānayanakāle tu suṣumnāmadhyamadhyake || 6-22 ||
amṛtābhiplutāṃ kṛtvā punaḥ sthāneṣu pūjayet | ūdrdhvodgamanakāle tu mahātejomayīṃ smaret || 6-23 ||
pratiprayāṇakāle tu sudhādhārābhirāplutām | mahākulakuṇḍalinīmamṛtānandavigrahām || 6-24 ||
dhyātvā dhyātvā punardhyātvā sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet | tasminsthāne mahādevīṃ vibhāvya kiraṇojjvalām || 6-25 ||
amṛtānandamuktiṃ tāṃ pūjayitvā śubhāṃ mudā | mānasoccārabījena māyāṃ vā kāmabījakam || 6-26 ||
pañcāśadvarṇamālābhirjjaptvānulomasatpathā | vilomena punarjaptvā sarvatra jayadaṃ stavam || 6-27 ||
paṭhitvā siddhimāpnoti tatstotraṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 6-28 ||
janmoddhāranirakṣiṇīhataruṇī vedādibījādimā | nityaṃ cetasi bhāvyate bhuvi kadā sadvākyasañcāriṇī | māṃ pātu priyadā sa vipadaṃ saṃhārayitri dhare | dhātri tvaṃ svayamādidevavanitādīnātidīnaṃ paśum || 6-29 ||
raktābhāmṛtacandrikālipimayī sarpākṛtinīdritā | jāgratkūrmasamāśritā bhagavatī tvaṃ māṃ samālokaya | māṃsodgandhakugandhadoṣajaḍitaṃ vedādikāryānvita| svalpānyāmalacandrakoṭikiraṇainītyaṃ śarīraṃ kuru || 6-30 ||
siddhārthī nijadoṣavit sthalagatirvyājīyate vidyayā | kuṇḍalyākulamārgamuktanagarīmāyākumārgaḥ śriyā | yadyevaṃ bhajati prabhātasamaye madhyāhnakāle'thavā | nityaṃ yaḥ kulakuṇḍalījapapadāmbhojaṃ sa siddho bhavet || 6-31 ||
vāyvākāśacaturdale'tivimale vāñchāphalānyālake | nityaṃ samprati nityadehaghaṭitā śāṅketitābhāvitā | vidyākuṇḍalamāninī svajananī māyākriyā bhāvyate yaistaiḥ siddhakulodbhavaiḥ praṇatibhiḥ satstotrakaiḥ śaṃbhubhiḥ || 6-32 ||
dhātāśaṅkara mohinītribhuvanacchāyāpaṭodgāminī | saṃsārādimahāsukhapraharaṇī tatrasthitā yoginī | sarvagranthivibhedinī svabhujagā sūkṣmātisūkṣmāparā | brahmajñānavinodinī kulakuṭī vyāghātinī bhāvyate || 6-33 ||
vande śrīkulakuṇḍalītrivalibhiḥ sāṅgaiḥ svayambhūṃ priya| prāveṣṭyāmbaramāracittacapalā bālābalāniṣkalā | yā devī paribhāti vedavadanā saṃbhāvinī tāpinī | iṣṭānāṃ śirasi svayambhuvanitāṃ saṃbhāvayāmi kriyām || 6-34 ||
vāṇīkoṭimṛdaṅganādamadanāniśreṇikoṭidhvaniḥ | prāṇeśīrasarāśamūlakamalollāsaikapūrṇānanā | āṣāḍhodbhavameghavājaniyutadhvāntānanāsthāyinī | mātā sā paripātu sūkṣmapathage māṃ yogināṃ śaṅkaraḥ || 6-35 ||
tvāmāśritya narā vrajanti sahasā vaikuṇṭhakailāsayoḥ | ānandaikavilāsinīṃ śaśiśatānandānanāṃ kāraṇām | mātaḥ śrīkulakuṇḍalī priyakare kālī kuloddīpane | tatsthānaṃ praṇamāmi bhadravanite māmuddhara tvaṃ paśum || 6-36 ||
kuṇḍalīśaktimārgasthaṃ stotrāṣṭakamahāphalam | yataḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 6-37 ||
kṣaṇādeva hi pāṭhena kavinātho bhavediha | paṭhet śrīkuṇḍalo yogo brahmalīno bhavet mahān || 6-38 ||
iti te kathitaṃ nātha kuṇḍalīkomalaṃ stavam | etatstotraprasādena deveṣu gurugīṣpatiḥ || 6-39 ||
sarve devāḥ siddhiyutāḥ asyāḥ stotraprasādataḥ | dviparārddhaṃ ciraṃjīvī brahmā sarvasureśvaraḥ || 6-40 ||
tvaṣṭāpi mama nikaṭe sthito bhagavatīpatiḥ | māṃ viddhi paramāṃ śaktiṃ sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpiṇīm || 6-41 ||
sarvaprakāśakaraṇīṃ vindhyaparvatavāsinīm | himālayasutāṃ siddhāṃ siddhamantrasvarūpiṇīm || 6-42 ||
vedāntaśaktitantrasthāṃ kulatantrārthagāminīm | rudrayāmalamadhyasthāṃ sthitisthāpakabhāvinīm || 6-43 ||
pañcamudrāsvarūpāñca śaktiyāmalamālinīm | ratnamālāvalākoṭyāṃ candrasūryaprakāśinīm || 6-44 ||
sarvabhūtamahābuddhidāyinīṃ dānavāpahām | sthityutpattilayakārīṃ karuṇāsāgarasthitām || 6-45 ||
mahāmohanivāsāḍhyāṃ dāmodaraśarīragām | chatracāmararatnāḍhya mahāśūlakarāṃ parām || 6-46 ||
jñānadāṃ vṛddhidāṃ jñānaratnamālākalāpadām | sarvatejaḥsvarūpābhāmanantakoṭivigrahām || 6-47 ||
daridradhanadāṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇamanoramām | sadā bhāvaya śambho tvaṃ yoganāyakapaṇḍita || 6-48 ||
punarbhāvaṃ paśoreva śṛṇu sādarapūrvakam | akasmāt siddhimāpnoti paśurnārāyaṇopamaḥ || 6-49 ||
vaikuṇṭhanagare yāti caturbhujakalevaraḥ | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmahasto garuḍavāhanaḥ || 6-50 ||
mahādharmasvarūpo'sau mahāvidyāprasādataḥ | paśubhāvaṃ mahābhāvaṃ bhāvānāṃ siddhidaṃ punaḥ || 6-51 ||
ādau bhāvaṃ paśoḥ kṛtvā paścāt kuryādavaśyakam | vīrabhāvaṃ mahābhāvaṃ sarvabhāvottamottamam || 6-52 ||
tatpaścādatisaundaryaṃ divyabhāvaṃ mahāphalam | phalākāṅkṣī mokṣagaśca sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 6-53 ||
vidyākāṅkṣī dhanākāṅkṣī ratnākāṅkṣī ca yo naraḥ | kuryād bhāvatrayaṃ divyaṃ bhāvasādhanamuttamam || 6-54 ||
bhāvena labhate vādyaṃ dhanaṃ ratnaṃ mahāphalam | koṭigodānajaiḥ puṇyaiḥ koṭiśālagrāmadānajaiḥ || 6-55 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ koṭiliṅgapūjanena ca yatphalam | tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ kṣaṇādeva na saṃśayaḥ || 6-56 ||
ādau daśamadaṇḍe tu paśubhāvamathāpi vā | madhyāhne daśadaṇḍe tu vīrabhāvamudāhṛtam || 6-57 ||
sāyāhnadaśadaṇḍe tu divyabhāvaṃ śubhapradam | athavā paśubhāvastho yajediṣṭādidevatām || 6-58 ||
janmāvadhi yajenmantrī mahāsiddhimavāpnuyāt | sarveṣāṃ gururūpaḥ syādaiśvaryañca dine dine || 6-59 ||
yadi gurusvabhāvaḥ syāttadā madhumatīṃ labhet | yadi vivekī niryāti mahāvananivāsavān || 6-60 ||
brahmacaryavratastho vā athavā svapure vasan | pīṭhabrāhmaṇamātreṇa mahāṣoḍhāśrameṇa ca || 6-61 ||
paśubhāvasthito mantrī siddhavidyāmavāpnuyāt | yadi pūrvāparasthāñca mahākaulikadevatām || 6-62 ||
kulamārgasthito mantrī siddhimāpnoti niścitam | yadi vidyāḥ prasīdanti vīrabhāvaṃ tadā labhet || 6-63 ||
vīrabhāvaprasādena divyabhāvamavāpnuyāt | divyabhāvaṃ vīrabhāvaṃ ye gṛhṇanti narottamāḥ || 6-64 ||
vāñchākalpadrumalatāpatayaste na saṃśayaḥ | āśramī dhyānaniṣṭhaśca mantratantraviśāradaḥ || 6-65 ||
bhūtvā vasenmahāpīṭhaṃ sadā jñānī bhaved yatiḥ | kimanyena phalenāpi yadi bhāvādikaṃ labhet || 6-66 ||
bhāvagrahaṇamātreṇa mama jñānī bhavennaraḥ | vākyasiddhirbhavet kṣipraṃ vāṇī hṛdayagāminī || 6-67 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ parihāya lakṣmīstiṣṭhati mandire | mama pūrṇaṃ tu mādṛṣṭī tasya dehe na saṃśayaḥ || 6-68 ||
avaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | mahābhairava uvāca sūcitaṃ tu mahādevi kathayasvānukampayā || 6-69 ||
sarvatantreṣu vidyāsu bhāvasaṅketameva hi | tathāpi śaktitantreṣu viśeṣāt sarvasiddhidam || 6-70 ||
bhāvavidyāvidhiṃ vidye vistārya bhāvasādhanam |
ānandabhairava uvāca
bhāvastu trividho deva divyavīrapaśukramāt || 6-71 ||
gururasya tridhā cātra tathaiva mantradevatāḥ | divyabhāvo mahādeva śreyasāṃ sarvasiddhidam || 6-72 ||
dvitīyo madhyamaḥ proktastṛtīyaḥ sarvaninditaḥ | bahujapāttathāhomāt kāyakleśādivistaraiḥ || 6-73 ||
na bhāvena binā devi tantramantrāḥ phalapradāḥ | kiṃ vīrasādhanenaiva mokṣavidyākulena kim || 6-74 ||
kiṃ pīṭhapūjanenaiva kiṃ kanyābhojanādibhiḥ | svayoṣitprītidānena kiṃ pareṣāṃ tathaiva ca || 6-75 ||
kiṃ jitendriyabhāvena kiṃ kulācārakarmaṇā | yadi bhāvo viśuddhārtho na syāt kulaparāyaṇaḥ || 6-76 ||
bhāvena labhate muktiṃ bhāvena kulavarddhanam | bhāvena gotravṛddhiḥ syād bhāvena kulaśodhanam || 6-77 ||
kiṃ tathā pūjanenaiva yadi bhāvo na jāyate | kena vā pūjyate vidyā kena vā pūjyate manuḥ || 6-78 ||
phalābhāvaśca deveśa bhāvābhāvāt prajāyate | etanmantrasya kathane śaṅkate mama mānasaḥ || 6-79 ||
trilokaṃ sañjayet prāyaḥ sarvaratnasamāgamaḥ | nāvīkṣya nirjanaṃ kuryāt kathaṃ tat kathayāmi te || 6-80 ||
śrīānandabhairava uvāca
tvatprasādānmahādevi (!) vidyāsvapnaprabodhini | sarvapañcaprapañcānāṃ dīkṣā deyā maheśvari || 6-81 ||
yadyato deva sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ svāpakāraṇam | karomi kathaya tvaṃ māṃ bhāvamārgottamottamam || 6-82 ||
śrīmahābhairavyuvāca
prathamaṃ divyabhāvastu kaulike śṛṇu yatnataḥ | sarvadevācītāṃ vidyāṃ tejaḥpuñjaprapūritām || 6-83 ||
tejomayīṃ jagatsarvāṃ vibhāvya mūtīkalpanām | tattanmūtīmayaiḥ rūpaiḥ snehaśūnye na vā punaḥ || 6-84 ||
ātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ kṛtvā sarvabhāvaṃ tathaiva ca | tatsarvāṃ yoṣitaṃ dhyātvā pūjayedyatamānasaḥ || 6-85 ||
aśeṣakulasampannāṃ nānājātisamudbhavām | nānādeśodbhavāṃ vāpi sadguṇālasya saṃyutām || 6-86 ||
dvitīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvat syādaṣṭamābdakam | tāvajjaptvā pūjayitvā kanyāṃ sundaramohinīm || 6-87 ||
divyabhāvaḥ sthitaḥ sākṣāttantramantraphalaṃ labhet | kumārīpūjanādeva kumārībhojanādibhiḥ || 6-88 ||
ekadvitryādibījānāṃ phaladā nātra saṃśayaḥ | tābhyaḥ puṣpaphalaṃ dattvā anulepādikaṃ tathā || 6-89 ||
balipriyañca naivedyaṃ dattvā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ | mudā tadaṅgamālyānāṃ bālabhāvaviceṣṭitaḥ || 6-90 ||
jātipriya kathālāpakrīḍākautūhalānvitaḥ | yathārthaṃ tat priyaṃ tatra kṛttvā siddhīśvaro bhavet || 6-91 ||
kanyā sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kanyā sarvaparantapaḥ | homaṃ mantrārcanaṃ nityakriyāṃ kaulikasatkriyām || 6-92 ||
nānāphalaṃ mahādharmaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ binā | tattadarddhaphalaṃ nātha prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ || 6-93 ||
phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ vīraḥ kumārīpūjayā labhet | kusumāñjalipūrṇañca kanyāyāṃ kulapaṇḍitaḥ || 6-94 ||
dadāti yadi tatpuṣpaṃ koṭimeruprado bhavet | tajjñānajaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kṣaṇādeva samālabhet || 6-95 ||
kumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitam | ekavarṣā bhavet sandhyā dvivarṣā ca sarasvatī || 6-96 ||
trivarṣā ca tridhāmūtīścaturvarṣā ca kālikā | sūryagā pañcavarṣā ca ṣaḍvarṣā caiva rohiṇī || 6-97 ||
saptabhirmālinī sākṣādaṣṭavarṣā ca kubjikā | navabhiḥ kālasandātrī daśabhiścāparājitā || 6-98 ||
ekādaśe ca rudrāṇī dvādaśe'bde tu bhairavī | trayodaśe mahālakṣmīdvīsaptapīṭhanāyikā || 6-99 ||
kṣetrajñā pañcadaśabhiḥ ṣoḍaśe cāmbikā matā | evaṃ krameṇa sampūjya yāvat puṣpaṃ na vidyate || 6-100 ||
pratipadādipūrṇāntaṃ vṛddhibhedena pūjayet | mahāparvasu sarveṣu viśeṣāñca pavitrake || 6-101 ||
mahānavamyāṃ deveśa kumārīśca prapūjayet | tasmāt ṣoḍaśaparyantaṃ yuvatīti pracakṣate || 6-102 ||
tatra bhāvaprakāśaḥ syātsa bhāvaḥ paramo mataḥ | rakṣitavyaṃ prayatnena rakṣitāstāḥ prakāśayet || 6-103 ||
mahāpūjādikaṃ kṛtvā vastrālaṅkārabhojanaiḥ | pūjayenmandabhāgyo'pi labhate jayamaṅgalam || 6-104 ||
anyeṣāṃ kathanenātha prayojanamahāphalam | vidhinā pūjayed yastu divyavīrapaśusthitaḥ || 6-105 ||
bhāvatraye mahāsaukhyaṃ divye satkarma satphalam || 6-106 ||
[iti śrī rudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane kumāryupacaryāvilāse siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhāvanirṇaye ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 6 ||
[atha saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
atha pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi kumāryāścātidurlabhām | vyādhivargavihīnānāṃ śīghraṃ siddhyati bhūtale || 7-1 ||
tatprakāraṃ mahādeva vīrāṇāmadhipādhipa | pūjāsthānaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ devālayamathāpi vā || 7-2 ||
sundarīṃ paramānandavarddhanīṃ jayadāyinīm | kālarātrisvarūpāṃ śrīṃ gaurīṃ raktāṅgarāgiṇīm || 7-3 ||
kanyāṃ devakulodbhūtāṃ rākṣasīṃ vā narottamām | naṭīkanyāṃ hīnakanyāṃ tathā kāpālikanyakām || 7-4 ||
rajakasyāpi kanyāṃ te tathā nāpitakanyakām | gopālakanyakāñcaiva tathā brāhmaṇakanyakām || 7-5 ||
śūdrakanyāṃ vaiśyakanyāṃ tathā vaidyakanyakām caṇḍālakanyakāṃ vāpi yatra kutrāśrame sthitām || 7-6 ||
suhṛdvargasya kanyāṃ ca samānīya prayatnataḥ | pūjayet paramānandairātmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 7-7 ||
kramaśaḥ śṛṇu devendra varahastaniṣevita | paramānandasaundarya kāraṇānandavigrahaḥ || 7-8 ||
mama pūjāṃ yaḥ karoti pratyahaṃ śuddhabhaktitaḥ | tasyāvaśyaṃ kumārīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ raveḥ || 7-9 ||
tejorūpaṃ vidhoścāgneḥ sarvabhāve praśasyate | tatpūjanāt tadālāpād bhojanādapi tat śubham || 7-10 ||
mama prītirbhavetsākṣād devatāguptisaṃsthitā | bālabhairavadevasya kāminīvaṭukasya ca || 7-11 ||
matputrasya sarvalokapūjitasya mahaujasaḥ | pūjābhivīvidhaidīvyaiḥ kumārī deva pūjitā || 7-12 ||
kumārī kanyakā proktā sarvajñā jagadīśvarī | pūjārthaṃ sarvalokasya samānīya sureśvarāḥ || 7-13 ||
pūjayanti mahādevīṃ guptabhāvanivāsinīm | sadā bhojanavāñchārghyāṃ mālyasantuṣṭahāsinīm || 7-14 ||
vṛthā na rauti sā devī kumārī devanāyikā | sarasvatīsvarūpā ca pūjyate sarvanāyakaiḥ || 7-15 ||
śivabhaktaivīṣṇubhaktaistathānyadevapūjitaiḥ | sarvalokaiḥ pūjitā sā cāvaśyaṃ pūjyate budhaiḥ || 7-16 ||
pūjayā labhate pūjāṃ pūjayā labhate śriyam | pūjayā dhanamāpnoti pūjayā labhate mahīm || 7-17 ||
pūjayā labhate lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ mahaujasam | mahāvidyāḥ prasīdanti sarve devā na saṃśayaḥ || 7-18 ||
bālabhairavabrahmendrā brāhmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ | rudrāśca devavargāśca vaiṣṇavā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ || 7-19 ||
avatārāśca dvibhujā viṣṇavo manuśobhitāḥ | anye dikpāladevāśca carācaragurustathā || 7-20 ||
nānāvidyāyutāssarve dānavā kūṭaśālinaḥ | apavargasthitā ye ye te te tuṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ || 7-21 ||
yadyahaṃ tuṣṭirūpā hi anye loke ca kā kathā | kumārī pūjanaṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet || 7-22 ||
mahāśāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ sarvapuṇyaṃ phalapradam | tattanmantrasadullekhāt kṣaṇāt puṇyayutaṃ bhavet || 7-23 ||
mantreṇa puṭitaṃ kṛtvā japtvā siddhīśvaro bhavet | yadyat prakāramuccārya vadāmi surasundara || 7-24 ||
tattat kāryamavaśyaṃ ca bhinnabuddhiṃ na kārayet |
bhairava uvāca
atha bījaprabhedañca vada śaṅkarapūjite || 7-25 ||
yadi māṃ snehapuñjo'sti matkulārthapraveśini | vadasva paramānanda bhairavi prāṇavallabhe || 7-26 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇu nātha kulārthaṃ me kumārīpūjane manum | mahāmantraṃ mahāmantraṃ siddhamantraṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7-27 ||
etanmantraprasādena jīvanmukto bhavet sudhīḥ | ante devīpadaṃ yāti satyamānandabhairava || 7-28 ||
ehikasukhasampattirmadhumatyāḥ prasādakam | avaśyaṃ prāpnuyānmartyo viśvāsaṃ kuru śaṅkara || 7-29 ||
vāgbhavena puraḥ kṣobhaṃ māyābīje guṇāṣṭakam | śriyobīje śriyolābho māyābīje ripukṣayaḥ || 7-30 ||
bhairaveṇa tu bījena khecaratvaṃ surādibhiḥ | kumārikā hyahaṃ nātha sadā tvaṃ hi kumārakaḥ || 7-31 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi ekāṃ vā paripūjayet | pūjitāḥ pratipadyante nirdahantyavamānitāḥ || 7-32 ||
kumārī yoginī sākṣāt kumārī paradevatā | asurā aṣṭanāgāśca ye ye duṣṭagrahā api || 7-33 ||
bhūtavetālagandharvā ḍākinīyakṣarākṣasāḥ | yāścānyā devatāḥ sarvāḥ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca bhairava || 7-34 ||
pṛthivyādīni sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 7-35 ||
te tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yastu kanyāṃ prapūjayet | nidhiyuktāṃ kumārīṃ tu pūjayeccaiva bhairava || 7-36 ||
pādyamarghyaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ śubham | bhaktibhāvena sampūjya kumārībhyo nivedayet || 7-37 ||
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryādādau madhye tathāntataḥ | paścācca dakṣiṇā deyā rajatasvarṇamauktikaiḥ || 7-38 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddatvā kumārībhyaḥ krameṇa tu | vivāhayet svayaṃ kanyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 7-39 ||
yāvacca puṇyakāle tu kanyādānaṃ prakalpayet | bhuktimuktiphalaṃ tasya saubhāgyaṃ sarvasampadaḥ || 7-40 ||
rudraloke vasennityaṃ trinetro bhagavān haraḥ | tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇi aśvamedhaśatāni ca || 7-41 ||
tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo yastu kanyāṃ vivāhayet | bālukāsāgare jñeyā tāvadabdasahasrakam || 7-42 ||
ekaikaṃ kulamuddhṛtya rudraloke mahīyate | tattadiṣṭadevānāṃ prītaye tuṣṭaye sudhī || 7-43 ||
kanyādānaṃ samāhṛtya muktimāpnoti bhairava | tattadvarṣīyakanyāyāstattadbuddhyā ca sādhakaḥ || 7-44 ||
vibhāvya śivarūpatvaṃ sampradānīyakārake | pūrṇarūpaṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā varaṃ sarvāṅgasundaram || 7-45 ||
tejomayaṃ yaśaḥkāntaṃ bālabhairavarūpiṇam | baṭukeśaṃ mahādevaṃ varayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ || 7-46 ||
bālarūpāṃ bhairavīṃ ca trailokyasundarīṃ varām | nānālaṅkāranamrāṅgīṃ bhadravidyāprakāśinīm || 7-47 ||
cāruhāsyāṃ mahānandahṛdayāṃ śubhadāṃ śubhām | dhyātvā dvādaśapatrābje pūrṇacandranibhānanām || 7-48 ||
sampradāne samānīya tattanmantreṇa dāpayet | etat śrutvā mahāvīro bāla(bala)rūpī nirañjanaḥ || 7-49 ||
punajījñāsayāmāsa paramānandabhairavīm |
ānandabhairava uvāca
kumārīkulatattvārthaṃ mantrārthaṃ japanakramam || 7-50 ||
yajanādiprakārañca bhojanādikramaṃ tathā | homādiprakiyāṃ tasyāḥ stotraṃ pratyekameva hi || 7-51 ||
kavacaṃ ca kumārīṇāṃ vadasva kramaśaḥ priye | yena krameṇa sā vidyā kumārī paradevatā || 7-52 ||
nirjane sādhakasyāgre mahāvākyaṃ svayaṃ vadet | bālikā cārunayanā kena hetoḥ prasīdati || 7-53 ||
tatprakāraṃ vada snehādānandabhairavapriye |
ānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇu śambho pravakṣyāmi kumārī kulamantrakān || 7-54 ||
yena vijñānamātreṇa dharaṇīśo narottamaḥ | sarveṣāṃ gururūpaḥ syāt kumārīyajanena ca || 7-55 ||
ekavarṣā varā sandhyādikānāṃ manumuttamam | ṣoḍaśācchāntarūpāṇāṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu mahāprabho || 7-56 ||
kramādikañca sarveṣāṃ caitanyasiddhisatkriyām | ānīya sundarīṃ nārīṃ kumārīṃ varanāyikām || 7-57 ||
ratnālaṅkārasaṃyuktāṃ śaṅkhavastrādiśobhitām | vāgbhavena jalaṃ nātha tannāmnā paridāpayet || 7-58 ||
devībuddhyā sadā dhyātvā pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ | māyābījena tannāmnā pādyaṃ dadyāt tathā prabho || 7-59 ||
lakṣmībījena cārghyaṃ tu kuryād bījena candanam | māyābījena puṣpāṇi kumāryai dāpayet sudhīḥ || 7-60 ||
sadāśivena mantreṇa dhūpadīpau mahottamau | datvā ṣaḍaṅgamantreṇa pūjayed devanāyakaḥ || 7-61 ||
tatprakāraṃ mahādeva śṛṇuṣvānandarūpadhṛk | mahātejomayaṃ śubhraṃ hṛdayaṃ hastadakṣiṇaiḥ || 7-62 ||
vibhāvya prapaṭhed dhīmān tanmantraṃ śṛṇu śaṅkara | ādau vāgbhavamuccārya māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tu kūrcakam || 7-63 ||
pretabījaṃ tato brūyāt savisargendubindukam | kulaśabdaṃ samuccārya kumārike tato vadet || 7-64 ||
hṛdayāyaḥ namaḥ procya tataḥ śirasi bhāvayet | śuklavarṇaṃ sarvamayaṃ bījamuccārya saṃnyaset || 7-65 ||
hakāraṃ vāgbhavāḍhyañca vakāraṃ vāgbhavārthakam | māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca dviṭhānte śirase padam || 7-66 ||
vahnijāyāvadhirmantro nyaset śirasi sādhakaḥ | śikhāmadhye kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ nīlāñjanacayaprabham || 7-67 ||
vibhāvya saṃnyasenmantrī kumārīkulasiddhaye | ādau praṇavamuddhṛtva tadante vahnisundarī || 7-68 ||
śikhāyai ca samuddhṛtya vaṣaṭkāraṃ tato vadet | tataḥ kavacamadhye ca balavantaṃ sutejasam || 7-69 ||
prathamāruṇasaṅkāśaṃ dhyātvā cārukalevaram | vāgbhavañca samuccārya kulaśabdaṃ tato vadet || 7-70 ||
vāgīśvarīpadaṃ paścāt kavacāya tato vadet | tārakabrahmaśabdañca kavacanyāsajālakam || 7-71 ||
tato netratrayaṃ dhyātvā mahābījaṃ mahāprabham | raktavarṇa koṭikoṭivāmaṇḍala maṇḍitam || 7-72 ||
virājitaṃ koṭipuṇyājītatejasi bhāskare | vāgbhavaṃ ca samuccārya kuleśvaripadaṃ tataḥ || 7-73 ||
netratrayāya śabdānte vauṣaṭ locanamantrakam | tataḥ sādhakamantrī ca vāmahastatale tathā || 7-74 ||
madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ ca tāladvayamupācaret | tanmantraṃ koṭisūryograjyotsnājālasamaprabham || 7-75 ||
mahākāśodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ mahograparipīḍanam | māyābījaṃ tathāstrāya padamuddhṛtya yatnataḥ || 7-76 ||
pāntaṭhāntaṃ samuddhṛtya mahāmantraṃ prakītītam | tatastasyā hṛnnilaye dhyātvā ca parivārakān || 7-77 ||
pūjayed yatnato mantrī bheṣajāmṛtadhārayā | tarpayet pūjayed bhaktyā bhairavaṃ bālabhairavam || 7-78 ||
devatābhiḥ pūjayitvā parivārān krameṇa vai | tato vāgbhavamuccārya siddhajayāya śabdataḥ || 7-79 ||
pūrvaṃ padaṃ samuccārya vaktrāya nama īritaḥ | tato vāgbhavamuccārya jayāya śabdamuddharet || 7-80 ||
uttaravaktramuddhṛtya caturthyantaṃ namaḥpadam | tato vāgbhavamāyā śrī bījamuccārya yatnataḥ || 7-81 ||
kubjike paścimānte ca vaktrāya nama ityapi | tato vāgbhavamuccārya kālike padamuccaret || 7-82 ||
dakṣavaktrāya śabdānte nānāmantraṃ prakītītam etanmantrākṣaraṃ nātha samuccārya kuleśvara || 7-83 ||
pūjayitvā krameṇaiva bhāskaraṃ paripūjayet | candraṃ dikpāladevañca sandhyādīn paripūjayet || 7-84 ||
vīrabhadrāṃ mahākālīṃ kaulinīṃ kulagāminīm | aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ kālīṃ caturvargā prapūjayet || 7-85 ||
naivedyādīn samānīya nānābhojyādisaṃyutam | dugdhaṃ ghanāvṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pakvānnaṃ pakvasatphalam || 7-86 ||
yadyatkālopayogyañca śarkarāmadhumiśritam | pañcatattvaṃ kuladravyaṃ nijakalyāṇavardhanam || 7-87 ||
nānādravyañca naivedyaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhitam | kumārībhyo nivedyaivaṃ nānāsaurabhaśobhitam || 7-88 ||
śītalaṃ jalamānīya dadyāttābhyo mahāsudhīḥ | tato hitaṃ mahāmantraṃ kumāryāścātidurlabham || 7-89 ||
athavā svīyamūlañca japtvā siddhīśvaro bhavet || 7-90 ||
samarthaprāṇavāyūnāṃ dhārayetkārayet svayam | aṣṭāṅgādipraṇāmaṃ ca kurvan stotraṃ paṭhan diśet || 7-91 ||
namāmi kulakāminīṃ paramabhāgyasandāyinīm | kumāraraticāturīṃ sakalasiddhimānandinīm || 7-92 ||
pravālaguṭikāmṛjāṃ rajatarāgavastrānvitām | hiraṇyakulabhūṣaṇāṃ bhuvanavākkumārīṃ bhaje || 7-93 ||
iti mantreṇa saṃnyasya tāriṇīṃ paripūjayet | śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sampūjya praṇamet sādhakottamaḥ || 7-94 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane kumāryupacaryāvinyāse siddhamantra(--) prakaraṇe divyabhāvanirṇaye saptama paṭalaḥ] || 7 ||
[athāṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca
atha vakṣye mahādeva kumāryā japahomakam | lakṣasaṃkhyajapaṃ kṛtvā māyāṃ vā vāgbhavaṃ ramām || 8-1 ||
kālībījaṃ vāpi nātha māyāṃ vā kāmabījakam | sadāśivena puṭitaṃ binducandravibhūṣitam || 8-2 ||
athavā praṇavenāpi puṭitaṃ tridaśeśvara | japitvā mūlamantrañca lakṣasaṃkhyāvidhānataḥ || 8-3 ||
taddaśāṃśaṃ mahāhomaṃ ghṛtāktabilvapatrakaiḥ | athavā śvetapuṣpaiśca kundapuṣpairmahāphalam || 8-4 ||
evaṃ krameṇa juhuyāt karavīraprasūnakaiḥ | ghṛtāktaiḥ kaivalairvāpi candanāgurumiśritaiḥ || 8-5 ||
haviṣyāśī divābhāge rātrau pūjāparo bhavet | nijapūjāvaśeṣaistu kuladravyaiḥ prapūjayet || 8-6 ||
divāsaṃkhyaṃ japettatra paramānandarūpadhṛk | japānte juhuyānmantrī maduktadravyasaṃyutaiḥ || 8-7 ||
tataḥ prāṇātmakaṃ vāyuṃ śodhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā cāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamenmudā || 8-8 ||
praṇāmasamaye nātha idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhet yatiḥ | kavacañca tathā pāṭhyaṃ kumārīṇāmathāpi vā || 8-9 ||
nijadevyā mahāstotraṃ paṭheddhi kavacaṃ tataḥ | kumārīṇāṃ mahādeva sahasranāma sāṣṭakam || 8-10 ||
paṭhitvā siddhimāpnoti paṭhitvā sādhakottamaḥ | agre saṃsthāpya tāḥ sarvā ratnakoṭisuśītalāḥ || 8-11 ||
tataḥ stotraṃ paṭheddhīmān samāhitamanā vaśī | mahādivyācārarato vīrabhāvolbaṇo'pi vā || 8-12 ||
evaṃ krameṇa prapaṭhed bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥ | mahāvidyā mahāsevā bhaktiśraddhāplutāpītaḥ || 8-13 ||
mahājñānī bhavet kṣipraṃ vāñchāsiddhimavāpnuyāt || 8-14 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
devendrādaya indukoṭikiraṇāṃ vārāṇasīvāsinī | vidyāṃ vāgbhavakāminīṃ trinayanāṃ sūkṣmakriyājvālinīm | caṇḍodyoganikṛntinīṃ trijagatāṃ dhātrīṃ kumārīṃ varā | mūlāmbhoruhavāsinīṃ śaśimukhīṃ sampūjayāmi śriye || 8-15 ||
bhāvyāṃ devagaṇaiḥ śivendrayatibhirmokṣāthībhirbālikā | sandhyāṃ nityaguṇodayāṃ dvijagaṇe śreṣṭhodayāṃ sāruṇām | śuklābhāṃ parameśvarīṃ śubhakarīṃ bhadrāṃ viśālānanā | gāyatrīṃ gaṇamātaraṃ dinagatiṃ kṛṣṇāñca vṛddhāṃ bhaje || 8-16 ||
bālāṃ bālakapūjitāṃ gaṇabhṛtāṃ vidyāvatāṃ mokṣadā | dhātrīṃ śuklasarasvatīṃ navavarāṃ vāgvādinīṃ caṇḍikām | svādhiṣṭhānaharipriyāṃ priyakarīṃ vedāntavidyāpradā | nityaṃ mokṣahitāya yogavapuṣā caitanyarūpāṃ bhaje || 8-17 ||
nānāratnasamūhanimītagṛhe pūjyāṃ sūrairbālikā | vande nandanakānane manasije siddhāntabījānane | arthaṃ dehi nirarthakāya puruṣe hitvā kumārīṃ kalām | satyaṃ pātu kumārike trividhamūrtyā ca tejomayīm || 8-18 ||
varānane sakalikāṃ kulapathollāsaikabījodvahā | māṃsāmodakarālinīṃ hi bhajatāṃ kāmātiriktapradām | bālo'haṃ vaṭukeśvarasya caraṇāmbhojāśrito'haṃ sadā | hitvā bālakumārike śirasi śuklāmbhoruheśaṃ bhaje || 8-19 ||
sūryāhlādavalākinīṃ kalimahāpāpāditāpāpahā | tejo'ṅgāṃ bhuvi sūryagāṃ bhayaharāṃ tejomayīṃ bālikām | vande hṛtkamale sadā ravidale vālendravidyāṃ satī | sākṣāt siddhikarīṃ kumāri vimale'nvāsādya rūpeśvarīm || 8-20 ||
nityaṃ śrīkulakāminīṃ kulavatīṃ kolāmumāmambikā | nānāyoganivāsinīṃ suramaṇīṃ nityāṃ tapasyānvitām | vedāntārthaviśeṣadeśavasanā bhāṣāviśeṣasthitāṃ vande parvatarājarājatanayāṃ kālapriyo tvāmaham || 8-21 ||
kaumārīṃ kulakāminīṃ ripugaṇakṣobhāgnisandohinī | raktābhānayanāṃ śubhāṃ paramamārgamuktisaṃjñāpradām | bhāryā bhāgavatīṃ matiṃ bhuvanamāmodapañcānanā | pañcāsyapriyakāminīṃ bhayaharāṃ sarpādihārāṃ bhaje || 8-22 ||
candrāsyāṃ caraṇadvayāmbujamahāśobhāvinodīṃ nadī | mohādikṣayakāriṇīṃ varakarāṃ śrīkubjikāṃ sundarīm | ye nityaṃ paripūjayanti sahasā rājendracūḍāmaṇi | sampādaṃ dhanamāyuṣo janayato vyāpyeśvaratvaṃ jaguḥ || 8-23 ||
yogīśaṃ bhuvaneśvaraṃ priyakaraṃ śrīkālasandarbhayā | śobhāsāgaragāminaṃ harabhavaṃ vāñchāphaloddīpanam | lokānāmaghanāśanāya śivayā śrīsaṃjñayā vidyayā | dharmaprāṇasadaivatāṃ praṇamatāṃ kalpadrumaṃ bhāvaye || 8-24 ||
vidyāṃ tāmaparājitāṃ madanabhāvāmodamattānanāṃ hṛtpadmasthitapādukāṃ kulakalāṃ kātyāyanīṃ bhairavīm | ye ye puṇyadhiyo bhajanti paramānandābdhimadhye mudā sarvvācchāpitatejasā bhayakarīṃ mokṣāya saṅkīrtaye || 8-25 ||
rudrāṇīṃ praṇamāmi padmavadanāṃ koṭyarkatejomayīṃ nānālaṅkṛtabhūṣaṇāṃ kulabhujāmānandasandāyinīm | śrī māyākamalānvitāṃ hṛdigatāṃ santānabījakriyāṃ ānandaikaniketanāṃ hṛdi bhaje sākṣādalabdhāmaham || 8-26 ||
namāmi varabhairavīṃ kṣititalādyakālānalā | mṛṇālasukumārāruṇāṃ bhuvanadoṣasaṃśodhinīm | jagadbhayaharāṃ harāṃ harati yā ca yogeśvarī | mahāpadasahasrakam sakalabhogadāntāmaham || 8-27 ||
sāmrājyaṃ pradadāti yācitavatī vidyā mahālakṣaṇā | sākṣādaṣṭasamṛddhidātari mahālakṣmīḥ kulakṣobhahā | svādhiṣṭhānasupaṅkaje vivasitāṃ viṣṇoranantapriye | vande rājapadapradāṃ śubhakarīṃ kauleśvarīṃ kaulikīm || 8-28 ||
pīṭhānāmadhipādhipām asuvahāṃ vidyāṃ śubhāṃ nāyikā | sarvālaṅkaraṇānvitāṃ trijagatāṃ kṣobhāpahāṃ vāruṇīṃ | vande pīṭhaganāyikāṃ tribhuvanacchāyābhirācchāditā | sarveṣāṃ hitakāriṇīṃ jayavatāmānandarūpeśvarīm || 8-29 ||
kṣetrajñāṃ madavihvalāṃ kulavatīṃ siddhipriyāṃ preyasīm | śambhoḥ śrī vaṭukeśvarasya mahatāmānandasañcāriṇīm || 8-30 ||
sākṣādātmaparodgamāṃ kamalamadhyasaṃbhāvinī | śiro daśaśate dale'mṛtamahābdhidhārādharām | nijamanaḥ kṣobhāpahāṃ śākinīm | bāhyārtha prakaṭāmahaṃ rajatabhāṃ vande mahābhairavīm || 8-31 ||
praṇāmaphaladāyinīṃ sakalabāhyavaśyāṃ guṇā | namāmi paramambikāṃ viṣayadoṣasaṃhāriṇīm | sampūrṇāvidhuvanmukhīṃ kamalamadhyasambhāvinīṃ | śiro daśaśate dale'mṛtamahābdhidhārādharām || 8-32 ||
sākṣādahaṃ tribhuvanāmṛtapūrṇadehāṃ sandhyādi devakamalāṃ kulapaṇḍitendrām | natvā bhaje daśaśate dalamadhyamadhye | kauleśvarīṃ sakaladivyajanāśrayāṃ tām || 8-33 ||
viśveśvarīṃ svarakule varabālike tvāṃ siddhāsane pratidinaṃ praṇamāmi bhaktyā | bhaktiṃ dhanaṃ jayapadaṃ yadi dehi dāsya| tasmin mahāmadhumatīṃ laghunāhatāḥ syāt || 8-34 ||
etatstotraprasādena kavitā vākpatirbhavet | mahāsiddhīśvaro divyo vīrabhāvaparāyaṇaḥ || 8-35 ||
sarvatra jayamāpnoti sa hi syād devavallabhaḥ | vācāmīśo bhavet kṣipraṃ kāmarūpo bhavennaraḥ || 8-36 ||
paśureva mahāvīro divyo bhavati niścitam | sarvavidyāḥ prasīdanti tuṣṭāḥ sarve digīśvarāḥ || 8-37 ||
vahniḥ śītalatāṃ yāti jalastambhaṃ sa kārayet | dhanavān putravān rājā iha kāle bhavennaraḥ || 8-38 ||
pare ca yāti vaikuṇṭhe kailāse śivasannidhau | muktireva mahādeva yo nityaṃ sarvadā paṭhet || 8-39 ||
mahāvidyāpadāmbhojaṃ sa hi paśyati niścitam | śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi kumārītarpaṇādikam || 8-40 ||
yāsāṃ tarpaṇamātreṇa kulasiddhirbhaved dhruvam | kulabālāṃ mūlapadmasthitāṃ kāmavihāriṇīm || 8-41 ||
śatadhā mūlamantreṇa tarpayāmi tava priye | mūlādhāramahātejo jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitām || 8-42 ||
sandhyādevīṃ tarpayāmi kāmabījena me śubhe | mūlapaṅkajayogāṅgī kumārīṃ śrīsarasvatīm || 8-43 ||
tarpayāmi kuladravyaistava santoṣahetunā | cakre mūlādhārapadme trimūtībālanāyikām || 8-44 ||
sarvakalyāṇadāṃ devīṃ tarpayāmi parāmṛtaiḥ | svādhiṣṭhāne mahāpadme ṣaḍdalāntaḥprakāśinīm || 8-45 ||
śrībījena tarpayāmi bhogamokṣāya kevalam | svādhiṣṭhānakulollāsa viṣṇusaṅketagāminīm || 8-46 ||
kālikāṃ nijabījena tarpayāmi kulāmṛtaiḥ | svādhiṣṭhānākhyapadmasthāṃ mahātejomayīṃ śivām || 8-47 ||
sūryagāṃ śīrṣamadhunā tarpayāmi kuleśvarīm | maṇipūrābdhimadhye tu manoharakalevarām || 8-48 ||
umādevīṃ tarpayāmi māyābījena pārvatīm | maṇipūrāmbhojamadhye trailokyaparipūjitām || 8-49 ||
mālinīṃ malacittasya sadbuddhiṃ tarpayāmyaham | maṇipūrasthitāṃ raudrīṃ paramānandavadhīnīm || 8-50 ||
ākāśagāminīṃ devīṃ kubjikāṃ tarpayāmyaham | tarpayāmi mahādevīṃ mahāsādhanatatparām || 8-51 ||
yoginīṃ kālasandarbhāṃ tarpayāmi kulānanām | śaktimantrapradāṃ raudrīṃ lolajihvāsamākulām || 8-52 ||
aparājitāṃ mahādevīṃ tarpayāmi kuleśvarīm | mahākaulapriyāṃ siddhāṃ rudralokasukhapradām || 8-53 ||
rudrāṇīṃ raudrakiraṇāṃ tarpayāmi vadhūpriyām | ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃsiddhiṃ mahārauravanāśinīm || 8-54 ||
mahāmadyapānacittāṃ bhairavīṃ tarpayāmyaham | trailokyavaradāṃ devīṃ śrībījamālayāvṛtām || 8-55 ||
mahālakṣmīṃ bhavaiśvaryadāyinīṃ tarpayāmyaham | lokānāṃ hitakartrīñca hitāhitajanapriyām || 8-56 ||
tarpayāmi ramābījāṃ pīṭhādyāṃ pīṭhanāyikām | jayantīṃ vedavedāṅgamātaraṃ sūryamātaram || 8-57 ||
tarpayāmi sudhābhiśca kṣetrajñāṃ māyayāvṛtām | tarpayāmi kulānandaparamāṃ paramānanām || 8-58 ||
tarpayāmyambikādevīṃ māyālakṣmīhṛdisthitām || 8-59 ||
sarvāsāṃ caraṇadvayāmbujatanuṃ caitanyavidyāvatī | saukhyārthaṃ śubhaṣoḍaśasvarayutāṃ śrīṣoḍaśīsaṅkulām | ānandārṇavapadmarāgakhacite siṃhāsane śobhite | nityaṃ tat paritarpayāmi sakalaṃ śvetābjamadhyāsane || 8-60 ||
ye nityaṃ prapaṭhanti cārusaphalastotrārddhasantarpaṇa| vidyādānanidānamokṣaparamāṃ māyāmayaṃ yānti te | naśyanti kṣitimaṇḍaleśvaragaṇāḥ sarvāvipatkārakā | rājānaṃ vaśayanti yogasakalaṃ nityā bhavanti kṣaṇāt || 8-61 ||
tarpaṇātmakamokṣākhyaṃ paṭhanti yadi mānuṣāḥ | aṣṭaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā vatsarāttāṃ prapaśyati || 8-62 ||
mahāyogī bhavennātha māsādabhyāsataḥ prabho | trailokyaṃ kṣobhayetkṣipraṃ vāñchāphalamavāpnuyāt || 8-63 ||
bhūmadhye rājarājeśo labhate varamaṅgalam | śatrunāśe tathoccāṭe bandhane vyādhisaṅkaṭe || 8-64 ||
cāturaṅge tathā ghore bhaye dūrasya preṣaṇe | mahāyuddhe narendrāṇāṃ paṭhitvā siddhimāpnuyāt || 8-65 ||
yaḥ paṭhedekabhāvena santarpaṇaphalaṃ labhet | pūjāsāphalyamāpnoti kumārīstotrapāṭhataḥ || 8-66 ||
yo na kuryātkumāryarcāṃ stotrañca nityamaṅgalam | sa bhavet pāśavaḥ kalpo mṛtyustasya pade pade || 8-67 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane kumāryupacaryāvilāse siddhamantra(--) prakaraṇe divyabhāvanirṇaye aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 8 ||
[atha navamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kumārīkavacaṃ śubham | trailokyaṃ maṅgalaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśakam || 9-1 ||
paṭhanāddhāraṇāllokā mahāsiddhāḥ prabhākarāḥ | śakro devādhipaḥ śrīmān devagururbṛhaspatiḥ || 9-2 ||
mahātejomayo vahnirdharmmarājo bhayānakaḥ | varuṇo devapūjyo hi jalānāmadhipaḥ svayam || 9-3 ||
sarvaharttā mahāvāyuḥ kuberaḥ kuñjareśvaraḥ | dharādhipaḥ priyaḥ śambhoḥ sarve devā digīśvaraḥ || 9-4 ||
na meruḥ prabhurekāyāḥ sarveśo nirmalo dvayoḥ | etatkavacapāṭhena sarve bhūpā dhanādhipāḥ || 9-5 ||
praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu māyā sandāyikā satī | lalāṭodrdhvaṃ mahāmāyā pātu me śrīsarasvatī || 9-6 ||
kāmākṣā vaṭukeśānī trimūttirbhālameva me | cāmuṇḍā bījarūpā ca vadanaṃ kālikā mama || 9-7 ||
pātu māṃ sūryagā nityaṃ tathā netradvayaṃ mama | karṇayugmaṃ kāmabījaṃ svarūpomātapasvinī || 9-8 ||
rasanāgraṃ tathā pātu vāgdevī mālinī mama | ḍāmarasthā kāmarūpā dantāgraṃ kuñjikā mama || 9-9 ||
devī praṇavarūpā'sau pātu nityaṃ śivā mama | oṣṭhādharaṃ śaktibījātmikā svāhāsvarūpiṇī || 9-10 ||
pāyānme kālasandaṣṭā pañcavāyusvarūpiṇī | galadeśaṃ mahāraudrī pātu me cāparājitā || 9-11 ||
kṣauṃ bījaṃ me tathā kaṇṭhaṃ rudrāṇī svāhayānvitā | hṛdayaṃ bhairavī vidyā pātu ṣoḍaśa susvarā || 9-12 ||
dvau bāhū pātu sarvatra mahālakṣmīḥ pradhānikā | sarvamantrasvarūpaṃ me codaraṃ pīṭhanāyikā || 9-13 ||
pārśvayugmaṃ tathā pātu kumārī vāgbhavātmikā | kaiśorī kaṭideśaṃ me māyābījasvarūpiṇī || 9-14 ||
jaṅghāyugmaṃ jayantī me yoginī kullukāyutā | sarvāṅgamambikādevī pātu mantrārthagāminī || 9-15 ||
keśāgraṃ kamalādevī nāsāgraṃ vindhyavāsinī | cibukaṃ caṇḍikā devī kumārī pātu me sadā || 9-16 ||
hṛdayaṃ lalitā devī pṛṣṭhaṃ parvatavāsinī | triśaktiḥ ṣoḍaśī devī liṅgaṃ guhyaṃ sadāvatu || 9-17 ||
śmaśāne cāmbikā devī gaṅgāgarbhe ca vaiṣṇavī | śūnyāgāre pañcamudrā mantrayantraprakāśinī || 9-18 ||
catuṣpathe tathā pātu māmeva vajradhāriṇī | śavāsanagatā caṇḍā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitā || 9-19 ||
pātu māne kaliṅge ca vaikharī śaktirūpiṇī | vane pātu mahābālā mahāraṇye raṇapriyā || 9-20 ||
mahājale taḍāge ca śatrumadhye sarasvatī | mahākāśapathe pṛthvī pātu māṃ śītalā sadā || 9-21 ||
raṇamadhye rājalakṣmīḥ kumārī kulakāminī | arddhanārīśvarā pātu mama pādatalaṃ mahī || 9-22 ||
navalakṣamahāvidyā kumārī rūpadhāriṇī | koṭisūryapratīkāśā candrakoṭisuśītalā || 9-23 ||
pātu māṃ varadā vāṇī vaṭukeśvarakāminī iti te kathitaṃ nātha kavacaṃ paramādbhutam || 9-24 ||
kumāryāḥ kuladāyinyāḥ pañcatattvārthapāraga yo japet pañcatattvena stotreṇa kavacena ca || 9-25 ||
ākāśagāminī siddhirbhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ || 9-26 ||
vajradehī bhavet kṣipraṃ kavacasya prapāṭhataḥ | sarvasiddhīśvaro yogī jñānī bhavati yaḥ paṭhet || 9-27 ||
vivāde vyavahāre ca saṅgrāme kulamaṇḍale | mahāpathe śmaśāne ca yogasiddho bhavet sa ca || 9-28 ||
paṭhitvā jayamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara vaśīkaraṇakavacaṃ sarvatra jayadaṃ śubham || 9-29 ||
puṇyavratī paṭhennityaṃ yatiśrīmānbhaved dhruvam siddhavidyā kumārī ca dadāti siddhimuttamām || 9-30 ||
paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyādvāpi sa bhavetkalpapādapaḥ | bhaktiṃ muktiṃ tuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ rājalakṣmīṃ susampadām || 9-31 ||
prāpnoti sādhakaśreṣṭho dhārayitvā japedyadi | asādhyaṃ sādhayedvidvān paṭhitvā kavacaṃ śubham || 9-32 ||
dhanināñca mahāsaukhyadharmmārthakāmamokṣadam | yo vaśī divase nityaṃ kumārīṃ pūjayenniśi || 9-33 ||
upacāraviśeṣeṇa trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet | palalenāsavenāpi matsyena mudrayā saha || 9-34 ||
nānābhakṣyeṇa bhojyena gandhadravyeṇa sādhakaḥ | mālyena svarṇarajatālaṅkāreṇa sucailakaiḥ || 9-35 ||
pūjayitvā japitvā ca tarpayitvā varānanām | yajñadānatapasyābhiḥ prayogeṇa maheśvara || 9-36 ||
stutvā kumārīkavacaṃ yaḥ paṭhedekabhāvataḥ | tasya siddhirbhavet kṣipraṃ rājarājeśvaro bhavet || 9-37 ||
vāñchārthaphalamāpnoti yadyanmanasi vartate | bhūrjapatre likhitvā sa kavacaṃ dhārayed hṛdi || 9-38 ||
śanimaṅgalavāre ca navamyāmaṣṭamīdine | caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 9-39 ||
likhitvā dhārayed vidvān uttarābhimukho bhavan | mahāpātakayukto hi muktaḥ syāt sarvapātakaiḥ || 9-40 ||
yoṣidvāmabhuje dhṛtvā sarvakalyāṇamālabhet | bahuputrānvitā kāntā sarvasampattisaṃyutā || 9-41 ||
tathāśrīpuruṣaśreṣṭho dakṣiṇe dhārayed bhuje | ehike divyadehaḥ syāt pañcānanasamaprabhaḥ || 9-42 ||
śivaloke pare yāti vāyuvegī nirāmayaḥ | sūryamaṇḍalamābhedya paraṃ lokamavāpnuyāt || 9-43 ||
lokānāmatisaukhyadaṃ bhayaharaṃ śrīpādabhaktiprada | mokṣārthaṃ kavacaṃ śubhaṃ prapaṭhatāmānandasindhūdbhavam | pārthānāṃ kalikālaghorakaluṣadhvaṃsaikahetuṃ jaya | ye nāma prapaṭhanti dharmamatulaṃ mokṣaṃ vrajanti kṣaṇāt || 9-44 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane kumāryupacaryāvinyāse kumārī(--) kavacollāse siddhamantraprakaraṇe divyabhāvanirṇaye navamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 9 ||
[atha daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca
vada kānte sadānandasvarūpānandavallabhe | kumāryā devatāmukhyāḥ paramānandavardhanam || 10-1 ||
aṣṭottarasahasrākhyaṃ nāma maṅgalamadbhutam | yadi me vartate vidye yadi snehakalāmalā || 10-2 ||
tadā vadasva kaumārīkṛtakarmaphalapradam | mahāstotraṃ koṭikoṭi kanyādānaphalaṃ bhavet || 10-3 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
mahāpuṇyapradaṃ nātha śṛṇu sarveśvarapriya | aṣṭottarasahasrākhyaṃ kumāryāḥ paramādbhutam || 10-4 ||
paṭhittvā dhārayittvā vā naro mucyeta saṅkaṭāt | sarvatra durlabhaṃ dhanyaṃ dhanyalokaniṣevitam || 10-5 ||
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhyaṅgaṃ sarvānandakaraṃ param | māyāmantranirastāṅgaṃ mantrasiddhiprade nṛṇām || 10-6 ||
na pūjā na japaṃ snānaṃ puraścaryāvidhiśca na | akasmāt siddhimavāpnoti sahasranāmapāṭhataḥ || 10-7 ||
sarvayajñaphalaṃ nātha prāpnoti sādhakaḥ kṣaṇāt | mantrārthaṃ mantracaitanyaṃ yonimudrāsvarūpakam || 10-8 ||
koṭivarṣaśatenāpi phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate | tathāpi vaktumicchāmi hitāya jagatāṃ prabho || 10-9 ||
asyāḥ śrīkumāryāḥ sahasranāmakavacasya | vaṭukabhairavaṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ(,) kumārīdevatā(,) sarvamantrasiddhisamṛddhaye viniyogaḥ || 10-10 ||
oṃ kumārī kauśikī kālī kurukullā kuleśvarī | kanakābhā kāñcanābhā kamalā kālakāminī || 10-11 ||
kapālinī kālarūpā kaumārī kulapālikā | kāntā kumārakāntā ca kāraṇā karigāminī || 10-12 ||
kandhakāntā kaulakāntā kṛtakarmaphalapradā | kāryākāryapriyā kakṣā kaṃsahantrī kurukṣayā || 10-13 ||
kṛṣṇakāntā kālarātriḥ karṇeṣudhāriṇīkarā | kāmahā kapilā kālā kālikā kurukāminī || 10-14 ||
kurukṣetrapriyā kaulā kuntī kāmāturā kacā | kalañjabhakṣā kaikeyī kākapucchadhvajā kalā || 10-15 ||
kamalā kāmalakṣmī ca kamalānanakāminī | kāmadhenusvarūpā ca kāmahā kāmamadīnī || 10-16 ||
kāmadā kāmapūjyā ca kāmātītā kalāvatī | bhairavī kāraṇāḍhyā ca kaiśorī kuśalāṅgalā || 10-17 ||
kambugrīvā kṛṣṇanibhā kāmarājapriyākṛtiḥ | kaṅkaṇālaṅkṛtā kaṅkā kevalā kākinī kirā || 10-18 ||
kirātinī kākabhakṣā karālavadanā kṛśā | keśinī keśihā keśā kāsāmbaṣṭhā karipriyā || 10-19 ||
kavināthasvarūpā ca kaṭuvāṇī kaṭusthitā | koṭarā koṭarākṣī ca karanāṭakavāsinī || 10-20 ||
kaṭakasthā kāṣṭhasaṃsthā kandarpā ketakī priyā | kelipriyā kambalasthā kāladaityavināśinī || 10-21 ||
ketakīpuṣpaśobhāḍhyā karpūrapūrṇajihvikā | karpūrākarakākolā kailāsagirivāsinī || 10-22 ||
kuśāsanasthā kādambā kuñjareśī kulānanā | kharbā khaḍgadharā khaḍgā khalahā khalabuddhidā || 10-23 ||
khañjanā khararūpā ca kṣārāmlatiktamadhyagā | khelanā kheṭakakarā kharavākyā kharotkaṭā || 10-24 ||
khadyotacañcalā khelā khadyotā khagavāhinī | kheṭakasthā khalākhasthā khecarī khecarapriyā || 10-25 ||
khacarā kharapremā khalāḍhyā khacarānanā | khecareśī kharogrā ca khecarapriyabhāṣiṇī || 10-26 ||
kharjūrāsavasaṃmattā kharjūraphalabhoginī | khātamadhyasthitā khātā khātāmbuparipūriṇī || 10-27 ||
khyātiḥ khyātajalānandā khulanā khañjanāgatiḥ | khalvā khalatarā khārī kharodveganikṛntanī || 10-28 ||
gaganasthā ca bhītā ca gabhīranādinī gayā | gaṅgā gabhīrā gaurī ca gaṇanātha priyā gatiḥ || 10-29 ||
gurubhaktā gvālihīnā gehinī gopinī girā | gogaṇasthā gāṇapatyā girijā giripūjitā || 10-30 ||
girikāntā gaṇasthā ca girikanyā gaṇeśvarī | gādhirājasutā grīvā gurvī gurvyambaśāṅkarī || 10-31 ||
gandharvvakāminī gītā gāyatrī guṇadā guṇā | guggulusthā guroḥ pūjyā gītānandaprakāśinī || 10-32 ||
gayāsurapriyāgehā gavākṣajālamadhyagā | gurukanyā guroḥ patnī gahanā gurunāginī || 10-33 ||
gulphavāyusthitā gulphā garddabhā garddabhapriyā | guhyā guhyagaṇasthā ca garimā gaurikā gudā || 10-34 ||
gudordhvasthā ca galitā gaṇikā golakā galā | gāndharvī gānanagarī gandharvagaṇapūjitā || 10-35 ||
ghoranādā ghoramukhī ghorā gharmanivāriṇī | ghanadā ghanavarṇā ca ghanavāhanavāhanā || 10-36 ||
ghargharadhvanicapalā ghaṭāghaṭapaṭāghaṭā | ghaṭitā ghaṭanā ghonā ghanarupa ghaneśvarī || 10-37 ||
ghuṇyātītā ghargharā ca ghorānanavimohinī | ghoranetrā ghanarucā ghorabhairava kanyakā || 10-38 ||
ghātāghātakahā ghātyā ghrāṇāghrāṇeśavāyavī | ghorāndhakārasaṃsthā ca ghasanā ghasvarā gharā || 10-39 ||
ghoṭakesthā ghoṭakā ca ghoṭakeśvaravāhanā | ghananīlamaṇiśyāmā gharghareśvarakāminī || 10-40 ||
ṅakārakūṭasampannā ṅakāracakragāminī | ṅakārī ṅasaṃśā caiva ṅīpanītā ṅakāriṇī || 10-41 ||
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthā caturā cāruhāsinī | cārucandramukhī caiva calaṅgamagatipriyā || 10-42 ||
cañcalā capalā caṇḍī cekitānā carusthitā | calitā cānanā cārvvo cārubhramaranādinī || 10-43 ||
caurahā candranilayā caindrī candrapurasthitā | cakrakaulā cakrarūpā cakrasthā cakrasiddhidā || 10-44 ||
cakriṇī cakrahastā ca cakranāthakulapriyā | cakrābhedyā cakrakulā cakramaṇḍalaśobhitā || 10-45 ||
cakreśvarapriyā celā celājinakuśottarā | caturvedasthitā caṇḍā candrakoṭisuśītalā || 10-46 ||
caturguṇā candravarṇā cāturī caturapriyā | cakṣuḥsthā cakṣuvasatiścaṇakā caṇakapriyā || 10-47 ||
cārvvaṅgī candranilayā caladambujalocanā | carvvarīśā cārumukhī cārudantā carasthitā || 10-48 ||
casakasthāsavā cetā cetaḥsthā caitrapūjitā | cākṣuṣī candramalinī candrahāsamaṇiprabhā || 10-49 ||
chalasthā chudrarūpā ca chatracchāyāchalasthitā | chalajñā cheśvarāchāyā chāyā chinnaśivā chalā || 50 ||
chatrācāmaraśobhāḍhyā chatriṇāṃ chatradhāriṇī | chinnātītā chinnamastā chinnakeśā chalodbhavā || 10-51 ||
chalahā chaladā chāyā channā channajanapriyā | chalachinnā chadmavatī chadmasadmanivāsinī || 10-52 ||
chadmagandhā chadāchannā chadmaveśī chakārikā | chagalā raktabhakṣā ca chagalāmodaraktapā || 10-53 ||
chagalaṇḍeśakanyā ca chagalaṇḍakumārikā | churikā churikakarā churikārinivāśinī || 10-54 ||
chinnanāśā chinnahastā choṇalolā chalodarī | chalodvegā chāṅgabījamālā chāṅgavarapradā || 10-55 ||
jaṭilā jaṭharaśrīdā jarā jajñapriyā jayā | jantrasthā jīvahā jīvā jayadā jīvayogadā || 56 ||
jayinī jāmalasthā ca jāmalodbhavanāyikā | jāmalapriyakanyā ca jāmaleśī javāpriyā || 10-57 ||
javākoṭisamaprakhyā javāpuṣpapriyā janā | jalasthā jagaviṣayā jarātītā jalasthitā || 10-58 ||
jīvahā jīvakanyā ca janārddanakumārikā | jatukā jalapūjyā ca jagannāthādikāminī || 10-59 ||
jīrṇāṅgī jīrṇahīnā ca jīmūtāttyantaśobhitā | jāmadā jamadā jṛmbhā jṛmbhaṇāstrādidhāriṇī || 60 ||
jaghanyā jārajā prītā jagadānandavaddhīnī | jamalārjunadarpaghnī jamalārjunabhañjinī || 10-61 ||
jayitrījagadānandā jāmalollāsasiddhidā | japamālā jāpyasiddhirjapayajñaprakāśinī || 10-62 ||
jāmbuvatī jāmbavataḥ kanyakājanavājapā | javāhantrī jagadbuddhirjjagatkartṛ jagadgatiḥ || 10-63 ||
jananī jīvanī jāyā jaganmātā janeśvarī | jhaṅkalā jhaṅkamadhyasthā jhaṇatkārasvarūpiṇī || 10-64 ||
jhaṇatjhaṇadvahnirūpā jhananājhandarīśvarī | jhaṭitākṣā jharā jhañjhā jharjharā jharakanyakā || 10-65 ||
jhaṇatkārī jhanā jhannā jhakāramālayāvṛtā | jhaṅkarī jharjharī jhallī jhalveśvaranivāsinī || 10-66 ||
ñakārī ñakirātī ca ñakārabījamālinī | ñanayo'ntā ñakārāntā ñakāraparameśvarī || 10-67 ||
ñāntabījapuṭākārā ñekale ñaikagāminī | ñaikanelā ñasvarūpā ñahārā ñaharītakī || 10-68 ||
ṭunṭunī ṭaṅkahastā ca ṭāntavargā ṭalāvatī | ṭapalā ṭāpabālākhyā ṭaṅkāradhvanirūpiṇī || 10-69 ||
ṭalātī ṭākṣarātītā ṭitkārādikumārikā | ṭaṅkāstradhāriṇī ṭānā ṭamoṭārṇalabhāṣiṇī || 10-70 ||
ṭaṅkārī vidhanā ṭākā ṭakāṭakavimohinī | ṭaṅkāradharanāmāhā ṭivīkhecaranādinī || 10-71 ||
ṭhaṭhaṅkārī ṭhāṭharūpā ṭhakārabījakāraṇā | ḍamarūpriyavādyā ca ḍāmarasthā ḍabījikā || 10-72 ||
ḍāntavargā ḍamarukā ḍarasthā ḍoraḍāmarā | ḍagarārddhā ḍalātītā ḍadārukeśvarī ḍutā || 10-73 ||
ḍhārddhanārīśvarā ḍhāmā ḍhakkārī ḍhalanā ḍhalā | ḍhakesthā ḍheśvarasutā ḍhemanābhāvaḍhonanā || 10-74 ||
ṇomākānteśvarī ṇāntavargasthā ṇatunāvatī | ṇano māṇāṅkakalyāṇī ṇākṣavīṇākṣabījikā || 10-75 ||
tulasītantusūkṣmākhyā tāralyā tailagandhikā | tapasyā tāpasasutā tāriṇī taruṇī talā || 10-76 ||
tantrasthā tārakabrahmasvarūpā tantumadhyagā | tālabhakṣatridhāmūttīstārakā tailabhakṣikā || 10-77 ||
tārogrā tālamālā ca takarā tintiḍīpriyā | tapasaḥ tālasandarbhā tarjayantī kumārikā || 10-78 ||
tokācārā talodvegā takṣakā takṣakapriyā | takṣakālaṅkṛtā toṣā tāvadrūpā talapriyā || 10-79 ||
talāstradhāriṇī tāpā tapasāṃ phaladāyinī | talvalvapraharālītā talārigaṇanāśinī || 10-80 ||
tūlā taulī tolakā ca talasthā talapālikā taruṇā taptabuddhisthāstaptā pradhāriṇī tapā || 10-81 ||
tantraprakāśakaraṇī tantrārthadāyinī tathā | tuṣārakiraṇāṅgī ca caturdhā vā samaprabhā || 10-82 ||
tailamārgābhisūtā ca tantrasiddhiphalapradā | tāmraparṇā tāmrakeśā tāmrapātrapriyātamā || 10-83 ||
tamoguṇapriyā tolā takṣakārinivāriṇī | toṣayuktā tamāyācī tamaṣoḍheśvarapriyā || 10-84 ||
tulanā tulyarucirā tulyabuddhistridhā matiḥ | takrabhakṣā tālasiddhiḥ tatrasthāstatra gāminī || 10-85 ||
talayā tailabhā tālī tantragopanatatparā | tantramantraprakāśā ca triśareṇusvarūpiṇī || 10-86 ||
triṃśadarthapriyā tuṣṭā tuṣṭistuṣṭajanapriyā | thakārakūṭadaṇḍīśā thadaṇḍīśapriyā'thavā || 10-87 ||
thakārākṣararūḍhāṅgī thāntavargātha kārikā | thāntā thamīśvarī thākā thakārabījamālinī || 10-88 ||
dakṣadāmapriyā doṣā doṣajālavanāśritā | daśā daśanaghorā ca devīdāsapriyā dayā || 10-89 ||
daityahantrīparā daityā daityānāṃ maddīnī diśā | dāntā dāntapriyā dāsā dāmanā dīrghakeśikā || 10-90 ||
daśanā raktavarṇā ca darīgrahanivāsinī devamātā ca durlabhā ca dīrghāṅgā dāsakanyakā || 10-91 ||
daśanaśrī dīrghanetrā dīrghanāsā ca doṣahā | damayantī dalasthā ca dveṣyahantrī daśasthitā || 10-92 ||
daiśeṣikā diśigatā daśanāstravināśinī dāridryahā daridrasthā daridradhanadāyinī || 10-93 ||
danturā deśabhāṣā ca deśasthā deśanāyikā | dveṣarūpā dveṣahantrī dveṣārigaṇamohinī || 10-94 ||
dāmodarasthānanādā dalānāṃ baladāyinī | digdarśanā darśanasthā darśanapriyavādinī || 10-95 ||
dāmodarapriyā dāntā dāmodarakalevarā | drāviṇī draviṇī dakṣā dakṣakanyā daladṛḍhā || 10-96 ||
dṛḍhāsanādāsaśaktirdvandvayuddhaprakāśinī | dadhipriyā dadhisthā ca dadhimaṅgalakāriṇī || 10-97 ||
darpahā darpadā dṛptā darbhapuṇyapriyā dadhiḥ | darbhasthā drupadasutā draupadī drupadapriyā || 10-98 ||
dharmacintā dhanādhyakṣā dhaśveśvaravarapradā | dhanahā dhanadā dhanvī dhanurhastā dhanuḥpriyā || 10-99 ||
dharaṇī dhairyarūpā ca dhanasthā dhanamohinī | dhorā dhīrapriyādhārā dharādhāraṇatatparā || 10-100 ||
dhānyadā dhānyabījā ca dharmādharmasvarūpiṇī | dhārādharasthā dhanyā ca dharmapuñjanivāsinī || 10-101 ||
dhanāḍhyapriyakanyā ca dhanyalokaiśca sevitā | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṅgī dharmārthakāmamokṣadā || 10-102 ||
dharādharā dhuroṇā ca dhavalā dhavalāmukhī | dharā ca dhāmarūpā ca dhruvā dhrauvyā dhruvapriyā || 10-103 ||
dhaneśī dhāraṇākhyā ca dharmanindāvināśinī | dharmatejomayī dharmmyā dhairyāgrabhargamohinī || 10-104 ||
dhāraṇā dhautavasanā dhattūraphalabhoginī | nārāyaṇī narendrasthā nārāyaṇakalevarā || 10-105 ||
naranārāyaṇaprītā dharmanindā namohitā | nityā nāpitakanyā ca nayanasthā narapriyā || 10-106 ||
nāmnī nāmapriyā nārā nārāyaṇasutā narā | navīnanāyakaprītā navyā navaphalapriyā || 10-107 ||
navīnakusumaprītā navīnānāṃ dhvajānutā | nārī nimbasthitānandānandinī nandakārikā || 10-108 ||
navapuṣpamahāprītā navapuṣpasugandhikā | nandanasthā nandakanyā nandamokṣapradāyinī || 10-109 ||
namitā nāmabhedā ca nāmnārttavanamohinī | navabuddhipriyānekā nākasthā nāmakanyakā || 10-110 ||
nindāhīnā navollāsā nākasthānapradāyinī | nimbavṛkṣasthitā nimbā nānāvṛkṣanivāsinī || 10-111 ||
nāśyātītā nīlavarṇā nīlavarṇā sarasvatī | nabhaḥsthā nāyakaprītā nāyakapriyakāminī || 10-112 ||
naivavarṇā nirāhārā nivīhāṇāṃ rajaḥpriyā | nimnanābhipriyākārā narendrahastapūjitā || 10-113 ||
nalasthitā nalaprītā nalarājakumārikā | pareśvarī parānandā parāparavibhedikā || 10-114 ||
paramā paracakrasthā pārvatī parvatapriyā | pārameśī parvanānā puṣpamālyapriyā parā || 10-115 ||
parā priyā prītidātrī prītiḥ prathamakāminī | prathamā prathamā prītā puṣpagandhapriyā parā || 10-116 ||
pauṣyī pānaratā pīnā pīnastanasuśobhanā | paramānaratā puṃsāṃ pāśahastā paśupriyā || 10-117 ||
palalānandarasikā palāladhūmarūpiṇī | palāśapuṣpasaṅkāśā palāśapuṣpamālinī || 10-118 ||
premabhūtā padmamukhī padmarāgasumālinī | padmamālā pāpaharā patipremavilāsinī || 10-119 ||
pañcānanamanohārī pañcavaktraprakāśinī | phalamūlāśanā phālī phaladā phālgunapriyā || 10-120 ||
phalanāthapriyā phallī phalgukanyā phalonmukhī | phetkārītantramukhyā ca phetkāragaṇapūjitā || 10-121 ||
pheravī pheravasutā phalabhogodbhavā phalā | phalapriyā phalāśaktā phālgunānandadāyinī || 10-122 ||
phālabhogottarā phelā phulāmbhojanivāsinī | vasudevagṛhasthā ca vāsavī vīrapūjitā || 10-123 ||
viṣabhakṣā budhasutā bluṅkārī blūvarapradā | brāhmī bṛhaspatisutā vācaspativarapradā || 10-124 ||
vedācārā vedyaparā vyāsavaktrasthitā vibhā | bodhajñā vauṣaḍākhyā ca vaṃśīvaṃdanapūjitā || 10-125 ||
vajrakāntā vajragatirbadarīvaṃśavivaddhīnī | bhāratī bhavaraśrīdā bhavapatnī bhavātmajā || 10-126 ||
bhavānī bhāvinī bhīmā bhiṣagbhāryā turisthitā | bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpā ca bhṛśārttā bhekanādinī || 10-127 ||
bhautī bhaṅgapriyā bhaṅgabhaṅgahā bhaṅgahāriṇī | bhartā bhagavatī bhāgyā bhagīrathanamaskṛtā || 10-128 ||
bhagamālā bhūtanātheśvarī bhārgavapūjitā | bhṛguvaṃśā bhītiharā bhūmirbhujagahāriṇī || 10-129 ||
bhālacandrābhabhalvabālā bhavabhūtivībhūtidā | makarasthā mattagatirmadamattā madapriyā || 10-130 ||
madirāṣṭādaśabhujā madirā mattagāminī | madirāsiddhidā madhyā madāntargatisiddhidā || 10-131 ||
mīnabhakṣā mīnarūpā mudrāmudgapriyā gatiḥ | muṣalā muktidā mūrttā mūkīkaraṇatatparā || 10-132 ||
mṛṣārttā mṛgatṛṣṇā ca meṣabhakṣaṇatatparā | maithunānandasiddhiśca maithunānalasiddhidā || 10-133 ||
mahālakṣmīrbhairavī ca mahendrapīṭhanāyikā | manaḥsthā mādhavīmukhyā mahādevamanoramā || 10-134 ||
yaśodā yācanā yāsyā yamarājapriyā yamā | yaśorāśivibhūṣāṅgī yatipremakalāvatī || 10-135 ||
ramaṇī rāmapatnī ca ripuhā rītimadhyagā | rudrāṇī rūpadā rūpā rūpasundaradhāriṇī || 10-136 ||
retaḥsthā retasaḥ prītā retaḥsthānanivāsinī | rendrādevasutāredā ripuvargāntakapriyā || 10-137 ||
romāvalīndrajananī romakūpajagatpatiḥ | raupyavarṇā raudravarṇā raupyālaṅkārabhūṣaṇā || 10-138 ||
raṅgiṇā raṅgarāgasthā raṇavahnikuleśvarī | lakṣmīḥ lāṅgalahastā ca lāṅgalī kulakāminī || 10-139 ||
lipirūpā līḍhapādā latātantusvarūpiṇī | limpatī lelihā lolā lomaśapriyasiddhidā || 10-140 ||
laukikī laukikīsiddhirlaṅkānāthakumārikā | lakṣmaṇā lakṣmīhīnā ca lapriyā lārṇamadhyagā || 10-141 ||
vivasā vasanāveśā vivasyakulakanyakā | vātasthā vātarūpā ca velamadhyanivāsinī || 10-142 ||
śmaśānabhūmimadhyasthā śmaśānasādhanapriyā | śavasthā parasiddhyarthī śavavakṣasi śobhitā || 10-143 ||
śaraṇāgatapālyā ca śivakanyā śivapriyā | ṣaṭcakrabhedinī ṣoḍhā nyāsajāladṛḍhānanā || 10-144 ||
sandhyāsarasvatī sundyā sūryagā śāradā satī | haripriyā harahālālāvaṇyasthā kṣamā kṣudhā || 10-145 ||
kṣetrajñā siddhidātrī ca ambikā cāparājitā | ādyā indrapriyā īśā umā ūḍhā ṛtupriyā || 10-146 ||
sutuṇḍā svarabījāntā hariveśādisiddhidā | ekādaśīvratasthā ca endrī oṣadhisiddhidā || 10-147 ||
aupakārī aṃśarūpā astrabījaprakāśinī | ityetat kāmukīnātha kumārīṇāṃ sumaṅgalam || 10-148 ||
trailokyaphaladaṃ nityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam | mahāstotraṃ dharmasāraṃ dhanadhānyasutapradam || 10-149 ||
sarvavidyāphalollāsaṃ bhaktimān yaḥ paṭhet sudhīḥ | sa sarvadā divārātrau sa bhavenmuktimārgagaḥ || 10-150 ||
sarvatra jayamāpnoti vīrāṇāṃ vallabho labhet | sarve devā vaśaṃ yānti vaśībhūtāśca mānavāḥ || 10-151 ||
brahmāṇḍe ye ca śaṃsanti te tuṣṭā nātra saṃśayaḥ | ye vaśanti ca bhūrloke devatulyaparākramāḥ || 10-152 ||
te sarve bhṛtyatulyāśca satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara | akasmāt siddhimāpnoti homena yajanena ca || 10-153 ||
jāpyena kavacādyena mahāstotrārthapāṭhataḥ | vinā yajñaivīnā dānaivīnā jāpyairlabhet phalam || 10-154 ||
yaḥ paṭhet stotrakaṃ nāma cāṣṭottarasahasrakam | tasya śāntirbhavet kṣipraṃ kanyāstotraṃ paṭhettataḥ || 10-155 ||
vāratrayaṃ prapāṭhena rājānaṃ vaśamānayet | vāraikapaṭhito mantrī dharmārthakāmamokṣabhāk || 10-156 ||
tridinaṃ prapaṭhedvidvān yadi putraṃ samicchati | vāratrayakrameṇaiva vāraikakramato'pi vā || 10-157 ||
paṭhittvā dhanaratnānāmadhipaḥ sarvavittagaḥ | trijaganmohayenmantrī vatsarārddhaṃ prapāṭhataḥ || 10-158 ||
vatsaraṃ vāpya yadi vā bhaktibhāvena yaḥ paṭhet | cirajīvī khecarattvaṃ prāpya yogī bhavennaraḥ || 10-159 ||
mahādūrasthitaṃ varṇaṃ paśyati sthiramānasaḥ | mahilāmaṇḍale sthittvā śaktiyuktaḥ paṭhet sudhīḥ || 10-160 ||
sa bhavetsādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrī kalpadrumo bhavet | sarvadā yaḥ paṭhennātha bhāvodgatakalevaraḥ || 10-161 ||
darśanāt stambhanaṃ karttuṃ kṣamo bhavati sādhakaḥ | jalādistambhane śakto vahnistambhādisiddhibhāk || 10-162 ||
vāyuvegī mahāvāgmī vedajño bhavati dhruvam | kavinātho mahāvidyo vandhakaḥ paṇḍito bhavet || 10-163 ||
sarvadeśādhipo bhūttvā devīputraḥ svayaṃ bhavet | kāntiṃ śriyaṃ yaśo vṛddhiṃ prāpnoti balavān yatiḥ || 10-164 ||
aṣṭasiddhiyuto nātha yaḥ paṭhedarthasiddhaye | ujjaṭe'raṇyamadhye ca parvate ghorakānane || 10-165 ||
vane vā pretabhūmau ca śavopari mahāraṇe | grāme bhagnagṛhe vāpi śūnyāgāre nadītaṭe || 10-166 ||
gaṅgāgarbhe mahāpīṭhe yonipīṭhe gurorgṛhe | dhānyakṣetre devagṛhe kanyāgāre kulālaye || 10-167 ||
prāntare goṣṭhamadhye vā rājādibhayahīnake | nirbhayādisvadeśeṣu śiliṅgālaye'thavā || 10-168 ||
bhūtagartte caikaliṅgai vā śūnyadeśe nirākule | aśvatthamūle bilve vā kulavṛkṣasamīpage || 10-169 ||
anyeṣu siddhadeśeṣu kularūpāśca sādhakaḥ | divye vā vīrabhāvastho yaṣṭvā kanyāṃ kulākulai || 10-170 ||
kuladravyaiśca vividhaiḥ siddhidravyaiśca sādhakaḥ | māṃsāsavena juhuyānmuktena rasena ca || 10-171 ||
hutaśeṣaṃ kuladravyaṃ tābhyo dadyāt susiddhaye | tāsāmucchiṣṭamānīya juhuyād raktapaṅkaje || 10-172 ||
ghṛṇālajjāvinirmuktaḥ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ | pibenmāṃsarasaṃ mantrī sadānando mahābalī || 10-173 ||
mahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ tābhyo madirākumbhapūritam | tāro māyā ramāvahnijāyāmantraṃ paṭhet sudhīḥ || 10-174 ||
nivedya vidhinānena paṭhittvā stotramaṅgalam | svayaṃ prasādaṃ bhuktvā hi sarvavidyādhipo bhavet || 10-175 ||
śūkarasyoṣṭrmāṃsena pīnamīnena mudrayā | mahāsavaghaṭenāpi dattvā paṭhati yo naraḥ || 10-176 ||
dhruvaṃ sa sarvagāmī syād vinā homena pūjayā | rudrarūpo bhavennityaṃ mahākālātmako bhavet || 10-177 ||
sarvapuṇyaphalaṃ nātha kṣaṇāt prāpnoti sādhakaḥ | kṣīrābdhiratnakoṣeśo viyadvyāpī ca yogirāṭ || 10-178 ||
bhaktyāhlādaṃ dayāsindhuṃ niṣkāmattvaṃ labhed dhruvam | mahāśatrupātane ca mahāśatrubhayāddīte || 10-179 ||
vāraikapāṭhamātreṇa śatrūṇāṃ vadhamānayet | samardayet śatrūn kṣipramandhakāraṃ yathā raviḥ || 10-180 ||
uccāṭane māraṇe ca bhaye ghoratare ripau | paṭhanāddhāraṇānmarttyo devā vā rākṣasādayaḥ || 10-181 ||
prāpnuvanti jhaṭit śāntiṃ kumārīnāmapāṭhataḥ | puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau nārī vāmakare tathā || 10-182 ||
dhṛtvā putrādisampattiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 10-183 ||
mamājñayā mokṣamupaiti sādhako | gajāntakaṃ nātha sahasranāma ca paṭhenmanuṣyo yahi bhaktibhāvata(--) stadā hi sarvatra phalodayaṃ labhet ca || 10-184 ||
mokṣaṃ satphalabhogināṃ stavavaraṃ sāraṃ parānandadaṃ ye nityaṃ hi mudā paṭhanti viphalaṃ sārthañca cintākulāḥ te nityāḥ prabhavanti kītīkamale śrīrāmatulyo jaye kandarpāyutatulyarūpaguṇinaḥ krodhe ca rudropamāḥ || 10-185 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane kumāryupacaryāvinyāse siddhamantra(--) prakaraṇe divyabhāvanirṇaye aṣṭottarasahasranāmamaṅgalollāse daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 10 ||
[athaikādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi divyabhāvādinirṇayam | yamāśritya mahārudro bhuvaneśvaranāmadhṛk || 11-1 ||
yaṃ jñātvā kamalānātho devatānāmadhīśvaraḥ | caturvedādhipo brahmā sākṣādbrahma sanātanaḥ || 11-2 ||
baṭuko mama putraśca śakraḥ svargādhidevatā | aṣṭasiddhiyutāḥ sarve dikpālāḥ khecarādayaḥ || 11-3 ||
tatprakāraṃ mahādeva ānandanāthabhairava | surānanda hṛdayānanda jñānānanda dayāmaya || 11-4 ||
śṛṇusvaikamanā nātha yadi tvaṃ siddhimicchasi | mama priyānandarūpa yato me tvaṃ tanusthitaḥ || 11-5 ||
trividhaṃ divyabhāvañca vedāgamavivekajam | vedārthamadhamaṃ samproktaṃ madhyamaṃ cāgamodbhavam || 11-6 ||
uttamaṃ sakalaṃ proktaṃ vivekollāsasambhavam | tathaiva trividhaṃ bhāvaṃ divyavīrapaśukramam || 11-7 ||
divyaṃ vivekajaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam | uttamaṃ tadvijānīyādānandarasasāgaram || 11-8 ||
madhyamaṃ cāgamollāsaṃ vīrabhāvaṃ kriyānvitam | vedodbhavaṃ phalārthañca paśubhāvaṃ hi cādhamam || 11-9 ||
sarvanindā samāvyāptaṃ bhāvānāmadhamaṃ paśoḥ | uttame uttamaṃ jñānaṃ bhāvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām || 11-10 ||
madhyame madhumatyāśca matkulāgamasambhavam | akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ bhāvānāmatidurlabham || 11-11 ||
vīrabhāvaṃ vinā nātha na siddhyati kadācana | adhame adhamā vyākhyā nindārthavācakaṃ sadā || 11-12 ||
yadi nindā na karoti tadā tatphalamāpnuyāt | paśubhāve'pi siddhiḥ syāt yadi vedaṃ sadābhyaset || 11-13 ||
vedārthacintanaṃ nityaṃ vedapāṭhadhvanipriyam | sarvanindāvirahitaṃ hiṃsālasyavivajītam || 11-14 ||
lobha(--)moha(--)kāma(--)krodha(--)madamātsaryavajītam | yadi bhāvasthito mantrī paśubhāve'pi siddhibhāk || 11-15 ||
paśubhāvaṃ mahābhāvaṃ ye jānanti mahītale | kimasādhyaṃ mahādeva śramābhyāsena yānti tat || 11-16 ||
śramādhīnaṃ jagat sarvaṃ śramādhīnāśca devatāḥ | śramādhīnaṃ mahāmantraṃ śramādhīnaṃ parantapaḥ || 11-17 ||
śramādhīnaṃ kulācāraṃ paśubhāvopalakṣaṇam | vedārthajñānamātreṇa paśubhāvaṃ kulapriyam || 11-18 ||
smṛtyāgamapurāṇāni vedārthavividhāni ca | abhyasya sarvaśāstrāṇi tattvajñānāttu buddhimān || 11-19 ||
palalamiva dhānyārthī sarvaśāstrāṇi santyajet | jñānī bhūtvā bhāvasāramāśrayet sādhakottamaḥ || 11-20 ||
vede vedakriyā kāryā maduktavacanādṛtaḥ | paśūnāṃ śramadāhānāmiti lakṣaṇamīritam || 11-21 ||
āgamārthaṃ kriyā kāryā matkulāgamaceṣṭayā | vīrāṇāmuddhatānāñca mat śarīrānugāminām || 11-22 ||
maccecchākula tattvānāmiti lakṣaṇamīritam | vivekasūtrasaṃjñājñā kāryā sudṛḍhaṃcetasām || 11-23 ||
sarvatra samabhāvānāṃ bhāvamātraṃ hi sādhanam | sarvatra matpadāmbhojasambhavaṃ sacarācaram || 11-24 ||
pṛṣṭvā yatkurute karma cākhaṇḍaphalasiddhidam | akhaṇḍajñānacittānāmiti bhāvaṃ vivekinām || 11-25 ||
nirmalānandadivyānāmiti lakṣaṇamīritam | divye tu trividhaṃ bhāvaṃ yo jānāti mahītale || 11-26 ||
na naśyati mahāvīraḥ kadācit sādhakottamaḥ | divyabhāvaṃ vinā nātha matpadāmbhojadarśanam || 11-27 ||
ya icchati mahādeva sa mūḍhaḥ sādhakaḥ katham | paśubhāvaṃ prathamake dvitīye vīrabhāvakam || 11-28 ||
tṛtīye divyabhāvañca divyabhāvatrayaṃ kramāt | tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu śiva trailokyaparipāvana || 11-29 ||
bhāvatrayaviśeṣajñaḥ ṣaḍādhārasya bhedanaḥ | pañcatattvārthabhāvajño divyācārarataḥ tadā || 11-30 ||
sa eva bhavati śrīmān siddhanāmādipāragaḥ | śivavad viharet so'pi aṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 11-31 ||
sarvatra śucibhāvena ānandaghanasādhanam | prātaḥkālādimadhyāhnakālaparyantadhāraṇam || 11-32 ||
bhojanañcoktadravyeṇa saṃyamādikrameṇa vā | yaḥ sādhayati sa siddho divyabhāve paśukramāt || 11-33 ||
divyabhāve vīrabhāvaṃ vadāmi tatpunaḥ śṛṇu | madhyāhnādikasandhyāntaṃ śucibhāvena sādhanam || 11-34 ||
japanaṃ dhāraṇaṃ vāpi cittamādāya yatnataḥ | ekāntanirjane deśe siddho bhavati niścitam || 11-35 ||
tatkālaṃ vīrabhāvārthaṃ bhāvamātraṃ hi sādhanam | bhāvena labhate siddhiṃ vīrādanyanna kutracit || 11-36 ||
rātrau gandhādisampūrṇastāmbūlapūritānanaḥ | vijayānandasampanno jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ || 11-37 ||
ekyaṃ citte samādhāya ānandodrekasaṃbhramaḥ | yo japet sakalāṃ rātriṃ gatabhīnīrjane gṛhe || 11-38 ||
sa bhavet kālikādāso divyānāmuttamottamaḥ | evaṃ bhāvatrayaṃ jñātvā yaḥ karma sādhayettataḥ || 11-39 ||
aṣṭaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā sarvajño bhavati dhruvam | bhāvatrayāṇāṃ madhye tu bhāvapuṇyārthanirṇayam || 11-40 ||
śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā'vadhāraya | akasmāt siddhimāpnoti jñātvā saṅketalāñchitam || 11-41 ||
yo jānāti mahādeva tasya siddhirna saṃśayaḥ | dvādaśe paṭale sūkṣmasaṅketārthaṃ vadāmi tat || 11-42 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
ekādaśe ca paṭale śuddhabhāvārthanirṇayam | bhāvena labhyate sarvaṃ bhāvādhīnaṃ jagattrayam || 11-43 ||
bhāvaṃ vinā mahādeva na siddhirjāyate kvacit | paśubhāvāśrayāṇāñca aruṇodayakālataḥ || 11-44 ||
daśadaṇḍāśritaṃ kālaṃ praśnārthaṃ kevalaṃ prabho | cakraṃ dvādaśarāśeśca māsadvādaśakasya ca || 11-45 ||
daśadaṇḍe vijānīyād bhāvābhāvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | anulomavilomena pañcasvaravibhedataḥ || 11-46 ||
bālya kaiśorasaundaryaṃ yauvanaṃ vṛddhasañjñakam | asta(aṣṭa)mitaṃ kramājjñeyo vidhiḥ pañcasvaraḥ svayam || 11-47 ||
svakīyaṃ nāsikāgrasthaṃ pañcamaṃ parikītītam | yannāsāpuṭamadhye tu vāyurbhavati bhairava || 11-48 ||
tannāsāpuṭamadhye tu bhāvābhāvaṃ vicintayet | ākāśaṃ vāyurūpaṃ hi taijasaṃ vāruṇaṃ prabho || 11-49 ||
pāthīvaṃ kramaśo jñeyaṃ bālyāstādikrameṇa tu | vāmodaye śubhā vāmā dakṣiṇe puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ || 11-50 ||
vāyūnāṃ gamanaṃ jñeyaṃ gaganāvadhireva ca | kevalaṃ madhyadeśe tu gamanaṃ pavanasya ca || 11-51 ||
tadākāśaṃ vijānīyād bālyabhāvaṃ prakītītam tiryaggatistu nāsāgre vāyorudayameva ca || 11-52 ||
kevalaṃ bhramaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvamaṅgalameva ca | kiśoraṃ tadvijānīyād vāyau tiryaggatau vibho || 11-53 ||
kevalorddhvanāsikāgre vāyurgacchati daṇḍavat | tattaijasaṃ vijānīyād gamanaṃ balavad bhavet || 11-54 ||
tadvṛddhagatabhāvañca vilambo'dhikaceṣṭayā | prāpnoti paramāṃ prītiṃ varuṇāmbhodaye rujām || 11-55 ||
yadādho gacchati kṣipraṃ kiñcid ūrdhvamagocaram | yadā karoti praśvāsaṃ tadā rogolbaṇodayaḥ || 11-56 ||
pṛthivyā unnataṃ bhāgyaṃ yogātapaprapīḍitam | astamitaṃ mahādeva anulomavilomataḥ || 11-57 ||
pavano gacchati kṣipraṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhedataḥ | vāmanāsāpuṭe yāti pṛthivī jalameva ca || 11-58 ||
sadā phalāphalaṃ datte muditā kuṇḍamaṇḍale | tayorvai vāyavī śaktiḥ phalabhāgaṃ tadā labhet || 11-59 ||
yadyevaṃ vāmabhāge tu vāmāyāḥ praśnakarmaṇi | yadi tatra pumān praśnaṃ karoti vāmagāmine || 11-60 ||
tadā rogamavāpnoti karmahīno bhaved dhruvam | yadi vāyūdayo vāme dakṣiṇe puruṣaḥ sthitaḥ || 11-61 ||
tadā phalamavāpnoti dravyāgamanadurlabham | akasmād dravyahāniḥ syānmanogataphalāpaham || 11-62 ||
suhṛd bhaṅgavivādañca bhinnabhinnodaye śubham | kevalaṃ varuṇasyaiva puruṣo dakṣiṇe śubham || 11-63 ||
aśubhaṃ pṛthivīdakṣe bhedo'yaṃ varadurlabhaḥ | sadodayaṃ dakṣiṇe ca vāyostaijasa eva ca || 11-64 ||
ākāśasya vijānīyāt śubhāśubhaphalaṃ prabho | yadi bhāgyavaśādeva vāyormandā gatirbhavet || 11-65 ||
dakṣanāśāmadhyadeśe tadā vāmodayaṃ śubham | tadā vāme vicārañca vāyutejodvayasya ca || 11-66 ||
jñātvodayaṃ vijānīyād mitre hāniḥ sure bhayam | evaṃ subhavanāgāre yadi gacchati vāyavī || 11-67 ||
tasmin kāle pumān dakṣo dakṣabhāgasthasammukhaḥ | tadā kanyādānaphalaṃ yathā prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 11-68 ||
tadā vāyuprasādena prāpnoti dhanamuttamam | deśāntarasthabhāvārttā āyānti putrasampadaḥ || 11-69 ||
bālyādikaṃ bhāvatrayaṃ rāśibhede śubhaṃ diśet etaccakre phalaṃ tasya rāśidvādaśacakrake || 11-70 ||
sūkṣmaṃ phalaṃ vijānīyāt cakraṃ nāma śṛṇu prabho | ājñācakraṃ kāmacakraṃ phalacakrañca sāradam || 11-71 ||
praśnacakraṃ bhūmicakraṃ svargacakraṃ tataḥ param | tulācakraṃ vāricakraṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ triguṇātmakam || 11-72 ||
sāracakramulkācakraṃ mṛtyucakraṃ kramātprabho | ṣaṭkoṇaṃ cātra jānīyādanulomavilomataḥ || 11-73 ||
sarvacakre svarajñānaṃ sarvatra vāyusaṅgatim | sarvapraśnādisañcāraṃ bhāvena jāyate yadi || 11-74 ||
tadā taddaṇḍamānañca jñātvā rāśyudayaṃ budhaḥ | kuryāt praśnavicārañca yadi kītīmihecchati || 11-75 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvabodhanirṇaye paśubhāvavicāre sārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 11 ||
[atha dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
tadvāmasandhideśasthamaṣṭamāṅkamatho likhet | tadadhaḥ sandhideśasthaṃ saptāṅkaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ || 12-1 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ vāmakoṇe ca tṛtīyāṅkaṃ likhettataḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ koṇagehe ca yugmāṅkaṃ vilikhettathā || 12-2 ||
taddakṣiṇe gṛhe caikamaṅkavarṇaṃ śṛṇu prabho | vasubhāvaṃ śūnyabhāvaṃ ṣaṣṭhabhāvañca śūnyakam || 12-3 ||
etanmadhye nāsti varṇaṃ koṇāṅkañca savarṇakam | ṭatavargau śa śa likhet śare śūnyādha eva ca || 12-4 ||
vedāṅkasthau kacavargau eekārasamanvitau | tṛtīyāṅkasthitaṃ varṇaṃ ādikṣāntaṃ ṭavargamom || 12-5 ||
tapavargau yugāntasthau makāraṃ sāvadhānataḥ | vilikhed dakṣiṇe tasya gehe caikāṅkamadhyake || 12-6 ||
uyugaṃ patavargau ca akāraṃ yugmaśīrṣake | etat cakraṃ kāmacakraṃ praśnakāle phalapradam || 12-7 ||
vāmāvarttena gaṇayet daśakoṇasthavarṇakān | anuloma vilomena pañcasvarādināmataḥ || 12-8 ||
yasmingṛhe svīyanāma prāpnoti vedapāragaḥ | tadgṛhāvadhi praśnārthaṃ gaṇayed grahasiddhaye || 12-9 ||
navagrahanavasthānaṃ varṇaṃ jñātvā subuddhimān | bālyabhāvādikaṃ jñātvā yatra grahasthitirbhavet || 12-10 ||
tannakṣatraṃ samānīya dvārādhikāramānayet | vinā trikoṇayogena ṣaṭkoṇaṃ likhed budhaḥ || 12-11 ||
tanmadhye aṣṭakoṇañca bhitvā devagṛhāntaram | tanmadhye cāpi ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye ca trikoṇakam || 12-12 ||
krameṇa vilikhed varṇaṃ dakṣiṇāvarttayogataḥ | ūdrdhvavāmadeśabhāge a ā i ca kavargakam || 12-13 ||
taddakṣiṇe ī i yugaṃ ṭavargañca likhed budhaḥ | dakṣapārśve adhobhāge ṛyugaṃ tu tavargakam || 12-14 ||
tadadho ḷ ḹ e e rūpañca pavargañca likhed budhaḥ | tadvāmapārśvabhāge ca o au yaralavān likhet || 12-15 ||
śeṣagehe likhedaṃ aḥ śādikṣāntaṃ hi ṣaḍgṛhe | madhyastamādikoṇe ca ekāṅkaṃ śārvakaṃ tanum || 12-16 ||
rudrāgnimūtīmanilaṃ agnikoṇe likhed budhaḥ | yajamānaḥ paśupatimūtīṣaṣṭhañca dakṣiṇe || 12-17 ||
mahādevaṃ somamūtīṃ saptamaṃ nairṛte likhet | jalamūttībhavaṃ yugmaṃ paścime vilikhed budhaḥ || 12-18 ||
ugravīraṃ vāyumūttīṃ vāyukoṇe caturthakam | bhīmarūpākāśamūttīṃ pañcamaṃ cottare likhet || 12-19 ||
īśānaṃ sūryamūtīñca īśāne ṣaḍdalaṃ likhet | adhaḥ ṣaṭkoṇamadhye ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhettataḥ || 12-20 ||
ūdrdhvakoṇe grīṣmakālaṃ śiśirañcāpi dakṣiṇe | varṣākālamadhastasya sarvādhaśca vasantakam || 12-21 ||
śaratkālaṃ pañcakośe śītakālañca ṣaṣṭhake | trikoṇe cāpi tanmadhye vahnirūpaṃ vakārakam || 12-22 ||
likhitvā gaṇayenmantrī varṇadevāṅkavahnibhiḥ | etaccakraṃ mahāsūkṣmaṃ phalacakraṃ viśāradam || 12-23 ||
adhunā kulanātheśa pṛṣṭhacakraṃ punaḥ śṛṇu | vinā jñānena yasyaivaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāvo na jāyate || 12-24 ||
yadi pṛṣṭhacakrabhāvaṃ jānāti sādhakottamaḥ | tadā nijaphalaṃ jñātvā siddhimāpnoti niścitam || 12-25 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kārayenmantrī vinā trikoṇasādhanaiḥ | tanmadhye ca catuṣkoṇaṃ tanmadhye śādivarṇakān || 12-26 ||
likhitvā vilikhettatra ṣaḍaṅkamadhyadeśataḥ | ṣaḍaṅkaṃ dāpayenmantrī dīrghadīrghakrameṇa tu || 12-27 ||
tadagre ṣaḍgṛhaṃ kuryāttatrāṅkārṇān likhetsudhīḥ | ūdrdhvaprathamagehe ca kavargaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ || 12-28 ||
taddakṣiṇe mandire ca cavargaṃ vilikhed budhaḥ | ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe cādhaḥ sarvādhastu tavargakam || 12-29 ||
tadvāme mandire nātha pavargaṃ varṇamaṅgalam | tadūrdhve yādivāntaṃ ca dakṣiṇāvarttayogataḥ || 12-30 ||
akārādisvarān tatra mandire vilikhed budhaḥ | yāvat svarasthitiryāti tāvatkālaṃ vicārayet || 12-31 ||
meṣādirāśisadbhāvaṃ vargalekhanamānataḥ | anulomavilomena vilikhet ṣaṣṭhamandire || 12-32 ||
yadyadgṛhe sādhyanāma cāsti nātha svarādikam | ekatrīkṛtya haraṇāt yadaṅkaṃ prāpyate varam || 12-33 ||
ṣaḍaṅkena tato nātha haredanalasaṃkhyayā | yadaṅkaṃ prāpyate tatra sa rāśistat kṣaṇasya ca || 12-34 ||
ājñācakraṃ phalaṃ siddhaṃ vidyānātha vadāmi tat | yena vijñātamātreṇa sarvajño bhavati dhruvam || 12-35 ||
akasmāt śaktimāpnoti vidyāratnaṃ dadāmi tat | ravyādisaptavārañca kṛte bhadravivardhanam || 12-36 ||
śanyādisaptavāraṃ ca tretāyāṃ saukhyavarddhanam | gurvādisaptavārañca dvāpare dharmasādhanam || 12-37 ||
śukrādivārasaptañca kalau yugaphalapradam | ataḥ śukrādiparyantaṃ gaṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 12-38 ||
gaṇayet saptavārañca madhye catudrdale sudhīḥ | pūrvādikramato vārān gaṇayed tantravittamaḥ || 12-39 ||
nijavāro yatra patre samāptistūdbhavañca tat | tadbharāśiṃ samānīya varṇabhedaṃ samānayet || 12-40 ||
sāmānyaphalamūlañca vadārṇādipatrabhedataḥ | ājñācakraṃ śubhaṃ mantrī ājñācakraṃ vicārayet || 12-41 ||
tatphalāphalamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu saṅketapaṇḍita || 12-42 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
dale pūrvabhāge ākārārdha indu(--) | sphuṭe rājyalābhaṃ hakārāntaśabdam | sāmānārthabhāvaṃ viśiṣṭārthayoga| kratukṣemayuktaṃ tathā putralābham || 12-43 ||
dayāyuktabhūṣāśrayatvaṃ jayatva| samāpnoti martyo vivāhaṃ suvāham sukhaṃ nātha lokānurāgaṃ subhoga| vibhādhāvakānāṃ samāpte kṣaṇādim || 12-44 ||
padme dakṣiṇapatrake priyapadā modadahaṃ bhāsvara| nānālakṣaṇaduḥkhadaṃ śucipadā āndolitastairaham | māhendrāmṛtayogarāgahananaṃ sākṣādyamāropaṇa| cittānāṃ paricañcalaṃ khalaguṇāhlādena sāmoditam || 12-45 ||
pātrārthalābhaṃ yadi vādha eva pragacchati krūrakhalapratāpaḥ | tathāpi hantuṃ na ca varṇamadhye kṣamaḥ svasiddhaṃ bhajate kṣamādi || 12-46 ||
rasārthapraśnaṃ kurute yadi syād vāro hi cāro gṛhamadhyabhāge | svakīya indupriyavad bhaved dhruvam manogataṃ saukhyavivardhanañca || 12-47 ||
śatrūṇāṃ hananaṃ tadā kulagataṃ sañcāravātaṃ mudā | rogāṇāṃ parimardanaṃ prabhupade bhaktyathīnāṃ jñāpanam | āhlādaṃ hṛdayāmbuje'mṛtadhanaṃ tīrthāgamaṃ śokaha| sūkṣmārthaṃ gaṇayettataḥ pracapalā vāgdevatādarśanam || 12-48 ||
ātharve patramadhye nivasati kamalā komalā vādyadātrī | āgantavyādivārtā kathayati sahasā sarvadā maṅgalāni | nityāvaśyaṃ pratāpaṃ priyagaṇahitāṃ premabhāvāśrayattva| nityaṃ kāntāmukhāmbhoruhavimalamadhupremapānābhilāṣam || 12-49 ||
meṣe tṛptimupaiti siṃha iṣubhiḥ kumbhena teṣāṃ phala| lābhaṃ kuñjaraghātakeṣu rajataṃ cauryeṇa yadyadgata | evaṃ kāsyavihāraṇaṃ śatapale sūryodayāttiṣṭhati | prātaḥ kālaphalāphalaṃ kathayati śrīkeśarīmadhyagaḥ || 12-50 ||
paśyādekaśataṃ palendudhanuṣā vyāptaṃ yadā bhūtale | vittānāṃ haraṇaṃ tadā jalagate mitrasya rājyādikam | dūrasthādikathāgatādisamayaṃ śatrormahāpīḍana| vāñchāvargakulodayaṃ samudayāt sūryasya cāgaṇyate || 12-51 ||
śeṣe caikaśate phale samudite kumbho mahādurbalī | dāridryasya kathā kadā suviṣayaṃ vidyārthabhūṣañca yam | lābhaṃ deśavideśakāryagamanaṃ śīghraṃ dhanādyāgama| devānāṃ khalu darśanārthakathanaṃ vyāmohasannāśanam || 12-52 ||
vāre śukre śanigatadina lavaṭāhau ca sūrye | nityaṃ jñānodayanijapatha āyuṣāṃ nirṇayaṃ tat | aṣṭau vargānudayati mudā prāpya vīro mahattva| loko doṣaṃ prathamakhacare cāyuṣāṃ pṛṣṭamātram || 12-53 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvapraśnārthabodhanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ājñācakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 12 ||
[atha trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
ājñāpraśnārthabhāvañca varṇavinyāsanirṇayam | adhunā śṛṇu sarvajña bhāvajñānaparāyaṇa || 13-1 ||
yadi meṣe svanakṣatraṃ svavārasaṃyutaṃ śubham | jñātvā śubhādipatrañca palamānena sādhakaḥ || 13-2 ||
gaṇayed varṇasārañca yena tatpraśnanirṇayaḥ | pūrve dale kakārasya varṇabhedaṃ śṛṇu prabho || 13-3 ||
manasi sukhasamūhaṃ prāṇasaukhyārthacintā | vasanagamanalābhaṃ prītiputrārthayogyam | sthirapadamapi deśe darśanaṃ prāṇabandhoḥ | sakalakaluṣahāniścādipatre kakāre || 13-4 ||
sadā nṛnāsike sukhaṃ sukholbaṇasya sevana| sadāśive ca bhaktidaṃ svakīyagehasatphalam | kalādharasya dṛṣṭibhiḥ pradhānalokapūjana| hitāhitaṃ na bādhate vivāhakelinā sukham || 13-5 ||
ṛkāraṃ vipadāṃ dhvaṃsaṃ dhairye vidyāvibodhanam | vyādhipīḍādurjanānāṃ pīḍāpraśnaṃ vadettadā || 13-6 ||
ukāre vāyubhāvasya vṛthāgamanameva ca | dāridryahānayoryānti dūrāgamanadurlabham || 13-7 ||
khakāre dravyapraśnañca śubhakārye gate bhayam | āśu bhayaṃ samāpnoti prāpya nirdhanatāṃ vrajet || 13-8 ||
pañcatvajijñāsanameva satyaṃ nityaṃ sukhānāmudayāya ceṣṭā | śatrovīnāśāya hitāya bandhoḥ pakārakūṭe paracauraceṣṭā || 13-9 ||
kaivalyādisamāpanaṃ nijamano duṣṭavyāpahaṃ kāminā| nānābhogavināśanaṃ kanakaraupyarājapradaṃ svake | mārībhītivirodhanaṃ dhanapaterānandapuñjodaya| govidyāśriyamāśu lābhavividhaṃ dharmārthacintākulam || 13-10 ||
haripūjā haridhyānaṃ haripādāmbuje ratiḥ | cauryāharaṇadravyasya na hānirjanmahārdake || 13-11 ||
ākāre tejaso hānirmahāśabde vināśanam | āgatānāñca hāniḥ syāt pakṣapātaṃ gatau jayam || 13-12 ||
uśato nijagehasthā ulbaṇavyādhipīḍanam | utsāhadhvaṃsaśūnyañca pāṭhe pāṇḍityamulbaṇam || 13-13 ||
dīrghaḷkāravarṇe ca lāvaṇyalocano nṛpaḥ | lajjānaṣṭakṣemabuddhimītratulyapriyo bhavet || 13-14 ||
dīrghapraṇavamoṅkāre nirāśrayo na jīvati | mahadāśrayamātreṇa sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ karoti hi || 13-15 ||
siṃhe kārmukameṣalagnasamaye nityāśiṣaṃ prāpnuyāt | kiñcidbhāti parākramī gatimatāṃ śreṣṭho bhavet karmaṇi | kiñciddoṣakulāpahaṃ narapaterutsāhasaṃvardhana| krodhī nityaparākramī bhavati saḥ śīghrābhilāṣānvitaḥ || 13-16 ||
atha vakṣye mahādeva vīrāṇāmuttamottama | sarvaśāstrārthatattvajña tattvajñānaparāyaṇa || 13-17 ||
dakṣiṇasthadalasyāpi varṇabhedārthanirgamam | phalamatyantaniṣkarṣaṃ vāñchāvākyaphalapradam || 13-18 ||
kānte bīje kamalanilayā gehabhāgasthirā yā | nānādeśabhramaṇabhayadā naiva kutrāpi susthā | caṇḍodvegāpahasati khalānāñca hāniḥ prabuddho | vāṇī vaśyā vasati vadane cakriṇāṃ hānayaḥ syuḥ || 13-19 ||
cārupratāpaṃ caraṇe gurūṇāṃ bhaktirdṛḍhā syād gamaneṣu cāru | tadāgatānāṃ nṛpatipriyāṇāṃ sampreraṇaṃ cāruphalañca kūṭe || 13-20 ||
kānteṣu kāntāvadanāravinde suṣaṭpadatvaṃ ramaṇīvilāsam | āyuḥ kṣayodvegavināśakaraṇaṃ cākarṣaṇaṃ deśasukhaṃ dhanānām || 13-21 ||
ṭakāre dhāraṇaṃ deśe sukhaṃ śeṣe niśāmukham | videśasthadhanādīnāṃ syādāgamanamuttamam || 13-22 ||
dakūṭamadhanaṃ vinā bhavati vighnahāniḥ sadā | jayaṃ svagṛhakāmino kamalanetrakāntā yathā | susiddhakarameva hi prabalabhāvanāto bhavet | bhave jayati mānuṣastu pṛṣṭasya jijñāsane || 13-23 ||
vyākhyātaṃ munibhiḥ phalaṃ phalamayaṃ kālaṃ ripūṇāṃ sadā | lokānāṃ vaśakāraṇaṃ kulavaro vedāgame pāragaḥ | prāpnoti priyaputrakaṃ narapaterutsāhasaṃ kāraṇa| kārye durjanapīḍanaṃ bhayasamūhānāṃ vināśaṅkake || 13-24 ||
yaśasi vayasi tejo buddhireva yakūṭe | samayaphalabhūpollāsavṛddhiḥ samṛddhayā | yajanamapi surāṇāṃ cauryamātraṃ na bhūyā(--) datiśayadhanavṛddhiḥ kreyavikreyakāle || 13-25 ||
śītakāle dhanaprāptiḥ svarṇaraupyādilābhakam | putraprāptiḥ sukhaprāptiḥ saṅkaṭe vadati dhruvam || 13-26 ||
lakṣmīḥ priyaṃ dhanaṃ dātuṃ muditā bhūmimaṇḍale | jalena jāyate hānirlayaṃ deve na kūṭake || 13-27 ||
praśnādyakṣaramityādisvaramūlaṃ hi yo naraḥ | jijñāsanaṃ yadā kuryāt tadā syādutkaṭaṃ phalam || 13-28 ||
śṛṇu tattat svaraṃ nātha etatpatrasthamākṣayam || 13-29 ||
ikārakūlamaṅgale dhanāditṛṣṇayānvitoḥ | viśeṣadharmalakṣaṇaṃ dhanañca paitṛkaṃ labhet || 13-30 ||
gatipriyaṃ sudevatā susampadaṃ sadāsukham | tathā hi sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ parāstamākarodarim || 13-31 ||
īkāramaparapriyaṃ paramatadhvaṃsasaṃvarddhanam | videśagamanaṃ nahi prabhavatīha bāhyaṃ dayā || 13-32 ||
jagajjanamabhipriyaṃ taruṇadoṣasammānanam | vikārarahitaṃ sukhaṃ bhavati pṛṣṭa āvedake || 13-33 ||
e bīje baddhasantoṣaṃ kāmanāphalasiddhidam | vāyunā haraṇaṃ caiva prāpnoti nṛpamānanam || 13-34 ||
amītyekākṣare bīje bījabhūte jagatpateḥ | prāpnoti kanyādānādiphalaṃ vastrañca taijasam || 13-35 ||
gokanyāmakare khage khagacaratā saundaryalakṣmīrbhavet | śeṣe kāñcanapuñjalābhamatulaṃ santoṣasāraṃ gatau | saṃsāre nijadāyikā svajanatā ratnādikaṃ sañcaya| sarvaṃ sañcayati prabho hitakaraṃ praśnārthamādyākṣare || 13-36 ||
tṛtīyadalamāhātmyaṃ yad yad varṇe vicārayet | praśnādyakṣaravarṇeṣu nītvā ca gaganaṃ caret || 13-37 ||
tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabha premapāraga | yajjñānāt praśnasiddhiḥ syādakālaphaladaṃ nṛpam || 13-38 ||
dṛṣṭvā jñātvā bhāvarāśimuttamādhamamadhyamam | lokabhāvavidhānajño nijavidyādikaṃ tathā || 13-39 ||
sarvaṃ viṣayarūpeṇa bhāvasāraṃ vicārayet | gabījaṃ maṅgalaṃ jñeyaṃ phalamatyantabhāgyadam || 13-40 ||
gatadravyādilābhañca tathā lokavaśaṃ phalam || 13-41 ||
dakārakūṭe kaṭhinaṃ ripūṇāṃ vidrāvaṇaṃ dharmavināśakasya | bhūmipatervā maraṇaṃ vināśanaṃ divyāṅganāyā vararatnalābham || 13-42 ||
ṭakāre dūragānāñca darśanaṃ bhavati dhruvam | udvāhaḥ putrasampattiḥ ṣaṣṭhamāsena labhyate || 13-43 ||
ṭānte caurabhayaṃ nāsti taddravyāgamanaṃ bhavet | vidhividyāprakāśena śive viṣṇau ca bhaktimān || 13-44 ||
dhakārakūṭe dharaṇīpatittvaṃ vyādherbhayaṃ nāsti tathā paśośca | praveśamātreṇa gatau kalāpi jīvādisampattimupaiti lakṣmīm || 13-45 ||
rabīje siddhaḥ samyak khagakulavaro dhīragamanam | vāñchātulyaṃ vibhavamatulaṃ rājarājyapriyaṃ syāt | pratāpaṃ sāmrājyaṃ sakalahitagolokarasatā | rasaṃ sarvaṃ lokaṃ priyamatisukhaṃ lābhavividham || 13-46 ||
cakāre vahnibīje ca jitaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram | yathā krameṇa sarvatra gamane bhāgyadaṃ phalam || 13-47 ||
ṣakāramadhyame deśe vārttādeśādupaiti hi | patrikāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ yaḥ karoti dhanaṃ labhet || 13-48 ||
kṣakāre sakhyabhāvañca mitrabhāvaṃ yadā labhet | suprītiśca bhavettasmāt tadā praśnabhayaṃ na ca || 13-49 ||
svarājye ca bhavet saukhyaṃ puṣpajijñāsakarmaṇi | hasanānte tathā varṇe pācakaṃ dehi cādidam || 13-50 ||
yadi syāducyate nātha viparītaphalaṃ na ca || 13-51 ||
dīrghīkāre viṣayaghaṭanā nātha pādeḥ matiḥ syād | yadyārambho bhavati kulanaṃ dīrghajīvī narendraḥ | bālāpatyaṃ gamayati mudā kāladeśādhikārī | lokāraṇye sakalakaluṣadhvaṃsahetormṛgendraḥ || 13-52 ||
sukhañcacāra cāṣṭame mahādhaneśasannidhau | prabuddhavān bhavennaraḥ samāhito bhaved dhruvam | vicitracāturī yadā mahākucoragā prabho | prahasyate kṣaṇādapi prabhātasūryadarśanāt || 13-53 ||
atīva dhairyatāṃ labhet vicitravāgbhavejjayam | jayena sevitaṃ purā purāṇa vākyalābhaka| jagajjanādisevanaṃ labhet (vā yadi svayaṃ?) || 13-54 ||
na cākulāgamaṃ gayāgabhīratulyasatphalam | sadā hi puṇyasāgare guroḥ padāmbujaṃ labhet || 13-55 ||
visarjanīye susvare samāptikomalānvitam | janāgamaṃ dhanāgamaṃ viśālavedanānvitam || 13-56 ||
manogataṃ kubuddhidaṃ svakīyabandhusajjanam | visarjanaṃ kulakṣaṇaṃ bhavellabhet kubandhanam || 13-57 ||
sakulaṃ niṣkulaṃ kāntaṃ viduḥ śreṣṭhā maharṣayaḥ | hāsyasukhe hāsyaphalaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ bhavennahi || 13-58 ||
krodhakrameṇaiva tadaiva cakṣuṣo(--) vīkārabhāvena haret samastam | śīrṣe karau cet kalikālasaṃyuta| phalaṃ hi lābhe vadha eva bhūṣaṇam || 13-59 ||
śeṣe vedadale varābhayakare hārāvaśabdāpahā | dūrādāgamanaṃ bhaveddhi niyataṃ bālāgaṇairāvṛtam | ghorāpāyavisarjanaṃ jalaguṇāhlādena sāmodita| kūṭe kūṭaghakāravargalaharī bhāsāpabhāsārase || 13-60 ||
javarge jatukaṃ svarṇaṃ jīvanopāyacintanam | jarāvyādhisamākrāntaṃ jīrṇavastrāpahāraṇam || 13-61 ||
ṭhakārakūṭe yadi cakravartī | bhūmaṇḍale syātpatatīti niścitam | antaḥsukhaṃ hanti yadādibhāve | ṭhakāramātreṇa ripūttamo bhavet || 13-62 ||
ādyapraśnākṣaraṃ nātha takāraṃ taruṇapriyam | pāpāndhakāra paṭaladhvaṃsāya kalpayate tadā || 13-63 ||
nakāramādye yadi praśnavāgmī jijñāsamāno dhruvamarthasañcayam | ālāpamātreṇa narā vaśā syuḥ praveśanaṃ rājakulendrasannidhau || 13-64 ||
bhīto bhavati deśe ca bhayasthāne na duḥkhabhāk | bhūṣāsampattivṛddhiśca bhakārakūṭamaṅgale || 13-65 ||
lokānurāgaṃ sarvatra ādyakṣaravicārataḥ | lakārasyāpi lokeśa bhāryāduḥkhaṃ vimuñcati || 13-66 ||
sakāre maithunaṃ kāntākulasya kulavarddhanam | dhanavṛddhirvaṃśavṛddhiḥ sarasvatīkṛpā bhavet || 13-67 ||
vedapatre akārasya phalamāhātmyanirṇayam | śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā'vadhāraya || 13-68 ||
kakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ vyāpta tiṣṭhati tattvataḥ | akāreṇa vinā śaktirjjāyate kutra na prabho || 13-69 ||
akāre grathitaṃ sarvaṃ carācarakalevaram | yadyakāramādyabhāge praśnajijñāsane bhavet || 13-70 ||
kuphale'pi satphalānāṃ sañcayaṃ bhavati dhruvam | śatrūṇāṃ vāsahetordhanādīnāñcaiva sañcaye || 13-71 ||
antaryajanavidyāsu lokasyāgamane tathā | nijaduḥkhānutāpe syādyakāravidhirucyate || 13-72 ||
ukāraphalamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu praśnārthapaṇḍita | uṣākāle cauryapraśnamullāsaṃ mānasoddhamam || 13-73 ||
uttamasthalavāsañca utkṛṣṭabhojanādikam | ulbaṇābuddhirutpattirumādevīpade matiḥ || 13-74 ||
rakāralakṣaṇaṃ cakṣuḥ śabdasya vacanaṃ bhavet | locane darśanaṃ strīṇāṃ likhanaṃ dūrasambhavam || 13-75 ||
prāpnoti paramāṃ lakṣmīṃ lokavaśyāya kevalam | lāṅgalānāṃ sañcayañca bhūmilābho bhaved dhruvam || 13-76 ||
okāre rājyavṛddhiḥ syāt putravṛddhistathaiva ca | sadā santoṣamāpnoti praṇavaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 13-77 ||
