mīne karkaṭarāśivṛścikatule dharmāgnibhānūdaye | gehe vedavicāraṇe śubhaphalaṃ śrīlābhagatyunnatim | vidyāvedakathādikaṃ jayavatāmānandasindhoḥ phala| prāpnoti pratipattisiddhapadavīṃ martyo mudā harṣaṇam || 13-78 ||
patrapramāṇaṃ kathitaṃ hīnavidyāvinirgamam | punaḥ śṛṇu mahākālakalikālasya udbhavam || 13-79 ||
yadyanmāsasya prathame tathā cāhno'rbhakasya ca | daṇḍadvaye śubhaphalaṃ prathamasya maheśvara || 13-80 ||
tṛtīyaikadaṇḍamātraṃ viparītaphalapradam | tatra daṇḍeṣu nakṣatraṃ yadi cennāśubhaṃ bhavet || 13-81 ||
aśvinyādyaṣṭanakṣatraṃ pūrvaprathamapatrake | tatsutāraṃ vijānīyāt duṣṭadoṣe sukhaṃ bhavet || 13-82 ||
āśleṣābhādicitrāntaṃ dvitīye dakṣiṇe dale | tatphalaṃ viparītākhyaṃ saphale'pi phalāpaham || 13-83 ||
svātyādivasunakṣatraṃ tṛtīyādhodale likhet | tatsutāraṃ kramājjñeyaṃ nānyathāśubhamānayet || 13-84 ||
tatphalārthaṃ kutsitañca viparītaphalasthale | aśubhaṃ tatphalasthāne kuphale suphalaṃ bhavet || 13-85 ||
uttarāṣāḍhakātārādirevatyantameva ca | tatphalaṃ tu bhaved martyo yadi karmaparo bhavet || 13-86 ||
atha vakṣye mahādeva aśvinyādiphalaṃ prabho | yajjñātvā devatāḥ sarvā digvidikṣvādirakṣakāḥ || 13-87 ||
tatprakāraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ devadeva phalodbhavam || 13-88 ||
trailokye saukhyapūjāṃ tribhuvanaviditāṃ traiguṇāhlādasiddhā| siddhabhrānto viśālo varadavidalitāṃ vedanārdrāpaśaṅkām | mandānāṃ mandabhāgyopahaguṇahananaṃ hīnadīnāpadāhā| lokānāṃ satphalānāṃ phalagatavapuṣā sāśvinī sā dadau cet || 13-89 ||
evaṃ krameṇa deveśa tārakāṇāṃ phalāphalam | punaḥ punaḥ śṛṇu prāṇa(--)vallabha premabhāvaka || 13-90 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ājñācakra(--) sārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 13 ||
[atha caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi yogamārgeṇa śaṅkara | bharaṇyādisaptaviṃśān nakṣatrārthaṃ susatphalam || 14-1 ||
tatphalāphalamāhātmyaṃ sākṣātkārakaleḥ phalam | phalārthaṃ bharaṇīkṣetraṃ dharmavidyādinirṇayam || 14-2 ||
dharmacintāvinirbodhaṃ gamanābhāvamaṅgalam | makārādivarṇajātāṃ prāpnoti bharaṇīṃ bhake || 14-3 ||
kṛttikāyāṃ śādivarṇaṃ vyādhiśaṅkarasaṃkṣayam | ārogyāya dhanasyārthe tatra sūryaṃ na cācaret || 14-4 ||
yā rohiṇī dhanavatāṃ dhanahānayorna | prāṇapriyaṃ gaṇasubuddhavibuddhiśuddhim | nāgādidoṣaśamanaṃ kṣiticakramadhye | rājaśriyaṃ vibudhaśuddhimupaiti vṛddhim || 14-5 ||
gṛgendraśīrṣagāminī narendra mandire nidhi| dadāti pāpanirmale jale ghanyaśūnyake | bhayaṃ vivāhakālake kule śubhaṃ śubhekṣaṇā | svakīyakilbiṣaṃ dahedanantabuddhisañcayam || 14-6 ||
ārdrāvidrumarūpiṇī ratikalākolāhalollāsinī | sā matyārpaṇameva samprakurute kāle phalālāpanam | saukhyaṃ mukhyasamṛddhidā daradalāmbhojacchaṭālimpaṭā | sā dhīraṃ parirakṣyati pratidinaṃ śāntaṃ dṛśāntaṃ dahet || 14-7 ||
punarvasusutārikā taruṇarūpakūpā kṛpā(--) | viśiṣṭaphalabhāvanārahitacittadoṣāpahā | dhanamantaparimāṇagaṃ pracuraśokasaṅghāpahā | prarakṣati mahāgrahaḥ paramapīḍitaṃ mānuṣam || 14-8 ||
puṇyā pauṣamākaroti sahasā tejasvināṃ kāntidā | kāntāyāḥ kanakādi(--)lābhavipadāṃ dhvaṃsena vaṃśādidā | bādhāyāṃ phaladā mṛgā mṛgapaterānandatulyaṃ śriyam | kādyā pañcamavarṇajñānalalitā pātīha putraṃ yathā || 14-9 ||
etaddhi pūrvapatrānte tārā maṅgaladāyikāḥ | pratibhānti yathā cakre grahāṇāṃ bhrāmaṇe śubhe || 14-10 ||
viparītaphalaṃ nātha prāpnoti pātake bahu | puṣyāyāṃ sa bhavet krūraḥ karkaṭastho'pi bhāskaraḥ || 14-11 ||
etāsāṃ tārakāṇāñca rāśidevān śṛṇu prabho | meṣaḥ siṃho dhanuścaiva aśvinyādikadevatāḥ || 14-12 ||
yeṣāṃ rāśisthitaṃ varṇaṃ na hānivīṣayāspade | sarvatra jayamāpnoti grahe krūre'pi saukhyadaḥ || 14-13 ||
vibhinnarāśau saṃbhinno dharmanindāvivajītaḥ | svanakṣatraphalaṃ jñātvā praśnārthaṃ komalaṃ vadet || 14-14 ||
tattannakṣatrasuphalaṃ kuphalaṃ vā bhavedyadi | tadā varṇavicārañca kṛtvā puṣpaṃ tadā vadet || 14-15 ||
akṣamālākrameṇaiva tadvarṇānāṃ vicārataḥ | tattadvarṇavicāre tu yadyat saukhyaṃ pravarttate || 14-16 ||
adhike doṣajāle tu adhikaṃ duḥkhameva ca | bahusaukhyaṃ nityasaukhyaṃ prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ || 14-17 ||
etāsāṃ tārakāṇāṃ tu vārān śṛṇu yathākramam | ravyādiravivārāntaṃ tārāṇāmadhipaṃ śubham || 14-18 ||
aśubhañca tathā rudra jñātvā praśnārthamāvadet | tadvāranirṇayaṃ vakṣye pūrvapaṅkeruhe dale || 14-19 ||
ravau rājyaṃ bālakānāṃ yadi praśnaṃ priyaṃ phalam | dharmārthalābhamevaṃ hi trayoviṃśādhike nare || 14-20 ||
saṃhitaṃ paramānandaṃ yogena tattvacintanam | ityādi ravivārasya vṛddhānāmaśubhaṃ śubhe || 14-21 ||
some ratnamupaiti devakusumāmodena pūrṇa sukham | bālāyāṃ navakanyakā śubhaphalaṃ mudrāmayārtha labhet | kaivalyārthaviceṣṭanaṃ nṛpavadhūpremābhilāpaḥ sadā | vāñchā puṇyasukhāspadeṣu vimalā bhaktiśca some dine || 14-22 ||
pṛthvīputro rudhiravadano bālabālī viśeṣo | mukhyaṃ kāryaṃ dahati sahasā sāhasaṃ vāsanāyām | hanti prāyo viphalaghaṭitaṃ śokasantānasāra| mokṣaṃ puṇyaṃ ghaṭayati sadā maṅgale bhūmivāre || 14-23 ||
budhe vāramukhye mahāpuṇyapuñja| samāpnoti martyastathā durbalañca | sadā kāladoṣaṃ mahāghoraduḥkha| ripūṇāṃ dhanīnāṃ mahāvīryadarpam || 14-24 ||
surāṇāṃ devānāṃ vividha dhanalābhaṃ vitaraṇa| pratāpaṃ satkīttī kratuphalaviśeṣaṃ vidhigatam | janānāmānandaṃ samara vasagatānanda hṛdaye | pratiṣṭhā saddharmaṃ gamayati mudā vāsanagurau || 14-25 ||
mandāramālānvita dehadhārī nākasthale gacchati devaniṣṭhaḥ | hareḥ pade bhaktimupaiṃti satyaṃ prasādhanāt śukrasuvārakāle || 14-26 ||
śanaiścaradine bhayaṃ bhuvanadoṣamohānvita| kṣitipriyasutapriyaṃ paramatārakaṃ strīsukham | viśiṣṭadhananīradaṃ vayasi siddhirṛddhyarkaja| bhajanti yadi mānuṣāḥ sakalakāmanādeḥ prabhoḥ || 14-27 ||
punaśca ravivāragaṃ phalamatīva duḥkhāspada| pracaṇḍakiraṇaṃ sadā vikalalokarogāpaham | tameva paribhāvanaṃ parikaroti yo vā naro | na naśyati kadācana pracuratāpaśāpākaram || 14-28 ||
kalādharaphalaṃ śṛṇu praṇavabāhyasūkṣmāśraya| samagrakhacarāphalaṃ phalavatāṃ hi sañjñāphalam | gabhīravacanaṃ nṛpapriyakarasya rakṣākara| yadīndubhajanaṃ yadā kaliśubhādiśambho'karot || 14-29 ||
dvitīyadalamāhātmyaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍalāvṛtam | tattattārāphalaṃ vakṣye yena praśnārthanirṇayaḥ || 14-30 ||
aśleṣā bahuduḥkhavādanagataṃ vyāmohaśobhāvṛta| nānābhṛṅganiṣevaṇaṃ dhanavatāṃ hāniḥ pade sampade | bhūpānāṃ parivarjjanaṃ khalajanairācchāditaṃ tāpita| sandadyāt kṣitijātibhāti niyataṃ kolāhale nārake || 14-31 ||
maghāyāṃ maheśi dhanaṃ hanti madhye mahollāsavṛddhiṃ bhayaṃ tasya śatroḥ | kṣitikṣobhahantārametyantabhāvaṃ kukāmāturāṇāṃ sadā saṅgakāram || 14-32 ||
pūrvaphalguninakṣatre dūragānāṃ phalaṃ paṭhet | atidhairyaṃ śatrupakṣe hānayo yānti niścitam || 14-33 ||
phalamuttaraphalgunyā dīyate gatirīśvarī | yadi devaparo nātha tadā sarvatra sundaram || 14-34 ||
hastāmastakavrīḍayā śubhavilokatraye bhāgyadā | raktāṅgīgaticañcalāmalaguṇāhlādena kalyāṇadā | sā nityaṃ pradadāti rukmaśatakaṃ bhaktāya yajñāthīne | nānāvyañjanabhojanairatisukhī saṃjñāsamūhaṃ dadet || 14-35 ||
dadāti vittaṃ jagatīha citrā manorathaṃ vyākulatāmalaṅkṛtā | kadācidevaṃ hi śarīraduḥkhadaṃ na prāpnuyādīśvarabhaktimālabhet || 14-36 ||
aśleṣānātha śukro vipadamapi kadā no dadāti praduḥkha| dakṣe patre vihārottarabhayaharācaṇḍatāpaṃ na hanti | jīvaḥ śrīmānamoghāśādhanamapi vividhaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pītavarṇaḥ | pūrvāntaḥphalgunīśo vidhutanujavaro nīlavarṇaḥ svapatram || 14-37 ||
kurute bahusukhavittaṃ uttaraphalgunīnātho maṅgalena | hastāyāḥ patiścandro vibhavamanantaṃ citreśo raviḥ || 14-38 ||
adhastṛtīyapatrasya nakṣatrāṇi śṛṇu prabho | yāsāṃ vāraviśiṣṭānāṃ praśnaniṣkarṣasatphalam || 14-39 ||
svātīṃ raviḥ pāti mahogra tejasā | vināśakāle viparītabuddhidaḥ | induvīśākhāṃ sukhadaḥ sarasvatī| kujo'nurādhāṃ vipadāṃ prabādhām || 14-40 ||
budho hi pāyāt sakalārthasādhinī| tathā hi mūlāṃ sukhadāñca jīvaḥ | tadā dhanārthaṃ pradadāti śukraḥ | pūrvānvitā''ṣāḍhikayā'nvitaḥ sukham || 14-41 ||
caturthapatraṃ vāmasthaṃ mahāmaṅgalakāraṇam | atharvavedarūpaṃ tat sarvapraśnakathāvṛtam || 14-42 ||
viparīte mahaddukhaṃ varṇasaukhye'pi hānayaḥ | bhavanti tārakāṇāñca śubhadṛṣṭayā mahodayāḥ || 14-43 ||
tattārakānāthaguṇaṃ śubhāśubhaphalapradam | praśnavarṇasamūhānāṃ matamālokya nirṇayam || 14-44 ||
śaniḥ pātyuttarāṣāḍhāṃ hānirūpāṃ vipākadām | duḥkhadāridryasaṃyuktāṃ devaniṣṭhena bādhate || 14-45 ||
raviḥ prapāti śravaṇāṃ dhanādibhiḥ pradhānadevāśrayanivīkalpām | tathā dhaniṣṭhāṃ phaladāṃ sudhāṃśuḥ kujo vipattiṃ śatabhiggaṇeśaḥ || 14-46 ||
pūrvabhādrapadānātho budhaḥ kāñcanavardhanaḥ | tathā lokaṃ mahādevottarabhādrapadāpatiḥ || 14-47 ||
bṛhaspatiḥ sukhollāsaṃ revatī śastathā bhṛguḥ | dadāti paramāhlādaṃ svasva patrastharāśibhiḥ || 14-48 ||
abhijittārakaṃ pāti śaniḥ śrīmān dhanapradaḥ | phalabhāgaṃ mudā dātuṃ śanī rājamṛgāntike || 14-49 ||
taccandroccasthamiti ke vadanti paramapriyam | rāhurājā grahāḥ kṣetre abhijit kālaveṣṭitaḥ || 14-50 ||
tatkālaṃ sūkṣmatadrūpaṃ yo jānāti mahītale | sandhyākālamiti jñeyaṃ śanirāhū sukhāntayoḥ || 14-51 ||
tatsandhikālamevaṃ hi sattvaguṇamahodayam | tatkumbhakaṃ vijānīyānmadīya dehasambhavam || 14-52 ||
mahāsūkṣmakṣaṇaṃ taddhi kuṇḍalīmaṇḍalaṃ yathā | tasyāḥ prathamabhāge ca dhāraṇākhyaḥ śaniḥ prabhuḥ || 14-53 ||
svayaṃ brahmā mudā bhāti nirañjanakalevaraḥ | tasyāḥ śeṣe recanākhyaḥ saṃhāravigrahaḥ śuciḥ || 14-54 ||
rāhurūpī svayaṃ śambhuḥ pañcatattvavidhānavit | kālarūpī mahādevo vikaṭāsyo bhayaṅkaraḥ || 14-55 ||
sarvapāpānalaṃ hanti candrarūpī sudhākaraḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kālayamaḥ puṇyāpuṇyanirūpakaḥ || 14-56 ||
dvayormadhye sūkṣmarūpā taḍitkoṭisamaprabhā | mahāsattvāśritā devī viṣṇumāyāgrahāśritā || 14-57 ||
abhijittārakā sūkṣmā sandhikālalayā jayā | kumbhakākrāntahṛdayā grahacakrapurogamā || 14-58 ||
nakṣatramaṇḍalagrāmamadhyasthā tithiṣoḍaśī | asāmayī sūkṣmakalā taruṇānandanirbharā || 14-59 ||
asyā ādyabhāgasaṃstho brahmarūpī rajoguṇaḥ | asyāḥ śeṣaḥ kālarūpī tamoguṇalayapriyaḥ || 14-60 ||
candro brahmā śivaḥ sūryo mahāmāyātanūttaraḥ | ātreyī paramā śaktiḥ suṣumnāntaragāminī || 14-61 ||
madhyasthā brahmaśivayovīdhiśāstrasya siddhidā | yairjñāyate sarvasaṃsthā sarvānandahṛdi sthitā || 14-62 ||
tairānandaphalopetaiḥ sattvasambhogakāriṇī | mahāviṣṇurmahāmāyā candratārāsvarūpiṇī || 14-63 ||
muktidā bhogadā bhogyā śambhorādyā maheśvarī | ajñānāvṛtatā ghorāndhakārakālasaṃhārahaṃsinī || 14-64 ||
mandavāyupriyā yasya kalpanārthe ca vīrahā | sā pāti jagatāṃ lokān tasyādhīnamidaṃ jagat || 14-65 ||
nākāle mirayate kaścid yadi jānāti vāyavīm | vāyavī paramā śaktiriti tantrārtha nirṇayaḥ || 14-66 ||
sūkṣmāgamanarūpeṇa sūkṣmasiddhiṃ dadāti yā | narāṇāṃ bhajanārthāya aṣṭaiśvaryajayāya ca || 14-67 ||
kathitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ śiṣyāya tanujāya ca | lobhamohakāmakrodhamadamātsaryahāya ca || 14-68 ||
tatkramaṃ paramaṃ prītivardhanaṃ bhūtale prabho | ājñācakrasya madhye tu vāyavī paritiṣṭhati || 14-69 ||
candrasūryāgnirūpā sā dharmādharmavivajītā | manorūpā buddhirūpā śarīraṃ vyāpyaṃ tiṣṭhati || 14-70 ||
ājñā dvidalamadhye tu catudrdaśamudāhṛtam | vedadale vedavarṇaṃ vādisāntaṃ mahāprabham || 14-71 ||
tadagnirūpa sampannam ṛgvedādisamanvitam | śṛṇu tadvedamāhātmyaṃ kramaśaḥ kramaśaḥ prabho || 14-72 ||
[iti śrī rudrayāmale uttaratantre bhāvapraśnārthanirṇaye ājñācakrasaṅkete vedaprakaraṇe bhairavī bhairavasaṃvāde caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 14 ||
[atha pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
devakāryaṃ vedaśākhāpallavaṃ praṇavaṃ param | vadāmi paramānanda bhairavāhlādamāśṛṇu || 15-1 ||
ādyapatre akārañca ṛgvedaṃ paramākṣaram | brahmāṇaṃ taṃ vijānīyād ādyavedārthanirṇayam || 15-2 ||
vedena labhyate sarvaṃ vedādhīnamidaṃ jagat | vedamantravihīno yaḥ śaktividyāṃ samabhyaset || 15-3 ||
sa bhaveddhi kathaṃ yogī kaulamārgaparāyaṇaḥ | śrīānandabhairava uvāca brahmastotraṃ hi kiṃ devi(!) brahmavidyā ca kīdṛśī(?) || 15-4 ||
brahmajñānī ca ko vā syāt ko vā brahmaśarīradhṛk | tatprakāraṃ kulānandakāriṇi priyakaulini || 15-5 ||
vada śīghraṃ yadi snehadṛṣṭiścenmayi sundari | śrī ānandabhairavī uvāca tadeva brahmaṇaḥ stotraṃ vāyavīśaktisevanam || 15-6 ||
sūkṣmarūpeṇa magnā yā brahmavidyā prakītītā | sadā vāyū prāṇarasasūkṣmonmattaprasannadhīḥ || 15-7 ||
ekāntabhaktiḥ śrīnāthe brahmavidyā prakītītā | aṣṭāṅganyāsanihataḥ sūkṣmasañcārahṛt śuciḥ || 15-8 ||
sadā vivekamākuryād brahmajñānī prakītītaḥ | brahmānandaṃ hṛdi śrīmān śaktimādhāya vāyavīm || 15-9 ||
sadā bhajati yo jñānī brahmajñānī prakītītaḥ | vijayārasasāreṇa binā bāhyāsavena ca || 15-10 ||
vāyavyānandasaṃyukto brahmajñānī prakītītaḥ | sadānandarase magnaḥ paripūrṇakalevaraḥ || 15-11 ||
ānandāśrujalonmatto jñāto brahmaśarīradhṛk | śaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī devī jaganmātāsvarūpiṇī || 15-12 ||
prāpyate yaiḥ sadā bhaktaiḥ muktirevāgamaṃ phalam | ādyapatre pratiṣṭhanti varṇajālasamāśritāḥ || 15-13 ||
vāyavīśaktayaḥ kāntā brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalasthitāḥ | rāśinakṣatratithibhiḥ sarvadojjvalanāyikāḥ || 15-14 ||
bhavānī brahmaśaktisthā sā'vaśyamevamāśrayet | māsena jāyate siddhiḥ khecarī vāyuśoṣaṇī || 15-15 ||
dvimāse vajradehaḥ syāt krameṇa vardhayet pumān | dvimāse kalpasaṃyukto yasya sambandharūpataḥ || 15-16 ||
caitanyā kuṇḍalī śaktirvāyavī balatejasā | caitanyasiddhihetusthā jñānamātraṃ dadāti sā || 15-17 ||
jñānamātreṇa mokṣaḥ syād vāyavī jñānamāśrayet | mahābalī mahāvāggmī vardhate ca dine dine || 15-18 ||
āyurvṛddhiḥ sadā tasya jarāmṛtyuvivajītaḥ | kuṇḍalīkṛpayā nātha vinā kiñcinna siddhyati || 15-19 ||
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvarañca sadāśivaḥ | tataḥ paraśivo deva vāyavī parikalpitā || 15-20 ||
ete ṣaṭśaṅkarāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ cittasaṃsthitāḥ | sarve tiṣṭhanti patrāgre'mṛtadhārārasāplutāḥ || 15-21 ||
adhomukhāḥ sūkṣmarūpāḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhāḥ | brahmamārgasthitāḥ sarve santi ṣaṭcakramaṇḍale || 15-22 ||
ājñayā adha evaṃ hi cakraṃ dvādaśakaṃ smaret | galitāmṛtadhārābhirāplutaṃ kuṇḍalīpriyam || 15-23 ||
āgneyīṃ kuṇḍalīṃ mattvā adhodhārābhitarpaṇam | prakurvanti parānandarasikāḥ ṣaṭśivāḥ sadā || 15-24 ||
candramaṇḍalasañjātā jīvarūpadharā yathā | ātmajñānasamāśaktāḥ śaktitarpaṇatatparāḥ || 15-25 ||
dvitīyadalarūpaṃ hi yajurvedaṃ kuleśvara | akasmāt siddhikaraṇaṃ viṣṇunā parimīlitam || 15-26 ||
vajrakoṭimahādhvānaghoranādasamākulam | harimīśvaramīśānaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam || 15-27 ||
satvādhiṣṭhāna vinayaṃ caturvargaphalapradam | vāñchātiriktadātāraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yogeśvaraṃ prabhum || 15-28 ||
rādhikā rākiṇī devī vāyavīśaktilālitam | mahābalaṃ mahāvīraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 15-29 ||
pītāmbaraṃ sārabhūtaṃ yauvanāmodaśobhitam | śrutikanyāsamākrāntaṃ śrīvidyārādhikā prabhum || 15-30 ||
daityadānavahantāraṃ śarīrasya sukhāvaham | bhāvadaṃ bhaktinilayaṃ yadā sāgara candrakam || 15-31 ||
garuḍāsanasamārūḍhaṃ manorūpaṃ jaganmayam | yajñakarmavidhānajñaṃ ājñācakropari sthitam || 15-32 ||
adhaḥ parāmṛtarasapānonmattakalevaraḥ | sādhako yoganirataḥ svādhiṣṭhānagataṃ yathā || 15-33 ||
tadākāraṃ vibhāvyāśu siddhimāpnoti śaṅkara | ko vaiṣṇavo vājikaḥ ko dhāmīko vāpi ko bhuvi || 15-34 ||
ko vā bhavati yogī ca tanme vada sureśvari | ānandabhairavī uvāca śaṅkara śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kālanirṇayalakṣaṇam || 15-35 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ājñācakre phalāphalam | ājñācakraṃ mahācakraṃ yo jānāti mahītale || 15-36 ||
tasyā'sādhyaṃ tribhuvane na kiñcidapi vartate | sadā śucirdhyānaniṣṭho muhurjāpyaparāyaṇaḥ || 15-37 ||
smṛtivedakriyāyukto vidhiśrutimanupriyaḥ | sarvatra samabhāvo yo vaiṣṇavaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-38 ||
samatā śatrumitreṣu kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | yogaśikṣāparo nityaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-39 ||
yajurvedābhyāsarataḥ sadācāravicāravān | sadā sādhuṣu saṃsargo vaiṣṇavaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-40 ||
vivekadharmavidyārthī kṛṣṇe cittaṃ nidhāya ca | śivavat kurute karma vaiṣṇavaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-41 ||
yajñiko brāhmaṇo dhīro bhavaḥ premābhilāṣavān | vanastho ghoravipine navīnataruśobhite || 15-42 ||
ekākī kurute yogaṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | vāyvagnī recakaḥ sūryaḥ pūrakaścandramā tathā || 15-43 ||
jvalacchikhā sūryarūpā na ca yojanameva ca | punaḥ pūrakayogaśca candrasya tejasā haviḥ || 15-44 ||
ūdrdhvaviṣā jvaladvahnau vāyavībalacañcale | yo'niśaṃ kurute homaṃ maunī yājñika ucyate || 15-45 ||
jīvasūryāgnikiraṇe ātmacandrādyapūrakaiḥ | kāye yaḥ kurute homaṃ yājñikaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-46 ||
surā śaktiḥ śivo māṃsaṃ tadbhoktā bhairavaḥ svayam | śaktyagnau juhuyānmāṃsaṃ yājñikaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-47 ||
vidhivat kulakuṇḍe ca kulavahnau śivātmakaiḥ | pūrṇahomaṃ yaḥ karoti yājñikaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-48 ||
bhūmaṇḍale dharmaśālo nirjane kāmaveśmani | dṛḍhabhaktyā jīvasāraṃ yo japet sa hi dhāmīkaḥ || 15-49 ||
maṇau loṣṭhe samaṃ dhyānaṃ dharme'dharme jaye'jaye | kṛtvā tyāgī bhavedyastu brahmajñānī sa sādhakaḥ || 15-50 ||
sadā īśvaracintā ca gurorājñā vyavasthitiḥ | suśīlo dīnabandhuśca dhāmīkaḥ parikītītaḥ || 15-51 ||
kālajño vidhivettā ca aṣṭāṅgayogavigrahaḥ | parvate kandare maunī bhakto yogī prakītītaḥ || 15-52 ||
brahmajñānī cāvadhūtaḥ puṇyātmā sukṛtī śuciḥ | vāñchāvihīno dharmātmā sa yogī parikītītaḥ || 15-53 ||
vāgvādinīkṛpāpātraḥ ṣaḍādhārasya bhedakaḥ | ūrdhvaretā strīvihīnaḥ sa yogī parikītītaḥ || 15-54 ||
yajurvedapurogāmī yajuḥpatrasthavarṇadhṛk | varṇamālācittajāpo bhāvukaḥ sa hi yogirāṭ || 15-55 ||
māsadvādaśakagrastaṃ rāśidvādaśakānvitam | tithivāraṃ tu nakṣatrayuktamājñāmbujaṃ bhajet || 15-56 ||
dikkāladeśapraśnārthaṃ vāyavīśaktinirṇayam | bālavṛddhāstādidaṇḍapalaniśvāsasaṃkhyayā || 15-57 ||
vyāptamājñācakrasāraṃ bhajet paramapāvanam | cakre sarvatra sukhadaṃ satāṃ hānirna ca prabho || 15-58 ||
khalānāṃ viparītañca nindakānāṃ pade pade | duḥkhāni prabhavantīha pāpināñca phalāphalam || 15-59 ||
pāpī pañcattvamāpnoti jñānī yāti paraṃ padam | yaḥ śvāsakālavettā ca sa jñānī parikītītāḥ || 15-60 ||
śvāsakālaṃ na jānāti sa pāpī parikītītaḥ | yajurvedaṃ sattvaguṇaṃ sattvādhiṣṭhānanirmalam || 15-61 ||
gurorājñākrameṇaiva adhastattvena kuṇḍalīm | mahāśaktiṃ samāpnoti ūdrdhvādhaḥ kramayogataḥ || 15-62 ||
yajurveda mahāpātrasattvādhiṣṭhānasevayā | lalāṭāmṛtadhārābhiścaitanyā kuṇḍalī bhavet || 15-63 ||
vibhāvya dvidalaṃ cakraṃ homaṃ kuryādahanīśam | śuddhājyairjuhuyānmantrī adhastuṇḍe ca kuṇḍalīm || 15-64 ||
bhajanti ruddhendriyaśuddhayoga| pracaṇḍaraśmipragatāṅgasundarāḥ | āmbujaṃ cakravaraṃ catudrdala| yanmadhyadeśe śatakoṭitejasam || 15-65 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ājñā(--) cakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe vedaprakaraṇollāse bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde | pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 15 ||
[atha ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇuṣvānandarudreśa tṛtīyadalalakṣaṇam | sāmavedamadhaścakraṃ tamoguṇanirākulam || 16-1 ||
varṇajālādinākrāntaṃ rudrarūpaṃ maheśvaram | layasthānaṃ kāmarūpaṃ paramānandamandiram || 16-2 ||
vahnivṛttisusthānaṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet | tatsthānaṃ yogināṃ dharmo gurorājñāphalapradam || 16-3 ||
tatpadābjaṃ śrīgurūṇāṃ bhrūmadhye dvidalāmbuje | muhurmuhuḥ śanairdhyāyet samīrāspadabhāsvaram || 16-4 ||
vibhāvya manasā vācā karmaṇā sūkṣmavāyunā | līnaṃ kṛtvā sadā dhyāyet sadā harṣakalevaraḥ || 16-5 ||
sahasrāre yathā dhyānaṃ taddhyānaṃ dvidalāmbuje | gurumātmānamīśānaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam || 16-6 ||
akasmāt siddhidātāraṃ yogā'ṣṭāṅgaphalapradam || 16-7 ||
nityaṃ śabdamayaṃ pramāṇaviṣayaṃ nityopameyaṃ guru | candrollāsatanuprabhaṃ śatavidhūllāssāya paṅkeruham | sarvaprāṇagataṃ gatisthamacalaṃ jñānādhinirlepana | rūḍhālāsyaguṇālayaṃ layamayaṃ svātmopalabdhiṃ bhaje || 16-8 ||
yadi bhajejjagatāmamaleśvaraṃ smaraharaṃ gurumīśvaramātmani | paramasundaracandrasāmākulaṃ nipatitādyakulānalasañcayam || 16-9 ||
praṇamatāṃ samatāṃ kurute guro yadi bhavān viphalaṃ parihanti me | tava padāmbujamadbhutalīlayā paribhaje bhavasāgarapāragam || 16-10 ||
gurupadaṃ sitapaṅkajarājitaṃ kanakanūpurasundarasañjanam | racitacitritacārunakhendukaṃ bhuvanabhāvanapāvanamāśraye || 16-11 ||
sakalasatphala pālanakomalaṃ vimalaśoṇita paṅkaja maṇḍitam | padatalaṃ khanigrahapālanaṃ khacitaratnadharācalanaṃ bhaje || 16-12 ||
sukanakājaḍitāsanapaṅkaje paribhavaṃ bhavasāgarasambhavam | yadi kṛpā vibhavenmayi pāmare vyavatu māṃ tava pādatalaṃ bhaje || 16-13 ||
paramahaṃsamanuṃ hararūpiṇaṃ sakalamakṣavaśaṅgurumīśvaram | sakalalakṣaṇacandramasaḥkaraṃ tarugurormukhapaṅkajamāśraye || 16-14 ||
gurorājñācakraṃ bhuvanakaraṇaṃ kevalamaya | sakāraṃ nādendukumudahṛdayaṃ kāmakalayā | layasthāne vāyornavamadhurasamodamilite | dale vedakṣetre vidhuvirahite tatra padake || 16-15 ||
tamoguṇasamākrānte adhomaṇḍalamaṇḍite | dvibindunilaye sthāne dvidale śrīguroḥ padam || 16-16 ||
mahāvahniśikhākāraṃ tanmadhye cintayet sudhīḥ | etadyogaprasādena bījavāgbhavakūṭakaiḥ || 16-17 ||
cirajīvī bhavet kṣudro vāgīśatvamavāpnuyāt | śrīguroścaraṇāmbhojaniḥsṛtaṃ yat parāmṛtam || 16-18 ||
tatparāmṛtadhārābhiḥ santarpya kulanāyikām | punaḥ punaḥ samākuñcya prabuddhāṃ tāṃ smaret sadā || 16-19 ||
paryāyattvāpararasaṃ dhārayenmārutaṃ sudhīḥ | tatparāmṛtadhārābhiḥ santarpya kulanāyikām || 16-20 ||
tataḥ punaḥ punaḥ pātyaṃ sarvapuṇyaphalaṃ priye | dhanaratnamahālakṣmīḥ prāpnoti sādhakottamaḥ || 16-21 ||
sarvatra jayamāpnoti yuddhe krodhe mahābhaye | mahāyudhi sthito yāti suśīlo mokṣamāpnuyāt || 16-22 ||
iti te kathitaṃ nātha brahmajñānamanuttamam | ājñācakratrikhaṇḍasya dalasya kāmarūpataḥ || 16-23 ||
satphalaṃ samavāpnoti vicārya bhāvayedyadi | ājñācakre trikhaṇḍe ca kāmarūpaṃ maheśvaram || 16-24 ||
cīnācārasamākrāntaṃ śmaśānādhipaveṣṭitam | kālaṃ kālakaraṃ cakraṃ mahākālaṃ kalānidhim | palānupalavipaladdaṇḍatithyātipadapakṣakaiḥ || 16-25 ||
māsavatsarādiyugairmahākālaiḥ samanvitam | ulkākoṭisamaṃ netraṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrṃ sureśvaram || 16-26 ||
koṭikoṭinetrajālaśobhitānanapaṅkajam | cidrūpaṃ sadasanmuktirūpiṇaṃ bahurūpiṇam || 16-27 ||
dhyātvā tvatisukhenaiva kālarudraṃ pareśvaram | nāsikodrdhve bhruvormadhye ājñācakre mahāprabho || 16-28 ||
vibhāvya paramaṃ sthānaṃ tatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhavet | hākinīṃ bhāvayenmantrī rauravādivināśinīm || 16-29 ||
koṭisaudāminībhāsāmamṛtānandavigrahām | amātattvapūrṇaśobhāṃ hemavārāṇasīsthitām || 16-30 ||
nānālaṅkāra śobhāṅgīṃ navayauvanaśālinīm | pīnastanīṃ balonmattāṃ sarvādhārasvarūpiṇīm || 16-31 ||
dīrghapraṇavajāpena toṣayantīṃ trivikramam | maunāṃ manomayīṃ devīṃ sarvavidyāsvarūpiṇīm || 16-32 ||
mahākālīṃ mahānīlāṃ pītavarṇāṃ śaśiprabhām | tripurāṃ sundarīṃ vāmāṃ vāmakāmadughāṃ śivām || 16-33 ||
dhyāyedekāsane vāme paranāthasya pāvanīm | sarvādhārātmikāṃ śaktiṃ dunīvāryāṃ duratyayām || 16-34 ||
śvāsamātreṇa vasayet kulamārgaṃ na paṇḍitaḥ | kulākulavibhāgena ātmānaṃ nīyate pare || 16-35 ||
śvāsābhyāsaṃ vinā nātha aṣṭāṅgābhyasanena ca | vinā damena dhairyeṇa kulamārgo na siddhyati || 16-36 ||
tathā pūrakayogena recakenāpi tiṣṭhati | vinā kumbhakasattvena yathaitau nāpi tiṣṭhataḥ || 16-37 ||
tathā yogaṃ vinā nātha aṣṭāṅgābhyasanaṃ vinā | kulamārgo mahātattvo na siddhyati kadācana || 16-38 ||
kulamārgaṃ vinā mokṣaṃ kaḥ prāpnoti mahītale | kulamārgaṃ na jānāti yogavākyāgamākulam || 16-39 ||
sa kathaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ tasya yogaḥ kṛtaḥ prabho | ajñātvā vīranāthānāmācāraṃ yaḥ karoti hi || 16-40 ||
teṣāṃ bahudine yogaśikṣā bhavati niścitam | prāṇāyāmaṃ mahādharmaṃ vedānāmapyagocaram || 16-41 ||
sarvapuṇyasya sāraṃ hi pāparāśitulānalam | mahāpātakakoṭīnāṃ tatkoṭīnāñca duṣkṛtam || 16-42 ||
pūrvajanmājītaṃ pāpaṃ nānāduṣkarmapātakam | naśyatyeva mahādeva ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogataḥ || 16-43 ||
sandhyākāle prabhāte ca yaḥ karotyapyahanīśam | vaśī ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyābhiḥ prāṇāyāmān punaḥ punaḥ || 16-44 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ vaśī dhyāttvā khecaro yogirāḍ bhavet | yogī bhūtvā kaulamārgaṃ samāśrityāmaro bhavet || 16-45 ||
mahāvidyāpatirbhūtvā vicārāt sādhakottamaḥ || 16-46 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvārthabodhanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ājñā(--) cakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 16 ||
[atha saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
atha vakṣye mahādeva atharvavedalakṣaṇam | sarvavarṇasya sāraṃ hi śaktyācārasamanvitam || 17-1 ||
atharvavedādutpannaṃ sāmavedaṃ tamoguṇam | sāmavedādyajurvedaṃ mahāsattvasamudbhavam || 17-2 ||
rajoguṇamayaṃ brahmā ṛgvedaṃ yajuṣaḥ sthitam | mṛṇālasūtrasadṛśī atharvavedarūpiṇī || 17-3 ||
atharve sarvavedāśca jalakhecarabhūcarāḥ | nivasanti mahā vidyā kulavidyā maharṣayaḥ || 17-4 ||
samāptipatraśeṣārthaṃ samīpaṃ lokamaṇḍale | śakticakrasamākrāntaṃ divyabhāvātmakaṃ śubham || 17-5 ||
tatraiva vīrabhāvañca tatraiva paśubhāvakam | sarvabhāvāt paraṃ tattvamatharvaṃ vedapatrakam || 17-6 ||
dvibindunilayasthānaṃ brahmāviṣṇuśivātmakam | caturvedānvitaṃ tattvaṃ śarīraṃ dṛḍhaṇimītam || 17-7 ||
catuvīṃśatitattvāni santi gātre manohare | brahmā rajoguṇākrāntaḥ pūrakeṇābhirakṣati || 17-8 ||
viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇākrāntaḥ kumbhakaiḥ sthirabhāvanaiḥ | harastamoguṇākrānto recakeṇāpi vigraham || 17-9 ||
atharvavedacakrasthā kuṇḍalī paradevatā | etanmāyā tu yo naiva brahmaviṣṇuśivena ca || 17-10 ||
śarīraṃ devanilayaṃ bhaktaṃ jñātvā pravakṣyati | sarvavedamayī devī sarvamantrasvarūpiṇī || 17-11 ||
sarvayantrātmikā vidyā vedavidyāprakāśinī | caitanyā sarvadharmajñā svadharmasthānavāsinī || 17-12 ||
acaitanyā jñānarūpā hemacampakamālinī | akalaṅkā nirādhārā śuddhajñānamanojavā || 17-13 ||
sarvasaṅkaṭahantrī ca sā śarīraṃ prapāti hi | tasyāḥ kāryamidaṃ viśvaṃ tasyāḥ puṇyāni hanti hi || 17-14 ||
tasyāścaitanyakaraṇe sadā vyākulacetasaḥ | mahātmānaḥ prasiddhyanti yadi kurvanti cetanām || 17-15 ||
tasyā anugrahādeva kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale | ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena caitanyā kuṇḍalī bhavet || 17-16 ||
sā devī vāyavī śaktiḥ paramākāśavāhinī | tāriṇī vedamātā ca bahiryāti dine dine || 17-17 ||
dvādaśāṅgulamānena āyuḥ kṣarati nityaśaḥ | dvādaśāṅgulavāyuśca kṣayaṃ kuryāddane dine || 17-18 ||
yāvad yāvad bahiryāti kuṇḍalī paradevatā | tāvattāvatkhaṇḍalayaṃ bhaveddhi pāpamokṣaṇam || 17-19 ||
yadā yadā na kṣarati vāyavī sūkṣmarūpiṇī | bāhyacandre mahādeva āgneyī somamaṇḍale || 17-20 ||
mūlādhāre kāmarūpe jvalantī caṇḍikā śikhā | yadā śiromaṇḍale ca sahasradalapaṅkaje || 17-21 ||
tejomayī sadā yāti śivaṃ kāmeśvaraṃ prabhum | acyutākhyaṃ mahādevaṃ tadā jñānī sa yogirāṭ || 17-22 ||
yadi kṣarati sā devī bāhyacandre manolaye | tadā yogaṃ samākuryāt yāvat śīrṣeṇa gacchati || 17-23 ||
yadi śīrṣe samāgamyāmṛtapānaṃ karoti sā | vāyavī sūkṣmadehasthā sūkṣmālayapriyā satī || 17-24 ||
tadeva paramā siddhirbhaktimārgo na saṃśayaḥ | caturveda jñānasāraṃ atharvaṃ parikītītam || 17-25 ||
atharvavedavidyā ca devatā vāyavī matā | tasyāḥ sevanamātreṇa rudrrarūpo bhavennaraḥ || 17-26 ||
kevalaṃ kumbhakasthā sā ekā brahmaprakāśinī |
bhairava uvāca
kena vā vāyavī śaktiḥ kṛpā bhavati pārvati || 17-27 ||
sthiracetā bhavet kena vivekī vā kathaṃ bhavet | mantrasiddhirbhavet kena kāyasiddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 17-28 ||
vistārya vada cāmuṇḍe ānandabhairaveśvarī |
ānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śambho mama prāṇakuleśvara || 17-29 ||
ekavākyena sakalaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā manoniyamatatparaḥ || 17-30 ||
sa prāpnoti parāśaktiṃ vāyavīṃ sūkṣmarūpiṇīm | dhairyakṣamāmitāhārī śāntiyukto yatirmahān || 17-31 ||
satyavādī brahmacārī dayādharmasukhodayaḥ | manasaḥ saṃyamajñānī digambarakalevaraḥ || 17-32 ||
sarvatra samabuddhiśca paramārthavicāravit | śaraśayā bhūmitale vāyavīṃ paramāmṛtam || 17-33 ||
ya evaṃ pibati kṣipraṃ tatraiva vāyavī kṛpā | gurusevāpare dhīre śuddhasattvatanuprabhe || 17-34 ||
bhakte aṣṭāṅganirate vāyavī sukṛpā bhavet | atithiṃ bhojayedyastu na bhuktā svayameva ca || 17-35 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | antarātmā mahātmā yaḥ kurute vāyudhāraṇam || 17-36 ||
devagurau satyabuddhirvāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | ekakālo vṛthā yāti naiva yasya maheśvara || 17-37 ||
vāyavyāṃ cittamādāya tatrānilakṛpā bhavet | vicaranti mahīmadhye yogaśikṣānibandhanam || 17-38 ||
prāṇāyāmecchuko yo vā vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | prativatsaramānena pīṭhe pīṭhe vasanti ye || 17-39 ||
vāyavīṃ prajapantīha vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | alpāhārī nirogī ca vijayānandananditaḥ || 17-40 ||
vāyavīṃ bhajato yogī vāyavī sukṛpā bhavet | antaryāge pīṭhacakre cittamādhāya yatnataḥ || 17-41 ||
nāmaniṣṭho dhāraṇākhyo vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | paśubhāva samākrāntaḥ sadā retovivajītaḥ || 17-42 ||
śukramaithunahīnaśca vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | akāle'pi sakāle'pi nityaṃ dhāraṇatatparaḥ || 17-43 ||
yogināmapi saṅgī yo vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | bandhubāndhavahīnaśca vivekākrāntamānasaḥ || 17-44 ||
śokāśokasamaṃ bhāvaṃ vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | sarvadānandahṛdayaḥ kālajño bhautasādhanaḥ || 17-45 ||
maunadhāraṇajāpaśca vāyavī sukṛpā tataḥ | nirjanasthānanirato niśceṣṭo dīnavatsalaḥ || 17-46 ||
bahujalpanaśūnyaśca sthiracetāḥ prakītītaḥ | hāsya santoṣahiṃsādirahitaḥ pīṭhapāragaḥ || 17-47 ||
yogaśikṣāsamāptyarthī sthiracetāḥ prakītītaḥ | matkulāgamabhāvo jño mahāvidyādimantravit || 17-48 ||
śuddhabhaktiyutaḥ śāntaḥ sthiracetāḥ prakītītaḥ | mūlādhāre kāmarūpe hṛdi jālandhare tathā || 17-49 ||
lalāṭe pūrṇagiryākhye uḍḍīyāne tadūrdhvake | vārāṇasyāṃ bhruvormadhye jvalantyāṃ locanatraye || 17-50 ||
māyāvatyāṃ sukhavṛtte kaṇṭhe cāṣṭapure tathā | ayodhyāyāṃ nābhideśe kaṭyāṃ kāñcyāṃ maheśvara || 17-51 ||
pīṭheṣveteṣu bhūloke cittamādhāya yatnataḥ | udare pūrayed vāyuṃ sūkṣmasaṅketabhāṣayā || 17-52 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhe ca jaṅghāyāṃ jānuyugme ca mūlake | caturdale ṣaḍdale ca tathā daśadale tathā || 17-53 ||
dale dvādaśake caiva siddhisiddhāntanirmale | kaṇṭhe ṣoḍaśapatre ca dvidale pūrṇatejasi || 17-54 ||
kailāsākhye brahmarandhrapade nirmalatejasi | sahasrāre mahāpadme koṭikoṭividhuprabhe || 17-55 ||
cālayitvā mahāvāyuṃ kumbhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | pūrayitvā recayitvā romakūpādvinirgatam || 17-56 ||
tisraḥ koṭyardhakoṭi ca yāni lomāni mānuṣe | nāḍīmukhāni sarvāṇi dharmabinduṃ cyavanti hi || 17-57 ||
yāvattadbindupātaśca tāvatkālaṃ layaṃ smṛtam | tāvatkālaṃ prāṇayogāt prasvedādhamasiddhidam || 17-58 ||
sūkṣmavāyusevayā ca kinna siddhyati bhūtale | lomakūpe mano dadyāt layasthāne manorame || 17-59 ||
sthiracetā bhavet śīghraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | vāyusevāṃ vinā nātha kathaṃ siddhirbhaved bhave || 17-60 ||
sthiracittaṃ binā nātha madhyamāpi na jāyate | sthāne sthāne mano datvā vāyunā kumbhakena ca || 17-61 ||
dhārayenmārutaṃ mantrī kālajñānī divāniśam | ekāntanirjane sthitvā sthiracetā bhaved dhruvam || 17-62 ||
sthiracittaṃ vinā śambho siddhiḥ syāduttamā katham || 17-63 ||
nivāhya pañcendriyasañjñakāni yatnena dhairyāyatirīśvarastvam | prāpnoti māsannayasādhanena viṣāsavaṃ bhoktumasau samarthaḥ || 17-64 ||
māsatrayābhyāsa(--)susañcayena sthirendriyaḥ syādadhamādisiddhiḥ | sā khecarī siddhiratra prabuddhā caturthaye māse tu bhavedvikalpanam || 17- 65 ||
tadādhikārī pavanāśano'sau sthirāsanānandasucetasā bhuvi | prakalpane siddhiṃ yathārthagāminīmupeti śīghraṃ varavīrabhāvam || 17- 66 ||
sā vayavī śaktiranantarūpiṇī lobhāvalīnāṃ kuhare mahāsukham | dadāti saukhyaṃ gaticañcalaṃ jayaṃ sthirāśayatvaṃ sati śāstrakovidam || 17-67 ||
ṣaṇmāsayogāsananiṣṭhadehā vāyuśramānandarasāptavigrahaḥ | vihāya kalpānvitayogabhāvaṃ śrutyāgamān kartumasau samarthaḥ || 17-68 ||
sthiracetā mahāsiddhiṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ | saṃvatsarakṛtābhyāse mahākhecaratāṃ vrajet || 17-69 ||
yāvannirgacchati prītā vāyavī śaktiruttamā | nāsāgramavavāryaiva sthiracetā mahāmatiḥ || 17-70 ||
caṇḍavegā yadā kṣipramantarālaṃ na gacchati | sarvatragāmī sa bhavet tāvatkālaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 17-71 ||
yadi śīrṣādūrdhvadeśe dvādaśāṅgulakopari | gantuṃ samartho bhagavān śivatulyo gaṇeśvaraḥ || 17-72 ||
sarvatragāmī prabhavet khecaro yogirāḍ vaśī | iti siddhirvatsare syāt sthiracittena śaṅkara || 17-73 ||
yogī bhūtvā manaḥsthairyaṃ na karoti yadā bhuvi | kṛccherṇa padamāruhya prapatennārakī yathā || 17-74 ||
ata eva mahākāla sthiracetā bhava prabho | tadā māṃ prāpsyasi kṣipraṃ vāyavīmaṣṭasiddhidām || 17-75 ||
yadi siddho bhaved bhūmau vāyavīsukṛpādibhiḥ | sadā kāmasthiro bhūtvā gopayenmātṛjāravat || 17-76 ||
yadā yadā mahādeva yogābhyāsaṃ karoti yaḥ | śiṣyebhyo'pi sutebhyo'pi datvā kāryaṃ karoti yaḥ || 17-77 ||
tadaiva sa mahāsiddhiṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ | saṃvatsaraṃ careddharmaṃ yogamārgaṃ hi durgamam || 17-78 ||
prakāśayenna kadāpi kṛtvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt | yogayogād bhavenmokṣo mantrasiddhirakhaṇḍitā || 17-79 ||
na prakāśyamato yogaṃ bhuktimuktiphalāya ca | nityaṃ sukhaṃ mahādharmaṃ prāpnoti vatsarād bahiḥ || 17-80 ||
ātmasukhaṃ nityasukhaṃ mantraṃ yantraṃ tathāgamam | prakāśayenna kadāpi kulamārga kuleśvara || 17-81 ||
yadyevaṃ kurute dharmaṃ tadā maraṇamāpnuyāt | yogabhraṣṭo vijñānajño'jaḍaṃ mṛtyumavāpnuyāt || 17-82 ||
yena mṛtyuvaśo yāti tatkāryaṃ nāpi darśayet | dattātreyo mahāyogī śuko nārada eva ca || 17-83 ||
yena kṛtaṃ siddhimantraṃ varṇajālaṃ kulārṇavam | ekena lokanāthena yogamārgapareṇa ca || 17-84 ||
tathā maṅgalakāryeṇa dhyānena sādhakottamaḥ | uttamāṃ siddhimāpnoti vatsarād yogaśāsanāt || 17-85 ||
ādau vai brahmaṇo dhyānaṃ pūrakāṣṭāṅgalakṣaṇaiḥ | kuryāt sakalasiddhyarthamambikāpūjanena ca || 17-86 ||
ṛgvedaṃ cetasi dhyātvā mūlādhāre catudrdale | vāyunā candrarūpeṇa dhārayenmārutaṃ sudhīḥ || 17-87 ||
atharvānnirgataṃ sarvaṃ ṛgvedādi carācaram | tena pūrṇacandramasā jīvenāryāmṛtena ca || 17-88 ||
juhuyādekabhāvena kuṇḍalīsūryago'nale | kumbhakaṃ kārayenmantrī yajurvedapuraḥsaram || 17-89 ||
sarvasattvādhiṣṭhitaṃ tat sarvavijñānamuttamam | vāyavyāḥ pūrṇasaṃsthānaṃ yogināmabhidhāyakam || 17-90 ||
punaḥ punaḥ kumbhayitvā sattve nirmalatejasi | mahāpralayasārajño bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 17-91 ||
recakaṃ śambhunā vyāptaṃ tamoguṇamanolayam | sarvamṛtyukulasthānaṃ vyāptaṃ dharmaphalāphalaiḥ || 17-92 ||
punaḥ punaḥ kṣobhaniṣṭho recakena nivartate | recakena layaṃ yāti recanena paraṃ padam || 17-93 ||
prāpnoti sādhakaśreṣṭho recakenāpi siddhibhāk | recakaṃ vahnirūpañca koṭivahniśikhojjvalam || 17-94 ||
dvādaśāṅgulamadhyasthaṃ dhyātvā bāhye layaṃ diśet | candravyāptaṃ sarvalokaṃ sarvapuṇyasamudbhavam || 17-95 ||
recakāgnirdahatīha vāyusakhyo mahābalī | tat śaśāṅkajīvarūpaṃ pītvā jīvati vāyavī || 17-96 ||
āgneyī dahyati kṣipraṃ eṣa homaḥ paro mataḥ | etat kāryaṃ yaḥ karoti sa na mṛtyuvaśo bhavet || 17-97 ||
etayoḥ sandhikālañca kumbhakaṃ tattvasādhanam | tadeva bhāvakānāñca paramasthānameva ca || 17-98 ||
mahākumbhakalākṛtyā sthiraṃ sthittvā ca kumbhake | atharvagāminīṃ devīṃ bhāvayedamaro mahān || 17-99 ||
anantabhāvanaṃ śabhbhoraśeṣasṛṣṭiśobhitam | atharvaṃ bhāvayenmantrī śakticakrakrameṇa tu || 17-100 ||
ājñācakre vedadale caturdalasumandire | atharvayoginīṃ dhyāyet samādhisthena cetasā || 17-101 ||
tato'cyutākhyaṃ jagatāmīśvaraṃ śīrṣapaṅkaje | prapaśyati jagannāthaṃ nityasūkṣmasukhodayam || 17-102 ||
ājñācakre śodhanamaśeṣadalamatharvaṃ parikītītam | jyotiścakre tanmadhye yogamārgeṇa sadbilam || 17-103 ||
prapaśyati mahājñānī bāhyadṛṣṭyā yathāmbujam | kālena siddhimāpnoti brahmajñānī ca sādhakaḥ || 17-104 ||
tato bhajet kaulamārgaṃ tato vidyāṃ prapaśyati | mahāvidyāṃ koṭisūryajvālāmālāsamākulam || 17-105 ||
etattattvaṃ vinā nātha na paśyati kadācana | vasiṣṭho brahmaputro'pi cirakālaṃ susādhanam || 17-106 ||
cakāra nirjane deśe kṛccherṇa tapasā vaśī | śatasahasraṃ vatsaraṃ ca vyāpya yogādisādhanam || 17-107 ||
tathāpi sākṣādvijñānaṃ na babhūva mahītale | tato jagāma kruddho'sau tātasya nikaṭe prabhuḥ || 17-108 ||
sarvaṃ tat kathayāmāsa svīyācārakramaṃ prabho | anyamantraṃ dehi nātha eṣā vidyā na siddhidā || 17-109 ||
anyathā sudṛḍhaṃ śāpaṃ tavāgre pradadāmi hi | tatastaṃ vārayāmāsa evaṃ na kuru bho suta || 17-110 ||
punastāṃ bhaja bhāvena yogamārgeṇa paṇḍita | tataḥ sā varadā bhūtvā āgamiṣyati te'grataḥ || 17-111 ||
sā devī paramā śaktiḥ sarvasaṅkaṭatāriṇī | koṭisūryaprabhā nīlā candrakoṭisuśītalā || 17-112 ||
sthiravidyullatākoṭisadṛśī kālakāminī | sā pāti jagatāṃ lokān tasyāḥ karma carācaram || 17-113 ||
bhaja putra sthirānanda kathaṃ śaptuṃ samudyataḥ | ekāntacetasā nityaṃ bhaja putra dayānidhe || 17-114 ||
tasyā darśanamevaṃ hi avaśyaṃ samavāpsyasi | etat śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 17-115 ||
jagāma jaladhestīre vaśī vedāntavit śuciḥ | sahasravatsaraṃ samyak jajāpa paramaṃ japam || 17-116 ||
ādeśo'pi na babhūva tataḥ krodhaparo muniḥ | vyākulātmā mahāvidyāṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ śaptumudyataḥ || 17-117 ||
dvirācamya mahāśāpaḥ pradattaśca sudāruṇaḥ | tenaiva muninā nātha muneragre kuleśvarī || 17-118 ||
ājagāma mahāvidyā yogināmabhayapradā | akāraṇamare vipra śāpo dattaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 17-119 ||
mama sevāṃ na jānāti matkulāgama cintanam | kathaṃ yogābhyāsavaśāt matpadāmbhojadarśanam || 17-120 ||
prāpnoti mānuṣo deve manadhyānamaduḥkhadam | yaḥ kulārthī siddhamantrī madvedācāra nirmalaḥ || 17-121 ||
mamaiva sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ vedānāmapyagocaram | bauddhadeśe'tharvavede mahācīne tadā vraja || 17-122 ||
tatra gatvā mahābhāvaṃ vilokya matpadāmbujam | matkulajño maharṣe tvaṃ mahāsiddho bhaviṣyasi || 17-123 ||
etadvākyaṃ kathayitvā sā vāyavyākāśavāhinī | nirākārā'bhavat śīghraṃ tataḥ sākāśavāhinī || 17-124 ||
tato munivaraḥ śrutvā mahāvidyāṃ sarasvatīm | jagāma cīnabhūmau ca yatra buddhaḥ pratiṣṭhati || 17-125 ||
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāsau vasiṣṭhaḥ kṣitimaṇḍale | rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva sūkṣmarūpadharāvyaya || 17-126 ||
atidīnaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ māṃ sadā vyākulacetasam | brahmaputro mahādevīsādhanāyājagāma ca || 17-127 ||
siddhimārgaṃ na jānāmi vedamārgaparo hara | tavācāraṃ samālokya bhayāni santi me hṛdi || 17-128 ||
tannāśaya mama kṣipraṃ durbuddhiṃ bhedagāminīm | vedabahiṣkṛtaṃ karma sadā te cālaye prabho || 17-129 ||
kathametat prakārañca madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathāṅganām | sarve digambarāḥ siddhā raktapānodyatā varāḥ || 17-130 ||
muhurmuhuḥ prapibanti ramayanti varāṅganām | sadā māṃsāsavaiḥ pūrṇā mattā raktavilocanāḥ || 17-131 ||
nigrahānugrahe śaktāḥ pūrṇāntaḥkaraṇodyatāḥ | vedasyāgocarāḥ sarve madyastrīsevane ratāḥ || 17-132 ||
ityuvāca mahāyogī dṛṣṭvā vedabahiṣkṛtam | prāñjalivīnayāviṣṭo vada caitat kulaṃ prabho || 17-133 ||
manaḥpravṛttireteṣāṃ kathaṃ bhavati pāvana | kathaṃ vā jāyate siddhirvedakāryaṃ binā prabho || 17-134 ||
śrībuddha uvāca
vasiṣṭha śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kulamārgamanuttamam | yena vijñātamātreṇa rudrarūpī bhavet kṣaṇāt || 17-135 ||
sākṣepeṇa sarvasāraṃ kulasiddhyarthamāgamam | ādau śucirbhaved dhīro vivekākrāntamānasaḥ || 17-136 ||
paśubhāvasthiracetāḥ paśusaṅgavivajītaḥ | ekākī nirjane sthitvā kāmakrodhādivajītaḥ || 17-137 ||
damayogābhyāsarato yogaśikṣādṛḍhavrataḥ | vedamārgāśrayo nityaṃ vedārthanipuṇo mahān || 17-138 ||
evaṃ krameṇa dharmātmā śīlo dārḍhyaguṇānvitaḥ | dhārayenmārutaṃ nityaṃ śvāsamārge manolayam || 17-139 ||
evamabhyāsayogena vaśī yogī dine dine | śanaiḥ kramābhyāsād dahed svedodgamo'dhamaḥ || 17-140 ||
madhyamaḥ kalpasaṃyukto bhūmityāgaḥ paro mataḥ | prāṇāyāmena siddhiḥ syānnaro yogeśvaro bhavet || 17-141 ||
yogī bhūtvā kumbhakajño maunī bhakto divāniśam | śive kṛṣṇe brahmapade ekāntabhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 17-142 ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivā ete vāyavīgaticañcalā | evaṃ vibhāvya manasā karmaṇā vacasā śuciḥ || 17-143 ||
ādau cittaṃ samādhāya cidrūpāyāṃ sthirāśayaḥ | tato mahāvīrabhāvaṃ kulamārgaṃ mahodayam || 17-144 ||
śakticakraṃ sattvacakraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ navavigraham | samāśritya bhajenmantrī kulakātyāyanīṃ parām || 17-145 ||
pratyakṣadevatāṃ śrīdāṃ caṇḍodveganikṛntinīm | cidrūpāṃ jñānanilayāṃ caitanyānandavigrahām || 17-146 ||
koṭisaudāminībhāsāṃ sarvatattvasvarūpiṇīm | aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ raudrīṃ śivamāṃsācalapriyām || 17-147 ||
āśritya prajapenmantraṃ kulamārgāśrayo naraḥ | kulamārgāt paraṃ mārgaṃ ko jānāti jagattraye || 17-148 ||
etanmārgaprasādena brahmā sraṣṭā svayaṃ mahān | viṣṇuśca pālane śakto nirmalaḥ sattvarūpadhṛk || 17-149 ||
sarvasevyo mahāpūjyo yajurvedādhipo mahān | haraḥ saṃhārakarttā ca vīreśottamamānasaḥ || 17-150 ||
sarveṣāmantakaḥ krodhī krodharājo mahābalī | vīrabhāvaprasādena dikpālā rudrarūpiṇaḥ || 17-151 ||
vīrādhīnamidaṃ viśvaṃ kulādhīnañca vīrakam | ataḥ kulaṃ samāśritya sarvasiddhīśvaro jaḍaḥ || 17-152 ||
māsenākarṣaṇaṃ siddhidvīmāse vākpatirbhavet | māsatrayeṇa saṃyogājjñāyate sukhavallabhaḥ || 17-153 ||
evaṃ catuṣṭaye māsi bhaved dikpālagocaraḥ | pañcame pañcabāṇaḥ syātṣaṣṭhe rudro bhaved dhruvam || 17-154 ||
etadācārasāraṃ hi sarveṣāmapyagocaram | etanmārgaṃ kaulamārga kaulamārgaṃ paraṃ nahi || 17-155 ||
yogināṃ dṛḍhacittānāṃ bhaktānāmekamāsataḥ | kāryasiddhirbhavennārī kulamārgaprasādataḥ || 17-156 ||
pūrṇayogī bhaved vipraḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogataḥ | śaktiṃ binā śivo'śaktaḥ kimanye jaḍabuddhayaḥ || 17-157 ||
ityuktvā buddharūpī ca kārayāmāsa sādhanam | kuru vipra mahāśaktisevanaṃ madyasādhanam || 17-158 ||
mahāvidyāpadāmbhojadarśanaṃ samavāpsyasi | etacchrutvā gurorvākyaṃ smṛtvā devīṃ sarasvatīm || 17-159 ||
madirāsādhanaṃ karttuṃ jagāma kulamaṇḍale | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ mudrā maithunameva ca || 17-160 ||
punaḥ punaḥ sādhayitvā pūrṇayogī babhūva saḥ | yogamārgaṃ kulamārgamekācārakramaṃ prabho || 17-161 ||
yogī bhūtvā kulaṃ dhyātvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | sandhikālaṃ kulapathaṃ yogena jaḍitaṃ sadā || 17-162 ||
bhagasaṃyogamātreṇa sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | etadyogaṃ vijānīyājjīvātmaparamātmanoḥ || 17-163 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvapraśnārthanirṇaye siddhamantraprakaraṇe caturvedollāse bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 17 ||
[athāṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi asādhyasādhanaṃ param | kāmacakrasya varṇānāṃ varṇanaṃ praśnanirṇayam || 18-1 ||
ājñācakramadhyabhāge nāḍīkoṭirasālinī | tanmadhye bhāvayenmantrī kāmacakraṃ manoramam || 18-2 ||
kāmacakre ca pūrvoktavarṇamālokya sādhakaḥ | nyāsamantre puṭīkṛtya japitvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 18-3 ||
eko mandiramadhyastho mantramāśritya yatnataḥ | nijanāmākṣaraṃ tatra tatkoṣṭhamanumāśrayet || 18-4 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
eteṣāṃ koṣṭhasaṃsthānāṃ varṇānāṃ hi phalāphalam | vada kānte rahasyaṃ me kāmacakraphalodbhavam || 18-5 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
kāmacakraṃ kālarūpaṃ tato vārāṇasīpuram | tatra sarvapīṭhacakraṃ cakrāṇāmuttamottamam || 18-6 ||
etaccakraprasādena te pādāmbujadarśanam | prāpnoti sādhakān satyaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti sādhakaḥ || 18-7 ||
kāmanāphalasiddhyarthaṃ mantrārthādivicāraṇām | vṛddhamastamitaṃ tyaktvā gṛhṇīyānmantramuttamam || 18-8 ||
( ānandabhairavī uvāca ) |
śṛṇu varṇaphalaṃ nātha asādhyapraśnanirṇayam | varṇānāñca nātha rāśibhedena saṃśṛṇu prabho || 18-9 ||
bālyādiṣu sthitān vargān āśrayet sādhakottamaḥ | varjayed vṛddhabhāvañca tathāstamitameva ca || 18-10 ||
āśrayed rāśibhāvena bālyakaiśorayauvana | atha bālyaṃ vargabhedaṃ vicāre vāmayogataḥ || 18-11 ||
mantrāṇāñcāpi gaṇayet praśnakarmāṇi dakṣiṇāt | madhyakoṇāvadhiṃ nātha gaṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 18-12 ||
ūdrdhvadakṣiṇayogena gaṇayet praśnakarmaṇi | vāmayogena gaṇayed mantrādīnāṃ vicāraṇe || 18-13 ||
śṛṇu tadvargavargāṇāṃ phalamatyantasundaram | vadāmi paramānandarasasindhumadhuvrataḥ(ta) || 18-14 ||
kavargaṃ kāmākhyābhavanamaṇipīṭhe trijagatā| dharitrī sā dhātrī vasati satataṃ siddhinavake | hutāśeṣvākāśe jaladatanusākāśajananī | gabhīrā khaḍgābhā karahara(bhayavara)karā ghoramukharā || 18-15 ||
abhyāsayogāt kalikālapāvanī| kālīṃ kulānandamayīṃ rameśīm | mahārasollāsasuvaktralocanā| kāmeśvarīṃ kūrmapadaṃ(daṃ) bhajejjayī || 18-16 ||
kālāguroruttamasiddhasevitā | manoharā khecarasāraśākhinī | ulkāsamagrā bhavadīpavṛtti(--) steja(ḥ)(pra)kūṭāmalanīladehā || 18-17 ||
khaḍgāyudhā kharparadhāriṇī sā | caṇḍodgamā vāyupathastha khecarī | vidyābhayākhañjanalocanā gatiḥ | kṣitikṣaye khecaravargadhāriṇī || 18-18 ||
khārī vihārī khalakhelanena | kharākharonmattagatipriyā khagā | mahākhagārūpakhalasthitā sadā | prapāti vidyābalavikramasthitā || 18-19 ||
vyāpāranidrāgahanārthacintākharaprabhābhāti yadā yadā || 18-20 ||
gāyatrī gaṇanāyikā matigatiglāniragūḍhāśayā | gītā gokulakāminī gurutarā gārhyāgnijeyodayā | gorūpā gayahā gayā guṇavatī gāthāpathasthāyinī | śrīgurvī pratipālanaṃ trijagatāṃ gāyanti yāṃ tāṃ bhajet || 18-21 ||
vāyorgharmakarānandamohinī ghargharā ghanā | nidrāmādhyāti ghaṭanā nīlā ghoṭakavāhinī || 18-22 ||
bindusthā viṣabhojanānalakathā bījaśramāyopriyā | pañcāḍhyāmanunāsikā sukhamayī vedakriyā ṣaṇmukhī || 18-23 ||
vicitravastrācaraṇābjacālanam | vicāraceṣṭāṃ mayi dehi cañcale || 18-24 ||
iti varṇaṃ cavargasya mahāpātakanāśanam | kāmacakre sthitaṃ yadyat praśne mantragṛhe yathā || 18-25 ||
cavargaphalamatyantaniṣkarṣaṃ sūkṣmabhāvanam | dhiyā sarvākṣaraśreṇīṃ bhāvayanti punaḥ punaḥ || 18-26 ||
sarvaṃ jānāti śambho tvaṃ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi te | tathāpi vargamāhātmyaṃ kāmacakrasthanirmalam || 18-27 ||
yo jānāti kāmacakraṃ yamo hanti na taṃ janam | tatprakāraṃ bhāvayuktaṃ bhāvanādhyānanirmalam || 18-28 ||
dhyātvā kāmarūpasthā mūlādhāranivāsinaḥ | devatāḥ pāthīvāḥ sarve ātmānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 18-29 ||
na jānanti bālakā me teṣāṃ yogādisiddhaye | kāmacrakaṃ kāmarūpaṃ kāmanāphalasiddhidam || 18-30 ||
tanmantragrahaṇādeva sākṣādīśo bhavennaraḥ | śrutiśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kare tasya na saṃśayaḥ || 18-31 ||
yogaśikṣādikaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti kāmacakrataḥ | kāmacakraprasādena kāmarūpī bhaved dhruvam || 18-32 ||
tadvarṇasthaṃ tadantaḥsthaṃ daśakoṇasthameva ca | aṣṭadalasthaṃ tatrāpi vicārya sādhakottamaḥ || 18-33 ||
anulomavilomena śāstrasyānukrameṇa ca | bālyaṃ kaiśoramullāsaṃ vṛddhiḥ siddhiśca yauvane || 18-34 ||
vṛddho vṛddhatvamāpnoti aste ca nidhanaṃ bhavet | navagrahāstatra madhye pañcaprāṇāśca santi vai || 18-35 ||
anulomavilomena gaṇayeddaśakoṇake | daśakoṇe sarvasiddhiraṣṭasiddhiśca tatra vai || 18-36 ||
aṣṭapatre praśaṃsanti adho'nantamadhye gṛhe | brāhmaṇamūrdhvagehe ca mantravarṇāṃśca tattu tān || 18-37 ||
samāśritya japedvidyāṃ sūrayaḥ kramarūpiṇīm | hrasvadevīṃ hrasvabuddhiṃ dadāti sādhakāya ca || 18-38 ||
yadi krodhaparā vidyā bhakṣayet sādhakaṃ laghu | ataḥ samavayorūpāṃ devatāmaṣṭasiddhidām || 18-39 ||
devo bhūtvā yajeddevaṃ tadā mokṣaṃ samāpnuyāt | yadi varṇaṃ na jānāti kaulaputro'pyadho vrajet || 18-40 ||
ḍākinī taṃ bhakṣayati dīkṣāmantrārṇahīnakam | tato varṇavicārañca pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || 18-41 ||
cāpān dhṛtvā narendrastamapi manujakaṃ pālayantīha loke | sarva candro vighātaṃ pracuramayabhayaṃ bhāskaro hanti śokān | cāturthyā cakrapāṇeḥ padamapi capalā sandadātīha māyā(--) | yogodyogī carugatamanasā sādhakāyā''śu yogam || 18-42 ||
chatrāśā kamale sthitā sthitilaye vāñchāphalaśrīdharā | chāyāmaṇḍapamadhyagācchalagatā chatrañchaṭā tejasā | trailokyaṃ pratipāti pāśupatibhiḥ kṣetrādhipaiḥ śrīdharaiḥ | prāṇapremavihāriṇī bhagavatīcchatreṇa taṃ sādhakam || 18-43 ||
jātikhyātiranuttamā prabhavati prītāyamābhyāsatā| jīvānāmatiduḥkharāśihananāt ekārthasañcāriṇī | vajrā jīvanamadhyagā gatimatī vidyā jayā yāminī | jātā jātanivāriṇī janamanaḥsaṃhāracintāvatu || 18-44 ||
jhaṃ jhaṃtvādavivādaṃ jhaṭiti jharajharā jhārayābījajhaṅkā| gaṅgā hanti hatāśubhā dhanamukhī kaivalyamuktipradā | kṛtvā rakṣati sādhakaṃ jharajhanatkāreṇa sūkṣmānilā | kāmakrodhavināśinī śaśimukhī jhaṅkāraśabdapriyā || 18-45 ||
ñakārabījāmalabhāvasāraiḥ bāṇasya puñjaṃ pratihanti yoginī | khaḍgāyudhā sā rasapānamattā saṃhāranidrākulasādhuduḥkhahā || 18-46 ||
candrātapasnigdhasukānta vigrahā ṭaṅkāstra vajrāstrahatāripuṅgavāḥ | ṭiṃ ṭiṃ mahāmantrajapena siddhidā hanti śriyaṃ kāpuruṣasya pātakam || 18-47 ||
viśālanetrā yadi cārukāṅgī ṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ svabījaṃ paripāti kakṣarī | manogataṃ duḥkhasamūhamurvaśī ratnākarā sainyakulaṃ nihanti || 18-48 ||
ḍāmarā jagatāmādyā ḍaṃ ḍāṃ ḍiṃ ḍīṃ svarūpiṇī | kāmacakre sukhaṃ datvā sārayaivaṃ tanoti sā || 18-49 ||
ḍhaṃ ḍhāṃ bījātmikā vidyā ratnamandirasṃsthitā | ḍhakkārī pāśahastā ca sādhaka pāti sundarī || 18-50 ||
ṇaṃ ṇāṃ ṇiṃ ṇīṃ japati sujano jīvanīmadhyasaṃsthā | aṣṭaiśvaryā prabhavati hṛdi kṣobhapuñjāpahāya | vārāṇasyāṃ sakalabhayahā sandadātīha lakṣmī| sūkṣmātyantānalapathamukhī kālajālaṃ nihanti || 18-51 ||
tārārūpā tarusthā trinayana kuṭilā tārakākhyā | nihantrī tanvaśreṇī taruvarakalātrāṇahetoratītā | tālakṣetrā taḍidiva kalākoṭisūryaprakāśā | tokādīnāṃ bahalataruṇī tārakaṃ pāti bhaktam || 18-52 ||
kālakrameṇaiva vimuktidāyinī manoramā nīrajanetra komalā | sthitā kṣa(tha)kārākṣaramālinīsthalā prapāti mukhyaṃ varasādhakaṃ śivā || 18-53 ||
dālī daridrātinikṛṣṭaduḥkhahā dāntapriyā daityavidāriṇī dahā | dānasthalasthā dayitā jagatpaterdayāṃ dadāti dravadevadārā || 18-54 ||
dhātrī dharādhāraṇatatparā dhanī dhanapradā dharmagatirdharitrī | dadhāra dhīraṃ dhanabījamālinī dhyānasthitā dharmanirūpaṇāya || 18-55 ||
nandasya pratipālanāya jagatāmānandapuñjodayā | yoginyo nayanāmbujojjvalaśikhāśobhā pramālākṣarā | nītā nāvapathasthitā matimatī yāḥ pālayantīha tāḥ | pāntu śrīmukhatejasā khalu yathā kālakramāt sādhakam || 18-56 ||
pītā premavilāsinī varapathajñānāśrayā pālanāt | pūjyā pāyasapā parāparapadā pītāmbarā poṣaṇā | prauḍhā premavatī purāṇakathanā pāyāt purā pāvanī | yā kāmeśvarapāvanaṃ parajanaṃ śrī sādhakaṃ prasthitā || 18-57 ||
phutphaṇivaramālā pheravī pherurūpā | phaṇadharamukhakulyāmbhojavākyāmṛtābdhau | niravadhiharikaṇṭhe vākyarūpā phalasthā | phalagataphaṇicūḍā pātu phullāravinde || 18-58 ||
vajrākhyāṃ vaśakāriṇīṃ yadi japet śrīpādasaṃsevanāt | bālyaṃ vedavinirgatāṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīrāmadevorvvarām | vaśyā tasya karāmbuje vasati sā vīrāsanaḥsthā vaśā | vaktrāmbhoruha komale bhagavatī bhūteśvarī bhūtagā || 18-59 ||
mātā mandiramālinī matimatāmānandamālāmalā | mithyāmaithunamohinī manasi yā(jā) mi(me)lā mahanmelanī | mānī taṃ vadate maheśvaramahitvaṃ tasya vakṣaḥsthale | sthitvā sā maraṇaṃ nihanti sahasā maunāvalambī bhavet || 18-60 ||
yātapriyā yā pratibhāti yoginī | yāmāsthitā yogamukhāspadā yathā | yonisthale sā yatisādhaka| yaśoyātrā sadā pāti yamādikaṃ dahet || 18-61 ||
ratnasthā ratirājitā raṇamukhe rājñaḥ priyābhītihā(--) | rukṣmā(kyā)laṅkṛtaraṅgiṇī rasavatī rāgāpahā rogahā | rājendraṃ rajanīsthe prakupitā rādhāmṛtā pāti ta| svāhārūpamanoramā suramaṇī rāmā rakārākṣarī || 18-62 ||
lakṣmīrlāṅgalilakṣaṇā sulalanā lolāmalā nirbhayā | bālāmūlamivāsatāṃ lavaṇākulā sindhūllāsalīlākulā | lolākolakulānnajānalamukhī lagnālaghūrākulā | kaulārkākulalocanā layakarī līlālayaṃ pāti mām || 18-63 ||
viṣāsavasthānaraṇasthavāsanā | vaśyāvahantī lalanāvaśārtham | sā pāti vīraṃ yadi tāṃ bhajed vaśī | viṣāśanaṃ te nivasanti vāruṇīm || 18-64 ||
śītāṃ śaśīśoka viśeṣanāśinī| bhajet suśīlāṃ sa bhaveddavākaraḥ | śivāṃ śacīṃ śaucaśubhāṃ śavapriyā| śavasthitāṃ śītaladeśaśobhitām || 18-65 ||
ṣaṭcakre ṣaṭpadāṣāḍhī ṣaḍaṅgasthā ṣaḍānanā | ṣaṭcakre siddhidā pāti sādhakaṃ ṣoḍaśī mudā || 18-66 ||
sā mā sūkṣmā vahati sujalaṃ saptanākasthalāḍhyā | sārā sākṣāt sukhasamarasojjvālasāhlādasāmyā | sākārā sāmbujamadhugirā pūrayantī mahārthaṃ | vedā saurā suramatinivahā sāmavedāntarasthā || 18-67 ||
haṭhātkāreṇa sahārā harati prāṇahaṃ janam | nihāriṇaṃ na sā hanti hiraṇyāhāramālinī || 18-68 ||
ālokā lakṣajapadā lākṣaraṃllakṣaṇā samā | ālagdānāla sālāpā (?) pāti taṃ yo bhajellaghu || 18-69 ||
kṣayaṃ kṣitau yāti susūkṣmabhāvana| vihāya mantrī kṣayarogahāriṇī | sūkṣmātisūkṣmānyatamaṃ vicintayet | kṣobhādikaṃ pakṣakalākṣayantī || 18-70 ||
ṣoḍaśasvarabhedena phalaṃ śṛṇu mahāprabho | saṃkṣepeṇa pravaktavyamutkṛṣṭaṃ phalakāṅkṣaṇām || 18-71 ||
ślokatrayeṇa(dvayena) tatsarvaṃ phalamatyantasādhanam | ye kurvanti mahādeva kāmacakrotsavaṃ yathā || 18-72 ||
a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ | ādyāṣṭasvaramaṅgalaṃ japati yaḥ śrīnāthavaktrāmbujā| prāpya śrīdharanāyakaḥ kṣititale siddho bhavet tatkṣaṇāt | rājā rājakuleśvaro jayapathe dīpojvalāmālayā | sampaśyet paramāṃ kalāṃ jayati saḥ kāmānalaṃ tāḍayet || 18-73 ||
ḷ ḷ e e o au aṃ aḥ | śeṣāṣṭau svarapāvanī priyajanānandena mandodarī | mantraṃ hanti madānanā trijagatāṃ sādhūttamānāṃ sukham | dattvā pālayati prabhā pralayake kauṭilyavidyāpahā | bhaktaye kṣitipālanaṃ nijajapadhyānākulāmaṅgalam || 18-74 ||
iti varṇaphalaṃ jñātvā yo gṛhṇāti manūttamam | sa bhavet kulayogārthī siddhajñānī mahītale || 18-75 ||
varge varge phalaṃ nātha śṛṇu vakṣyāmi adbhutam | praśnādīnāñca kathanaṃ yo jānāti sa sādhakaḥ || 18-76 ||
kavarge kāmasampattiṃ śriyā vyāptaṃ sumandiram | prāpnoti kāmacakrārthaṃ rāśinakṣatrasammatam || 18-77 ||
cavarge dīrghajīvī syāt dṛḍhasampadameva ca | vṛttiṃ prāpnoti gamanādanuddaśya śarīriṇaḥ || 18-78 ||
samācāraṃ samāpnoti gamane sarvamuttamam | ṭavarge sambhave nātha mahaduccāṭanādikam || 18-79 ||
putrāṇāmapi vṛddhiḥ syāt tavarge dhanalābhakam | pavarge maraṇaṃ nātha yādi(--)kṣānte mahāguṇī || 18-80 ||
kāmacakraphalaṃ nātha rāśidaṇḍena yojayet | nijagehasthitaṃ rāśiṃ jñātvā hi dinadaṇḍataḥ || 18-81 ||
gaṇayitvāśubhaṃ jñānī anulomavilomataḥ | ghaṭasthaṃ sakalaṃ sandhikoṇasthaṃ pārśvake śubham || 18-82 ||
śubhamantraṃ gṛhītvā tu siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 18-83 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvapraśnārthanirṇaye pāśavakalpe kāmacakrasārasaṅkete siddhimantraprakaraṇe caturvedollāse bhairavabhairavī | saṃvāde aṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 18 ||
[athonaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
idaṃ tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sarvatantrārthagopanam | tatsarvaṃ praśnacakre ca ṣaḍādhārasya bhedanam || 19-1 ||
kālacakraphalaṃ tatra nivīkalpādisādhanam | praśnacakraṃ kāmarūpaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvadātmanoḥ || 19-2 ||
ṣaḍmandire ṣaṭkalāpaṃ kaivalyasādhanādikam | nānābhogaṃ yogasiddhiṃ hitvā yo mantramājapet || 19-3 ||
sa bhaved devatādrohī koṭikalpena sidhyati | hṛdi yasya mahābhaktiḥ pratibhāti mahodayā || 19-4 ||
kṣaṇādeva hi siddhiḥ syāt kiṃ japairmantrasādhanaiḥ | ato bhaktiṃ sadā kuryād devatābhāvasiddhaye || 19-5 ||
bhairava uvāca
etaccakraprasādena ko vā kiṃ siddhimāpnuyāt | etasya bhāvanādeva kiṃ phalaṃ bhāvanaṃ śubham || 19-6 ||
ko vā praśnādikathane kṣamo bhavati sundari | tatprakāraṃ vidhānena vada me phalasiddhaye || 19-7 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
yaḥ karoti pūrṇahomaṃ putrārthaṃ yogasiddhaye | kuṇḍalīkramayogena punaḥ punaḥ krameṇa ca || 19-8 ||
etaccakrārthabhāvajñaḥ sa eva nātra saṃśayaḥ | yaḥ karoti sadā nātha vāyunirgamalakṣaṇam || 19-9 ||
ūrdhvaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivad bhāvanāṃ kurute naraḥ | sa eva siddhimāpnoti siddhamārgo(rge) na saṃśayaḥ || 19-10 ||
phalametadbhāvanārthaṃ kāmakrodhādivajītaḥ | bhāvanāphalasiddhyarthaṃ vāyusaṃyogasaṃkramāt || 19-11 ||
lepayitvā śodhayitvā mantrayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | dharmādharmavirodhena sūkṣmavāyukrameṇa ca || 19-12 ||
prāpnoti mahatīṃ siddhimetaccakrasya tatphalam | phalañca dvividhaṃ proktaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaparasthitam || 19-13 ||
sthūlaṃ tyaktvā mahāsūkṣme mano yāti yadā yadā | tadā hi mahatī siddhiramarastatkṣaṇād bhavet || 19-14 ||
ekabāraṃ bhāvayedyaḥ siddhacakrasya varṇakān | tasyaiva bhāvasiddhiḥ syād bhāvena kiṃ na siddhyati || 19-15 ||
mahadbhāvaṃ vinā nātha kaḥ siddhiphalakagrahī | yogabhraṣṭaḥ sthūlaphale parajanmani siddhibhāk || 19-16 ||
ehike siddhimāpnoti sūkṣmaphalakrameṇa ca | yo jānāti sūkṣmaphalaṃ sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 19-17 ||
sa eva praśnakathane yogyo bhavati sādhakaḥ | yaḥ sūkṣmaphalabhoktā syāt kriyāgopanatatparaḥ || 19-18 ||
nirantaraṃ praśnacakraṃ ājñācakropari sthitam | vibhāvya kālasiddhiḥ syāt sarvajño vedapāragaḥ || 19-19 ||
kālajñānī ca sarvajña iti tattvārtha nirṇayaḥ | praśnacakrasthitaṃ varṇaṃ sūkṣmakālaphalāvaham || 19-20 ||
manorūpaṃ daṇḍabhedaṃ māsabhedaṃ savargakam | manaso bhrama evaṃ hi kāla eko na saṃśayaḥ || 19-21 ||
mṛtyu(tyṃ)vaśaṃ karotyeva kālajñānī sa yogirāṭ | kālena līyate sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 19-22 ||
kālādhīnamidaṃ viśvaṃ tasmāt kāla(lṃ)vaśaṃ nayet | tatkālaṃ sūkṣmanilayaṃ durvācyaṃ praśnakaṃ śṛṇu || 19-23 ||
meṣaṃ tulārāśimanuttamaṃ sadā | vaiśākhamāse phalasiddhikāraṇam | kavargamāvāpya svarān sa eva | vibhāvayet sa kṣitinātha ābhavet || 19-24 ||
ājñācakropari dhyātvā sarvacakraṃ mahāprabho | ekakṣaṇena siddhiḥ syāt parabhāvena hetunā || 19-25 ||
siddheśacakracaitanyaṃ yo jānāti mahītale | vāksiddhirjāyate māsāddivārātrikrameṇa ca || 19-26 ||
varṇamālāsamākrāntaṃ rāśinakṣatrasaṃyutam | grahacakraṃ bhāvayitvā sarvaṃ jānāti sādhakaḥ || 19-27 ||
ca vargaṃ vṛṣamīnasthaṃ kaiśorasiddhikāraṇam | dvimāsasādhanādeva sarvajño bhavati dhruvam || 19-28 ||
yoginī khecarī bhūtvā prayāti nikaṭe satām | grahacakraprasādena jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥ || 19-29 ||
yadi karma karotyeva ekāntacittanirmalaḥ | tasyā'sādhyaṃ tribhuvane na kiñcidapi vartate || 19-30 ||
praśnacakra prasādena sarve vai yogino bhuvi | yadi yogī bhaved bhūmau tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 19-31 ||
vinā yogasādhanena kaḥ siddho bhūmimaṇḍale | sādhanena vinā siddhiḥ kasya bhaktasya jāyate || 19-32 ||
bhaktānāṃ nikaṭe sarve pratiṣṭhanti maharṣayaḥ | ato bhaktiṃ sadā kuryāt sarvadharmān vihāya ca || 19-33 ||
tatkālaṃ bhaktimāpnoti praśnacakraprasādataḥ | tatprakāraṃ mahādharmaṃ ko vaktuṃ kṣama eva hi || 19-34 ||
kañcittadbhāvasārañca praśnacakre vadāmyaham | cavargabhāvanādeva bhaktiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 19-35 ||
samādhāya paraṃ devamājñācakropari prabho | vibhāvya nityabhāvaṃ hi prāpnoti tatkulāda(kalāma)pi || 19-36 ||
ānandāśrūṇi pulako dehāveśamanolayam | sarvakarma svayaṃ(--)tyāgī yaḥ karoti sa yogirāṭ || 19-37 ||
ṭavarge vāsanāsiddhiḥ saṃsārarahito bhavet | balavān sarvavijñānī trimāse khecaro bhavet || 19-38 ||
khecarīmelanaṃ tasya paraṃ prāpnoti cakrataḥ | ṭavargaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhanti mithunaṃ kumbhayonayaḥ || 19-39 ||
svanakṣatrasvayogañca vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet | caturmāse pūrṇayogī tavargasādhanādapi || 19-40 ||
vetālādimahāsiddhimindrasiddhiṃ samāpnuyāt | tavargaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhanti makaravṛścikakarkaṭāḥ || 19-41 ||
cirajīvī bhavedīśa indratulyapriyo bhavet | tiṣṭhet pralayaparyantaṃ mahāpralayarūpavān || 19-42 ||
kṛtvā kāla(lṃ)vaśaṃ mantrī mahāvāyau mahālayam | mahācakre sūryamadhye vahnimaṇḍalamadhyage || 19-43 ||
vāgdevatā tasya sākṣādbhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ | pavargaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhanti dhanuḥsiṃhāstu citkalāḥ || 19-44 ||
vibhāvya paramasthānaṃ sa(na) naśyati mahānilam | trailokyamaṣṭavargaṃ ca ṣaṭcakraṃ cakṣuṣā kṣaṇāt || 19-45 ||
yadi vāntaṃ brahmarūpaṃ sarvatīrthapadāśraya | mahāsattvaguṇākrāntaṃ matvā nirmalacakṣuṣā || 19-46 ||
kanyāvṛścikarāśibhyāṃ brahmamārga vilokayet | ṣaṇmāsena siddhiḥ syād mahākaulo bhaved dhruvam || 19-47 ||
maunī ekāntabhaktaḥ syāt śrīpādāmbhojadarśanam | prāpnoti sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ sāyujyapadavīṃ labhet || 19-48 ||
tato madhye pragacchanti yoginastattvacintakāḥ | śādikṣānte catuṣkoṇe sarvayogāśraye pade || 19-49 ||
vibhāvya yāti śīghraṃ saḥ śrī devīlokamaṇḍale | mahākālo bhaved dhīmān praśnacakrasya bhāvakaḥ || 19-50 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvapraśnārthanirṇaye pāśavakalpe praśnacakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe caturvedollāse bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde | ūnaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 19 ||
[atha viṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
atha vakṣye mahādeva siddhamantravicāraṇam | japitvā bhāvayitvā ca naro mucyeta saṅkaṭāt || 20-1 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
phalacakre sarvamantraṃ sarvasāraṃ tanupriyam | kriyāyogād bhavet siddhirvāyavīśaktisevanāt || 20-2 ||
vahnibījaṃ trikoṇasthaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tad bahiḥ prabho | ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaṇmanuṃ(nūn) dhyātvā ṣaṇmāsādrudrarūpiṇaḥ || 20-3 ||
aṣṭakoṇe sthitān varṇān aṅkabhedena paṇḍitaḥ | aṅkasaṃkhyākrameṇaiva dhyātvā tad bahireva ca || 20-4 ||
tatsaṃkhyāsu gatān varṇān vibhāvya khecaro bhavet | vinā trikoṇayogena ṣaṭakoṇaṃ tatra varṇakān || 20-5 ||
ājñācakramadhyadeśe kāmacakraṃ manoramam | kāmacakraṃ(kra) madhyadeśe mahāsūkṣmaphalodayam || 20-6 ||
praśnacakraṃ ṣaṭpadārthaṃ ṣaṭcakraphalasādhanam | praśnacakre phalacakraṃ yogāṣṭāṅgaphalapradam || 20-7 ||
phalacakrasyodrdhvabhāge varṇamālākrameṇa tu | tadvarṇān maunajāpena phalasāraṃ samāpnuyāt || 20-8 ||
phalacakraprasādena tattvacintāparo(rā) matiḥ | sthitvā bhū(bhrū)madhyakuhare sadā bhāvayatīśvaram || 20-9 ||
bhāvajñānī bhavet śīghraṃ mūḍho'pi bhāvanāvaśāt | ādau sūkṣmaphalaṃ vakṣye varṇabhedena śaṅkara || 20-10 ||
vahnirbhāti nirantaraṃ trijagatāṃ nāśāya rakṣākaro | jīvaḥ sarvacalā calasthadahanaṃ śrīkālikāvigrahaḥ | sarvavyāpaka īśvaraḥ kṣayati yaḥ kāmān manaḥpallava| dhyātvā taṃ samarūpavān paraśivajñānī bhavettatkṣaṇāt || 20-11 ||
vahnibījaṃ sūkṣmaphalaṃ sākṣāt pratyakṣakāraṇam | trikoṇasthaṃ vahnibījaṃ vidhividyāprakāśakam || 20-12 ||
akasmāt siddhidātāraṃ yo bhajet sa bhavet sukhī | ṣaṭkoṇasthavarṇamantrān śṛṇuṣvānandabhairava || 20-13 ||
yajjñātvā devatāḥ sarvā digvidikṣu prapālakāḥ | tadbhedaṃ ramaṇīyārthaṃ saṅketaśuddhilāñchitam || 20-14 ||
vahnibījasyodrdhvadeśe candrabījamanuttamam | tatra yo bhāvayenmantrī sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ || 20-15 ||
vidhorbījaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vimalakamalaṃ kāntakiraṇa| sadā jīvasthānaṃ pralayanilayaṃ vāyujaḍitam | tato vāme sūryaṃ sakalaviphaladhvaṃsanikara| mahāvahnisthānaṃ bhajati sujano bhāvavidhinā || 20-16 ||
tadadhaḥ koṇagehe ca śrībījaṃ pañcamasvaram | bhāvakalpalatāsāramakārādikulākṣaram || 20-17 ||
catuḥpañcāśadaṅkasthaṃ vāyubījamadhastataḥ | vibhāvya vāyavīsiddhimavāpnoti narādhipaḥ || 20-18 ||
tadaṅgaṃ dakṣiṇe nātha bhavānībījamaṇḍalam | yugmasvarasamākrāntaṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 20-19 ||
taddakṣiṇordhvakoṇe ca somabījamanuttamam | vibhāvya jagatāmīśadarśanaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 20-20 ||
tadūrdhve paramaṃ bījaṃ sākṣātkāraphalapradam | māsaikabhāvanādeva devaloke gatirbhavet || 20-21 ||
tadūrdhvakoṇagehe ca rukmiṇībījamadbhutam | sādhanādeva siddhiḥ syāllakṣmīnātho bhavediha || 20-22 ||
aṅgakrameṇa sarvatra jñeyaṃ svaravidhānakam | yena tena svareṇāpi veṣṭitaṃ phalabījakam || 20-23 ||
bhavatyeva mahādeva vāyusiddhyādikāraṇam | aṣṭakoṇaṃ(ṇa)tale nātha ṣaṭkoṇe yoni santi vai || 20-24 ||
tadbījāni satphalāni dhyātvā vāksiddhimāpnuyāt | rephodrdhve kamalābījaṃ bhāvakalpadrumākaram || 20-25 ||
sarvatra tejasā vyāptaṃ vibhāvya yoginīpatiḥ | tadadhaḥ śītalābījaṃ vāmabhāgakrameṇa tu || 20-26 ||
vibhāvya paramānandarase magno mahāsukhī | tadadhaḥ kāmabījañca kāmanāphalasiddhidam || 20-27 ||
yo japet paramānando nityajñānī ca vāyunā | tadagre vedakoṇe ca vāruṇaṃ bījamuttamam || 20-28 ||
vibhāvya bhāvako bhūtvā cirajīvī sa jīvati | tadūrdhve pañcame koṇe vajrabījaṃ vakārakam || 20-29 ||
aṣṭasiddhikaraṃ sākṣād bhajatāṃ śīghrasiddhidam | ṣaṭkoṇe ca tadūrdhve ca surabījaṃ mahāphalam || 20-30 ||
hṛdi yo bhāvayenmantrī tasya siddhiḥ pratiṣṭhitā | aṣṭakoṇasyodrdhvadeśe varṇamālāvidhiṃ śṛṇu || 20-31 ||
yena bhāvanamātreṇa sarvajño jagadīśvaraḥ | o au pavargamevaṃ hi yo nityaṃ bhajate'niśam || 20-32 ||
tasya siddhiḥ kṣaṇādeva vāyavīrūpabhāvanāt | candrabījasyodrdhvadeśe vibhāti pūrṇatejasā || 20-33 ||
ḷ e e tavargañca taddakṣiṇavidhānataḥ | tejomayī vāyuśaktirdadāti sarvamaṅgalam || 20-34 ||
ṭavargaṃ bhāvayenmantrī ṛ ṛ ḷ svarasaṃyutam | aṣṭaiśvaryapradaṃ nityaṃ kamalāsanasiddhidam || 20-35 ||
tadadho bhāvayed yastu sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ | bhavānībījarūpasya adho gehe vibhāvayet || 20-36 ||
i ī yugmaṃ cavargañca bhāvayitvāmaro bhavet | a ā i saṃyuto nātha kavargaṃ kurute jayam || 20-37 ||
bhāvayet parayā bhaktyā so'bhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt | ityetat kathitaṃ nātha phalacakraṃ ca sāradam || 20-38 ||
etaccakrabhāvanābhirmahāvidyāpatirbhavet | kāmarūpe mahāpīṭhe liṅgapīṭhe prayatnataḥ || 20-39 ||
ājñācakraṃ catuścakraṃ bhāvayitvā'maro bhavet | mahāyogī hiraṇyākṣo māsaikabhāvanāvaśāt || 20-40 ||
saptadvīpeśvaro bhūtvā ante viṣṇurbabhūva saḥ | sthiracetāḥ sa yogī syāditi tantrārthaniścayaḥ || 20-41 ||
etāni cakrasārāṇi ājñācakrasthitāni ca | vibhāvya paramānandairātmasiddhirbhaved dhruvam || 20-42 ||
sūkṣmavāyuprasādena cirajīvī bhavediha || 20-43 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvapraśnārthanirṇaye pāśavakalpe phalacakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe caturvedollāse bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde | viṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 20 ||
[athaikaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrībhairava uvāca
vada kānte rahasyaṃ me yena siddho bhavennaraḥ | tatprakāraṃ viśeṣeṇa devānāmapi durlabham || 21-1 ||
vīrabhāvasya māhātmyamakasmāt siddhidāyakam | karuṇādṛṣṭirānandā yadi cedasti sundari || 21-2 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
paramānandasārajño yogakṣetraprapālaka | rahasyaṃ śṛṇu me nātha mahākālajña bhāvaga || 21-3 ||
yogamārgānusāreṇa vīrabhāvaṃ śrayeta kaḥ | ānandodrekapuñjaṃ tat śaktivedārthanirṇayam || 21-4 ||
vedādhīnaṃ mahāyogaṃ yogādhīnā ca kuṇḍalī | kuṇḍalyadhīnaṃ cittaṃ tu cittādhīnaṃ carācaram || 21-5 ||
manasaḥ siddhimātreṇa śaktisiddhirbhaved dhruvam | yadi śaktirvaśībhūtā trailokyañca tadā vaśam || 21-6 ||
amaraḥ sa bhavedeva satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara | sahasraślokayogena vīrayogārthanirṇayam || 21-7 ||
paṭalaikādaśa kṣemayogena yogamaṇḍalam | ṣaṭcakrabodhinī vidyā sahasradalapaṅkajam || 21-8 ||
kailāsākhyaṃ sūkṣmapathaṃ brahmajñānāya yoginām | kathayāmi mahāvīra kramaśaḥ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu || 21-9 ||
vīrāṇāmuttamānāñca bhraṣṭānāṃ prahitāya ca | sākṣāt siddhikaraṃ yadyat tatsarvaṃ pravadāmi te || 21-10 ||
yogaśāstrakrameṇaiva yaḥ siddhiphalamicchati | sa siddho bhavati kṣipraṃ brahmamārge na saṃśayaḥ || 21-11 ||
brahmavidyāsvarūpeṇa japahomārcanādikam | kurute phalasiddhyai yaḥ sa brahmajñānavān śuciḥ || 21-12 ||
ṣaṭcakrabhedane prītiryasya sādhanacetasaḥ | saṃsāre vā vane vāpi siddho bhavati dhruvam || 21-13 ||
ṣaṭcakrārthaṃ na jānāti yo bhajedambikāpadam | tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti saptajanmasu siddhibhāk || 21-14 ||
jñātvā ṣaṭcakrabhedañca yaḥ karma kurute'niśam | saṃvatsarāt bhavet siddhiriti tantrārthanirṇayaḥ || 21-15 ||
prasvedanaṃ samāpnoti māsatrayaniṣevaṇāt | aṣṭamāsāt kalpa(mpa)nāśo vatsarāt khecarī gatiḥ || 21-16 ||
prasvedamadhamaṃ proktaṃ kalpa(mpa)naṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam | bhūmerutthāpanaṃ nātha khecaratvaṃ mahāsukham || 21-17 ||
dvātriṃśad granthibhedañca mūlādhārāvadhisthitam | merudaṇḍāśritaṃ deśaṃ kṛtvā brahmamayo bhavet || 21-18 ||
suṣumnā bāhyadeśe ca yad yad granthipadaṃ prabho | kramaśaḥ kramaśo bhitvā khecaro bhavati dhruvam || 21-19 ||
alpa(nya)kārye mano datvā dhyānajñānavivajītaḥ | unmattaḥ sa bhavedeva śāstrāṇāṃ yogirāḍ bhavet || 21-20 ||
himakundendudhavalāṃ bālāṃ śaktiṃ mahojjvalām | kalikālaphalānandāṃ mūle dhyātvā bhaved vaśī || 21-21 ||
mūlapadmaṃ(dme) mahājñānī dhyātvā cārucaturdale | kapilākoṭidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti yogirāṭ || 21-22 ||
mūlapadme koṭicandrakalāyuktaṃ saraktakam | galatsudhārasāmodavadanābjaṃ phalaṃ bhajet || 21-23 ||
nirmalaṃ koṭivīrogratejasaṃ brahmarūpiṇam | vāmapārśve kuṇḍalinyā vibhāvya śītalo bhavet || 21-24 ||
tataḥ śrīyāmalaṃ vīraṃ tadākāraṃ tadudbhavam | lalāṭavahnijaṃ devyā nāthaṃ bhajati yogirāṭ || 21-25 ||
tatra padmapūrvadale sindhūrāruṇavigraham | vakāraṃ koṭicapalāmālaṃ bhajati yogirāṭ || 21-26 ||
tatpārśve śoṇitadale ājñācakraṃ manoramam | yathā dhyānaṃ kuṇḍalinyā ājñācakre tathātra ca || 21-27 ||
bhūmicakrakramaṃ nātha śṛṇu śaṅkara yoginām | yaṃ dhyātvā siddhimāpnoti siddhidaṃ ṣaḍgṛhaṃ bhavet || 21-28 ||
ṣaḍgṛhaṃ trikālāgehamekatrasthaṃ mahāprabham | dhyāyed yoginīgehaṃ madhyagehe rabījakam || 21-29 ||
vakāraṃ dakṣiṇe gehe hemamālinamañjanam | ḍākinī paramābījaṃ brahmabījaṃ vibhāvayet || 21-30 ||
vakāravāmapārśve ca yogināṃ yogasādhanam | sadāśivamahābījaṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 21-31 ||
vaṃ bījaṃ vāruṇādhyakṣaṃ himakundendunirmalam | tadviṣṇorjanmasaṃsthānaṃ sattvaṃ dravamupāśrayet || 21-32 ||
tadūrdhvapūrvagehe ca laṃ bījamindrapūjitam | vidyullatāhemavarṇaṃ vibhāvya yogināṃ patiḥ || 21-33 ||
indrabījaṃ dakṣapārśve śrībījaṃ bindulāñchitam | sthiravidyullatārūpamindrāṇyāḥ sādhu bhāvayet || 21-34 ||
tadvāmapārśvabhāge ca praṇavaṃ brahmasevitam | vibhāvya koṭimihiraṃ yogirāḍ bhavati dhruvam || 21-35 ||
vaṃ bījādhomandire śrīvidyāyāḥ bījatejasam | koṭisūryaprabhākāraṃ vibhāvya sarvago bhavet || 21-36 ||
nijadevyā vāmabhāge adhaḥ kanakamandire | śrīguro ramaṇaṃ bījaṃ dhyātvā vāgbhavamīśvaram || 21-37 ||
nijadevyā dakṣapārśve dīrghapraṇavatejasam | koṭisūryaprabhārūpaṃ dhyātvā yogī bhaved yatiḥ || 21-38 ||
nijadevīṃ tatra padme manaḥsadvākyayogakaiḥ | yathā dhyānaṃ tathā maunaṃ dhyānaṃ kuryājjagatpateḥ || 21-39 ||
brahmaṇaḥ pūrakeṇaiva mahāyogakrameṇa tu | sūkṣmavāyūdgamenāpi bhūmicakre japañcaret || 21-40 ||
catuṣkoṇaṃ dharāyāstu navabhūmigṛhānvitam | aṣṭagehaṃ vibhedyādau vasuśūnye yajed yatiḥ || 21-41 ||
dharābījaṃ vāntavarṇaṃ śakreṇa paripūjitam | vibhāvya kuṇḍalītattvaṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 21-42 ||
bhajedindraṃ tatra nāke śvetakuñjaravāhanam | caturbāhuṃ devarājaṃ vidyutpuñjaṃ bhavakṣayam || 21-43 ||
ḍākinyā mandire kāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ haṃsahaṃsagam | navīnārkaṃ caturbāhuṃ caturvaktraṃ bhajed vaśī || 21-44 ||
brahmāṇaṃ ḍākinīyuktaṃ sindūrāplutabhāskaram | paramāmodamattaṃ taṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 21-45 ||
vidyullatāvadujjvalāṃ śrīdevaḍākinīṃ surāṭ | abhīkṣāṃ(kṣṇāṃ) raktanayanāṃ haṃsasthāṃ bhāvayed vaśī || 21-46 ||
haṃsodrdhve kamalābījaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam | mahālakṣmīsvarūpaṃ yattad bhajanti maharṣayaḥ || 21-47 ||
indrapṛthvībījavāme praṇavaṃ brahmasevitam | prāṇāyāmasiddhidaṃ yattad bhajanti maharṣayaḥ || 21-48 ||
tadadhaḥ prāṇanilayaṃ pretabījaṃ śaśiprabham | vibhāvya śivatulyaḥ syād bhūmicakre sadāśivaḥ || 21-49 ||
tadadho vāgbhavaṃ dhyāyet koṭisaudāminīprabham | gurubījaṃ bhūmicakre mahāvidyāgururbhavet || 21-50 ||
dakṣiṇe madhyagehe ca śrīvidyānirmalaṃ padam | vibhāvya mānasadhyānāt siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ || 21-51 ||
taddakṣiṇe śeṣagehe praṇavāntaṃ manūttamam | sarvādhāraṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivadurgāpadaṃ bhavet || 21-52 ||
etat śrībhūmicakrārthaṃ sarvaṃ caitanyakārakam | mūlādhārapūrvadale vakāraṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati || 21-53 ||
bhūmicakramaṇḍale tu vakārasthaṃ smaredyadi | brahmāṇḍamaṇḍaleśaḥ syādaṇḍaṃ vyāpyaikapatrakam || 21-54 ||
tadekapatraṃ padasya śoṇitaṃ nirmaladyutim | tanmadhyānte bhūmicakre madhye vaṃ bhāvayed vaśī || 21-55 ||
etaccakraprasādena varuṇo madirāpatiḥ | amṛtānandahṛdayaḥ sarvaiśvaryānvito bhavet || 21-56 ||
dvitīye dakṣiṇe patre vāntabījaṃ mahāprabham | mano vidhāya yogīndro dhyāyed yogārthasiddhaye || 21-57 ||
tatra dhyāyet svargacakraṃ svargaśobhāsamākulam | vibhāvya svarganāthaḥ syāddevendrasadṛśo bhuvi || 21-58 ||
pañcakoṇaṃ vibhedyāpi pañcakoṇaṃ vibhāti yat | tanmadhye vṛttayugalaṃ tatra ṣaṭkoṇagaṃ bhajet || 21-59 ||
etat svargākhyacakraṃ tu bhūpuradvayamadhyake | dakṣiṇottarapatrasthe vibhāvya vāntamīśvaram || 21-60 ||
ṣaṭkoṇāntargataṃ vāntaṃ vidyutkoṭisamaprabham | tamāśritya surāḥ sarve daśakoṇe vaśanti te || 21-61 ||
pūrvakoṇe mahendraśca sarvadevasamāsthitaḥ | indrāṇī sahitaṃ dhyātvā yogīndro bhavati dhruvam || 21-62 ||
taddakṣiṇe raktakoṇe vahniṃ svāhānvitaṃ smaret | koṭikālānalālolaṃ parivāragaṇānvitam || 21-63 ||
taddakṣiṇe kāmarūpī bhāti śaktiyutaḥ prabhuḥ | parivārānvitaṃ dhyātvā taṃ mṛtyu(tyuṃ)vaśamānayet || 21-64 ||
nairṛtaṃ vidyudākāraṃ kandarpadamanaṃ priyam | śaktiyuktaṃ svarānandaṃ vibhāvya yoginīpatiḥ || 21-65 ||
tadadho varuṇaṃ dhyātvā suśaktiparilālitam | jalānāmadhipaṃ sattvaṃ nityasattvaśriyo bhavet || 21-66 ||
tadvāme marutaḥ koṇaṃ marudgaṇavibhākaram | vāyusthānaṃ layasthānaṃ vāyuvyāptaṃ bhavet sudhīḥ || 21-67 ||
tatpaścād gaṇanāthañca mattaṃ śaktisamanvitam | parivāragaṇānandaṃ vibhāvya syād gaṇeśvaraḥ || 21-68 ||
tatpaścāt paramaṃ sthānamīśaṃ śaktisamanvitam | parivārānvitaṃ dhyātvā kāmarūpī bhavedyatiḥ || 21-69 ||
tatpaścāt koṇagehe ca candrasūryāgnitejasam | ekarūpamūdrdhvasaṃsthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhāvayedyatiḥ || 21-70 ||
indravāmakoṇagehe anantaṃ vahnirūpiṇam | anantasadṛśaṃ dhyātvā anantasadṛśo bhavet || 21-71 ||
etat svacakramadhye tu vṛttayugmaṃ mahāprabham | sarvadā vahninā vyāptaṃ jvaladagniṃ vibhāvayet || 21-72 ||
vṛttamadhye ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ koṇe koṇe ripukṣayam | lobhamohādiṣaṭkañca haret ṣaṭkoṇasṃsthitān || 21-73 ||
lobhaṃ harati indrāṇī(gnī) mohaṃ harati daṇḍadhṛk | kāmaṃ nairṛtavaruṇau krodhaṃ vāyuśca yoginām || 21-74 ||
madaṃ haredadhīśaśca brahmānantau hi yoginām | mātsaryaṃ saṃharatyeva māsatrayaniṣevaṇāt || 21-75 ||
ṣaṭkoṇamadhyadeśasthaṃ vāntabījaṃ śaśiprabham | svarṇālaṅkārajaḍitaṃ bhāvayed yogasiddhaye || 21-76 ||
sadā vyāptaṃ kuṇḍalinyā pālitaṃ maṇḍitaṃ sudhīḥ | taile yathā dīpapuñjaṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 21-77 ||
svayaṃbhūliṅgaṃ tatraiva vibhāvya candramaṇḍalam | āplutaṃ kārayenmantrī kuṇḍalīsahitaṃ vaśī || 21-78 ||
evaṃ krameṇa siddhaḥ syāt kuṇḍalyākuñcanena ca | sadābhyāsī mahāyogī saṃsthāpya vāyavīṃ tataḥ || 21-79 ||
vāyavyābhāsayuktena etaccakrāśrayeṇa ca | mūko'pi vākpatirbhūyāt phalabhāgī dine dine || 21-80 ||
tṛtīyadalamāhātmyaṃ yogijñānodayaṃ param | bhāvasiddhirbhavettasya yo bhajedātmacintanam || 21-81 ||
dalamadhye tulācakraṃ catuṣkoṇo gṛhāṇi ca | dvātriṃśad granthirūpāṇi santi granthivibhedane || 21-82 ||
tulācakrasya nāḍībhirdvātriṃśad granthibhedanam | galadeśāvadhi dhyānaṃ merumadhye prakārayet || 21-83 ||
dvātriṃśadgranthigehasya madhye vṛttatrayaṃ śubham | tanmadhye ca trikoṇe ca khaṃ mūrddhanyaṃ bhajed vaśī || 21-84 ||
etadgehe vibhāvyāni varṇajālaphalāni ca | dakṣiṇāvartayogena vibhāvya vākpatirbhavet || 21-85 ||
akāramādyagehe ca anusvāraṃ dvitīyake | visargaṃ tu tṛtīye ca yo bhajetsa bhavedvaśī || 21-86 ||
etadanyamandireṣu kādihāntaṃ vibhāvayet | vādisāntaṃ varjayitvā sabinduṃ sa bhavedvaśī || 21-87 ||
ājñācakre yathānāmaphalaṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ | varṇānāṃ mūlapadme tu tatphalaṃ hi tulāgṛhe || 21-88 ||
bhajenmadhyaṃ sakārasya trivṛttastha trikoṇake | jvālāmālasahasrāḍhyaṃ svarṇālaṅkṛtamāśrayet || 21-89 ||
pratyekavarṇapuṭitaṃ tulācake ca maunavān | maunaṃ japaṃ yaḥ karoti ṣakāraṃ vyāpya yogirāṭ || 21-90 ||
etadyogaprasādena caitanyā kuṇḍalī bhavet | vāksiddhiśca bhavettasya tāpatrayavināśinī || 21-91 ||
siddhirmantrasya varṇānāṃ japamātreṇa śaṅkara | tulācakrāntarasthānaṃ vibhāvya mantrasiddhibhāk || 21-92 ||
etaccakraṃ vinā nātha kuṇḍalī nāpi siddhyati | bhāvajñānaṃ binā kutra yogī bhavati bhārate || 21-93 ||
athānyadalamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ | yogasañcārasāraṃ yat kuṇḍalīśaktisādhanam || 21-94 ||
śaktibījaṃ binduyuktam aṣṭakoṇasthanirmalam | vidyutpuñjaṃ svarṇamālāveṣṭitaṃ bhāvayedyatiḥ || 21-95 ||
catuṣkoṇaṃ vibhedyāpi catuṣkoṇaṃ manoharam | tanmadhye ca catuṣkoṇaṃ sabījaṃ bhāvayettataḥ || 21-96 ||
koṭisūryasamāṃ devīṃ kuṇḍalīdevamātaram pādāṅguṣṭhāvadhiṃ dhyātvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 21-97 ||
yadi vāricakramadhye dhyānaṃ kurvanti mānuṣāḥ | amarāḥ sattvayogasthāḥ ṣaṭcakraphalabhoginaḥ || 21-98 ||
taccatuṣkaṃ samāvāpya vārivyāptaṃ sunirmalam | vāmāvartasthitaṃ dhyāyet saptakhaṇḍaṃ mahābalī || 21-99 ||
saptavṛttopari dhyāyed dalaṣoḍaśapaṅkajam | dale dale mahātīrthaṃ siddho bhavati niścitam || 21-100 ||
tīrthamālāvṛtaṃ nātha dalaṃ ṣoḍaśa śobhitam | tadekapatra(dma)madhye tu bhāti vidyullatānvitam || 21-101 ||
pūrvādau dakṣiṇe pātu tīrthamālāphalaṃ śṛṇu | yeṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥ || 21-102 ||
gaṅgā godāvarī devī gayā guhyā mahāphalā | yamunā koṭiphaladā buddhidā ca sarasvatī || 21-103 ||
maṇidvīpaṃ śvetagaṅgā mahāpuṇyā mahāphalā | śvetagaṅgā mahāpuṇyā bhargagaṅgā mahāphalā || 21-104 ||
svargagaṅgā mahākṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthapāraṇam | kāverī sindhupuṇyā ca narmadā śubhadā sadā || 21-105 ||
aṣṭakoṇe aṣṭasiddhiṃ vāripūrṇāṃ phalodayām | saptakoṇe saptasindhuṃ pūrvādau bhāvayed yatiḥ || 21-106 ||
lavaṇekṣusurāsapīrdadhidugdhajalāntakāḥ | sakāraṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhanti mahāsattvaṃ smared yatiḥ || 21-107 ||
madhye catuṣke śaktiñca koṭisaudāminītanuḥ | vibhāvya vāricakre tu koṭividyāpatirbhavet || 21-108 ||
śaktibījaṃ vāmabhāge ādyā prakṛtisundarī | vibhāti kāmanāśāya yoginī sā satāṅgatiḥ || 21-109 ||
śaktibījaṃ dakṣiṇe ca puṅkalā puṃśivātmakam | sadā bhāvanarūpābhaṃ yo bhajedīśasiddhaye || 21-110 ||
śaktibījasyodrdhvabhāge pūrṇacandramanoharam | bhajanti sādhavaḥ sarve dharmakāmārthasiddhaye || 21-111 ||
śaktibījatale gehe śrīsūryaṃ kālavahnijam | ulkākoṭisamaṃ dhyātvā vāñchātiriktamāpnuyāt || 21-112 ||
vāricakraprasādena cirajīvī bhavennaraḥ | bhūmau mahākālarūpī mūlādhāre catudrdale || 21-113 ||
catudrdalaśeṣadale vāricakraṃ saṣāntakam(?) | koṭisaudāminībhāsaṃ vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 21-114 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvārthanirṇaye pāśavakalpe | mūlapadmollāse bhūmicakra(--)svargacakra(--)tulācakra(--) vāricakrasārasaṅkete | siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde ekaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 21 ||
[atha dvāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca
śṛṇu śambho pravakṣyāmi ṣaṭcakrasya phalodayam | yajjñātvā yoginaḥ sarve ciraṃ tiṣṭhanti bhūtale || 22-1 ||
mūlādhāraṃ mahāpadmaṃ caturdalasuśobhitam | vādisāntaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ śaktibrahmapadaṃ vrajet || 22-2 ||
kṣityaptejomarudvyomamaṇḍalaṃ ṣaṭsu paṅkaje | krameṇa bhāvayenmantrī mūlavidyāprasiddhaye || 22-3 ||
mūlapadmodrdhvadeśe ca svādhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāprabham | ṣaḍdalaṃ rākiṇīṃ viṣṇuṃ kaṇīkāyāṃ smaredyatiḥ || 22-4 ||
ṣaḍdalaṃ bādilāntaṃ ca varṇaṃ dhyātvā surādhipaḥ | kandarpavāyunā vyāptaliṅgamūle bhajedyatiḥ || 22-5 ||
tadūrdhve nābhimūle ca maṇikoṭisamaprabham | daśadalaṃ yogadharmaṃ ḍādiphāntārthagaṃ bhajet || 22-6 ||
lākinīsahitaṃ rudraṃ dhyāyedyogādisiddhaye | mahāmokṣapadaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam || 22-7 ||
bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ daladvādaśaśobhitam | kādiṭhāntārṇasahitamīśvaraṃ kākinīṃ bhajet || 22-8 ||
tadūrdhve ṣoḍaśollāsapade sākṣāt sadāśivam | mahādevīṃ sākinīgaṃ kaṇṭhe dhyātvā śivo bhavet || 22-9 ||
viśuddhākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam | dhūmradhūmākaraṃ vidyutpuñjaṃ bhajati yogirāṭ || 22-10 ||
ājñānāmotpalaṃ śubhraṃ himakundendumandiram | haṃsasthānaṃ bindupadaṃ dvidalaṃ bhrūkuṭe bhajet || 22-11 ||
lakṣavarṇadvayāḍhyaṃ yad binduyuktaṃ manolayam | tayoḥ strīpuṃprakṛtyākhyaṃ koṭicandrojjvalaṃ bhajet || 22-12 ||
kaṇṭhe ṣoḍaśapatre ca ṣoḍaśasvaraveṣṭitam | akārādivisargāntaṃ vibhāvya kuṇḍalīṃ nayet || 22-13 ||
ājñācakre samānīya koṭicandrasamodayām | kaṇṭhādhārāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ jīvanmukto bhavediha || 22-14 ||
yadi śvāsaṃ na tyajati bāhyacandramasi prabho | bhrūmadhye candranikare tyaktvā yogī bhavediha || 22-15 ||
sūkṣmavāyūdgamenaiva tyajed vāyuṃ muhurmuhuḥ | sahasrādāgataṃ mūle mūlāttatraivamānayet || 22-16 ||
candraḥ sūrye layaṃ yāti sūryaścandramasi prabho | yo bāhye nānayet śabdaṃ tasya binducayo bhavet || 22-17 ||
yāvad bāhye candramasi mano yāti raviplute | antargate candrasūrye na tasya duritaṃ tanau || 22-18 ||
kevalaṃ sūkṣmavāyusthaṃ vāyavīśaktilālitam | mānasaṃ yaḥ karotīti tasya yogādivarddhanam || 22-19 ||
prāpte yajñopavīte yaḥ śrīdharo brāhmaṇottamaḥ | yogābhyāsaṃ sadā kuryāt sa bhavedyogivallabhaḥ || 22-20 ||
yāvatkālaṃ sthitaṃ binduṃ bālyabhāve yathā yathā | tathā tathā yogamārgaṃ bindupātānmariṣyati || 22-21 ||
tathāpi yadi māsaṃ vā pakṣaṃ vā daśabhidīnam | yadi tiṣṭhati bindūgraḥ sākṣādabhyāsato jayī || 22-22 ||
kāmānalamahāpīḍāviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣo yadā | tatkāmādisaṃharaṇe vinā yogena kaḥ kṣamaḥ || 22-23 ||
samasaṃsargagūḍhena kāmo bhavati niścitam | tatkāmāt krodha utpanno mahāśatruvīnāśakṛt || 22-24 ||
krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛtivibhramaḥ | smṛtibhraṃśād buddhināśo buddhināśād vināśanam || 22-25 ||
ataḥ sambuddhimādhārya mūlādibrahmamaṇḍale | dhyātvā śrīnāthapādābjaṃ siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ || 22-26 ||
īśvarasya kṛpācinhamādau śāntirbhaved hṛdi | śāntibhirjāyate jñānaṃ jñānānmokṣamavāpnuyāt || 22-27 ||
śāntivīdyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiriti tāḥ smṛtāḥ | caturvyūhastato devaḥ procyate parameśvaraḥ || 22-28 ||
idaṃ jñānamidaṃ jñeyamiti cintāsamākulāḥ | paṭhantyahanīśaṃ śāstraṃ paratattvaparāṅmukhāḥ || 22-29 ||
śiro vahati puṣpāṇi gandhaṃ jānāti nāsikā | paṭhanti mama tantrāṇi durlabhā bhāvabodhakāḥ || 22-30 ||
yajñopavītakāle tu paśubhāvāśrayo bhavet | yāvadyogaṃ na samprāptaṃ tāvad vīrācaraṃ na ca || 22-31 ||
ācāro vinayo vidyā pratiṣṭhā yogasādhanam | tasyaiva jāyate siddhiriṣṭapādāmbuje matiḥ || 22-32 ||
deve gurau mahābhaktiryasya nityaṃ vivardhate | saṃvatsarāttasya siddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 22-33 ||
vedāgamapurāṇānāṃ sāramālokya yatnataḥ | manaḥ saṃsthāpayediṣṭapādāmbhoruhamaṇḍale || 22-34 ||
cetasi kṣetrakamale ṣaṭcakre yoganirmale | mano nidhāya maunī yaḥ sa bhaved yogavallabhaḥ || 22-35 ||
manaḥ karoti karmāṇi mano lipyati pātake | manaḥsaṃyamanī bhūtvā pāpapuṇyairna lipyate || 22-36 ||
śrī bhairava uvāca
vada kānte rahasyaṃ me yena siddho bhavennaraḥ | tatprakāraṃ viśeṣeṇa yogināmapyagocaram || 22-37 ||
yatraiva gopayedyadyadānandena nirīkṣayet | pūjayed bhāvayeccaiva varjayenna jugupsayet || 22-38 ||
krameṇa vada tattvañca yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati | na jñātvāpi ca bhūtattvaṃ yogī mohāśrito bhavet || 22-39 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
trailokye yogayogyo'si ṣaṭcakrabhedane rataḥ | tvameva paramānanda mahādhiṣṭhānanirmala || 22-40 ||
saṅghātayenmahāvīra etāndoṣān mahābhayān | kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryasañjñakān || 22-41 ||
saṅghātayenmahāvīro vikāraṃ cendriyodbhavam | nidrā(--)lajjā(--)daurmanasyaṃ daśakālānalān prabho || 22-42 ||
saṅgopayenmahāvīro mahāmantraṃ kulakriyām | mudrākṣasūtratantrārthaṃ gopināṃ vīrasaṅgamam || 22-43 ||
atyācāraṃ bhairavāṇāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sādhanam | nāḍīgrathanamānañca gopayenmātṛjāravat || 22-44 ||
na nindet prāṇanidhane devatāṃ gurumīśvaram | surāṃ vidyāṃ mahākṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ yogādhikāriṇam || 22-45 ||
yoginī jaḍamunmattaṃ janmakarmakulakriyām | prayoge dharmakartāraṃ na nindet prāṇasaṃsthitau || 22-46 ||
patnīṃ bhrātṛvadhūñcaiva bauddhācārañca yoginīm | karma śubhāśubhañcaiva mahāvīro na nindayet || 22-47 ||
nirīkṣayenna kadāpi kanyāyoniṃ dine ratim | paśukrīḍāṃ digvasanāṃ kāminīṃ prakaṭastanīm || 22-48 ||
vigrahaṃ dyūtapāśārthaṃ klībaṃ viṣṭhādikaṃ śucau | abhicārabhārañca kriyāmapramattasya nekṣayet || 22-49 ||
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā devatāṃ gurumīśvaram | śaktiṃ sādhumātmarūpaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaṃ prayatnataḥ || 22-50 ||
atithiṃ mātaraṃ siddhaṃ pitaraṃ yoginaṃ tathā | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā siddhamantraṃ susiddhaye || 22-51 ||
bhāvayedekacittena sādhūktaṃ yogasādhanam | gurorvākyopadeśaṃ ca svadharmaṃ tīrthadevatām || 22-52 ||
kulācāraṃ vīramantramātmānaṃ parameṣṭhinam | bhāvayedvidhividyāṃ ca tantrasiddhārthanirṇayam || 22-53 ||
varjayet sādhakaśreṣṭho'gamyāgamanādikam | dhūrtasaṅgaṃ vañcakañca pralāpamanṛtāśubham || 22-54 ||
varjayet pāpagoṣṭhīyamālasyaṃ bahujalpanam | avedakarmasañcāraṃ gosavaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca || 22-55 ||
jugupsayenna kadāpi viṇmūtraṃ kledaśoṇitam | hīnāṅgīṃ piśitaṃ nātha kapālāharaṇādikam || 22-56 ||
surāṃ gopālanañcaiva nijapāpaṃ riporbhayam | jugupsayenna sudharmmaṃ yadi siddhimihecchati || 22-57 ||
samayācāramevedaṃ yogināṃ vīrabhāvinām | gurvājñayā yaḥ karoti jīvanmukto bhaved bhuvi || 22-58 ||
vṛthā dharma vṛthā caryaṃ vṛthā dīkṣā vṛthā tapaḥ | vṛthā sukṛtamākhyeti gurvājñālaṅghanaṃ nṛṇām || 22-59 ||
