brāhmaṇakṣatriyādīnāmādau yogādisādhanam | paścāt kulakriyā nātha yogavidyāprasiddhaye || 22-60 ||
vinā bhāvena vīreṇa pūrṇayogī kuto bhavet | ādau kuryāt paśorbhāvaṃ paścāt kulavicāraṇam || 22-61 ||
mama tantre mahādeva kevalaṃ sāranirṇayam | akasmād bhaktisiddhyarthaṃ kulācāraṃ ca yoginām || 22-62 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ kulācāraṃ kevalaṃ jñānasiddhaye | jñānena jāyate yogī yogādamaravigrahaḥ || 22-63 ||
bhūtvā yogī kulīnaśca yogābhyāsamahanīśam | ṣaṭcakraṃ bhūtanilayaṃ bhāvayed bhāvasiddhaye || 22-64 ||
mūlapadmasyodrdhvadeśe liṅgamūle mahāśuciḥ | svādhiṣṭhāne mahāpadmaṃ paddale vāyunā yajet || 22-65 ||
etat ṣaḍdalavarṇānāṃ bhāvanāṃ yaḥ karoti hi | tasya sākṣād bhavedviṣṇuḥ rākiṇīsahitaḥ prabho || 22-66 ||
svādhiṣṭhānaṣaḍdalasya kaṇīkāmadhyamaṇḍale | dalāṣṭakaṃ bhāvayitvā nāgayuktaṃ sa īśvaraḥ || 22-67 ||
aṣṭau nāgā aṣṭadale pratibhānti yathāruṇāḥ | jalasyopari padme ca dhyāyettannāgavallabhām || 22-68 ||
anantaṃ vāsukiṃ padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ ca takṣakam | kulīraṃ karkaṭaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇādau dale bhajet || 22-69 ||
aṣṭadalopari dhyāyet kaṇīkāvṛttayugmakam | tadūrdhve ṣaḍdalaṃ vādilāntayuktaṃ sabindukam || 22-70 ||
pūrvādikramayogena dakṣiṇāvarttavāyunā | punaḥ punaḥ kumbhayitvā dhyāyet ṣaḍvarṇavāyavīm || 22-71 ||
keśaraṃ yugalaṃ dhyāyet kulordhve sākṛtiṃ mudā | aṣṭadale ṣaḍdale ca vibhāvya yogirāḍ bhavet || 22-72 ||
aṣṭadalasyordhvadeśe vṛttayugmaṃ manoharam | tasyopari punardhyāyet ṣaḍdale vādilāntakam || 22-73 ||
dalāṣṭakādho dhyāyedyo vṛttayugmaṃ manoharam | vṛttādhomaṇḍalākāraṃ vaṃ bījaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati || 22-74 ||
vṛttalagnaṃ samāvyāptaṃ yaṃ bījaṃ vidyudākaram | koṭisūryasamābhāsaṃ vibhāvya yogināṃ patiḥ || 22-75 ||
yāntabījakalānāṃ tu adhaḥ ṣaṭkoṇamaṇḍalam | ṣaṭkoṇe dakṣiṇādau ca bhāvayed yādilāntakam || 22-76 ||
tatṣaṭkoṇamadhyadeśe ṣaṭkoṇaṃ dhūmra maṇḍalam | tatkoṇe dakṣiṇādau ca dravyādiṣaṭkamāśrayet || 22-77 ||
dravyaṃ guṇāstathā karma sāmānyaṃ saviśeṣakam | samavāyaṃ krameṇaiva ṣaṭkoṇeṣu vibhāvayet || 22-78 ||
pūrvādikramayogena dakṣiṇāvartavāyunā | sarvatra bhāvayenmantrī kumbhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 22-79 ||
dravyaṣaṭkoṇamadhye tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ cārutejasam | koṇe koṇe ca ṣaḍvargān bhāvayet sthiracañcalān || 22-80 ||
tanmadhye ca trikoṇe ca rākiṇīsahitaṃ harim | koṭicandramarīcisthaṃ dhyāyedyogī viśāladhīḥ || 22-81 ||
ṣaḍdalāntargataṃ padmaṃ yogināmapi sādhanam | yo nityaṃ kurute'bhyāsaṃ tasya yogaḥ prasiddhyati || 22-82 ||
etaccakraprasādena nīrogī nirahaṅkṛtaḥ | sarvajño bhavati kṣipraṃ śrīnāthapadabhāvanāt || 22-83 ||
jyotīrūpaṃ yogamārgaṃ sūkṣmātisūkṣmanirmalam | trailokyakāmanāsiddhiṃ ṣaṭcakre bhāvayeddharim || 22-84 ||
yo hariḥ śeṣaśambhuśca yaḥ śambhuḥ sūkṣmarūpadhṛk | sūkṣmarūpasthito brahmā brahmādhīnamidaṃ jagat || 22-85 ||
ekamūtīstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇupitāmahāḥ | mama vigrahasṃśliṣṭāḥ sṛjatyavati hanti ca || 22-86 ||
prāṇāyāmodgatā ete yogavighnakarāḥ sadā | prāṇāyāmena niṣpīḍya prasabhaṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 22-87 ||
akāraṃ brahmaṇo varṇaṃ śabdarūpaṃ mahāprabham | praṇavāntargataṃ nityaṃ yogapūrakamāśrayet || 22-88 ||
ukāraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ varṇaṃ śabdabhedinamīśvaram | praṇavāntargataṃ sattvaṃ yogakumbhakamāśrayet || 22-89 ||
makāraṃ śāmbhavaṃ rūpaṃ bījabhūtaṃ vidhūdgatam | praṇavāntasthitaṃ kālaṃ layasthānaṃ samāśrayet || 22-90 ||
varṇatrayavibhāgena praṇavaṃ parikalpitam | praṇavājjāyate haṃso haṃsaḥ so'haṃ paro bhavet || 22-91 ||
so'haṃ jñānaṃ mahājñānaṃ yogināmapi durlabham | nirantaraṃ bhāvayedyaḥ sa eva paramo bhavet || 22-92 ||
haṃ pumān śvāsarūpeṇa candreṇa prakṛtistu saḥ | etaddhaṃsaṃ vijānīyāt sūryamaṇḍalabhedakam || 22-93 ||
viparītakrameṇaiva so'haṃ jñānaṃ yadā bhavet | tadaiva sūryagaḥ siddhaḥ svadhāsvaraprapūjitaḥ || 22-94 ||
hakārārṇaṃ sakārārṇaṃ lopayitvā tataḥ param | sandhiṃ kuryāttataḥ paścāt praṇavo'sau mahāmanuḥ || 22-95 ||
etad haṃsaṃ mahāmantraṃ svādhiṣṭhāne manogṛhe | manorūpaṃ bhajedyastu sa bhavet sūryamadhyagaḥ || 22-96 ||
haṃsaṃ sūrya vijānīyāt so'haṃ candro na saṃśayaḥ | viparīto yadā bhūyāttadaiva mokṣabhāg bhavet || 22-97 ||
yadi haṃsamanorūpaṃ svādhiṣṭhāne hareḥ pade | vibhāvya śrīguroḥ pāde nīyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 22-98 ||
so'haṃ yadā śaktikūṭaṃ akārākārasampuṭam | kṛtvā japati yo jñānī sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ || 22-99 ||
japahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ haṃsena yaḥ karoti hi | tadaiva candrasūrya syāt haṃsamantraprasādataḥ || 22-100 ||
etajjapaṃ mahādeva dehamadhye karomyaham | ekaviṃśasahasrāṇi ṣaṭśatāni ca haṃmanuḥ || 22-101 ||
puṃrūpeṇa hakārañca strīrūpeṇa sakārakam | japtvā rakṣāṃ karotīha candrabinduśatena ca || 22-102 ||
praṇavāntaṃ mahāmantraṃ nityaṃ japati yo naraḥ | vāyusiddhirbhavettasya vāyavī sukṛpā bhavet || 22-103 ||
bṛhad haṃsaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena siddho bhavennaraḥ | kāmarūpī kṣaṇādeva vāksiddhiriti niścitam || 22-104 ||
ādau praṇavamuccārya tato haṃsapadaṃ likhet | tatpaścāt praṇavaṃ jñeyaṃ tataḥ parapadaṃ smaret || 22-105 ||
tarpayāmi padasyānte praṇavaṃ phaḍiti smaret | etaddhi haṃsamantrastu vīrāṇāmudayāya ca || 22-106 ||
bṛhad haṃsaprasādena ṣaṭcakrabhedako bhavet | ṣaṭcakre ca praśaṃsanti sarve devāścarācarāḥ || 22-107 ||
yogasiddhiṃ vighātāya bhramanti yoginastanau | yadi haṃsaṃ bṛhaddhaṃsaṃ japanti vāyusiddhaye || 22-108 ||
tadā sarve palāyante rākṣasānmānuṣā yathā || 22-109 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete yogaśikṣāvidhinirṇaye siddhamantraprakaraṇe | bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde dvāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 22 ||
[atha trayoviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrībhairavī uvāca
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi brahmamārgamanuttamam | yad yajjñātvā surāḥ sarve jayākhyāḥ paramaṃ jaguḥ || 23-1 ||
na tantejaḥprakāśāya mahatāṃ dharmavṛddhaye | yogāya yogināṃ deva bhakṣaprasthanirūpaṇam || 23-2 ||
yogābhyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti na jānātīha bhakṣaṇam | koṭivarṣasahasreṇa na yogī bhavati dhruvam || 23-3 ||
ato vai bhakṣamāhātmyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ | yajjñātvā siddhimāpnoti svādhiṣṭhānādibhedanam || 23-4 ||
ādau vivekī yo bhūyād bhūtale parameśvara | sa eva bhakṣaniyamaṃ gṛhe'raṇye samācaret || 23-5 ||
vāyvāsanadṛḍhānandaparamānandanirbharaḥ | mitāhāraṃ sadā kuryāt pūrakāhlādahetunā || 23-6 ||
tadā pūrakasiddhiḥ syād bhakṣaṇādinirūpaṇāt | udaraṃ pūrayennityaṃ kumbhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 23-7 ||
nijahastapramāṇābhiḥ pūrayet pūrṇameva ca | tatpūrayet sthāpayennātha viśvāmitrakapālake || 23-8 ||
haṃsadvādaśavāreṇa śilāyāmapi gharṣayet | nityaṃ tatpātrapūrṇaṃ ca pākenaikena bhakṣayet || 23-9 ||
taṇḍulān śālisambhūtānkapālaprasthapūrṇakān | dine dine kṣayaṃ kuryād bhakṣaṇādiṣu karmasu || 23-10 ||
haṃsadvādaśavāreṇa japena saṃkṣayaṃ caret | śilāyāṃ tatkapālaṃ ca varddhayet pūrakādikam || 23-11 ||
yāvatkālaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti nijabhakṣaṇanirṇayam | tatkālaṃ vāyunāpūrya nodaraṃ kākacañcubhiḥ || 23-12 ||
ākuñcayet sadā mūle kuṇḍalī bhakṣadhāraṇāt | tatrasampūrayedyogī bhakṣaprasthāvanāśanāt || 23-13 ||
kālakrameṇa tat siddhimavāpnoti jitendriyaḥ | yatsthānaṃ bhakṣaṇasyaiva tatsthāne pūrayetsukham || 23-14 ||
punaḥ punarbhakṣaṇena bhakṣasiddhimupaiti hi | vinā pūrakayogena bhakṣaṇaṃ nāpi siddhyati || 23-15 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa bhakṣatyāgaṃ vinirṇayam | yena hīnā na siddhyanti nāḍīcakrasthadevatāḥ || 23-16 ||
dvātriṃśad grāsamādāya triparvvaṇi yathāsthitam | arddhagrāsaṃ vihāyāpi nityaṃ bhakṣaṇamācaret || 23-17 ||
sadā sampūrayed vāyuṃ bhāvako gatabhīrmahān | bhakṣasthāne samāyojya pibed vāyumahanīśam || 23-18 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭidine sarvaṃ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sudhīḥ | payobhakṣaṇamākuryāt sthiracetā jitendriyaḥ || 23-19 ||
payaḥ pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi hastaprasthatrayaṃ trayam | śanaiḥ śanaivījetavyāḥ prāṇā mattagajendravat || 23-20 ||
ṣaṇmāsājjāyate siddhiḥ pūrakādiṣu lakṣaṇam | krameṇāṣṭāṅgasiddhiḥ syāt yatīnāṃ kāmarūpiṇām || 23-21 ||
baddhapadmāsanaṃ kṛtvā vijayānandananditaḥ | dhārayenmārutaṃ mantrī mūlādhāre manolayam || 23-22 ||
athāsanaprabhedañca śṛṇu matsiddhikāṅkṣaṇām | yena vinā pūrakāṇāṃ siddhibhāk na mahītale || 23-23 ||
adho muṇḍāsanaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ sukham | ūdrdhvamārge padaṃ dattvā dhārayenmārutaṃ sudhīḥ || 23-24 ||
sarvāsanānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi ūdrdhvapādo yadā caret | tadaiva mahatīṃ siddhiṃ dadāti vāyavī kalā || 23-25 ||
etatpadmāsanaṃ kuryāt prāṇavāyuprasiddhaye | śubhāsanaṃ tadā dhyāyetpūrayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 23-26 ||
ūrumūle vāmapādaṃ punastaddakṣiṇaṃ padam | vāmorau sthāpayitvā ca padmāsanamitismṛtam || 23-27 ||
savyapādasya yogena āsanaṃ parikalpayet | tadaikāsanakāle tu dvitīyāsanamābhavet || 23-28 ||
pṛṣṭhe karadvayaṃ nītvā vṛddhāṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ sudhīḥ | kāyasaṅkocamākṛtya dhṛtvā baddhāsano bhavet || 23-29 ||
baddhapadmāsanaṃ kṛtvā vāyubaddhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | cibukaṃ sthāpayedyatnād hlāditejasi bhāskare || 23-30 ||
ityāsanaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ siddhikāraṇam | vāyuvaśyāya yaḥ kuryāt sa yogī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 23-31 ||
svabhāvasiddhikaraṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ svastikāsanam | vāmapādatale kuryātpādadakṣiṇameva ca || 23-32 ||
savyāpasavyayogena āsanadvayameva ca | sarvatraivaṃ prakāraṃ ca kṛtvā nāḍīva sāramet || 23-33 ||
āsanāni śṛṇu hyetattriṃśatāsaṃkhyakāni ca | savyāpasavyayogena dviguṇaṃ prabhavediha || 23-34 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭyāsanānīha vadāmi vāyusādhanāt | dvātriṃśadbindubhedāya kalpayed vāyuvṛddhaye || 23-35 ||
kārmukāsanamākṛtya udare pūrayet sukham | tadā vāyurvaśo yāti kālena sūkṣmavāyunā || 23-36 ||
kṛtvā padmāsanaṃ mantrī veṣṭayitvā pradhārayet | kareṇa dakṣiṇenaiva vāmapādāntikaṃ taṭam || 23-37 ||
savyāpasavyadviguṇaṃ kārmukāsanameva ca | kārmukadvayayogena śaravad vāyumānayet || 23-38 ||
kukkuṭāsanamāvakṣye nāḍīnirmalahetunā | matkulāgamayogena kuryād vāyuniṣevaṇam || 23-39 ||
nijahastadvayaṃ bhūmau pātayitvā jitendriyaḥ | padbhyāṃ baddhaṃ yaḥ karoti kūrparadvayamadhyataḥ || 23-40 ||
savyāpasavyayugalaṃ kukkuṭaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam | baddhaṃ kṛttvā adhaḥśīrṣaṃ yaḥ karoti khagāsanam || 23-41 ||
khagāsana prasādena śramalopo bhaved drutam | punaḥ punaḥ śramādeva viṣayaśramalopakṛt || 23-42 ||
lolāsanaṃ sadā kuryād vāyulolāpaghātanāt | sthiravāyuprasādena sthiracetā bhaveddrutam || 23-43 ||
padmāsanaṃ samākṛtya pādayoḥ sandhigahvare | hastadvayaṃ madhyadeśaṃ niyojya kukkuṭākṛtiḥ || 23-44 ||
nijahastadvayadvandvaṃ nipātya hastanirbharam | kṛtvā śarīramullāpya sthitvā padmāsane'nilaḥ || 23-45 ||
sthitvaitadāsane mantrī adhaḥśīrṣaṃ karoti cet | uttamāṅgāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ yogināmatidurlabham || 23-46 ||
etadāsanamātreṇa śarīraṃ śītalaṃ bhavet | punaḥ punaḥ prasādena caitanyā kuṇḍalī bhavet || 23-47 ||
savyāpasavyayogena yaḥ karoti punaḥ punaḥ | pūrayitvā mūlapadme sūkṣmavāyuṃ vikumbhayet || 23-48 ||
kṛtvā kumbhakamevaṃ hi sūkṣmavāyulayaṃ vidhau | mūlādibrahmarandhrānte sthāpayellayage pade || 23-49 ||
etat śubhāsanaṃ kṛttvā sūkṣmarandhre manolayam | sūcīrandhre yathāsūtraṃ pūrayet sūkṣmavāyunā || 23-50 ||
etat krameṇa ṣaṇmāsān pūrakasyāpi lakṣaṇam | mahāsukhaṃ samāpnoti yogāṣṭāṅganiṣevaṇāt || 23-51 ||
atha vakṣye mahādeva parvatāsanamaṅgalam | yatkṛtvā sthirarūpī syād ṣaṭcakrādivilopanam || 23-52 ||
yonyāsanaṃ parvatena yogaṃ yogaphale'nilam | tatkālaphalalantāvat khecaro yāvadeva hi || 23-53 ||
pādayogena cakrasya liṅgāgraṃ yo niyojayet | anyatpadamūrau dattvā tatra yonyāsanaṃ bhuvi || 23-54 ||
tatra madhye mahādeva banddhayonyāsanaṃ śṛṇu | yatkṛtvā khecaro bhūtvā vicaredīśvaro yathā || 23-55 ||
kṛtvā yonyāsanaṃ nātha liṅgaguhyādibandhanam | mukhanāsānetrakarṇakaniṣṭhāṅgulibhistathā || 23-56 ||
oṣṭhādharaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāmanāmābhyāñca nāsike | madhyamābhyāṃ netrayugmaṃ tarjjanībhyāṃ paraiḥ śrutī || 23-57 ||
kṛttvā yonyāsanaṃ nātha yogināmati durlabham | kṛttvā yaḥ pūrayed vāyuṃ mūlamākuñcya stambhayet || 23-58 ||
savyāpasavyayogena siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāruhya kumbhakaṃ paripūrayet || 23-59 ||
aruṇodayakālācca vasudaṇḍe sadāśiva | savyāpasavyayogena gṛhṇīyādvāyugānilam || 23-60 ||
dvitīyaprahare kuryād vāyupūjāṃ manoramām | etadāsanamākṛtya siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ || 23-61 ||
athānyadāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā so'maro bhavet | matsādhakaḥ śuciḥ śrīmān kuryādgattvā nirāvile || 23-62 ||
bhekānāmāsanaṃ yogaṃ nijavakṣasi sammukham | nidhāya pādayugalaṃ skandhe bāhū padopari || 23-63 ||
dhyāyeddhi citpadaṃ bhrāntamāsanasthaḥ sukhāya ca | yadi sarvāṅgamuttolya gagane khecarāsanam || 23-64 ||
mahābhekāsanaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam | mahāvidyāṃ mahāmantraṃ prāpnoti japatīha yaḥ || 23-65 ||
etat prabhedaṃ vakṣyāmi karoti yaḥ sa cāmaraḥ | ekapādamūrau baddhvā skandhe'nyatpādarakṣaṇam || 23-66 ||
etatprāṇāsanaṃ nāma sarvasiddhipradāyakam | vāyumūle samāropya dhyāttvā''kuñcya prakārayet || 23-67 ||
kevalaṃ pādamekañca skandhe cāropya yatnataḥ | ekapādena gagane tiṣṭhet sa daṇḍavat prabho || 23-68 ||
apānāsanametaddhi sarveṣāṃ pūrakāśrayam | kṛttvā sūkṣme śīrṣapadme samāropya ca vāyubhiḥ || 23-69 ||
tadā siddho bhavenmarttyaḥ prāṇāpānasamāgamaḥ | apānāsanayogena kṛttvā yogeśvaro bhuvi || 23-70 ||
samānāsanamāvakṣye siddhamantrādisādhanāt | ekapādamūrau dattvā guhye'nyalliṅgavaktrake || 23-71 ||
etad vīrāsanaṃ nātha samānāsanasaṃjñakam | ityākṛtya japenmantraṃ dhṛtvā vāyuṃ caturdale || 23-72 ||
kuṇḍalīṃ bhāvayenmantraṃ koṭividyullatākṛtim | ātmacandrāmṛtarasairāplutāṃ yoginīṃ sadā || 23-73 ||
vīrāsanaṃ tu vīrāṇāṃ yogavāyupradhāraṇam | yo jānāti mahāvīraḥ sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 23-74 ||
atha vakṣye mahākāla samānāsanasādhana | bhedakrameṇa yajjñātvā vīrāṇāmadhipo bhavet || 23-75 ||
samānāsanamākṛtya vṛddhāḍguṣṭhaṃ kareṇa ca | ekena so'dhikārī syāt svarayogādisādhane || 23-76 ||
āsanaṃ yo hi jānāti vāyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ tathā | kālādīnāṃ nirṇayaṃ tu sa kadācinna naśyati || 23-77 ||
kālena labhyate siddhiḥ kālarūpo mahojjvalaḥ | sādhakairyogibhirdhyeyaḥ siddhavīrāsanātmanā || 23-78 ||
atha vakṣye nīlakaṇṭha granthibhedāsanaṃ śubham | jñātvā rudro bhavet kṣipraṃ sūkṣmavāyuniṣevaṇāt || 23-79 ||
kṛtvā padmāsanaṃ mantrī jaṅghayoḥ hṛdaye karau | kūrparasthāna paryantaṃ vibhedya skandhadhāraṇam || 23-80 ||
bhitvā padmāsanaṃ mantrī sahasrārddhena ghāṭanam | yena śīrṣaṃ bhāvanamraṃ sarvāṅgulibhirāśramam || 23-81 ||
granthibhedāsanañcaitat khecarādipradarśanam | kṛttvā sūkṣmavāyulayaṃ paramātmani bhāvayet || 23-82 ||
athānyāsanamāvakṣye yogapūrakarakṣaṇāt | kṛttvā padmāsanaṃ pādā aṅguṣṭhajaṅghayoḥ sthitam || 23-83 ||
hastamekaṃ tu jaṅghāyāḥ kārmukaṃ kūrparorddhakam | padmāsane samādhāya aṅguṣṭhaṃ paridhāvayet || 23-84 ||
kārmukāsanametaddhi savyāpasavyayogataḥ | padmāsanaṃ veṣṭayitvā aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ pradhāvayet || 23-85 ||
yaḥ karoti sadā nātha kārmukāsanamuttamam | tasya rogādiśatrūṇāṃ kṣayaṃ nītvā sukhī bhavet || 23-86 ||
atha vakṣye'tra saṃkṣepāt sarvāṅgāsanamuttamam | yatkṛtvā yoganipuṇo vidyābhiḥ paṇḍito yathā || 23-87 ||
adho nidhāya śīrṣaṃ ca ūdrdhvapādadvayaṃ caret | padmāsanaṃ tu tatraiva bhūmau kūrparayugmakam || 23-88 ||
daṇḍe daṇḍe sadā kuryāt śramaśāntiparaḥ sudhīḥ | nityaṃ sarvāsanaṃ hitvā na kuryād vāyudhāraṇam || 23-89 ||
māsena sūkṣmavāyūnāṃ gamanaṃ copalabhyate | trimāse devapadavīṃ trimāse śītalo bhavet || 23-90 ||
atha vakṣye mahādeva mayūrāsanamuttamam | bhūmau nipātya hastau dvau kūrparopari dehakam || 23-91 ||
kūrparopari saṃsthāpya sarvadehaṃ sthirāśayaḥ | kevalaṃ hastayugalaṃ nipātya bhuvi susthiraḥ || 23-92 ||
etadāsanamātreṇa nāḍīsambhedanaṃ bhavet | pūrakeṇa dṛḍho yāti sarvatrāṅgāśrayeṇa ca || 23-93 ||
athānyadāsanaṃ kṛttvā sarvavyādhinivāraṇam | yogābhyāsī bhavetkṣipraṃ jñānāsanaprasādataḥ || 23-94 ||
dakṣapādorumūle ca vāmapādatalaṃtathā | dakṣapādatalaṃ dakṣapārśve saṃyojya dhārayet || 23-95 ||
etajjñānāsanaṃ nātha jñānādvidyāprakāśakam | nirantaraṃ yaḥ karoti tasya granthiḥ ślathī bhavet || 23-96 ||
savyāpasavyayogena muṇḍāsanamiti smṛtam | kṛtvā dhyātvā sthiro bhūtvā līyate paramātmani || 23-97 ||
garuḍāsanamāvakṣye yena dhyānaṃ sthiraṃ bhuvi | sarvadoṣādvinirmukto bhavatīha mahābalī || 23-98 ||
ekapādamurau baddhvā ekapādena daṇḍavat | jaṅghāpādasandhideśe jñānavyagraṃ vyavasthitam || 23-99 ||
etadāsanamākṛtya pṛṣṭhe saṃhāramudrayā | ārādhya yoganāthaṃ ca sadā sarveśvarasya ca || 23-100 ||
athānyadāsanaṃ vakṣye yena siddho bhavennaraḥ | akasmād vāyusañcāraṃ kokilākhyāsanena ca || 23-101 ||
ūdrdhve hastadvayaṃ kṛtvā tadagre pādayoḥ sudhīḥ | vṛddhāṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ nātha śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prakārayet || 23-102 ||
padmāsanaṃ samākṛtya kūrparopari saṃsthitaḥ | atha vakṣye vīranātha ānandamandirāsanam || 23-103 ||
yatkṛtvā amaro dhīro bhavatyeveha sādhakaḥ | hastayugmaṃ pādadeśe pādayugmaṃ pradāpayet || 23-104 ||
prakṛtya daṇḍavat kaula nitambāgre pratiṣṭhati | khañjanāsanamāvakṣye yatkṛtvā susthiro bhavet || 23-105 ||
pṛṣṭhe pādadvayaṃ baddhvā hastau bhūmau pradhārayet | bhūmau hastadvayaṃ nātha pātayitvānilaṃ pibet || 23-106 ||
pṛṣṭhe pādadvayaṃ baddhvā khañjanena jayī bhavet | athānyadāsanaṃ vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai || 23-107 ||
pavanāsanarūpeṇa khecaro yogirāḍbhavet | sthitvā baddhāsane dhīro nābheradhaḥkaradvayam || 23-108 ||
ūdrdhvamuṇḍaḥ pibed vāyuṃ niruddhyeta yamāvile | atha sarpāsanaṃ vakṣye vāyupānāya kevalam || 23-109 ||
śarīraṃ daṇḍavattiṣṭhedrajjubaddhastu pādayoḥ | vāyavī kuṇḍalī devī kuṇḍalākāramaṅgule || 23-110 ||
maṇḍitā bhūṣaṇādyaiśca vakṣye sarpāsanasthitam | nidrālasyabhayān tyaktvā rātrau kuryātpunaḥ punaḥ || 23-111 ||
sarvān vighnān vaśīkṛtya nidrādīn vāyusādhanāt | atha vakṣye kākarūpaskandhāsanamanuttamam || 23-112 ||
kalipāpāt pramucyeta vāyavīṃ vaśamānayet | nijapādadvayaṃ baddhvā skandhadeśe ca sādhakaḥ || 23-113 ||
nityametat padadvandvaṃ bhūmau puṣṭikaradvayam || 23-114 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvāsananirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde | trayoviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 23 ||
[atha catuvīṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca
atha vakṣye mahādeva yogaśāstrārthanirṇayam | yena vijñānamātreṇa ṣaṭcakragranthibhedakaḥ || 24-1 ||
parvvātiriktadivase kuryāt śrīyogasādhanam | kālikākulasarvasvaṃ kalā kālasamanvitam || 24-2 ||
āsanaṃ vidhinā jñānaṃ koṭikoṭikriyānvitam | śatalakṣasahasrāṇi āsanāni mahītale || 24-3 ||
svarge pātālamadhye tu sammuktāni mahaṣībhiḥ | bhedābhedakrameṇaiva kuryānnityaṃ sadāsanam || 24-4 ||
tatprakāraṃ ca vividhaṃ yatkṛttvā so'maro bhavet | amaraḥ siddha ityāhuraṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitam || 24-5 ||
pratibhāti sa evārtho mūlamantrārthavedinaḥ | amarāste praśaṃsanti sarvalokanirantaram || 24-6 ||
devāḥ śrīkāminīkāntāḥ prabhavanti jagattraye | kālaṃ hi vaśamākarttuṃ niyukto yaśca bhāvakaḥ || 24-7 ||
te sarve vicarantīha koṭivarṣaśateṣu ca | tattadāsananāmāni śṛṇu tatsādhanāni ca || 24-8 ||
yena vijñānamātreṇa sākṣādīśasya bhaktimān | atha kūrmāsanaṃ nātha kṛtvā vāyuṃ prapūrayet || 24-9 ||
kāmarūpo bhavet kṣipraṃ kalikalmaṣanāśanam | samānāsanamākṛtya liṅgāgre svīyamastakam || 24-10 ||
nitambe hastayugalaṃ bhūmau saṅkocitaḥ patet | kumbhīrāsanamāvakṣye vāyūnāṃ dhāraṇāya ca || 24-11 ||
tiṣṭhet kuṇḍākṛtirbhūmau karau śīrṣopari sthitau | padopari padaṃ dattvā śīrṣopari karadvayam || 24-12 ||
tiṣṭhet kuṇḍākṛtirbhūmau kumbhīrāsanameva tat | atha matsyāsanaṃ pṛṣṭhe hastopari karāṅguliḥ || 24-13 ||
pādayugmapramāṇena vṛddhāṅguṣṭhasya yojanam | makarāsanamāvakṣye vāyupānāya kumbhayet || 24-14 ||
pṛṣṭhe pādadvayaṃ dattvā hastābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhabandhanam | atha siṃhāsanaṃ nātha kūrparopari jānunī || 24-15 ||
sthāpayitvā ūdrdhvamukho vāyupānaṃ samācaret | atha vakṣye mahādeva kuñjarāsanamuttamam || 24-16 ||
kareṇaikena pādābhyāṃ bhūmau tiṣṭhet śiraḥ karaḥ | vyāghrāsanamatho vakṣye krodhakālavināśanam || 24-17 ||
ekapādaṃ śīrṣamadhye merudaṇḍopari sthitam | bhallūkāsanamāvakṣye yatkṛttvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 24-18 ||
nitambe ca pādagoṣṭhī hastābhyāmaṅgulīyakam | atha kāmāsanaṃ vakṣye kāmasaṅgena hetunā || 24-19 ||
garuḍāsanamākṛtya kaniṣṭhāgraṃ spṛśodbhavam | varttulāsanamāvakṣye yatkṛttvā bhairavo bhavet || 24-20 ||
ākāśasthitapādābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ nibandhayet | atha mokṣāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛttvā mokṣamandiram || 24-21 ||
dakṣahastaṃ dakṣapādaṃ kevalaṃ sthāpayetsudhīḥ | atha mālāsanaṃ nātha yatkṛtvā vāyavīpriyaḥ || 24-22 ||
śubhayogaṃ samāpnoti ekahastasthito naraḥ | atha divyāsanaṃ vakṣye pṛṣṭhaṃ hastena bandhayet || 24-23 ||
ekahastamadhyadeśaṃ bhūmihastañca nāsayā | arddhodayāsanaṃ nātha sarvāṅgaṃ khe niyojayet || 24-24 ||
kevalaṃ hastayugalaṃ bhūmimālokya nāsayā | atha candrāsanaṃ vakṣye pādābhyāṃ svaśarīrakam || 24-25 ||
punaḥ punaḥ dhārayed yo vāyudhāraṇapūrvakam | atha haṃsāsanaṃ vakṣye śarīreṇa punaḥ punaḥ || 24-26 ||
bhūmau santāḍayet śvāsaiḥ prāṇavāyudṛḍhaḥ sudhīḥ | atha sūryāsanaṃ vakṣye pṛṣṭhāt pādena bandhanam || 24-27 ||
pṛṣṭhe bhedānvitaṃ pādaṃ tasya hastena bandhayet | atha yogāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 24-28 ||
sarvāḥ pādataladvandvaṃ svāṅge baddhvā karadvayam | gadāsanamato vakṣye gadākṛtirvased bhuvi || 24-29 ||
ūdrdhvabāhurbhavedyena kāyaśodhanahetunā | atha lakṣmyāsanaṃ vakṣye liṅgāgre'ṅghirataladvayam || 24-30 ||
guhyadeśe hastayugmaṃ talābhyāṃ bandhayed bhuvi | atha kulyāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā kauliko bhavet || 24-31 ||
ekahastaṃ mastakastho'dhaḥ śīrṣe'bhinnage karam | brāhmaṇāsanamāvakṣye yatkṛttvā brāhmaṇo bhavet || 24-32 ||
ekapādamūrau dattvā tiṣṭhed daṇḍākṛtirbhuvi | kṣatriyāsanamāvakṣye yatkṛttvā dhanavān bhavet || 24-33 ||
keśena pādayugalaṃ baddhvā tiṣṭhedadhomukhaḥ | atha vaiśyāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā satyavānbhavet || 24-34 ||
vṛddhāṅguṣṭhena yastiṣṭhet hastayugmaṃ svakorasi | atha śūdrāsanaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā sevako bhavet || 24-35 ||
dhṛtvāṅguṣṭhadvayaṃ yojyaṃ nāsāgrapādamadhyake | atha jātyāsanaṃ vakṣye yena jātismaro bhavet || 24-36 ||
hastāṅghirayugmaṃ bhūmau ca gamanāgamanaṃ tataḥ | pāśavāsanamāvakṣye kṛttvā paśupatirbhavet || 24-37 ||
pṛṣṭhe hastadvayaṃ dattvā kūrparāgre svamastakam | eteṣāṃ sādhanādeva cirajīvī bhavennaraḥ || 24-38 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ sādhanādvai jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam | śrīvidyāsādhanaṃ paścāt kathitavyaṃ taba prabho || 24-39 ||
āsanaṃ yogasiddhyarthaṃ kāyaśodhanahetunā | idānīṃ śṛṇu deveśa rahasyaṃ komalāsanam || 24-40 ||
yogasiddhivicārāya rahasyaṃ carmāsanaṃ śubham | atha narāsanaṃ vakṣye ṣoḍaśādiprakārakam || 24-41 ||
yena sādhanamātreṇa yogī bhavati sādhakaḥ | prakāraṃ ṣoḍaśaproktaṃ matkulāgamasambhavam || 24-42 ||
yena sādhanamātreṇa sākṣādyogī mahītale | ekamāsād bhavetkalpo dvimāse drutakalpanam || 24-43 ||
trimāse yogakalpaḥ syāccaturmāse sthirāśayaḥ | pañcamāse sūkṣmakalpe ṣaṣṭhamāse vivekagaḥ || 24-44 ||
saptamāse jñānayukto bhāvako bhavati dhruvam | aṣṭamāse'nnasaṃyukto jitendriyakalevaraḥ || 24-45 ||
navame siddhimilano daśame cakrabhedavān | ekādaśe mahāvīro dvādaśe khecaro bhavet || 24-46 ||
iti yogāsanasthaśca yogī bhavati sādhakaḥ | narāsanaṃ yaḥ karoti sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ || 24-47 ||
tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena siddho bhavetprabho | adhomukhaṃ mahādeva narāsanasya sādhane || 24-48 ||
karaṇīyaṃ sādhakendrairyogaśāstrārthasammataiḥ | akṣīṇaṃ yauvanoddāmaṃ sundaraṃ cārukuntalam || 24-49 ||
lokānāṃ śreṣṭhamevaṃ hi patitaṃ raṇasammukhe | tatsarvaṃ hi samānīya maṅgale vāsare niśi || 24-50 ||
candrasūryāsanaṃ kṛtvā sādhayettatra kaulikaḥ | athānyat sampravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhiprakārakam || 24-51 ||
bhekāsanaṃ yaḥ karoti sa eva yoginīpatiḥ | athānyat sampravakṣyāmi yatkṛtvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 24-52 ||
tatsarvottaraśirasi sthitvā candrāsane japet | athānyat tatprakārañca mahāvidyādidarśanāt || 24-53 ||
matsare gauravarṇe ca tatra śailāsane japet | athānyattatprakāraṃ ca yogikaulo na saṃśayaḥ || 24-54 ||
yadyevaṃ mirayate so'pi tadā bhadrāsane japet | tattatsādhanakāle ca evaṃ kuryāddane dine || 24-55 ||
nṛtyavādyagītarāgabhogonaviṃśatau dine | caturdaśaṃ na vīkṣyeta bhairavāṇāṃ bhayādrdanāt || 24-56 ||
manoniveśamātreṇa yogī bhavati bhairava | svecchāsanaṃ samākṛtya mantraṃ japati yo naraḥ || 24-57 ||
mahāsāro vītarāgaḥ siddho bhavati niścitam | athānyat śavamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama || 24-58 ||
tatsarvaṃ gṛhamānīyācchādya śārdūlacarmaṇā | tatra mantrī mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā praviśya saṃjapet || 24-59 ||
padmāsanasthastasyaiva jhaṭid yogī na saṃśayaḥ || 24-60 ||
etatprakārarāsanamāśu kṛtvā | jitendriyo yogaphalārthavijñaḥ | bhavenmanuṣyo mama cājñayā hi | siddho gaṇo'sau jagatāmadhīśaḥ || 24-61 ||
mūlakhaḍgayaṣṭiparaḍitaravārādinā yutam | (....) bhūtasarparājavyāghraṃ sadyo mṛtaṃ yajet || 24-62 ||
yasya mṛtyurbhavennātha bhairavasya surāpateḥ | raṇe sammukhayuddhasya tadānīya japaṃ caret || 24-63 ||
tatra kaulāsanaṃ kṛtvā athavā kamalāsanam | mahāvidyāmahāmantraṃ japtvā liṅgamavāpnuyāt || 24-64 ||
etatsarvaṃ na gṛhṇīyād yadīcchedātmano hitam | kuvyādhimaraṇaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ strīvaśyaṃ patitaṃ mṛtam || 24-65 ||
dubhīkṣamṛtamunmattamavyaktaliṅgameva ca | hīnāṅgaṃ bhūcaravṛddhaṃ palāyanaparaṃ tathā || 24-66 ||
anyadyo yad vicāreṇa hattvā lokaṃ japanti ye | te sarve vyāghrabhakṣā syuḥ khādanti vyāghrarūpiṇaḥ || 24-67 ||
paryuṣitaṃ tathāśvasthamadhikāṅgaṃ kukilbiṣam | brāhmaṇaṃ gomayaṃ vīraṃ dhāmīkaṃ santyajet sudhīḥ || 24-68 ||
strījanaṃ yoginaṃ tyaktvā sādhayedvīrasādhanam | tadā siddho bhavenmantrī ājñayā me na saṃśayaḥ || 24-69 ||
taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ mantravidyaṃ samujjvalam | gṛhītvā japamākṛtya siddho bhavati nānyathā || 24-70 ||
manuṣyaśavahṛtpadme sarvasiddhikulākulāḥ | tatra sarvāsanānyeva siddhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 24-71 ||
athānyattatprakāraṃ tu yatkṛtvā yogirāṭ bhavet | komalādyāsane sthitvā dhārayan mārutaṃ sudhīḥ || 24-72 ||
tatkomalāsanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva mama tadvacaḥ | avṛddhakaṃ mṛtaṃ bālaṃ ṣaṇmāsāt komalaṃ param || 24-73 ||
tadvibhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi garbhacyuta mahāśavam | taddhi vyāghratvacārūḍhaṃ kṛtvā tatra japet sthitaḥ || 24-74 ||
ṣaṇmāsānantaraṃ yāvaddaśamāsācca pūrvakam | mṛtaṃ cārumukhaṃ bālaṃ garbhāṣṭamapuraḥsaram || 24-75 ||
ekahaste dvihaste vā caturhaste samantataḥ | viśuddha āsane kuryāt saṃskāraṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ || 24-76 ||
pūrṇe pañcamavarṣe ca sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam | hīnavītopanayano yo mṛtastaṃ hi komalam || 24-77 ||
garbhacyutaphalaṃ nātha śṛṇu tatphalasiddhaye | aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhiḥ syāt saṃvatsarasya sādhanāt || 24-78 ||
mṛtāsane japenmantrī mahāvidyāmamuṃ śubham | acirāttasya siddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 24-79 ||
athānyat śavamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu siddhiśca sādhanāt | sādhako yogirāṭ bhūttvā mama pādatale vaset || 24-80 ||
daśasaṃvatsare pūrṇe yo mirayeta śubhe dine | śanau maṅgalavāre ca tamānīya prasādhayet || 24-81 ||
tatra vīrāsanaṃ kṛttvā yo japed bhadrakālikām | athavā baddhapadme ca sa siddho bhavati dhruvam || 24-82 ||
atha bhāvaphalaṃ vakṣye yena śavādisādhanam | akasmāt prāptimātreṇa śavasya vihitasya ca || 24-83 ||
yaṃ pañcadaśavarṣīyaṃ sundaraṃ patitaṃ raṇe | tamānīya japedvidyāṃ niśi vīrāsane sthitaḥ || 24-84 ||
śīghrameva susiddhiḥ syāt khecarī vāyupūraṇī | dhāraṇāśaktisiddhiḥ syāt yaḥ karotīha sādhanam || 24-85 ||
atha ṣoḍaśavarṣīyaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām | bhogamokṣau kare tasya śavendrasya ca sādhanāt || 24-86 ||
evaṃ krameṇa pañcāśad varṣīyaṃ sundaraṃ varam | ānīya sādhayedyastu sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 24-87 ||
śavaṃ raṇasthamānīya sādhayetsusamāhitaḥ | indratulyo bhavennātha raṇasthaśavasādhanāt || 24-88 ||
yadi sammukhayuddhe vā śṛṇu paṭṭīśaghātanam | śavamānīya vīrendro japedvīrāsanasthitaḥ || 24-89 ||
tat śavaṃ tu mahādeva pūjārthaṃ nijamandire | devālaye nirṇaye ca sthāpayitvā japaṃ caret || 24-90 ||
tatra vīrāsanaṃ kiṃ vā yonimudrāsanādikam | padmāsanaṃ tathākṛtya vāyuṃ dhṛtvā japaṃ caret || 24-91 ||
māsaikena bhavedyogī vipro guṇadharaḥ śuciḥ | sūkṣmavāyudhāraṇajño japed yauvanage śave || 24-92 ||
śavasādhanakālena yadyat karma karoti hi | tatkarmasādhanādeva yogī syādamaro naraḥ || 24-93 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
kālakriyādikaṃ jñāttvā sūkṣmānilanidhāraṇam | sādhako vicaredvīro vīrācāravivecakaḥ || 24-94 ||
śavāde raṇayātasya kriyāmāhātmyamuttamam | śṛṇu saṅketabhāṣābhiḥ śivendracandraśekhara || 24-95 ||
ekahastārddhamāne tu bhūmyadhovidhimandire | saṃsthāpya suśavaṃ nātha māyādavagataḥ prabho || 24-96 ||
ekāhaṃ jagadādhārā ādhārāntargatā satī | patihīnā sūkṣmarūpādadharādicarācaram || 24-97 ||
madīyaṃ sādhakaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣagam | prakaromi sadā rakṣāṃ dhātrīrūpā sarasvatī || 24-98 ||
kevalaṃ tadabhāvena śambho yogaparāyaṇa | magnā saṃsārakaraṇāttvayi tvañcāhameva ca || 24-99 ||
yadyatpadārthanikare tiṣṭhasi tvaṃ sadā mudā | tatraiva saṃsthirā hṛṣṭā cāhameva na saṃśayaḥ || 24-100 ||
etadbhāvaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi kasya hetostava priyā | vāmāṅge saṃsthirā nityaṃ kāmakrodhavivajītā || 24-101 ||
ānandabhairava uvāca
kiṃ prayojanamevaṃ hi śavādīnāñca sādhanāt | yadi te śrīpadāmbhojamadhūnmatto bhavedyatiḥ || 24-102 ||
trailokyapūjite bhīme vāgvādinīsvarūpiṇī | śavasādhanamātreṇa kena yogī bhavedvada || 24-103 ||
ānandarasa lāvaṇyamanda hāsamukhāmbuje | yogī bhajati yogārthaṃ kena tatphalamāvada || 24-104 ||
ānandabhairavī uvāca
yadi śaṅkara bhakto'si mama jāpaparāyaṇaḥ | tathāpi śavabhāvena śavavat śavasādhanam || 24-105 ||
rātriyoge prakarttavyaṃ divase na kadācana | śave sthiro yo babhūva sa bhakto me na saṃśayaḥ || 24-106 ||
me śavākṛtimaddravyaṃ mama tuṣṭinibandhanam | mamājñāpālane yogyaḥ kuryād vīraḥ śavāsanam || 24-107 ||
yadyahaṃ tatra gacchāmi tadaiva sa śivo bhavet | niḥśeṣatyāgamātreṇa śavatvaṃ pralayaṃ tanoḥ || 24-108 ||
yaḥ karoti bhāvarāśiṃ mayi devyāṃ maheśvara | trailokyapūjitāyāṃ tu sa śivaḥ śavamāśrayet || 24-109 ||
adhikārī tu bhaktasya pālanaṃ parapṛṣṭhataḥ | karomi kāminīnātha sandeho nātra bhūtale || 24-110 ||
yadāhaṃ tyajyate gātraṃ paśūnāṃ māraṇāya ca | tadaite ca mṛtāḥ sarve jīvante kena hetunā || 24-111 ||
tadāhutimahādravyaṃ śavendraṃ raṇahānigam | ānīya sādhayedyastu sa sthiro me subhaktigaḥ || 24-112 ||
sadā krodhī bhavedyastu sa krūro nātra saṃśayaḥ | sa kathaṃ vīrarātrau ca sādhayed vihvalaḥ śavam || 24-113 ||
bhayavihvalacetā yaḥ sa krodhī nātra saṃśayaḥ | nāsti krodhasamaṃ pāpaṃ pāpāt kṣipto bhavet śave || 24-114 ||
yo bhaktaḥ pāpanirmuktaḥ siddharūpī nirāśrayaḥ | vivekī dhyānaniṣṭhaśca sthiraḥ saṃsādhayet śavam || 24-115 ||
yāvatkālaṃ sthiracittaṃ na prāpnoti jitendriyaḥ | tāvatkālaṃ nāpi kuryāt śavendrasyāpi sādhanam || 24-116 ||
śavamānīya taddvāre tenaiva parikhanya ca | taddanāttaddinaṃ yāvat yadbaddhvā vyāpya sādhayet || 24-117 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyāśī mahāvidyādisādhanam | jitendriyo mudā kuryād aṣṭāṅgasādhanena ca || 24-118 ||
tadaṣṭāṅgaphalaṃ hyetat yatkṛttvā siddhibhāg bhavet | nāḍīmudrābhedakañca kulācāraphalānvitam || 24-119 ||
aṣṭāṅgasādhanādeva siddharūpo mahītale | paścādanyasvargagāmī bhavenna bhūtalaṃ binā || 24-120 ||
ādau bhūtalasiddhiḥsyādbhuvolokasya siddhibhāk | janalokasya siddhīśastapolokasya siddhibhāk || 24-121 ||
satyalokasya siddhīśaḥ paścād bhavati sādhakaḥ | evaṃ krameṇa siddhiḥ syāt svargādīnāṃ maheśvara || 24-122 ||
aṣṭāṅgasādhanārthāya devā bhavanti bhūtale | bhūtale siddhimāhṛtya gacchanti brahmamandire || 24-123 ||
krameṇaivaṃ vilīnāste ato bhūtalasādhanam | bhūtale śavamāsthāya brahmacārī divā śuciḥ || 24-124 ||
niśāyāṃ pañcatattvena divase'ṣṭāṅgasādhanam | jitendriyo nivīkāro vittavānaparo naraḥ || 24-125 ||
śavaṃ saṃsādhayeddhīraścintālasyavivajītaḥ | cintābhirjāyate lobho lobhāt kāmaḥ prapadyate || 24-126 ||
kāmādbhavati sammoho mohādālasya sañcayaḥ | ālasyadoṣajālena nidrā bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 24-127 ||
mahānidrāvipākena mṛtyurbhavati niścitam | apakṣanidrābhaṅgena krodho bhavati niścitam || 24-128 ||
tatkrodhāccittavikalo vikalāt śvāsavarddhanaḥ | vṛthāyuḥ kṣayamāpnoti vistare śvāsasaṃkṣaye || 24-129 ||
balabuddhikṣayaṃ yāti buddhihīno jaḍātmakaḥ | jaḍabhāvena mantrāṇāṃ japahīno bhavennaraḥ || 24-130 ||
japahīne śvāsanāśaḥ śvāsanāśe tanukṣayam | atastanuṃ samāśritya japaniṣṭho bhavet śuciḥ || 24-131 ||
aṣṭāṅgadhāraṇenaiva siddho bhavati nānyathā | aṣṭāṅgalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sākṣāt siddhikaraṃ param || 24-132 ||
janmakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ phalena kurute naraḥ | yamena labhyate jñānaṃ jñānāt kulapatirbhavet || 24-133 ||
yo yogeśaḥ sa kuleśaḥ śiśubhāvasthanirmalaḥ | niyamena bhavet pūjā pūjayā labhate śivam || 24-134 ||
yatra kalyā ṇa sampūrṇā sampūrṇaḥ śucirucyate | āsanena dīrghajīvī rogaśokavivajītaḥ || 24-135 ||
granthibhedanamātreṇa sādhakaḥ śītalo bhavet | prāṇāyāmena śuddhaḥ syāt prāṇavāyuvaśena ca || 24-136 ||
vaśī bhavati deveśa ātmārāme'pi līyate | pratyāhāreṇa cittaṃ tu cañcalaṃ kāmanāpriyam || 24-137 ||
tatkāmanāvināśāya sthāpayet padapaṅkaje | dhāraṇena vāyusiddhiraṣṭasiddhistataḥ param || 24-138 ||
aṇimāsiddhimāpnoti aṇurūpeṇa vāyunā | dhyānena labhate mokṣaṃ mokṣeṇa labhate sukham || 24-139 ||
sukhenānandavṛddhiḥ syādānando brahmavigrahaḥ | samādhinā mahājñānī sūryācandramasorgatiḥ || 24-140 ||
mahāśūnye layasthāne śrīpadānandasāgaraḥ | tattaraṅge mano dattvā paramārthavinirmale || 24-141 ||
śrīpādamūtīmākalpya dhyāyet koṭiravīnduvat | śrīmūtīṃ koṭicapalāṃ samujjvalāṃ sunirmalām || 24-142 ||
dhyāyedyogī sahasrāre koṭisūryendumandirām || 24-143 ||
śrīvidyāmatisundarīṃ trijagatāmānandapuñjeśvarī| koṭyarkāyuta tejasi priyakarīṃ yogādarīṃ śāṅkarīm | tāṃ mālāṃ sthiracañcalāṃ gurughanāṃ vyālācalāṃ kevalāṃ dhyāyet sūkṣmasamādhinā sthiramatiḥ saśrīpatirgacchati || 24-144 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete yogavidyāprakaraṇe mantrasiddhiśaktyupāye | bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde catuvīṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 24 ||
[atha pañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca vada kānte rahasyaṃ me tattvāvadhānapūrvakam | yad yajjñātvā mahāyogī praviśatyanalāmbuje || 25-1 || yadi snehadṛṣṭirasti mama brahmanirūpaṇam | yogasāraṃ tattvapathaṃ nirmalaṃ vada yogine || 25-2 || ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu prāṇeśa vakṣyāmi yoganātha kriyāguro | yogāṅgaṃ yogināmiṣṭaṃ tattvabrahmanirūpaṇam || 25-3 || etat sṛṣṭiprakārañca prapālanavidhiṃ tathā | asaṃkhyasṛṣṭisaṃhāraṃ vadāmi tattvataḥ śṛṇu || 25-4 || tvameva saṃhārakaro varapriyaḥ pradhānameṣu tritayeṣu śaṅkara | saṃhārabhāvaṃ malabhūtināśanaṃ pradhānamādyasya jagatprapālanam || 25-5 || tatrādhanaṃ merubhujaṅgamaṅgaṃ sṛṣṭiprakāraṃ khalu tatra madhyamam | tatpālanañceti mayaiva rājye saṃhārarūpaṃ prakṛterguṇārthakam || 25-6 || etattrayaṃ nātha bhayādikāraṇaṃ tannāśanāmne praṇavaṃ guṇātmakam | trayaṃ guṇātītamanantamakṣaraṃ sambhāvya yogī bhavatīha sādhakaḥ || 25-7 || avyaktarūpāt praṇavāddhi sṛṣṭistallīyate vyaktatanoḥ samāsā | sūkṣmādyakārāt pratibhānti khe sadā praṇaśyati sthūlakalānnirakṣarāt || 25-8 || atīva citraṃ jagatāṃ vicitraṃ nityaṃ caritraṃ kathituṃ na śakyate | haṃsāśritāste bhavavāsino janā jñātvā na dehasthamupāśrayante || 25-9 || dehādhikārī praṇavādideva māyāśrito nidrita eṣa kālaḥ | pralīyate dīrghapathe ca kāle tadā praṇaśyanti jagat sthitā janāḥ || 25-10 || kālo jagadbhakṣaka īśaveśo tarī tu jīrṇā patihīnadīnā | sa eva mṛtyuvīhitaṃ carācaraṃ prabhuñjati śrīrahitaṃ palāyanam || 25-11 || pañcendutattvena mahendrasṛṣṭiḥ pratiṣṭhitā yajñavidhānahetunā | sadaiva yajñaṃ kurute bhavārṇave niḥsṛṣṭikāle varayajñasādhanam || 25-12 || hitāhitaṃ tatra mahārṇave bhayaṃ vilokya lokā bhayavihvalāḥ sadā | viśanti te kutsitamārgamaṇḍale ato mahānārakibuddhihīnāḥ || 25-13 || māyāmaye dharmakulānale bhave līno hareryāti pathānusārī | mirayeta kālānalatulyamṛtyunā kathaṃ tu yogī kathameva sādhakaḥ || 25-14 || yaḥ sādhakaḥ prema(--)kalāsubhaktyā sa eva mūrkho yadi yāti saṃsṛtau | saṃsārahīnaḥ priyacārukālyāḥ siddho bhavet kāmadacakravartī || 25-15 || vasenna siddho gṛhīṇīsamṛddhyāṃ mahāvipadduḥkhaviśoṣikāyām | yadīha kāle prakaroti vāsanāṃ tadā bhavenmṛtyuratīva niścitam || 25-16 || kṛpāvalokyaṃ vadanāravindaṃ tadaiva he nātha mamaiva cedyadi | sadaiva yaḥ sādhugaṇāśrito naro dhyātvā nigūḍhamatibhāgagadvataḥ || 25-17 || sa eva sādhuḥ prakṛterguṇāśritaḥ kṛtī vaśī vedapurāṇavaktā | sattvaṃ mahākāla itīha cāhaṃ praṇiścayaṃ te kathitaṃ śriye mayā || 25-18 || guṇena bhaktendragaṇādhikānāṃ sākṣāt phalaṃ yogajapākhyasaṅgatim | aṣṭāṅgabhedena śṛṇuṣva kāmaperamāya bhāvāya jayāya vakṣye || 25-19 || māyādikaṃ yaḥ prathamaṃ vaśaṃ nayet sa eva yogī jagatāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | raviprakāraṃ yamavāsanāvaśe śṛṇuṣva taṃ kālavaśārthakevalam || 25-20 || sarvatra kāmādikamāśu jitvā jetuṃ samartho yamakarmasādhakaḥ | kāmaṃ tathā krodhamatīva lobhaṃ mohaṃ madaṃ mātsaritaṃ suduṣṭakṛtam || 25-21 || ato mayā dvādaśa śabda ghātakaṃ vaśaṃ samākṛtya mahendratulyam | sarvatra vāyorvaśakāraṇāya karoti yogī sacalānyathā bhavet || 25-22 || ahiṃsanaṃ satyasuvākyasupriyamasteyabhāvaṃ kurute vasiṣṭhavat | subrahmacaryaṃ sudṛḍhārjjavaṃ sadā kṣamādhṛtiṃ sevasusūkṣmavāyunaḥ || 25-23 || tathā mitāhāramasaṃśayaṃ manaḥ śaucaṃ prapañcārthavivarjanaṃ prabho | karoti yaḥ sādhakacakravartī vādyotsavājñānavivarjanaṃ sadā || 25-24 || vaśī yamadvādaśasaṃkhyayeti karoti cāṣṭāṅgaphalārthasādhanam | varānanā śrīcaraṇāravindaṃ sattvādaśācchannatrinetragocaram || 25-25 || tapaśca santoṣamanasthiraṃ sadā āstikyamevaṃ dvijadānapūjanam | nitāntadevārcanameva bhaktyā siddhāntaśuddhaśravaṇaṃ ca hrīrmatiḥ || 25-26 || japohutaṃ tarpaṇameva sevanaṃ tadbhāvanaṃ ceṣṭanameva nityam | itīha śāstre niyamāścaturdaśā bhaktikriyāmaṅgalasūcanāni || 25-27 || pūrvoktayonyāsanameva satyaṃ bhekāsanaṃ baddhamahotpalāsanam | vīrāsanaṃ bhadrasubhakāsanaṃ ca pūrvoktamevāsanamāśu kuryāt || 25-28 || sarvāṇi tantrāṇi kṛtāni nātha sūkṣmāṇi nālaṃ vaśahetunā mayā | tathāpi mūḍho yadi vāyupānamāhṛtya yonau bhramatīha pātakī || 25-29 || prāṇānilānandavaśena matto gajendragāmī puruṣottamaṃ smṛtam | tasyaiva sevānipuṇo bhavedvaśī brahmāṇḍalokaṃ paripāti yo balī || 25-30 || vadāmi devādisureśvara prabho sūkṣmānilaṃ prāṇavaśena dhārayet | siddho bhavet sādhakacakravartī sarvāntarasthaṃ paripaśyati prabhum || 25-31 || ānandabhairava uvāca vada kānte mahābrahmajñānaṃ sarvatra śobhanam | yena vāyuvaśaṃ kṛttvā khecaro bhūbhṛtāṃ patiḥ || 25-32 || sādhako brahmarūpī syāt brahmajñānaprasādataḥ | brahmajñānāt paraṃ jñānaṃ kutrāsti vada sundari || 25-33 || ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇuṣva yogināṃ nātha dharmajño brahmasañjñaka | ajñānadhvāntamohānāṃ nirmalaṃ brahmasādhanam || 25-34 || brahmajñānasamo dharmo nānyadharmo vidhīyate | yadi brahmajñānadharmī sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25-35 || koṭikanyāpradānena koṭijāpena kiṃ phalam | brahmajñānasamo dharmo nānyadharmo vidhīyate || 25-36 || sarovarasahasreṇa koṭihemācalena ca | koṭibrāhmaṇabhojyena koṭitīrthena kiṃ phalam || 25-37 || kāmarūpe mahāpīṭhe sādhakairlabhyate yadi | brahmajñānasamo dharmo nānyadharmo vidhīyate || 25-38 || brahmajñānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāṇāyāmajamavyayam | bhaktivākyaṃ śabdarasaṃ svarūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ patham || 25-39 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ sugarbhañca nigarbhakam | japadhyānaṃ sagarbhaṃ tu tadā yuktaṃ nigarbhakam || 25-40 || avyayālakṣaṇākrāntaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ parāt param | brahmajñānena jānāti sādhako vijitendriyaḥ || 25-41 || tatprakāradvayaṃ nātha mālāvṛttiṃ japakramam | mālāvṛttidvādaśakaṃ japakramaṃ tu ṣoḍaśa || 25-42 || nāsikāyāṃ mahādeva lakṣaṇatrayamanuttamam | pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ tatra recakaṃ devatātrayam || 25-43 || eteṣāmapyadhiṣṭhāne brahmaviṣṇuśivāḥ prajāḥ | triveṇī saṅgame yānti sarvapāpāpahārakāḥ || 25-44 || īḍā ca bhāratī gaṅgā piṅgalā yamunā matā | īḍāpiṅgalayormadhye suṣumnā ca sarasvatī || 25-45 || triveṇīsaṅgamo yatra tīrtharājaḥ sa ucyate | triveṇīsaṅgame vīraścālayettān punaḥ punaḥ || 25-46 || sarvapāpād vinirmuktaḥ siddho bhavati nānyathā | punaḥ punaḥ bhrāmayitvā mahātīrthe nirañjane || 25-47 || vāyurūpaṃ mahādevaṃ siddho bhavati nānyathā | candrasūryātmikāmadhye vahnirūpe mahojjvale || 25-48 || dhyātvā koṭi(ravi)karaṃ kuṇḍalīkiraṇaṃ vaśī | trivārabhramaṇaṃ vāyoruttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || 25-49 || yatra yatra gato vāyustatra tatra trayaṃ trayam | iḍādevī ca candrākhyā sūryākhyā piṅgalā tathā || 25-50 || suṣumnā jananī mukhyā sūkṣmā paṅkajatantuvat | suṣumnā madhyadeśe ca vajrākhyā nāḍikā śubhā || 25-51 || tatra sūkṣmā citriṇī ca tatra śrīkuṇḍalīgatiḥ | tayā saṅgrāhya taṃ nāḍyā ṣaṭpadmaṃ sumanoharam || 25-52 || dhyānagamyāparaṃ jñānaṃ ṣaṭśaraṃ śaktisaṃyutam | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 25-53 || tataḥ paraśivo nātha ṣaṭśivāḥ parikītītāḥ | ḍākinī rākiṇī śaktirlākinī kākinī tathā || 25-54 || sākinī tatra ṣaṭpadme śaktayaḥ ṣaṭśivānvitāḥ | mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ supaṅkajam || 25-55 || anāhataṃ viśuddhākhyamājñācakraṃ mahotpalam | ājñācakrādimadhye tu candraṃ śītalatejasam || 25-56 || prapatantaṃ mūlapadme taṃ dhyātvā pūrakānilam | yāvatkālaṃ sthairyaguṇaṃ tatkālaṃ kumbhakaṃ smṛtam || 25-57 || piṅgalāyāṃ pragacchantaṃ recakaṃ taṃ vaśaṃ nayet | aṅguṣṭhaikaparvaṇā ca dakṣanāsāpuṭaṃ vaśī || 25-58 || dhṛtvā ṣoḍaśavāreṇa praṇavena japaṃ caret | etatpūrakamākṛtya kuryātkumbhakamadbhutam || 25-59 || catuḥṣaṣṭipraṇavena japaṃ dhyānaṃ samācaret | kumbhakānantaraṃ nātha recakaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 25-60 || dvātriṃśadvārajāpena mūlena praṇavena vā | dvināsikāpuṭaṃ baddhvā kumbhakaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 25-61 || kaniṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu vāmamaṅguṣṭhadakṣiṇam | punardakṣiṇanāsāgera vāyumāpūrayed budhaḥ || 25-62 || manuṣoḍaśajāpena kumbhayet pūrvavattataḥ | tato vāme recakañca dvātriṃśatpraṇavena tu || 25-63 || punarvāmena sampūrya ṣoḍaśapraṇavena tu | punardakṣiṇanāsāgre dvādaśāṅgulamānataḥ || 25-64 || kumbhayitvā recayedyaḥ sarvatra pūrvavat prabho | prāṇāyāmatrayeṇaiva prāṇāyāmaikamuttamam || 25-65 || dvivāraṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ caikavārakam | trikālaṃ kārayedyatnāt anantaphalasiddhaye || 25-66 || prātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyahne niyataḥ śuciḥ | japadhyānādibhirmu(ryu)ktaṃ sagarbhaṃ yaḥ karoti hi || 25-67 || māsāt sallakṣaṇaṃ prāpya ṣaṇmāse pavanāsanaḥ | tālumūle samāropya jihvāgraṃ yogasiddhaye || 25-68 || trikāle siddhimāpnoti prāṇāyāmena ṣoḍaśa | sadābhyāsī vaśībhūttvā pavanaṃ janayet pumān || 25-69 || ṣaṇmāsābhyantare siddhiriti yogārthanirṇayaḥ | yogena labhyate sarvaṃ yogādhīnamidaṃ jagat || 25-70 || tasmād yogaṃ paraṃ kāryaṃ yadā yogī tadā sukhī | binā yogaṃ na siddhe'pi kuṇḍalī paradevatā || 25-71 || atha yogaṃ sadā kuryāt īśvarīpādadarśanāt | yogayogād bhavenmokṣa iti yogārthanirṇayaḥ || 25-72 || mantrasiddhīcchuko yo vā saiva yogaṃ sadābhyaset | mātrāvṛttiṃ pravakṣyāmi kākacañcupuṭaṃ tathā || 25-73 || sūkṣmavāyu bhakṣaṇaṃ tat candramaṇḍalacālanam | tryāvṛttiñcaiva vividhaṃ tanmadhye uttamaṃ trayam || 25-74 || varṇaṃ sacandaṃ saṃyuktaṃ mūlaṃ tryakṣarameva vā | jānujaṅghāmadhyadeśe tattatsarvāsanasthitaḥ || 25-75 || vāmahastatālumūlaṃ bhrāmayed dvādaśakramāt | dvādaśakramaśaḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmaṃ hi pūrvavat || 25-76 || mātrāvṛttikrameṇaiva japamaṣṭasahasrakam | prāṇāyāmadvādaśaikairbhavettadaṣṭasahasrakam | kṛtvā siddhīśvaro nāma niṣpāpī caikamāsataḥ || 25-77 || trisandhyaṃ kārayedyatnād brahmajñānī nirañjanaḥ | bhavatīti na sandehaḥ sadābhyāsī hi yogirāṭ || 25-78 || yogābhyāsād bhavenmukto yogābhyāsāt kuleśvaraḥ | yogābhyāsācca saṃnyāsī brahmajñānī nirāmayaḥ || 25-79 || sadābhyāsād bhavedyogī sadābhyāsāt parantapaḥ | sadābhyāsāt pāpamukto vidhividyāśakṛt śakṛt || 25-80 || kākacañcupuṭaṃ kṛtvā pibedvāyumahanīśam | sūkṣmavāyukrameṇaiva siddho bhavati yogirāṭ || 25-81 || baddhapadmāsanaṃ kṛtvā yogimudrāṃ vibhāvya ca | mūle sampūrayed vāyuṃ kākacañcupuṭena tu || 25-82 || mūlamākuñcya sarvatra prāṇāyāme manorame | prabodhayet kuṇḍalinīṃ caitanyāṃ citsvarūpiṇīm || 25-83 || oṣṭhādharakākatulaṃ dante dantāḥ pragāḍhakam | baddhvā vā yad yajed yogī jihvāṃ naiva prasārayet || 25-84 || rājadantayugaṃ nātha na spṛśejjihvayā sudhīḥ | kākacañcupuṭaṃ kṛtvā baddhvā vīrāsane sthitaḥ || 25-85 || tālujihvāmūladeśe cānyajihvāṃ prayojayet | tadudbhūtāmṛtarasaṃ kākacañcupuṭe pibet || 25-86 || yaḥ kākacañcupuṭake sūkṣmavāyupraveśanam | karoti stambhanaṃ yogī so'maro bhavati dhruvam || 25-87 || etadyogaprasādena jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥ | jarāvyādhimahāpīḍārahito bhavati kṣaṇāt || 25-88 || athavā mātrayā kuryāt ṣoḍaśasvarasampuṭam | svamantraṃ praṇavaṃ vāpi japtvā yogī bhavennaraḥ || 25-89 || athavā varṇamālābhiḥ puṭitaṃ mūlamantrakam | mālāsaṃkhyākrameṇaiva japtvā kālavaśaṃ nayet || 25-90 || vadane noccaredvarṇaṃ vāñchāphalasamṛddhaye | kevala jihvayā japyaṃ kāmanāphalasiddhaye || 25-91 || nābhau sūryo vahnirūpī lalāṭe candramāstathā | agniśikhāsparśanena galitaṃ candramaṇḍalam || 25-92 || tatparāmṛtadhārābhiḥ dīptimāpnoti bhāskaraḥ | santuṣṭaḥ pāti satataṃ pūrakeṇa ca yoginām || 25-93 || tataḥ pūrakayogena amṛtaṃ śrāvayet sudhīḥ | kuryātprajvalitaṃ vahniṃ recakena varāgninā || 25-94 || atha maunajapaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sūkṣmānilaṃ mudā | sahasrāre guruṃ dhyātvā yogī bhavati bhāvakaḥ || 25-95 || prāṇavāyusthiro yāvat tāvanmṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ | ūrdhvaretā bhavedyāvattāvatkālabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 25-96 || yāvadbinduḥ sthito dehe vidhurūpī sunirmalaḥ | sadāgalatsudhāvyāptastāvanmṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ || 25-97 || ānandabhairava uvāca vada kānte kulānandarasike jñānarūpiṇi | sarvatejo'gradevena yena siddho bhavennaraḥ || 25-98 || mahāmṛtā khecarī ca sarvatattvasvarūpiṇī | kīdṛśī śāṅkarīvidyā śrotumicchāmi tatkriyām || 25-99 || adhyātmavidyāyogeśī kīdṛśī bhavitavyatā | kīdṛśī paramā devī tatprakāraṃ vadasva me || 25-100 || ānandabhairavī uvāca yasya nātha manasthairyaṃ mahāsattve sunirmale | bhaktyā sambhāvanaṃ yatra vināvalambanaṃ prabho || 25-101 || yasyā manaścittavaśaṃ svamindriya| sthirā svadṛṣṭirjagadīśvarīpade | na khenduśobhe ca vināvalokana| vāyuḥ sthiro yasya binā nirodhanam || 25-102 || ta eva mudrā vicaranti khecarī pāpādvimuktāḥ prapibanti vāyum | yathā hi bālasya ca tasya veṣṭī nidrāvihīnāḥ pratiyānti nidrām || 25-103 || pathāpathajñānavivajītā ye dharmārthakāmāddhi vihīnamānasāḥ | vināvalambaṃ jagatāmadhīśvara eṣaiva mudrā vicaranti śāṅkarī || 25-104 || jñāne sādhyātmavidyārthaṃ jānāti kulanāyakam | adhyājñācakrapadmasthaṃ śivātmānaṃ suvidyayā || 25-105 || adhyātmajñānamātreṇa siddho yogī na saṃśayaḥ | ṣaṭcakrabhedako yo hi adhyātmajñaḥ sa ucyate || 25-106 || adhyātmaśāstrasaṅketamātmanā maṇḍitaṃ śivam | koṭicandrākṛtiṃ śāntiṃ yo jānāti ṣaḍambudhe || 25-107 || sa jñānī saiva yogī syāt saiva devo maheśvaraḥ | sa māṃ jānāti he kānta vismayo nāsti śaṅkara || 25-108 || mama sarvātmakaṃ rūpaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | sṛṣṭisthitipralayagaṃ yo jānāti sa yogirāṭ || 25-109 || adhyātmavidyāṃ vijñāpya nānāśāstraṃ prakāśitam | tacchāsrajālayugmā ye te'dhyātmajñāḥ kathaṃ narāḥ || 25-110 || tridaṇḍī syātsadābhakto vedābhyāsaparaḥ kṛtī | vedādudbhavaśāstrāṇi tyaktvā māṃ bhāvayedyadi || 25-111 || vedābhyāsaṃ samākṛtya nānāśāstrārthanirṇayam | samutpannāṃ mahāśaktiṃ samālokya bhajedyatiḥ || 25-112 || sarvatra vyāpikāṃ śaktiṃ kāmarūpāṃ nirāśrayām | vyaktāvyaktāṃ sthirapadāṃ vāyavīṃ māṃ bhajedyatiḥ || 25-113 || yasyā ānandamatulaṃ jñānaṃ yasya phalāphalam | yogināṃ niścayajñānamekameva na saṃśayaḥ || 25-114 || yasyāḥ prabhāvamātreṇa tattvacintāparo naraḥ | tāmeva paramāṃ devīṃ sarparājasu kuṇḍalīm || 25-115 || tāmeva vāyavīṃ śaktiṃ sūkṣmarūpāṃ sthirāśayām | ānandarasikāṃ gaurīṃ dhyāyet śvāsanivāsinīm || 25-116 || ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ tattvadehe vyavasthitam | tasyābhivyañjakaṃ dravyaṃ yogibhiḥ paripīyate || 25-117 || taddravyasthāṃ mahādevīṃ nīlotpaladalaprabhām | mānavīṃ paramāṃ devīmaṣṭādaśabhujairyutām || 25-118 || kuṇḍalīṃ cetanākāntiṃ caitanyāṃ paradevatām | ānandabhairavīṃ nityāṃ ghorahāsāṃ bhayānakām || 25-119 || tāmeva paramāṃ devīṃ sarvavāyuvaśaṅkarīm | madirāsindhusambhūtāṃ mattāṃ raudrīṃ varābhayām || 25-120 || yoginīṃ yogajananīṃ jñānināṃ mohinīsamām | sarvabhūtasarvapakṣasthitirūpāṃ mahojjvalām || 25-121 || ṣaṭcakrabhedikāṃ siddhiṃ tāsāṃ nityāṃ matisthitām | vimalāṃ nirmalāṃ dhyāttvā yogī mūlāmbuje yajet || 25-122 || etatpaṭalapāṭhe tu pāpamukto vibhākaraḥ | yathodrdhvaretā dharmajño vicaret jñānasiddhaye || 25-123 || etatkriyādarśanena jñānī bhavati sādhakaḥ | jñānādeva hi mokṣaḥ syānmokṣaḥ samādhisādhanaḥ || 25-124 || yaduddharati vāyuśca dhāraṇāśaktireva ca | tanmantraṃ varddhayitvā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret || 25-125 || prāṇāyāmāt paraṃ nāsti pāparāśikṣayāya ca | sarvapāpakṣaye yāte kinna siddhyati bhūtale || 25-126 || prāṇavāyuṃ mahograṃ tu mahattejomayaṃ param | prāṇāyāmena jitvā ca yogī mattagajaṃ yathā || 25-127 || prāṇāyāmaṃ vinā nātha kutra siddho bhavennaraḥ | sarvasiddhikriyāsāraṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ paraṃ smṛtam || 25-128 || prāṇāyāmaṃ triveṇīsthaṃ yaḥ karoti muhurmuhuḥ | tasyāṣṭāṅgasamṛddhiḥ syādyogināṃ yogavallabhaḥ || 25-129 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe prāṇāyāmollāse bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde pañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 25 ||
[atha ṣaḍaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu prāṇeśa sakalaṃ prāṇāyāmanirūpaṇam | prāṇāyāme japaṃ dhyānaṃ tattvayuktaṃ vadāmi tat || 26-1 || prakārayeyamullāsaṃ prāṇāyāmeṣu śobhitam | devatāvidhiviṣṇvīśāste tu madhyamamadhyamāḥ || 26-2 || rajastamoguṇaṃ nātha sattve saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ | kāmakrodhādikaṃ tyaktvā yogī bhavati yogavit || 26-3 || rajoguṇaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ tu tamoguṇamatīva ca | adhikaṃ tu paśūnāṃ hi sādhūnāṃ sattvameva ca || 26-4 || sattvaṃ viṣṇuṃ vedarūpaṃ nirmalaṃ dvaitavajītam | ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ trimūtīmūlamāśrayet || 26-5 || sattvaguṇāśrayādeva niṣpāpī sarvasiddhibhāk | jitendriyo bhavet śīghraṃ brahmacārivratena ca || 26-6 || prāṇavāyuvaśenāpi vaśībhūtāścarācarāḥ | tasyaiva kāraṇe nātha japaṃ dhyānaṃ samācaret || 26-7 || vakṣyāmi tatprakāraṃ japadhyānaṃ vidhidvayam | etatkaraṇamātreṇa yogī syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 26-8 || japaṃ ca trividhaṃ proktaṃ vyaktāvyaktātisūkṣmagam | vyaktaṃ vācikamupāṃśumavyaktaṃ sūkṣmamānasam || 26-9 || tatra dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi prakāramekaviṃśatim | dhyānena japasiddhiḥ syāt japāt siddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 26-10 || ādau vidyāmahādevīdhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi śaṅkara | eṣā devī kuṇḍalinī yasyā mūlāmbuje manaḥ || 26-11 || manaḥ karoti sarvāṇi dharmakarmāṇi sarvadā | yatra gacchati sa śrīmān tatra vāyuśca gacchati || 26-12 || ato mūle samāropya mānasaṃ vāyurūpiṇam | dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ bāhye nāsāgre cāvadhārayet || 26-13 || manaḥsthaṃ rūpamākalpya manodharmaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | manastat sadṛśaṃ yāti gatiryatra sadā bhavet || 26-14 || manovikārarūpaṃ tu ekameva na saṃśayaḥ | ajñānināṃ hi deveśa brahmaṇo rūpakalpanā || 26-15 || avyaktaṃ brahmarūpaṃ hi tacca dehe vyavasthitam | dharmakarmavinirmuktaṃ manogamyaṃ bhajedyatiḥ || 26-16 || padmaṃ caturdalaṃ mūle svarṇavarṇaṃ manoharam | tatkaṇīkāmadhyadeśe svayambhūveṣṭitāṃ bhajet || 26-17 || koṭisūryapratīkāśāṃ suṣumnārandhragāminīm | ūdrdhvaṃ galatsudhādhārāmaṇḍitāṃ kuṇḍalīṃ bhajet || 26-18 || svayambhūliṅga paramaṃ jñānaṃ ciravivarddhanam | sūkṣmātisūkṣmamākāśaṃ kuṇḍalījaḍitaṃ bhajet || 26-19 || pūrvoktayogapaṭalaṃ tatra mūle vibhāvayet | kuṇḍalīdhyānamātreṇa ṣaṭcakrabhedako bhavet || 26-20 || dhyāyed devīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ parāparagurupriyām | ānandāṃ bhuvi madhyasthāṃ yoginīṃ yogamātaram || 26-21 || koṭividyullatābhāsāṃ sūkṣmātisūkṣmavartmagām | ūdrdhvamārgavyācalantīṃ prathamāruṇavigrahām || 26-22 || prathamodgamane kaulīṃ jñānamārgaprakāśikām | prati prayāṇe pratyakṣāmamṛtavyāptavigrahām || 26-23 || dharmodayāṃ bhānumatīṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamām | sarvāntasthāṃ nivīkalpāñcaitanyānandanirmalām || 26-24 || ākāśavāhinīṃ nityāṃ sarvavarṇasvarūpiṇīm | mahākuṇḍalinīṃ dhyeyāṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ || 26-25 || praṇavāntaḥsthitāṃ śuddhāṃśuddhajñānāśrayāṃ śivām | kulakuṇḍalinīṃ siddhiṃ candramaṇḍalabhedinīm || 26-26 || mūlāmbhojasthitāmādyāṃ jagadyoniṃ jagatpriyām | svādhiṣṭhānādipadmasthāṃ sarvaśaktimayīṃ parām || 26-27 || ātmavidyāṃ śivānandāṃ pīṭhasthāmatisundarīm | sarpākṛtiṃ raktavarṇāṃ sarvarūpavimohinīm || 26-28 || kāminīṃ kāmarūpasthāṃ mātṛkāmātmadāyinīm | kulamārgānandamayīṃ kālīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ bhajet || 26-29 || iti dhyātvā mūlapadme nirmale yogasādhane | dharmodaye jñānarūpīṃ sādhayet parakuṇḍalīm || 26-30 || kuṇḍalībhāvanādeva khecarādyaṣṭasiddhibhāk | īśvaratvamavāpnoti sādhako bhūpatirbhavet || 26-31 || yogābhyāse bhāvasiddhau smṛto vāyurmahodayaḥ | prāṇānāmādunīvāryo yatnena taṃ pracālayet || 26-32 || pratikṣaṇaṃ samākṛṣya mūlapadmastha kuṇḍalīm | tadā prāṇamahāvāyurvaśī bhavati niścitam || 26-33 || ye devāścaiva brahmāṇḍe kṣetre pīṭhe sutīrthake | śilāyāṃ śūnyage nātha siddhāḥ syuḥ prāṇavāyunā || 26-34 || brahmāṇḍe yāni saṃsanti tāni santi kalevare | te sarve prāṇasaṃlagnāḥ prāṇātītaṃ nirañjanam || 26-35 || yāvatprāṇaḥ sthito dehe tāvanmṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ | gate prāṇe samāyānti devatāścetanāsthitāḥ || 26-36 || sarveṣāṃ mūlabhūtā sā kuṇḍalī bhūtadevatā | vāyurūpā pāti sarvamānandacetanāmayī || 26-37 || jagatāṃ cetanārūpī kuṇḍalī yogadevatā | ātmamanaḥsamāyuktā dadāti mokṣameva sā || 26-38 || atastāṃ bhāvayenmantrī bhāvajñānaprasiddhaye | bhavānīṃ bhogamokṣasthāṃ yadi yogamihecchasi || 26-39 || vāyurodhanakāle ca kuṇḍalī cetanāmayī | brahmarandhrāvadhi dhyeyā yoginaṃ pāti kāminī || 26-40 || vāyurūpāṃ parāṃ devīṃ nityāṃ yogeśvarī jayām | nivīkalpāṃ trikoṇasthāṃ sadā dhyāyet kuleśvarīm || 26-41 || anantāṃ koṭisūryābhāṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikām | anantajñānanilayāṃ yāṃ bhajanti mumukṣavaḥ || 26-42 || ajñānatimire ghore sā lagnā mūḍhacetasi | suptā sarpāsanā maulā pāti sādhakamīśvarī || 26-43 || īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñānājñānaprakāśinīm | dharmādharmaphalavyāptāṃ karuṇāmayavigrahām || 26-44 || nityāṃ dhyāyanti yogīndrāḥ kāñcanābhāḥ kalisthitāḥ | kulakuṇḍalinīṃ devīṃ caitanyānandanirbharām || 26-45 || kakārādimāntavarṇāṃ mālāvidyullatāvṛtām | hemālaṅkārabhūṣāṅgīṃ ye māṃ sambhāvayanti te || 26-46 || ye vai kuṇḍalinīṃ vidyāṃ kulamārgaprakāśinīm | dhyāyanti varṣasaṃyuktāste muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26-47 || ye muktā pāparāśestu dharmajñānasumānasāḥ | te'vaśyaṃ dhyānamākurvan stuvanti kuṇḍalīṃ parām || 26-48 || kulakuṇḍalinīdhyānaṃ bhogamokṣapradāyakam | yaḥ karoti mahāyogī bhūtale nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26-49 || trividhaṃ kuṇḍalinīdhyānaṃ divyavīrapaśukramam | paśubhāvādiyogena siddho bhavati yogirāṭ || 26-50 || divyadhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāmānyānantaraṃ prabho | ādau sāmānyamākṛtya divyādīn kārayettataḥ || 26-51 || koṭicandrapratīkāśāṃ tejobimbāṃ nirākulām | jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyāṃ kālānalaśatopamām || 26-52 || draṃṣṭrakarāladurdharṣāṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitām | ghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ sahasrakoṭicañcalām || 26-53 || koṭicandrasamasnigdhāṃ sarvatrasthāṃ bhayānakām | anantasṛṣṭisaṃhārapālanonmattamānasām || 26-54 || sarvavyāpakarūpādyāmādinīlākalevarām | anantasṛṣṭinilayāṃ dhyāyanti tāṃ mumukṣavaḥ || 26-55 || vīradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatkṛtvā vīravallabhaḥ | varāṇāṃ vallabho yo hi mukto bhogī sa ucyate || 26-56 || vīrācāre sattvaguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ divyamuttamam | samprāpya ca mahāvīro yogī bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 26-57 || vīrācāraṃ binā nātha divyācāraṃ na labhyate | tato vīrācāradharmaṃ kṛtvā divyaṃ samācaret || 26-58 || vīrācāraṃ koṭiphalaṃ vāraikajapasādhanam | koṭikoṭijanmapāpaduḥkhanāśaṃ sa bhaktakaḥ || 26-59 || kulācāraṃ samācāraṃ vīrācāraṃ mahāphalam | kṛtvā siddhiśca vai dhyānaṃ kuladhyānaṃ madīyakam || 26-60 || kulakuṇḍalinīṃ devīṃ māṃ dhyātvā pūjayanti ye | mūlapadme mahāvīro dhyātvā bhavati yogirāṭ || 26-61 || kālīṃ kaulāṃ kuleśīṃ kalakala(--)kalijadhyānakālānalārkāṃ | kalyolkāṃ kālakavalāṃ kilikilikalikāṃ kelilāvaṇyalīlām | sūkṣmākhyāṃ saṃkṣayākhyāṃ kṣayakulakamale sūkṣmatejomayīntā(--) | mādyantasthāṃ bhajanti praṇatagatajanāḥ sundarīṃ cāruvarṇām || 26-62 || aṣṭādaśabhujairyuktāṃ nīlendīvaralocanām | madirāsāgarotpannāṃ candrasūryāgnirūpiṇīm || 26-63 || candrasūryāgnimadhyasthāṃ sundarīṃ varadāyinīm | kāminīṃ koṭikandarpadarpāntakapatipriyām || 26-64 || ānandabhairavākrāntāmānandabhairavīṃ parām | bhoginīṃ koṭiśītāṃśugaladgātramanoharām || 26-65 || koṭividyullatākārāṃ sadasadvyaktivajītām | jñānacaitanyaniratāṃ tāṃ vīrā bhāvayanti hi || 26-66 || asyā dhyānaprasādena tvaṃ tuṣṭo bhairavaḥ svayam | ahaṃ ca tuṣṭā saṃsāre sarve tuṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ || 26-67 || prāṇāyāmān sa karoti sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ | dhyātvā devīṃ mūlapadme vīro yogamavāpnuyāt || 26-68 || vīrabhāvaṃ sūkṣmavāyudhāraṇena maheśvara | sādhako bhuvi jānāti svamṛtyuṃ janmasaṅkaṭam || 26-69 || māsādākarṣaṇīsiddhirvāksiddhiśca dvimāsataḥ | māsatrayeṇa saṃyogājjāyate devavallabhaḥ || 26-70 || evañcatuṣṭaye māsi bhaveddakapālagocaraḥ | pañcame pañcabāṇaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhe rudro na saṃśayaḥ || 26-71 || vīrabhāvasya māhātmyaṃ koṭijanmaphalena ca | jānāti sādhakaśreṣṭho devībhaktaḥ sa yogirāṭ || 26-72 || vīrācāraṃ mahādharmaṃ cittasthairyasya kāraṇam | yasya prasādamātreṇa divyabhāvāśrito bhavet || 26-73 || svayaṃ rudro mahāyogī mahāviṣṇuḥ kṛpānidhiḥ | mahāvīraḥ sa evātmā mokṣabhogī na saṃśayaḥ || 26-74 || atha nātha mahāvīra bhāvasnānaṃ kulāśrayam | yatkṛtvā śucireva syāt śuciścet kiṃ na siddhyati || 26-75 || kulasnānaṃ mahāsnānaṃ yogināmatidurlabham | kṛtvā jitendriyo vīraḥ kuladhyānaṃ samācaret || 26-76 || snānaṃ tu trividhaṃ proktaṃ majjanaṃ gātramārjanam | mantrajñānādibhiḥ snānamuttamaṃ parikītītam || 26-77 || tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabha priyakāraka | snānamātreṇa muktaḥ syāt pāpaśailādanantagaḥ || 26-78 || snānañca vimale tīrthe hṛdayāmbhojapuṣkare | bindutīrthe'thavā snāyāt sarvajanmāghamuktaye || 26-79 || iḍāsuṣumne śivatīrthake'smin jñānāmbupūrṇe vahataḥ śarīre | brahmādibhiḥ snāti tayostu nīre kiṃ tasya gāṅgairapi puṣkarairvā || 26-80 || iḍāmalasthānanivāsinī yā sūryātmikāyāṃ yamunā pravāhikā | tathā suṣumnā maladeśagāminī sarasvatī majjati bhakṣaṇārthakam || 26-81 || manogatasnānaparo manuṣyo mantrakriyāyoga viśiṣṭa tattvavit | mahīsthatīrthe vimale jale mudā mūlāmbuje snāti ca muktibhāg bhavet || 26-82 || sarvāditīrthe suratīrthapāvanī gaṅgā mahāsatvavinirgatā satī | karoti pāpakṣayameva muktiṃ dadāti sākṣādatulārthapuṇyadā || 26-83 || sargasthaṃ yāvadātīrthaṃ svādhiṣṭhāne supaṅkaje | mano nidhāya yogīndraḥ snāti gaṅgājale tathā || 26-84 || maṇipūre devatīrthe pañcakuṇḍaṃ sarovaram | etat śrīkāmanātīrthaṃ snāti yo muktimicchati || 26-85 || anāhate sarvatīrthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamadhyagam | vibhavaḥ sarvatīrthāni snāti yo muktimicchati || 26-86 || viśuddhākhye mahāpadme aṣṭatīrthaṃ samudbhavam | kaivalyamuktidaṃ dhyātvā snāti vīro vimuktaye || 26-87 || mānasaṃ bindutīrthañca kālīkuṇḍaṃ kalātmakam | ājñācakre sadā dhyātvā snāti nirvāṇasiddhaye || 26-88 || etat kule priyasnānaṃ kurvanti yogino mudā | ato vīrāḥ sattvayuktāḥ sarvasiddhiyutāḥ surāḥ || 26-89 || nānā pāpaṃ sadā kṛtvā brahmahatyāvinirgatam | kṛtvā snānaṃ mahātīrthe siddhāḥ syuraṇimādigāḥ || 26-90 || snānamātreṇa niṣpāpī śaktaḥ syādvāyusaṅgrahe | tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ yeṣāṃ śakto yogī bhaved dhruvam || 26-91 || atha sandhyāṃ mahātīrthe kulaniṣṭhaḥ samācaret | kularūpāṃ yogavidyāṃ yogayogād yatīśvaraḥ || 26-92 || śivaśaktau samāyogo yasmin kāle prajāyate | sā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhisthe prajāyate || 26-93 || śivaṃ sūryaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā bhālaśaktīndusaṅgamam | sā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhisthe prajāyate || 26-94 || athavenduṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā hṛtsūryaśaktisaṅgamam | saṃyogavidyā sā sandhyā samādhisthe prajāyate || 26-95 || iti sandhyā ca kathitā jñānarūpā jaganmayī | sā nityā vāyavī śaktiḥ chinnabhinnā vināśanāt || 26-96 || tattvatīrthe mahādeva tarpaṇaṃ yaḥ karoti hi | trailokyaṃ tapītaṃ tena tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 26-97 || mūlāmbhoje kuṇḍalinīṃ candrasūryāgnirūpiṇīm | samutthāpya kuṇḍalinīṃ paraṃ binduṃ niveśya ca || 26-98 || tadudbhavāmṛteneha tarpayed dehadevatām | kuleśvarīmādividyāṃ sa siddho bhavati dhruvam || 26-99 || candrasūryamahāvahnisambhūtāmṛtadhārayā | tarpayet kaulinīṃ nityāmamṛtāktāṃ vibhāvayet || 26-100 || etatparapadā kālī strīvidyādipratarpaṇam | kṛtvā yogī bhavedeva satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara || 26-101 || mūle pātraṃ cāndramasaṃ lalāṭendvamṛte na ca | sampūrya jñānamārgeṇa tarpayettena khecarīm || 26-102 || sudhāsindhormadhyadeśe kulakanyāṃ pratarpayet | madirāmṛtadhārābhiḥ siddho bhavati yogirāṭ || 26-103 || tatra tīrthe mahājñānī dhyānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ | tadgarbhamabhyasennityaṃ dhyānametaddhi yoginām || 26-104 || svīyāṃ kanyāṃ bhojayedvai parakīyāmathāpi vā | paritoṣāya sarveṣāṃ yuvatīṃ vā pratoṣayet || 26-105 || stotreṇānena divyena toṣayet śaṅkara prabho | sahasranāmnā kaumāryāḥ stutvā devīṃ pratoṣayet || 26-106 || yaḥ karoti pūrṇayajñaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ japakarmaṇi | puraścaraṇakāryaṃ ca prāṇāyāmena kārayet || 26-107 || prāṇavāyuḥ sthiro gehe pūjāgrahaṇahetunā | ye'ntarasthaṃ na kurvanti teṣāṃ siddhiḥ kutaḥ sthitā || 26-108 || ato'ntaryajanenaiva kuṇḍalītuṣṭamānasā | yadi tuṣṭā mahādevī tadaiva siddhibhāk pumān || 26-109 || abhiṣicya jagaddhātrīṃ pratyakṣaparadevatām | mūlāmbhojāt sahasrāre pūjayed bindudhārayā || 26-110 || galaccandrāmṛtollāsidhārayāsicya pārvatīm | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā mūlamantraṃ smaran sudhīḥ || 26-111 || arccayanviṣayaiḥ puṣpaistatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhavet | nyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena pūjayet || 26-112 || mantrākṣarāṇi cicchaktau protāni paribhāvayet | tāmeva parame vyomni paramānandasaṃsthite || 26-113 || darśayatyātmasadbhāvaṃ pūjāhomādibhivīnā | tadantaryajanaṃ jñeyaṃ yogināṃ śaṅkara prabho || 26-114 || antarātmā mahātmā ca paramātmā sa ucyate | tasya smaraṇamātreṇa sādhuyogī bhavennaraḥ || 26-115 || amāyamanahaṅkāramarāgamamadaṃ tathā | amohakamadambhañca anindākṣobhakau tathā || 26-116 || amātsaryamalobhaśca daśapuṣpāṇi yoginām | ahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ || 26-117 || dayā puṣpaṃ kṣamā puṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpaṃ ca pañcamam | ityaṣṭasaptabhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayet paradevatām || 26-118 || atha homavidhiṃ vakṣye puraścaraṇasiddhaye | saṅketabhāṣayā nātha kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat || 26-119 || ātmānamaparicchinnaṃ vibhāvya sūkṣmavat sthitaḥ | ātmatrayasvarūpaṃ tu citkuṇḍaṃ caturasrakam || 26-120 || ānandamekhalāyuktaṃ nābhisthajñānavahniṣu | arddhamātrākṛtiryonibhūṣitaṃ juhuyāt sudhīḥ || 26-121 || itimantreṇa tadvahnau so'haṃbhāvena homayet | bāhyanārīvidhiṃ tyaktvā mūlāntena svatejasam || 26-122 || nābhicaitanyarūpāgnau haviṣā manasā srucā | jñānapradīpite nityamakṣavṛttirjuhomyaham || 26-123 || iti prathamamāhutyā mūlānte sañcaret kriyām | dvitīyāhutidānena homaṃ kṛtvā bhavedvaśī || 26-124 || dharmādharmapradīpte ca ātmāgnau manasā srucā | suṣumnā vartmanā nityamakṣavṛttiṃ juhomyaham || 26-125 || svāhāntaṃ mantramuccārya ādye mūlaṃ niyojya ca | juhuyādekabhāvena mūlāmbhoruhamaṇḍale || 26-126 || caturthe pūrṇahavane etanmantreṇa kārayet | etanmantracaturthaṃ tu pūrṇavidyāphalapradam || 26-127 || antanīrantaranirandhanamedhamāne | māyāndhakāraparipanthini saṃvidagnau | kasmṃiścidadbhutamarīcivikāsabhūmau viśvaṃ juhomi vasudhādiśivāvasānam || 26-128 || ityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā sākṣād brahmamayo bhavet | na tasya puṇyapāpāni jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam || 26-129 || jñānināṃ yogināmeva antaryāgo hi siddhidaḥ | athāntaḥ pañcamakārayajanaṃ śṛṇu śaṅkara || 26-130 || antaryajanakāle tu dṛḍhabhāvena bhāvayet | tvāṃ māṃ nāthaikatāṃ dhyātvā divārātryaikatāṃ yathā || 26-131 || surāśaktiḥ śivo māṃsaṃ tadbhakto bhairavaḥ svayam | tayoraikyasamutpanna ānando mokṣanirṇayaḥ || 26-132 || ānandaṃ brahmakiraṇaṃ dehamadhye vyavasthitam | tadabhivyañjakairdravyaiḥ kuryād brahmāditarpaṇam || 26-133 || ānandaṃ jagatāṃ sāraṃ brahmarūpaṃ tanusthitam | tadabhivyañjakaṃ dravyaṃ yogibhistaiḥ prapūjayet || 26-134 || liṅgatrayaṃ ca ṣaṭpadmādhāramadhyendubhedakaḥ | pīṭhasthānāni cāgatya mahāpadmavanaṃ vrajet || 26-135 || mūlāmbhojo brahmarandhraṃ cālayedasucālayet | gatvā punaḥ punastatra ciccandraḥ paramodayaḥ || 26-136 || ciccandraḥ kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ sāmarasyamahodayaḥ | vyomapaṅkajanispandasudhāpānarato naraḥ || 26-137 || madhupānamidaṃ nātha bāhye cābhyantare satām | itaraṃ madyapānaṃ tu yogināṃ yogaghātanāt || 26-138 || itaraṃ tu mahāpānaṃ bhrāntimithyāvivajītaḥ | mahāvīraḥ saṅkaroti yogāṣṭāṅgasamṛddhaye || 26-139 || puṇyāpuṇyapaśuṃ hatvā jñānakhaḍgena yogavit | paraśivena yaścittaṃ niyojayati sādhakaḥ || 26-140 || māṃsāśī sa bhavedeva itare prāṇighātakāḥ | śarīrasthe mahāvahnau dagdhamatsyāni pūjayet || 26-141 || śarīrasthajalasthāni itarāṇyaśubhāni ca | mahīgatasnigdhasaumyodbhavamudrāmahābalāḥ || 26-142 || tatsarvaṃ brahmakiraṇe āropya tarpayet sudhīḥ | tatra mudrābhojanāni ānandavarddhakāni ca || 26-143 || itarāṇi ca bhogārthe etaddhi yogināṃ param | paraśaktyātmamithunasaṃyogānandanirbharāḥ || 26-144 || muktāste maithunaṃ tatsyāditare strīniṣevakāḥ | etatpañcamakāreṇa pūjayet paranāyikām || 26-145 || puraścaraṇagūḍhārthasāramantraprapūjanam | etadyogaṃ sadābhyased nidrālasyavivajītaḥ || 26-146 || prāṇavāyurayaṃ kuryāt kālakāraṇavāraṇāt | etatkriyāṃ prāṇavaśe yaḥ karoti nirantaram || 26-147 || tasya yogasamṛddhiḥ syāt kālasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 26-148 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvanirṇaye sūkṣmayogasiddhyadhikaraṇe pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete siddhimantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde ṣaḍviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 26 ||
[atha saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca vividhāni tvayoktāni yogaśāstrāṇi bhairavi | sarvarūpatvamevāsyā mama kānte priyaṃvade || 27-1 || yogāṣṭāṅgaphalānyeva sarvatattvajalāni ca | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi śaktitattvakrameṇa tu || 27-2 || pūrvoktaprāṇavāyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ vāyudhāraṇam | pratyāhāraṃ dhāraṇākhyaṃ dhyānaṃ samādhimāvada || 27-2 || ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu lokeśa vakṣyāmi prāṇāyāmaphalāphalam | na gṛhṇīyādvistaraṃ tu svalpaṃ naiva tu kumbhayet || 27-4 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prakartavyaṃ saṅghātañca vivarjayet | pūrakāhlādasiddheśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ śatam || 27-5 || vṛddhyai prāṇalakṣaṇaṃ tu yasmin yasmin dine gatiḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣe śuklapakṣe tithitriṃśatphalodayaḥ || 27-6 || śuklapakṣe iḍāyāṃ tu kṛṣṇapakṣe'nyadeva hi | kuryāt sarvatra gamanaṃ suṣumnā bahurūpiṇī || 27-7 || tithitrayaṃ sitasyāpi pratipadādisambhavam | taddvayaṃ dakṣanāsāyāṃ vāyorjñeyaṃ mahāprabho || 27-8 || caturthīṃ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ vyāpyodayati devatā | vāmanāsāpuṭe dhyeyā vāyudhāraṇakarmaṇi || 27-9 || saptamīmaṣṭamīñcaiva navamīṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati | vāmanāsāpuṭe dhyeyā sādhakaiḥ kulapaṇḍitaiḥ || 27-10 || daśamyekādaśīṃ caiva dvādaśīṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati | vāyurdakṣiṇanāsāgre dhyeyo yogibhirīśvaraḥ || 27-11 || trayodaśīṃ vyāpya vāyuḥ paurṇamāsīṃ caturdaśīm | vāmanāsāpuṭe dhyeyaḥ saṃhāraharaṇāya ca || 27-12 || kṛṣṇapakṣaphalaṃ vakṣye yajjñātvā amaro bhavet | kālajñānī bhavet śīghraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 27-13 || pratipaddvitīyāmasya tṛtīyāmapi tasya ca | piṅgalāyāṃ samāvāpya vāyanīḥsarate sadā || 27-14 || caturthī pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ vāme vyāpya pratiṣṭhati | saptamīmaṣṭamīṃ vāyurnavamīṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ || 27-15 || daśamyekādaśīṃ vāyurvyāpya bhramati sarvadā | vāme ca dakṣiṇe'nyāni tithyādīni sadāniśam || 27-16 || yadā etadvyastabhāvaṃ samāpnoti narottamaḥ | tadaiva maraṇaṃ rogaṃ bandhunāśaṃ tripakṣake || 27-17 || bhinnajanmatithiṃ jñātvā tasmin kāle virodhayet | ārabhya janmanāśāya prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret || 27-18 || yadā pratyayabhāvena dehaṃ tyaktvā prayacchati | tadā nirudhya śvasanaṃ kālāgnau dhārayedadhaḥ || 27-19 || yāvat svasthānamāyāti tāvatkālaṃ samabhyaset | yāvanna calate dehaṃ yāvanna calate manaḥ || 27-20 || kramādabhyasataḥ puṃso dehe svedodgamo'dhamaḥ | madhyamaṃ kampasaṃyukto bhūmityāgaḥ parasya tu || 27-21 || ṣaṇmāsādbhūtadarśī syāt dūraśravaṇameva ca | saṃvatsarābhyāsayogā yogavidyāprakāśakṛt || 27-22 || yogī jānāti sarvāṇi tantrāṇi svakramāṇi ca | yadi darśanadṛṣṭiḥ syāttadā yogī na saṃśayaḥ || 27-23 || pratyāhāraphalaṃ vakṣye yatkṛtvā khecaro bhavet | īśvare bhaktimāpnoti dharmajñānī bhavennaraḥ || 27-24 || uttamasya guṇaprāptiryāvacchīlanamiṣyate | tāvajjapet sūkṣmavāyuḥ pratyāhāraprasiddhaye || 27-25 || indriyāṇāṃ vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣu nivartanam | balādāharaṇaṃ tebhyaḥ pratyāhāro vidhīyate || 27-26 || nānyakarmasu dharmeṣu śāstradharmeṣu yogirāṭ | patitaṃ cittamānīya sthāpayet pādapaṅkaje || 27-27 || dunīvāryaṃ dṛḍhacittaṃ duratyayamasammatam | balādāharaṇaṃ tasya pratyāhāro vidhīyate || 27-28 || etat pratyāhārabalāt yogī svastho bhaved dhruvam | akasmād bhāvamāpnoti bhāvarāśisthiro naraḥ || 27-29 || bhāvāt parataraṃ nāsti bhāvādhīnamidaṃ jagat | bhāvena labhyate yogaṃ tasmādbhāvaṃ samāśrayet || 27-30 || atha dhāraṇamāvakṣye yatkṛtvā dhairyarūpabhāk | trailokyamudare kṛtvā pūrṇaḥ tiṣṭhati yogirāṭ || 27-31 || aṅguṣṭhagulphajānūrusīmani liṅganābhiṣu | hṛdgrīvākaṇṭhadeśeṣu lambikāyāṃ tathā nasi || 27-32 || bhrūmadhye mastake mūdhnī dvādaśānte yathāvidhi | dhāraṇaṃ prāṇamaruto dhāraṇeti nigadyate || 27-33 || sarvanāḍīgranthideśe ṣaṭcakre devatālaye | brahmamārge dhāraṇaṃ yad dhāraṇeti nigadyate || 27-34 || dhāraṇaṃ mūladeśe tu kuṇḍalīṃ nāsikātaṭe | prāṇavāyoḥ praśamanaṃ dhāraṇeti nigadyate || 27-35 || tatra śrīcaraṇāmbhojamaṅgale cārutejasi | bhāvena sthāpayeccittaṃ dhāraṇāśaktimāpnuyāt || 27-36 || atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yat kṛtvā sarvago bhavet | dhyānayogād bhavenmokṣo matkulāgamanirgamaḥ || 27-37 || samāhitena manasā caitanyāntarvatīnā | ātmanyabhīṣṭadevānāṃ yogadhyānamihocyate || 27-38 || śrīpadāmbhoruhadvandve nakhakiñjalkacitrite | sthāpayitvā manaḥpadmaṃ dhyāyediṣṭagaṇaṃ mahat || 27-39 || atha samādhimāhātmyaṃ vadāmi tattvataḥ śṛṇu | yasyaiva kāraṇādeva pūrṇayogī bhavennaraḥ || 27-40 || samatvabhāvanā nityaṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ | samādhinā jayī bhūyādāndabhairaveśvara || 27-41 || saṃyogasiddhimātreṇa samādhisthaṃ mahājanam | prapaśyati mahāyogī samādhyaṣṭāṅgalakṣaṇaiḥ || 27-42 || etatsamādhimākṛtya yogī yogānvito bhavet | atha candre manaḥ kuryāt samāropya vibhāvayet || 27-43 || etadaṣṭāṅgasāreṇa yogayogyo bhavennaraḥ | yogayogād bhavenmokṣo mantrasiddhirakhaṇḍitā || 27-44 || yogaśāstra prakāreṇa sarve vai bhairavāḥ smṛtāḥ | yogaśāstrāt paraṃ śāstraṃ trailokye nāpi vartate || 27-45 || trailokyātītaśāstrāṇi yogāṅgavividhāni ca | jñātvā yā paśyati kṣipraṃ nānādhyāyena śaṅkara || 27-46 || kāmādidoṣanāśāya kathitaṃ jñānamuttamam | idānīṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi mantrayogārthanirṇayam || 27-47 || viśvaṃ śarīramākleśaṃ pañcabhūtāśrayaṃ prabho | candrasūryāgnitejobhiḥ jīvabrahmaikarūpakam || 27-48 || tisraḥ koṭyastadardhena śarīre nāḍayo matāḥ | teṣu mukhyā daśa proktāstāsu tisro vyavasthitāḥ || 27-49 || pradhānā merudaṇḍe'tra somasūryāgnirūpiṇī | nāḍītrayasvarūpeṇa yogamātā pratiṣṭhitā || 27-50 || iḍā vāme sthitā nāḍī śuklā tu candrarūpiṇī | śaktirūpā ca sā nāḍī sākṣādamṛtavigrahā || 27-51 || dakṣiṇe piṅgalākhyā tu puṃrūpā sūryavigrahā | dāḍimīkusumaprakhyā viṣākhyā parikītītā || 27-52 || merumadhye sthitā yā tu suṣumnā bahurūpiṇī | visargādbinduparyantaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati tattvataḥ || 27-53 || mūlādhāre trikoṇākhye icchājñānakriyātmake | madhye svayaṃbhūliṅgaṃ taṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham || 27-54 || tadūrdhve kāmabījaṃ tu kalāśāntīndunāyakam | tadūrdhve tu śikhākārā kuṇḍalī brahmavigrahā || 27-55 || tadbāhye hemavarṇābhaṃ vasuvarṇacaturdalam | drutahemasamaprakhyaṃ padmaṃ tatra vibhāvayet || 27-56 || tadūrdhve'gnisamaprakhyaṃ ṣaḍdalaṃ hīrakaprabham | vādilāntaṃ tu ṣaḍvarṇasahitaṃ rasapatrakam || 27-57 || svādhiṣṭhānākhyamamalaṃ yogināṃ hṛdayaṅgamam | mūlamādhāraṣaṭkānāṃ mūlādhāraṃ prakītītam || 27-58 || svaśabdena paraṃ liṅgaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ svaliṅgakam | tadūrdhve nābhideśe tu maṇipūraṃ mahāprabham || 27-59 || meghābhaṃ vidyutābhaṃ ca bahutejomayaṃ tataḥ | maṇimadbhannatatpadmaṃ maṇipūraṃ śaśiprabham || 27-60 || kathitaṃ sakalaṃ nātha hṛdayābjaṃ śṛṇu priya | daśabhiśca dalairyuktaṃ ḍādiphāntākṣarānvitam || 27-61 || śivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ padmaṃ viśvālokanakārakam | tadūrdhve'nāhataṃ padmaṃ hṛdisthaṃ kiraṇākulam || 27-62 || udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ kādiṭhāntākṣarānvitam | daladvādaśasaṃyuktamīśvarādyasamanvitam || 27-63 || tanmadhye bāṇaliṅgaṃ tu sūryāyutasamaprabham | śabdabrahmamayaṃ vakṣye'nāhatastatra dṛśyate || 27-64 || tenānāhatapadmākhyaṃ yogināṃ yogasādhanam | ānandasadanaṃ tattu siddhenādhiṣṭhitaṃ param || 27-65 || tadūdrdhvaṃ tu viśuddhākhyaṃ dalaṣoḍaśapaṅkajam | varṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ mahāprabham || 27-66 || yogināmadbhutasthānaṃ siddhivarṇaṃ samabhyaset | viśuddhaṃ tanute yasmāt jīvasya haṃsalokanāt || 27-67 || viśuddhaṃ padmamākhyātamākāśākhyaṃ mahāprabham | ājñācakraṃ tadūdrdhve tu athīnādhiṣṭhitaṃ param || 27-68 || ājñāsaṃkramaṇaṃ tatra gurorājñeti kītītam | kailāsākhyaṃ tadūrdhve tu tadūrdhve bodhanaṃ tataḥ || 27-69 || evaṃvidhāni cakrāṇi kathitāni tava prabho | tadūddhrvasthānamamalaṃ sahasrārāmbujaṃ param || 27-70 || bindusthānaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ gaṇānāṃ matamāśṛṇu | bauddhā vadanti cātmānamātmajñānī na īśvaraḥ || 27-71 || sarvaṃ nāstīti cārvākā nānākarmavivajītāḥ | vedanindāparāḥ sarve bauddhāḥ śūnyābhivādinaḥ || 27-72 || mama jñānāśritāḥ kāntāścīnabhūminivāsinaḥ | ātmānamaparicchinnaṃ vibhāvya bhāvyate mayā || 27-73 || śrīpadābje binduyugmaṃ nakhendumaṇḍalaṃ śubham | śivasthānaṃ pravadanti śaivāḥ śāktā maharṣayaḥ || 27-74 || paramaṃ puruṣaṃ nityaṃ vaiṣṇavāḥ prītikārakāḥ | hariharātmakaṃ rūpaṃ saṃvadanti pare janāḥ || 27-75 || devyāḥ padaṃ nityarūpāścaraṇānandanirbharāḥ | vadanti munayo mukhyāḥ puruṣaṃ prakṛtātmakam || 27-76 || puṃprakṛtyākhyabhāvena magnā bhānti mahītale | iti te kathitaṃ nātha mantrayogamanuttamam || 27-77 || yogamārgānusāreṇa bhāvayet susamāhitaḥ | ādau mahāpūrakeṇa mūle saṃyojayenmanaḥ || 27-78 || gudameḍhrantare śaktiṃ tāmākuñcya prabuddhayet | liṅgabhedakrameṇaiva prāpayedbinducakrakam || 27-79 || śambhulābhāṃ parāṃ śaktimekībhāvaivīcintayet | tatrotthitāmṛtarasaṃ drutalākṣārasopamam || 27-80 || pāyayitvā parāṃ śaktiṃ kṛṣṇākhyāṃ yogasiddhidām | ṣaṭcakrabhedakastatra santarpyāmṛtadhārayā || 27-81 || ānayettena mārgeṇa mūlādhāraṃ tataḥ sudhīḥ | evamabhyasyamānasya ahanyahani mārutam || 27-82 || jarāmaraṇaduḥkhādyairmucyate bhavabandhanāt | tantroktakathitā mantrāḥ sarve siddhyanti nānyathā || 27-83 || svayaṃ siddho bhavet kṣipraṃ yoge hi yogavallabhā | ye guṇāḥ santi devasya pañcakṛtyavidhāyinaḥ || 27-84 || te guṇāḥ sādhakavare bhavantyeva na cānyathā | iti te kathitaṃ nātha mantrayogamanuttamam || 27-85 || idānīṃ dhāraṇākhyañca śṛṇuṣva paramāñjanam | dikkālādyanavacchinnaṃ tvayi cittaṃ nidhāya ca || 27-86 || mayi vā sādhakavaro dhyātvā tanmayatāmiyāt | tanmayo bhavati kṣipraṃ jīvabrahmaikayojanāt || 27-87 || iṣṭapāde mati datvā nakhakiñjalkacitrite | athavā mananaṃ cittaṃ yadā kṣipraṃ na siddhyati || 27-88 || tadāvayavayogena yogī yogaṃ samabhyaset | pādāmbhoje mano dadyād nakhakiñjalkacitrite || 27-89 || jaṅghāyugme tathārāmakadalīkāṇḍamaṇḍite | ūrudvaye mattahastikaradaṇḍasamaprabhe || 27-90 || gaṅgāvarttagabhīre tu nābhau siddhibile tataḥ | udare vakṣasi tathā haste śrīvatsakaustubhe || 27-91 || pūrṇacandrāmṛtaprakhye lalāṭe cārukuṇḍale | śaṅkhacakragadāmbhojadordaṇḍaparimaṇḍite || 27-92 || sahasrādityasaṅkāśe kirīṭakuṇḍaladvaye | sthāneṣveṣu bhajenmantrī viśuddhaḥ śuddhacetasā || 27-93 || mano niveśya śrīkṛṣṇe vaiṣṇavo bhavati dhruvam | iti vaiṣṇavamākhyātaṃ dhyānaṃ sattvaṃ sunirmalam || 27-94 || viṣṇubhaktāḥ prabhajanti svādhiṣṭhānaṃ manaḥ sthirāḥ | yāvanmanolayaṃ yāti kṛṣṇe ātmani cintayet || 27-95 || tāvat svādhiṣṭhānasiddhiriti yogārthanirṇayaḥ | tāvajjapenmanuṃ mantrī japahomaṃ samabhyaset || 27-96 || ataḥ paraṃ na kiñcicca kṛtyamasti manohare | vidite paratattve tu samastainīyamairalam || 27-97 || ata eva sadā kuryāt dhyānaṃ yogaṃ manuṃ japet | tamaḥ parivṛte gehe ghaṭo dīpena dṛśyate || 27-98 || evaṃ sa yo vṛto hyātmā manunā gocarīkṛtaḥ | iti te kathitaṃ nātha mantrayogamanuttamam || 27-99 || kṛtvā pāpodbhavairduḥkhairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | durlabhaṃ viṣayāsaktaiḥ sulabhaṃ yogināmapi || 27-100 || sulabhaṃ na tyajedvidvān yadi siddhimihecchati | brahmajñānaṃ yogadhyānaṃ mantrajāpyaṃ kriyādikam || 27-101 || yaḥ karoti sadā bhadro vīrabhadro hi yogirāṭ | bhaktiṃ kuryāt sadā śambhoḥ śrīvidyāyāḥ parātparām || 27-102 || yogasādhanakāle ca kevalaṃ bhāvanādibhiḥ | mananaṃ kīrttanaṃ dhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam || 27-103 || arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam | etadbhaktiprasādena jīvanmuktastu sādhakaḥ || 27-104 || yogināṃ vallabho bhūtvā samādhistho bhavedyatiḥ || 27-105 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvārthanirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakrasārasaṅkete siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 27 ||
[athāṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca trailokyapūjite kānte idānīṃ siddhihetave | mantrasiddherlakṣaṇaṃ tu yogināmatidurlabham || 28-1 || tvanmukhāmbhoruhollāsaniḥsṛtaṃ paramāmṛtam | pītvā cakāra tantrāṇi yattatra nāsti tad vada || 28-2 || ānandabhairavī uvāca niścayaṃ te pravakṣyāmi ānandabhairaveśvara | mantrasiddherlakṣaṇaṃ tu yogamārgānukūlataḥ || 28-3 || nityaṃ cetasi susthire sthitapathakleśādidoṣakṣaya| sarvañcottamamantrasiddhikalitaṃ saṃlakṣaṇaṃ śobhanam | mṛtyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ jagatpatimatiṃ sandarśanañcottama| yogo'kleśavivarddhanaṃ samudayāccheśaprayogeṣṭabhāk || 28-4 || narendrāṇāṃ kāye praviśati haṭhāt kṣobhayati ta| pure teṣāmūdrdhvotkramaṇacarasyāvarapure | adhaḥchidraṃ paśyet khacaravanitāmelanamala| śṛṇoti pradhmāne jagati jagatāṃ kītīratulā || 28-5 || itīha siddhyādisulakṣaṇena | prayāti vaikuṇṭhapurīṃ manoramām | hitaṃ yadā paśyati sattvabhūbhṛtā| jagadvipakṣo nijapakṣamāśrayet || 28-6 || kītīrbhūṣaṇamādibhaktisaphalā bhuktikriyāsaṃyutā | devānāmatibhaktiyuktahṛdayaṃ sarvakriyādakṣatā | trailokyaṃ nijadāsyakarmanipuṇaṃ jitvā ciraṃ jīvati aṣṭāṅgābhyasanaṃ jagadvaśakaraṃ caitanyatāmuttamam || 28-7 || bhogecchārahitaṃ jagajjanacamatkārānukalpānvita| rogāṇāṃ daraṇaṃ viraktahṛdayaṃ vairāgyabhaktipriyam | tyāgaṃ saṃsaraṇaṃ tathā śamadayāmāyābdhijālasya vā | eśvaryaṃ kavitārasaṃ dhanajanaṃ lakṣmīgaṇaṃ jāpanam || 28-8 || ullāsaṃ hṛdayāmbuje sutadhanaṃ sammānanaṃ satpatha| vāñchāsāgararatnapūrṇaghaṭitaṃ kāntāgaṇānmoditam | saṅketādimanupriyaṃ hariharabrahmaikabhāvānvita| lokānāṃ gurutānirantaraśivānandaika mudrādharam || 28-9 || etaduktaṃ mahādevottaratantranirūpaṇam | mantrasiddhilakṣaṇaṃ taduttamādhamamadhyamam || 28-10 || munayo devamukhyāśca nityaṃ janmani janmani | divyarūpaṃ narakule dhṛtvā tṛpyanti cāniśam || 28-11 || tavaivāpi mamaivāpi tarpaṇaṃ homabhojanam | sarvadā kurute sādhu tanmano bhavati dhruvam || 28-12 || etatprāṇavāyupāne sūkṣmacandraniyojane | kartavyaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryaṃ divārātrau muhurmuhuḥ || 28-13 || adyaitat karma saṃskuryāt yogasādhanamuttamam | yaḥ śrīmān sādhu sadvaktā duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati || 28-14 || etaddoṣasamūhaṃ tu vadāmi tattvataḥ śṛṇu | chinnādidoṣaduṣṭānāṃ yogatattvena sidhyati || 28-15 || devendra pāśaduṣṭā ca bhuvaneśī susiddhidā | ārādhitā mahāvidyā vīryadarpavivajītā || 28-16 || ekākṣarī vīryahīnā vāgbhavena mahojjvalā | tadavadyuttamā devī tārasampuṭahaṃsinī || 28-17 || āviddhā kāmarājena vidyā kāmeśvarī parā | śareṇa pīḍitā pūrvaṃ bhuvaneśyāḥ pratiṣṭhitā || 28-18 || yā kumārī mahāvidyā yayā saptāribodhikā | tārācandrasvarūpāhaṃ śivaśaktyā ca kevalam || 28-19 || bhairavīṇāṃ hi vidyānāṃ doṣajālaṃ śṛṇu prabho | etāndoṣānpraṇaśyanti yogamārgānusāriṇaḥ || 28-20 || yataḥ kuṇḍalinī devī yogena cetanāmukhī | ato yogaṃ sadā kuryāt sarvamantraprasiddhaye || 28-21 || bhairavī vidhiśaptā ca dagdhā ca kīlitā tathā | saiva saṃhārakarī mohitā cānumoditā || 28-22 || mahāmadonmattacittā rmūcchitā vīryavajītā | stambhitā māritācchinnā viddhā ruddhā ca trāsitā || 28-23 || nirbījā śaktihīnā ca suptā mattā ca ghūṇītā | parāṅmukhī netrahīnā sā bhītā duḥsaṃskṛtā || 28-24 || suṣuptā bheditā prauḍhā bālikā mālinī kṣamā | bhayadā yuvatī krūrā dāmbhikā śokasaṅkaṭā || 28-25 || nisṃtriśakā siddhihīnā kūṭasthā mandabuddhidā | hīnakarṇā hīnanāsā atikruddhāṅgabhaṅgurā || 28-26 || kalahā kalahaprītā bhraṣṭasthānakṣayākulā | dharmabhraṣṭā cātivṛddhātibālā siddhināśinī || 28-27 || kṛtavīryā mahābhīmā krodhapuṃjā ca dhvaṃsinī | kālavidyā sūkṣmadharmā vidharmā dharmamohinī || 28-28 || durgasthitā kṣiptacittā pracaṇḍā caṇḍagāminī | ulkāvaccalatī tīkṣṇā mandāhārā niraṃśakā || 28-29 || tattvahīnā kekarā ca dhūṇītāliṅgitā jitā | atiguptā kṣudhārttā ca dhūrttā dhyānasthirāsthirā || 28-30 || etā vidyāḥ prasannāḥ syuryogakālanirodhanāt | vīrabhāvena siddhiḥ syāt puraścaraṇakarmaṇā || 28-31 || ānandabhairavī uvāca tatra vīro yajet kāntāṃ parakīyāmathāpi vā | svīyāmalaṅkārayuktāṃ sundarīṃ cāruhāsinīm || 28-32 || madanānalataptāṅgīmāsavānanda vigrahām | yoginīṃ kaulinīṃ yogyāṃ dharmaśīlāṃ kulapriyām || 28-33 || dīkṣitāṃ lolavadanāṃ vadanāmbhojamohinīm | nānādeśasthitāṃ kanyāṃ yuvatīṃ paripūjayet || 28-34 || jāpikāṃ mandahāsyāṃ ca mandamanda gatipriyām | kṛśāṅgīmatisaundaryāmalaṅkṛtakalevarām || 28-35 || koṭikanyāpradānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | tatphalaṃ labhate sadyaḥ kāminīparipūjanāt || 28-36 || tataḥ ṣoḍaśakanyāśca yoginyo yogasiddhaye | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 28-37 || nānāvidhaiḥ piṣṭakānnaiḥ pakvānnaiḥ prāṇasambhavaiḥ | dadhidugdhaghṛtaiścāpi navanītaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ || 28-38 || upalākhaṇḍamiśrānnaiḥ nānārasaphalānvitaiḥ | cūḍādibhirnārikelaiḥ kapilairnāgaraṅgakaiḥ || 28-39 || nānāgandhaphalaiścaiva nānāgandhasamanvitaiḥ | mṛganābhicandanaiśca śrīkhaṇḍairnavapallavaiḥ || 28-40 || pūjayettāḥ prayatnena jalajaiḥ sthalajaistathā | nānāsugandhipuṣpaiśca raktacandanakuṅkumaiḥ || 28-41 || pūjayet śūnyagṛhe ca nirjane vipine tathā | kuladevīṃ samānīya svāgataṃ pravadedanu || 28-42 || arghodakena saṃśodhyāmṛtīkaraṇamācaret | śaktiñcābhimukhīṃ nītvā vīrayogī bhaveddhruvam || 28-43 || śaktiṃ ca ṣoḍaśī devīṃ kulacakrapriyāṃ śubhām | mahāśaktiṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabhe śrīkalāvatīm || 28-44 || brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā veśyā ca sundarī | kulabhūṣāsamākrāntā māninī nātipiṅgalā || 28-45 || rajakī naṭakī kaulā śyāmāṅgī sthūlavigrahā | saṅketāgamanā bhāryā vidagdhā rañjakī tathā || 28-46 || khaṭakī kolakanyā ca kulamārgapravatīkā | sarvāṅgasundarī bhavyā cārunetrā hasanmukhī || 28-47 || yadyaddīkṣāratāstāstu deyā dīkṣā tadā prabho | sūkṣmatantrānusāreṇa kathitaṃ pūrvasūcitam || 28-48 || sarvāṅgasundarī śuddhā śuddhalokakulodbhavā | yuvatī yoganiratā sā devī ḍākinī matā || 28-49 || tāmānīya mahāmantraṃ dāpayediṣṭasiddhaye | tatastāḥ pūjanīyāstu dīkṣāhīnāstu nācaret || 28-50 || śrīkṛṣṇarāmamantraṃ tu dāpayetsattvasiddhaye | tābhya ādau tato mṛtyuñjayamantraṃ tataścaret || 28-51 || ānandabhairavībījaṃ devīṃ śaktiṃ svabījakam | athavā siddhamantraṃ tu śrīvidyāyāḥ pradāpayet || 28-52 || kiṃ vā kevalamāyāṃ tu krodhāruṇakarākṛtim | jvalantīṃ mūlapadme tu svayambhūkusumākarām || 28-53 || etadbhūtāṃ mahāmāyāṃ tasmai datvā jayī bhavet | ādau vāmakarṇapuṭe agnivāraṃ pare trayam
