|| 28-54 || ataḥ śikṣāṃ sadānandadīkṣānte kārayed budhaḥ | dīkṣāmūlaṃ japaṃ sarvaṃ dīkṣāmūlaṃ guroḥ kṛpā || 28-55 || dīkṣāmāśritya māyāṃ yā japet sā khecarī parā | tasyāḥ pūjanamātreṇa prasannāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 28-56 || jagatāṃ jagadīśānāṃ nārīrūpeṇa saṃsthitiḥ | ahaṃ nārī na sandehaḥ sundarī kutsitā parā || 28-57 || sundarīpālanārthāya vināśāyāśu kutsitā | sādhakasya bhrāntirūpā saṃhitāḥ paribhāvayet || 28-58 || yā parā mokṣadā vidyā sundarī kāmacāriṇī | bhāvinī sā bhavānī ca tāṃ vidyāṃ paripūjayet || 28-59 || tasyā aṅge sthirā nityaṃ devatāyā ahaṃ prabho | yaśca yogī sarvasamaḥ sa sarvātmā nayet kila || 28-60 || anyathā siddhihāniḥ syād bhāvābhāvavicāraṇāt | binā bhāvaṃ na siddhyettu bhāvānāṃ bhāvarāśiga || 28-61 || kulapuraścaraṇaṃ kuryāt kulākulavimuktaye | yogī syādavyayo dhīro vidvānmukto hi jīvane || 28-62 || brāhmaṇīṃ sundarīṃ caiva saṃsthāpya kramato yajet | vāmahaste mahārghyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe āsanādikam || 28-63 || dadyāt pādyamāsanāni tattannāmnā ca svāgatam | tattadā arghapātrasthajalena prokṣayecca tāḥ || 28-64 || dhenumudrāṃ samākṛtya vaṃ mantreṇāmṛtīkriyām | amṛtīkaraṇānte ca rūpabhedaṃ samānayet || 28-65 || saṃjñābhirnāmakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā cāsanamarpayet | śrībhairavī uvāca atha kānta pravakṣyāmi ṣaṭcakrabhedanakriyām || 28-66 || yatkṛtvā amarā loke vicaranti carācare | akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 28-67 || yogena jīvavargāśca bhavantyamararūpiṇaḥ | ṣaṭcakre ca mahāpadme sarvasattvaguṇānvite || 28-68 || dharmādharme manorājye sarvavidyānidhau kratau | kalikalmaṣamukhyānāṃ sarvapāpāpahārakam || 28-69 || mano datvā mahākāle jīvāḥ sarvatra gāminaḥ | etacchruttvā mahāvīro vivekī paramārthavit || 28-70 || punajījñāsayāmāsa jñānajñeyena śaṅkara | ānandabhairava uvāca ṣaṭcakrabhedanakathāṃ kathayasva varānane || 28-71 || hitāya sarvajantūnāṃ hiraṇyavarṇamaṇḍitam | prakāśayasva varade yogānāmudayaṃ vada || 28-72 || yena yogena dhīrāṇāṃ hitārthaṃ vāñchitaṃ mayā | kālakrameṇa siddhiḥ syāt kālajālavināśanāt || 28-73 || kālakṣālanahetośca punarudyāpanaṃ kṛtam | ānandabhairavī uvāca ādau kuryāt parānandaṃ rasasāgarasambhavam || 28-74 || māndyaṃ mandaguṇopetaṃ śṛṇu tatkramamuttamam | stotraṃ kuryāt mūlapadme kuṇḍalinyāḥ puraṣkriyām || 28-75 || puraścaraṇakāle tu japānte nityakarmaṇi | kāmyakarmaṇi dharmeṣu tathaiva dharmakarmasu || 28-76 || gurvādyagurunityeṣu bhaktimākṛtya sampaṭhet | oṃ namo gurave oṃ namo gurvambaparadevatāyai || 28-77 || sarvadharmasvarūpāyai sarvajñānasvarūpāyai | oṃ bhavavibhavāyai oṃ dakṣayajñavināśinyai || 28-78 || oṃ bhadrakālyai oṃ kapālinyai oṃ umāyai oṃ māheśvaryai oṃ sarvasaṅkaṭatāriṇyai oṃ mahādevyai namo namaḥ || 28-79 || oṃ yā māyā mayadānavakṣayakarī śaktiḥ kṣamā karttṛkā | śumbhaśrīmahiṣāsurāsurabalaprātrolacaṇḍāmahā | bhadrārdrā rudhirapriyā priyakarī krodhāṅgaraktotpalā | cāmuṇḍā raṇaraktabījarajanī jyotsnā mukhendīvarā || 28-80 || yā jāyā jayadāyinī nṛgṛhiṇī bhītyāpahā bhairavī | nityā sā parirakṣaṇaṃ kuru śivā sārasvatotpattaye | sā me pātu kalevarasya viṣayāhlādendriyāṇāṃ balaṃ vakṣaḥ sthāyinamulvaṇojjvalaśikhākārādijīvāñcitā || 28-81|| kṛtvā yogakulānvitaṃ svabhavane nityaṃ manorañjana| nityaṃ saṃyamatatparaṃ paratare bhaktikriyānirmalam | śambho rakṣarajo'panīśacaraṇāmbhoje sadā bhāvana| vidyārthapriyadarśanaṃ trijagatāṃ saṃyamyayogī bhavet || 28-82 || ākāṅkṣāparivajītaṃ nijaguroḥ sevāparaṃ pāvana| premāhlādakathācyutaṃ kuṭilatāhiṃsāpamānapriyam | kālakṣepaṇa doṣajālarahitaṃ śāktaṃ subhaktaṃ pati| śrīśaktipriyavallabhaṃ surucirajñānāntaraṃ māninam || 28-83 || mālāsūkṣma susūkṣmabaddhanilayaṃ sallakṣaṇaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ nānākāraṇakāraṇaṃ sasaraṇaṃ sākārabrahmārpaṇam | nityā sā jaḍitaṃ mahāntamakhile yogāsanajñānina| taṃ vande puruṣottamaṃ trijagatāmaṃśārkahaṃsaṃ param || 28-84 || māyāṅke pratibhāti cārunayānāhlādaikabījaṃ vidhi| kallolāvikulākulā samatulā kālāgnivāhānanā | hālāhelana kaulakālakalikā keyūrahārānanā | sarvāṅgā mama pātu pītavasanā śīghrāsanā vatsalā || 28-85 || sā bālābalavāhanā sugahanā sammānanā dhāraṇā | khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ khacarācarā kulacarā vācācarā vaṅkharā | caṃ caṃ caṃ camarīharībhagavatī gāthāgatāḥ saṅgatiḥ | bāhau me paripātu paṅkajamukhī yā caṇḍamuṇḍāpahā || 28-86 || kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ kamalākalā gatiphalā phūtkārapherūtkarā | paṃ paṃ paṃ paramā ramā jayagamā vyāsaṅgamā jaṅgamā | taṃ taṃ taṃ timirāruṇā sakaruṇā mātāvalā tāriṇī | bhaṃ bhaṃ bhaṃ bhayahāriṇī priyakarī sā me bhavatvantarā || 28-87 || jhaṃ jhaṃ jhaṃ jharajharmarīgatipathasthātā ramānanditaṃ maṃ maṃ maṃ malinaṃ hi māṃ hayagatāṃ hantrīṃ ripūṇāṃ hi tām | bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇī raṇamukhe śatroḥ kulāgnisthitā | sā sā sā bhavatu prabhāvapaṭalā dīptāṅghrayugmojjvalā || 28-88 || gaṃ gaṃ gaṃ gururūpiṇī gaṇapaterānandapuñjodayā tārāsārasaroruhāruṇakalā koṭiprabhālocanā | netraṃ pātu(sadā)śivapriyapathā kauṭyāyutārkaprabhā | tuṇḍaṃ muṇḍavibhūṣaṇā naraśiromālā vilolā samā || 28-89 || yogeśī śaśiśekharolvaṇakathālāpodayā mānavī | śīrṣaṃ pātu lalāṭakarṇa yugalānantastataḥ sarvadā | mūrttaṃ meruśikhā sthitā vyavatu me gaṇḍasthalaṃ kaivalī | tuṣṭaṃ cāṣṭamaṣaṣṭikādharatalaṃ dhātrī dharādhāriṇī || 28-90 || nāsāgradvayagahvaraṃ bhṛgutarā netratrayaṃ tāriṇī | keśān kuntalakālikā sukapilā kailāsaśailāsanā | kaṅkālāmalamālikā suvasanā dantāvalīṃ daityahā | bāhyaṃ mantramanantaśāstrataraṇī sañjñāvacaḥstambhinī || 28-91 || haṃ haṃ haṃ narahāraghoraramaṇī sañcāriṇī pātu me | śatrūṇāṃ dalanaṃ karotu niyataṃ me caṇḍamuṇḍāpahā | bhīmā sandahatu pratāpatapanā saṃvarddhanaṃ vaddhīnī | mandārapriyagandhavibhramamadā vaidagdhamohāntarā || 28-92 || śyāmā pātu pataṅgakoṭininadā haṅkāraphaṭkāriṇī | ānandotsavasarvasārajayadā sarvatra sā rakṣikā | kṣauṃ kṣauṃ kṣauṃ kaṭhinākṣarā kṣayakarī sarvāṅgadoṣaṃhanā | dehāreḥ kacahā parā kacakucākīlālapūrāśitā || 28-93 || ghaṃ ghaṃ ghaṃ ghaṭaghargharā vighaṭitā jāyāpateḥ pātu me kalpe kalpā kulānāmatibhayakalitaṃ sarvatra me vigraham | nidrodrāvitakālikā mama kulaṃ laṅkātaṭācchādinī naṃ naṃ naṃ nayanānanā sukamalā sā lākinī lakṣaṇā || 28-94 || kukṣau pṛṣṭhatalaṃ sadā mama dhanaṃ sā pātu mudrāmayī | mokṣaṃ pātu karālakālarajakī yā rañjakī kautukī | kṛtyā nāpitakanyakā śaśimukhī sūkṣmā mama prāṇaga| mandārapriyamālayā maṇimayagranthyā mahanmaṇḍitā || 28-95 || pūjyā yogibhirutsukī bhagavatī mūlasthitā satkriyā | mattā pātu pativratā mama gṛhaṃ dharmaṃ yaśaḥ śreyasam | dharmāmbhoruhamadhyadarśanikare kālī mahāyoginī | mattānāmatidarpahā haraśiromālā kalā kevalā || 28-96 || me guhyaṃ jayameva liṅgamapi me mūlāmbujaṃ pātu sā | yā kanyā himaparvatasya bhayahā pāyānnitambasthalam | sarveṣāṃ hṛdayodayānalaśikhāśaktirmanorūpiṇī | me bhaktiṃ paripātu kāmakuśalā lakṣmīḥ priyā me prabho || 28-97 || gaurī gauravakāriṇī bhuvi mahāmāyā mahāmohahā | vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ varavāruṇī sumadirā me pātu nityaṃ kaṭim | kūṭā sā ravicandravahnirahitā svecchāmayī me mukham || 28-98 || etatstotraṃ paṭhed yastu sarvakāle ca sarvadā | sa bhavet kālayogendro mahāvidyānidhirbhavet || 28-99 || mūlapadmabodhane ca mūlaprakṛtisādhane | nijamantrabodhane ca ghorasaṅkaṭakālake || 28-100 || āpadastasya naśyanti andhakāraṃ binā raviḥ | sarvakāle sarvadeśe mahāpātakaghātakaḥ || 28-101 || sa bhaved yoginīputraḥ kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ || 28-102 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane bhāvāsananirṇaye pāśavakalpe ṣaṭcakra prakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde kandavāsinistotraṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 28 ||
[athaikonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha ṣaṭcakrayogaṃ ca pravakṣyāmīha tattvataḥ | kuṇḍalīyogavividhaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavennaraḥ || 29-1 || mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ ṣaṭcakrabhedanaṃ matam | ṣaṭcakre yogaśāstrāṇi vividhāni vasanti hi || 29-2 || yo jānātīha ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvaśāstrārthavidbhavet | catudrdalaṃ mūlapadmaṃ vādisāntārṇasambhavam || 29-3 || hiraṇyavarṇamamalaṃ dhyāyedyogī punaḥ punaḥ | nirjane vipine śūnye paśupakṣigaṇāvṛte || 29-4 || nirbhaye sundare deśe dubhīkṣādivivajīte | kṛtvā dṛḍhāsanaṃ mantrī yogamārgaparo bhavet || 29-5 || tadā yogī bhavet kṣipraṃ mama śāstrānusārataḥ | pūrvadale vakāraṃ ca dhyāyedyogī sadā sukhī || 29-6 || suvarṇavarṇaṃ hitakāriṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ satvodbhavaṃ pūrvadalasthitaṃ sukham | mattapriyaṃ vāraṇamattamandiraṃ mantrārthakaṃ śītalarūpadhāriṇam || 29-7 || yogānubhāvāśrayakālamandiraṃ tejomayaṃ siddhisamṛddhidaṃ gurum | ādyākṣaraṃ vaṃ varabhāvasādhanaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhāvanapañcamacyutam || 29-8 || dhyāyet śakāraṃ kanakācalaprabhaṃ gaurīpateḥ śrīkaraṇaṃ purāṇam | lakṣmīpriyaṃ sarvasuvarṇaveṣṭitaṃ sadā mudā dakṣiṇapatramuttamam || 29-9 || śamīśvarīṣaṣṭhaguṇāvataṃsaṃ ṣaṭpadmasambhedanakārakaṃ param | parāparasthānanivāsinaṃ guṇaṃ hemācalaṃ patramahaṃ bhajāmi || 29-10 || sakāramānandarasaṃ priyaṃ priyaṃ dhyāye mahāhāṭakaparvatāgrakam | dhyāye mudāhaṃ ghananāthamandire māyāmahāmohavināśanaṃ jayam || 29-11 || caturbhujaṃ bhujayugaṃ aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ tathā | aṣṭahastaṃ sadā dhyāyenmantrī bhāvaviśuddhaye || 29-12 || tato dhyāyet kaṇīkāyāṃ madhyadeśe manoramam | svayambhūliṅgaparamaṃ yogināṃ yogasiddhidam || 29-13 || prātaḥ sūryasamaprakhyaṃ taḍitkoṭisamaprabham | taṃ saṃveṣṭya mahādevī kuṇḍalī yogadāyinī || 29-14 || sārdhatriveṣṭanagranthiyutā sā muktidāyinī | nidritā sā sadā bhadrā mahāpātakaghātinī || 29-15 || nirantaraṃ tasya śīrṣe vibhāti śaśadhāriṇī | tacchvāsadhāriṇī nityā jagatāṃ prāṇadhāriṇī || 29-16 || suptā sarpasamā bhrāntiḥ yathārkaśatakoṭayaḥ | yadā liṅgaṃ sā vihāya prāktiṣṭhati mahāpathe || 29-17 || tadā siddho bhavedyogī dhyānadhāraṇakṛt śuciḥ | sadānandamayo nityaścaitanyakuṇḍalī yadā || 29-18 || suṣumnā nāḍikāmadhye mahāsūkṣmavile sthitaḥ | mano nidhāya yo yogī śvāsamārgaparo bhavet || 29-19 || tadā sā dravati kṣipraṃ caitanyā kuṇḍalī parā | pṛṣṭhadeśe mahādaṇḍe merumūle mahāprabhe || 29-20 || mūlādibrahmarandhrādhaḥ sadāsthirūpadhārakaḥ | kanakācalanāmnā ca pratibhāti jagattraye || 29-21 || tanmadhye paramā sūkṣmā suṣumnā bahurūpiṇī | manomunisvarūpā ca manaścaitanyakāriṇī || 29-22 || tanmadhye bhāti vajrākhyāghorapātakanāśinī | siddhidābhāvavijñānāṃ mokṣadā kularūpiṇām || 29-23 || tanmadhye citriṇī devī devatāprītivaddhīnī | hitaiṣiṇī mahāmāyā kālajālavināśinī || 29-24 || sā pāti sakalān cakrān padmarūpadharān parān | trailokyamaṇḍalagatān sākṣādamṛtavigrahān || 29-25 || svayaṃ dadhāra sā devī citrākhyā cārutejasī | tale pṛṣṭhe ūdrdhvadeśe śīrṣe vakṣasi nābhiṣu || 29-26 || kaṇṭhakūpe cakramadhye brahmāṇḍaṃ pāti sarvadā | śarīrātmakamīśārthaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 29-27 || citrāsugrathanaṃ padmaṃ yo'vabhāvyati bhāvakaḥ | bhāvena labhyate yogaṃ bhāvena bhāvyate śivaḥ || 29-28 || bhāvena śaktimāpnoti tasmādbhāvaṃ samāśrayet | ṣaṭcakrabhāvanāṃ kṛtvā mahāyogī bhavennaraḥ || 29-29 || sarvadharmānvito bhūtvā rājate kṣitimaṇḍale | sarvatragāmī sa bhavet yadi padme manolayam || 29-30 || padmabhāvanamātreṇa ākāśasadṛśo bhavet | mahāpadme mano datvā mahābhakto bhaveddhruvam || 29-31 || yadi bhakto bhavennātha tadā mukto na saṃśayaḥ | yadi mukto mahīmadhye dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ || 29-32 || tadā kālaparāṃ jñātvā sarvadarśī ca sarvavit | sarvajñaḥ sarvatobhadro bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 29-33 || citriṇī madhyadeśe ca brahmanāḍī mahāprabhā | sarvasiddhipradā nityā sā devī sakalā kalā || 29-34 || vyomarūpā bhagavatī sarvacaitanyarūpiṇī | ekarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma brahmātītaṃ jagattrayam || 29-35 || yadā jagattrayaṃ brahma tadā sattvālayaṃ prabho | mahālaye mano datvā sarvakālajayo bhavet || 29-36 || mṛtyuñjayo mahāvīro mahācchatro mahāgatiḥ | sarvavyāpakarūpeṇa īśvaratvena bhāṣate || 29-37 || sarvadā mantrasambhūto viśālākṣaḥ prasannadhīḥ | ekasthānasthito yāti nakṣatraṃ sa hi śaṅkara || 29-38 || ekadṛṣṭiḥ kṣudhātṛṣṇārahito vākyavajītaḥ | nirākāre mano dadyāttadā mahānayaṃ prabho || 29-39 || kintu nāthājñānināṃ hi nāpi nāpi mahālayaḥ | mahāpralaya evaṃ hi yogināṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29-40 || yadā manoyoga viśuddhaye manolayaṃ yaḥ kurute'pyahanīśam | sa eva mokṣo guṇasindhurūpī kālāgnirūpī nijadaivadaivataḥ || 29-41 || mahāmanoyoga vikāravajītaḥ | kāmakriyā kāṇḍaviśuddhamaṇḍitaḥ | hito gatīnāṃ matimānnirasto | mahālayastho'mara eva bhaktaḥ || 29-42 || mānī vicārārthavivekacittaś(--) cāturya cittolbaṇatāvivajītaḥ | yogī bhavetsādhaka cakravartī | vyomāmbuje cittavisarjanaṃ sadā || 29-43 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane ṣaṭcakra prakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde mahāpralayanāmā ekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 29 ||
[atha triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha vakṣye mahākāla mūlapadmavivecanam | yat kṛtvā amaro bhūtvā vaset kālacatuṣṭayam || 30-1 || atha ṣaṭcakrabhedārthe bhedinīśaktimāśrayet | chedinīṃ sarvagranthīnāṃ yoginīṃ samupāśrayet || 30-2 || tasyā mantrān pravakṣyāmi yena siddho bhavennaraḥ | ādau śṛṇu mahāmantraṃ bhedinyāḥ paraṃ manum || 30-3 || ādau kālīṃsamutkṛtya brahmamantraṃ tataḥ param | devyāḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya bhedanī tadanantaram || 30-4 || tato hi mama gṛhṇīyāt prāpaya dvayameva ca | cittacañcīśabdānte māṃ rakṣa yugmameva ca || 30-5 || bhedinī mama śabdānte akālamaraṇaṃ hara | hara yugmaṃ svaṃ mahāpāpaṃ namo namo'gnijāyayā || 30-6 || etanmantraṃ japettatra ḍākinīrakṣasi prabho | ādau praṇavamuddhṛtya brahmamantraṃ tataḥ param || 30-7 || śāmbhavīti tataścoktvā brāhmaṇīti padaṃ tataḥ | manoniveśaṃ kurute tārayeti dvidhāpadam || 30-8 || chedinīpadamuddhṛtya mama mānasaśabdataḥ | mahāndhakāramuddhṛtya chedayeti dvidhāpadam || 30-9 || svāhāntaṃ manumuddhṛtya japenmūlāmbuje sudhīḥ | etanmantraprasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 30-10 || tathā strīyoginīmantraṃ japettatraiva śaṅkara | oṃ ghorarūpiṇipadaṃ sarvavyāpini śaṅkara || 30-11 || mahāyogini me pāpaṃ śokaṃ rogaṃ hareti ca | vipakṣaṃ chedayetyuktvā yogaṃ mayyarpaya dvayam || 30-12 || svāhāntaṃ manumuddhṛtya japādyogī bhavennaraḥ | khecaratvaṃ samāpnoti yogābhyāsena yogirāṭ || 30-13 || ḍākinīṃ brahmaṇā yuktāṃ mūle dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ | japenmantraṃ sadāyogī brahmamantreṇa yogavit || 30-14 || brahmamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi tajjāpenāpi yogirāṭ | brahmamantraprasādena jaḍo yogī na saṃśayaḥ || 30-15 || praṇavatrayamuddhṛtya dīrghapraṇavayugmakam | tadante praṇavatrīṇi brahma brahma trayaṃ trayam || 30-16 || sarvasiddhipadasyānte pālayeti ca māṃ padam | sattvaṃ guṇo rakṣa rakṣa māyāsvāhāpadaṃ japet || 30-17 || ḍākinīmantrarājañca śṛṇuṣva parameśvara | yajjaptvā ḍākinī vaśyā trailokyasthitipālakāḥ || 30-18 || yo japet ḍākinīmantraṃ caitanyā kuṇḍalī jhaṭit | anāyāsena siddhiḥ syāt paramātmapradarśanam || 30-19 || māyātrayaṃ samuddhṛtya praṇavaikaṃ tataḥ param | ḍākinyante mahāśabdaṃ ḍākinyambapadaṃ tataḥ || 30-20 || punaḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya māyātrayaṃ tataḥ param | mama yogasiddhimante sādhayeti dvidhāpadam || 30-21 || manumuddhṛtya deveśi japādyogī bhavejjaḍaḥ | japtvā sampūjayenmantrī puraścaraṇasiddhaye || 30-22 || sarvatra cittasāmyena dravyādivividhāni ca | pūjayitvā mūlapadme cittopakaraṇena ca || 30-23 || tato mānasajāpañca stotrañca kālipāvanam | paṭhitvā yogirāṭ bhūttvā vaset ṣaṭcakraveśmani || 30-24 || śaktiyuktaṃ vidhiṃ yastu stauti nityaṃ maheśvara | tasyaiva pālanārthāya mama yantraṃ mahītale || 30-25 || tat stotraṃ śṛṇu yogārthaṃ sāvadhānāvadhāraya | etatstotraprasādena mahālayavaśo bhavet || 30-26 || brahmāṇaṃ haṃsasaṅghāyutaśaraṇavadāvāhanaṃ devavaktra| vidyādānaikahetuṃ timicaranayanāgnīnduphullāravindam vāgīśaṃ vāggatisthaṃ matimatavimalaṃ bālārkaṃ cāruvarṇaṃ | ḍākinyāliṅgitaṃ taṃ suranaravaradaṃ bhāvayenmūlapadme || 30-27 || nityāṃ brahmaparāyaṇāṃ sukhamayīṃ dhyāyenmudā ḍākinī| raktāṃ gacchavimohinīṃ kulapathe jñānākulajñāninīm | mūlāmbhoruhamadhyadeśanikaṭe bhūvimbamadhye prabhā| hetusthāṃ gatimohinīṃ śrutibhujāṃ vidyāṃ bhavāhlādinīm || 30-28 || vidyāvāstavamālayā galatalaprālambaśobhākarā| dhyātvā mūlaniketane nijakule yaḥ stauti bhaktyā sudhīḥ | nānākāravikārasārakiraṇāṃ kartrī vidho yoginā| mukhyāṃ mukhyajanasthitāṃ sthitimatiṃ sattvāśritāmāśraye || 30-29 || yā devī navaḍākinī svaramaṇī vijñāninī mohinī | māṃ pātu pirayakāminī bhavavidherānandasindhūdbhavā | me mūlaṃ guṇabhāsinī pracayatu śrīḥ kītīcakraṃ hi mā| nityā siddhiguṇodayā suradayā śrīsaṃjñayā mohitā || 30-30 || tanmadhye paramākalā kulaphalā bāṇaprakāṇḍākarā rākā rāśaṣasādaśā śaśighaṭā lolāmalā komalā | sā mātā navamālinī mama kulaṃ mūlāmbujaṃ sarvadā | sā devī lavarākiṇī kaliphalollāsaikabījāntarā || 30-31 || dhātrī dhairyavatī satī madhumatī vidyāvatī bhāratī | kalyāṇī kulakanyakādharanarārūpā hi sūkṣmāspadā | mokṣasthā sthitipūjitā sthitigatā mātā śubhā yoginā| naumi śrībhavikāśayāṃ śamanagāṃ gītodgatāṃ gopanām || 30-32 || kalkeśīṃ kulapaṇḍitāṃ kulapathagranthikriyācchedinī| nityāṃ tāṃ guṇapaṇḍitāṃ pracapalāṃ mālāśatārkāruṇām | vidyāṃ caṇḍaguṇodayāṃ samudayāṃ trailokyarakṣākṣarā| brahmajñānanivāsinīṃ sitaśubhānandaikabījodgatām || 30-33 || gītārthānubhavapirayāṃ sakalayā siddhaprabhāpāṭalām | kāmākhyāṃ prabhajāmi janmanilayāṃ hetupirayāṃ satkriyām | siddhau sādhanatatparaṃ parataraṃ sākārarūpāyitām || 30-34 || brahmajñānaṃ nidānaṃ guṇanidhinayanaṃ kāraṇānandayānam | brahmāṇaṃ brahmabījaṃ rajanijayajanaṃ yāgakāryānurāgam || 30-35 || śokātītaṃ vinītaṃ narajalavacanaṃ sarvavidyāvidhijñam | sārāt sāraṃ taruṃ taṃ sakalatimirahaṃ haṃsagaṃ pūjayāmi || 30-36 || etatsambandhamārgaṃ navanavadalagaṃ vedavedāṅgavijñam | mūlāmbhojaprakāśaṃ taruṇaraviśaśipronnatākārasāram || 30-37 || bhāvākhyaṃ bhāvasiddhaṃ jayajayadavidhiṃ dhyānagamyaṃ purāṇam pārākhyaṃ pāraṇāyaṃ parajanajanitaṃ brahmarūpaṃ bhajāmi || 30-38 || ḍākinīsahitaṃ brahmadhyānaṃ kṛtvā paṭhet stavam | paṭhanād dhāraṇānmantrī yogināṃ saṅgatirbhavet || 30-39 || etatpaṭhanamātreṇa mahāpātakanāśanam | ekarūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ viśālanayanāmbujam || 30-40 || evaṃ dhyātvā paṭhet stotraṃ paṭhitvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 30-41 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe | ṣaṭcakrasiddhisādhane bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde ḍākinī | stotraṃ nāma triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 30 ||
[athaikatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha nātha pravakṣyāmi bhedinyāḥ sādhanaṃ param | yena sādhanamātreṇa yogī syāt kalikālahā || 31-1 || kalikāle mahāyogaṃ sādhaya tvaṃ mahāprabho | yadi na sādhitaḥ kālaḥ sa kālo dehabhakṣakaḥ || 31-2 || bhedinīsādhanenaiva granthīnāṃ bhedanaṃ bhavet | ḍākinīṃ hṛdaye dhyāyet paramānandarūpiṇīm || 31-3 || aṣṭahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ śaśāṅkāvayavāṅkitām | trailokyamohinīṃ vidyāṃ bhayadāṃ varadāṃ satām || 31-4 || śuklavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ cārurūpamanoharām | dhyātvā mūlāmbuje yogī pādyādyaiḥ paripūjayet || 31-5 || tatra manolayaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavati bhūtale | yadā manolayaṃ yāti tadā tasyāḥ stavaṃ paṭhet || 31-6 || stotraṃ paṭhanamātreṇa sarvasattvāśrito bhavet | dhyānamākṛtya prapaṭhet sarvasiddhimayo bhavet || 31-7 || yā bhedinī sakalagranthivināśanānā| dharmāntare sakalaśatruvināśanasthā | sā me sadā pratidinaṃ paripātu deha| kālātmikā bhagavatī śubhakāryakartrī || 31-8 || yā kāntā karuṇāmayī trijagatāmānandasiddhisthitā | nityā sā paripālikā kulakalā nīlāmalākomalā | vāṇī siddhikarī kṛtārthanigaḍe śīghrodayā śāṅkarī | saṃjñābhedanabhedikā śubhakarī vedāntasiddhāntadā || 31-9 || vāṇī bālā kulālā kalakalacaraṇā yāmalāsaṃkhyamālā | helābhālāntarālā kulakamalacalā cañcalā dehakālā || 31-10 || bhedākhyā bhedyabhedā varanadaninadā nādabinduprakāśā | sā me śīrṣaṃ lalāṭaṃ mukhahṛdayakaṭiṃ mukhyapadmaṃ prapāyāt || 31-11 || kāñcīpīṭhaprakāśā nijapadavilayā yoginīnetravakṣā | nātiyogaprakāśyā caruśataghaṭitā ghorasaṃhārakārā || 31-12 || brahmānandasvarūpā vigatimatiharā hīrakā bhāti netrā | hāraśreṇyādibhūṣā śaśiśatakiraṇā pātu māṃ bhedyadeham || 31-13 || yā bhedinī sakalapāparipupirayāṇāṃ svargāpavargaviralā bagalāmukhī sā | me pātu dehaghaṭitaṃ sakalepsitārthaṃ bhāvaprabhāvapaṭalā sahadehasaṃsthā || 31-14 || kāmāśritā vividhadoṣavināśaleṣā | saundaryaveśakaraṇī kratukarmarakṣā | dīkṣā satāṃ matimatāṃ nijayogadātrī | sā me sadā sakaladehamihāśu bhedyā || 31-15 || kāntā śāntaguṇodayā mama dhanaṃ dehasya nityāśayā pāyāt śrīkuladaivatasya jayadā yā yogasāraṃ param | sākṣādīśvarapūjitā samucitā cittāthītā cāthītā | yanme ghoratare jaye nijakule kālākule vyākule || 31-16 || bhedābhedavivajītā suravaraśrīhastapadmācīte | me meḍhaṃr khalu liṅga mūlakamalaṃ kālapirayā pātu sā | saptasvargatalaṃ mamaiva vapuṣā mithyāvamānāpahā | heḍambāsurasundara pirayavatī hemāvatī bhāratī || 31-17 || etat stotraṃ paṭhitvā yaḥ stauti mūlāmbuje ca mām | sa eva yogamāpnoti sa bhaved yogivallabhaḥ || 31-18 || manaḥ sthiraṃ bhavet kṣipraṃ rājatvaṃ labhate jhaṭit | anāyāsena siddhiḥ syāt tasya vāyurvaśo bhavet || 31-19 || yoginīnāṃ darśanaṃ hi anāyāsena labhyate | bhāvasindhuyuto bhūtvā vicaredamaro yathā || 31-20 || mūlapadme vaseddevī mūlāmbhojaprakāśinī | mālatī mālavī maunā mālinī ca manoharā || 31-21 || mānasī madanā mānyā mudrāmaithunatatparā | merusthā mādyakusumā maṇḍitā maṇḍalasthitā || 31-22 || manaḥsthairyakarī devī bhāvyate yaiḥ kumārakaiḥ | akasmāt siddhimāpnoti kālena parameśvara || 31-23 || atha vakṣye mahādevyāḥ chedinyāḥ stavamuttamam | chettā tvaṃ sarvagranthīnāṃ matprasādād yatīśvaraḥ || 31-24 || yatprasādādananto hi yogī saṃsāramaṇḍale || 31-25 || deśānandā sakalaguṇadā chedinī chedanasthā | havyasthā sā vibhavaniratā yā nidhisthā niśāyām | sā me nityaṃ kulakamalagā gopanīyā vidhijñā | śrīvāgeśī gaganavasanā sarvayogaṃ prapāyāt || 31-26 || kāmānandā madananiratā bhāvitā bhāvasindhau kāmānandodbhavarasavatī yogiyogasthadhātrī | dehaklede nirasanaratā (... ... ... ... ... ...) | sā me dhautaṃ prakuru vapuṣo dharmapuñjaṃ prapāyāt || 31-27 || kālākālaṃ kamalakalikāvāsinī kālikā me | granthicchedaṃ sthiragṛhagatā gātranāḍīpathasthā | vaktrāmbhoje vacanamadhuraṃ dhārayantī janānā| sā me randhraṃ mama ruciratanoḥ pātu pañcānanā yā || 31-28 || yogāṅgasthā sthitilayavibhavā lomakūpāmbujasthā | mātā gaurī giripatisutā bhāsurāstrapradīptā | sampāyānme hṛdayavivaraṃ chedinīmūlapūre | kailāsasthā mamamanugiriṃ pātu rudraprasādā || 31-29 || nādāntaḥsthā managuṇadharaṇāsannasiddhāntapārā | bhogānandā bhaganagabile kāśayantī janānām | vidyāvidyā vividhagaganā chedinī channarūpā | sā sarvāntaḥkaraṇanilayā lākinī premabhāvā || 31-30 || yogaṃ svarge'rpayasi manasi premabhāvaṃ pareśe | yā yā yātrā trividhakaraṇā kāraṇā sarvajantoḥ | mātā jñātrī gaṇeśe gṛhigaṇasadayā sarvakartrī mano me | rakṣā rakṣākṣaragatakalā kevalā niṣkalā yā || 31-31 || sā yogendrā samavatu mudā me gudaṃ kuṇḍalinyā| jahnoḥ kanyā kamalanilayā rākiṇī premabhāvān | mokṣaprāṇān tapanarahitā pātu me vedavaktrā | siddhā mūlāmbujadalagatā pāvanī pātu tuṇḍam || 31-32 || herambājñā pralayaghaṭitā kākinī krodharūpā || 31-33 || yadi bhajati kulīnaḥ kāminīṃ krodhavidyā| sa bhavati parayogī chedinīstotrapāṭhāt | sakaladuritanāśaḥ kṣālanādiprasiddhiḥ | sakalajanavaśaḥ syāt tasya nityaṃ surājyam || 31-34 || etat stotraṃ paṭhedvidvān mahāsaṃyamatatparaḥ | mūle manaḥ sthiro yāti sarvāniṣṭavināśanaḥ || 31-35 || sarvasiddhiḥ kare tasya yo bhāvaṃ samupāśrayet śṛṇuṣva paramānanda rasasāgarasambhava || 31-36 || yoginīstotrasāraṃ ca śravaṇāddhāraṇād yatiḥ | aprakāśyamidaṃ ratnaṃ nṛṇāmiṣṭaphalapradam || 31-37 || yasya vijñānamātreṇa śivo bhavati sādhakaḥ || 31-38 || kaṅkālī kulapaṇḍitā kulakalā kālānalā śyāmalā | yogendrendrasurājyanāthayajitā'nyā yoginīṃ mokṣadā | māmekaṃ kujaḍaṃ sukhāstamadhanaṃ hīnaṃ ca dīnaṃ khala| yadyevaṃ paripālanaṃ karoṣi niyataṃ tvaṃ trāhi tāmāśraye || 31-39 || yajñeśī śaśiśekharā svamaparā herambayogāspadā | dātrī dānaparā harāhariharā'ghorāmarāśaṅkarā | bhadre buddhivihīna dehajaḍitaṃ pūjājapāvajītaṃ māmekārbhamakiñcanaṃ yadi sarattvaṃ yoginī rakṣasi || 31-40 || bhāvyā bhāvanatatparasya karaṇā sā cāraṇā yoginī | candrasthā nijanāthadehasugatā mandāramālāvṛtā | yogeśī kulayoginī tvamamarā dhārādharācchādinī yogendrotsavarāgayāgajaḍitā yā mātṛsiddhisthitā || 31-41 || tvaṃ māṃ pāhi pareśvarī suratarī śrībhāskarī yogaga| māyāpāśavibandhanaṃ tava kathālāpāmṛtāvajītam | nānādharmavivajītaṃ kalikule saṃvyākulālakṣaṇa| mayyeke yadi dṛṣṭipātakamalā tat kevalaṃ me balam || 31-42|| māyāmayī hṛdi yadā mama cittalagna| rājyaṃ tadā kimu phalaṃ phalasādhanaṃ vā | ityāśayā bhagavatī mama śaktidevī | bhāti piraye śrutidale mukharārpaṇaṃ te || 31-43 || yā yoginī sakalayogasumantraṇāḍhyā | devī mahadguṇamayī karuṇānidhānā | sā me bhayaṃ haratu vāraṇamattacittā | saṃhāriṇī bhavatu sodaravakṣahārā || 31-44 || yadi paṭhati manojño gorasāmīśvaraṃ yo | vaśayati ripuvargaṃ krodhapuñjaṃ vihanti | bhuvanapavanabhakṣo bhāvukaḥ syāt susaṅgī | ratipatiguṇatulyo rāmacandro yatheśaḥ || 31-45 || etatstotraṃ paṭhedyastu sa bhakto bhavati pirayaḥ | mūlapadme sthiro bhūttvā ṣaṭcakre rājyamāpnuyāt || 31-46 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane ṣaṭcakraprakāśe siddhimantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde bhedinyādistotraṃ nāma ekatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 31 ||
[atha dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca atha kānta pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva mama tattvataḥ | śaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī devī sarvabhedanabhedinī || 32-1 || kalikalmaṣahantrī ca jagatāṃ mokṣadāyinī | tasyāḥ stotraṃ tathā dhyānaṃ nyāsaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 32-2 || yasya vijñānamātreṇa mūlapadme manolayaḥ | caitanyānandanirato bhavet kuṇḍalisaṅgamāt || 32-3 || ākāśagāminīṃ siddhiṃ dadāti kuṇḍalī bhṛśam | amṛtānandarūpābhyāṃ karoṣi pālanaṃ nṛṇām || 32-4 || śvāsocchvāsakalābhyāṃ ca śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam | pañcabhūtāvṛtā nityaṃ pañcānilā bhaved dhruvam || 32-5 || koṭisūryapratīkāśāṃ nirālambāṃ vibhāvayet | sarvasthitāṃ jñānarūpāṃ śvāsocchvāsanivāsinīm || 32-6 || svayambhūkusumotpannāṃ dhyānajñānaprakāśinīm | mokṣadāṃ śaktidāṃ nityāṃ nityajñānasvarūpiṇīm || 32-7 || lolāṃ līlādharāṃ sarvāṃ śuddhajñānaprakāśinīm | koṭikālānalasamāṃ vidyutkoṭimahaujasām || 32-8 || tejasā vyāptakiraṇāṃ mūlādūrdhvaprakāśinīm | aṣṭalokaprakāśāḍhyāṃ phullendīvaralocanām || 32-9 || sarvamukhīṃ sarvahastāṃ sarvapādāmbujasthitām | mūlādibrahmarandhrāntasthānalokaprakāśinīm || 32-10 || tribhāṣāṃ sarvabhakṣāṃ ca śvāsanirgamapālinīm | lalitāṃ sundarīṃ nīlāṃ kuṇḍalīṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim || 32-11 || abhūmaṇḍalabāhyasthāṃ bāhyajñānaprakāśinīm | nāginīṃ nāgabhūṣāḍhyāṃ bhayānakakalevarām || 32-12 || yogijñeyāṃ śuddharūpāṃ viralāmūrdhvagāminīm | evaṃ dhyātvā mūlapadme kuṇḍalīṃ paradevatām || 32-13 || bhāvasiddhirbhavet kṣipraṃ kuṇḍalībhāvanādiha | tato mānasajāpaṃ hi mānasaṃ homatarpaṇam || 32-14 || abhiṣekaṃ mudā kṛtvā prātaḥ kāle punaḥ punaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ paṭhet || 32-15 || etatstotrasya pāṭhena svayaṃ siddhāntavid bhavet | kuṇḍalī sukṛpā tasya māsād bhavati niścitam || 32-16 || nidrādoṣādikṃ tyaktvā prakāśyāhaṃ śarīrake | ahaṃ dātrī suyogānāmadhipāhaṃ jagattraye || 32-17 || ahaṃ karma ahaṃ dharmaḥ ahaṃ devī ca kuṇḍalī | yo jānāti mahāvīra kuṇḍalīrūpasevanāt || 32-18 || iti taṃ pātrakaṃ kartumavatīrṇāsmi sarvadā | ata eva paraṃ mantraṃ kuṇḍalinyāḥ stavaṃ śubham || 32-19 || prapaṭhet sarvadā dehe yadi vaśyā na kuṇḍalī | tāvat kālaṃ japaṃ kuryād yāvat siddhirna jāyate || 32-20 || ādhāre paradevatā bhavanatādhokuṇḍalī devatā | devānāmadhidevatā trijagatāmānandapuñjasthitā || 32-21 || mūlādhāranivāsinī triramaṇī yā jñāninī mālinī | sā me mātṛmanusthitā kulapathānandaikabījānanā || 32-22 || sarvāṅgasthitikāriṇī suragaṇānandaikacinhā śivā | vīrendrā navakāminī vacanadā śrīmānadā jñānadā || 32-23 || sānandā ghananandinī ghanagaṇā chinnā bhavā yoginī | dhīrā dhairyavatī samāptaviṣayā śrīmaṅgalī kuṇḍalī || 32-24 || sarvākāranivāsinī jayadharādhārādharasthāgayā | gītā godhanavaddhīnī gurumayī jñānapirayā godhanā || 32-25 || gārhāgnisthiti candrikā sulatikā jāḍyāpahā rāgadā | dārā godhanakāriṇī mṛgamanā brahmāṇḍamārgojjvalā || 32-26 || mātā mānasagocarā haricarā siṃhāsanekāraṇā | yāmā dāsagaṇeśvarī guṇavatī chāyāpathasthāyinī || 32-27 || nidrā kṣubdhajanapirayā varatṛṣā bhāṣāviśeṣasthitā | sthityantapralayāpahā naraśiromālādharā kuṇḍalī || 32-28 || gāṅgeśī yamuneśvarī gurutarī godāvarī bhāskarī | bhaktātīkṣayakāriṇī samaśivaṃ yadyekabhāvānvitā || 32-29 || tvaṃ śīghraṃ kuru kaulike mama śirorandhraṃ tadabjaṃ mudā | tatpatrasthitadaivataṃ kulavatī mātṛsthalaṃ pāhikam || 32-30 || bhālodrdhve dhavalā kalārasakalā kālāgnijālojjvalā | pheruprāṇaniketane gurutarā gurvī sugurvī surā || 32-31 || hālollāsasamodayā yatinayā māyā jagattāriṇī | nidrāmaithunanāśinī mama harā mohāpahā pātukam || 32-32 || bhālaṃ nīlatanusthitā matimatāmarthapirayā maithilī | bhālānandakarā mahāpirayajanā padmānanā komalā || 32-33 || nānāraṅgasupīṭhadeśavasanā siddhāsanā ghoṣaṇā | trāṇasthāvararūpiṇī kalihanī śrīkuṇḍalī pātukam || 32-34 || bhrūmadhyaṃ bagalāmukhī śaśimukhī vidyāmukhī sammukhī | nāgākhyā nagavāhinī mahiṣahā pañcānanasthāyinī || 32-35 || pārāvāra vihārahetusapharī setuprakārā parā | kāśīvāsinamīśvaraṃ pratidinaṃ śrīkuṇḍalī pātukam || 32-36 || yā kuṇḍodbhavasārapānaniratā mohādidoṣāpahā | sā netratrayamambikā suvalikā śrīkālikā kaulikā || 32-37 || kākasthā dvikacañcupāraṇakarī saṃjñākarī sundarī | me pātu pirayayā tayā viśadayā sacchāyayā chāditā || 32-38 || śrīkuṇḍe raṇacaṇḍikā suratikā kaṅkālikā bālikā | sākāśā parivajītā sugatikā jñānomīkā cotsukā || 32-39 || saukāsūkṣmasukhapirayā guṇanikā dīkṣā ca sūkṣmākhyakā | māmandyaṃ mama kandavāsini śive santrāhi santrāhikam || 32-40 || etatstotraṃ paṭhitvā tribhuvanapavanaṃ pāvanaṃ laukikānām | rājā syāt kilviṣāgniḥ kratupatiriha yaḥ kṣemadaṃ yogināṃ vā || 32-41 || sarveśaḥ sarvakartā bhavati nijagṛhe yogayogāṅgavaktā | śāktaḥ śaivaḥ sa ekaḥ paramapuruṣago nirmalātmā mahātmā || 32-42 || praṇavena puṭitaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ stauti niyataḥ śuciḥ | sa bhavet kuṇḍalīputro bhūtale nātra saṃśayaḥ || 32-43 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane mūlacakrasārasaṅkete bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde kandavāsinīstotraṃ nāma dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 32 ||
[atha trayastriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrī ānandabhairavī uvāca atha vakṣye mahādeva kuṇḍalīkavacaṃ śubham | paramānandadaṃ siddhaṃ siddhavṛndaniṣevitam || 33-1 || yatkṛtvā yoginaḥ sarvaṃ dharmādharmapradarśakāḥ | jñānino mānino dharmā vicaranti yathāmarāḥ || 33-2 || siddhayo'pyaṇimādyāśca karasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | etat kavacapāṭhena devendro yogirāḍ bhavet || 33-3 || ṛṣayo yoginaḥ sarve jaṭilāḥ kulabhairavāḥ | prātaḥkāle trivāraṃ ca madhyāhne vārayugmakam || 33-4 || sāyāhne vāramekaṃ tu paṭhet kavacameva ca | paṭhedevaṃ mahāyogī kuṇḍalīdarśanaṃ bhavet || 33-5 || kulakuṇḍalīkavacasya brahmendra ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ(,) kulakuṇḍalī devatā sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ || oṃ īśvarī jagatāṃ dhātrī lalitā sundarī parā | kuṇḍalī kularūpā ca pātu māṃ kulacaṇḍikā || 33-6 || śiro me lalitā devī pātūgrākhyā kapolakam | brahmamantreṇa puṭitā bhrūmadhyaṃ pātu me sadā || 33-7 || netratrayaṃ mahākālī kālāgnibhakṣikā śikhām | dantāvalīṃ viśālākṣī oṣṭhamiṣṭānuvāsinī || 33-8 || kāmabījātmikā vidyā adharaṃ pātu me sadā | ḷyugasthā gaṇḍayugmaṃ māyā viśvā rasapirayā || 33-9 || bhuvaneśī karṇayugmaṃ cibukaṃ krodhakālikā | kapilā me galaṃ pātu sarvabījasvarūpiṇī || 33-10 || mātṛkāvarṇapuṭitā kuṇḍalī kaṇṭhameva ca | hṛdayaṃ kālapṛthvī ca kaṅkālī pātu me mukham || 33-11 || bhujayugmaṃ caturvargā caṇḍadodrdaṇḍakhaṇḍinī | skandhayugmaṃ skandamātā hālāhalagatā mama || 33-12 || aṅgulyagraṃ kulānandā śrīvidyā nakhamaṇḍalam | kālikā bhuvaneśānī pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ sadāvatu || 33-13 || pārśvayugmaṃ mahāvīrā vīrāsanadharābhayā | pātu māṃ kuladarbhasthā nābhimudaramambikā || 33-14 || kaṭideśaṃ pīṭhasaṃsthā mahāmahiṣaghātinī | liṅgasthānaṃ mahāmudrā bhagaṃ mālāmanupirayā || 33-15 || bhagīrathapirayā dhūmrā mūlādhāraṃ gaṇeśvarī | caturdalaṃ kakṣyapūjyā dalāgraṃ me vasundharā || 33-16 || śīrṣaṃ rādhā raṇākhyā ca brahmāṇī pātu me mukham | medinī pātu kamalā vāgdevī pūrvagaṃ dalam || 33-17 || chedinī dakṣiṇe pātu pātu caṇḍā mahātapā | candraghaṇṭā sadā pātu yoginī vāruṇaṃ dalam || 33-18 || uttarasthaṃ dalaṃ pātu pṛthivīmindrapālitā | catuṣkoṇaṃ kāmavidyā brahmavidyābjakoṇakam || 33-19 || aṣṭaśūlaṃ sadā pātu sarvavāhanavāhanā caturbhujā sadā pātu ḍākinī kulacañcalā || 33-20 || meḍhrsthā madanādhārā pātu me cārupaṅkajam | svayambhūliṅga cārvākā koṭarākṣī mamāsanam || 33-21 || kadambavanamāpātu kadambavanavāsinī | vaiṣṇavī paramā māyā pātu me vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 33-22 || ṣaḍdalaṃ rākiṇī pātu rākiṇī kāmavāsinī | kāmeśvarī kāmarūpā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pītavāsasam || 33-23 || vanamālāṃ vanadurgā śaṅkhaṃ me śaṅkhinī śivā | cakraṃ cakreśvarī pātu kamalākṣī gadāṃ mama || 33-24 || padmaṃ me padmagandhā ca padmamālā manoharā | rādilāntākṣaraṃ pātu lākinī lokapālinī || 33-25 || ṣaḍdale sthitadevāṃśca pātu kailāsavāsinī | agnivarṇā sadā pātu gaṇaṃ me parameśvarī || 33-26 || maṇipūraṃ sadā pātu maṇimālāvibhūṣaṇā | daśapatraṃ daśavarṇaṃ ḍādiphāntaṃ trivikramā || 33-27 || pātu nīlā mahākālī bhadrā bhīmā sarasvatī | ayodhyāvāsinī devī mahāpīṭhanivāsinī || 33-28 || vāgbhavādyā mahāvidyā kuṇḍalī kālakuṇḍalī | daśacchadagataṃ pātu rudraṃ rudrātmakaṃ mama || 33-29 || sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarā pātu sūkṣmasthānanivāsinī | rākiṇī lokajananī pātu kūṭākṣarasthitā || 33-30 || taijasaṃ pātu niyataṃ rajakī rājapūjitā | vijayā kulabījasthā tavargaṃ timirāpahā || 33-31 || mantrātmikā maṇigranthiṃ bhedinī pātu sarvadā | garbhadātā bhṛgusutā pātu māṃ nābhivāsinī || 33-32 || nandinī pātu sakalaṃ kuṇḍalī kālakampitā | hṛtpadmaṃ pātu kālākhyā dhūmravarṇā manoharā || 33-33 || daladvādaśavarṇaṃ ca bhāskarī bhāvasiddhidā | pātu me paramā vidyā kavargaṃ kāmacāriṇī || 33-34 || cavargaṃ cāruvasanā vyāghrāsyā ṭaṅkadhāriṇī | cakāraṃ pātu kṛṣṇākhyā kākinīṃ pātu kālikā || 33-35 || ṭakurāṅgī ṭakāraṃ me jīvabhāvā mahodayā | īśvarī pātu vimalā mama hṛtpadmavāsinī || 33-36 || kaṇīkāṃ kālasandarbhā yoginī yogamātaram | indrāṇī vāruṇī pātu kulamālā kulāntaram || 33-37 || tāriṇī śaktimātā ca kaṇṭhavākyaṃ sadāvatu | vipracittā mahogrogrā prabhā dīptā ghanāsanā || 33-38 || vākstambhinī vajradehā vaidehī vṛṣavāhinī | unmattānandacittā ca kṣaṇośīśā bhagāntarā || 33-39 || mama ṣoḍaśapatrāṇi pātu mātṛtanusthitā | surān rakṣatu vedajñā sarvabhāṣā ca kaṇīkām || 33-40 || īśvarārddhāsanagatā prapāyānme sadāśivam | śākambharī mahāmāyā sākinī pātu sarvadā || 33-41 || bhavānī bhavamātā ca pāyād bhrūmadhyapaṅkajam | dvidalaṃ vratakāmākhyā aṣṭāṅgasiddhidāyinī || 33-42 || pātu nāsāmakhilānandā manorūpā jagatpirayā | lakāraṃ lakṣaṇākrāntā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇā || 33-43 || kṛṣṇājinadharā devī kṣakāraṃ pātu sarvadā | dvidalasthaṃ sarvadevaṃ sadā pātu varānanā || 33-44 || bahurūpā viśvarūpā hākinī pātu saṃsthitā | harāparaśivaṃ pātu mānasaṃ pātu pañcamī || 33-45 || ṣaṭcakrasthā sadā pātu ṣaṭcakrakulavāsinī | akārādikṣakārāntā bindusargasamanvitā || 33-46 || mātṛkārṇā sadā pātu kuṇḍalī jñānakuṇḍalī | devakālī gatipremā pūrṇā giritaṭaṃ śivā || 33-47 || uḍḍīyāneśvarī devī sakalaṃ pātu sarvadā | kailāsaparvataṃ pātu kailāsagirivāsinī48 || pātu me ḍākinīśaktirlākinī rākiṇī kalā | sākinī hākinī devī ṣaṭcakrādīn prapātu me || 33-49 || kailāsākhyaṃ sadā pātu pañcānana tanūdbhavā | hiraṇyavarṇā rajanī candrasūryāgnibhakṣiṇī || 33-50 || sahasradalapadmaṃ me sadā pātu kulākulā | sahasradalapadmasthā daivataṃ pātu khecarī || 33-51 || kālī tārā ṣoḍaśākhyā mātaṅgī padmavāsinī | śaśikoṭigaladrūpā pātu me sakalaṃ tamaḥ || 33-52 || vane ghore jale deśe yuddhe vāde śmaśānake | sarvatra gamane jñāne sadā māṃ pātu śailajā || 33-53 || parvate vividhāyāse vināśe pātu kuṇḍalī | pādādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ sarvākāśaṃ sureśvarī || 33-54 || sadā pātu sarvavidyā sarvajñānaṃ sadā mama | navalakṣamahāvidyā daśadikṣu prapātu mām || 33-55 || ityetat kavacaṃ devi kuṇḍalinyāḥ prasiddhidam | ye paṭhanti dhyānayoge yogamārgavyavasthitāḥ || 33-56 || te yānti muktipadavīmaihike nātra saṃśayaḥ | mūlapadme manoyogaṃ kṛtvā hṛdāsanasthitaḥ || 33-57 || mantraṃ dhyāyet kuṇḍalinīṃ mūlapadmaprakāśinīm | dharmodayāṃ dayārūḍhāmākāśasthānavāsinīm || 33-58 || amṛtānandarasikāṃ vikalāṃ sukalāṃ śitām | ajitāṃ raktarahitāṃ viśaktāṃ raktavigrahām || 33-59 || raktanetrāṃ kulakṣiptāṃ jñānāñjanajayojjvalām | viśvākārāṃ manorūpāṃ mūle dhyātvā prapūjayet || 33-60 || yo yogī kurute evaṃ sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ | rogī rogāt pramucyeta baddho mucyeta bandhanāt || 33-61 || rājyaṃ śriyamavāpnoti rājyahīnaḥ paṭhedyadi | putrahīno labhet putraṃ yogahīno bhavedvaśī || 33-62 || kavacaṃ dhārayedyastu śikhāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje | vāmā vāmakare dhṛtvā sarvābhīṣṭamavāpnuyāt || 33-63 || svarṇe raupye tathā tāmre sthāpayitvā prapūjayet | sarvadeśe sarvakāle paṭhitvā siddhimāpnuyāt || 33-64 || sa bhūyāt kuṇḍalīputro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 33-65 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhividyāprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde kandavāsinīkavacaṃ nāma trayastriśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 33 ||
[atha catustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha bhedān pravakṣyāmi hitāya jagatāṃ prabho | nirmalātmā śuciḥ śrīmān dhyānātmā ca sadāśivaḥ || 34-1 || sa mokṣago jñānarūpī sa ṣaṭcakrārthabhedakaḥ | triguṇajñānavikalo na paśyati divāniśam || 34-2 || divārātryajñānahetorna paśyati kalevaram | iti kṛtvā hi maraṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ janmani janmani || 34-3 || tajjanmakṣayahetośca mama yogaṃ samabhyaset | pañcasvaraṃ mahāyogaṃ kṛtvā syādamaro naraḥ || 34-4 || tatprakāraṃ śṛṇuṣvātha vallabha pirayadarśana | tava bhāvena kathaye na kutra vada śaṅkara || 34-5 || yadi lokasya nikaṭe kathyate yogasādhanam | vighnā ghorā vasantyeva gātre yogādikaṃ katham || 34-6 || yogayogād bhavenmokṣaḥ tatprakāśādvināśanam | ato na darśayed yogaṃ yadīcchedātmanaḥ śubham || 34-7 || kṛtvā pañcāmarā yogaṃ pratyahaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ | paṭhet śrīkuṇḍalīdevīsahasranāma cāṣṭakam || 34-8 || mahāyogī bhavennātha ṣaṇmāse nātra saṃśayaḥ | pañcame vā yogavidyā sarvavidyāprakāśinī || 34-9 || kṛtvā pañcasvarā siddhiṃ tato'ṣṭāṅgādidhāraṇā | ādau pañcasvarā siddhistato'nyā yogadhāraṇā || 34-10 || tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya | ahaṃ jānāmi saṃsāre kevalaṃ yogapaṇḍitān || 34-11 || tat sākṣiṇī hyahaṃ nātha bhaktānāmudayāya ca | idānīṃ kathaye te'haṃ mama vā yogasādhanam || 34-12 || evaṃ kṛtvā nityarūpī yogānāmaṣṭadhā yataḥ | tataḥ kālena puruṣaḥ siddhimāpnoti niścitam || 34-13 || pañcāmarā vidhānāni krameṇa śṛṇu śaṅkara | netīyogaṃ hi siddhānāṃ mahākaphavināśanam || 34-14 || dantiyogaṃ pravakṣyāmi paścād hṛdayabhedanāt | dhautīyogaṃ tataḥ paścāt sarvamalavināśanāt || 34-15 || neulīyogamaparaṃ sarvāṅgodaracālanāt | kṣālanaṃ paramaṃ yogaṃ nāḍīnāṃ kṣālanāt smṛtam || 34-16 || etat pañcāmarāyogaṃ yamināmatigocaram | yamaniyamakāle tu pañcāmarākriyāṃ yajet || 34-17 || amarā sādhanādeva amaratvaṃ labhed dhruvam | etatkaraṇakāle ca tathā pañcāmarāsanam || 34-18 || pañcāmarābhakṣaṇena amaro yogasiddhibhāk | tāni dravyāṇi vakṣyāmi tavāgre parameśvara || 34-19 || yena hīnā na siddhyanti kalpakoṭiśatena ca | ekā tu amarā dūrvā tasyā granthiṃ samānayet || 34-20 || anyā tu vijayā devī siddhirūpā sarasvatī | anyā tu bilvapatrasthā śivasantoṣakāriṇī || 34-21 || anyā tu yogasiddhyarthe nirguṇḍī cāmarā matā | anyā tu kālitulasī śrīviṣṇoḥ paritoṣiṇī || 34-22 || etāḥ pañcasvarāḥ jñeyā yogasādhanakarmaṇi | etāsāṃ dviguṇaṃ grāhyaṃ vijayāpatramuttamam || 34-23 || brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrāḥ sarvatra pūjitāḥ | etaddravyāṇi saṅgrāhya bhakṣayeccūrṇamuttamam || 34-24 || taccūrṇabhakṣasamaye etanmantrādipañcamam | paṭhitvā bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā naro mucyeta saṅkaṭāt || 34-25 || oṃ tvaṃ dūrve'marapūjye tvaṃ amṛtodbhavasambhave | amaraṃ māṃ sadā bhadre kuruṣva nṛharipiraye || 34-26 || oṃ dūrvāyai namaḥ svāhā iti dūrvāyāḥ | punavījayāmantreṇa śodhayet sarvakanyakāḥ | oṃ saṃvide brahmasambhūte brahmaputri sadā'naghe | bhairavāṇāṃ ca tṛptyarthe pavitrā bhava sarvadā || 34-27 || oṃ brāhmaṇyai namaḥ svāhā | oṃ siddhimūlakare devi hīnabodhaprabodhini | rājaputrīvaśaṅkari śūlakaṇṭhatriśūlini || 34-28 || oṃ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā | oṃ ajñānendhanadīptāgni jñānāgnijjvālarūpiṇi | ānandādyāhutiṃ kṛtvā samyakjñānaṃ prayaccha me || 34-29 || hrīṃ hrīṃ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā | oṃ namasyāmi namasyāmi yogamārgapradaśīni | trailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhava || 34-30 || śrīṃ śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhā | oṃ kāvyasiddhikarī devī bilvapatranivāsini | amaratvaṃ sadā dehi śivatulyaṃ kuruṣva mām || 34-31 || oṃ śivadāyai namaḥ svāhā | nirguṇḍi paramānande yogānāmadhidevate | sā māṃ rakṣatu amare bhāvasiddhiprade namaḥ || 34-32 || oṃ śokāpahāyai namaḥ svāhā | oṃ viṣṇoḥ piraye mahāmāye mahākālanivāriṇī | tulasī māṃ sadā rakṣa māmekamamaraṃ kuru || 34-33 || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ eṃ klīṃ amarāyai namaḥ svāhā | punareva samākṛtya sarvāsāṃ śodhanañcaret || 34-34 || oṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave'mṛtavaṣīṇi amṛtamākarṣaya | ākarṣaya siddhiṃ dehi svāhā | dhenumudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ matsyamudrāṃ pradarśayet | tattvamudrākrameṇaiva tarpaṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 34-35 || amantrakaṃ saptavāraṃ gurornāmnā śive'rpayet | saptakañca sveṣṭadevyā nāmnā śuddhiṃ pradāpayet || 34-36 || tatastarpaṇamākuryāttarpayāmi namo namaḥ | etadvākyasya pūrve ca iṣṭamantraṃ samuccaret || 34-37 || paradevatāṃ samuddhṛtya sarvādyapraṇavaṃ smṛtam | tato mukhe prajuhuyāt kuṇḍalīnāmapūrvakam || 34-38 || oṃ eṃ vada vada vāgvādini mama jihvāgre sthirībhava | sarvasattvavaśaṅkari śatrukaṇṭhatriśūlini svāhā | etajjaptvā sāśramī ca vaśī sādhakasattamaḥ | pañcāmarā śāsanajñaḥ kulācāravidhipirayaḥ || 34-39 || sthiracetā bhavedyogī yadi pañcāmarāgataḥ | netīyogavidhānāni śṛṇu kailāsapūjite || 34-40 || yena sarvamastakasthakaphānāṃ dahanaṃ bhavet | sūkṣmasūtraṃ dṛḍhataraṃ pradadyāt nāsikābile || 34-41 || mukharandhre samānīya sandhānena samānayet | punaḥ punaḥ sadā yogī yātāyātena gharṣayet || 34-42 || krameṇa varddhanaṃ kuryāt sūtrasya parameśvara | netīyogena nāsāyā randhraṃ nirmalakaṃ bhavet || 34-43 || vāyorgamanakāle tu mahāsukhamiti prabho | dantīyogaṃ tataḥ paścātkuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 34-44 || dantadhāvanakāle tu yogametat prakāśayet | dantadhāvanakāṣṭhañca sārdhahastaikasambhavam || 34-45 || nātisthūlaṃ nātisūkṣmaṃ navīnaṃ namramuttamam | apakvaṃ yatnato grāhyaṃ mṛṇālasadṛśaṃ tarum || 34-46 || gṛhītvā dantakāṣṭhaṃ vai yogī nityaṃ prabhakṣayet | dantakāṣṭhāgrabhāgañca kaniṣṭhāṅguliparvataḥ || 34-47 || evaṃ dantāvalibhyāñca carvaṇaṃ sundaraṃ caret | tataḥ prakṣālya toyena śanaigīlanamācaret || 34-48 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prakarttavyaṃ kāyāvākcittaśodhanam | yāvadabhinnakāṣṭhāgraṃ nābhimūle tvanākṣatam || 34-49 || tāvat sūkṣmataraṃ grāhyamavaśyaṃ pratyahañcaret | hṛdaye jalacakrañca yāvat khaṇḍaṃ na jāyate || 34-50 || tāvatkālaṃ sarvadine prabhāte dantadhāvanam | hṛdaye kaphabhāṇḍasya khaṇḍanaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 34-51 || pavanāgamane saukhyaṃ prayāti yoganirbharam | khecaratvaṃ sa labhatām amlānañca kaṭūdbhavam || 34-52 || miṣṭānnaṃ śākadadhyannaṃ dvivāraṃ rātribhojanam | avaśyaṃ santyajedyogī yadi yogamihecchati || 34-53 || ekabhāgaṃ mudgabījaṃ dvibhāgaṃ taṇḍulaṃ matam | uttamaṃ pākamākṛtya ghṛtadugdhena bhakṣayet || 34-54 || athavā kevalaṃ dugdhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | kuṇḍalīṃ kularūpāñca dugdhena paritarpayet || 34-55 || kuṇḍalītarpaṇaṃ yogī yadi jānāti śaṅkara | anāyāsena yogī syāt sa jñānīndro bhaveddhruvam || 34-56 || yamaniyamaparo yaḥ kuṇḍalīsevanastho vibhavavirahito vā bhūribhārāśrito vā | sa bhavati parayogī sarvavidyārthavedyo | guṇagaṇagaganastho muktarūpī gaṇeśaḥ || 34-57 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde pañcāmarāsādhanaṃ nāma catustriśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 34 ||
[atha pañcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha vakṣye mahākāla rahasyaṃ cātidurlabham | yasya vijñānamātreṇa naro brahmapadaṃ labhet || 35-1 || ākāśe tasya rājyañca khecareśo bhaved dhruvam | dhaneśo bhavati kṣipraṃ brahmajñānī bhavennaraḥ || 35-2 || yogānāmadhipo rājā vīrabhadro yathākaviḥ | viriñcigaṇanāthasya kṛpā bhavati sarvadā || 35-3 || yaḥ karoti pañcayogaṃ sa syādamaravigrahaḥ | dhautīyogaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatkṛtvā nirmalo bhavet || 35-4 || atyantaguhyaṃ yogaṃ ca samādhikaraṇaṃ nṛṇām | yadi na kurute yogaṃ tadā maraṇamāpnuyāt || 35-5 || dhautīyogaṃ vinā nātha kaḥ siddhyati mahītale | sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ vastraṃ dvātriṃśaddhastamānataḥ || 35-6 || ekahastakrameṇaiva yaḥ karoti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | yāvad dvātriṃśaddhastañca tāvatkālaṃ kriyāñcaret || 35-7 || etatkriyā prayogeṇa yogī bhavati tatkṣaṇāt | krameṇa mantrasiddhiḥ syāt kālajālavaśaṃ nayet || 35-8 || etanmadhye cāsanāni śarīrasthāni cācaret | dṛḍhāsane yogasiddhiriti tantrārthanirṇayaḥ || 35-9 || siddhe manau parāvāptiḥ pañcayogāsanena ca | pārśve cāṣṭāṅgulaṃ vastraṃ dīrghe dvātriṃśadīśvara || 35-10 || etat sūkṣmaṃ suvasanaṃ gṛhītvā kārayed yatiḥ | jitendriyaḥ sadā kuryād jñānadhyānaniṣevaṇaḥ || 35-11 || kulīnaḥ paṇḍito mānī vivekī susthirāśayaḥ | dhautīyogaṃ sadā kuryāttadaiva śucigo bhavet || 35-12 || anācāreṇa hāniḥ syādindriyāṇāṃ balena ca | mahāpātakamukhyānāṃ saṅgadoṣeṇa hānayaḥ || 35-13 || sambhavanti mahādeva kālayogaṃ sukarma ca | vṛddho vā yauvanastho vā bālo vā jaḍa eva ca || 35-14 || karaṇāddīrghajīvī syādamaro lokavallabhaḥ | mantrasiddhiraṣṭasiddhiḥ sa siddhīnāmadhīśvaraḥ || 35-15 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sadā kuryāt kāladoṣavināśanāt | hṛdayagranthibhedena sarvāvayavavardhanam || 35-16 || tadā mahābalo jñānī cāruvarṇo mahāśayaḥ | dhautīyogodbhavaṃ kāmaṃ mahāmaraṇakāraṇam || 35-17 || tasya tyāgaṃ yaḥ karoti sa naro devavikramaḥ | śvāsaṃ tyaktvā stambhanañca mano dadyānmahānile || 35-18 || śvāsādīnāñca gaṇanamavaśyaṃ bhāvayed gṛhe | prāṇāyāmavidhānena sarvakālaṃ sukhī bhavet || 35-19 || vāyupānaṃ sadā kuryāt dhyānaṃ kuryātsadaiva hi | pratyāhāraṃ sadā kuryāt manoniveśanaṃ sadā || 35-20 || mānasādiprajāpyañca sadā kuryānmanolayam | dhautīyogāntaraṃ hi neulīṅkarma cācaret || 35-21 || neulīyogamātreṇa āsane neulopamaḥ | neulīsādhanādeva cirajīvī nirāmayaḥ || 35-22 || antarātmā sadā maunī nirmalātmā sadā sukhī | sarvadā samayānandaḥ kāraṇānandavigrahaḥ || 35-23 || yogābhyāsaṃ sadā kuryāt kuṇḍalī sādhanādikam | kṛtvā mantrī khecaratvaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 35-24 || tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya | bhuktvā mudgānnapakvañca bāraikaṃ pratipālayet || 35-25 || prapālayetsodarañca kaṭināsāvivajītaḥ | punaḥ punaścālanañca kuryāt svodaramadhyakam || 35-26 || kulālacakravat kuryāt bhrāmaṇañcodarasya ca | sarvāṅgacālanādeva kuṇḍalīcālanaṃ bhavet || 35-27 || cālanāt kuṇḍalīdevyāścaitanyā sā bhavet prabho | etasyānantaraṃ nātha kṣālanaṃ parikītītam || 35-28 || nāḍīnāṃ kṣālanādeva sarvavidyānidhirbhavet | sarvatra jayamāpnoti kālikādarśanaṃ bhavet || 35-29 || vāyusiddhirbhavettasya pañcabhūtasya siddhibhāk | tasya kītīstribhuvane kāmadevabalopamaḥ || 35-30 || sarvatragāmī sa bhavedindriyāṇāṃ patirbhavet | muṇḍāsanaṃ hi sarvatra sarvadā kārayed budhaḥ || 35-31 || ūdrdhve muṇḍāsanaṃ kṛtvā adhohaste japaṃ caret | yadi tridinamākartuṃ samartho muṇḍikāsanam || 35-32 || tadā hi sarvanāḍyaśca vaśībhūtā na saṃśayaḥ | nāḍīkṣālanayogena mokṣadātā svaya bhavet || 35-33 || nāḍīyogena sarvārthasiddhiḥ syānmuṇḍikāsanāt | muṇḍāsana yaḥ karoti neūli(--)siddhigo yadi || 35-34 || neūlīsādhanagato neūlīsādhanottamaḥ | tadā kṣālanayogena siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 35-35 || neūlīṃ yo na jānāti sa kathaṃ karttumuttamaḥ | sa dhīro mānasacaro matimān sa jitendriyaḥ || 35-36 || yo neūlī yogasāraṃ karttumuttamapāragaḥ | sa cāvaśya kṣālanañca kuryāt nāḍyādiśodhanāt || 35-37 || neūlīyogamārgeṇa nāḍīkṣālanapāragaḥ | bhavatyeva mahākāla rājarājeśvaro yathā || 35-38 || pṛthivīpālanarato vigrahaste prapālanam | kevalaṃ prāṇavāyośca dhāraṇāt kṣālanaṃ bhavet || 35-39 || vinā kṣālanayogena dehaśuddhirnajāyate | kṣālanaṃ nāḍikādīnāṃ kaphapittamalādikam || 35-40 || karoti yatnato yogī muṇḍāsananiṣevaṇāt | vāyugrahaṇamevaṃ hi neūlīvaśakālake || 35-41 || na kuryāt kevalaṃ nātha anyakāle sadā caret | yāvanneūlīṃ na jānāti tāvat vāyuṃ na saṃpibet || 35-42 || bahutaraṃ na saṅagrāhyaṃ vāyorāgamanādikam | kevalaṃ śvāsagaṇanaṃ yāvanneūlī na siddhyati || 35-43 || pañcasvarā prakathitā yoginī siddhidāyikā | pañcasvarasādhanādeva pañcavāyurvaśo bhavet || 35-44 || pratāpe sūryatulyaḥ syāt śokadoṣāpahārakaḥ | sarvayogasthirataraṃ saṃprāpya yogirāḍ bhavet || 35-45 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavī saṃvāde pañcasvarayogasādhanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 35 ||
[atha ṣaḍastriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca atha kānta pravakṣyāmi kuṇḍalīcetanādikam | sahasranāmasakalaṃ kuṇḍalinyāḥ priyaṃ sukham || 36-1 || aṣṭottaraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sākṣāt siddhipradāyakam | tava premavaśenaiva kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat || 36-2 || vinā yajanayogena vinā dhyānena yatphalam | tatphalaṃ labhate sadyo vidyāyāḥ sukṛpā bhavet || 36-3 || yā vidyā bhuvaneśānī trailokyaparipūjitā | sā devī kuṇḍalī mātā trailokyaṃ pāti sarvadā || 36-4 || tasyā nāma sahasrāṇi aṣṭottaraśatāni ca | śravaṇātpaṭhanānmantrī mahābhakto bhavediha || 36-5 || ehike sa bhavennātha jīvanmukto mahābalī || 36-6 || asya śrīmanmahākuṇḍalīsāṣṭottarasahasranāmastotrasya brahmaṣīrjagatīcchando bhagavatī śrīmanmahākuṇḍalīdevatā sarvayogasamṛddhisiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ || kuleśvarī kulānandā kulīnā kulakuṇḍalī | śrīmanmahākuṇḍalī ca kulakanyā kulapriyā || 36-7 || kulakṣetrasthitā kaulī kulīnārthaprakāśinī | kulākhyā kulamārgasthā kulaśāstrārthapātinī || 36-8 || kulajñā kulayogyā ca kulapuṣpaprakāśinī kulīnā ca kulādhyakśā kulacandanalepitā || 36-9 || kularūpā kulodbhūtā kulakuṇḍalivāsinī | kulābhinnā kulotpannā kulācāravinodinī || 36-10 || kulavṛkśasamudbhūtā kulamālā kulaprabhā | kulajñā kulamadhyasthā kulakaṅkaṇaśobhitā || 36-11 || kulottarā kaulapūjā kulālāpā kulakriyā | kulabhedā kulaprāṇā kuladevī kulastutiḥ || 36-12 || kaulikā kālikā kālyā kalibhinnā kalākalā | kalikalmaṣahantrī ca kalidoṣavināśinī || 36-13 || kaṅkālī kevalānandā kālajñā kāladhāriṇī | kautukī kaumudī kekā kākā kākalayāntarā || 36-14 || komalāṅgī karālāsyā kandapūjyā ca komalā | kaiśorī kākapucchasthā || kāmarāgā bhūṣaṇāḍhyā kāminīraguṇapriyā | kulīnā nāgahastā ca kulīnanāgavāhinī || 36-153 || kāmapūrasthitā kopā kapālī bakulodbhavā | kārāgārajanāpālyā kārāgāraprapālinī || 36-154 || kriyāśaktiḥ kālapaṅktiḥ kārṇapaṅktiḥ kaphodayā | kāmaphullāravindasthā kāmarūpaphalāphalā || 36-155 || kāyaphalā kāyapheṇā kāntā nāḍīphalīśvarā | kamapherugatā gaurī kāyavāṇī kuvīragā || 36-156 || kabarīmaṇibandhasthā kāverītīrthasaṅgamā | kāmabhītiharā kāntā kāmavākubhramāturā || 36-157 || kavibhāvaharā bhāmā kamanīyabhayāpahā | kāmagarbhadevamātā kāmakalpalatāmarā || 36-158 || kamaṭhapriyamāṃsādā kamaṭhā markaṭapriyā | kimākārā kimādhārā kumbhakāramanasthitā || 36-159 || kāmyayajñasthitā caṇḍā kāmyayajñopavītikā | kāmayāgasiddhikarī kāmamaithunayāminī || 36-160 || kāmākhyā yamalāśasthā kālayāmā kuyoginī | kuruyāgahatāyogyā kurumāṃsavibhakśiṇī || 36-161 || kururaktapriyākārī kiṅkarapriyakāriṇī | kartrīśvarī kāraṇātmā kavibhakśā kavipriyā || 36-162 || kaviśatrupraṣṭhalagnā kailāsopavanasthitā | kalitridhā trisiddhisthā kalitridinasiddhidā || 36-163 || kalaṅkarahitā kālī kalikalmaṣakāmadā | kulapuṣparaṅga sūtramaṇigranthisuśobhanā || 36-164 || kambojavaṅgadeśasthā kulavāsukirakśikā | kulaśāstrakriyā śāntiḥ kulaśāntiḥ kuleśvarī || 36-165 || kuśalapratibhā kāśī kulaṣaṭcakrabhedinī | kulaṣaṭpadmamadhyasthā kulaṣaṭpadmadīpinī || 36-166 || kṛṣṇamārjārakolasthā kṛṣṇamārjāraṣaṣṭhikā | kulamārjārakupitā kulamārjāraṣoḍaśī || 36-167 || kālāntakavalotpannā kapilāntakaghātinī | kalahāsā kālahaśrī kalahārthā kalāmalā || 36-168 || kakśapapakśarakśā ca kukṣetrapakśasaṃkśayā | kākśarakśāsākśiṇī ca mahāmokśapratiṣṭhitā || 36-169 || arkakoṭiśatacchāyā ānvīkśikikarācītā | kāverītīrabhūmisthā āgneyārkāstradhāriṇī || 36-170 || iṃ kiṃ śrīṃ kāmakamalā pātu kailāsarakṣiṇī | mama śrīṃ īṃ bījarūpā pātu kālī śirasthalam || 36-171 || urusthalābjaṃ sakalaṃ tamolkā pātu kālikā | ūḍumbanyarkaramaṇī uṣṭregrā kulamātṛkā || 36-172 || kṛtāpekṣā kṛtimatī kuṅkārī kiṃlipisthitā | kuṃdīrghasvarā kḷptā ca keṃ kailāsakarācīkā || 36-173 || kaiśorī kaiṃ karī kaiṃ keṃ bījākhyā netrayugmakam | komā mataṅgayajitā kauśalyādi kumārikā || 36-174 || pātu me karṇayugmantu krauṃ krauṃ jīvakarālinī | gaṇḍayugmaṃ sadā pātu kuṇḍalī aṅkavāsinī || 36-175 || arkakoṭiśatābhāsā akṣarākṣaramālinī | āśutoṣakarī hastā kuladevī nirañjanā || 36-176 || pātu me kulapuṣpāḍhyā pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ sukṛttamā | kumārī kāmanāpūrṇā pārśvadeśaṃ sadāvatu || 36-177 || devī kāmākhyakā devī pātu pratyaṅgirā kaṭim | kaṭisthadevatā pātu liṅgamūlaṃ sadā mama || 36-178 || guhyadeśaṃ kākinī me liṅgādhaḥ kulasiṃhikā | kulanāgeśvarī pātu nitambadeśamuttamam || 36-179 || kaṅkālamālinī devī me pātu cārumūlakam | jaṃghāyugmaṃ sadā pātu kītīḥ cakrāpahāriṇī || 36-180 || pādayugmaṃ pākasaṃsthā pākaśāsanarakṣikā | kulālacakrabhramarā pātu pādāṅgulīrmama || 36-181 || nakhāgrāṇi daśavidhā tathā hastadvayasya ca | viṃśarūpā kālanākṣā sarvadā parirakṣatu || 36-182 || kulacchatrādhārarūpā kulamaṇḍalagopitā | kulakuṇḍalinī mātā kulapaṇḍitamaṇḍitā || 36-183 || kākānanī kākatuṇḍī kākāyuḥ prakharārkajā | kākajvarā kākajihvā kākājijñā sanasthitā || 36-184 || kapidhvajā kapikrośā kapibālā hikasvarā | kālakāñcī viṃśatisthā sadā viṃśanakhāgraham || 36-185 || pātu devī kālarūpā kalikālaphalālayā | vāte vā parvate vāpi śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe || 36-186 || kulendrasamayācārā kulācārajanapriyā | kulaparvatasaṃsthā ca kulakailāsavāsinī || 36-187 || mahādāvānale pātu kumārge kutsitagrahe | rājño'priye rājavaśye mahāśatruvināśane || 36-188 || kalikālamahālakṣmīḥ kriyālakṣmīḥ kulāmbarā | kalīndrakīlitā kīlā kīlālasvargavāsinī || 36-189 || daśadikṣu sadā pātu indrādidaśalokapā | navacchinne sadā pātu sūryādikanavagrahā || 36-190 || pātu māṃ kulamāṃsāḍhyā kulapadmanivāsinī | kuladravyapriyā madhyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī || 36-191 || vidyāvāde vivāde ca mattakāle mahābhaye | dubhīkṣādibhaye caiva vyādhisaṅkarapīḍite || 36-192 || kālīkullā kapālī ca kāmākhyā kāmacāriṇī | sadā māṃ kulasaṃsarge pātu kaule susaṅgatā || 36-193 || sarvatra sarvadeśe ca kularūpā sadāvatu | ityetat kathitaṃ nātha mātuḥ prasādahetunā || 36-194 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāma sahasraṃ kuṇḍalīpriyam | kulakuṇḍalinīdevyāḥ sarvamantrasusiddhaye || 36-195 || sarvadevamanūnāñca caitanyāya susiddhaye | aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca || 36-196 || brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ kuladravyaparāya ca | akulīne'brāhmaṇe ca na deyaḥ kuṇḍalīstavaḥ | pravṛtte kuṇḍalīcakre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ || 36-197 || nivṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak(--)pṛthak | kulīnāya pradātavyaṃ sādhakāya viśeṣataḥ || 36-198 || dānādeva hi siddhiḥ syānmamājñābalahetunā | mama kriyāyāṃ yastiṣṭhetsa me putro na saṃśayaḥ || 36-199 || sa āyāti mama padaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa vāsavaḥ | āsavena samāṃsena kulavahnau mahāniśi || 36-200 || nāma pratyekamuccārya juhuyāt kāyasiddhaye | pañcācārarato bhūttvā ūdrdhvaretā bhavedyatiḥ || 36-201 || saṃvatsarānmama sthāne āyāti nātra saṃśayaḥ | ehike kāyasiddhiḥ syāt daihike sarvasiddhidaḥ || 36-202 || vaśī bhūttvā trimārgasthāḥ svargabhūtalavāsinaḥ | asya bhṛtyāḥ prabhavanti indrādilokapālakāḥ || 36-203 || sa eva yogī paramo yasyārthe'yaṃ suniścalaḥ | sa eva khecaro bhakto nāradādiśukopamaḥ || 36-204 || yo lokaḥ prajapatyevaṃ sa śivo na ca mānuṣaḥ | sa samādhigato nityo dhyānastho yogivallabhaḥ || 36-205 || caturvyūhagato devaḥ sahasā nātra saṃśayaḥ | yaḥ pradhārayate bhaktyā kaṇṭhe vā mastake bhuje || 36-206 || sa bhavet kālikāputro vidyānāthaḥ svayaṃbhuvi | dhaneśaḥ putravān yogī yatīśaḥ sarvago bhavet || 36-207 || vāmā vāmakare dhṛttvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 36-208 || yadi paṭhati manuṣyo mānuṣī vā mahatyā | sakaladhanajaneśī putriṇī jīvavatsā | kulapatiriha loke svargamokṣaikahetuḥ sa bhavati bhavanātho yoginīvallabheśaḥ || 36-209 || paṭhati ya iha nityaṃ bhaktibhāvena martyo haraṇamapi karoti prāṇaviprāṇayogaḥ | stavanapaṭhanapuṇyaṃ koṭijanmāghanāśa| kathitumapi na śakto'haṃ mahāmāṃsabhakṣā || 36-210 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde mahākulakuṇḍalinī aṣṭottarasahasranāmastavakavacaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 36 ||
[atha saptatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca śrutañca paramaṃ jñānaṃ dharmādharmavivecanam | sarvavedāntasāraṃ ca sārātsāraṃ parātparam || 37-1 || kuṇḍalīstavanaṃ śrutvā pūrṇo'haṃ jagadīśvari | īdānīṃ śrotumicchāmi svādhiṣṭhānaṃ prakāśakam || 37-2 || yadi me sukṛpādṛṣṭirānandaghanasañcaye vada śrīkuṇḍalīyogaṃ svādhiṣṭhānavibhedanam || 37-3 || yena krameṇa bhedaṃ syāttatprakāraṃ vinirṇaya | ānandabhairavī uvāca mahākāla mahāvīra ānandasāgarapiraya || 37-4 || yogyo'si yogamārgāṇāmata eva prakathyate | yena krameṇa cakrasya bhedaḥ syādamaro bhavet || 37-5 || amaro jitacittāriḥ krodhajit prabalo balī | dharmādharmajñānavāṃśca yogī bhavati sajjanaḥ || 37-6 || parakāladarśī vijñaḥ syāt kratuśraddhāparāyaṇaḥ | ahaṅkāravihīno yaḥ sa yogī bhavati dhruvam || 37-7 || mahāvīrasusaṅginī ca saṅgadoṣavivajītaḥ | mahātmāparamaṃ brahmajñānī bhavati yogirāṭ || 37-8 || vikhyātaḥ sarvadeśe ca kintu svāśrayavajītaḥ | bālako vikramī dhanvī dhanurbāṇadharo'vyayaḥ || 37-9 || sa bhavet yogamārgeśo vivekī pāpavajītaḥ | avidyāgranthiniśceṣṭo vivekadharmacātakaḥ || 37-10 || caturo viṣamajñānavajīto yajñakṛt śuciḥ | sa bhaved yoginīputro yogānāmadhipo bhavet || 37-11 || yadi yogasthito mantrī vāyavīśaktinirbharaḥ | sa eva yogī ṣaṇmāsāditi me tantranirṇayaḥ || 37-12 || yo me tantrāṇi jānāti sadarthajñānajāni ca | sa eva caturo yogī mama bhakto na saṃśayaḥ || 37-13 || yadi vāyupānarato mantrī bhavati sādhakaḥ || 37-14 || atha svādhiṣṭhānaṃ kulavaragataṃ ṣaḍdalagata| prabhākāraṃ viṣṇoratiśayapadaṃ kāmanilayam | mahāyogendrāṇāṃ manasi nilayaṃ cārukiraṇa| śaraccandrajyotsnāyutamatidhanaṃ bhavyaviṣayam || 37-15 || sadābhāvakṣetre sakalasudhiyo veda (... ...) yadāmāpakṣeme sakalasudhiyo vedapathagāḥ | vicāraṃ kurvanti kṣitigataratāḥ śrīprabhṛtayaḥ | mahāviṣṇoḥ pītāmbara narapate śyāmalatanoḥ | ( prakāśasyāntaḥpaṭastha naṭavarasyātinilayam ) | viṭacchāyāmadhye nivasati yathā gokulakule || 37-16 || haridhyānaṃ kuryānniravadhimahānandarasikaḥ | sa evātmā sākṣādiha navavaraḥ ṣoḍaśayuvā mahāsarpāristhaṃ sthitikaraṇagaṃ nāgagamana| mukhaṃ vaṃśīnādadhvaniguṇadharaṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 37-17 || sa evātmā nityo yatiriha dale komalakule | kulāgāre sāre sarasijayute ṣaḍdalavare | surānandaśrīdaṃ divi damanakarttāramamada| sudhākāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 37-18 || mahāvidyāsiddhaṃ kulapatimanomānyayajita| mukundaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rasadalagataṃ svāgamagata| murāriṃ pāpāriṃ navayuvatihṛtpadmasugata| hṛṣīkeśaṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣayakaraṇaṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 37-19 || sa yogendro jñānī jayati sṛkṛtau kautukavatā| rameśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rasaviṣaharaṃ mānasacaram | sarasvatyā yuktaṃ kularasamayaṃ muktijaḍita| bhajeccaitanyāntaṃ suraguruvaraṃ mokṣamayate || 37-20 || yatīndraḥ saśrīkaḥ pracayati nijaṃ bhāvyaviṣaya| purāṇaṃ yogīndraṃ harimakhilapaṃ kāmanilayam | mahāsūkṣmaṃ dvāraṃ kulavadhurataṃ vāmakiraṇa| viśālākṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nijarasakule kāntamamaram || 37-21 || kṛpāsākṣījñānaṃ guṇagaditadehaṃ dāharahita| mahāśaulaṃ satyaṃ kuvalayakariṃ hanti maraṇam | aghāvīśaṃ śrīśaṃ śaśimukhikarāmbhojayajita| tamātmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nijakuladale yo'pi bhajati || 37-22 || mahāśabdotpannaṃ prakṛtivikṛtiṃ kāraṇakṛti| kṛpāsindhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kulavadhuśatāmodamilitam | jagannāthaṃ stauti kṣitipativaśāyopakaraṇa| virāṭaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ karaṇagamahāviṣṇumaraṇam || 37-23 || vinodaṃ vyākartuṃ tribhuvanapatiḥ śrīpatiraho | pracaṇḍe saṃsāre udayati sadābhāvasadane | mahāmeghaśyāmastriphalakaruṇāsāgarakule | amūlye sañcāre viṣayarasanāsañcaya viṣam || 37-24 || sa kṛṣṇaḥ śrī viṣṇuḥ prakṛtigadayā hanti satata| ataḥ kṛṣṇo dhyeyaḥ suranaragaṇaiḥ pañcasumukhaiḥ | kulāmbhoje ṣaṭke manarasadale dhyānaphalitaḥ | kirātī rākiṇyā nayana kamalāpānamadhuram || 37-25 || dharādhāraṃ pūrṇaṃ gagananilayaṃ kālapuruṣa| manogamyaṃ ramyaṃ nava nayanalāvaṇyarasikam | sadā dhyāyet kṛṣṇaṃ kurugaṇaripuṃ yaḥ kulapatiḥ | nirālambaḥ śyāmaḥ prakṛtiyamunātīratarugaḥ || 37-26 || kulīnā gopībhiḥ parimilitapārśvasthalasukhaḥ | pradhānaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ kṣitipatikarāmbhojayajitaḥ | prakāśātmā nāthaḥ pracayakaruṇo dhyeya irayā | manodharmaṃ cchatraṃ trividhaguṇagānāśritakaram || 37-27 || trikāṇḍasthaṃ khaṇḍodbhavavanarasaṃ prāṇarasika| yadā stauti prātaḥ samayamaphale cāruvaradam | mahāmokṣakṣetraṃ kulavadhuyutaṃ kṛṣṇaparama| guṇeśaṃ rādheśaṃ rajanividhunitaṃ vedanilayam || 37-28 || kriyādakṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ samayaguṇayogāṅkajaḍita| trikoṇasthaṃ gaṅgājalagalitasāraṃ tārakatanum | mahākālānandaṃ gaganaghanavarṇaṃ sajalaka| prabhāvāraṃ bhāvaṃ taruṇanavavapuḥ śrīdharamalam || 37-29 || vanotphulāmbhojā manaviracanā bhālakalayā | mahāśobhārūpaṃ kulapuruṣagaṃ vyāśrayati yaḥ | sa yogī saṃsāre bhavati rasanāyoganirataḥ | mano yo vyādhāya pracuraphaladaṃ kṛṣṇamakhilam || 37-30 || mahājñānotsāhaṃ gatiguṇavahiḥ prāṇanicaya| jagattāraṃ brahma niravadhimahāyogakiraṇam | yadā lokastauti pratidinamihānandaghaṭita| vikāraṃ sarveṣāṃ grahaṇanilanaṃ bhāskaravidhoḥ || 37-31 || mahārāhugrāsaṃ śataśatamahāpuṇyanikaraṃ | kulānandaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśiśataghaṭārāmakiraṇam | manogamyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇajaḍitaṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 37-32 || kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ mudā kṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvā kṛtvā yatirbhavet | śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje tasya bhaktirna saṃśayaḥ || 37-33 || kṛṣṇabrahma kṛṣṇabrahmā ca tridhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | sa kṛṣṇastaṃ janaṃ nītvā dadāti api śaṅkara || 37-34 || vinā kṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ kuto jayam | kṛṣṇadhyānānmahāpadmabhedaṃ prāpnoti śaṅkara || 37-35 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde svādhiṣṭhānaśrīkṛṣṇarākiṇīsādhanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 37 ||
[athāṣṭātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi śrīkṛṣṇasādhanottamam | yena krameṇa bhaktiḥ syātkālajālavaśo bhavet || 38-1 || mama pādāmbuje bhaktirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | bhaktimān yaḥ sādhakendro mahāviṣṇuṃ bhajedyadi || 38-2 || śivatulyo bhavennātha mama bhakto mahītale || 38-3 || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ trijagatāmānandamokṣātmaka| sampūrṇaṃ triguṇāvṛtaṃ guṇadharaṃ sattvādhidaivaṃ param | liṅgādhaḥ sthitirājyapālapuruṣaṃ pañcānanasthāyina| śrīviṣṇuṃ śubhadaṃ jano yadi bhajellokaḥ saśaktiṃ sukhī || 38-4 || ādau kāmaṃ trisargaṃ kulavadhuniyutaṃ kāmabījaṃ trisargaṃ | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vārayugmaṃ praṇayayugalakaṃ candrikākāśayuktam | brahmadvandvaṃ bhajāmi prakṛti puruṣikāṃ kākinīṃ tatpare ca | bhūyo bhūyo bhajāmi śravaṇagalayanaṃ vahnijāyāvilagnam || 38-5 || etanmantraṃ japitvā praṇavamiti namo'ntaṃ tathādye militvā | bhūyo bhūyo namo'ntaṃ tribhuvanasahitaṃ kṣobhayettat kṣaṇena | rājaśrīstasya śīrṣe niravadhi vasudhā mandire saṃsthirā syāt | kālacchedaṃ prakṛtya pravasati sumukhī brahmadaṇḍe ca kāle || 38-6 || tataḥ prāṇe daivanātha mama santoṣavarddhana | idānīṃ narasiṃhasya mantraṃ śṛṇu mahāprabho || 38-7 || kāntabījaṃ samuddhṛtya yugalaṃ yugalaṃ smṛtam | mahānṛsiṃhamantreṇa pūjayāmi namo namaḥ || 38-8 || svādhiṣṭhāne mahāpadme manoniṣpāpahetunā | mano vidhāya yo yogī japenmantraṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 38-9 || etanmantrajapenāpi siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ | etanmantraprabhāveṇa bhāvasiddhiṃ kṣaṇāllabhet || 38-10 || sādhako yadi bhūmisthaḥ sādhayettu harermanum | reṇusaṃkhyā krameṇaiva siddhiṃ prāpnoti vīryataḥ || 38-11 || atha vakṣye mahādeva sarvavarṇasusārakam | varṇamālāsvasaṃśakto japtvā siddhimavāpnuyāt || 38-12 || siddhimantraṃ prārthayate yadi martyo nirāśrayaḥ | nirjane saṃsthiro bhūttvā ekākī dīpavajītaḥ || 38-13 || niḥśaṅkaṃ prajapenmantraṃ svādhiṣṭhānābjasaṅgate | vaśīkṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yena tatkramamāśṛṇu || 38-14 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya nāntabījaṃ tathodgaret | vahnibījasamālagnamadhodantasvarānvitam || 38-15 || nādabindusamāyuktaṃ punarvāradvayaṃ vadet | narasiṃhāya śabdānte punarvāratrayaṃ vadet || 38-16 || devībījaṃ śaktibījaṃ svāhāntaṃ manumudgaret | etanmantraprayogeṇa kuṇḍalīvaśamānayet || 38-17 || svādhiṣṭhāne sthirībhāvaṃ prāpnoti sādhakāgraṇīḥ | sarveṣāṃ prāṇago bhūtvā prabalo'sau mahītale || 38-18 || śītaṃ raudraṃ samaṃ tasya pāpāpāpaṃ jayājayam | dharmādharmaḥ sadā jñānaṃ nityajñānaṃ samāpnuyāt || 38-19 || punaḥ śrīkṛṣṇamantrāśca sarvadevaniṣevakāḥ | yajjñātvā devatāḥ sarvā sarvadiṅmukhapālakāḥ || 38-20 || tatprayogaṃ mahādeva śṛṇu siddheśca lakṣaṇam | vinā kṛṣṇāśrayeṇāpi brahmā tuṣṭo na kutracit || 38-21 || na tuṣṭā kuṇḍalī devī paśubhāvaṃ vinā prabho | paśubhāve jñānasiddhirvīrabhāve hi mokṣabhāk || 38-22 || divyabhāve samādhistho jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyate | kāntabījaṃ samuddhṛtya śakravāmasvarānvitam || 38-23 || nādabindusamākrāntaṃ kṛṣṇasambodhanaṃ padam | punaḥ pūrvamanuṃ yuktā tryakṣarātmā mahāmanuḥ || 38-24 || etanmantrajapaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavati yogirāṭ | yogo'yaṃ paramāhlādakārako'nantarūpakaḥ || 38-25 || bahubhiḥ kiṃ kathanīyaṃ yaḥ karoti phalaṃ labhet | dhyāyet śrīgopikānāthaṃ rākiṇīmaṇḍaleśvaram || 38-26 || jagatāṃ sattvanilayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ gokuleśvaram svādhiṣṭhānasthitaṃ śyāmaṃ yajed bhujacatuṣṭayam || 38-27 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadma (--) mahāśobhāmanoramam | sarvavidyāgataṃ kāmyaṃ śrīgovindaṃ suśītalam || 38-28 || mahāmohaharaṃ nāthaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam | koṭikanyākarāmbhojajayitaṃ sarvasaṅgatam || 38-29 || kirīṭinaṃ mahāvīraṃ bālenduṃ cūḍayānvitam | guñjāmālā śobhitāṅgaṃ śrīnāthaṃ parameśvaram || 38-30 || pītāmbaraṃ mandahāsyaṃ ṣaṭpadmadalamadhyagam | kāminīprāṇanilayaṃ vasudevasutaṃ harim || 38-31 || evaṃ dhyātvā ṣaḍdale ca sadā vakṣaḥsthakaustubham | rājarājeśvaraṃ śauriṃ bhāvyaṃ śrīvatsalāñchanam || 38-32 || svādhiṣṭhānagataṃ dhyāyenmurārisiddhigo naraḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā purā brahmā nārāyaṇaguṇodayaḥ || 38-33 || manaḥ kalpitadravyaiśca pūjayetparameśvaram | ṣaḍdale ca mahāpadme saṃdhyāyet harimāyajet || 38-34 || ṣoḍaśopacārayuktairmānasakṣetrasambhavaiḥ | manaḥ kalpitapīṭhe ca sthāpayitvā hariṃ gurum || 38-35 || yogeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇamīśaṃ rādhikārākiṇīśvaram | ekāntacitte cāropya kṛṣṇaṃ pīṭhe prapūjayet || 38-36 || tatra dalāṣṭakaṃ padmaṃ tatra ṣaṭkoṇakaṇīkam | vedadvāropaśobhañca sṃnirmmāya manoharam || 38-37 || punaḥ punaryadā dhyāyet ṣaḍdaleṣu daleṣṭakam | pañcopacārairdaśakaiḥ śrīviṣṇuṃ paripūjayet || 38-38 || gandhādayo naivedyāntā pūjāpañcopacārikā āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam || 38-39 || madhuparkācamanasnāna(--)vasanābharaṇāni ca sugandhisumano dhūpadīpanaivedyavandanam || 38-40 || prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa viṣṇorārādhane kuryāt sarvatra vidhireṣa yaḥ || 38-41 || vidhiḥ syāt kṛṣṇaviśveśa samudbhūtasya satpateḥ | daśopacārakathanaṃ śrūyatāṃ vallabha prabho || 38-42 || pādyamarghyaṃ tathācāmaṃ madhuparkācamanaṃ tathā | gandhādayo naivedyāntā upacārā daśakramāt || 38-43 || viṣṇuṃ sampūjya dhīmān haviṣyāśījītendriyaḥ | sarvadā paramānandaḥ kālikāvaśasevakaḥ || 38-44 || sarvajñānadharo vīro vivekī sarvadarśakaḥ | saṃbhāvayet svādhiṣṭhāne nirantaraṃ mahāśuciḥ || 38-45 || bālakakriyayā vyāpto bhāvajñānī nirāmayaḥ | sa bhavet kālikāputro yaḥ kṛṣṇabhāvatatparaḥ || 38-46 || kṛṣṇaṃ sañcintayenmūlakamalodrdhve kulātmakam | sa bhavetkālikāputro'ṣṭāṅgasiddhiguṇānvitaḥ || 38-47 || mānasaiḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhasthāpanamācaret | yatkṛtvā mānasaṃ yogaṃ na kuryādbahirarcanam || 38-48 || mūlamantradevatāyāḥ sādhane daivataṃ yajet | devasya dakṣiṇasthāṃśca pūrvopāsyasusaṃsthitān || 38-49 || pūjayed gandha puṣpādyaistulyamantreṇa mantravit | tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādābjaṃ dhyānaṃ kuryānmanolayam || 38-50 || evaṃ krameṇa tatpadme sthiro bhavati yogirāṭ | yaḥ karoti śuddhabhāvaṃ mahāmohaharaṃ harim || 38-51 || sthāpayitvā ca ṣaṭpadme mahāmokṣamavāpnuyāt | yaḥ pradhānaguṇajñaśca sa me śāstrārthamāśrayet || 38-52 || ihakāle śatruloke nivasatyeva yogirāṭ | pādāmbhoje mano dadyānmakhakiñjalkacitrite || 38-53 || jaṅghāyuge cārurāmakadalīkāṇḍamaṇḍite | ūrudvaye mattagajakaradaṇḍasamaprabhe || 38-54 || gaṅgāvartagabhīre tu nābhau śuddhavile'male | udare vakṣasi tathā harau śrīvatsakaustubhe || 38-55 || pūrṇacandrāyutapakṣe lalāṭe cārukuṇḍale | śaṅkhacakragadāmbhoje dordaṇḍoparimaṇḍite || 38-56 || sahasrādityasaṅkāśe sakirīṭakuladvayam | sthāneṣveṣu yajenmantrī viśuddhaḥ śuddhacetasā || 38-57 || mano niveśya kṛṣṇe vai tanmayo bhavati dhruvam | yāvanmanolayaṃ yāti kṛṣṇe svātmani cinmaye || 38-58 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇasvādhiṣṭhānapraveśo nāma aṣṭātriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 38 ||
[athaikonacattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha nātha pravakṣye'haṃ saṃsārasādhanottamam | yena sādhanamātreṇa yogī bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 39-1 || anāyāsena siddhiḥ syād yadyanmanasi varttate | trailokyaṃ mohayetkṣipraṃ trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet || 39-2 || rāmeṇa sahitaṃ nityaṃ jagatāṃ sākṣiṇaṃ varam | jāmadagnyakarāmbhojasevitaṃ sarvasevitam || 39-3 || anantasattvanilayaṃ vāsukī saṅgamākulam | aṣṭahastāgrasuśrīdaṃ nānālaṅkāraśobhitam || 39-4 || svādhiṣṭhānagataṃ dhyātvā śītalo jāyate vaśī | tatstotraṃ śṛṇu me nātha yatpāṭhāt siddhimāpnuyāt || 39-5 || brahmādayaḥ surādhīśā munayaḥ kraturakṣakāḥ | etat stotraṃ purā kṛtvā jīvanmukto mahītale || 39-6 || ataḥ śrīkālikānātha stotraṃ śṛṇu mahatphalam || 39-7 ||
śrīviṣṇoradbhutakarmaṇo brahmaṣīstriṣṭupchandaḥ śrīviṣṇuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīnārāyaṇo devatā sarvastotrasārakavacamantrasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ ||
śrī kṛṣṇaṃ jagatāmadhīśamanaghaṃ dhyānātsiddhiprada| govindaṃ bhavasindhupārakaraṇaṃ santāraṇaṃ kāraṇam | śrī viṣṇuṃ vanamālinaṃ narahariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ gokula| yogendraṃ naranāthamādipuruṣaṃ vṛndāvane bhāvayet || 39-8 || mokṣaśrīsahitaṃ kṛtāntavikṛtaṃ dharmārṇavaṃ sundara| śrīrāmaṃ balarāmabhāvavimalaṃ nityākulaṃ satkulam | śrīśyāmaṃ kanakādihāravilasatlambodaraṃ śrīdhara| taṃ vande harimīśvaraṃ guṇavatīmāyāśrayaṃ svāśrayam || 39-9 || vaikuṇṭheśamaśeṣadoṣarahitaṃ sāyujyamokṣātmaka| nānāratnavinimītā mama pūjā rājendracūḍāmaṇim | śobhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaṃ suratarucchāyākaraṃ yogina| vidyāgopasutāvṛtaṃ guṇamayaṃ vāksiddhaye bhāvayet || 39-10 || svādhiṣṭhānaniketanaṃ parajanaṃ vidyādhanaṃ māyina| śrīnāthaṃ kulayoginaṃ tribhuvanollāsaikabījaṃ prabhum | saṃsārotsavabhāvalābhanirataṃ sarvādideśaṃ sukha| vande'haṃ varasarpaśatrusaphale pṛṣṭhe sthirānandadam || 39-11 || bhāvāṣṭaṃ bhavabhāvayogajaḍitaṃ jāḍyāpahaṃ bhāsvara| nityaṃ śuddhaguṇaṃ gabhīradhiṣaṇāmodaikahetuṃ patim | kītīkṣemakaraṃ mahābhayaharaṃ kāmādhidaivaṃ śiva| tattatṣaḍdalamadhyageharucirānandaikadeśāspadam || 39-12 || vande śrīpatimacyutaṃ narahariṃ daityāriśikṣyākula| gandharvaprabhṛteḥ sugāyanarataṃ vaṃśīdharaṃ bhāvadam | ratnānāmadhipaṃ gatisthamacalaṃ govardhanādhāraṇa| viśvāmitratapodhanādi munibhiḥ saṃsevitaṃ taijasam || 39-13 || vande govindapādāmbujamajamajitaṃ rājitaṃ bhaktimārge | sattvotpannaṃ prabhutvaṃ paragaṇanamitaṃ cārumañjīrahāram | haṃsākāraṃ dhavalagaruḍānandapṛṣṭhe nimagna| bandhūkāraktasārānvitacaraṇatalaṃ sarvadāśāntarālam || 39-14 || rākiṇyāḥ premasiddhaṃ navavayasigataṃ gītavādyādirāga| rāgotpannaṃ suphalaguṇadaṃ gokulānandacandram | vāṇī(--)lakṣmī(--)pirayaṃ taṃ tribhuvanasujanāhlādakartāramādya| vande siddhāntasāraṃ gatinatirahitaṃ sārasaṅketitāptam || 39-15 || kāmaṃ kāmātmakaṃ taṃ vidhugataśirasaṃ kṛṣṇasambodhanānta| bījaṃ kāmaṃ punastat puruṣasurataruṃ bhāvayitvā bhaje'ham | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇaṃ niravadhisukhadaṃ suprakāśaṃ prasanna| svādhiṣṭhānākhyapadmemanasi gato bhave siddhisthalastham || 39-16 || ākāśe cārupadme rasabhayavalagaṃ raktavarṇaṃ prakāṇḍa| ātmārāmaṃ narendraṃ sakalaratikaraṃ kaṃsahantāramādim | ādyantasthānahīnaṃ vidhiharagamanaṃ sendranīlāmalābha| bhāvotsāhaṃ trisargasthitiparamamaraṃ bhāvaye bhāvasiddhyai || 39-17 || sarveṣāṃ jñānadānaṃ rasadalakamale sarvadā tvaṃ karoṣi | ātmānandaṃ sudhādipirayadhanaguṇināmekayogapradhānam | māyāpūrṇaḥ pracayanavarasaḥ prītideśaḥ prabhekaḥ | śrīrājākhyaḥ prapūrṇaḥ mayi dhanarahite dṛṣṭipātaṃ bhavādau || 39-18 || kālī śrīkuṇḍalinyāḥ paragṛhanirataṃ bhāvakabrahmarūpaṃ mukticchatraṃ pureśaṃ nijadhanasukhaṃ bhāryayā krīḍayantam sabhākṣetraṃ netraṃ nayamānamayamatpurasaṃsthābhiṣekam || 39-19 || dhyātvā'haṃ praṇamāmi sūkṣmakamale lokādhipaṃ vyādhipa| vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṛṣṇamīḍe kurubhavavibhavakṣemahantāramantam | śāntānāṃ jñānagamyaṃ svanayanakamale pālayantaṃ trimārgaṃ vajrāriṃ pūtanāriṃ dvayavakanarakadhvāntasaṃhārasūram || 39-20 || mānyaṃ lokeṣu sarveṣvatiśayamanasaṃ kevalaṃ nirmalañca | oṅkāraṃ kāraṇākhyaṃ sugatimatimatāṃ mātṛkāmantrasiddham | siddhānāmādisiddhaṃ suraripuśamanaṃ kālarūpaṃ ripūṇā| mūlordhve ṣaḍdalānte manasi suvimale pūrayitvā mukundam || 39-21 || nityaṃ sambhāvaye'haṃ nijatanusamatā siddhaye pūjayāmi tvaṃ sākṣādakhileśvaraḥ pirayakaraḥ śrīlokahastācītaḥ | kṣoṇīśaḥ pralayātmakaḥ pratiguṇī jñānī tvameko mahān || 39-22 || yadyevaṃ mama pāmarasya kaluṣaṃ śrīdharmahīnāndita| kṛtvā pādatale yadīha niyataṃ vyārakṣa rakṣātmagam | rādhākṛṣṇapadāmalāmbujatalaṃ caitanyamuktyākulaṃ sarvatrādigamāgamaṃ trigamanaṃ nirvāṇamokṣāśrayam || 39-23 || bālaṃ vairivināśanaṃ sukhamayaṃ kaivalyamokṣāspada| daivaṃ devagaṇācītaṃ rasadale cāropayāmi prabho | nirddaṣṭaṃ bhuvanāśrayaṃ yatipatiṃ nirvāṇamokṣasthitaṃ nirvāṇādikamodane pracapalaṃ śrīcañcalāsaṅkulam || 39-24 || vande'haṃ parameśvaraṃ sakaladaityānāṃ balaprāṇaha| haṃsārūḍhanirakṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇagataṃ vāṇīpatiṃ bhūpatim | vāñchākalpalatāpatiṃ kulapatiṃ vidyāpatiṃ gopatim || 39-25 || śrīvidyāpatimādidevapuruṣaṃ viśveśvarapremaga| śrīkumbhodbhavakālasatvanikaraṃ tvāṃ bhāskaraṃ bhāvaye | siddhānāmabhicinhayoganirataṃ rakṣa tvamādau hi mām || 39-26 || prabho niḥsaṅketaṃ guṇamaṇimataṃ śreyasi mata| matāmantaḥ susthaṃ vigalitamahāpremasurasam | mudā vande kṛṣṇaṃ harakaratalāmbhojayajitam || 39-27 || prabhāpuñjaṃ rāmāśrayapadamadaṃ kāmakuśala| mahāmantracchāyāṃ rajanimilitaṃ dhvāntajaḍitam | trikoṇasthaṃ kusthaṃ kugatisugatiṃ kāraṇagati| pralīnaṃ saṃsthānaṃ jagati jagatāṃ dharmamudayam || 39-28 || rameśaṃ vāṇīśaṃ vidhigatapadaṃ śambhunigata| trikālaṃ yogānāṃ nayanakamalaṃ śabdaniratam | kulānandaṃ gopījanahṛdayagaṃ gopiyajitaṃ vidhānaṃ tvāmindraṃ gurutaramupendraṃ hariripum || 39-29 || mudā tvāṃ vande'haṃ capalaṃ tāṃ me navahave | kulālāpaśraddhāmaya makhilasiddhipradamanam | malātītaṃ nītaṃ suranarasatāṃ śāstrabhavanam || 39-30 || vinodaṃ nārīṇāṃ hṛdayarasikaṃ śokarahitam | virājaṃ yajñānāṃ hitamatiguṇaṃ yāmi śaraṇam || 39-31 || etatsambandhamātrī mama kulaśirasi sthāyinaṃ pātu nityaṃ gopīnāṃ prāṇanāthaḥ pratidinamaniśaṃ bhāladeśaṃ prapāyāt | bhālādhodeśasaṃsthaṃ samavatu sahasā rājarājeśvareśaḥ | ( gopānvanvo sureśaḥ ? ) sthityanteśastrinetraṃ sukhamakhilabhavaḥ kaṇṭhacchatrābhisaṃstham || 39-32 || pṛṣṭhasthaṃ pātu śauriḥ pratidinamamaro liṅgabāhyaṃ kaṭisthaṃ śambhupremābhilāṣī mama tu kulapadaṃ guhyadeśaṃ prapāyāt ānandodrekakārī sakalatanugataṃ pātu nityaṃ murāriḥ | daityāriścorumūlaṃ nṛhariravatu me jaṅghayā pādapadmam || 39-33 || etatstotraṃ paṭhedvidvān niyato bhaktimān śuciḥ | sthiro bhavati māsena ṣaḍdale sarvasiddhibhāk || 39-34 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇastavanakavacaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 39 ||
[atha cattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha nātha pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama | yena krameṇa lokānāṃ yogakāryaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavet || 40-1 || sarvatra bhāvagrastaḥ saḥ siddho bhavati bhairava | yo bhavedbhairavo devo bhuvane sarvago hi saḥ || 40-2 || kriyādakṣo mahāvīro vīravallabhabhāvakaḥ | bhāvayitvā varṇamālāṃ madhye japtvā divāniśam || 40-3 || haviṣyāśī prāṇavāyurato vedāntapāragaḥ | siddhāntavettā sarveṣāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ nirṇayapirayaḥ || 40-4 || gāthājñānī parānando vivekī bhāvatatparaḥ | bhāvavettā rahasyārthajñānī kovidavedavit || 40-5 || vākyasiddhijñānaparaḥ satyavādī dṛḍhāsanaḥ | bhāvayet ṣaḍgataṃ varṇaṃ dhyānaṃ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak || 40-6 || ṣaṭpadmastho bhāvayedvai ṣaḍvarṇaṃ dhyānapūrvakam | vādilāntākṣaraṃ dhyāyenmahāvidyāniṣevakaḥ || 40-7 || bakāraṃ saundaryaṃ svakiraṇamayaṃ bhāvyamatula| mukundaśrībhaktipirayaramaṇakaṃ pūrvadalagam | viśiṣṭajñānāntaṃ sukharanataṃ koṭikiraṇa| vibhāvya śrīlakṣmīṃ gamayati jhaṭit kālapuruṣam || 40-8 || dvivarṇaṃ śrīnāthaṃ sukhayati bhakāraṃ rasadale | trikoṇāpārśvasthāṃ capalaśakalaṃ śambhunilayam | mahāraktākāraṃ taruṇavigataṃ bhīmamakula| kulāgārasthānaṃ kularamaṇīraktāyutamiti || 40-9 || yadā dhyāyet jñānī niravadhi mudā śokaviṣaha| trilokānāṃ sthānaṃ bhuvanaśaraṇaṃ prātavisukhī | mahāmokṣadvāre bhavati sa mahān sarvajaḍito | vilāsī sarveṣāṃ navanavavadhūnāṃ pirayapatiḥ || 40-10 || mahākālasthānaṃ sa jayati sakāraṃ yadi bhaje darīṇāṃ vyāhastā rudhirakiraṇaṃ koṭyaruṇakam | mahākālasthānaṃ (.....) śaraṇaṃ prāgapi sukhī | trikoṇāṃ dakṣāṅge nigamanayano yogayajitaḥ || 40-11 || vinodī saukhyānāṃ suratarusamāno bhuvi divi | yakāraṃ yo dhyāyedamarapadavīvyādhirahitaḥ | mahāvāṇīnāthaṃ praṇayajaḍitaṃ tvak surataru| mukundānandāntaḥ pavanamilitaṃ kāmakaraṇam || 40-12 || tadā loko'kāmī bhavati nitarāṃ kākapavanī | mahāgneḥ saṃsthānaṃ parajaladharaṃ sūryaśatakam | yadānandairdhyāyet paramadhanadaṃ yajñasudhayā | sudhāpānajñānī havanakaraṇaṃ kāmyaphaladam | pirayaṃ tadveratyāḥ kamalagabhujaṅgeśvaranuta| trikoṇāpṛṣṭhasthaṃ vidhihariharasya pirayamiti || 40-13 || vidhānaṃ vahnīnāṃ kulavimalabījaṃ sakaruṇa| asṛṅ māyākhaṇḍaṃ khagagaṇamanorañjanavaram | yadi dhyāyedeko vibhavavividhaṃ yāti sahasā | mahendraḥ sthānāṅgaṃ kamalasukhadaṃ kṛṣṇanilayam || 40-14 || pirayaṃ siddhakṣetraṃ yadi sukhamayaṃ bhāvayati yaḥ | lakāraṃ candrasthaṃ vidhuśatakaraṃ bindunilayam | viśālākṣī rādhā madhuravacanālāpakalitaṃ ramāmode patre taraṇakaraṇaṃ sāpaharaṇam || 40-15 || suvāme rākiṇyā navarasamayaṃ mohaharaṇa| vibhāvya śrīnāthaṃ bhajati sa naro dhyānanipuṇo | mahāmokṣaṃ prāpya prathamarajasaṃ saṅgamayati || 40-16 || tato dhyeyā mahāvidyā rākiṇīśaktiruttamā | śrīviṣṇusahitā nityaṃ yogairbhogavivajītaḥ || 40-17 || akalaṅkī kulānando mandahāsyāvṛto mahān | sa yogī paramaṃ rājyaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 40-18 || yāvanmūlādhārayogaṃ tāvad yamādikaṃ prabho | yamaniyamāsane kāle yogaṃ pañcāmarānvitam || 40-19 || tāvatkuryānmahādeva yāvattat siddhimāpnuyāt | yadi pañcāmarā siddhistadā māyādisiddhibhāk || 40-20 || pañcāsavā siddhikāle prāṇādivāyupañcamam | dhṛtvā dhṛtvā punardhṛtvā kumbhayedaniśaṃ śanaiḥ || 40-21 || śarīre nirmale yāte vāyunirmalatā bhavet | sarvarūpī mahāvāyunīrmalātmānamātmani || 40-22 || siddhiṃ dadāti yogeśa yadi svakāryamāśrayet || 40-23 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhimantraprakaraṇe ānandabhairavī(--) bhairavasaṃvāde ṣaḍdalavarṇaprakāśo nāma catvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 40 ||
[athaikacattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca kṛtāntasaṃhāravihārabhogaṃ rasāplutaśrīkara śaṅkara prabho | tavājñayā'haṃ kathayāmi siddhaye | mayāgamānandavaśāddhi tantram || 41-1 || premābhilāṣī sujano munīndro | jānāti tantrārthamanantasādhanam | mahāprabhāte carāṇābjabhakto | govindaśambhoryadi bhaktibhājanaḥ || 41-2 || ṣaḍcakrabhedārthaviśeṣasādhana| jānāti yo vā sa jano'tidurlabhaḥ | sa eva saṃsāraniṣedhasādhana| sadā vihāyācala bhaktimāpnuyāt || 41-3 || ānandabhairava uvāca yadi vā kathitā kānte ṣaḍdalaprakriyā śubhā | rākiṇyā milanaṃ devyāḥ kuṇḍalinyāḥ parākramam || 41-4 || sārddhaṃ śrīviṣṇunā kālarūpiṇā bahurūpiṇā | śuddhanirmalatattvena parivāragaṇaiḥ saha || 41-5 || na taddhi kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya parākramam | stavanaṃ devarākiṇyā sahitaṃ kṛṣṇasādhanam || 41-6 || maṅgalaṃ paramaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ kulavarddhanam | kṛṣṇaprakāśastavanaṃ rākiṇīśaktisaṃyutam || 41-7 || kathayasva mahākāli yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati | atyantaguhyaṃ kathanaṃ sahasranāmamaṅgalam || 41-8 || aṣṭottaraṃ mahāviṣṇo rākiṇyā sahitaṃ piraye | idānīṃ rākiṇīstotraṃ vada bhāminī kāmade || 41-9 || ānandabhairavī uvāca yogendra paramānandasindho śrīcandraśekhara | śṛṇuṣva rākiṇīstotraṃ paramānandavardhanam || 41-10 || sarvatra sukhadaṃ proktaṃ siddhānāmapi sādhanam | etat stavanapāṭhena yogī yogendrabhāk bhavet || 41-11 || vaiṣṇavīsādhane yastu pañcācāraṃ karoti vā | sarveṣāṃ sādhanotkṛṣṭaṃ jātibhraṣṭo'pi no bhavet || 41-12 || samatā śatrumitreṣu karmākarmasu tattvavit | yadi vā vaiṣṇave nātha samabhāvaḥ prajāyate || 41-13 || pañcācārakrameṇaiva siddho bhavati nānyathā | rādhādigopikābhiśca gopavṛndaiḥ samantataḥ || 41-14 || pañcācāraṃ mudā kṛtvā sarveṣāṃ paripālanam | cakāra kamalānātho'taḥ pañcācāramāśrayet || 41-15 || pañcācārakrameṇaiva caitanyā kuṇḍalī bhavet | kṛṣṇacaitanyahetośca rākiṇyāśca tathā prabho || 41-16 || caitanyāya ṣaḍdalasthadeva caitanyahetunā | kuṇḍalīvadhurākiṇyāḥ stotraṃ śṛṇu kulārṇava || 41-17 || āndolitā rasanidhau kulacañcalā yā | māyāmayo sakaladuḥkhavināśavīrā | vīrāsanā sthitigatā sulabhā munīnā| bhavyā prapātu bhavikā kularākiṇī mām || 41-18 || ānandasindhu jaḍitākhilasārapānā bālā kulīnanamitā dalaṣaṭkulasthā | kālīkalāmalaguṇā dhanināṃ dhanasthā | kṛṣṇeśvarī samudayaṃ kuru rākiṇī me || 41-19 || yā rākiṇī trijagatāmudayāya ceṣṭā | saṃjñāmayī kulavatī kulavallabhasthā | viśveśvarī smaraharapirayakarmaniṣṭhā | kṛṣṇapirayā mama sukhaṃ paripātu devī || 41-20 || ṣaḍvarganāthakarapadmaniṣevitā yā | rādheśvarī pirayakarī surasundarī sā | mātā kuleśajananī jagatāṃ manusthā | vidyā parā ripuharāvata me śarīram || 41-21 || govindarāmaramaṇī navamālinī yā | rājyeśvarī smaraharā navakāminī vā | me ṣaḍdalāśritasuraṃ paripātu nitya| śrīkuṇḍalī suvimalā kularākiṇī sā || 41-22 || śrīsundarī kulaparā kulavṛndavandyā sandhyāvidhi prabhavatāmatikāmatīrthā | śrīdāyinī kulagaṇāmalabhāvadātrī | nityaṃ prapātu viṣayaṃ kulaṣaḍdalānām || 41-23 || caitanyadānaniratāṃ triguṇābhirāmā| śyāmāṃ nitambadhṛtasundararatnaghaṇṭām | nīlācalasthitakarāṃ varadānahastā| śrīkṛṣṇavāmakamalopari pūjayāmi || 41-24 || tāṃ rākiṇīṃ triramaṇīṃ samalāpahantrī| sarvasthitāṃ gaganamātaramambujasthām | padmāsanāṃ śrutibhujāṃ gurujāmanantā| śāntāṃ ṣaḍambujadalopari pūjayāmi || 41-25 || śāntiṃ kṛpākapaṭakopari nāśamukti| śivāṃ paramavaiṣṇavapūjitāṅghram | rādhāṃ sudhāṃ varamayīṃ jagatāṃ guṇasthā| dharmārṇavāṃ rasadale paripūjayāmi || 41-26 || karttīkarāṃ sakaruṇāṃ ramaṇīṃ
