trisargā | tāṃ rākiṇīmatidayāmamalārthacintām | bhrāntiṃ bhramāgamavarāṃ smṛtimādipūjyā| bhāryāṃ hareratisukhāṃ paripūjayāmi || 41-27 || yā kātaraṃ niravadhipraṇayasvavasthā vāgīśvarī bhagavatī yatikoṭinamrā | tāmrākṛtiprakṛticetasi raktavarṇā | māyāmayī surakalāvati pātu me'ṅgam || 41-28 || kalpadrumāśayalatā phalarūpiṇī yā | bhargasthitā puruṣakoṭimunistuvantī | sā me kuleśvararasaṃ harihastapūjyā | kṣāntiḥ sadā mama dhanaṃ paripātu rādhā || 41-29 || kṣemaṅkarī varakarī sukarī haristhā | yā saukarī bhavakarī tripurā maheśī | vāyusthitā layamayī sthitimārgasaṅgā | bhaṅgapirayā sakalakā paripātu rādhā || 41-30 || gaṅgā nirmalabhāvadā mamaśirodeśaṃ sadā rakṣatu | śrīrādhā kularākiṇī mama kapālordhva mahāvākpirayā | mantrasthā jayadā mudā kumudinī bhālaṃ bhruvorantara| vidyā vāgbhavakuṇḍalīphalavalābālā ca netratrayam || 41-31 || gaṇḍaṃ caṇḍasarasvatī śrutikulaṃ kailāsaśailasthitā | medhā ṭaṃ ghaṭavāsinī śaśīmukhī sūkṣmātisūkṣmāśayā | jihvāgraṃ cibukaṃ radāvadhivahā kaṇṭhaṃ galaṃ skandhagaṃ skandeśī daśanaprabhāmalamati (--) vaikuṇṭhadhāmeśvarī || 41-32 || nānāvarṇavilāsinī mṛdurasaṃ śambhorbhavānī śivā | pṛṣṭhaṃ karmasu pṛṣṭhagā gatikarī nityolbaṇī bhāsvatī | pārśvaṃ me kulamālinī mama kaṭiṃ liṅgaṃ nitambāmbara| kāmākhyā dhanadāyinī sakaruṇā pādadvayaṃ pātu sā || 41-33 || mātṛkrodhanivāriṇī mama śivaṃ ṣaṭpatraśobhākara| pātu śrīcaruvāsinī kulataruṃ gaurī parānandadā | caitanyasthalavāsinī mama gatā govindamātṛpirayā | caitanyaṃ satataṃ prapātu dharaṇī dhātrī varakṣetragā || 41-34 || dhanyā piṅgalalocanāmbujamukhī caitanyakarmapirayā | sarvatra pirayamākarotu niyataṃ śaktiḥ kṣamākartṛkā | kītīsthā mama kītīcakranilayaṃ lākṣāruṇā balvarī | nīcā cakranivāsinī mama jayā jīvaṃ mudā pātu mām || 41-35 || etatstotraṃ paṭhennityaṃ prāṇavāyuvarāśubhe | ṣaṭcakrabhedasamaye sadā pāṭhyaṃ suyogibhiḥ || 41-36 || kulavinyāsasamaye kulacakrapraveśane | avaśyaṃ prapaṭhedvidvān rākiṇīrādhikāstavam || 41-37 || trisandhyaṃ cedamākuryāt paṭhitvā ca punaḥ punaḥ | dhyātvā bhāvaparo bhūtvā mucyate bhavabandhanāt || 41-38 || acalāṃ bhaktimāpnoti viśvāmitro yathā vaśī | paṭhanāt pāmaro yāti brahmalokaṃ kulādhipa || 41-39 || etatpaṭhanamātreṇa śītalo guṇavān bhavet | aprakāśyamidaṃ stotraṃ sarvāntakavināśanam || 41-40 || samabhāvaṃ samākṛtya jīvanmukto bhavedvaśī | pañcācārarato bhūtvā sādhayed yadi sādhanam || 41-41 || kuṇḍalīyogakāle ca kulācāraṃ na varjayet | kulācāravarjanena mahāhāniḥ prajāyate || 41-42 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyo vā śūdra eva ca | samabhāvaṃ sadā kṛtvā kulācāraṃ samāśrayet || 41-43 || kuṇḍalī pṛthivī devī rākiṇī svāridevatā | tadgehagāminī devī rādhikā rājyakāminī || 41-44 || asyāḥ sādhanakāle ca samayācāramāśrayet | samabhāve mahāmokṣa iti tantrārthanirṇayaḥ || 41-45 || samabhāvārthakathanaṃ tyaktvā yogī bhavetkṛtī || 41-46 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhimantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde svādhiṣṭhānarākiṇī(--)stotraṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 41 ||
[atha dvicattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca kathayāmi mahākāla paramādbhutasādhanam | kuṇḍalīrūpiṇī devī rākiṇyāḥ kulavallabha || 42-1 || mānasaṃ dravyamānīya cāthavā bāhyadravyakam | anaṣṭahṛṣṭacittaśca pūjayet sāvadhānataḥ || 42-2 || bhaktyā japenmūlamantraṃ mānasaṃ sarvameva ca | pūjayitvā tato japtvā homaṃ kuryāt parāmṛtaiḥ || 42-3 || samāsaiḥ pakvanaivedyaiḥ sugandhikusumaistathā | svayambhūkusumainītyamarghyaṃ kṛttvā nivedayet || 42-4 || sumukhaṃ pūjayennityaṃ madhumāṃsena śaṃkara | hutvā hutvā punarhutvā prāṇavāyvagnisaṃgamaiḥ || 42-5 || bhrāmayittvā mano bāhye sthāpayittvā punaḥ punaḥ | punarāgamyagamanaṃ kārayittvā sumaṅgalam || 42-6 || vācayittvā suvāṇībhiryācayittvā savāpikam | tarpaṇaṃ cābhiṣekañca kevalāsavamiśritaiḥ || 42-7 || māṃsairmudrādibhirmatsyaiḥ sāradravyaiḥ sapiṣṭakaiḥ | ghṛtādisuphalairvāpi yad yadāyāti kaulike || 42-8 || acalāṃ bhaktimāpnoti viśvāmitro yathā vaśī | tattaddravyaiḥ sādhakendro nityaṃ santarpya saṃjapet || 42-9 || etanmantraṃ pāṭhittvā ca tarpaṇañca samācaret | tarpaṇānte cābhiṣekaṃ sadā kuryācca tāntrikaḥ || 42-10 || mūlānte cābhiṣiñcāmi namaḥ svāhā padaṃ tataḥ | tato hi praṇamedbhaktyā aṣṭāṅganatibhiḥ prabho || 42-11 || sahasranāmnā stavanamaṣṭottarasamanvitam | ardhāṅga rākiṇīyuktaṃ rākiṇīkeśavastavam || 42-12 || śṛṇu taṃ sakalaṃ nātha yatra śraddhā sadā tava | śravaṇārthaṃ bahūktaṃ tat kṛpayā te vadāmyaha || 42-13 || etat śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet | rākiṇīsaṅgamaṃ nātha stavanaṃ nāma pāvanam || 42-14 || ye paṭhanti śraddhayā cāśraddhayā vā punaḥ punaḥ | tasya sarvaḥ pāparāśiḥ kṣayaṃ yāti kṣaṇādiha || 42-15 || kāle kāle mahāvīro bhavatyeva hi yogirāṭ | saṃsārottāraṇe yukto mahābalaparākramaḥ || 42-16 || oṃ śrīkṛṣṇo mahāmāyā yādavo devarākiṇī | govindo viśvajananī mahāviṣṇurmaheśvarī || 42-17 || mukundo mālatī mālā vimalā vimalākṛtiḥ | ramānātho mahādevī mahāyogī prabhāvatī || 42-18 || vaikuṇṭho devajananī dahano dahanapriyā | daityārirdaityamathinī munīśo maunabhāvitā || 42-19 || nārāyaṇo jayakalā karuṇo karuṇāmayī | hṛṣīkeśaḥ kauśikī ca keśavaḥ keśighātinī || 42-20 || kiśorāpi kaiśorī mahākālī mahākalā | mahāyajño yajñahartrī dakṣeśo dakśakanyakā || 42-21 || mahābalī mahābālā bālako devabālikā | cakradhārī cakrakarā cakrāṅgaḥ cakramadīkā || 42-22 || amaro yuvatī bhīmo bhayā devo divisthitā | śrīkaro veśadā vaidyo guṇā yogī kulasthitā || 42-23 || samayajño mānasajñā kriyāvijñaḥ kriyānvitā | akśaro vanamālā ca kālarūpī kulākśarā || 42-24 || viśālākśo dīrghanetrā jayado jayavāhanā | śāntaḥ śāntikarī śyāmo vimalaśyāma vigrahā || 42-25 || kamaleśo mahālakṣmī satyaḥ sādhvī śiśuḥ prabhā | vidyutākāravadano vidyutpuñjanabhodayā || 42-26 || rādheśvaro rākiṇī ca kuladevaḥ kulāmarā | dakśiṇo dakśiṇī śrīdā kriyādakśo mahālayā || 42-27 || vaśiṣṭhagamano vidyā vidyeśo vāksarasvatī | atīndriyo yogamātā raṇeśī raṇapaṇḍitā || 42-28 || kṛtāntako bālakṛṣṇā kamanīyaḥ sukāmanā | ananto anantaguṇadā vāṇīnātho vilakśaṇā || 42-29 || gopālo gopavanitā gogopa kulātmajā | maunī maunakarollāsā mānavo mānavātmajā || 42-30 || sarvācchinno mohinī ca māyī māyā śarīrajā | akśuṇṇo vajradehasthā garuḍastho hi gāruḍī || 42-31 || satyapriyā rukmiṇī ca satyaprāṇo'mṛtāpahā | satyakarmā satyabhāmā satyarūpī trisatyadā || 42-32 || śaśīśo vidhuvadanā kṛṣṇavarṇo viśāladhīḥ | trivikramo vikramasthā sthitimārgaḥ sthitipriyā || 42-33 || śrīmādhavo mādhavī ca madhuhā madhusūdanī | vaikuṇṭhanātho vikalā vivekastho vivekinī || 42-34 || vivādastho vivādeśī kumbhakaḥ kumbhakārikā | sudhāpānaḥ sudhārūpā suveśo devamohinī || 42-35 || prakriyādhārako dhanyā dhanyārtho dhanyavigrahā | dharaṇīśo mahānantā sānanto nandanapriyā || 42-36 || priyo vipriyaharā ca viprapūjyo dvijapriyā | kānto vidhumukhī vedyo vidyā vāgīśvaro'ruṇā || 42-37 || akāmī kāmarahitā kamro vilacarapriyā | puṇḍarīko vikuṇḍasthā vaikuṇṭho bālabhāvinī || 42-38 || padmanetra padmamālā padmahasto'mbujānanā | padmanābhiḥ padmanetrā padmasthaḥ padmavāhanā || 42-39 || vāsudevo bṛhadgarbhā mahāmānī mahāñjanā | kāruṇyo bālagarbhā ca ākāśastho vibhāṇḍajā || 42-40 || tejorāśistaijasī ca bhayācchanno bhayapradā | upendro varṇajālasthā svatantrastho vimānagā || 42-41 || nagendrastho nāginī ca nageśo nāganandinī | sārvabhaumo mahākālī nagendraḥ nandinīsutā || 42-42 || kāmadevāśrayo māyā mitrastho mitravāsanā | mānabhaṅgakaro rāvā vāraṇāripriyaḥ priyā || 42-43 || ripuhā rākiṇī mātā sumitro mitrarakśikā | kālānta kalahā devī pītavāsāmbarapriyā || 42-44 || pāpahartā pāpahantrī niṣpāpaḥ pāpanāśinī | parānandapriyo mīnā mīnarūpī malāpahā || 42-45 || indranīlamaṇiśyāmo mahendro nīlarūpiṇī | nīlakaṇṭhapriyo durgā durgādurgatināśinī || 42-46 || trikoṇamandiraśrīdo vimāyā mandirasthitā | makarandarasollāso makarandarasapriyā || 42-47 || dāruṇārinihantā ca dāruṇārivināśinī | kalikālakulācāraḥ kalikālaphalāvahā || 42-48 || kālakṣetrasthito raudrī vratastho vratadhāriṇī | viśālākśo viśālāsyā camatkāro karodyamā || 42-49 || lakārastho lākinī ca lāṅgalī lolayānvitā | nākastho nākapadakā nākākśo nākarakśakā || 42-50 || kāmago nāmasambandhā sāmavedaviśodhikā | sāmavedaḥ sāmasandhyā sāmago māṃsabhakśiṇī || 42-51 || sarvabhakśo rātrabhakśā retastho retapālinī | rātrikārī mahārātriḥ kālarātro mahāniśā || 42-52 || nānādoṣaharo mātrā mārahantā surāpahā | candanāṅgī nandaputrī nandapālaḥ vilopinī || 42-53 || mudrākārī mahāmudrā mudrito mudritā ratiḥ | śākto lākśā vedalākśī lopāmudrā narottamā || 42-54 || mahājñānadharo'jñānī nīrā mānaharo'marā | satkītīstho mahākītīḥ kulākhyo kulakītītā || 42-55 || āśāvāsī vāsanā sā kulavettā sugopitā | aśvatthavṛkśanilayo vṛkśasāranivāsinī || 42-56 || nityavṛkśo nityalatā kḷptaḥ kḷptapadasthitaḥ | kalpavṛkśo kalpalatā sukālaḥ kālabhakśikā || 42-57 || sarvālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyo sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā | akalaṅkī nirāhārā dunīrīkṣyo nirāpadā || 42-58 || kāmakartā kāmakāntā kāmarūpī mahājavā | jayanto yājayantī ca jayākhya jayadāyinī || 42-59 || trijīvano jīvamātā kuśalākhyo visundarā | keśadhārī keśinī ca kāmajo kāmajāḍyadā || 42-60 || kiṅkarastho vikārasthā mānasaṃjño manīṣiṇī | mithyāharo mahāmithyā mithyāsargo nirākṛti || 42-61 || nāgayajñopavītaśca nāgamālāvibhūṣitā | nāgākhyo nāgakulapā nāyako nāyikā vadhūḥ || 42-62 || nāyakakṣemado nārī naro nārāyaṇapriyā | kirātavarṇo rāsajñī tārako guṇatārikā || 42-63 || śaṅkarākhyo'mbujākārā kṛpaṇaḥ kṛpaṇāvatī | deśago deśasantoṣā darśo darśanivāsinī || 42-64 || darśanajño darśanasthā dṛg dṛdikśā suro'surāḥ | surapālo devarakśā trirakśo rakśadevatā || 42-65 || śrīrāmasevī sukhadā sukhado vyāsavāsinī | vṛndāvanastho vṛndā ca vṛndāvanyo mahattanū || 42-66 || brahmarūpī tritārī ca tārakākśo hi tāriṇī | tantrarthajñaḥ tantravidyā sutantrajñaḥ sutantrikā || 42-67 || tṛptaḥ sutṛptā lokānāṃ tarpaṇastho vilāsinī | mayūrā mandirarato mathurā mandire'malā || 42-68 || mandiro mandirādevī nirmāyī māyasaṃharā | śrīvatsahṛdayo vatsā vatsalo bhaktavatsalā || 42-69 || bhaktapriyo bhaktagamyā bhakto bhaktiḥ prabhuḥ prabhā | jaro jarā varo rāvā havirhemā kśamaḥ kśiti || 42-70 || kśoṇīpo vijayollāsā vijayojayarūpiṇī | jayadātā dātṛjāyā balipo balipālikā || 42-71 || kṛṣṇamārjārarūpī ca kṛṣṇamārjārarūpiṇī | ghoṭakastho hayasthā ca gajago gajavāhanā || 42-72 || gajeśvaro gajādhārā gajo garjanatatparā | gayāsuro gayādevī gajadarpo gajāpītā || 42-73 || kāmanāphalasiddhyarthī kāmanāphalasiddhidā | dharmadātā dharmavidyā mokśado mokśadāyinī || 42-74 || mokśāśrayo mokśakartrī nandagopāla īśvarī | śrīpatiḥ śrīmahākālī kiraṇo vāyurūpiṇī || 42-75 || vāyvāhārī vāyuniṣṭhā vāyubījayaśasvinī | jetā jayantī yāgastho yāgavidyā śivaḥ śivā || 42-76 || vāsavo vāsavasthī ca vāsākhyo dhanavigrahā | ākhaṇḍalo vikhaṇḍā ca khaṇḍastho khaṇḍakhañjanī || 42-77 || khaḍgahasto bāṇahastā bāṇago bāṇavāhanā | siddhāntajño dhvāntahantrī dhanastho dhānyavaddhīnī || 42-78 || lokānurāgo rāgasthā sthitaḥ sthāpakabhāvanā | sthānabhraṣṭo'padasthā ca śaraccandranibhānanā || 42-79 || candrodayaścandravarṇā cārucandro rucisthitā | rucikārī ruciprītā racano racanāsanā || 42-80 || rājarājo rājakanyā bhuvano bhuvanāśrayā | sarvajñaḥ sarvatobhadrā vācālo layadhātinī || 42-81 || liṅgarūpadharo liṅgā kaliṅgaḥ kālakeśarī | kevalānandarūpākhyo nirvāṇamokśadāyinī || 42-82 || mahāmeghagāḍhaḥ mahānandarūpā | mahāmeghajālo mahāghorarūpā | mahāmeghamālaḥ sadākārapālā | mahāmeghamālāmalālolakālī || 42-83 || viyadvyāpako vyāpikā sarvadehe mahāśūravīro mahādharmavīrā | mahākālarūpī mahācaṇḍarūpā | vivekī madaikī kuleśaḥ kuleśī || 42-84 || sumārgī sugītā śucisvo vinitā | mahārko vitarkā sutarko'vitarkā | kṛtīndro mahendrī bhago bhāgyacandrā | caturtho mahārthā nagaḥ kītīcandrā || 42-85 || viśiṣṭo maheṣṭirmanasvī sutuṣṭi(--) | rmahāṣaḍdalastho mahāsuprakāśā | galaccandradhārāmṛtasnigdhadeho | galatkoṭisūryaprakāśābhilāṣā || 42-86 || mahācaṇḍavego mahākuṇḍavegī | mahāruṇḍakhaṇḍo mahāmuṇḍakhaṇḍā | kulālabhramaccakrasāraḥ prakārā | kulālo malākā racakraprasārī || 42-87 || kulālakriyāvān mahāghorakhaṇḍaḥ kulālakrameṇa bhramajñānakhaṇḍā | pratiṣṭhaḥ pratiṣṭhā pratīkśaḥ pratīkśā | mahākhyo mahākhyā sukālo'tidīkśā || 42-88 || mahāpañcamācāratuṣṭaḥ praceṣṭā | mahāpañcamā premahā kāntaceṣṭā | mahāmattaveśo mahāmaṅgaleśī | sureśaḥ kśapeśī varo dīrghaveśā || 42-89 || caro bāhyaniṣṭhā caraścāruvarṇā | kulādyo'kulādyā yatiryāgavādyā | kulokāpahantā mahāmānahantrī | mahāviṣṇuyogī mahāviṣṇuyogā || 42-90 || kśitikśobhahantā kśitikśubdhabādhā | mahārgho mahārghā dhanī rājyakāryā | mahārātri sāndrāndhakāraprakāśo | mahārātri sāndrāndhakārapraveśā || 42-91 || mahābhīmagambhīraśabdapraśabdo | mahābhīmagambhīraśabdāpaśabdā | kulā jñānadātrī yamo yāmayātrā | vaśī sūkṣmaveśāśvago nāmamātrā || 42-92 || hiraṇyākśahantā mahāśatruhantrī | vināśapriyo bāṇanāśapriyā ca | mahāḍākinīśo mahārākiṇīśo | mahāḍākinī sā mahārākiṇī sā || 42-93 || mukundo mahendro mahābhadracandrā | kśitityāgakartā mahāyogakartrī | hito mārahantrī maheśeśa indrā | gatikśobhabhāvo mahābhāvapuñjā || 42-94 || śaśīnāṃ samūho vidhoḥ koṭiśaktiḥ | kadambāśrito vāramukhyā satīnā| mahollāsadātā mahākālamātā | svayaṃ sarvaputraḥ svayaṃ lokaputrī || 42-95 || mahāpāpahantā mahābhāvabhartrī | hariḥ kātīkī kātīko devasenā | jayāpto viliptā kulāpto gaṇāptā | suvīryo sabhāṣā kśitīśo'bhiyātā || 42-96 || bhavān bhāvalakṣmīḥ priyaḥ premasūkṣmā | janeśo dhaneśī kṛpo mānabhaṅgā | kaṭhorotkaṭānāṃ mahābuddhidātā | kṛtisthā guṇajño guṇānandavijñā || 42-97 || mahākālapūjyo mahākālapūjyā | khagākhyo nagākhyā kharaḥ khaḍgahastā | atharvo'tharvāndolitasthaḥ mahārthā | khagakśobhanāśā haviḥ kūṭahālā || 42-98 || mahāpadma mālādhṛto gāṇapatyā | gaṇastho gabhīrā guruḥ jñānagamyā | ghaṭaprāṇadātā ghanākārarūpā | bhayārthoṅabījāṅavārīṅakartā || 42-99 || bhavo bhāvamātā naro yāmadhyātā | calānto'calākhyā cayo'ñjālikā ca chalajñaśchalāḍhyā chakāraśchakārā | jayo jīvanasthā jaleśo jaleśā || 42-100 || japañjāpakārī jagajjīvanīśā jagatprāṇanātho jagaddhlādakārī | jharo jharjharīśā jhanatkāraśabdo | jhanañjhañjanānādajhaṅkārarāvā || 42-101 || ñacaitanyakārī ñakaivalyanārī | hanollāsadhārī ṭanatṭaṅkahastā | ṭhareśo paviṣṭaśṭhakārādikoṭī | ḍaro ḍākinīśo ḍareśo ḍamārā || 42-102 || ḍhameśo hi ḍhakkā varasthānabījo | ṇavarṇā tamālatanuḥ sthānaniṣṭhā | thakārārṇamānasthanistho'saṃkhyā | dayāvān dayārdrā dhaneśo dhanāḍhyā || 42-103 || navīno nagebhāgatīrṇāṅgahāro | nageśī paraḥ pāraṇī sādipālā | phalātmā phalā phālgunī pheṇanāśaḥ | phalābhūṣaṇāḍhyā vaśī vāsaramyā || 42-104 || bhagātmā bhavastrī mahābījamāno | mahābījamālā mukundaḥ susūkṣmā | yatisthā yaśasthā ratānandakartā | ratirlākinīśo layārtha pracaṇḍā || 42-105 || pravālāṅgadhārī pravālāṅgamālā | halohālahelāpadaḥ pādatālā | vaśīndraḥ prakāśo varasthānavāsā | śivaḥ śrīdharāṅgaḥ śalākā śilā ca || 42-106 || ṣaḍādhāravāsī ṣaḍādhāravidyā | ṣaḍāmbhojasaṃsthaḥ ṣaḍabjopaviṣṭā | sadā sādharogropaviṣṭā'parāgī | susūktāpayasthā palāśrayasthitā || 42-107 || harasthograkarmā harānandadhārā laghustho | lipisthā kśayīkśubdhaka saṃkhyā | ananto nirvāṇāharākārabījā | urastho'pyurusthā urā ūrdhvarūpā || 42-108 || ṛcastho hi ṝgālaso dīrghaḷsthā | tvameko hi caiṃbījagurvī guṇasthā | sadauṅkāravarṇā hsauṃkārabījā | asaṅkāracandro hyusaḥ kāravīrā || 42-109 || harīndro harīśā hariḥ kṛṣṇarūpā | śivo vedabhāṣā ca śauriḥ prasaṅgā | gaṇādhyakśarūpī parānandabhakśā | pareśo gaṇeśī raso vāsapūjyā || 42-110 || cakori kulaprāṇabuddhisthitisthā | svayaṃ kāmadhenusvarūpī virūpā | śrīhiraṇyaprabhaḥ śrī hiraṇyaprabhāṅgī | prabhātārkavarṇo'ruṇākāraṇāṅgī || 42-111 || vibhā koṭidhārā dharādhāra koṣā | raṇīśo pratyādikūṭo'dharo .. dhāraṇā śaurirāryā | mahāyajñasaṃstho mahāyajñaniṣṭhā | sadākarmasaṅgaḥ sadāmaṅgaraṅgā || 42-112 || kirātīpati rākiṇī kālaputrī | śilākoṭa nirmāṇadohā viśālā | kalārkakalastho kalākiṅkiṇīsthā | kiśoraḥ kiśorī kurukṣetrakanyā || 42-113 || mahālāṅgaliśrī baloddhāmakṛṣṇaḥ | kulālādividyā'bhayo bhāvaśūnyā | mahālākinī kākinī śākinīśo | mahāsuprakāśā paro hākinīśā || 42-114 || kurukṣetravāsī kurupremamūtī | rmahābhūtibhogī mahāyoginī ca | kulāṅgārakāro kulāṅgīśakanyā | tṛtīyastṛtīyā'dvitīyo'dvitīyā || 42-115 || mahākandavāsī mahānandakāśī | puragrāmavāsī mahāpīṭhadeśā | jagannātha vakśaḥ sthalastho vareṇyā(--) | cyutānandakartā rasānandakartrī || 42-116 || jagaddīpakalo jagaddīpakālī | mahākāmarūpī mahākāmapīṭhā | mahākāmapīṭhasthiro bhūtaśuddhi (--) | rmahābhūtaśuddhiḥ mahābhūtasiddhiḥ || 42-117 || prabhāntaḥ pravīṇā gurustho giristhā | galaddhāradhārī mahābhaktaveṣā | kśaṇakśunnivṛttinīvṛttāntarātmā | sadantargatasthā layasthānagāmī || 42-118 || layānandakāmyā visargāptavargo | viśālākśamārgā kulārṇaḥ kulārṇā | manasthā manaḥśrīḥ bhayānandadātā sadā | lāṇagītā gajajñānadātā mahāmerupāyā || 42-119 || tarormūlavāsī tarajñopadarśā sureśaḥ | sameśaḥ sureśā sukhī khaḍganiṣṭhā | bhayatrāṇakartā bhayajñānahantrī | janānāṃ makhastho makhānandabhaṅgā || 42-120 || mahāsatpathastho mahāsatpathajñā | mahābindumāno mahābindumānā | khagendropaviṣṭo visargāntarasthā | visargapraviṣṭo mahābindunādā || 42-121 || sudhānandabhakto vidhānandamuktiḥ | śivānandasustho vinānandadhātrī | mahāvāhanāhlādakārī suvāhā | surānandakārā girānandakārī || 42-122 || hayānandakāntiḥ mataṅgasthadevo | mataṅgādhidevī mahāmattarūpaḥ | tadeko mahācakrapāṇiḥ pracaṇḍā(--) | khilāpasthalastho'vihamnīśapatnī || 42-123 || śikhānandakartā śikhāsāravāsī | suśākambharī kroṣṭarī vedavedīsugandhā | yugo yogakanyā davo dīrghakanyā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇyā | munijñānagamyā sudhanyaḥ sudhanyā || 42-124 || śaśī vedajanyā yamī yāmavāmā | hyakāmo hyakāmā sadā grāmakāmā | dhṛtīśaḥ dhṛtīśā sadā hāṭakasthā'(--) | yaneśo'yaneśī bhakāro bhagīrā || 42-125 || calatkhañjanasthaḥ khalatkhelanasthā | vivātī kirātī khilāṅgo'khilāṅgī | bṛhatkhecarastho bṛhatkhecarī ca | mahānāgarājo mahānāgamālā || 42-126 || hakārārddhasaṃjñā vṛtohāramālā | mahākālanemiprahā pārvatī ca | tamisrā tamisrāvṛto duḥkhahatyā | vipanno vipannā guṇānandakanyā || 42-127 || sadā duḥkhahantā mahāduḥkhahantrī | prabhātārka varṇaḥ prabhātāruṇaśrīḥ | mahāparvatapremabhāvopapanno | mahādevapatnīśabhāvopapannā || 42-128 || mahāmokśanīlapriyā bhaktidātā | nayānanda bhaktipradā devamātā || 42-129 || ityetatkathitaṃ nātha mahāstotraṃ manorama | sahasranāmayogā'ṅgamaṣṭottarasamanvitamam || 42-130 || yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya śucirvāśucimānasaḥ | bhaktyā śāntimavāpnoti anāyāsena yogirāṭ || 42-131 || pratyahaṃ dhyānamākṛtya trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet śuciḥ | ṣaṇmāsāt paramo yogī satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvara || 42-132 || akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam | apamṛtyvādiharaṇaṃ vāramekaṃ paṭhedyadi || 42-133 || paṭhittvā ye na gacchanti vipatkāle mahāniśi | anāyāsena te yānti mahāghore bhayārṇave || 42-134 || akāle yaḥ paṭhennityaṃṃ sukālastatkṣaṇādbhavet | rājasvaharaṇe caiva suvṛttiharaṇādike || 42-135 || māsaikapaṭhanādeva rājasvaṃ sa labhed dhuravam | vicaranti mahāvīrāḥ svarge martye rasātale || 42-136 || gaṇeśatulyavalino mahākrodhaśarīriṇaḥ | etatstotraprasādena jīvanmukto mahītale || 42-137 || mahānāmastotrasāraṃ dharmādharmanirūpaṇam | akasmāt siddhidaṃ kāmyaṃ kāmyaṃ paramasiddhidam || 42-138 || mahākulakuṇḍalinyāḥ bhavānyāḥ sādhane śubhe | abhedyabhedane caiva mahāpātakanāśane || 42-139 || mahāghoratare kāle paṭhitvā siddhimāpnuyāt | ṣaṭcakrastambhanaṃ nātha pratyahaṃ yaḥ karoti hi || 42-140 || manogatistasya haste sa śivo na tu mānuṣaḥ | yogābhyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti na stavaḥ paṭhyate yadi || 42-141 || yogabhraṣṭo bhavet kṣipraṃ kulācāravilaṅghanāt | kulīnāya pradātavyaṃ na khalvakuleśvaram || 42-142 || kulācāraṃ samākṛtya brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ | yoginaḥ prabhavantyeva stotrapāṭhāt sadāmarāḥ || 42-143 || ānandabhairava uvāca vada kānte rahasyaṃ me mayā sarvañca vismṛtam | mahāviṣaṃ kālakūṭaṃ pīttvā devādirakṣaṇāt || 42-144 || kaṇṭhasthāḥ devatāḥ sarrvā bhasmībhūtāḥ susambhṛtāḥ | mahāviṣajvālayā ca mama dehasthadevatāḥ || 42-145 || kaivalyaniratāḥ sarve prārthayanti nirantaram | ṣaṭcakraṃ kathayitvā tu santoṣṃ me kuru prabho | ṣaṭcakrabhedakathanamamṛtaśravaṇādikam || 42-146 || kathitvā mama santoṣaṃ kuru kalyāṇi vallabhe | amṛtānandajaladhau sudhābhiḥ siktavigraham || 42-147 || kṛttvā kathaya śīghraṃ me cāyuṣaṃ parivardhaya | ānandabhairavī uvāca nigūḍhārtha mahākāla kāleśa jagadīśvara || 42-148 || bhairavānandanilaya kālakūṭaniṣevaṇa | idānīṃ śṛṇu yogārtha mayi saṃyoga eva ca || 42-149 || śrutvā caitatkriyākāryaṃ naro yogīśvaro bhavet | mamodbhavaḥ khe'male ca sarvākāravivajīte || 42-150 || bhūramadhye sarvadehe ca sthāpayitvā ca māṃ naraḥ | bhāvyate cāparicchannaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam || 42-151 || mama rūpaṃ mahākāla sattvarajastamaḥ priyam | kevalaṃ rajoyogena śarīraṃ nāpi tiṣṭhati || 42-152 || tathā kevalayogena tamasā nāpi tiṣṭhati | tathā kevalasattvena kuto dehī pratiṣṭhati | atastriguṇayogena dhārayāmi navāṅgakam || 42-153 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ vijetavyāḥ sattvarajastamoguṇāḥ | ādau jitvā rajodharmaṃ paścāttāmasameva ca || 42-154 || sarvaśeṣe sattvaguṇaṃ naro yogīśvaro bhavet | guṇavān jñānavān vāgmī suśrīrdharmī jitendriyaḥ || 42-155 || śuddhanirmalasatvaṃ tu guṇamāśritya mokṣabhāk | sadā sattvaguṇācchannaṃ puruṣaṃ kāla eva ca || 42-156 || paśyatīha na kadācijjarāmṛtyuvivajītam | taṃ janaṃ paramaṃ śāntaṃ nirmalaṃ dvaitavajītam || 42-157 || sarvatyāginamātmānaṃ kālaḥ sarvatra rakṣati | jale vā parvate vāpi mahāraṇye raṇasthale || 42-158 || bhūgarttanilaye bhīte saṃhāre duṣṭavigrahe | santiṣṭhati mahāyogī satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara || 42-159 || mahāyogaṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabha śrīniketana | yogārthaṃ paramaṃ brahmayogārtha parantapaḥ || 42-160 || ye jānanti mahāyogaṃ mirayante na ca te narāḥ | kṛtvā kṛtvā ṣaḍdalasya sādhanaṃ kṛtsnasādhanam || 42-161 || tataḥ kuryānmūlapadme kuṇḍalīparicālanam | muhurmuhuścālanena naro yogīśvaro bhavet || 42-162 || ekāntanirmale deśe dubhīkṣādivivajīte | varṣamekāsane yogī yogamārgaparo bhavet || 42-163 || padmāsanaṃ sadā kuryād baddhapadmāsanaṃ tathā | mahāpadmāsanaṃ kṛtvā tathā cāsanamañjanam || 42-164 || tatpaścāt svastikākhyañca baddhasvastikameva ca | yogābhyāse sadā kuryāt mantrasiddhyādikarmaṇi || 42-165 || cakrāsanaṃ sadā yogī yogasādhanakarmaṇi | baddhacakrāsanaṃ nāma mahācakrāsanaṃ tathā || 42-166 || kṛtvā punaḥ prakartavyaṃ baddhayogeśvarāsanam | yogeśvarāsanaṃ kṛtvā mahāyogeśvarāsanam || 42-167 || vīrāsanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt mahāvīrāsanaṃ tathā | baddhavīrāsanaṃ kṛtvā naro yogeśvaro bhavet || 42-168 || tataḥ kuryānmahākāla baddhakukkuṭāsanam | mahākukkuṭamākṛtya kevalaṃ kukkuṭāsanam || 42-169 || mayūrāsanamevaṃ hi mahāmayūrameva ca | baddhamayūramākṛtya naro yogeśvaro bhavet || 42-170 || etat sarvaṃ pravaktavyaṃ vicārya sumanaḥpriya | abhiṣekaprakaraṇe āsanādiprakāśakam || 42-171 || kathitavyaṃ viśeṣeṇa idānīṃ śṛṇu ṣaṭkramam | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 42-172 || tataḥ paraśivo devaḥ ṣaṭśivāḥ ṣaṭprakāśakāḥ | eteṣāṃ ṣaḍguṇānandāḥ śaktayaḥ paradevatāḥ || 42-173 || ṣaṭcakrabhedanaratā mahāvidyādhidevatāḥ | eteṣāṃ stavanaṃ kuryāt paradevasamanvitam || 42-174 || etatprakārakaraṇe yaśca pratyahamādarāt | kriyāniviṣṭaḥ sarvatra bhāvanāgraharūpadhṛk || 42-175 || sa paśyati jagannāthaṃ kamalopagataṃ harim | ādau harerdarśanañca kārayedyena kuṇḍalī || 42-176 || tato rudrasya sañjñāyāṃ lākinyāḥ śubhadarśanam | sarvaśaḥ kramaśo nātha darśanaṃ prāpyate naraḥ || 42-177 || śanaiḥ śanairmahākāla kailāsadarśanaṃ bhavet | krameṇa sarvasiddhiḥ syāt aṣṭāṅgayogasādhanāt || 42-178 || aṣṭāṅgasādhane kāle yadyat karmaṃ karoti hi | tatsarvaṃ pariyatnena śṛṇu sādarapūrvakam | tatkriyādikamākṛtya śīdhraṃ yogī bhaviṣyati || 42-179 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde dvicattvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 42 ||
[atha tricattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha kāmāturāṇāñca kāmanirmūlahetunā | kathayāmi mahākāla yat kṛtvā kāminīvaśam || 43-1 || tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yogasādhanahetunā | hastāsanaṃ samākṛtya ūdrdhve padmāsanaṃ caret || 43-2 || śiromūle karadvandvaṃ niyojya japamācaret | alpālpadhāraṇaṃ kuryāt śvāsasaṃkhyāṃ samācaret || 43-3 || śvāsasaṃkhyāṃ tadā kuryād yadā kumbhakasusthiraḥ | vinā śvāsasaṃkhyāṃ ca kuto yogivaro vaśī || 43-4 || vinā saṃkhyāprayogeṇa binā kuyogavāraṇāt | kadācinna prakartavyaṃ saṃkhyākumbhakavajītaḥ || 43-5 || alpālpakumbhakaṃ kuryāt khecarapirayakarmaṇi | sarvakāle prakartavyaṃ sarvakāle sukhī bhavet || 43-6 || ānandakalpamākṛtya vijayādyāsavādibhiḥ | krameṇa bhedanaṃ kuryāt tataḥ sādhakayogirāṭ || 43-7 || yogināmaparicchinnaṃ bhāvaṃ vidyutprabhākaram | vidyutkoṭisamābhāsaṃ vāridhārāsamākulam || 43-8 || yadyevaṃ sutabhāvajñā vipākena patanti te | te yānti paramaṃ sthānaṃ te yānti koṭirājyapāḥ || 43-9 || te bhogino yoginaśca te lokapālakāḥ smṛtāḥ | te mahadguṇasambhogyā mirayante na kadā kutaḥ || 43-10 || te bhavanti mahāśreṣṭhāste bhavanti sudhākarāḥ | te bhedakaraṇe yuktāste manuṣyā na devatāḥ || 43-11 || te sarve yānti sarvatra te śivāste ca kiṅkarāḥ | te me bhaktā mahākāla iti me svāgamodayam || 43-12 || ye bhajanti tava padā'mbhojaṃ bhāvaparāyaṇāḥ | te jñānino bhavantyeva teṣāṃ kālo vaśo bhavet || 43-13 || ye prāṇavāyusaṃyogā ye prāṇaparirakṣakāḥ | ātmahatyāṃ parīhāya brahmalokaṃ mudānvitāḥ || 43-14 || yānti nātha dhyānaparāḥ saṃsārārthavivajītāḥ | araṇyavāsino ye ca nāraṇyavāsino narāḥ || 43-15 || ekāntanirjane deśe sarvavighnavivajīte | ṣaṭcakrabhedamākṛtya te narāḥ phalabhāginaḥ || 43-16 || mahākālaphalaṃ yastu sadecchati satāṃ gatim | sa eva yogī bhūmadhye sthitvā sarvatrago bhavet || 43-17 || sarvadeśe sadā pūjyaḥ sarveśo nirmalo'dvayaḥ | anādyanantavibhavaḥ kālātmā sa bhavet kṣaṇāt || 43-18 || eteṣāṃ sādhanaṃ śīghraṃ siddhividyāsukalpanam | etadrūpaṃ nijaṃ dhyātvā bhedaṃ kṛtvā nijasthalam || 43-19 || mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ bhedajñānī vibhedya ca | kuryāt paramasandarbhaṃ maṇipūre vicakṣaṇaḥ || 43-20 || kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ vidvān śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam | svādhiṣṭhānādidevendraṃ śaktiyuktaṃ nirañjanam || 43-21 || rākiṇīrādhikā vyāptaṃ trilokarakṣaṇaṃ param | paramākāśanilayaṃ traiguṇyaṃ vārirūpiṇam || 43-22 || vāñchākalpatarormūlavāsinaṃ śivavaiṣṇavam | vilokyānandahṛdayo'śaṅkaḥ sarvatra darśakaḥ || 43-23 || kṛtvā yogī sadābhyāsī maṇipūraṃ vilokayet | maṇipūraṃ mahācinhaṃ siddhikṣetraṃ sudhāmayam || 43-24 || hiraṇyakoṭidānena gokoṭidānahetunā | koṭibrāhmaṇabhojyena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 43-25 || tatphalaṃ labhate dhyātvā maṇipūraṃ manoramam | maṇipūraṃ mahāsthānaṃ yogināmapyadarśanam || 43-26 || sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ paramaṃ jñānināṃ jñānagocaram | aprakāśyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ yogayogena labhyate || 43-27 || ānandabhairava uvāca yogārthaṃ yatra kamale koṭividyutsamaprabhe | koṭikālāgnimilite koṭicandravinimīte || 43-28 || koṭisūryādikiraṇe manaḥ kena vilīyate | sūcīrandhre yathā sūtraṃ tadeva phaladaṃ sukham || 43-29 || yanna dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ kvāpi jñānaṃ na tatra sundari | tatra kena prakāreṇa manoniveśanaṃ bhavet || 43-30 || yatra na gamanaṃ nṝṇāṃ tasya devasya yatphalam | tatphalaṃ kiṃ na jānāti adṛṣṭe gamanaṃ kutaḥ || 43-31 || kuto rājñāṃ nasampattiḥ kuto vā svārthadarśanam | kuto vā jāyate siddhirbhedane kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet || 43-32 || tattvaṃ jānāsi deveśi tatprakāraṃ prakāśaya | ānandabhairavī uvāca yaduktaṃ taddhi sakalaṃ saphalaṃ parameśvara || 43-33 || tatra pūrvaṃ yogadharmasvāśrayaṃ śṛṇu tatkramam | pūrvasmaraṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhaviṣyasi || 43-34 || jīva eva mahābhāga lokānāṃ mokṣabandhagaḥ | sa jīvo vāyurūpeṇa mahābalaparākramaḥ || 43-35 || gacchati pratyahaṃ nityaṃ sarvadā ca punaḥ punaḥ | punarāyāti dharaṇīṃ svabhāvena nirantaram || 43-36 || nānābhāvapirayaḥ so'pi nānākāranirūpakaḥ | nānādharmapirayaḥ śuddho'śuddhaveśadharo mahān || 43-37 || kandarpanilayo yogī sa yogī paramārthavit | sa jñānī nirahaṅkārī so'haṅkārī śarīradhṛk || 43-38 || sarvagandhapirayo'dṛśyo bhāvayettāṃ rahasyavit | sa eva niṣkalaḥ śuddhaḥ sadā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 43-39 || yadā cātmani brahmāṇḍe brahmaṇi tvayi śaṅkare | tanmayo vilayaṃ yāti tadā bhāvo mahān smṛtaḥ || 43-40 || tadbhāvaḥ paramaṃ jñānaṃ na kathyaṃ viparītakam | ādhāraṃ susukhaṃ nityaṃ svalpakālavivajītam || 43-41 || atyantadharma sandhānaṃ prāpya yogī bhavennaraḥ | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ pragantavyaṃ tatra tatra sudarśanam || 43-42 || tatra tatra mahāsiddho bhūttvā saṃsāraputravān | yogināṃ bahukālasthaṃ mṛtānāmalpakālakam || 43-43 || śvāsadhāraṇamākṛtya bahukālaṃ sukhī bhavet | yathā bṛhaspatiḥ śrīmān yathā sūryo divākaraḥ || 43-44 || tathā prakāśamākuryāt koṭibhiḥ stotranāmabhiḥ | stutvā bhūtvā mahādravyaistarpayitvā yathākramam || 43-45 || abhiṣiktaḥ punardhyātvā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi | mānasopacāradravyaiḥ svadhāyuktairathāpi vā || 43-46 || paramānandito bhūttvā bhāvayet pīṭhadevatāḥ | bhāvayitvā tato japtvā dharmādharmau vicintayet || 43-47 || devatāyāṃ mano yojya sthāpayitvā svapīṭhake | punarutphullakamalaṃ mudritaṃ parikārayet || 43-48 || ṣaḍdalaṃ rmūcchitaṃ kṛtvā dalāgre saṃviśet sudhīḥ | sadānandaḥ sarvamayo vedavedāntanāmabhiḥ || 43-49 || stavakoṭibhirekatra dhyātvā saṃhāramudrayā | adhomukhe daśadalakamalāgre niyojayet || 43-50 || ṣaḍdalāgraṃ mahākāla niyojya gamanaṃ caret | tato gacchet prajvalite padme daśadale pure || 43-51 || praviśya kaṇīkāmadhye tanmayastatkṣaṇād bhavet | tatkṣaṇāttanmayo bhūtvā kuṇḍalīcakrasaṃsthitaḥ || 43-52 || asādhyasādhanaṃ sarvaṃ maṇipūrasthanirmalam | maṇipūre mahāpīṭhe dhyānagamye sati prabho || 43-53 || manoniveśanaṃ kṛtvā naro mucyeta saṅkaṭāt | manoyogī manobhogī manobhakto manoyuvā || 43-54 || mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ trāṇamokṣayoḥ | kāraṇaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ tadbhāvaṃ santyajed budhaḥ || 43-55 || sarvabhāvaṃ vihāyāpi mahābhāvaṃ samāśrayet | bhāvena labhyate mokṣo bhāvena labhyate sukham || 43-56 || etadbhāvaṃ sadā kuryād bhāvād bhavati yogirāṭ | bhāvena bhaktimāpnoti viṣayād bhāvamāśrayet || 43-57 || viṣayaṃ vikṛtigrāhyaṃ sukṛtijñānavajītam | tyaktvā divyaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ maṇipūraṃ samāśrayet || 43-8 || mahāyantre mano datvā nirmāṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | maṇibhirgrathanaṃ kṛtvā nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam || 43-50 || supīṭhaṃ kulapīṭhe vā liṅgapīṭhamathāpi vā | śrīvidyāpīṭhamālikhya vibhāvya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 43-60 || tataḥ prasphuṭite padme dalāgre ṣaḍdalasya ca | sthāpayitvā mahāviṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā susaṃyataḥ || 43-61 || japtvā ca tanmayo bhūtvā nidhāya maṇipūrake | dṛḍhākāramūrdhvagataṃ ṣaḍdalaṃ parirakṣayet || 43-62 || tataścodrdhvatare sthāne mahoccottarasundare | manoniveśanaṃ kṛtvā śaktiṃ rudraṃ samāśrayet || 43-63 || caitanyarūpiṇīṃ śaktiṃ caitanyaṃ rudrarūpiṇam | tatra bhadrātmakaṃ raudraṃ raudrīṃ prakāśakāriṇīm || 43-64 || bhaktyā punaḥ punardhyāyedūrdhvaretāstamīśvaram | pragacchanti codrdhvamārge dhyeyā yogibhireva ca || 43-65 || ahaṃ devī parānandā maṇipūranivāsinī | tathā śrīlākinīśaktiḥ śrīrudrastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 43-66 || rudrarūpī mahādevo rudrarūpā sarasvatī | sarvadā ūdrdhvagāmī ca sā śaktirūdrdhvagāminī || 43-67 || ūdrdhvamārgaṃ kāśayantīṃ yoginīṃ yogamātaram | mahārudraṃ tathā dhyātvā maṇipūre sunirmale || 43-68 || ūdrdhvamukhaṃ samākuryād mahāpadmaṃ manoramam | maṇipūraṃ mahākāntaṃ maṇikoṭisunirmalam || 43-69 || koṭikoṭiśaraccandra pūrṇajyotiḥsamākaram | ūdrdhvamukhaṃ samākuryāt svayaṃbhāvena jāyate || 43-70 || yadi codrdhvamukhaṃ padmaṃ yantramaṇḍalasaṃyutam | atikomalapatreṣu bhāti cātyadbhutaṅkaram || 43-71 || lepayitvā yojayitvā sthāpayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | prāpayitvā mahārudraṃ trailokyajananīṃ śivām || 43-72 || rudrāṇīṃ raudraśaktiñca lākinīṃ lokasākṣiṇīm | kumbhakaṃ prāṇavāyośca prāṇavāyośca yojanam || 43-73 || ekatra milanaṃ kṛtvā bhāvanaṃ parikārayet | bhāvena labhyate mokṣo bhāva eva nijapirayaḥ || 43-74 || mano niveśya tatrastho rudrārādhanamācaret | tathā śrīlākinīdevyāḥ paramādbhutasādhanam || 43-75 || śṛṇuṣva paramānanda bhairava pirayavallabha | mamopadeśaṃ santyajya ko'pi siddho na sambhavet || 43-76 || mamājñābalayogena siddho bhavati mānavaḥ | muktimūlaṃ mahābhāvaṃ muktimūlaṃ hi sādhanam || 43-77 || muktikrameṇa kālena siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ | mama yogakrameṇaiva mama tantrāvalokanāt || 43-78 || ko'pi nātha brahmayogī bhavatyeva na cākhile | sarve ca yoginaḥ śīghraṃ prabhavanti na saṃśayaḥ || 43-79 || sphuṭākāradalaṃ kṛtvā vinyāsaṃ tatra kārayet | mahāyogikulanyāsaṃ vidyānyāsaṃ samācaret || 43-80 || sarvanyāsaṃ nijanyāsaṃ jñānajālaṃ samācaret | mānasakriyayā vyāptaṃ dehaṃ madhurasamplutam || 43-81 || śivarūpiṇamātmānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānacakṣuṣam | ekākāraṃ mūlamantradhyānaṃ tatra samācaret || 43-82 || dhyātvā cārghyaṃ samākuryāt kulacakrakrameṇa tu | ātmānamaparicchinnaṃ vicintya punareva ca || 43-83 || sandhyāyennijacaitanyadevatāṃ kuladevatām | pādyārdhyādikrameṇaiva pūjayitvā'pyahanīśam || 43-84 || parivārāṃstato dhyātvā tatsarvān paripūjayet | dhūpadīpau tato dadyād nijapūjāvidhānataḥ || 43-85 || prāṇāyāmaṃ dīpanādau kuryāt sādhaka eva ca | bhaktyā dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā maṇipūrasthadaivate || 43-86 || japaṃ samarpya vidhinā prāṇāyāmaṃ punastrayam | praṇamya stotrakavacaiḥ svadevīṃ hṛdi cārpayet || 43-87 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhimantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde maṇipūracakrabhedaprakāro nāma tricatvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 43 ||
[atha catuścattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca maṇipūravibhedārthaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ | yaṃ jñātvā mūḍhalokāśca praviśanti mahāghaṭe || 44-1 || amūḍhatvaṃ prāpnuvanti bhavanti yogino'marāḥ | khecaratvaṃ prāpnuvanti sāṃkhyayoganiṣeviṇaḥ || 44-2 || mahāpātakamukhyānāṃ nāśaṃ śīghraṃ mahāripum | kiyatkāle'nale doṣe jale parvatakānane || 44-3 || kurvanti ca didṛkṣūṇāṃ devatāvaśameva ca | maṇipūraṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ dhyāyed yaḥ prāṇasaṃyamam || 44-4 || tathā pañcā''savāsiddhiṃ kṛtvā pūraṃ vibhedayet | triloka jananīṃ satyāṃ śivāmādyāṃ triyoginīm || 44-5 || mūlādhārāt samutpatya gacchantī rasaṣaḍdale | prakāśaṃ ṣaḍdalaṃ kṛttvā pragacchantī prabhānvitā || 44-6 || maṇipūre mahācakre trailokyajapasādhane | siddhīnāṃ nilaye kāmye kamanīye manaḥpiraye || 44-7 || manaḥ pirayā mahādevī sarvollāsanakāriṇī | khecarī mahadānandamaṇḍitā mantrayoginī || 44-8 || anugrahakarī siddhā vibhāvyā tata eva hi | ānandaghana sandohamātmajñānaṃ sunirmalam || 44-9 || maṇipūraṃ saṃvibhāvya kinna siddhyati bhūtale | aṇimā laghimā vyāptirmahāśreṣṭhādisiddhibhāk || 44-10 || kaulo vā vāra mukhyo vā jñānī vā sādhakottamaḥ | yogābhyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti maṇipūraṃ samāśrayet || 44-11 || maṇipūrasthitaṃ devaṃ yaḥ stauti niyataḥ śuciḥ | stavarājasya pāṭhena prabuddhā kuṇḍalī bhavet || 44-12 || sā devī paramā māyā maṇipūre sthitā śivā | prabuddhāṃ kāsyatyeva tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 44-13 || siddhe manau parāprāptiriti me tantranirṇayaḥ | yadi caitanyamicchanti kuṇḍalinyāḥ parākramam || 44-14 || jānāti nijadehe ca mahodayamanuttamam | teṣāṃ caitanyahetośca devatānāṃ kuleśvara || 44-15 || mahāstotraṃ samākuryāt pratyahaṃ siddhihetunā | siddhikāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ maṇipūre samāpnuyāt || 44-16 || maṇipūranivāsinyāḥ bhedanaṃ jñānasādhanam | sahasranāmamamalaṃ siddhidravyanirūpaṇam || 44-17 || nityasiddhiṃ kāmyasiddhiṃ maṇipūre samāśrayet | prāṇabuddhyā sveṣṭadevīṃ pūjayellākinīṃ parām || 44-18 || svadevatāṃ pūjayed vai maṇipūre mahālaye | maṇipūrasthitāṃ raudrīṃ mahāśaktiṃ mahodayām || 44-19 || sarvasañcāriṇīṃ yogyāṃ mahāyogipirayāṃ parām | nijadevīpadāmbhoja pūjāvat pūjanaṃ caret || 44-20 || pūjāṃ samāpya vidhinā stotraṃ devyāḥ samācaret | tatprāṇavāyurūpeṇa siddhīnāṃ nāśahetave || 44-21 || kṛtaṃ stotraṃ koṭināma brahmaṇā guṇakātmanā | tatsarvaṃ prakaroṣyetat prakāraṃ jñānaśaṅkara || 44-22 || etatstotraprasādena yoginaste mahaujasaḥ | ahaṅkāraghaṭī jñānaṃ mahāvyādhinivāraṇam || 44-23 || mahāstavanamevaṃ hi sākṣādānandavardhanam | naya bhaktipradaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhānāmapyagocaram || 44-24 || śivāṃ śakyāmādyāṃ daśadalagatāṃ rudramahiṣī| viśālākṣīṃ sūkṣmāṃ śaśiyutajaṭājūṭamukuṭām | mahāvidyutkoṭipirayajaḍitapīṭhe trinayanā| mahālākinyākhyāṃ daśadala kalāṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 44-25 || mṛṇālāntardhvāntaḥ prakaṭataṭasaṃhārasubhagā| kulakṣetrollāsāṃ caramapadadāṃ dīpakalikām | sadānandākārāṃ gatiguṇaharāṃ cārukiraṇā| prabhāvarṇaśyāmāṃ ruciravadanāṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 44-26 || pratīkṣānandābdhi prakaṭacaraṇāmbhojayugalā| viyadvarṇāṃ kāntāṃ suravarasupūjāvidhiratām | mahāsūkṣmadvārapracalanakarīṃ bhedanakarī| divāyogāhlādapirayajanaśivāṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 44-27 || ayodhyāpīṭhasthāmaruṇakamanīṃ premagalitā| mahāraudrīṃ bhīmāṃ śataśataravipremanikarām | mahāduḥkhārtānāṃ nayanaśubhagāṃ bhāvavirahā| satīṃ sītāmindrotsavanavaghaṭāṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 44-28 || sudhābdherāhlādaprakaraṇasurāṃ saurabhakarā| kriyārūpāṃ yogyāṃ bhuvamaṇipūraprakṛtigām | guroḥ sthānodyogāṃ samanadahanāṃ śītalavarā| tritattvāṃ tattvajñāṃ sa(śa)maraharaśaktiṃ bhajati kaḥ || 44-29 || vikārākārāṅgīṃ taruṇaravikoṭiśriyamimā| kulādhārāṃ sārāṃ paramarasadhārāṃ jayavarām | kṛpācchannākāmāṃ paramarasabhāṇḍeṣu śubhadā| bhajedindrāṃ rudrāṃ śaśimukhakarāhlādanikarām || 44-30 || rasābdhau viśrāntiṃ kupitajanaśāntiṃ sakaruṇā| trilokajñānasthāṃ madananilayāṃ yoganikarām | maṇidvīpacchāyāṃ daśadalakalāṃ kevalabhavā| bhavānīṃ rudrāṇīṃ varadamaṇipūre bhajati kaḥ || 44-31 || kṛpābdhau kiṃ kiṃ kimanugatasutāṃ maulinamitā| śivāṅkāṃ mūlasthāṃ sakalamaṇipūrasthirabhavām | hiraṇyākṣīṃ takṣāṃ kṣayakaraṇaraśmicchaviśatā| vinodīṃ pañcāsyapirayaguṇadharāṃ bhāvayati kaḥ || 44-32 || mahāpadmākhyāṃ sakaladhanadānākulacalā| calānandodreka(--)pracayarasasindhūdbhavahṛdi | hṛdānando dhyāyet sakalaguṇadātrīṃ sukhamayī| kalāṃ sūkṣmātyantāṃ timiradahanāṃ koṭidhanadām || 44-33 || daśakaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ śrīvidyāṃ sukhadāyinīm | dhyātvā hṛdayapadmādho nirmalātmā sadā paṭhet || 44-34 || maṇipūrasthitaṃ devaṃ rudraṃ paśyati yogirāṭ | rudrāṇīsahitaṃ śambhuṃ dṛṣṭvā mukto bhavet kṣaṇāt || 44-35 || jīvanmuktaḥ sa evātmā yoginīvallabho bhavet | yogātmā paramātmā ca sa hi sākṣādanīśvaraḥ || 44-36 || sa bhitvā maṇi pūrābdhiṃ nirmalaṃ jyotirujjvalam | śambhorīśvarayogajñakriyānāthasya śrīpateḥ || 44-37 || nikaṭe yāti devyāśca sthāne yogī na saṃśayaḥ || 44-38 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe maṇipūrabhedane bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde tritattvalākinīśaktistavanaṃ nāma catuścattvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 44 ||
[atha pañcacattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha kālakramaṃ vakṣye yatkāle yogirāḍ bhavet | tatkālaṃ prāṇavāyūnāṃ nilayaṃ sūkṣmasañcayam || 45-1 || punaḥ punaḥ sañcayane dṛḍho bhavati saṃvaśī | kriyāyāṃ sañcarantyeva yoginyo yogamātaraḥ || 45-2 || yatkāle yatprakarttavyaṃ bhānurūpyakulārṇava | kāle kāle vaśo yāti paramātmā nirāmayaḥ || 45-3 || vinā prayogasāreṇa vinā jāpyena śaṅkara | kaḥ siddho jāyate jñānī yogī bhavati kutra vā || 45-4 || abhyāsamantrayogena śanairyogī bhavennaraḥ | prabhāte jñānaśaucañca kuṇḍalībhāvanādikam || 45-5 || tanmadhye cāpi saṃskuryād yogaṃ pañcāmarādikam | tato mantrasnānakāryaṃ mastake jalasecanam || 45-6 || sandhyāvandana kāryañca tataḥ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak | tata utthāya sadbhūmau śuddhakomalajāsane || 45-7 || upaviśya sadābhyāsī śuddhakāyāsanañcaret | tatkāryasamaye nātha dhyānaṃ caitanyameva ca || 45-8 || kuṇḍalinyāḥ sadā kuryāt tanmadhye japameva ca | āsanaṃ sundaraṃ kuryāt savyāpasavyabhedataḥ || 45-9 || āsanādikamākṛtya śeṣe susthāsanaṃ caret | susthāsanaṃ samākṛtya cordhvapadmāsanaṃ caret || 45-10 || mastakādhaḥ keśamadhye hastau dattvā manuṃ japet | caturaśītitriguṇamāsanaṃ bhañjanaṃ tathā || 45-11 || pratyāsanaṃ krameṇaiva eteṣāṃ dviguṇaṃ punaḥ | eteṣāmāsanādīnāṃ vaktavyā saṅkhyakā punaḥ || 45-12 || aṣṭāṅgasādhane nātha vaktavyaṃ sarvamāsanam | prāṇāyāmaṃ ṣoḍaśakamathavā dvādaśādikam || 45-13 || svakarṇāgocaraṃ kṛtvā pibedvāyuṃ sadā budhaḥ | tataḥ samāpya tatkāryaṃ mantrayogaṃ samabhyaset || 45-14 || samāpya mantrayogaṃ ca prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret | tata utthāya nadyādiṃ vilokya cāntarātmani || 45-15 || snānaṃ kṛttvā mahāyogī mānasādikrameṇa tu | tatraiva mānasaṃ jāpaṃ samāpya japameva ca || 45-16 || ekaprāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt kṛttvā tīre viśet sudhīḥ | pidhāya pītavasanaṃ dharmādharmaṃ vicintayet || 45-17 || tataḥ sandhyāvandanaṃ ca kṛttvā pūjāvidhiṃ caret | sarvatra kumbhakaṃ kṛttvā bhāvayittvā punaḥ punaḥ || 45-18 || maṇipūre mahāpīṭhe dhyātvā devīṃ kuleśvarīm | pūjayittvā vidhānena prāṇāyāmaṃ punaścaret || 45-19 || tataḥ kuryāt sādhakendro vidhinā kavacastavam | sarvatra prāṇasaṃyogād yogī bhavati niścitam || 45-20 || athavā kālajālānāṃ vāraṇāya mahaṣībhiḥ | etat kāryaṃ samākuryād yoganirṇayasiddhaye || 45-21 || vinā yogaprasādena (na) kālaḥ saṃvaśo bhavet | kālena yogamāpnoti yogadhyānaṃ svakālakam || 45-22 || yogādhīnaṃ paraṃ brahma yogādhīnaṃ parantapaḥ | yogādhīnā sarvasiddhistasmād yogaṃ samāśrayet || 45-23 || yogena jñānamāpnoti jñānānmokṣamavāpnuyāt | tatkramaṃ śṛṇu bhūcakre sarvasiddhyādisādhanam || 45-24 || siddhisādhanamantreṇa yogī bhavati bhūpatiḥ | śīghraṃ rājā bhaved yogī śīghraṃ yogī bhaved yatiḥ || 45-25 || śīghraṃ yogī bhavedvipro yadi svadharmamāśrayet | svadharmaniṣṭhatājñānaṃ sajjñānaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 45-26 || tajjñānena labhed yogaṃ yogādhīnāśca siddhayaḥ | siddhyadhīnaṃ paraṃ brahma tasmād yogaṃ samāśrayet || 45-27 || svadharmaniṣṭhatājñānaṃ sa tajjñānaṃ samāśrayet | yogayogādbhavenmokṣo mama tantrārthanirṇayaḥ || 45-28 || yogī brahmā murāriśca tathā yogī maheśvaraḥ | tathā yogī mahākālaḥ kaulo yogī na saṃśayaḥ || 45-29 || maṇipūrabhedane tu yatnaṃ kuryāt sadā budhaḥ | yadi cenmaṇipūrasthadevatābhedako bhavet || 45-30 || sarvakṣaṇaṃ sukhī bhūtvā ciraṃ tiṣṭhati niścitam | mahāprabhaṃ sundarañca mahāmohanighātanam || 45-31 || meghābhaṃ vidyutābhaṃ ca pūrṇatejomayaṃ param | maṇibhirgrathitaṃ padmaṃ maṇīnāṃ pūrameva ca || 45-32 || sūryakāntaiścandrakāntairvahnikāntairmahojjvalaiḥ | ityādimaṇibhiḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ kāntiguṇodayam || 45-33 || niviḍe jalade meghe koṭividyutprabhā yathā | tatprakāraṃ bhāvanīyaṃ siddhānāṃ jñānagocaram || 45-34 || atyantasūkṣmamārgasthaṃ nityasthānaṃ hi yoginām | maṇibhiḥ śobhitaṃ padmaṃ maṇipūraṃ tathocyate || 45-35 || daśakomalapatraiśca samāyuktaṃ manoharam | ḍādiphāntavarṇayuktaṃ sthiravidyutsamākulam || 45-36 || śivenādhiṣṭhitaṃ padmaṃ viśvālokanakārakam | ādau varṇarūpakāṇāṃ dhyānaṃ kuryāt svadhāmayaḥ || 45-37 || mahāpadme mano datvā nirmalaṃ paribhāvayet | ḍādiphāntākṣarāṇāṃ ca dhyānājjñānasthiro bhavet || 45-38 || manodhairyamupāgamya divyabhaktiṃ samālabhet | varṇadhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva parameśvara || 45-39 || yadvibhāvyāmaro bhūtvā ciraṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ | mahādhairyakriyāṃ kuryād vāyupānaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 45-40 || yatra yatra mano yāti tanmayastatkṣaṇād bhavet | pūrvādidalamārabhya dhyānaṃ kuryāt pṛthag pṛthak || 45-41 || ḍāṃ ḍāṃ ḍāṃ ḍākinīntā ḍamaruvararatāṃ tāriṇīṃ tārarūpā| ḍiṃ ḍiṃ ḍiṃ ḍāmarasthāṃ ḍamaruḍamagṛhe ḍaṅkaḍiṃkiṃ manusthām | ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍāmareśīṃ ḍimiḍimiḍimigadhvānanirmāṇaḍorā| ḍoṃ ḍoṃ ḍoṃ ḍākaḍaṃ ḍaḥ praḍuma ḍamuḍāṃ dāḍimāmāśrayāmi || 45-42 || ḍhāṃ ḍhāṃ ḍhāṃ gāḍhaḍhakkāṃ varanikarakarāṃ bāḍhamābāḍhamantrā| ḍhiṃ ḍhiṃ ḍhiṃ nāgarūpāṃ bhaja bhaja vimalānandacittaprakāśaḥ | śrīṃ ḍheṃ ḍhaṃ vajraḍhūṃ khā khavaṭa maṭamaraṃ svāhayā ṭoṃṭabījā| ḍhoṃ ḍhoṃ ḍhoṃ ḍhakkaḍhakkaḥ pirayaḍhunakaruṇākāminīṃ lākinīṃ tām || 45-43 || bāṇasthityasaṃsthāṃ rucinakaravaṇākāraṇā vāṇavāṇi| vīṇāṃ veṇūtsavāḍhyāṃ maṇiguṇakaruṇāṃ naṃ khaṭījapravīṇam | veṇusthānāṃ sumānāṃ maṇimayapavamāmantramālāvilolā| sindūrāraktavarṇāṃ taruṇaghananavīnāmalāṃ bhāvayāmi || 45-44 || tārāṃ tārakamañjālavimalāṃ tālādisiddhipradā| tāḍaṅkāmatitejasā munimanoyogaṃ vahantīṃ parām | tāṃ tārāṃ tulasīṃ tulāṃ tanutaṭāṃ tarkodbhavāṃ tāntrikā| śrīsūryāyutatejasīṃ bhaja manaḥ śrīmātaraṃ tāpasīm || 45-45 || vyagrasthāṃ sthānasusthāṃ sthitipathapathikāṃ thārṇakūṭāṃ thamālī| gāthāṃ yogāṃ vipathāṃ thamiti thamiti thaṃ vahnijāyāṃ sthirāsām | candrajyotsnāsthalasthāṃ sthirapadamathanāmujjvalāmāsanasthā| sthairyāṃ sthairyābhirāmāṃ praṇava nava sudhāṃ candravarṇāṃ bhajāmi || 45-46 || drāṃ drīṃ drūṃ dīrghadaṃṣṭraṃ daśanabhayakarāṃ sāṭṭahāsāṃ kuleśī| doṣacchatrāpahantrīṃ divitaraṇadaśādāyinīmādarasthām | śliṣṭāhlādapradīptāmakhiladhanapadāṃ dīpanīṃ bhāvayāmi || 45-47 || dharmāṃ śrīṃ dhyānaśikṣāṃ dharaṇidharadharāṃ dhūmadhūmāvatīṃ tā| dhūstūrākāravakrāṃ kuvalayadharaṇīṃ dhārayantīṃ karābjam | vidyunmadhyārkakoṭijvalanadharasudhāṃ kokilākṣīṃ susūkṣmā| dhyātvā hlādaikasiddhiṃ dharaṇidhananidhiṃ siddhividyāṃ bhajāmi || 45-48 || nityāṃ nityaparāyaṇāṃ trinayanāṃ bandhūkapuṣpojjvalā| koṭyarkāyutasaṃsthirāṃ navanavāṃ hastadvayāmbhoruhām | nānālakṣaṇadhāraṇāmalavidhuśrīkoṭiraśmisthitā| sānandāṃ naganandinīṃ triguṇagāṃ naṃ naṃ prabhāṃ bhāvaye || 45-49 || prītiṃ premamayīṃ parātparatarāṃ preṣṭhaprabhāpūritā| pūrṇāṃ pūrṇaguṇopari pralapanāṃ māṃsapirayāṃ pañcamām | vyāpāropanipātakāpalapanā pānāya pīyūṣapā| cittaṃ prāpaya pītakāntavasanāṃ paurāṇikīṃ pārvatīm || 45-50 || spheṃ spheṃ sameṃ phaṇivāhanāṃ phaṇaphaṇāṃ phullāravindānanā| pherūṇāṃ varaghoranādavikaṭāsphālapraphullenmukhīm phaṃ phaṃ phaṃ phaṇikaṅkaṇāṃ phaṇiti phaṃ mantraikasiddheḥ phalā| bhaktyā dhyānamahaṃ karomi niyataṃ vāñchāphalaprāptaye || 45-51 || vidyutāṅkāramadhye tu bijalīraktavarṇakān | evaṃ dhyātvākhilān varṇānraktavidyud dalodyatām || 45-52 || sadā dhyāyet kuṇḍalinīṃ kaṇīkāmadhyagāminīm | varahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ candrāvayavalakṣaṇām || 45-53 || cārucandanadigdhāṅgīṃ phaṇihāravibhūṣaṇām | dvibhujāṃ koṭikiraṇāṃ bhālasindūraśobhitām || 45-54 || trinetrāṃ kālarūpasthāṃ lākinīṃ layakāriṇīm | siddhimārgasādhanāya dhyāyed varṇān daśa kramāt || 45-55 || caturbhujāṃ ṣaḍbhujāṃ ca aṣṭahastāṃ parāparām | durgāṃ daśabhujāṃ devīṃ nijavāhanasusthitām || 45-56 || sarvāstradhāriṇīṃ sarvāṃ hastadvādaśaśobhitām | caturdaśabhujāṃ raudrīṃ tathā ṣoḍaśapālinīm || 45-57 || aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ śyāmāṃ hastaviṃśatidhāriṇīm | evaṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā rudrāṇīstotramāpaṭhet || 45-58 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhimantraprakaraṇe | ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde varṇadhyānakathana | nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 45 ||
[atha ṣaṭcattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu bhairava vakṣyāmi rudrāṇīstotramuttamam | śruttvā paṭhittvā deveśa dhārayittvā svadehake || 46-1 || mahāsiddho bhavedeva mahākālavaśo bhavet | trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā || 46-2 || rudrayuktāṃ mahāraudrīṃ stuttvā sarvajayo bhavet | tacchruttvā munayaḥ sarve yogino yogadarśakāḥ || 46-3 || sarve devāḥ sarvalokādhipāḥ syuḥ prāṇarakṣakāḥ | etat stavanamātreṇa brahmā brahmatvamāpnuyāt || 46-4 || viṣṇuvīṣṇutvamāpnoti devatvaṃ sarvadevatāḥ | idānīṃ śṛṇu tatstotramaṣṭāṅgayoga sādhanam || 46-5 || etatstavanapāṭhena cāṣṭāṅgakuladevatāḥ | vaśībhūtāḥ prabhavanti saptasvargasthadevatāḥ || 46-6 || asya mahārudraśaktistotrasya mahākālabhairavaṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīmachrīrūpiṇī devatā vāṃ bījaṃ drāṃ śaktiḥ samauṃ spheṃ kīlakaṃ mahogrādi devatā sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || mahāraudrī rudrāruṇāravaravakrodhanikarā | vikārā dharmāṇāṃ haratu viṣayaṃ dehi paramam | vivekaṃ satputraṃ tvamapi jagatāmādipuruṣaṃ | vibhākoṭigrāmaskhalananicalā locanacalā || 46-7 || tvamekā trailokyaṃ vyavasi satataṃ me śubhabhavā | anantā sā cātīndriyagaṇakalā nāgavasanā | śriyaṃ dātuṃ nityaṃ samudayati raśmistava śive | śivāhlādānandā jaḍitamanamandā kuru mudā || 46-8 || mahālobhaṃ pāpaṃ hara hara hare hīrakanibhe | viṣānandodghātā mama tanu viṣaṃ veśavaśini | sudhānandaṃ dehi kṣayamapi harakrodhamatulaṃ | madaṃ kāmaṃ mohaṃ kulajanani divyaṃ vitara tat || 46-9 || tapasyāsadbhāvaṃ tvamapi ca dadāsīha yadi vā | pradīptā sadvyāptā bhavati tava dāne mama manaḥ | praphullātiśrīde jaya mama na bhaktiṃ nijaśubhāṃ | samīḍe tvāmekāṃ bhuvanajanarakṣāṃ kuru sadā || 46-10 || vicārya sve tantre racayasi sukhaṃ nityamilitaṃ | mahākhaḍgaprakhyā tribhuvanakarā rudradayitā | surāṇāṃ saṃrakṣāṃ yadi kuru mudā pīṭhanikare | maṇidvīpe tejomayi hi maṇipūre'malapadam || 46-11 || mahākṣetre yuddhotsavabhayaharā tvaṃ kulakalā | kirātī sarvāṇī mama kulagataṃ pālaya laye | layajñānānandaṃ racaya hṛdaye yogajanani | yatīnāṃ rakṣāyai kulayuvati vidye udayati || 46-12 || pratiṣṭhā kītīste tvamavatarasi trāsi timirā(--) | nna jāne tvat tattvaṃ taruṇi mahimānaṃ sukhamayam | mahāpārāvārāṃ nidhibhavajaleśaṃ kuru jayam | hiraṇyāhlādasthā tvamapi karuṇāsāgaramayī || 46-13 || vidhātāraṃ viṣṇuṃ suravaraṇavandīn parajanān | prapāsi tvaṃ siddhā sukhabhuvanabhaṅgakṣayakarā | kirantī sānandā kiraṇaśatakoṭiṃ tribhuvane | tvamekā kalyāṇi giriśaramaṇiṃ pāhi satatam || 46-14 || tvadīyaṃ sukhāntaṃ samīcchāmi satyaṃ | visargenduvarṇātmakaṃ kāmanākhyam | kṛpādṛṣṭipātā manaḥ pāhi śuddhā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-15 || jagattāriṇī tvaṃ jagavyāpinī tvaṃ | jagajjvālarūpā jagaddharmarūpā | anaikāntikattvāttvamānandarūpā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-16 || vidhānaṃ janānāṃ kuru tvaṃ tvamīśā | kṣapākṣā macittā pirayānandadātrī | tvamājñāmbujasthā tvamāryā gurūṇāṃ | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-17 || prabhāmaṇḍalasthā sthitityāgasaṃsthā | sthalāmbhojamālā tvamālagnakaṇṭhā | śivaśyāmavarṇā mahāpiṅgalārṇā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-18 || caturthaśrutisthācalaścandrasaṃsthā | mahāvedabhāṣā tvamekā jagatyām | mahābhaktibhāvāśritaṃ māṃ prasiddhe | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-19 || jagaddhāmaceṣṭe jagadbuddhiniṣṭhe | jagadyauvanasthā jagadbhāvasaṃsthā | samāvarttamadhye mahāghūṇītaṃ māṃ | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-20 || mahā sṛṣṭisaṃhārakālakramasthā | mahāmāṃsabhakṣā sadānandarūpā | mahāśākya maunīndrapūjye surejye | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-21 || catuḥṣaṣṭitantrārṇa vāhlādakatvā(--) | nmahābhautikatvānmahāsiddhividyā | chalacchinnadehā chalānannasaṃjñā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-22 || śivatvaṃ mahattvaṃ samatvāmalatvā(--) | danaikāntikatvaṃ dadāsi tvamādyā | sudhāsāgarasthā mahāmohanasthā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-23 || mahāsiṃhapṛṣṭhe padāmbhojalakṣmī(--) rmama śrīśiromaṇḍalasthaṃ prapātu | bhavānandasantānakalpe'vadehaṃ | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-24 || sthirā sā mahāvidyudākārahārā | mahācañcalā cācalā jñānajanyā | sadā bhāvanatvātsadā jñāpanasthā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-25 || kulānandamohā mahākaulakanyā | kulakṣetrarakṣā kulacchatrakārā | mahācañcalatvānmahāvāyughūrṇā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-26 || ciraṃjīvinī bhāminī bhūmibījā | bhayābhāvahantrī śaratkoṭicandrā | vibhūtirbhayāhārakartrī prakṛṣṭā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-27 || mahāvīrabhāvāśrayā bhāvarūpā | viśeṣāviśeṣe mahāśaivavīrā | visargāpavargāśrayārṇojjvalattvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-28 || mahāpañcamatvānmahāmodakatvān mahākaulikātvādasañcāraṇatvāt | kulapremabhāvakriyāniścalatvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-29 || vasoḥ siddhidātrī śivānandakartrī | mahāmaithunānandasambhedanatvāt | sukhāśvāsatattvāttapaḥ prāṇarakṣā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-30 || galatpremabhāvā kulajñānatattvāt | pirayā śrīkṛpātvaṃ bhavādhāramūttīḥ | mahaiśvaryahetormahārājakanyā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-31 || mahāmokṣavidyā mahānirmalatvāt | prabhāpañcacūḍasya siddhipirayā ca | mahānādabinduprayāsābhirāmā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-32 || mahāvidrumākāravarṇābhirāmā | kulāhlādasūtrādisaṃsādhanatvāt | mahadrājyavidyādhanā saṅghaṭatvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-33 || tavāṅghradvayāmbhoja pūjāsukhatvā(--) nmahākālarūpā svayaṃ sarvavidyā | vikārādi sambandhaviśeṣaṇatvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-34 || śivatvaṃ śubhatvaṃ mahāśailakanye | pirayatvaṃ paratvaṃ mahāpāvanatvam | samādhehi tattvādanaikāntikatvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-35 || mahācetanādevanādona natvāda(--) | saṃkhyāmatīnāṃ manoyogamukhyā | virodhāpahantrī ripuprāṇahantrī | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-36 || catuvīṃśatikrodhatattvānukūle | viyatkhaṇḍacandrojjvale kīlakasthe | sadā māṃ prapātu pracaṇḍārkavarṇā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-37 || śubhaṃ kāmadhenusvarūpaṃ svadehaṃ | sadā darśane śraddhayā cāruvarṇā | himāṃśuprabhākoṭivarṇe'tvapūrṇe | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-38 || mahākāmabījānvitā khaṇḍayantī | mahādoṣajālaṃ śanairāvahantī | śivābhadrakālī sthirānandamālā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-39 || mahākālakūṭāśinaṃ tīkṣṇanetraṃ | sadā pāhi śambhuṃ bhayārdrātivelam | bhavāpālanatvādasaṃkhyānivāsā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-40 || harantī viṣāḍhyaṃ vahantī kalādyaṃ | raṭantī naṭantī viśālā bhramantī | śriyaḥ pālanī pālikā bālikātvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-41 || bhavānandahetoḥ sadā śraddhayā vā | padāmbhojamadhye manoyogakāle | parāsaṃkhyate kāmasaṃkṣālanatvāt | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-42 || kṣitikṣobhanāśāya siddhādividyā | kulāḍhyākhilāḍhyānanā sūkṣmamadhyā | prayatnaṃ karoṣi kṣayānandadānā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-43 || mahādhairyamāhṛtyajaṃ japyate yais (--) | tavādyābhidhānāni kāliprabhāte | tadaivāpi kāle dadāsīha siddhiṃ | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-44 || ciraṃ sthāpayantī ciraṃ bhāsayantī | tvamākhyā gurūṇāṃ kulānandavidye | svadhākāratuṣṭā kalāvahnijāyā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-45 || surānandakāle phalodbhūtacinhā | citāmadhyadeśe mahāsiddhidātri | tribhinnā vibhinnā mahārudravidye | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-46 || mahāpūvī kātyāyani krodhamūle | vivekādikaṃ dharmamādau dadāsi | trayāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ mudārakṣaṇāya | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-47 || viśuddhasphuṭattvānmahākautukatvā(--) | ttanudhyānamohādanante kṛtattvāt | kulārakṣaṇātmā mahālakṣaṇātmā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-48 || dahantī ripūṇāṃ kulañcātmadeśaṃ | kṣaṇādeva sūkṣmāsusūkṣmā satī sā | mamānandadeśaṃ sadā pālaya śrī | ttvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-49 || caturthāśramasthāśramaṃ pāhi rudre | mahograpratāpe mahāraudri bhadre | mahāpātakādikṣayatvāmṛtattvā(--) ttvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-50 || mahāvāyuramye mahājñānagamye | mahāmantrajāpyādisiddhiprasiddhe | layaṃ dehi bāhyānilāghātanatvā(--) ttvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-51 || na jānāmi kiṃ vāmaro vāpi viṣṇu(--) | rmahākauliko vā na jānāti pūjām | kulādyāsanante surendrādipāṭhe | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-52 || madīyaṃ pralobhyaṃ mahābhadrakāli | prakāśena karttuṃ samarthā bhava tvam | padābje ca hantuṃ mahāpāpasarge | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-53 || vahantī kapālaṃ skhalantīmapārthaṃ | mahāhemamālā mahākāśayantī | śivo maṅgalaṃ me tu vaiśvānarīśe | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-54 || pracaṇḍā prasannā bhavakṣobhaheto(--) | vīvādādighātāya śāntiḥ pratuṣṭiḥ | kiyatkālasaṃsthā prasannāntarātmā | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-55 || mahāvāyupānā kriyāmokṣakāle | kulajñānadānā divārūpiṇī tvam | prabhutvaṃ vidhehi kṣame kāmakartrī | tvamekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 46-56 || yadi śrīvarādye mamākhyā sasiddhiṃ | videhīti citte samādhāya bhaktaḥ | samāpnoti śīghraṃ sadā prārthyate yaiḥ | sadā paṭhyate vā mudā vāramekam || 46-57 || mahākālaśambho mahājñānasiddhaḥ | sadā kālavaśye paṭhedekacittaḥ | mahābhaktibhāvaṃ labhed veda muktiṃ | mahādevabhaktiṃ trikālena yogam || 46-58 || maṇeḥ pīṭhamadhye mahārudrakāntāṃ | mahālākinīṃ kuṇḍalīṃ bhāvayantī | mahāpuṇyalābhaṃ stavaṃ brahmasāraṃ | mahākāntalābhāya puṇyāya siddhyai || 46-59 || mahākāli rudrāṇi bhadrāṇi kṛṣṇe | bhavānandamūttīprakāśāya kuryāt | kilānandamākṛtya sampūjyate yai(--) rmahādevi caṇḍe tava dhyānaniṣṭhā || 46-60 || mahāmokṣabhāvaṃ samāpnoti śīghraṃ mahāśuddhatā kāmahā kālarūpī || 46-61 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhimantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe maṇipūrabhedanakrame bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde rudraśaktilākinīstotraṃ nāma | ṣaṭcattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 46 ||
[atha saptacattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu kailāsanāthābja cakramaṇḍalasaṃsthitim | ṣaṭcakrabhedamāhātmyaṃ sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 47-1 || aprakāśyamidaṃ mantraṃ maṇipūravibhedanam | aṣṭaiśvaryasādhanāya jīvanmuktipradāya ca || 47-2 || kathayāmi mahākāla yajjñātvā yogino'marāḥ | kriyāsādhanamātreṇa kena yogena eva hi || 47-3 || sādhanādeva sarvajñaḥ sarvārthajñānavān bhavet | rudrāṇīsahitaṃ rudraṃ dhyātvā sampūjya sañjapet || 47-4 || atha vakṣye mahāmantraṃ pūjāprakaraṇaṃ tathā | maṇipūre sthito mantrī rudrāṇīyajanaṃ caret || 47-5 || samprati mantrasyoddhāraṃ karomi kālakūṭapa | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya namaḥ śabdaṃ tato vadet || 47-6 || te śabdānte samuddhṛtya rudraśabdaṃ tataḥ param | rūpiṇyai padamuccārya rudrāṇī mantramīritam || 47-7 || tato mahārudramantraṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ śṛṇu | praṇavānte namasśabdaṃ te mahāśabdamuccaret || 47-8 || rudrāya padamuddhṛtya mahārudramanuḥ smṛtaḥ | tato'nyatkālarūpeśa rudrāṇīmantramāśṛṇu || 47-9 || ḍādiphāntaiḥ sarvavarṇairādyante puṭitaṃ manoḥ | sarvaśeṣe vahnijāyā mahāmantrottamottamaḥ || 47-10 || asya jāpanamātreṇa ṣaṭpadma sādhane jayī | evaṃ prakāraṃ rudrasya cāthavānyaprakārakam || 47-11 || rudrāṇāṃ vividhaṃ mantraṃ koṭitantre vinirṇayam | maṇipūre sadā dhyāyed yogasādhanahetunā || 47-12 || sarvatra mānasaṃ kāryaṃ dhyānapūjāvidhānakam | pramodākhyātimanubhirmṛtyuñjayādibhistathā || 47-13 || caitanyaṃ kārayet śīghraṃ maṇipūrasthadevayoḥ | atha vakṣye maheśasya rudrasya paramātmanaḥ || 47-14 || prāsādākhyaṃ mahāmantraṃ trailokyaphalasiddhidam | sāntamoṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitam || 47-15 || prāsādākhye manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ kāmadomaṇiḥ | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya svāhāntaṃ japate yadi || 47-16 || stambhanādīni karmāṇi sa karoti na saṃśayaḥ | athavā mṛtyujetāraṃ mahāmantraṃ mahāmanum || 47-17 || japenmānasajāpena yajjāpyaṃ prāṇarakṣakam | tāraṃ sthirā sakarṇendurbhṛguḥ sargasamanvitaḥ || 47-18 || tryakṣarātmā nigadito mantro mṛtyuñjayātmakaḥ | athavānyaprakāreṇa japenmṛtyuñjayātmakam || 47-19 || mṛtyuñjayaṃ samuddhatya pālaya dvitayaṃ tataḥ | mṛtyuñjayaṃ samuddhṛtya punareva vilomataḥ || 47-20 || dvādaśākṣaramantro'yaṃ mṛtyuñjayābhidho'paraḥ | dhyānaṃ (pūjāṃ) tathā nyāsaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi śaṅkara || 47-21 || rudramantreṇa puṭitaṃ yojayenmṛtyuhāraṇam | tathā hi rudrakāntāyā mantreṇa puṭitaṃ śivam || 47-22 || japitvā pūjayitvā ca naro goptā bhavedvaśī | prātaḥkṛtyādikaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ || 47-23 || atisāvadhānaparo vidhisevāparāyaṇaḥ | snānasandhyādikaṃ kṛtvā āsanādikamāśrayet || 47-24 || samāpya āsanaṃ sarvaṃ pītavastre pidhāya ca | athavā śuklavastre dve paridhāya manohare || 47-25 || komalādyāsane gatvā prakṣālyapādayugmakama | dvirācamya vidhānena pūjāyāṃ svastikāsane || 47-26 || vīrāsane tathā padmāsanayonyāsane tathā | upaviśya nirmalātmā pūjāmārgaparo bhavet || 47-27 || sarvāṇi dravyabhojyāni manasā kalpitāni ca | tadalābhe salābhe vā manaḥkalpitaśodhanam || 47-28 || karaṇīyaṃ sarvadaiva nijabāhye'pi cālayet | yathā labhyāni dravyāṇi saṃśodhya tatra yojayet || 47-29 || tataḥ kuryād viśeṣeṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ manoramam | catuḥṣaṣṭimātrayā vā tathā ṣoḍaśamātrayā || 47-30 || taddvādaśamātrayā vā saṃkhyayā vāyumāśrayet | prāṇāyāmaṃ samāpyātha rudranyāsaṃ samācaret || 47-31 || śrīkaṇṭhādimahāvīranyāsaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ | rudranyāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi manuyogādisiddhaye || 47-32 || etannyāsābhikaraṇe naro rudrasamo bhavet | sadā kuryānmahānyāsaṃ sarvasiddhiprakāśanāt || 47-33 || śaktihīnaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ mahānyāsaṃ prakītītam | śaktiyuktaṃ samākṛtya mahāśakto bhaved balī || 47-34 || śaktihīnaṃ tathā kāryaṃ sarvavighnavināśanāt | mātṛkāpadmacakre tu mātṛkāvargasaṃyutam || 47-35 || mātṛkāpuṭitaṃ mantraṃ kiṃ vā mantreṇa saṃpuṭam | kṛtvā mantrī nyāsajālaṃ sāvadhānena kārayet || 47-36 || vikramī siṃhatulyaḥ syāttaṃ dṛṣṭvā yānti śatravaḥ | maunī bhūtvā samākṛtya kulacakrasya bhedanam || 47-37 || maṇipūre sthiro bhūtvā mahātejomayo bhavet | teṣāṃ nāma pravakṣyāmi pañcāśadekasaṃkhyayā || 47-38 || pañcāśadekaśaktīnāṃ tathā nāma śṛṇu prabho | sarveṣāmabhidhānānte īśāya nama uccaret || 47-39 || ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇaṃ nāmna ādye niyojayet | śaktiyuktaṃ sadā nāma īśāntaṃ santyajet tathā || 47-40 || bhedane śaktiyuktastu nyāsaṃ kuryānmahāyatiḥ | kuśāsane siddhihetoścailājinakuśottaram || 47-41 || baddhaikamāsanaṃ yogī nyāsajālaṃ samācaret | athavā dvīpicarmādi komalādyāsane'pi vā || 47-42 || yogābhyāsī nyāsajālaṃ kṛtvā sāvabhayo bhavet | bhadrakālī gṛhe sthitvā ye kurvanti nirantaram || 47-43 || mahānyāsaṃ mahādeva tatkṣaṇādamaro bhavet | āyurārogyasampattiṃ samprāpnoti mahāśriyam || 47-44 || samāyāti mama sthāne nyāsayogaprasādataḥ | nyāsadhāraṇayogena maṇipūre hṛdo bhavet || 47-45 || ādau tannāma vaktavyaṃ paścātśaktyābhivnanakam | śrīkaṇṭhaścāpyanantaśca sūkṣmā trimūtīreva ca || 47-46 || amareśvaraścārghīśo bhāvabhūtistataḥ param | atithīśasthāṇvīśo haro jhiṇṭīśa eva ca || 47-47 || bhautikaḥ sadyojātaścāpyanugraheśvarastathā | akrūro'pi mahāseno nirjarādiśca ṣoḍaśa || 47-48 || ete devā mahārudra ṣoḍaśasvaravigrahāḥ | krodhīśaścāpi caṇḍeśaḥ pañcāntakaḥ śivottamaḥ || 47-49 || ekarudrastathā kūrma ekanetreśvarastataḥ | caturānano'jeśaśca sarvaḥ someśa eva ca || 47-50 || lāṅgalīśo dārukeśo'rddhanārīśvara eva ca | ( umākānteśa āṣāḍhiḥ ḍiṇḍīśo'trīśa eva ca mīneśaścāpi meṣeśo lohiteśaḥ śikhīśvaraḥ | chagalaṇḍe dviraṇḍeśo mahākāleśvarastataḥ |) vāṇīśaśca bhujaṅgeśaḥ pinākīśastataḥ param || 47-51 || khaḍgīśa ścarakeśaśca śyeno bhṛgvīśa eva ca nakulīśaḥ śiveśaśca saṃvarttakeśa eva ca || 47-52 || ete rudrāḥ samākhyātāḥ sarvakāle kuleśvarāḥ | yasya nāmnaścāntabhāte īśaśabdo na vidyate || 47-53 || keśāntaṃ nāma saṃskṛtya nyāsaṃ maulīśamācaret | kāmaṃ mohādināśārthaṃ yaḥ karoti nirantaram || 47-54 || mātṛkāvarṇaghaṭitaṃ mātṛkāsthalake nyaset | śaktiyuktaṃ yadā nyāsaṃ tatkāle'pīśayojanam | athavā rudraśaktyā ca tathā rudreṇa sampuṭam || 47-55 || nijamantreṇa vā nātha puṭitaṃ mātṛkāsthale | śaktyā ca grathanaṃ kṛtvā saṃsāraṃ santaret kṣaṇāt || 47-56 || tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇanātha śaṅkara vallabha | pūrṇodarī ca girijā śālmalī tadanantaram || 47-57 || lolākṣī varttulākṣī ca dīrghaghoṇā tataḥ param | sudīrghamukhigomukhyau dīrghajihvā tataḥ param || 47-58 || kuṇḍodarī codrdhvamukhī tathā vikṛtamukhyapi jvālāmukhī vahnimukhī lolajihvā tataḥ param || 47-59 || vidyāmukhī tathā nātha etāśca svaraśaktayaḥ | kādyārṇaśaktividyāśca vakṣyāmi pārvatīśvara || 47-60 || mahākālīsarasvatyormahālakṣmyāstataḥ param | drāviṇī nāgarī bhūyaḥ khecarī cāpi mañjarī || 47-61 || rūpiṇī bimbinī paścāt kākodarī ca pūtanā | bhadrakālī yoginī ca śaṅkhinī rgajjinī tathā || 47-62 || kālarātriḥ kuñjikā ca kapaddanī tataḥ param | vajrā jayā tato nātha sumukheśvaryapi prabho || 47-63 || revatī mādhavī caiva vāruṇī vāyavī tathā | vakṣovidāriṇī caiva sahajālakṣmyatha prabho || 47-64 || vyāpinī caiva māyā ca rudrāṅkapīṭhadevatāḥ | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā sindūrāruṇavigrahāḥ || 47-65 || dhṛtaśūlakapālādi bāṇaśaktiprakheṭakāḥ | varābhayakarā nityāḥ sarpavāhanavāhanāḥ || 47-66 || śrīkaṇṭhādyā mahārudrā dhṛtaśūlakapālakāḥ | khaḍgakheṭakaśaktīṣu gadāmūsaladhārakāḥ || 47-67 || nānāstradhārakā nityā bandhūkakoṭisundarāḥ | raktacandanadigdhāṅgāḥ pañcacūḍadharāḥ parāḥ || 47-68 || raktotpalamahāmālālaṅkārakarapaṅkajāḥ | pīṭhanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt mama tantrānusārataḥ || 47-69 || sarvatramūlapuṭitamathavā varṇasampuṭam | kṛtvā pīṭhanyāsakāryaṃ vidhānena vadāmi tat || 47-70 || oṃ anantāya namaśca namo hṛdi tataḥ param | oṃ padmāya namaḥ śabdaṃ hṛdaye ca tataḥ param || 47-71 || oṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya dvādaśānte kalātmane | oṃ namaḥ padaṃ samuccārya cānte ca hṛdaye prabho || 47-72 || oṃ uṃ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ | sarvatra hṛdaye kāryaṃ pīṭhanyāsaṃ manolayam || 47-73 || oṃ maṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ | oṃ saṃ sattvāya namaśca oṃ raṃ rajase namaḥ || 47-74 || oṃ taṃ tamase namaśca pūrvādikeśareṣu ca | oṃ taṃ ātmane namaśca oṃ sarvavyāpine namaḥ || 47-75 || oṃ aṃ antarātmane ca oṃ manonmanyai namaśca | tadupari tato vadet namo'nte śūnyavāsine || 47-76 || oṃ paṃ paramātmane ca namo'nte kālarūpiṇe | oṃ hrīṃ jñānātmane cānte namo'nte varṇavāsine || 47-77 || pīṭhaśaktestato nyāsaṃ kuryāt sādhakayogirāṭ | hṛtpadmasyāpi pūrvādi keśareṣu ca saṃnyaset || 47-78 || oṃ vāmāyai namaścānte oṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namo vadet | oṃ sarvabhūtadamanyai namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret || 47-79 || ( oṃ raudrāyai namaścānte oṃ kālyai ca namo vadet | oṃ kalavikariṇyai namaḥ śabdaṃ tato vadet | oṃ balapramathanyai namo va bho'nte ca punarvadet |) etā vinyasya deveśa madhye vinyāsamācaret | hṛtpadmasya kaṇīkāyāṃ kṛtvā bhāvanamācaret || 47-80 || oṃ manonmanyai namaśca tadupari tato vadet | oṃ namo bhagavate'nte ca sakalapadamuccaret | guṇāya śaktiyuktāya anantāya padaṃ tataḥ || 47-81 || ( yogapīṭhātmane cānte namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret | tataḥ kuryānmahādeva ṛṣyādinyāsameva ca | rudraśaktyā ṛṣevīṣṇustathā mṛtyuñjayasya ca |) kahoḍa muniputraśca ṛṣirasya prakītītaḥ | maheśvaramukhājjñātvā yaḥ sākṣāttapasā manum || 47-82 || saṃsādhayati śuddhātmā sa tasya ṛṣirīritaḥ | gurutvānmastake cāsya nyāsastu parikītītaḥ || 47-83 || sarveṣāṃ mantratattvānāṃ chādanād chanda ucyate | akṣarātvātpadatvācca mukhe cchandaḥ samīritam || 47-84 || sarveṣāmeva jantūnāṃ preṣaṇātpreraṇāttathā | hṛdayāmbhojamadhyasthā devatā tatra tāṃ nyaset || 47-85 || ṛṣicchando'parijñānānna mantraḥ phalabhāgbhavet | daurbalyaṃ yāti mantrāṇāṃ viniyogamajānatām || 47-86 || nyasenmūdhnī ṛṣinyāsaṃ chandonyāsaṃ mukhāmbuje | devatānyāsamākuryāt hṛdayāmbhoruhe sudhīḥ || 47-87 || mūke guhye bījanyāsaṃ śaktinyāsaṃ tu pādayoḥ | sarvāṅge kīlakanyāsamācaret yatnataḥ sudhīḥ || 47-88 || śivaśaktyātmakanyāsaṃ śirasyeva samācaret | śirasi prāṇarakṣāyai mahāviṣṇuṛṣaye namaḥ || 47-89 || mukhe paṅktacchandase vai namaḥśabdaṃ samuccaret | hṛdi mahārudrāya śaktiyuktāya saṃvadet || 47-90 || devatāyai namaḥ śabdaṃ karanyāsaṃ tataścaret | tato'ṅganyāsamākṛtya dhyānaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ || 47-91 || vahninā dīrghabījena mantrasyāṅgakriyāṃ caret | rudradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhyānād bhavati bhūpatiḥ || 47-92 || raudraṃ raudrātmakaṃ taṃ prakṛtipuruṣaṃ gaṃbhīragītābhidhānaṃ | śūlaṃ khaḍgaṃ dadhānaṃ varamabhayakaraṃ padmamekaṃ pracaṇḍam | sañcāraṃ raśmijālaṃ śaśiśatakiraṇaṃ kāmadhenusvarūpaṃ | dhyāyedraudrīṃ svaśaktiṃ pralayamayatanuṃ sūryakoṭiprakāśam || 47-93 || evaṃ dhyātvā sumanasaiśca sampūjyārghya vidhiñcaret | kṛtvārghyaṃ rudramantreṇa pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaret || 47-94 || vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī kalapadādikā | vikaraṇyākṣarā proktā balādivikaraṇyatha || 47-95 || balapramathanī paścāt sarvabhūtadamanyatha | manonmanīti samproktāḥ śivasya pīṭhaśaktayaḥ || 47-96 || pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pīṭhaśaktiḥ krameṇa tu | praṇavādi namo'ntena pūjā kāryā vidhānataḥ || 47-97 || punardhyātvā ca pādyārghyairāvāhya paripūjayet | pādyamarghyamācamanīyaṃ snānīyaṃ punarācamanam || 47-98 || gandhapuṣpabilvadalaiḥ pūrvāvaraṇamarcayet | vaṃ hṛdayāya nama ityādiṣaḍaṅgapūjanam || 47-99 || madhye catudīkṣu caivaṃ śeṣe vāradvayaṃ vadet | indrādīn lokapālāṃśca pūjayitvā tato'rcayet || 47-100 || vajrādīṃśca mahākāla dhūpadīpainīvedayet | naivedyaṃ bahu kṛtvā (ca) pānārthaṃ jaladānakam101 || śarīraśodhanaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ tataścaret | japet śatatrayaṃ mantrī viśuddhaḥ śuddhacetasā || 47-102 || aṣṭottaraṃ yojayitvā gajāntakasahasrakam | athavāṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā samarpaṇaṃ caret || 47-103 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryānnijamantra prasiddhaye | tataḥ praṇāmamākuryāt śakticaitanyahetunā || 47-104 || namo rudrāya devāya koṭisūrryendumūrttaye | sarvāya jñānadānāya namaste śūladhāriṇe || 47-105 || namaste kālarudrāya kālāya vedarūpiṇe | vedamārgapradarśāya śatrusaṃkṣayakāriṇe || 47-106 || raudrāya śaktiyuktāya śaṅkarāya namo namaḥ | caturbhujāya vedāya mahākāśasvarūpiṇe || 47-107 || varapadmaśūlakhaḍgadhāriṇe brahmaṇe namaḥ (....) rudraśaktyarcanaṃ kṛtvā mahārudreṇa saṃyutam || 47-108 || maṇipūre dṛḍho yāti satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara | śaktyarccanavidhiṃ vakṣye mūlamantreṇa pūjanam || 47-109 || sarvatra kārayenmantrī aṣṭaiśvaryajayāya ca | ādau ṛṣinyāsakāryaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ || 47-110 || śirasīha rudraśaktirmahāviṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ | ṛṣaye nama uccārya mukhe hastaṃ niyojayet || 47-111 || paṅktachandase namaśca hṛdi hastaṃ niyojayet | mahārudrāṇīti padaṃ lākinīpadameva ca || 47-112 || triśaktyante mahāvidyā devatāyai namastataḥ | guhye oṃ padamuccārya nijabījāya te namaḥ || 47-113 || sarvāṅge sakalāyaiva vajrāya kīlakāya ca | namaḥ padaṃ samuccārya ṛṣyādinyāsameva ca || 47-114 || rudravatsakalaṃ kāryaṃ karāṅganyāsakarmaṇi | ādāvṛṣyādikanyāsaḥ karaśuddhistataḥ param || 47-115 || aṅgulivyāpakanyāso hṛdādinyāsa eva ca | rudraśaktimahāṣoḍhānyāsañca tadanantaram || 47-116 || mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vyāpakanyāsamācaret | tālatrayañca digbandhaḥ prāṇāyāmastataḥ param || 47-117 || dhyānaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa rudraśaktyā mahāprabho || 47-118 || rudrāṇīṃ rudrakāntāṃ navarasajaḍitāṃ kuṅkumāśaktagātrāṃ | lokeśīṃ ṣaḍbhujāntāṃ tribhuvanayajitāṃ koṭisaudāminībhām | padmasthāṃ padmahastāṃ varabhayakarāṃ khaḍgaśaktiṃ dadhānāṃ | dhyāyed raudrīṃ trinetrāṃ śavadamanaśaśiśreṇibhūṣāmalāṅgīm || 47-119|| rudravat pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ rudraśaktyāśca śaṅkara | daśopacāraiḥ pūjā vā tathā pañcopacārakaiḥ || 47-120 || aṣṭādaśopacārairvā ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ | alābhe tu prakarttavyaṃ mānasena nivedayet || 47-121 || sarvatra mānasaṃ kāryaṃ koṭi koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | pūjāṃ samāpya vidhinā jalaṃ datvā japādike || 47-122 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā japtvāṣṭottarakaṃ śatam | sahasraṃ vā muhurjaptvā aṣṭottarasamanvitam || 47-123 || japaṃ samarpayedvidvān guhyātiguhyamantrakaiḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ paścāt kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 47-124 || vandanaṃ bhaktiyuktena kuryād yogādisiddhaye | mahāraudra namaste'stu lākinyai te namo namaḥ || 47-125 || śāntyai tuṣṭyai namo nityaṃ durgāyai te namo namaḥ | rudraśaktyai namo nityaṃ maṇipūranivāsinī || 47-126 || aṣṭasiddhiṃ yogasiddhiṃ dehi tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ | sarvagranthichedikāyai parabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 47-127 || māṃ rakṣa pālaya tvaṃ hi maṇipūre namo namaḥ | praṇamya vidhinānena pūjāsamāpanañcaret || 47-128 || punastatra pūjayed vai prāsādākhyaṃ mahāprabhum | tathā mṛtyuñjayaṃ devaṃ maṇipūre prapūjayet || 47-129 || prāṇāyāmādikaṃ kṛtvā śrīkaṇṭhanyāsamācaret | pūrṇodaryādisahitaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ nyasetsudhīḥ || 47-130 || pīṭhamanuṃ pravinyasya ṛṣyādinyāsamācaret | ṛṣirasya vāsudevaḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam || 47-131 || sadāśivo devatā ca aṅgulinyāsamācaret | hāmaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ paścāt hrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ tataḥ param | khāṃ namaḥ padamante ca ṣaḍdīrghabhājayānvitam || 47-132 || evaṃ karanyāsamākāryaṃ vidhānena samācaret | śūdrastu etatparyantaṃ kāryaṃ homādikaṃ ca yat || 47-133 || na kuryāt pārvatīnātha tathā strīloka ityapi | yadi jñānī bhaved deva sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥ || 47-134 || cāṇḍālādīni vā jātau sthito brāhmaṇottamaḥ | jñānavān vādasaṃvāde vajīto nyāsamācaret || 47-135 || nyāsastanmayatā buddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena pūjayet | sa eva jñānī paramo vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 47-136 || nyāsapūjādikaṃ tasya sarvadā nātra saṃśayaḥ | yāvaddehe hyahaṃbuddhistāvanmaraṇadhārakaḥ || 47-137 || tadvajīto mṛtyujetā nyāsapūjādikaṃ kṛtaḥ | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena hakāreṇa sabindunā || 47-138 || karayoraṃgulidvandvaṃ vinyaset saṃkrameṇa tu | īśānādyāḥ pañcamūrttīvīnyaset sādhakottamaḥ || 47-139 || tataḥ kuryānmahādeva ūdrdhvaḥ prāgdakṣiṇottare | mukheṣu vinyasenmantrī cāṅgulibhiḥ parasparam || 47-140 || tattadbījaiḥ prayatnena tattanmūrttīḥ pravinyaset | aṅguṣṭhayoḥ śeṣabhāge hau īśānāya oṃ namaḥ || 47-141 || ṣaḍdīrghabhājābījena hakāreṇa sabindunā | tatpuruṣamaghorañca vāmadevaṃ tataḥ param || 47-142 || sadyojātaṃ krameṇaiva aṅgulī dve tataḥ param | vinyasetsādhakaśreṣṭho namo'ntaṃ parameśvara || 47-143 || śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu vinyasetsudhīḥ | tattadaṅgulibhiścaiva tatkrameṇa pravinyaset || 47-144 || pañcamūrttīrnyasennātha tatprakāraṃ śṛṇuṣva tat | īśānādisvabījaṃ tu prakāreṇa pravinyaset || 47-145 || śūdraḥ kuryānnyāsajālametat paryantameva hi | tata ūrdhvaprāgdakṣiṇapaścimottarasaṃmukhe || 47-146 || īśānasya pañcakalā brahmaṛg vedasaṃyutāḥ | pañcapādādikā nātha praṇavādinamo'ntikāḥ || 47-147 || īśānaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ oṃ nalinyai tataḥ param | kalāyai nama evāpi sarvatraivaṃ krameṇa tu || 47-148 || īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tadaṅgaṃ padakaṃ tataḥ | dayāyai kalāyai namaścāpi brahmādipadaṃ tataḥ || 47-149 || oṃ brahmeṣṭadāyai cānte kalāyai nama ityapi | tataḥ śivo'stu me padaṃ oṃ sāvitryai padaṃ vadet || 47-150 || kalāyai nama evaṃ hi sadāśivo padantataḥ | omante cāṃśumālinyai kalāyai pada ityapi || 47-151 || diṅmukhe sa nyasenmantrī pūrvādikramayogataḥ | tatpuruṣasya catasraḥ kalā nyaset sadā vaśī || 47-152 || oṃ tatpuruṣāyapadaṃ vidmahe tadanantaram | oṃ śāntyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-153 || mahādevāya śabdānte dhīmahīti tataḥ padam | oṃ vidyāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-154 || tanno rudraḥ padaṃ paścāt oṃ pratiṣṭhāyai padaṃ likhet | śrī durgāyai kalāyai namaścātha pracodayāt || 47-155 || oṃ nivṛtyai kalāyai ca namaḥ padaṃ samuccaret | tato'ṣṭasthānamadhye tu aghorāṣṭakalā nyaset || 47-156 || hṛdgrīvāṃ madhyagatalaṃ tathā nābhiṣu pṛṣṭhake | tathā vakṣasi cāghorā aṣṭau kalā nyaset sudhīḥ || 47-157 || aghorebhya umānte vai umāyai padamuccaret | kalāyai nama evātha aghorebhyaḥ padaṃ vadet || 47-158 || oṃ mohāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi | aghorapadamuccārya kṣamāyai śabdamuccaret || 47-159 || kalāyai nama evātha ghoratarebhya eva ca | oṃ nidrāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-160 || sarvataḥ sarvaṃ oṃ ante vyādhaye śabdamuccaret | kalāyai nama evātha sarvebhyaḥ padamuccaret || 47-161 || oṃ mṛtyave padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi | namaste'stu padasyānte om kṣudhāyai padaṃ vadet || 47-162 || kalāyai nama evātha rudrarūpe'tha eva ca | om kṛṣṇāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-163 || vāmadevasya devasya trayodaśa kalā nyaset | eteṣu sthānapadmeṣu tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 47-164 || guhye'ṇḍa śeṣamadhye tu ūruyugme tataḥ padam | jānudvaye tathā jaṅghāyugale sphigdvaye tathā || 47-165 || kaṭyāṃ pārśvayuge caiva krameṇa bhāvako nyaset | ādau praṇavamuccārya tato mantraṃ smaretsudhīḥ || 47-166 || vāmadevāya śabdānte namo jyeṣṭhāyaśabdataḥ || 47-167 || namo rudrāya śabdānte namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret | kālāya nama evānte kalavikaraṇāya ca || 47-168 || namo balavikaraṇāya balapramathanāya ca | om vāmadevāya namaḥ om vajrāya tataḥ param || 47-169 || kalāyai nama evātha jyeṣṭhāya nama ityapi | om rakṣāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-170 || rudrāya nama om ratyai kalāyai nama ityapi | kālāya nama ityante pālinyai śabdamuccaret || 47-171 || kalāyai nama ityante pālinyai śabdamuccaret | kāmāyai śabdamuccārya kalāyai nama eva hi || 47-172 || vikaraṇāya namonte praṇavañcoñcaredbudhaḥ | saṃyaminyai padānte ca kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-173 || bala om śabdamuccārya krodhāyaipadamuccaret | kalāyai nama evātha vikalāyai namastataḥ || 47-174 || oṃ vṛddhyai padakasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi | bala oṃ śabdamuccārya sthirāyai śabdamuccaret || 47-175 || kalāyai nama evātha pramathanāya namastataḥ | oṃ raudrapadasyānte kalāyai nama ityatha || 47-176 || sarvabhūtadamanāya nama oṃ padamuccaret | bhrāminyai padakasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi || 47-177 || nama oṃ śabdamuccārya mohinyai padakaṃ smaret | kalāyai nama evātha unmanāya namastataḥ || 47-178 || oṃ jayāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama uccaret | tato nyāsaṃ mahākāla sadyojātasya tāḥ kalāḥ || 47-179 || sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi om vṛddhyai padamuccaret | kalāyai nama evātha sadyojātāya vai namaḥ || 47-180 || om vṛddhyai padakasyānte kalāyai nama ityapi | bhave pade tataḥ paścād om sadyaḥ padamuccaret || 47-181 || kalāyai nama evātha abhave om tataḥ param | om medhāyai padasyānte kalāyai nama ucyate || 47-182 || tato bhajasva māṃ śabdaṃ om prajñāyai padaṃ vadet | kalāyai nama evātha bhava om śabdamuccareta || 47-183 || prabhāyai padamuccārya kalāyai nama ityapi | tadbhavāya namaḥ paścāt om sudhāyai namastataḥ || 47-184 || kalāyai nama uccārya nsasedaṣṭau kalāḥ prabhoḥ | īśānākhyāstato nātha bhaktaḥ pañca ṛco nyaset || 47-185 || pañcāṅguliṣu yogeśa kramaśaḥ kāmanāśanāt | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya tato mantraṃ smaretsudhīḥ || 47-186 || īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ īśvarastadanantaram | uccaretsarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirityapi || 47-187 || brahmaṇodhipatiḥ paścāt śivo me'stu sadāśivaḥ praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya tatastatpuruṣāya ca || 47-188 || vidmahe padataḥ paścāt mahādevāya dhīmahi | tato rudraḥ padasyānte pracodayātpunarvadet || 47-189 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya tato mantraṃ smaret sudhīḥ | aghorebhyo'tha ghorebhyo ghoraśabdaṃ samuccaret || 47-190 || ghoratarebhya evānte sarvataḥ sarvaśabdakam | sarvebhyo'nte namaste'stu rudrarūpebhya eva ca || 47-191 || aṣṭau sthāneṣu caiteṣu sarvapāpanivṛttaye | pārśvayorhastayoścaiva nāsikāyāñca mastake || 47-192 || bāhuyugme mahāvīra maṇipūravibhedakaḥ | tatprakāraṃ pravakṣye'haṃ sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 47-193 || balapramathanāya namo'nte ca sarvabhūtapadaṃ vadet | damanāya namo'nte tu namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret || 47-194 || unmanāya namaḥ paścāt punaḥ praṇavamuddharet | sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ || 47-195 || bhave bhavenādibhave bhajasva māṃ tataḥ param bhavodbhavāya śabdānte namo mantraṃ mudā nyaset || 47-196 || aṅgulībhyāṃ samāhṛtya pañca ṛcānayā prabho evaṃ krameṇa sannayāsaṃ kuryādeṣu sthaleṣu ca || 47-197 || rmūdhnihṛdguhyapādeṣu nyasedetā ṛco mudā tataḥ kuryānmahākāla cāṅganyāsāntaraṃ śubham || 47-198 || tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya | vāgbhavaṃ pūrvamuccārya kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param || 47-199 || vakāraṃ śatrusaṃyuktaṃ dakṣakārṇendusaṃyutam | candrabījaṃ vāmanetrathāntavahnividhūnntam || 47-200 || kevalaṃ candrabījaṃ tu savisargamanuṃ tataḥ | sarvajñāya padasyānte hṛdayāya namaḥ padam || 47-201 || amṛte padamuccārya kāmabījaṃ tataḥ padam | tejojvālāpadaṃ māline'nte ca kḷptāya brahmaṇe'pi vasettataḥ || 47-202 || svāhāntaṃ tata evātha jvalitaśikhiśabdakam | śikhāyānādibodhāya śikhāyai vaṣaḍityatha || 47-203 || vajiraṇe vajrahastāya svatantrāya padaṃ vadet | kavacāya tāraśabdaṃ tato'nyad bījamuccaret || 47-204 || nākāraṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ vāmanetraṃ sabindukam | paśuśabdaṃ tāramantraṃ anantaśaktaye padam || 47-205 || astrāya phaḍiti procya evaṃ vinyasya yogirāṭ | maṇipūre mano yojya dhyāyeccaitanyamuttamam || 47-206 || om muktāpītapayodamauktikajavāvarṇairmukhaiḥpañcabhiḥ tryakṣairañcitamīśamindumukuṭaṃ pūrṇendukoṭiprabham | śūlaṃ ṭaṅkakṛpāṇavajradahanānnāgendraghaṇṭāṅkuśān | pāśaṃ bhītiharaṃ dadhānamamitākalpojjvalāṅgaṃ bhaje || 47-207 || evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ sampūjya pūjakaḥ | arghyasthāpanamākuryānnijamantrābhiśodhanam || 47-208 || śaivoktapīṭhamanvantāṃ pīṭhapūjāṃ tataścaret | punardhyātvā samāvāhya cāvāhanādimudrayā || 47-209 || pañcapuṣpāñjalidānaparyantaṃ paripūjayet | pañcapuṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā vadanārcanamācaret || 47-210 || śivāvaruṇadevāṃśca pūjayettat kramaṃ śṛṇu | eśānyāṃ pūjayedvidvān īśānāya namastataḥ || 47-211 || pūrve oṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret | dakṣiṇe oṃ aghorāya namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret || 47-212 || uttare oṃ vāmaśabdaṃ devāya nama uccaret | paścime praṇavaṃ paścāt sadyojātāya eva hi || 47-213 || namo'ntaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | īśānādicatuṣkeṣu nivṛttītyādīn prapūjayet || 47-214 || praṇavānte nivṛtyai ca namaścānte tato'rcayet | evaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidyāṃ ca śāntiṃ sampūjya yatnataḥ || 47-215 || praṇavādinamo'ntena caturthyantapadena ca | yojayitvā mahāpūjāvidhau kuryāt samarpaṇam || 47-216 || daśadalasya madhye tu vibhāvyāṣṭadalaṃ sudhīḥ | tatraiva pūjanaṃ kuryāt aṣṭāṅgayogasiddhaye || 47-217 || praṇavādinamo'ntena caturthyantapadena ca | pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 47-218 || ananteśaṃ pūjayedvai tathā sūkṣmeśameva ca | śivottameśaṃ sampūjya ekanetreśameva ca || 47-219 || ekarudreśamevaṃ hi trimūrttīśaṃ tato'rcayet | bhaktyā samarcayettatra śrīkaṇṭheśaṃ śikhaṇḍinam || 47-220 || tadbāhyapatrikāgreṣu uttarādikrameṇa tu umādyādevatāḥ pūjyāḥ praṇavādinamo'ntikāḥ || 47-221 || umādevīṃ samabhyarcya tathā caṇḍeśvaraṃ tataḥ | nandinañca mahākālaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā || 47-222 || bhṛṅgarīṭaḥ skandaputrau tadbāhye kramato'rcayet | indrādīn lokapālāśca gandhadīpaiḥ samarcayet || 47-223 || vajrādīṃśca krameṇaiva pūjayetsādhakottamaḥ | dhūpadīpādinaivedyapānārthaṃ punarācamanam || 47-224 || saṃhāramudrayā cordhve sthāpayedrudrarūpiṇam | visarjanāntaṃ tatkarma utsṛṣṭapūjanādikam || 47-225 || samāpya vidhinānena pūjākarma samāpayet | pratyahaṃ mānasaṃ jāpaṃ homamarcanatarpaṇe || 47-226 || vardhayet sādhakaśreṣṭho bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥ | pañcalakṣajapenāsyā puraścaraṇamiṣyate || 47-227 || evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ pañcalakṣaṃ madhuplutaiḥ | prasūnaiḥ karavīrotthairathavā juhuyāt sudhīḥ || 47-228 || sarvadā mānasaṃ kāryaṃ dravyālābhe'niśaṃ caret | taddaśāṃśaṃ prajuhuyāttaddaśāṃśañca tarpaṇam || 47-229 || taddaśāṃśaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ daśāṃśaṃ viprabhojanam | evaṃ japaṃ sādhanañca purā nārāyaṇo muniḥ || 47-230 || kṛtvā sarvasattvamayaḥ śītalo yogirāḍ bhavet | yaḥ karoti sādhanāni so'cirādamaro bhavet || 47-231 || pūjānte pūjāśeṣe ca pūjāmadhyakrameṇa ca | praṇamet sādhakaśreṣṭho varuṇāt pāpabhūpateḥ || 47-232 || oṃ namaḥ paramakalyāṇa namaste viśvabhāvana namaste pārvatīnātha umākānta namo'stu te || 47-233 || viśvātmane vicintyāya guṇāya nirguṇāya ca | dharmāya jñānamokṣāya namaste sarvayogine || 47-234 || namaste kālarūpāya trailokyarakṣaṇāya ca | golokaghātakāyaiva caṇḍeśāya namo'stu te || 47-235 || sadyojātāya devāya namaste śūladhāriṇe | kālāntāya ca kāntāya caitanyāya namo namaḥ || 47-236 || kulātmakāya kaulāya candraśekhara te namaḥ | umānātha namastubhyaṃ yogīndrāya namo namaḥ || 47-237 || sarvāya sarvapūjyāya dhyānasthāya guṇātmane | pārvatī prāṇanāthāya namaste paramātmane || 47-238 || etatstotraṃ paṭhitvā ca stauti yaḥ parameśvaram | yāti rudrakulasthānaṃ maṇipūraṃ vibhidyate || 47-239 || etatstotraprapāṭhena tuṣṭo bhavati śaṅkaraḥ | khecaratvaṃ padaṃ nityaṃ dadāti parameśvaraḥ || 47-240 ||
