tato vakṣye mahādeva mṛtyuñjayavidhānakam | yat kṛtvā paramabrahmamayo bhavati sādhakaḥ || 47-241 || mṛtyuñjayasya mantraṃ vai japate yadi mānuṣaḥ | koṭivarṣaśataṃ sthitvā līno bhavati brahmaṇi || 47-242 || sarvavyāpakarūpeṇa sa tiṣṭhati sadāśiva | tatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 47-243 || ādau pūjāṃ vidhānena vakṣyāmi sāranimītām | śrīkaṇṭhasapūrṇodaryāśca nyāsaṃ cāsye samācaret || 47-244 || tato hṛdayamadhye tu svahastāṅgulimudrayā | tadvayānyasya deveśa tatprakāśaṃ pracakṣyate || 47-245 || praṇavādi namo'ntena caturthyantapadena ca | yojayitvā nyasenmantrī mantrabhāvaparāyaṇaḥ || 47-246 || ādhāraśaktimevaṃ hi prakṛtitadanantaram | kūrmamanantaṃ tatpaścāt pṛthivīṃ kṣīrasāgaram || 47-247 || śvetadvīpaṃ tataḥ paścānmaṇimaṇḍapameva ca | kalpavṛkṣe tato nātha vinyasenmaṇivedikām || 47-248 || ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tatra hṛdayāmbhojamaṇḍale | dakṣavāmaskandhabhāge vāmorau dakṣiṇe tathā || 47-249 || mukhe vāmapārśvabhāge nābhau dakṣapārśvake | praṇavādinamo'ntena caturthyantapadena ca || 47-250 || sarvatra nyāsamākuryātteṣāṃ nāma śṛṇu prabho | krameṇa sarvaṃ karttavyaṃ kramabhaṅgo na cācaret || 47-251 || dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tadanantaram | adharmamapi cājñānamavairāgyaṃ tataḥ param || 47-252 || anaiśvaryaṃ krameṇāpi vinyaset sādhakottamaḥ | punarvāraṃ hṛdambhoje nyasedekamanāḥ sudhīḥ || 47-253 || anantapadmamevaṃ tu aṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ tathā dviṣaṭkalātmanā sārdhaṃ saṃ somamaṇḍalaṃ tathā || 47-254 || ṣoḍaśakalātmānañca maṃ vahnimaṇḍalaṃ tathā daśakalātmanā sārdhaṃ saṃ satvaṃ tadanantaram || 47-255 || raṃ bījaṃ rajasaṃ tatra taṃ tamasameva ca āṃ ātmane nyasenmantrī aṃ antarātmane namaḥ || 47-256 || paṃ bījaṃ paramātmānaṃ māyājñānātmane namaḥ ityantaṃ nyasya deveśa mantrasiddhimavāpsyasi || 47-257 || maṇipūre mantrasiddhiṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt yaḥ karoti sadā nyāsaṃ dhyānapūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 47-258 || vāmāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ tathā raudrīṃ kālīṃ kalapadādikām | vikaraṇyāhvayā yuktā balavikaraṇīṃ tathā || 47-259 || balapramathinīṃ caiva nyaset sādhakasattamaḥ | tataḥ sarvabhūtadamanīṃ manonmanīṃ tato nyaset || 47-260 || tadupari nyasennātha oṃ namo bhagavate padam | sakalaguṇātmanaḥ śaktiṃ cānte yuktāya padamāvadet || 47-261 || anantāya padasyānte yogapīṭhātmane padam | namo'nto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvopari nyasetsudhīḥ || 47-262 || tato nātha samākuryāt sādhako gatabhīḥ svayam | ṛṣyādinyāsamākuryāt tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 47-263 || śirasi padamuccārya kahoḍaṛṣaye namaḥ | tadupari tato nātha mahāviṣṇupadaṃ vadet || 47-264 || ṛṣaye nama ityuktvā mukhe devīpadaṃ vadet | gāyatrīcchandase paścānnamaḥ śabdaṃ samuccaret || 47-265 || hṛdi mṛtyuñjayāyaivaṃ daivatāyai namaḥ padam | ṛṣiḥ kahoḍo devyāśca gāyatrīcchanda īritam || 47-266 || mṛtyuñjayo mahādevo devatāsya prakītītā | karāṅganyāsakau kuryāt ṣaḍdīrghabhājayā saha || 47-267 || sakāreṇa mahākāla tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prabho | sāmaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ cānte ca namaḥ śabdaṃ krameṇa tu || 47-268 || evaṃ karāṅgulīnyāsaṃ kuryādeva mahāprabho | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā mantreṇa sakāreṇa sabindunā || 47-269 || karāṅganyāsamākuryāt kulatantrakrameṇa tu | tato dhyānaṃ samākuryāt śubhabhāvaparāyaṇaḥ || 47-270 || indvarkānalalocanaṃ smitamukhaṃ padmadvayāntāspadaṃ | mudrāpāśamṛgākṣasūtravilasatpāṇiṃ himāṃśucchavim | koṭīrendugalatsudhāplutatanuṃ hārādibhūṣojjvalaṃ | kāntyā viśvavimohanaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvaye || 47-271 || evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāradravyaiḥ prapūjayet | arghyasthāpanamākṛtya tattanmantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 47-272 || pūjayetpīṭhamanvantā tattanmantreṇa sādhakaḥ | punardhyātvā samāvāhya mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 47-273 || pādyādibhiḥ pūjayedvai gandhapuṣpādiśobhitaiḥ | pañcapuṣpāñjaliṃ datvā parivārān prapūjayet || 47-274 || keśareṣvagninirṛtivāyvīśāneṣu pūjayet | madhye dikṣu ca tanmadhye sā bījaṃ tatra coccaret || 47-275 || hṛdayāya namaścānte sīṃ bījaṃ tadanantaram | śirase svāhayā sārdhaṃ su bījaṃ tadanantaram || 47-276 || śikhāyai vaṣaḍityādi saiṃ bījaṃ tadanantaram | kavacāya padasyānte tārabījaṃ samuccaret || 47-277 || soṃ bījaṃ pūrvamuccārya netratrayāya ityapi | vauṣaḍādimadhyapadaṃ catudīkṣu tataḥ param || 47-278 || saścānte'strāya śabdānte phaḍityeva samarcayet | ṣaḍaṅgāni pūjayitvā tadbahiḥ pratipūjayet || 47-279 || indrādīṃllokapālāṃśca vajrādīṃśca tathā prabho | dhūpadīpādinaivedyapānādīni pradāpayet || 47-280 || vidhinā vādanaṃ kuryānmṛtyuñjayasutoṣaṇāt | visarjanāntaṃ yatkarma samāpya vidhināmunā || 47-281 || saṃhāramudrayā caiva hṛdaye cānayed budhaḥ | prasannahṛdayo bhūtvā caraṇodakamāpibet || 47-282 || etanmātreṇa deveśa sarvasiddhiṃ samāpnuyāt | pibāmi caraṇadvandvāmbhojaniḥsṛtakaṃ bhaje || 47-283 || amaratvaṃ sadā dehi mṛtyuñjaya namo'stute || 47-284 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mantraprakāśo nāma saptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 47 ||
[athāṣṭacattvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca śrutaṃ ca sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahārudrasya sundari | maṇipūre prakāśañca kathitaṃ jñānanirṇayam || 48-1 || akasmāt siddhisampattiṃ nutiṃ vada mahāpirayām | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa pāṭhena yoginīvaśam || 48-2 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca paramānandadeveśa yogānāmadhipa prabho | stotraṃ rudrasya vakṣyāmi sārātsāraṃ parātparam || 48-3 || yajjñātvā yoginaḥ sarve ṣaṭcakraparibhedakāḥ | ākāśagāminaḥ sarve rsvagamokṣābhilāṣukāḥ || 48-4 || mahādevasamāḥ sarve devāśca svargabhoginaḥ | sarvarakṣākaraṃ stotraṃ ye paṭhanti nirantaram || 48-5 || te yānti brahmasadanaṃ siddhamukhyā mahītale || 48-6 || oṃ bhajāmi śambhuṃ sukhamokṣahetuṃ | rudraṃ mahāśaktisamākulāṅgam | raudrātmakaṃ cāruhimāṃśuśekharaṃ | kālaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sumukhāya śaṅkaram || 48-7 || mṛtyuñjayaṃ jīvanarakṣakaṃ paraṃ | śivaṃ parabrahmaśarīramaṅgalam | himāṃśukoṭicchavimādadhānaṃ | bhajāmi padmadvayamadhyasaṃsthitam || 48-8 || sarvātmakaṃ kāmavināśamūlaṃ | taṃ candracūḍaṃ maṇipūravāsinam | caturbhujaṃ jñānasamudrayāḍhyaṃ | pāśaṃ mṛgākṣaṃ guṇasūtravyāptam || 48-9 || dharāmayaṃ tejasamindukoṭiṃ | vāyuṃ jaleśaṃ gaganātmakaṃ param | bhajāmi rudraṃ kulalākinīgataṃ | sarvāṅgayogaṃ jayadaṃ sureśvaram || 48-10 || śukraṃ mahābhīmanayaṃ purāṇaṃ | prāṇātmakaṃ vyāghivināśamūlam | yajñātmakaṃ kāmanivāraṇaṃ guruṃ | bhajāmi viśveśvaraśaṅkaraṃ śivam || 48-11 || vedāgamānāmatimūladeśaṃ | tadudbhavaṃ bhadrahitaṃ parāparam | kālāntakaṃ brahmasanātanapirayaṃ | bhajāmi śambhuṃ gaganādirūḍham || 48-12 || śivāgamaṃ śabdamayaṃ vibhākaram | bhāsvatpracaṇḍānalavigrahaṃ graham | grahasthitaṃ jñānakaraṃ karālam bhajāmi śambhuṃ prakṛtīśvaraṃ haram || 48-13 || chāyākaraṃ yogakaraṃ sukhendraṃ | mattaṃ mahāmattakulotsavāḍhyam | yogeśvaraṃ yogakalānidhiṃ vidhiṃ | vidhānavaktāramahaṃ bhajāmi || 48-14 || hemācalālaṅkṛtaśuddhaveśaṃ | varābhayādānanidānamūlam | bhajāmi kāntaṃ vanamālaśobhitaṃ | cāmūlapadmāmalamālinaṃ kulam || 48-15 || svayaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣeśvaraṃ guruṃ | mithyābhayāhlādavibhāvinaṃ bhaje | bhāvapirayaṃ premakalādharaṃ śivaṃ | girīśvaraṃ cārupadāravindam || 48-16 || dhyānapirayaṃ jñānagabhīrayogaṃ | bhāgyāspadaṃ bhāgyasamaṃ sulakṣaṇam | śūlāyudhaṃ śūlavibhūṣitāṅgaṃ | śrīśaṅkaraṃ mokṣaphalakriyaṃ bhaje || 48-17 || namo namo rudragaṇebhya evaṃ | mṛtyuñjayebhyaḥ kulacañcalebhyaḥ | śaktipirayebhyo vijayādibhūtaye | śivāya dhanyāya namo namaste || 48-18 || bāhyaṃ triśūlaṃ varasūkṣmabhāvaṃ | viśālanetraṃ tanumadhyagāminam | mahāvipad duḥkhavināśabījaṃ | prajñādayākāntikaraṃ bhajāmi || 48-19 || purāntakaṃ pūrṇaśarīriṇaṃ guruṃ | smarārimādyaṃ nijatarkamārgam | anādidevaṃ divi doṣaghātinam | bhajāmi pañcākṣarapuṇyasādhanam || 48-20 || digagbaraṃ padmamukhaṃ karasthaṃ | sthitikriyāyoganiyojanaṃ bhavam | bhāvātmakaṃ bhadraśarīriṇaṃ śivaṃ | bhajāmi pañcānanamarkavarṇam || 48-21 || māyāmayaṃ paṅkajadāmakomalaṃ | digvyāpinaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ hareśvaram | tripakṣakaṃ tryakṣarabījabhāvaṃ | tripadmamūlaṃ triguṇaṃ bhajāmi || 48-22 || vidyādharaṃ vedavidhānakāryaṃ | kāyāgataṃ nītaninādatoṣam | nityaṃ caturvargaphalādimūlaṃ | vedādisūtraṃ praṇamāmi yogam || 48-23 || vedāntavedyaṃ kulaśāstravijñaṃ | kriyāmayaṃ yogasvadharmadānam | bhakteśvaraṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaṃ varaṃ | bhaktaṃ mahābuddhikaraṃ bhajāmyaham || 48-24 || gatāgataṃ gamyamagamyabhāvaṃ | samullasatkoṭikalāvataṃsam | bhāvātmakaṃ bhāvamayaṃ sukhāsukhaṃ | bhajāmi bhargaṃ prathamāruṇaprabham || 48-25 || bindusvarūpaṃ parivādavādinaṃ | madhyāhnasūryāyutasannibhaṃ navam | vibhūtidānaṃ nijadānadānaṃ | dānātmakaṃ taṃ praṇamāmi devam || 48-26 || kumbhāpahaṃ śatrunikumbhaghātinaṃ | daityārimīśaṃ kulakāminīśam | prītyānvitaṃ cintyamacintyabhāvaṃ | prabhākarāhlādamahaṃ bhajāmi || 48-27 || trimūttīmūlāya jayāya śambhave | hitāya lokasya vapurdharāya | namo bhayācchinnavighātine pate | namo namo viśvaśarīradhāriṇe || 48-28 || tapaḥphalāya prakṛtigrahāya | guṇātmane siddhikarāya yogine | namaḥ prasiddhāya dayāturāya | vāñchāphalotsāhavivardhanāya te || 48-29 || śivamamaramahāntaṃ pūrṇayogāśrayantaṃ | dharaṇidharakarābjairvardhamānaṃ trisargam | visama maraṇaghātaṃ mṛtyupūjyaṃ janeśaṃ | vidhigaṇapatisevyaṃ pūjaye bhāvayāmi || 48-30 || etatstotraṃ paṭhed vidvān muniryogaparāyaṇaḥ | nityaṃ jagannāthaguruṃ bhāvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 48-31 || maṇipūre vāyuniṣṭho nityaṃ stotraṃ paṭhed yadi | jīvanmuktaśca dehānte paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 48-32 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane rudramṛtyuñjayastavanaṃ | nāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 48 ||
[athaikonapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca ṣaṭcakrabhedanārthāya sarvasiddhasusiddhaye | vakṣyāmi lākinīdevīstotraṃ paramadurlabham || 49-1 || yatpāṭhādatisantoṣaṃ prāpnoti yatirīśvara | tatkriyāsārasampannaṃ stavanaṃ lākinīpirayam || 49-2 || asya śrīlākinīstotrasya mahāviṣṇukahoḍaṛṣirgāyatrīcchando mahāsiddhidamṛtyuñjaya(--) mahārudra lākinī sarasvatīdevatā maṇipūrabhedane jape viniyogaḥ || om bījākṣaramūtīmātī hariṇīmāryāṃ jayāṃ buddhidāṃ | dīnānāmaparādhakoṭihananīṃ saṃjñāmaṇiṃ yoginām | tvāmādyāmanurāgiṇīṃ guṇagaṇāmodaikahetusthalāṃ | sthityantaḥkṛtakautukīma varade vande mudā lākinīm || 49-3 || herambārcanasiddhidādvayagatā koṭiprabhā bhāskarā sākārā kiraṇojjvalā sukhamayī vedadhvaniprāṇinī | kopāko pitalakṣaṇā tarutarākalpāśayā saṃśayā kṛtvaivaṃ varavaṇīnī samavatu śrīlākinī kaṅkinī || 49-4 || keyūrāmalahāramālaśubhagā vīrāsanā sthāyinī bhāryā rudrapateḥ pravālavimalā vaktrotpala sragdharā | mātā yogavatāṃ satī parā parapadā mādhvīrasācchāditā | tvaṃ māṃ pāhi kṛpāmayī yamagataṃ mṛtyuñjaye śrīdhare || 49-5 || ākāṅkṣīkulasaṅkhyakā kṣayakarī śatruprabhāderdayā | bhaktānāmatiduḥkhahā śaśimukhī yonyānanā kāmukī | kāmasthānamakāmadoṣaśatakaṃ śīghraṃ tvalakṣemadā | jīvanmuktipadaṃ vidhehi samare sargadruhasya pirayam || 49-6 || tvaṃ pañcānanapūjitā tvamaśitā tvaṃ bālavidyāgati(--) | stvaṃ satyaṃ kavitāsu vākyakavitā tvaṃ kevalānandadā | tvaṃ lākṣāruṇarūpiṇī tvamavarā tvaṃ liṅgasaṃhāriṇī | tvaṃ sākṣādamṛtapradā tvamajarā tvaṃ lākinī pātu mām || 49-7 || nānāmaṅgaladharmarājyajaḍitā saṃskārabodhāśrayā | liṅgasthācalaputrikā navagṛhe saṅkāmayantī śivā | me liṅgopari rudranātha vipathavyābhedanaṃ saṅgamaṃ | śīghraṃ kāraya devi mokṣaturikaṃ koṭīva candrojjvalā || 49-8 || candrābhāsakalāśrayā śrayati yā śabdacchaṭā yā samā | māyā mohabhidā dayā dayati yā kṛṣṇakriyā mohinī | lakṣmīrnīlakalevarāmalamaṇeḥ pūrvaṃ sadā rakṣatu | śrīvidyā bhayadāyinī tvamapi sā me nābhimūlodayā || 49-9 || mātrā mudrāmanananilayā mālinī mantravidyā | viśveśānī śayanarahitā śītavātātapasthā | satyāsatyā vacanabhavagā gauri mātā tvameva | prāṇān rakṣa prathamakiraṇāmāśraye tvāmanantām || 49-10 || siddhāsiddhā śaśiravikalā kevalāmbhojasaṃsthā | sthityānandā nayanasvacalāmbhojamadhyaprakāśā | nityaṃ śraddhāgatipathakarā kartrī kāmānahartrī | nādyastotraṃ bhaja bhaja bhaje tvāmanantāṃ svarūpe || 49-11 || pītāpītā pavanagamanā dhāraṇadhyānayogā | kālākālā kalikulakalā niṣkalā jñānarūpā | kṛṣṇānandā madanakuharā kekarā śaṅkarī vā | tvaṃ śrīghātrī dhavalakamalaṃ nābhimūle pravakṣye || 49-12 || śvetā śvetāruṇaśatakarā bhāvanājñānasiddhiḥ | prītāprītā paramagahanā cāruṇāmānanāyāḥ | tvaṃ sā vidyā vidhibudhavarā dhāraṇājñānagamyā | ramyāramyā ramaṇaniratā nīradā pātu nābhim || 49-13 || mandodbandhapirayavadhulatā nīravānāvahantrī | kṣetrākṣetrā paracaragatā bhuktimuktiprakāśā | kaulākaulājñāpitanayanā gañjanā vātamugdhā | mugdhāmugdhāmatidhanapaternābhisaṃsthe'vanābhim || 49-14 || haṃsī siṃhāsanagatapadā cakravidyā susūkṣmā | śrīvidyā tvaṃ navavilacarā sundarī raktavarṇā | svarṇāmbhojopari śubhamanā cakramadhye pratiṣṭhā sarvā varṇā parijanadayānābhipadmaṃ ca rakṣā || 49-15 || brahmānandā nṛpagaṇamahāpūjayā śobhitāṅgī | śrīśrīvidyāsakalavibhavā bhāvanīyā mahendraiḥ | siddhasthāne maṇimayagṛhe mūlasiṃhāsanasthā | padme cāṣṭānvitayugadale nābhimūle mamāva || 49-16 || yogajñānaṃ dvividhavibhavaṃ vedavidyāprakāśaṃ | me cāṣṭāṅgaṃ samavatu mudā ṣoḍaśī bhairavasthā | candrolkā tvaṃ bhavabhayaharā śokatāpāpahantrī | nābhāvabje udayati suro yastamīśe prarakṣa || 49-17 || saṃśiṣṭā tvaṃ virata karuṇe śītale śītaśaile | sākṣādanyapracayavacanā pārvaṇā parvapūrā | vidyutpūraṃ samasukhamayaṃ pāhi pañcānanā yā | tvaṃ sā devī śubhamaṇigṛhe śītalatvaṃ vidhehi || 49-18 || chandogānāṃ sakalaviṣayacchedinī cārṇamātā mālā lākṣaruṇakiraṇabhā gopapūjyā girījyā | mātastvaṃ me svamaṇibhavanaṃ pāhi sūkṣmā bhavānī | vānasthānāśraya jaya karācāṅgirā cānnapūrṇā || 49-19 || candrollāsā'vayavasukhadā dīrghakeśī viśālā | tvaṃ mātaṅgī janani jagatāṃ bālikā vipracaṇḍā | jyotsnājāle udayati sadā raktabhāṣaprabhāsā | tvaṃ me rudra hariharatanuṃ nābhimūle prarakṣa || 49-20 || vāṇīnāmnā racayati vacaḥ sundarī varṇanasthā | sthityantasthā calatanudharā dhāmasandhāmarā sā | bodhānandaprakṛtitanubhirvyāpinī jñānamugdhā | mātastvaṃ me maṇidalagṛhaṃ pāhi sarvāṅgavidye || 49-21 || vidyā caṇḍāmalasitasṛjā candanāliptadehā | viśveśāni bhagavati śive tvaṃ kṣayāmogharūpā | jāyā śambhorjaṭilaśivagatā mokṣadā mānasaṃsthā | cittaṃ śubhraṃ kuru viṣayachedanaṃ chedini tvam || 49-22 || maṇimayakulagehe koṭividyutprakāśe'(--) bhayavaramapi dehi kodhavidye mayi tvam | sakalasukhavibhogaṃ pālaya prāṇarūpaṃ | caraṇatalavilagnaṃ māmanāthaṃ pareśi || 49-23 || bhuvanagahanahetoḥ kāyasargā vināste | vidhimakhasuranāthaṃ mānuṣādi trisargam | mama maṇikulapadme nityarūpābhidhānaṃ | jayati khalu tadānīṃ stotrasāraprakāram || 49-24 || bhavatu caraṇapadme lākinī devakanye | viracaya manuśāstraṃ siddhamantraprakāram | vaha vaha bhavabhāvaṃ trāhi māṃ candragehe | kaṭhinahṛdayanāśaṃ śaṅkari tvaṃ kuruṣva || 49-25 || kamalavanasamīpe vanyamadhye'tiguhye viṣayaviṣayināśaṃ kaulike tvaṃ vikṛtya | bhavanijamaṇipīṭhe sthāpayitvā nidānaṃ | hara haradayite tvaṃ doṣaṣaṭkaṃ vivādam || 49-26 || ghore sāndrāndhakāre mama nijakuladṛgdānakatrī prasanne | vāñchākalpadrumasthā tvamiha kuśaladā dāyabhāgāvibhāgā | tvaṃ kālī nandinīsthā nayakaruṇaghaṭā madhyagā māghakā tvaṃ | bhīmā bhītyāpahantrī harapadanayano lākinī nābhimāva || 49-27 || etatstotraṃ paṭhed vidvān yogajñānī nirāśrayaḥ | mahāsukhagato vīro vibhavāyāmṛtāya ca || 49-28 || bhogamokṣau kare tasya caihike yogirāḍ bhavet | pare yāti mahādevī pādapadme na saṃśayaḥ || 49-29 || ehike cirajīvitvaṃ dadāti kāmadāyinī | maṇipūre sthito yāti kulamārgaprasādataḥ || 49-30 || kulamārgeṇa yatsthānaṃ layaṃ viśveśvarīpadam | tallayā maṇipūrasthā devatā paśyati dhruvam || 49-31 || pūjānte prapaṭhet stotraṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇaḥ | śīghrameva hi yogī syāt kulamārgaprasādataḥ || 49-32 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre lākinīśastavanaṃ nāma ekonapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 49 ||
[atha pañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca nātha kānta pravakṣyāmi siddhasādhanamuttamam | yena sādhanamātreṇa naro yogī bhaved dhruvam || 50-1 || trivīraṃ trividhaṃ proktamuttamādhamamadhyamam | tatraiva trividhaṃ saṅgamūrdhvapātālabhūtalam || 50-2 || sapta ūrdhvaṃ tathā nātha sapta bhūtalameva ca | sapta pātālamevaṃ hi saptatrisaptasaṃkhyakam || 50-3 || tanmadhye trividhaṃ bhāvaṃ divyavīrapaśukramam | divi tiṣṭhanti devāśca vīrāstiṣṭhanti bhūtale || 50-4 || paśavaḥ santi pātāle kramaśaḥ kramaśaḥ prabho | sarvatra triguṇacchannaṃ sattvarajastamādikam || 50-5 || sattvaguṇaṃ svargamadhye sarve viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ | tadā sarve dṛḍhāḥ svarge bhūtale ca rajoguṇam || 50-6 || brahmasevāparāḥ sarve brahmajñānina eva ca | pātāle śivasevāśca śivarūpiṇa eva ca || 50-7 || tamoguṇāt paśorbhāvaṃ tamodṛṣṭiṃ samāpya ca | tato vihāya tajjñānaṃ vīro bhavati sādhakaḥ || 50-8 || vīrabhāve jñānadṛṣṭiṃ brahmasiddhiṃ samāpya ca | devatā bhavati kṣipraṃ sattve nirmalabhāvake || 50-9 || sthiro bhūtvā mahādevo bhavatyeva krameṇa tu | ākāśagāminī siddhiḥ kramaśo bhavati dhruvam || 50-10 || mūlādhārasya cādho vai pātālatalavāsinaḥ | tadūrdhve brahmaloke tu bhūtalādinivāsinaḥ || 50-11 || tadūrdhve sattvanilayaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ hi daivatam vidhividyāprakāśaśca varadevasya sampadam || 50-12 || tadūrdhve sarvarūpañca sarvajñānāśrayaṃ param | parasthānaṃ mahādeva maṇipūraṃ manoharam || 50-13 || rudraśaktyātmakaṃ cakraṃ śrīvidyācakramaṇḍalam | lākinī paramā māyā mahārudreṇa sevitā || 50-14 || maṇipūraprakāśāya rudraśaktivībhāti ca | sarvajñānānandamayaṃ sarvasiddhiprakārakam || 50-15 || mahāsūkṣmaśabdamayaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ jñānasādhanam | yasyāḥ sādhanamātreṇa yogī bhavati bhairava || 50-16 || prakāra eva sevāyāṃ mahāsiddhīśvaro bhavet | sarve ca paśavaḥ santi talavad bhūtale narāḥ || 50-17 || teṣāṃ jñānaprakāśāya vīrabhāvaḥ prakāśitaḥ | vīrabhāvaṃ mudā prāpya krameṇa devatā bhavet || 50-18 || yatkāle vīrabhāvādisiddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ | tatkālanirṇayaṃ vakṣye vīrāddevatvamāpnuyāt || 50-19 || māsenākaṣīṇī siddhirmāsena vākpatirbhavet | māsatrayeṇa saṃyogājjāyate suravallabhaḥ || 50-20 || evaṃ catuṣṭaye māsi bhaved dikpālagocaraḥ | pañcame pañcabāṇaḥ syāt ṣaṣṭhe rudro na saṃśayaḥ || 50-21 || vīrabhāvaṃ samāśritya sarvadā yogamāśrayet | paśoradhīnaṃ deveśa vīrabhāvaṃ manoharam || 50-22 || vīrādhīnaṃ divyabhāvaṃ divyena rudratarpaṇam | rudradarśanamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam || 50-23 || jīvanmuktipadaṃ prāpya kinna sidhyati bhūtale | manoniveśamākṛtya paśubhāvāśrito naraḥ || 50-24 || vīrabhāvaṃ samāśritya cādau yogaṃ samāśrayet | sarvadā cābhyased yogaṃ mantranyāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 50-25 || yogasiddhiṃ jñānasiddhiṃ mokṣasiddhiṃ tataḥ param | yadi mokṣamihecchanti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥ || 50-26 || samajñānaṃ vīrabhāvamāśritya yogamāpnuyāt | yogābhyāsasya cādye ca śarīraṃ pariśodhayet || 50-27 || ādau pañcāmarāḥ kāryāḥ sarvakāryanirāśrayāḥ | kevalaṃ yogamāśritya sadā pañcāmarā bhavet || 50-28 || dviprakāraṃ mahākāla pañcāmarābhidhānakam | netī dantī tathā dhautī neulī kṣālanaṃ tathā || 50-29 || ekaprakāramevaṃ hi kathitaṃ parameśvara | dantī netī tathā dhauti neulī kṣālanakramāt || 50-30 || evaṃ vā nityamākuryād yogasiddhisamṛddhaye | pañcāmarāsādhanādikāle kuryānnijakriyām || 50-31 || oṣadhī pañcamaṃ grāhyaṃ pañcayogasusiddhaye | bilvapatraṃ jayāpatraṃ tulasīśyāmapatrakam || 50-32 || nirguṇḍīpatramevaṃ tu dūrvāgranthirasena ca | eṣāṃ prakṛtināmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu śaṅkara || 50-33 || amarā bilvapatraṃ tu cāmarā vijayādalam | amaralatā granthidūrvā nirguṇḍī cāmareśvarī || 50-34 || amarā śyāmatulasī pañcāmarāstarūdbhavāḥ | kathitā yogasiddhyarthe tatpramāṇaṃ kramāt śṛṇu || 50-35 || pañcatolakamānaṃ tu vijayāpatrameva ca | anyeṣāṃ tolakaṃ caikaṃ saṃśodhya bhakṣaṇaṃ caret || 50-36 || etadbhakṣaṇamātreṇa pañcayoge jayī bhavet | punasteṣāṃ mahākāla manuṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 50-37 || sakalaṃ cāmarāyogaṃ mantreṇānena bhakṣayet | tātadvayaṃ samuddhṛtya ṛyugaṃ tadanantaram || 50-38 || visargabindusaṃyuktaṃ tatpaścādamṛtāmukhi | maraṇaṃ mārayadvandvaṃ yogasiddhiṃ tataḥ param || 50-39 || dehi dehi padasyānte svāhāntaṃ mantramuttamam | etanmantreṇa cotpāṭya mantrayitvā prabhakṣayet || 50-40 || etatkāṇḍasya mantraṃ tu tatraiva pariyojayet | nirguṇḍīmantrarājaṃ tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhairava || 50-41 || kāmabījatrayaṃ paścāt kālībījatrayaṃ tathā | sarvayogaṃ tataḥ paścāt sādhayadvayameva ca || 50-42 || amṛtatvaṃ mayi śaktaṃ samarpayadvayaṃ tataḥ | svāhāntamanunā cātha cotpāṭya bhakṣaṇaṃ caret || 50-43 || bilvapatraṃ pragṛhṇīyāttanmantraṃ śṛṇu bhairava | lajjābījaṃ kāmabījaṃ śaktibījaṃ tataḥ param || 50-44 || brahmabījaṃ tataḥ paścād gaurasundari cāvadet | māṃ sthāpaya mahāyoge pālayadvayameva ca || 50-45 || śaṅkarapremagalite svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaret | tulasīpatraṃ saṃśodhya cotpāṭya manunā'munā || 50-46 || viṣṇupiraye mahāmāye śivayogaprasādhini | māyācchedaṃ tataḥ paścāt saṃsāraṃ hārayadvayam || 50-47 || amaratvaṃ dehi dehi svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam | śṛṇu śrīvijayāpatraśodhanaṃ hi catuvīdham || 50-48 || caturvarṇaṃ svamantreṇa pariśodhya kulākulam | tatkramaṃ parivakṣyāmi sāvadhānā'vadhāraya || 50-49 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya devībījaṃ tataḥ param | svāhāntaṃ mantramuddhṛtya saṃśodhya bhakṣayet sudhīḥ || 50-50 || ekīkṛtya mahādeva caitanmantreṇa mantrayet | amṛte'mṛtaśabdānte tadbhave padaṃ tataḥ || 50-51 || śrībījaṃ manmathaṃ bījaṃ lajjābījadvayaṃ kramāt | krameṇa ca samuddhṛtya vijaye jñānasundari || 50-52 || yogamokṣaprade paścāt kāyaśodhini pāvani | mama paścāt kāyasiddhiṃ dehi dehi tataḥ param || 50-53 || amṛtavaṣīṇi śabdānte amṛtaṃ tadanantaram | ākarṣayadvayaṃ paścāt siddhiṃ dehyanalapiraye || 50-54 || etanmantreṇa saṃśodhya sāvadhānena bhakṣayet | nyūnādhikaṃ na kartavyaṃ śanairabhyāsamācaret || 50-55 || yāvat pramāṇabhakṣaḥ syāt pramāṇe cādhikaṃ na ca | etadbhojanamākṛtya payaḥ pānaṃ samācaret || 50-56 || tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇanātha īśvara śaṅkara | marīcabījaṃ saṃśodhya dugdhaśodhanamācaret || 50-57 || etatprakāraṃ dvividhaṃ tatprakāraṃ vadāmyaham | vāñchākalpatarormūle guruṃ dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ || 50-58 || mānasopacāradravyaiḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | marīcaṃ tolakārdhaṃ tu śodhayenmanunāmunā || 50-59 || śrīkṛṣṇabījamuddhṛtya pṛthvībījatrayaṃ tathā | ghoraghoratare paścānmarīcakulasundari || 50-60 || nīlā tvaṃ bhava dehe me śarīraṃ śodhayadvayam | dviṭhānto'yaṃ manuḥ proktastatpaścād dugdhaśodhanam || 50-61 || ādau marīcaṃ bhuktvā tu dugdhapānaṃ mahābalam | carvayitvā marīcaṃ tu dugdhapānaṃ mahābalam || 50-62 || kṛṣṇabījaṃ samuddhṛtya kāmeśvarīmanuṃ tataḥ | śivabījadvayaṃ paścāt kṛṣṇagovasavāsinī || 50-63 || yogavigrahamuddhṛtya mama kāmaprasādhini | tatpaścād yogasiddhīnāmīśvari kṣetravāsini || 50-64 || śarīraṃ vasamante ca cālayadvayameva ca | vighnān vārayayugmaṃ tu svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ || 50-65 || dvādaśavāramuccārya cāthavā pañcavārakam | vāratrayaṃ mudā śodhya sarvatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 50-66 || yadi pibet khecaratvaṃ tathā dugdhaṃ dvipādakam | yadi cet kevalaṃ dugdhaṃ tadā prasthaṃ caturdaśa || 50-67 || laghvāhārī mahājñānī pañcamādi virāgavit | maṇipūre manoyogaṃ samākṛtyāmaro bhavet || 50-68 || caturvargaḥ kare tasya yo maṇeḥ pīṭhamāśrayet | śrīānandabhairava uvāca maṇipūrabhedanārthaṃ manoyogasusiddhaye || 50-69 || khecarādimahāyogasiddhaye sarvasiddhaye | mṛtyuñjayasya devasya rudraśaktyāśca darśanāt || 50-70 || tathā pīṭhasthirārthāya kālajālavaśāya ca | sahasranāmabījāni cāṣṭottaraśatāni ca || 50-71 || mṛtyuñjayasya lākinyāḥ stotraṃ makārakūṭakam | kathayasva varārohe yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || 50-72 || jñānade parameśāni śarīraṃ mama rakṣatu || 50-73 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇa bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde maṇibhedaprakāśo nāma pañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 50 ||
[athaikapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca atha sambhedanārrthāya vakṣye ṣaṭpaṅkajasya ca | mahārudrasya devasya śrī śrīmṛtyuñjayasya ca || 51-1 || lākinī śaktisahitaṃ sahasranāmamaṅgalam | aṣṭottaraśatavyāptaṃ nigūḍhaṃ bhava siddhaye || 51-2 || dhārayitvā paṭhitvā ca śrutvā vā nāmamaṅgalam | śṛṇuṣva paramānanda yogendra candraśekhara || 51-3 || tavāhlādapraṇayanāt sarvasampattiprāptaye | maṇiyogasusiddhyarthaṃ sāvadhānā'vadhāraya || 51-4 ||
aṣṭottarasahasranāmamaṅgalasya kahoḍa ṛṣirgāyatrīcchando mahārudramṛtyuñjayalākinī(--) sarasvatīdevatā sarvābhīṣṭaśacīpīṭhayogasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ |
oṃ mṛtyuñjaya rudrādi lākinyādi sarasvatī | mṛtyujetā mahāraudrī mahārudrasarasvatī || 51-5 || mahāraudro mṛtyuharo mahāmaṇivibhūṣitā | mahādevo mahāvaktro mahāmāyā maheśvarī || 51-6 || mahāvīro mahākālo mahācaṇḍeśvarī snuṣā | mahāvāto mahābhedo vīrabhadrā mahāturā || 51-7 || mahācaṇḍeśvaro mīno maṇipūraprakāśikā | mahāmatto mahārātro mahāvīrāsanasthitā || 51-8 || māyāvī mārahantā ca mātaṅgī maṅgaleśvarī | mṛtyuhārī muniśreṣṭhā manohārī manoyavā || 51-9 || maṇḍalastho manīlāṅgo mānyā mohanamaulinī | mattaveśo mahābāṇo mahābalā mahālayā || 51-10 || mārī hārī mahāmārī madirāmattagāminī | mahāmāyāśrayo maunī mahāmāyā marutpriyā || 51-11 || mudrāśī madirāpī ca manoyogā mahodayā | māṃsāśī mīnabhakśaśca mohinī meghavāhanā || 51-12 || mānabhaṅgapriyo mānyā mahāmānyo mahābalā | mahābāṇadharo mukhyo mahāvidyā mahīyasī || 51-13 || mahāśūladharo'nanto mahābalī mahākulā | malayādrinivāsī ca matirmālāsanapriyā || 51-14 || māyāpatirmahārudro maruṇāhatakāriṇī | mālādhārī śaṅkhamālī mañjarī māṃsabhakśiṇī || 51-15 || mahālakśaṇasampanno mahālakśaṇalakśaṇā | mahājñānī mahāvegī mauṣalī muṣalapriyā || 51-16 || mahokhyo mālinīnātho mandarādrinivāsinī | maunīnāmantarasthaśca mānabhaṅgā manaḥsvinī || 51-17 || mahāvidyāpatirmadhyo madhye parvatavāsinī | madirāpo mandaharo madanāmadanāsanā || 51-18 || madanastho madakṣetro mahāhimanivāsinī | mahān mahātmā māṅgalyo mahāmaṅgaladhāriṇī || 51-19 || mahāhīnaśarīraśca manoharatadudbhavā | māyāśaktipatirmohā mahāmohanivāsinī || 51-20 || mahaccito nirmalātmā mahatāmaśucisthita | mattakuñjarapṛṣṭhastho mattakuñjaragāminī || 51-21 || makaro | jayakārī jīvakārī jayadā jīvanī jayā || 51-167 || jayo gaṇeśa śrīdātā mahāpīṭhanivāsinī | viṣama sāmavedastho yajurvedāṃśayogayā || 51-168 || trikālaguṇagambhīro dvāviṃśatikarāmbujā | sahasrabāhu sārastho bhāgagā bhavabhāvinī || 51-169 || bhavanādikaro mārgo vinītā nayanāmbujā | sarvatrākarṣako'khaṇḍa sarvajñānābhikaṣīṇī || 51-170 || jitāśayo jitavipraḥ kalaṅkaguṇavajītā | nirādhāro nirālambo viṣayā jñānavajītā || 51-171 || ativistāravadano vivādakhalanāśinī | bhāryānāthaḥ kśobhanāśo ripūṇāṃ kulapūjitā || 51-172 || āśavo bhūrivargāṇāṃ cārukuntalamaṇḍitā | atibuddhidharo sūkṣmo rajanīdhvāntanāśinī || 51-173 || jyotsnājālakaro yogī viyogaśāyinī yugā | yugagāmī yogagāmī jayadā lākinī śivā || 51-174 || saṃjñābuddhikaro bhāvo bhavabhītivimohinī | sundara sundarānando ratikāratisundarī || 51-175 || ratijñānī ratisukho ratināthaprakāśinī | buddharūpī bodhamātro vairodho dvaitavajītā || 51-176 || bhūribhāvaharānando bhūrisantānadāyinī | yajñasādhanakartā ca suyajña pañcamocanā || 51-177 || koṭikoṭicandratejaḥ koṭikoṭirucicchaṭā | koṭikoṭicañcalābho dvikoṭyayutacañcalā || 51-178 || koṭisūryācchannadeha koṭikoṭiraviprabhā | koṭicandrakāntamaṇi koṭīndukāntanirmalā || 51-179 || śatakoṭividhumaṇi śatakoṭīndukāntagā | vilasatkoṭikālāgni koṭikālānalopamā || 51-180 || koṭivahnigato vahni vahnijāyā dvigodbhavā | mahātejo vahnivāriḥ kālāgnihāradhāriṇī || 51-181 || kālāgnirudro bhagavān kālāgnirudrarūpiṇī | kālātmā kalikālātmā kalikā kulalākinī || 51-182 || mṛtyujito mṛtyutejā mṛtyuñjayamanupriyā | mahāmṛtyuharo mṛtyurapamṛtyuvināśinī || 51-183 || jayo jayeśo jayado jayadā jayavadhīnī | jayakaro jagaddharmo jagajjīvanarakśiṇī || 51-184 || sarvajit sarvarūpī ca sarvadā sarvabhāvinī | ityetat kathitaṃ nātha mahāvidyābhidhānakam || 51-185 || śabdabrahmamayaṃ sākṣāt kalpavṛkṣasvarūpakam | aṣṭottarasahasrākhyaṃ śatasaṃkhyāsamākulam || 51-186 || trailokyamaṅgalakṣetraṃ siddhavidyāphalapradam | sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ sākṣāt kalpadrumakalānvitam || 51-187 || yogināmātmavijñānamātmajñānakaraṃ param | yaḥ paṭhed bhāvasampūrṇo mithyādharmavivajītaḥ || 51-188 || rudrapīṭhe svayaṃ bhūttvā mahāyogī bhaveddhruvam | akasmātsiddhimāpnoti cādhamāṃmālyadāyinīm || 51-189 || rājalakṣmīdhanaiśvaryamatidhairya hayādikam | kuñjaraṃ sundaraṃ vīraṃ putraṃ rājyaṃ sukhaṃ jayam || 51-190 || rājarājeśvaratvaṃ ca divyavāhanameva ca | akleśapañcamāsiddhiṃ tataḥ prāpnoti madhyamām || 51-191 || atyantaduḥkhahananaṃ gurutvaṃ lokamaṇḍale | devānāṃ bhaktisaṃkhyāñca divyabhāvaṃ sadā sukham || 51-192 || āyurvṛddhiṃ lokavaśyaṃ pūrṇakośaṃ hi godhanam | devānāṃ rājyabhavanaṃ pratyakṣe svapnakālake || 51-193 || dīrghadṛṣṭibhayatyāgaṃ cālpakāryavivajītam | sadā dharmapriyatvaṃ ca dharmajñānaṃ mahāguṇam || 51-194 || vivekāṅkuramānandaṃ śrīvāṇīsukṛpānvitam | tata uttamayogasthāṃ siddhiṃprāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 51-195 || anantaguṇasaṃsthānaṃ māyārthabhūtivarjanam | ekāntasthānavasatiṃ yogaśāstraniyojanam || 51-196 || sarvākāṅkṣāviśūnyatvaṃ daivataikāntasevanam | khecaratvaṃ sarvagatiṃ bhāvasiddhiṃ surapriyam || 51-197 || sadā raudrakriyāyogaṃ vibhūtyaṣṭāṅgasiddhidam | dṛḍhajñānaṃ sarvaśāstrakāritvaṃ rasasāgaram || 51-198 || ekabhāvaṃ dvaitaśūnyaṃ mahāpadaniyojanam | mahāguṇavatīvidyāpatitvaṃ śāntimeva ca || 51-199 || prāpnoti sādhakaśreṣṭho yaḥ paṭhed bhāvaniścalaḥ | trikālamekakālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ vā paṭhet sudhīḥ || 51-200 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ cāsya puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | puraścaraṇamākṛtya paṭhitvā ca punaḥ punaḥ || 51-201 || aṣṭaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā manogatimavāpnuyāt | sarvatra kuśalaṃ vyāptaṃ yaḥ paṭhenniyataḥ śuciḥ || 51-202 || ṣaṭcakramaṇipīṭhañca bhittvā'nāhatago bhavet | anāhataṃ tato bhittvā viśuddhasaṅgamo bhavet || 51-203 || viśuddhapadmaṃ bhittvā ca śīrṣe dvidalago bhavet | dvidalādimahāpadmaṃ bhittvaitat stotrapāṭhataḥ || 51-204 || caturvargāṃ kriyāṃ kṛtvā cānte nirvāṇamokṣabhāk | yogināṃ yogasiddhyarthe sarvabhūtadayodayam || 51-205 || nirvāṇamokṣasiddhyarthe kathitaṃ parameśvara | etatstavanapāṭhena kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale || 51-206 || kulaṃ kulakrameṇaiva sādhayed yogasādhanam | yogānte yogamadhye ca yogādye prapaṭhet stavam || 51-207 || kṛttikārohiṇīyogayātrāyāṃ mithune tathā | śravaṇāyāṃ meṣagaṇe kuje cendusamākule || 51-208 || śanivāre ca saṅkrāntyāṃ kujavāre punaḥ punaḥ | sandhyākāle likhet stotraṃ dhyānadhāraṇayogirāṭ || 51-209 || bhūrjapatre likhitvā ca kaṇṭhe śīrṣe pradhārayet | athavā rātriyoge ca kulacakre likhet sudhīḥ || 51-210 || sarvatra kulayogena paṭhan siddhimavāpnuyāt | etannāmnā prajuhuyāt kālikākṛtimān bhavet || 51-211 || taddaśāṃśakrameṇaiva hutvā yogīha sarvadā | maṇipūre dṛḍho bhūtvā rudraśaktikṛpāṃ labhet || 51-212 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale lākinīśāṣṭottaraśatasahasranāmavinyāse ekapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 51 ||
[atha dvipañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca kathayasva varārohe maṇipūramanukramam | yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve cāṣṭasiddhimavāpnuyuḥ || 52-1 || prajapan gacchati kṣipraṃ anāyāsa manāhate | mantrārthaṃ mantracaitanyaṃ nijavigraharakṣaṇam || 52-2 || tatparāparagranthisthaṃ vicārya vaktumarhasi | śrīānandabhairavī uvāca mahābhairava kālāgne manujñānaṃ niśāmaya || 52-3 || kathayāmi tava snehādatikomalasādhanam | mantrāṇāṃ mantracaitanyaṃ viṣayāni śṛṇu prabho || 52-4 || maṇipūre tvanāyāse yatprasādāt sthiro bhavet | etatkaraṇamātreṇa yogī bhavati niścitam || 52-5 || koṭikoṭimantrajālaṃ tadarthakoṭayaḥ smṛtāḥ | etanmadhye sārabhāgaṃ kathayāmi kulārṇava || 52-6 || sarvatra samabhāvena saṃsmaran mantramuttamam | śarīramaparicchinnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram || 52-7 || mūlādi maṇipūrāntaṃ triguṇaṃ manurūpakam | varṇamālāmupādāya muhurmuhurjapet sudhīḥ || 52-8 || pūrṇatejomayīṃ dhyāyet koṭikālāgnirūpiṇīm | svadevatāṃ sadā dhyāyenmūlādibrahmarandhrake || 52-9 || tanmūtīmaparicchinnāṃ gūḍhasthānanivāsinīm | gabhīrordhvagalānandāṃ sudhāsāgaravāsinīm || 52-10 || yajjñātvā brahmatulyaṃ syād brahmarandhre vibhāvanāt | mūlarandhre mudā dhyāyet koṭikālānalojjvalam || 52-11 || jvalantaṃ dhyānamākuryādūrdhvaśikhāprabhākaram | sudhārasamodamugdhaṃ havyāgnisadṛśojjvalam || 52-12 || lalāṭaṃ cintayet kāntaṃ pūrṇendukoṭisaṅkulam | vigaladrasapuñjaṃ tu tadrasaprojjvalānanam || 52-13 || sthiravāyusthirākāraṃ mantrārthaṃ ceti bhāvayet | athavā śuddhasaṅkāśaṃ pūrṇabrahmamayūkhagam || 52-14 || mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ mūlaṃ dhyātvā punaḥ punaḥ | vicintayet sūkṣmarūpāṃ mahāgurvīṃ svadevatām || 52-15 || mantrārthaṃ ceti tajjñānaṃ tajjñānānmokṣamāpnuyāt | mantrārthajñānamātreṇa siddhinirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 52-16 || na sthūlaṃ nātisūkṣmaṃ guṇamayavapuṣaṃ viśvanāthaṃ svaśaktiṃ | svānandānandacittaṃ kaliphalamacalaṃ cañcalaṃ śuklaraktam | pīnāpīnādirūpaṃ triguṇagagamanaṃ mūlapadmādivaktre | viśvātmānaṃ kulākhyaṃ manuguṇajaḍitaṃ bhāvayetsiddhalokaḥ || 52-17 || catuḥ ṣaṣṭikṣetre triguṇajananīṃ dhyānanipuṇāṃ | (mahā)mantrākārāṃ bhuvanakaruṇāṃ bodhaviṣaye | mahāvidyāmādyāṃ manumayarasācchannatanutā(--) mavāpyāmandābdhau kulapathi bhajantīha rasikāḥ || 52-18 || samastaṃ śūnyārthaṃ rajataghaṭanārāyaṇamayaṃ | visargaṃ bindusthaṃ raviśaśikalā vahnikiraṇam | jagad vyāpārāṅgaṃ bhavavirahitaṃ bhāvajaḍitaṃ vikārādhārāhaṃ daśadalabile sthāpayati dhīḥ || 52-19 || surāsurabhayapradaṃ taruṇarūpaśobhākaraṃ | manoharakalevaraṃ sakaladehasaṃjñāpanam | bhajanti munayo nṛpā yataya indradevādayo | daśacchadaniketane prakṛtidehamadhyasthitam || 52-20 || pracaṇḍavacanāśrayaṃ dhvanikalāpasammardanaṃ | mahotkaṭatapaḥpriyaṃ bhajati cāśutoṣaṃ śivam | nidhāya hṛdi paṅkaje kimapi nābhimūle'pi vā | vibhāvaguṇabhāvanaṃ parikaroti yogī mahān || 52-21 || svakīyaguṇasattvake kaṭhinacittasaṃjñārpaṇaṃ | caturbhujakalevare daśakalādharendīvare | manoharaharaṃ paramasāramādyākṣaraṃ | prakṛtya parameśvare praṇavarūpamāropaye || 52-22 || viviktamatinirmalaṃ kamalahāsamālyāśrayaṃ | śivaṃ śatakabhāskaraṃ sakaladehamadhye'pi vā | bhujāyutadharaṃ dharādharadharaṃ hi mudrādharaṃ | bhajanti kulakāminīpataya īśaveśmāspadā || 52-23 || sadā caraṇapaṅkaje vivahānimudrāptaye | kṛpāmayasalakṣaṇaṃ gatigasatvasambhāvanam | sadaikaguṇabhāvanaṃ paramadevadevasya yā | trilokajananīpate ramaṇameva kuryādvaśī || 52-24 || evaṃ kṛtvā nirālambaviśvāsadhyānavānnaraḥ | akasmānmantracaitanyaṃ prāpnotyarthavinirṇayam || 52-25 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mantrārtha caitanyavinyāso nāma | dvipañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 52 ||
[atha tripañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca ānandasāgarāmbhojamadhyastha paramapriya | idānīṃ kālajālādivāraṇaṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 53-1 || sampūrya sañcayācchannaṃ vāyuṃ svābhāvikīgatim | kumbhayitvā svabhāvena cirakālaṃ sukhī bhavet || 53-2 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ recayitvā sarvadā tadgato bhavet | kālajālavaśo yāti tatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 53-3 || vinā vāyvākuñcanena na sidhyati ca ko janaḥ | vāyucālanamātreṇa sūkṣmamārgodgamena ca || 53-4 || sidhyatyeva mahāyogī kālajālavaśo'pi ca | kālavaśaṃ na karoti mohādatisukhāyate || 53-5 || kālabhakṣo bhavet so'pi mirayate nātra saṃśayaḥ | maṇipure mano dattvā sādhayed devatāḥ sadā || 53-6 || stotraṃ dhyānaṃ nāma guṇaṃ paṭhitvā ca punaḥ punaḥ | manoyogañca sarvatra vāyunā kārayed budhaḥ || 53-7 || kumbhayitvā dhārayitvā recayitvā punaḥ punaḥ | sarvakālavaśaṃ nītvā jitātmā cāmaro bhavet || 53-8 || lobhamohau varjayitvā kāmakrodhādipātakam | sarvadā vāyupānañca kṛtvā rahasi saṃvaśī || 53-9 || nityaṃ vāyusādhanāni ṣaṭcakrabhedanāya ca | śanaiḥ śanairdhārayedvai cirajīvitvasādhanāt || 53-10 || yadi na cirajīvī syāt kālātmā vāyusevakaḥ | ṣaṭcakrabhāvasiddhyante jñānī mṛtyuvaśo bhavet || 53-11 || ataḥ kuryācchivajñānaṃ vāyusaṃsiddhakāraṇam | tatkriyāsādhanārthāya ādau pañcāmarāvidhim || 53-12 || kuryāt sādhakamukhyaśca nijakāyaprasādhanāt | netīyogaṃ tadā kuryād yathā bhavati saṃvaśī || 53-13 || dhautīyogaṃ tadā kuryād yathā bhavati saṃvaśī | neulīyogamākuryād yatra loko na vidyate || 53-14 || dantīyogaṃ tadā kuryād yadā mukhyakriyāvataḥ | tadā kṣaṇena yaḥ kuryād yadā tṛṣṇāvivajītaḥ || 53-15 || tṛṣṇānāśo bhavenmokṣa iti me yoganirṇayaḥ | viśeṣeṇa pravakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu kailāsapāvana || 53-16 || etatkāryaṃ purā kṛtvā divi devā munīśvarāḥ | kāyasiddhiṃ mudā kṛtvā chāyāmāyāvivajītāḥ || 53-17 || sarvatra gāminaḥ sarve dharmaśāstrārthapaṇḍitāḥ | cirajīvina evāpi sakalaśrīsamanvitāḥ || 53-18 || tattadbhedān pravakṣyāmi sādhanaṃ kāyarakṣaṇam | yaḥ karoti mahādeva kāyasādhanamuttamam || 53-19 || sa āyāti mamānandasadane nātra saṃśayaḥ | prabhāte ca samutthāya brāhme kālaphalodaye || 53-20 || sahasrāre guroḥ pādapaṅkajadhyānamācaret | vicintayettataḥ śrīmān gururūpāṃ sarasvatīm || 53-21 || svadevatāṃ parānandarasiko yogabuddhimān | praṇamya śirasā nityaṃ śaucakāryaṃ samācaret || 53-22 || śaucakriyākrameṇaiva siddhaḥ śuciguṇānvitaḥ | pragacchecchaucakāryārthaṃ ghaṭamānaṃ tu yatnataḥ || 53-23 || mṛttikāprasthamānañca nītvā śaucaṃ samācaret | kulkulaṃ saptadaśakaṃ varcatyāgaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 53-24 || tatastarjanyā cāloḍya vāmahastasya śaṅkara | gudarandhre samāyojya kṣālanaṃ hi punaḥ punaḥ || 53-25 || yāvacca visasaṃtyāgaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa malakṣayam | tāvanmṛtpayasā kṣālya śodhayedudaraṃ sudhīḥ || 53-26 || yāvanna jāyate saukhyaṃ tāvatkālaṃ samācaret | tata utthāya vidhinā mṛttikāśaucamācaret || 53-27 || yena krameṇa viṣṭhāyā gandhanāśo'pi jāyate | pādadvayaṃ samākṣālya cāntaḥśaucaṃ samāśrayet || 53-28 || tatkriyāsaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu yogeśvara prabho | sūkṣmavastrasamudbhūtaṃ ḍorakaṃ sūkṣmarandhrake || 53-29 || nāsikāyā dṛḍhataraṃ komalaṃ cātinirmalam | śanaiḥ śanainīyojyātha jihvāmūle niveśayet || 53-30 || jihvāmūlāt sadādāya vāraṃ dvādaśakaṃ sudhīḥ | mandamandāgharṣaṇaṃ tu kṛtvā bhedaṃ samānayet || 53-31 || māyātrayeṇa bījena devībījatrayeṇa ca | ramābījatrayeṇāpi yoginyai nama ityapi || 53-32 || etanmantreṇa yogīndro netīyogaṃ samācaret | śiraḥsthāṅgaṃ samākṛtya kaṇṭhaśodhanamācaret || 53-33 || tato vakṣaḥśodhanaṃ tu tato nābheśca śodhanam | krameṇa kuryāt kāyārthe tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 53-34 || dhautīkriyāṃ samākuryāt taptodakanisevanam | śuklavastraṃ sūkṣmasūtraṃ cāṣṭāṅgulapramāṇakam || 53-35 || dvātriṃśaddhastamānaṃ tu pūrṇasaṃkhyā udīritā | mantrī prathamataḥ kuryāt caturaṅgulavastrakam || 53-36 || dīrghe pañcahastamānaṃ taptodakasamanvitam | bhakṣayet śeṣajihvāgre saṃsthāpya vasanaṃ sukham || 53-37 || tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhamudrābhirbhakṣayet sudhīḥ | krameṇa vardhayennityaṃ dīrghe ca prasave tathā || 53-38 || etanmantreṇa deveśa pūrvoktamanunā tathā | sarvatra pūrvabījena saṃśodhya bījamuccaret || 53-39 || śaktibījatrayaṃ paścāt kāmabījatrayaṃ tathā | lakṣmībījatrayaṃ paścānmahāghautanivāsinī || 53-40 || mevāḍīmalamantre tu kṣālayadvayameva ca | bhāryā vahettataḥ paścādudare sanniveśayet || 53-41 || śanainīveśamākṛtya yāvat sarvaḥ prajāyate | etadyogaprasādena vāyavī sukṛpā bhavet || 53-42 || tataḥ kuryāt sādhakendro vigrahakṣemakāraṇāt | neulīparamaṃ yogaṃ gātradṛḍhanibandhanam || 53-43 || ghūrṇāyamānamākuryādudaraṃ parameśvara | sarvadā cālanaṃ kuryāt prāṇavāyupradhāraṇam || 53-44 || vāme ghūṇītamākṛtya dakṣiṇe ghūṇītaṃ caret | evaṃ krameṇa deveśa puṭapākaṃ samācaret || 53-45 || etanmantreṇa deveśa śubhāsane haṭho bhavet | brahmabījatrayaṃ paścāt kālībījatrayaṃ tataḥ || 53-46 || devīpraṇavayugmaṃ tu gātrasthāyai namo dviṭhaḥ | tadante nāḍikādīnāṃ kṣālanaṃ paramādbhutam || 53-47 || vakṣaḥsthānaṃ mahādeva dantīyogena kārayet | gajamānaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ nirmalaṃ sundaraṃ matam || 53-48 || dantakāṣṭhaṃ kṣālayedvai manunā sādhakāgraṇīḥ | māyābījatrayaṃ paścād bhairavībījakatrayam || 53-49 || madīnībījayugalaṃ dantakāṣṭhanivāsinī | me hṛdgranthiṃ chedaya iti yugalaṃ vahnisundarī || 53-50 || krameṇa vidhinānena galarandhre niveśayet | yāvannābheradho yāti yāvat sukhamayāni ca || 53-51 || tāvaddantīyogakāryaṃ prabhāte sarvakāryakam | etadante tataḥ kuryānnāḍīkṣālanameva ca || 53-52 || tanmantraṃ śṛṇu vīrendra cāmaratvapradāyakam | ādau praṇavamuddhṛtya dīrghapraṇavayugmakam || 53-53 || bhuvaneśībījayugmaṃ candrabījatrayaṃ tataḥ | kṛṣṇabījatrayaṃ paścādarkabījatrayaṃ tataḥ || 53-54 || vāgbhavatrayamuddhṛtya vahnibījatrayaṃ tataḥ | śrībījaṃ manmathaṃ lakṣmīṃ śītale tadanantaram || 53-55 || svodaraṃ nāḍikāmūlaṃ malakṣālayayugmakam | svāhāntamanunā nityaṃ kṣālayennāḍikādhamāḥ || 53-56 || yāvattṛṣṇānāśakaḥ syāttāvatkālaṃ samācaret | yāvadudgamaśaktitvaṃ tridaṇḍāvadhi dhāraṇā || 53-57 || tāvanna jāyate nātha kṣālanaṃ sukhasādhanam | yadi bhāgyavaśādeva tridaṇḍavāyukumbhakam || 53-58 || svayameva samāyāti nāḍikākṣālanaṃ śubham | yāvatsūkṣmānilālāpaṃ madhupānaṃ nirantaram || 53-59 || pādāmbhojaniḥsṛtaṃ tu paramānandavardhanam | tatsukhenāparicchinnaṃ saṃjñānanirmalena ca || 53-60 || cidānandasvarūpeṇa ānandāśruvimocanam | tadā hi hṛdayagranthibhedanaṃ dehavardhanam || 53-61 || tadā hi pulakaṃ sthairyaṃ dehāveśasthiraṃ tathā | tadā ṣaṭkañja siddhāntajñānaṃ caitanyanirmalam || 53-62 || cidānandamayo bhūtvā tṛṣṇājñānavivajītaḥ | jīvanmuktaḥ parānandarasikaḥ praṇayapriyaḥ || 53-63 || sthiracetā mahāyogī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | āstiko devabhaktaśca nindāvādavivajītaḥ || 53-64 || sa evātmā mahājñānī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | pañcayogaṃ samākṛtya nityādikamanuttamam || 53-65 || snānaṃ kuryādvidhānena tīrtharājaniketane | iḍā gaṅgājale vāpi piṅgalā yamunājale || 53-66 || suṣumnāyāṃ sarasvatyāṃ vasupuṣkarakoṭiṣu | tathāpi bāhyasnāne tu sarvāṅgamastakaṃ vinā || 53-67 || saptavāraṃ samāsiñcet mastakaṃ bāhyavāriṇā | mārjanenāpi manunā mūlamantreṇa vā punaḥ || 53-68 || tato'ṅgaṃ mārjayitvā ca sandhyāvandanamācaret | bāhyasandhyāṃ tu mantreṇaivāntare prakṛtīśvaram || 53-69 || ūrdhvādhastaijasaṃ binduṃ nādamaṇḍalasampuṭam | sandhyāvandanamākṛtya mahauṣadhiṃ prabhakṣayet || 53-70 || mūlamantreṇābhimantrya pañcagavyaṃ kuleśvara | tataḥ kuryānmahāpūjāṃ svasvamantroktasādhitām || 53-71 || ṣaṭcakrārthaṃ tato dhyāyed yaduktaṃ vidhinā prabho | kuṇḍalinyā mahāpūjā sahasranāmamaṅgalam || 53-72 || devatānāṃ paṭheddhīmān sarvakāle susiddhaye | mūlādhāraṃ mudā bhitvā sūkṣmavāyudvayena ca || 53-73 || tato bhedaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ rākiṇīviṣṇusaṅgamam | tayoranukramaṃ nātha sahasranāmamaṅgalam || 53-74 || anyantaguhyakathanaṃ sattvabhaktiprakārakam | bhitvā bhedaṃ mudā kuryānmaṇipīṭhasthadevayoḥ || 53-75 || dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ stavaṃ nityaṃ yajanaṃ nāmakīrtanam | caitanyaṃ rudralākinyāstathā mṛtyuñjayasya ca || 53-76 || nityaṃ gurumayaṃ dhyātvā sarvagāminamīśvaram | cirajīvī mahāyogī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 53-77 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde maṇipūrabhedo nāma tripañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 53 ||
[atha catuḥpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca parāparāvibhedajña nigūḍhajñānasādhanam | idānīṃ śṛṇu sarvajña pañcadravyādisādhanam || 54-1 || ṣaṭcakrapadmabhedārthaṃ yatkramājjāyate kṣaṇāt | amaraścāmarā caiva sarvasiddhipradāyikā || 54-2 || brahmajñānasādhanī ca brahmānandasvarūpiṇī | amaralatā tathā dhyeyā dūrvāsaṃjñā pratiṣṭhitā || 54-3 || siddhāmarā ca nirguṇḍī sarvasiddhipradāyikā | nīlāmarā tato grāhyā nīlatulasīsaṅgitā || 54-4 || amaruḥ samayāpatraṃ cāmarā vilvapatrikā | śivapriyā sadā pūjyā pūrvoktāvāsamāśrayet || 54-5 || etadbhakṣaṇamantrāṇi śṛṇu kailāsabhūpate | brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā cakramato jayā || 54-6 || tattanmantreṇa saṃśodhya bhakṣayenmanunāmunā | sarvāsāma marādīnāṃ bhakṣaṇe samudīritā || 54-7 || praṇavaṃ dīrghapraṇavaṃ kapile jñānasādhani | mama yogaṃ sādhayeti yugaṃ svareṇa sampuṭam || 54-8 || śākhāsamūhasampūrṇe mahauṣadhinivāsini | māmekamamaraṃ dehi kuru yugmaṃ tato dviṭhaḥ || 54-9 || amarāśanamantrāṇi śṛṇuṣva pārvatīśvara | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 54-10 || śivavad viharelloke bilvapatrasya bhakṣaṇāt | śrībījatrayamuddhṛtya vāgdevītritayaṃ tataḥ || 54-11 || lakṣmīkāmeśvarībījaṃ ramākāmatrayaṃ trayam | siddhaviśveśi parame nigūḍhataruvāsini || 54-12 || māmekaṃ jñānatattve'nte niyojaya yugaṃ dviṭhaḥ | etanmantreṇa vīrendro vidhitattvākhyamudrayā || 54-13 || śodhayitvā punarnātha cāmarāṃ śodhayettataḥ | dūrvā devī tribhuvane amṛtattvapradāyini || 54-14 || granthicchedabhedavārī praṇavādye pare ramā | tato hi viṣṇubījañca kiṅkaṇī bījamuddharet || 54-15 || rājarājeśvarībījaṃ śrībījaṃ trīṇi tatparam | sudhākhaṇḍe māmihānte siddhāmarapadaṃ likhet || 54-16 || dehi dehi namaḥ svāhāśabdamuccārya śodhayet | etadbhakṣaṇamātreṇa cirakālaṃ sukhī bhavet || 54-17 || sarvasaṃyogamātreṇa siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ | siddhāmarāśodhanaṃ tu śṛṇu śrīcandraśekhara || 54-18 || siddhāmarā ca nirguṇḍī triṣu lokeṣu gopitā | etatpradhānaṃ mūlañca patraṃ vā cālayet sudhīḥ || 54-19 || mūlābhāve dalaṃ grāhyaṃ dalābhāve na mūlakam | ānayet sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ śobhanena dinena tu || 54-20 || tadā bhavati siddhiśca kaulānāṃ niyamo nahi | kaulike sarvasiddhiśca kaulike yogasādhanam || 54-21 || kulācāravihīnānāṃ yogabhogādikaṃ katham | vinā yogena bhogādisañcayo jāyate katham || 54-22 || yogasādhanamātreṇa bhogasādhanamālabhet | tadbhogaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ kālāmṛtanisevanam || 54-23 || viṣayāhlādabhogādiranāyāsena vardhate | śarīriṇāmādikārya śarīrasya prabho priyam || 54-24 || śītalāmṛtarūpāḍhyaṃ vyaktāvyaktaprakārakam | ādisādhanamevaṃ hi kathitaṃ snehahetunā || 54-25 || vallabha prāṇarakṣārthe śokātīvāraṇāya ca | punastu kathaye tubhyaṃ nirguṇḍīśodhanaṃ manum || 54-26 || oṃ nirguṇḍi mahāmāye mahāyavanivāsini | āyurārogyajanani brahmaśabdanivāsini || 54-27 || madīyaṃ sakalaṃ kāyaṃ śuddhaṃ kuru yugaṃ tataḥ | nāntayugmaṃ bindunādabhūṣitaṃ cārutejasam || 54-28 || caturdaśasvaravyāptaṃ (ṭhayugaṃ) bindubhūṣitam | lakṣmībījatrayaṃ paścād ramābījamayaṃ likhet || 54-29 || vajrakāyaṃ dehi dehi śabdānte vahnisundarī | etanmantreṇa saṃśodhya bhakṣayet sādhakottamaḥ || 54-30 || tato'maro bhavet kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | tulasīśodhanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva parameśvara || 54-31 || yatkṛtvā ca nirogī syād balavān vijitendriyaḥ | praṇavaṃ vaiṣṇavī devī sattvajñānanivāsini || 54-32 || kāmabījatrayānte tu māṃ rakṣa yugalaṃ dviṭhaḥ | etacchodhanamākṛtya bhakṣaṇaṃ yaḥ karoti ca || 54-33 || kāyasiddhirbhavettasya dhyānadhāraṇayoginaḥ || 54-34 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde pañcasiddhadravyaśodhanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 54 ||
[atha pañcapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kathayāmi tava snehāt kāyavaśyaviśeṣaṇāt | haṭhayogaṃ prakathitamidānīṃ śṛṇuta kramam || 55-1 || maṇipūrasthitaṃ rudraṃ trailokye pavanākṣayam | kathayāmi śivānanda śivaśaṅkara maṅgala || 55-2 || svādhiṣṭhānordhvadeśe ca paramānandasāgaram | nābhimūlaṃ meghajālamadhya vidyucchatākulam || 55-3 || rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca yogināmatisāragam | tannābhimūladeśe ca nīlapadmaṃ mahāprabham || 55-4 || taddalāgre sadā bhānti ḍādiphāntākṣarāṇi ca | tad bāhye śobhitaṃ rūpaṃ trikoṇamanalasya ca || 55-5 || prabhātasūryasaṅkāśaṃ śikhākāraṃ nirañjanam | tatrāgnibījarūpaṃ ca rūpātītaṃ guṇāntaram || 55-6 || vicintayenmeṣapṛṣṭhavāhanaṃ cāruṇākṛtim | caturbāhuṃ trinayanaṃ cārudehadharaṃ param || 55-7 || tatkroḍe bhāti rudreśaḥ sindūrāruṇavigrahaḥ | brahmarūpī trinayanaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 55-8 || vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgastu lokānāmiṣṭado vibhuḥ | tasya vāme sadā bhāti lākinī paradevatā || 55-9 || caturbhujā mahādevī trinetrā saukhyadāyinī | śyāmāṅgī pītavasanā vicitrālaṅkṛtāmarā || 55-10 || sarvasiddhipradā mātā sarvatra sarvapālikā | sadā rakṣatu māṃ devī vidyābhiḥ kulapālikā || 55-11 || evaṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā japayāgastavādibhiḥ | tataḥ siddho bhavenmantrī maṇipūraprasādataḥ || 55-12 || maṇipūraphalaṃ vakṣye samāsena śṛṇuṣva tat | koṭivarṣaśatenāpi phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate || 55-13 || maṇipūrānantaraṃ hi pravaktavyamanāhatam | stotraṃ dhyānaṃ nāmadheyaṃ sahasraguṇaśaṅkaram || 55-14 || phalamatyantaguhyaṃ ca suhṛtpadmopasiddhidam | ātmajñānaṃ mokṣasiddhiṃ premabhaktyādilābhakam || 55-15 || saṃhartā janasaṅghānāṃ pālakaḥ kamalākaraḥ | akasmājjñānasandohalakṣmīṃ prāpnoti yogirāṭ || 55-16 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde maṇipūrabhedo nāma pañcapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 55 ||
[atha ṣaṭpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca vada kāmini kaumāri surānande kuleśvari | hṛdayāmbhojavinyāsamadhunā vaktumarhasi || 56-1 || yasya vijñānamātreṇa naro yogeśvaro bhavet | sarvasiddhikriyāsthānaṃ yogināmatidurlabham || 56-2 || sarvatattvasvarūpaṃ ca siddhimārgaprakāśakam | hṛdayāmbhoja vijñānānmārtaṇḍabhairavo bhavet || 56-3 || śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ ṣaṭcakrasāramaṅgalam | snehād dṛṣṭikrameṇaiva bhaktiyogodbhavena ca || 56-4 || bhedanaṃ bhāvanaṃ jñānaṃ cittadarśanameva ca | mantroddhārañca saṅketaṃ sarvajñādiguṇodayam || 56-5 || yajanaṃ kākinīdevyā īśvarasya guṇātmanaḥ | stavanaṃ kavacaṃ sarvaṃ sahasranāmamaṅgalam || 56-6 || vāyūnāṃ maṇḍalajñānaṃ samāsena vadasva me | tvameva śaraṇaṃ devi trāhi māṃ duḥkhasaṅkaṭāt || 56-7 || mahākāla bhayābhāva bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇa | mamānandabhairaveśa śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 56-8 || yaduktaṃ bhavatā cātra cāśrutaṃ cādbhutaṃ matam | noktaṃ kutrāpi sarveśa tava snehāt prakāśitam || 56-9 || aprakāśyamidaṃ ratnaṃ duḥkhajālanivāraṇam | sāvadhānena sarveśa kuru tvaṃ yogasādhanam || 56-10 || mayi yogaṃ mahādeva kṛtvā kālavaśaṃ naya | mayi yogaṃ na karoti siddhibhaktikriyādikam || 56-11 || akasmānmaraṇaṃ tasya kālabhakṣo na saṃśayaḥ | kevalaṃ māṃ hṛdambhoje paripūrṇaphalodaye || 56-12 || sarvākāre manorājye nānākautukasaṅkule | pūjayitvā sadā dhyāyet kākinīṃ māṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 56-13 || sa yogī jāyate nātha hṛdambujaprasādataḥ | hṛtpaṅkeruhamadhyasthāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 56-14 || māmarcayanti te nityaṃ bhaktibhāvaparāyaṇāḥ | ye dhyāyanti mahāvīra te paśyanti savāsavān || 56-15 || krameṇa prāṇasaṃyogān māṃ paśyanti na saṃśayaḥ | māmekaṃ kākinīdhyānaṃ sthiravāyuṃ pracaṇḍakam || 56-16 || paśyanti yoginaḥ kāye aṣṭaiśvaryaṃ mahāprabham | kevalaṃ bhaktiyogena nityayoge syuruttamāḥ || 56-17 || padmadhyānaṃ prathamataḥ kṛtvā siddho bhavennaraḥ | taddhayānaṃ śṛṇu vīreśa yogināmiha durlabham || 56-18 || hṛtpadmaṃ kulapālitaṃ sulalitaṃ haṃsena saṃśodhitaṃ | bandhūkāmaladīptikoṭijaḍitaṃ sambhāvitaṃ sādhakaiḥ | atyutkṛṣṭamayūkhapuñjamilitaṃ sindūrapūrāruṇaṃ | dhyātvā paśyati yo naraḥ pratidinaṃ kādyāruṇairāvṛtam || 56-19 || sa syātkoṭidhaneśvaro naravaro bhūyāttvabhāvārṇave | yo nityaṃ lipibhāvanaṃ prakurute nityeśvarālokanāt | taddhayānaṃ kramato vadāmi sakalaṃ yena prasiddho bhave(--) | dānandārṇavamadhyapadmakalitaṃ kādyarkavarṇojjvalam || 56-20 || dale pūrve dhyāyedativimalavarṇaṃ kamiti vā prabhātārkacchāyāruṇakiraṇayogaṃ yugamayam | caturbāhuṃ nityaṃ trinayanamanantaṃ ravigataṃ | bhavādyāśaktisthaṃ svabhavanaghaṭāśobhitatanum || 56-21 || dvitīye patre'smin khamaruṇasamūhāśrayapadaṃ | padaṃ śrītāriṇyā anilagaganayoḥ priyakaram | mudā dhyāyedevaṃ paramamanilaṃ devabhujagaṃ | suvarṇālaṅkāraṃ trinayanamamaulyaṃ sukhamayam || 56-22 || tṛtīye patre'smin vidhuyutakapālaṃ trinayanaṃ | svasindūrākāraṃ dviyugabhujaśobhābhavamaham | sadā dhyāyedevaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ śrīgaṇapatiṃ | sphuradraktākāraṃ taruṇamaṇimālaṃ jitamadam || 56-23 || catuḥ patre dhyāyedyamaruṇaśataṃ ghoraninadaṃ | kriyādakṣaṃ mūtīṃ trinayanasarojaṃ yugabhujam | varābhītiprocchatsphaṭikajapamālādisahitaṃ | phaṇālaṅkārāṅgaṃ śiva śiva mukheśottamamaham || 56-24 || ṅaṃbījaṃ sindūrāruṇamamakhilanāthaṃ trinayanaṃ | mahāmokṣasthānaṃ maṇikanakaratnādyabharaṇam | caturbāhuṃ rudraṃ jagati bhavamekaṃ guṇavibhuṃ | kapālaṃ śrīmālaṃ varamabhayakaṃ bibhratamaham || 56-25 || caturbāhūllāsaṃ kamalavaramālāsisahitaṃ | vibhuṃ taṃ dhyāye'haṃ vidhuśatamukhaṃ taṃ trinayanam | prabhātārkaprāyaṃ sakalamaṇiratnābharaṇakaṃ | mahājyotsnājālaṃ paramarasabindūdbhavatanum || 56-26 || tamekaṃ netrasthaṃ chamamalakaraṃ nūtanaraviṃ | caturbāhuṃ dhyāye varatanukapāleṣu sahitam | sudhādhārāpānaṃ kanakajapamālā'vṛtatanuṃ | trinetraṃ yogendraṃ vasudalagataṃ cāruvadanam || 56-27 || caturvaktraṃ dhyāye jamajamamaraṃ sāruṇatanuṃ | viśālākṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ samarasamayaṃ brahmavapuṣam | caturbāhuṃ devaṃ tribhuvanapadaṃ sāraghaṭitaṃ | mahāśaṅkhaṃ rudraṃ varamabhayakaṃ vibhratabalam || 56-28 || mahākāyaṃ tejomayamapi caruṃ bījamakhilaṃ | mudā dhyāye kāmāpahamatimukhaṃ cāṣṭamadale | mahāsindūrādriṃ dinakarakalākoṭivimalaṃ | trinetraṃ pañcāsyaṃ daśabhujayutaṃ sarvavapuṣam || 56-29 || ñabījaṃ sārdhendūdbhava śikhamakheśaṃ trinayanaṃ | caturbāhuṃ dhyāye sukamalagadācakraniyutam | mahāmālāvyāptaṃ sukanakaśubhā'laṅkṛtaguruṃ | prabhātārkaṃ viśvācītajaḍilarūpaṃ ravidale || 56-30 || manorūpācchannaṃ trinayanamadhīśāruṇadale | ṭabījaṃ bindvindvaṃ japavaṭivarābhītyasidharam | tamekaṃ someśaṃ maṇimayacalatkuṇḍaladharaṃ | mudā dhyāye śambhuṃ hṛdi śivadale siddhakamale || 56-31 || trinetraṃ kāmākhyaṃ śiśukaruṇayā siddhiphaladaṃ | suratnā'laṅkāracchavirucitanūnāṃ samanagham | ṭhakāraṃ bindvindvaṃ navaravighaṭākoṭikiraṇaṃ | dale cārke dhyāye kamalavaramālāśiśudharam || 56-32 || etacchuddhamanolayasya bhavanaṃ caitanyasaṃsiddhaye | varṇānāṃ japabhāvanaṃ yadi sadā cintāmaṇermaṇḍalam | yogīndraḥ kurute vaśiṣṭhasadṛśo vācāṃ patirbhūtale | vāksiddhiṃ cirakālavāsamakhile devo hi no mānuṣaḥ || 56-33 || vāñchācintāmaṇigṛhaṃ hṛdayāmbhojamaṇḍalam | tanmadhye pavanasthānaṃ maṇḍalākāramulbaṇam || 56-34 || buddhipratibhayā vyāptaṃ tanmadhye pavanākṣaram | ācchannadhūmasaṅkāśaṃ prasiddhasthānamuttamam || 56-35 || tanmadhye devatāpīṭhaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ param | tanmadhye bhāvayediṣṭaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhitam || 56-36 || vāyordhyānaṃ tatra kuryādatyantasūkṣmarūpiṇam | nirākāraṃ paraṃ brahma sākāraṃ śabdarūpiṇam || 56-37 || nirakṣaraṃ svākṣarāḍhyaṃ mahograṃ sthirarūpiṇam | caturbāhuṃ jagadvyāptaṃ kṛṣṇasārāsanaṃ yavam || 56-38 || lokatrayāṇāṃ varadaṃ karuṇāsindhurūpiṇam | pañcabhūtātmakaṃ raudraṃ prāṇasañjñaṃ kirīṭinam || 56-39 || saṃbibhrataṃ varābhītighaṇṭāḍamarusevakān | īśanāmnā paricitaṃ parahaṃsaṃ kuleśvaram || 56-40 || sarvā'laṅkāraśobhāṅgaṃ vivekodayakāraṇam | vicintayet sādhakendraḥ parivāragaṇāvṛtam || 56-41 || tatra paṅkeruhe dhyāyedīśvaraṃ varṇarūpiṇam | trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāthaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam || 56-42 || ratnamālāśobhitāṅgaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ mahāprabham | īśvaraṃ yogināmīśaṃ varadaṃ parameśvaram || 56-43 || varābhītiśaṅkhapadmaśriyā juṣṭaṃ purātanam | ratnābharaṇabhūṣāṅgaṃ hṛdayāmbhojavāsinam || 56-44 || vāñchātiriktaphaladaṃ bhāvasiddhiprakāśakam | paramahaṃsamīśānaṃ dhyāyed hṛtpadmamaṇḍale || 56-45 || tatpārśve dhyānamākuryāt kākinīṃ parameśvarīm | trailokyapūjitāṃ devīṃ kākacañcuprakāśinīm || 56-46 || caturbhujāṃ pītavarṇāṃ pītavastropaśobhitām | navavidyutkoṭirūpāṃ vilolanetrapaṅkajām || 56-47 || kapālaśaśiśūlāstravaradānasamākulām | vicitraratnanirmāṇasvarṇā'laṅkārabhūṣitām || 56-48 || trailokyalalitāṃ sūkṣmāṃ varābhayakarāmbujām | sudhāpānaratāṃ mattāṃ pūrṇarūpāṃ kuleśvarīm || 56-49 || ratnakaṅkaṇamālāḍhyāṃ paramānandabhairavīm | hṛdayāmbhojamadhyasthāṃ dhyāye'haṃ haṃsagāminīm || 56-50 || tatpīṭhamadhyanikare trikoṇaṃ paricintayet | pīṭhaśaktiṃ suvarṇāḍhyāṃ vidyutkoṭisamodayām || 56-51 || kākinīsadṛśīṃ mattāṃ pūrṇāntaḥ karaṇodyatām | sarvā'laṅkārabhūṣāḍhyāṃ parivāragaṇāvṛtām || 56-52 || taddakṣiṇe pārśvabhāge cintayettvāmaliṅgakam | suvarṇaśuddhasaṅkāśaṃ nirmalaṃ cārutejasam || 56-53 || mahālakṣmīpriyānandaṃ sarvākāraṃ nirañjanam | jñānayogodayaṃ brahmarūpiṇaṃ bahurūpiṇam || 56-54 || pradīpakalikākāraṃ cintayedīśvaraṃ śivam | eteṣāṃ jñānamākṛtya vāgīśo bhavati kṣaṇāt || 56-55 || vākyasiddhiṃ tatra nātha cintayet prasiddhaye | tatra bhānormaṇḍalañca cintayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ || 56-56 || padmakiñjalkamadhye tu cintayedaruṇāyutam | māsaikasādhanādeva yogī syācchītalāṅgadhṛk || 56-57 || dvimāse granthibhedaḥ syādanantaguṇavān bhavet | trimāse yogayogyaḥ syāt sarpādiviṣanāśakṛt || 56-58 || caturmāse nirmalātmā bhāvakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ | pañcame māsi samprāpte vāyavī kṛpayānvitā || 56-59 || sthiravāyuḥ sthirā dṛṣṭiratīva sukhasampadaḥ | tato dine dine vṛddhirvāyūnāmanukampayā || 56-60 || ṣaṇmāsāt pāpasaṃtyakto muktavad bhramate ciram | jale cāgnau ca bhūgarte kadācinna mirayeta hi || 56-61 || īśvarātmā mahājñānī niḥśaṅko nirupadravaḥ | mahāvivekasiddhāntajñānī bhedavivajītaḥ || 56-62 || sa bhūtvā cirajīvī ca bhuktibhāgī dine dine | saptame kalpasantyakto madano doṣavigrahaḥ || 56-63 || nityānandaguṇaprāptirbhūmityāgo dine dine | aṣṭame sarvaśatrughno rāmanāmavivajītaḥ || 56-64 || aṇimādidarśanañca brahmagovindadarśanam | navame kṣālanāsiddhirbhūmityāgastrihastakaḥ || 56-65 || daśame yogasiddhiśca ṣaṭcakrādipradarśanam | brahmarandhrabhedanajño mahāānandavigrahaḥ || 56-66 || ekādaśe sarvasiddhiḥ pañcabhūtamayāṅgadhṛk | saptasvargālokanañca ṣaṭśivapriyadarśanam || 56-67 || dvādaśe devasanmānaṃ devatā(--)pādadarśanam | atyantaṃ sukhasantānaṃ māyājālanivāraṇam || 56-68 || sarvavidyāsarvasiddhidīvyabhaktiḥ śubhodayā | te vīrāste ca yogīndrāste divyāste ca bhairavāḥ || 56-69 || te sarve mṛtyujetāraste bhaktā muktibhāginaḥ | ye tiṣṭhanti mahāraṇye nirjane parvate ciram || 56-70 || dhārayanti sādhayanti yogametat kuleśvara | yoge yogād bhavenmokṣa iti me tattvanirṇayaḥ || 56-71 || saṃsārottāraṇe muktiryogaśabdena kathyate | loke hi durlabhaṃ yogaṃ yogātparataraṃ nahi || 56-72 || yogaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktamekaṃ viṣayasammatam | dvitīyañca dvibhedañca pūjāyogaṃ tṛtīyakam || 56-73 || bhaktiyogaṃ paraṃ brahmayogasāraṃ kuleśvara | sarvatrāpi manoyogād baddho mukto bhaved dhruvam || 56-74 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde'nāhatapadmavinyāso nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 56 ||
[atha saptapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi vivekaguṇalakṣaṇam | varṇadhyānānantaraṃ hi pūjanaṃ tanmahāphalam || 57-1 || pūjayā labheta pūjāṃ vivekaṃ bhāvasambhavam | kākinīśvarasaṃyogaṃ bhāvaṃ paramadurlabham || 57-2 || yajanaṃ kākinīdevyā īśvarasyāpi bhāvanam | pūjābhāve mahāsiddhirjāyate tatkṣaṇācchiva || 57-3 || bhāvena labhyate pūjā vivekaṃ pūjayā labhet | vivekaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ tu prāpnoti koṭijanmani || 57-4 || athavā labhyate śīghraṃ tavāpi madanugrahaiḥ | tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabha tripureśvara || 57-5 || yasya vijñānamātreṇa bhavet paramabhāvakaḥ | vicintayedvarṇapārśve catudīkṣu krameṇa tu || 57-6 || siddheśvarān yogayuktān mahāpuruṣasaṃśritān | brahmāṇaṃ paramaṃ haṃsaṃ rudraṃ viśveśvaraṃ prabhum || 57-7 || mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahākālaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sureśvaram | śrīviṣṇuṃ kamalānāthaṃ pañcacūḍaṃ kumārakam || 57-8 || candraṃ sūryaṃ prajānāthaṃ dakṣaṃ munīndrameva ca | pracetasaṃ marīciñca kaśyapaṃ pulahaṃ tathā || 57-9 || vaśiṣṭhañca bhṛguñcaiva gautamaṃ kapilaṃ munim | pulastyañca kratuñcaiva prahlādaṃ kardamaṃ tathā || 57-10 || atharvāṅgirasaṣīñca bālakhilyān marīcipān | mānasañcāntarīkṣañca vidyāśca pavanaṃ vibhum || 57-11 || tejasañca jalañcaiva mahīsparśañca śabdakam | tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ prakṛtiñca vikārakam || 57-12 || yañcānyat kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhuvākṣayaṃ carācaram | tatpārśvagāmino devā sendrā bhramanti nityaśaḥ || 57-13 || agastyaśca mahātejā mārkaṃṇḍeyaśca vīryavān | yamadagnirbharadvājaḥ saṃvartaścyavanastathā || 57-14 || durvāsāśca mahābhāga ṛṣyaśṛgaṃśca dhāmīkaḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavān yogācāryo mahātapāḥ || 57-15 || asito devalaścaiva jaigīṣavyaśca tattvavit | ṛṣabhājītaśakraśca mahāvīryastathā maṇiḥ || 57-16 || āyurvedaṃ tathāṣṭāṅgamete bhānti svamūrtayaḥ | candramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityaiśca gabhastibhiḥ || 57-17 || vāyava ṛtavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca | mūtīmanto mahātmāno mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ || 57-18 || ete cānye ca bahava īśvaraṃ samupāsate | ete pārśve cintanīyā varṇānāṃ sādhakottamaiḥ || 57-19 || tatpārśvasthaḥ prabhākoṭidhārakaḥ pratibhāti ca | artho dharmaśca kāmaśca harṣo dveṣastathā damaḥ || 57-20 || tatra gandharvamukhyāśca sahitāpsarasastathā | viṃśatiḥ sapta caivānye lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ || 57-21 || śukro bṛhaspatiścaiva budho'ṅgāraka eva ca | śanaiścaraśca rāhuśca grahāḥ sarve tathaiva ca || 57-22 || mantro rathantaraścaiva haviṣmān vasumānapi | ādityāḥ sādhirājāno nānāvṛndairupāsitāḥ || 57-23 || maruto viśvakarmā ca vasavaśca kapālinaḥ | tathā pitṛgaṇāḥ sarve sarvāṇi ca havīṃṣyatha || 57-24 || ṛgvedaḥ sāmavedaśca yajurvedastathā vidhiḥ | atharvavedaśca tathā sarvaśāstrāṇi caiva hi || 57-25 || itihāsopadeśaśca vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ | grahā yajñāśca somāśca daivatāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 57-26 || sāvitrī tāriṇī durgā vāṇī saptavidhā tathā | medhā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiścaiva prajñā buddhiryaśaḥ kṣamā || 57-27 || sāmāni śrutiśāstrāṇi gāthāstu vividhāstathā | bhāṣyāṇi tarkayuktāni dehavanti vibhānti ca || 57-28 || nāṭikā vividhāḥ kāryāḥ kathākhyāyikakārikāḥ | atra tiṣṭhanti ye puṇyā ye puṇyā gurupūjakāḥ || 57-29 || kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca divārātriśca sarvataḥ | ardhamāsāstathāmāsāḥ ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ ca śaṅkara || 57-30 || saṃvatsarāḥ pañcayugaṃ māsā rātriścatuvīdhā | kālacakrañca yaddavyaṃ nityamakṣayamavyayam || 57-31 || dharmacakrastathā cāpi nityamāste maheśvara | aditiśca ditiścaiva rudraśca vinatā tathā || 57-32 || kālikā yuvatī devī surasā cātha gautamī | prādhā kadruśca vai devyo devatānāñca mātaraḥ || 57-33 || rudrāṇī śrīśca lakṣmīśca bhadrā ṣaṣṭhī tathā parā | pṛthivīsañjñitā devī hrīḥ svāhā kītī reva ca || 57-34 || surā devī śacī caiva tathā puṣṭirarundhatī | saṃsiddhi siddhidā vidyā mahādevī ratistathā || 57-35 || etāścānyāśca vai devya upatasthuralaṅkṛtāḥ | ādityāvasavo rudrā marutaścāśvināvapi || 57-36 || viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ | rājarṣayastatra bhānti hariścandrādayaḥ prabho || 57-37 || sarve hemakuṇḍalinaḥ sarvā'laṅkārabhūṣitāḥ | bhāvukā gītavādyādi nisvanairmagnadehinaḥ || 57-38 || bhāvayanti maheśānīṃ kākinīṃ parameśvarīm | varṇarūpāṃ nityakalāṃ maheśvarapativratām || 57-39 || īśvaraṃ bhāvayantyete pūjayanti nirantaram | veṣṭitāḥ sundarākārāḥ aṣṭasiddhisamṛddhidāḥ || 57-40 || etāḥ pūjyā mahākāla varṇapārśvacarāḥ prabhāḥ | prasīda nātha svāmīti nāmnā manasi pūjayet || 57-41 || (")varṇeśvara priyānandāṃ kākinīṃ pūjayāmyaham(") iti mantreṇaiva pūjyā varṇarūpā sarasvatī || 57-42 || tadā prasannāḥ siddhyanti śrīkākinyāḥ kalau yuge || 57-43 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde kākinīśvaravarṇapārśva carayajanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 57 ||
[athāṣṭapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca athāṣṭasiddhimāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu śrīcandraśekhara | mantroddhāraṃ tathā nyāsaṃ kavacāṅga tava priyam || 58-1 || stotraṃ sahasranāmākhyaṃ sāṣṭottaramanupriyam | sākāradhyānamakhilaṃ sālokyādipadapradam || 58-2 || yasya karaṇamātreṇa suro bhavati mānuṣaḥ | vṛkṣabījād bhaved vṛkṣaḥ śraddhayāśca phalodayaḥ || 58-3 || tathā tathaiva mantrāṇāmudayo bījayogataḥ | bījaṃ tu paramaṃ jñānaṃ bījādhīnaṃ carācaram || 58-4 || bījamāśritya sarvendrāḥ pratibhānti mahaujasaḥ | koṭisūryapratīkāśāḥ prāṇasthānanivāsinaḥ || 58-5 || ke cāpyayutasūryābhāḥ śatasūryasamaprabhāḥ | kecid dvādaśasūryābhāḥ ko janaścaikabhāsurāḥ || 58-6 || kopi nāma munirdīptaḥ kopi candrasamaprabhaḥ | kopi śrīkāntikiraṇaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || 58-7 || ete bījasamudbhūtā nirbījāśca pañcadevatāḥ | brahmaviṣṇuśivānandabhairavāḥ prāṇadevatāḥ || 58-8 || brahmābrahmasvarūpeṇa śvāsamārgapraveśakaḥ | viṣṇurvaiṣṇavatattvena kumbhakāntargataḥ prabhuḥ || 58-9 || śivaḥ saṃhārarūpeṇa mahāpralayagaḥ prabhuḥ | ānandabhairavaḥ śrīmān mūlajñānīparātparaḥ || 58-10 || mūlāmbhojād brahmarandhraṃ yāvattatra praveśikā | prāṇavidyāsvarūpeṇa bījarūpā sanātanī || 58-11 || sā bhāvyā yogibhinītyaṃ yogāṅgairatibhāvyate | yogaśāstraṃ vinā nātha ke jānanti maharṣayaḥ || 58-12 || atyantaduḥkhasādhyā sā yogijñeyā manoyavā | nānārūpā bṛhadrūpā śvāsocchvāsaprakāśinī || 58-13 || hṛdayāmbhojamadhyasthā īśvarasthānavāsinī | kālacañcuprakāśā sā sarvabhūtahṛdisthitā || 58-14 || sarveṣāṃ jñānakarttī ca sarvānandakarī hṛdi | sā devī kākinī vidyā īśvarī paramā kalā || 58-15 || vibhāvyā koṭisūryābhā koṭicandrasamānanā | tasyā mantraṃ mahāmantraṃ brahmamantraṃ hi yoginām || 58-16 || śṛṇunātha kulānanda bhairavyādimanuṃ mudā | etanmatraprabhāveṇa parātmānaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 58-17 || dīrghapraṇavamuccārya vāmanetraṃ samuddharet | māyānte vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ kāmabījaṃ samuddharet || 58-18 || kāmabījaṃ tathaiśvarye namo'nte vahnikāminī | etanmantraprasādena bhavet kālavaśaḥ kṣaṇāt || 58-19 || atyantasukhamāpnoti bhayājñānāpaho bhavet | kāmena puṭitaṃ mantraṃ vāgbhavenāpi vā prabho || 58-20 || svamantrapuṭitaṃ kṛtvā siddhiḥ syādacirādiha | athānyamantraṃ vakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 58-21 || bhadrakālīṃ samuddhṛtya kiṅkiṇībījamuddharet | bālābījaṃ samuddhṛtya māheśvaryai namo dviṭhaḥ || 58-22 || kevalaṃ mūlamantreṇa puṭitaṃ mūlamantrakaiḥ | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā hṛdayāmbhojamaṇḍale || 58-23 || aprakāśyamimaṃ mantraṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | lakṣajapena siddhiḥ syād hṛdayābje stharo bhavet || 58-24 || akasmāddīpakalikākāraṃ jīvaṃ prapaśyati | tato bhavenmahāyogī īśvarīmantrasādhanāt || 58-25 || dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi pūjāyā guhyād guhyataraṃ param | dhyātvā pādyādibhirnātha manaḥkalpitapuṣpakaiḥ || 58-26 || pūjayetparayā bhaktyā mantradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 58-27 || śaśadharaśatakoṭiśrīmayūkhaprabhāyāḥ | yā surataruguṇaśobhā nirmalā vedahastā | aruṇakiraṇabhālā hāramālā vilolā | hṛdayakamalamadhye śrīśvarīṃ tāṃ bhajāmi || 58-28 || evaṃ sarvasvarūpāṃ tāṃ vibhāvya hṛdayāmbuje | punaḥ punaḥ pūjayedvai trailokyodbhavapuṣpakaiḥ || 58-29 || avaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti pūjāyogaprabhāvataḥ | āyurārogyajananaṃ pūjanaṃ sumahāphalam || 58-30 || tato japenmahāmantraṃ varṇāmālākrameṇa tu | prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyaset sarvāṅgamadhyake || 58-31 || mātṛkāgranthinikare nyaset pūrvoktanāmabhiḥ | yaduktaṃ pūrvapaṭale teṣāṃ nāmābhireva ca || 58-32 || vinyasya mantrapuṭitaṃ mantranyāsaṃ tataścaret | kākinyā aṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nyāsaṃ kuryāttataḥ param || 58-33 || kākajihvādvikāṇḍeśī kāmākhyā kākinī dhvajā | kākinī kākamālā ca kākacañcuprakāśinī || 58-34 || kokilācāṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmnā vinyasya mastake | kaṇṭhakūpe nyasetpaścāt ṣoḍaśasvarasampuṭam || 58-35 || hṛdaye vinyasennātha kādidvādaśasampuṭam | mantraṃ vinyasya vidhinā nābhau mantreṇa sampuṭam || 58-36 || ḍādiphāntaṃ tu vinyasya bādilāntaṃ svaliṅgake | mūlādhāre mūlamantrapuṭitaṃ vādisāntakam || 58-37 || vinyasya vyāpakaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvāṅgāni ca bandhayet | tataḥ prāṇāyāmamekaṃ kṛtvā prāṇān samāśrayet || 58-38 || tataḥ stotraṃ paṭheddhīmān tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu śaṅkara | haviṣyāśī vaśībhūtvā sādhayediha siddhaye || 58-39 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre kākinīsiddhisādhana nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 58 ||
[athaikonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca jñāneśvarī śubhakarī paribhāvanīyā | yogeśvarairhariharairgurubhirmahendraiḥ | tāṃ kākinīṃ paraśivāṃ parameśapatnīṃ | saṃstaumi cāruhṛdayāmbujapīṭhamadhye || 59-1 || ekākinī trijagatāmatināśakāle | tvāṃ kākinīṃ samarakārṇā(ṇḍa)kakākapatnīm | tvaṃ sākṣiṇī bhuvanabhaṅgavidhau sakāste | bhūṣaṇḍakākamahiṣīva vayaṃ bhajāmaḥ || 59-2 || ekākinīṃ sakaladhāraṇakālayoge | ādhārya dehasamaye sati kākinīṃ tvām | vāyvāsane manasa āśu vikāranāśe | kākendracañcucalitāmahamevamīḍe || 59-3 || bhāvodaye praṇayinīmagatau ca bhāvā | āhlādayogavibhave bhuvaneśvarīṃ tvām | mandārahārarucire parameśvari tvaṃ | rakṣāṃ kuru prathamato matimāśrayāmi || 59-4 || candrodaye sukhamayī dyutikoṭidīptā | gopyāgame sumatibhiḥ svamanāṃsi śuddhā | sā tvaṃ sukhātvaṃ bhava bhāvavipūjanīye | rakṣāṃ kuru prathamabhāskaramaṅghiramīḍe || 59-5 || te pādapaṅkajamajasramahaṃ bhajāmi | sānandabindu vimalāsanabhāvapuñje | guñjāvaṭīvimalamālyasuśobhitāṅge | syāmeva me caramabhāvasamūhadātrī || 59-6 || pañcānane daśabhuje sakalāstrayukte | vidye bhaye narahare narahārabhūṣe | pretāsane trinayane jananī tvameva | rakṣe śubhe caraṇapaṅkajamāśrayāmi || 59-7 || śrī sundari praṇatarakṣiṇi vedamāta(--) | stāreśvarī tvamapi rakṣa vināśakāle | yadyekabhakta itihāsapurāṇavaktā | nityānuraktaharapādasarojamīḍe || 59-8 || te śrīpadaṃ bhuvanasāramanantasevyaṃ | yogāspadaṃ kṛtibhirāśrayamekayogam | sarve bhajanti nijamokṣaphalāya nityaṃ | dīno'hamamba bhuvaneśi mudā bhajāmi || 59-9 || trailokyapūjitapadaṃ hṛdayāmbujasthaṃ | cittaprakāśakamale svasukhānubhūtam | māyāśrayaṃ sakalasiddhinidānarūpaṃ | mañjīrahāravinataṃ varamāśrayāmi || 59-10 || kauṭīrahārakamalapriyamālyaśobhe | śobhākare sthiratarā bhava me hṛdabje | bhūmaṇḍale hi balavānkṛtakṛtya eva tvāmīśvarīṃ hṛdi mudā sukhamāśrayāmi || 59-11 || nitye purā bhajati yogasusiddhaye'sau | śambhugīrīśa iti ceśvarapārśvagāmi | sāyujyanāthapadavīṃ gata īśakānte | ekākinī kulavatāṅghirayugaṃ kimanyaiḥ || 59-12 || dhyāyanti yogina ihāghasamūhaśailaṃ | saṃhāra hetukasadāghavināśanāya | cittotsavāya vibhavāya jayāya bhūmeḥ | dīno'hamāśu vibhajāmi padaṃ śriye te || 59-13 || kṛṣṇe site vimalapītanibhe surakte | varṇāśraye tvamava māmatidīnamekam | putraṃ tavaiva caraṇāmbujameva kāntaṃ | nīlāmbuje sthirataraṃ kuru kāmadātri || 59-14 || sarveśvarī priyakari bhavabhāvahantri | nānā dhvanipraṇatakāmadughe vicitre | ratnāmbare sukhapadaṃ yadi dehi dāsyaṃ | tvaṃ cāruvarṇagalite padamāśrayāmi || 59-15 || ratnākare sakaruṇe'ruṇakoṭivarṇe | svarṇādinimītasṛjāpaviśobhitāṅgī | tvaṃ kākinī yadi kaṭākṣanipātamekaṃ | sarvaṃ kuruṣva sukhamokṣapathapramodī || 59-16 || ādye pravālavimale'malamālyaśobhe | sūkṣme'tisūkṣmanikare karuṇānidhāne | ( ka ) bāle vale pracale capale pralāpe | yogeśi pādakamalaṃ kulamāśrayāmi || 59-17 || ( kha ) tvaṃ ṣoḍaśī kharatarā kharakhaḍgahaste | khaḍgeśvarī prakharavākyamāthāḍhyavaktre | ma kharjūrahārarucire khalahantri tubhyaṃ | nityaṃ namo nama upendragirīndrasevye || 59-18 || ( ga ) gītānate tarutare praṇamāmi nityaṃ | gātreśvarī gatihare gaṇanāthasevye | gāyanti te caraṇapaṅkajasāragītaṃ | rakṣāpracaṇḍakaluṣādanupekṣaṇīyam || 59-19 || ( gha ) dīrghasvare ghanavare ghanaghoranāde | ghorānane navaghane ghaṭanāghanānām | ghorāspade ghaṭagate ghaṭaśūnyakatrī | tvaṃ kākinī samavatu kṣitidoṣajālāt || 59-20 || ( ṅa ) ānusvare smarahare nanu rūpavidye | saṃyoginīprabalaśatruvināśabhūte | rakṣe'tirakṣa karuṇāṃ kuru dehi mokṣaṃ | ( ca ) caṇḍi pracaṇḍanayane caraṇaṃ bhaje te || 59-21 || ( cha ) chatraprade chalahare chadavāsinī tvaṃ | chadmasthite hṛdayapaṅkajadakṣayoge | ( ja ) tvāṃ pūjaye jayadhare yadunāthajanyo | jāye jayaṃ yadiha dehi padaṃ bhajāmi || 59-22 || ( jha ) jhaṅke jhanajvalayatīha ripaṃ pibanti | tvaṃ kauśikī sakaladehaviśodhanī tvam | ( na ) nitye'nunāsikapade sakalārthade tvaṃ | ( ña ) rakṣāṃ kuruṣva vipade kulapuñjaguñje || 59-23 || ( ṭa ) ṭaṅkārage'ṭṭahasane ṭalale'ṭṭahāse | ( ṭha ) ṭhākkāriṇī saṭhaharā pariniṣṭhitā tvam | siṃheṣṭapṛṣṭhanilaye'sthirayogabhāvaṃ hṛtpadmake kuru sadā sakalārthadātri || 59-24 || etatstotraṃ paṭheddhīmān dhyānanyāsaparāyaṇaḥ | vibhāvya stauti yo yogī sa yogī mokṣabhāgbhavet || 59-25 || hṛtpaṅkaruhamadhyasthaṃ sa paśyati jagattrayam | aṣṭasiddhiyutaḥ śīghraṃ jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 59-26 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe kākinīstotravinyāso nāmonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 59 ||
[atha ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca vada kānte parānande rahasyaṃ kulasundari | yasya vijñānamātreṇa bhaved gaṅgādharo hariḥ || 60-1 || īśvarasya stavabrahmaparaṃ nirvāṇasādhanam | śobhākoṭiyogapateryogendrasya parāpateḥ || 60-2 || īśvaraṃ ke na mānanti brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | tasya smaraṇamātreṇa mahāvāggmī ca mṛtyujit || 60-3 || mantrī vedāntasiddhāntaṃ taṃ bhajanti maharṣayaḥ | devā manuṣyā gandharvāstaṃ bhajanti maheśvaram || 60-4 || akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvadā sarvatomukham | sadā tasya stavaṃ divyaṃ śrotumicchāmi śāṅkari || 60-5 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kaula tvaṃ śṛṇu śaṅkarapriyakaraṃ stotraṃ tadīśasya ca | śrīnāthāya namaḥ kuleśa paramaprāṇeśa tubhyaṃ mudā | sānandāya namo bhavāya pataye lokeśvarāyo oṃ namo | bhūteśāya gaṇādhipāya yataye śrīśūline te namaḥ || 60-6 || kāntāya praṇavāya yogapataye yogeśvarāyo oṃ namo | mahārāyākṣareśvarāya mahate nityāya nityaṃ namaḥ | svādhiṣṭhānavibhedakāya haraye mūlābjasambhedine | nābherambujabhedine hṛdayāmbhodbhadakāyoṃ namaḥ || 60-7 || kālāya praṇavāya māyavaśine nityaṃ namo bhāsvate | mokṣāya pramatheśvarāya kavaye khaṭvāṅgahastāya te | bhaktiśrīnidhaye mahendrakhacarāya māyāśrayāryo namo | vijñānāya śivāya sūkṣmagataye gūḍhāya bhūyo namaḥ || 60-8 || sarvajñāya jayāya bhūtipataye bhūteśvarāya prabho | pañcāsyāya harāya devapataye gaurīśvarāya śriye | bhogāyāntaragāmine hariharāyānandacidrūpiṇe | kalyāṇāya bhagāya śuddhamatibhinītyaṃ namaste namaḥ || 60-9 || govindapriyavallabhāya vidhaye brahmādikotpattaye | utpattisthitisaṃhṛtiprakṛtaye bāhyāya viśveśvara | tubhyaṃ kāla namo namaḥ pralayayogollāsine bhūbhṛte | vijñātāya girīndrapūjita vibho bhūtādhipāyāniśam || 60-10 || gaurīśāya gaṇācītāya manase mānyāya bhūvāsine | bhūtotsāhamahīśanāthaśaśicūḍāya pradhānāya te | nityaṃ nityakalākulāya phaṇicūḍāya prabuddhāya te | tejaḥśāntipate satāṃ patipate nirvāsase te namaḥ || 60-11 || śobhākoṭiyutāya candrakiraṇāhlādāya sūkṣmāya te tubhyaṃ nātha namo namaḥ praṇamatāmānandasindhūtsavā | heramba śrayakātīkeyajanakānandapriyāya prabho | pitre sarvasukhāya sarvapataye śrīnīlakaṇṭheśvara || 60-12 || tribrahmāpītabhūtaye surataye śrībhāsvate yoginā(--) mānandodayakāriṇe kulapate te nātha tubhyaṃ namaḥ | brahmānandakulāya raupyagiraye saundaryasaṃsiddhaye sarvānandakarāya samparatarāyāḍhyāya satyaṃ namaḥ || 60-13 || kāśīśaṃ kauśikīśaṃ suratarukiraṇaṃ kāraṇākhyaṃ sukhākhyaṃ | gaurīśaṃ gaṅgirīśaṃ gurumagurugiriśreṇiliptāṅgavaṅgam | ghoṣākhyaṃ mañjughoṣaṃ ghanagaṇaghaṭitaṃ ghorasaṅghaṭṭanādaṃ cārvīśaṃ rāghaveśaṃ ghanahṛdi ghaṭamāmīśvaraṃ ghauṭakeśa || 60-14 || lākṣābhāṇḍaṃ viśālo vasati tava kare sthāvaro jaṅgamo vā | bhūtādhyakṣo vaśiṣṭhaḥ svaparijanakule sarvadā pāhi śambho | bhaktijñānaṃ na dātuṃ capalamalamaṇiśreṇimālā vilolā | lokābhīto kalaṅkī vidhiśatamukuṭaśrīpadāmbhoruhaṃ te || 60-15 || dhūrtaḥ śauriḥ praśānto vimalamadhurasāmodamāno'pramatto | māyāmohāpadevī suramadamadano dānasammānadātā | tvaṃ nāthaṃ śrīpadāmbhoruhavimalatale te kathaṃ nā surakṣe | pūrvāsyo dakṣiṇāsyo dhanapativadanaḥ paścimāsyo munistvam || 60-16 || bhedī siddhāntavidyādharanidhikiraṇaḥ kāraṇo'nantaśakti(--) ryaḥ sākṣāt kāmadhenuḥ sa ca dhanapatipaḥ sarvabhogānurāgī | pādāmbhoje hi nityaṃ kalagirisutānātha te yogipatvaṃ | cittaṃ me cañcalākhyaṃ śaśidharakiraṇo vākpate yogasiddhiḥ || 60-17|| kapardī śrīkhaḍgāsivaragadayā vedabhujayā | ghanacchāyāsaṅkocaracanāvaśacchadmavijayaḥ | jayī jetā jāyerjayamanukarotu śriyatamo | jvalajjhaṃjhāvāte kṣaṇadhara iha krodha iti me || 60-18 || athā''jñā cakrāntargatavivaramācchannajaṭilaḥ | pratijñābhaṅgasthakaṭakaśatakoṭiprakaṭitaḥ | kuṭhāraste krodhī kamaṭhakaṭavāsī kaṭhinahā | kakārādyaṃ natvā daśakiraṇamāno'vatu sadā || 60-19 || sudhākhaṇḍādevyāḥ stavanapaṭhanena priyakaraṃ | padāmbhojaṃ ceti pracayati svabhāgyaṃ kulapate | pradhāne bhūkhaṇḍe jayati yadi mṛtyuñjayapadaṃ | vinodaṃ bhūyogaṃ pacati sahasā premataralaḥ || 60-20 || yadyevaṃ prapaṭhedidamaniyataṃ kaulāvalīsaṃyutaṃ | stotraṃ sārarahasyabhāraparamānandaikacittasthalam | yogīndrāvagatitvamuktaphaladaṃ sarveśvaratvaṃ padaṃ | candrādityasamāgataṃ parapadāhlādaikamātraṃ labhet || 60-21 || te śambho yadi pādāmbhoruhamaṅgalavallikā | pūjyate sarvadā yogī nirvāṇaguṇasiddhaye || 60-22 || kinna siddhayati bhrūmadhye śivabhaktiprasādataḥ || 60-23 ||
iti śrī rudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane anāhata padme surastavanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 60 ||
[athaikaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca vada kalyāṇi kāmeśi trailokyaparipūjite | brahmāṇḍānantanilaye kailāsaśikharojjvale || 61-1 || kālike kālarātristhe mahākālaniṣevite | śabdabrahmasvarūpe tvaṃ vaktumarhasi sādarāt || 61-2 || sahasranāmayogākhyam aṣṭottaramanantaram | anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍaṃ sāraṃ paramamaṅgalam || 61-3 || jñānasiddhikaraṃ sākṣād atyantānandavardhanam | saṅketaśabdamokṣārthaṃ kākinīśvarasaṃyutam || 61-4 || parānandakaraṃ brahma nirvāṇapadalālitam | snehādabhisukhānandādādau brahma varānane || 61-5 || icchāmi sarvadā mātarjagatāṃ surasundari | snehānandarasodrekasambandhān kathaya drutam || 61-6 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca īśvara śrīnīlakaṇṭha nāgamālāvibhūṣita | nāgendracitramālāḍhya nāgādhiparameśvara || 61-7 || kākinīśvarayogāḍhyaṃ sahasranāma maṅgalam | aṣṭottaraṃ vṛtākāraṃ koṭisaudāminīprabham || 61-8 || āyurārogyajananaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama | anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍasāraṃ nityaṃ parātparam || 61-9 || sādhanaṃ brahmaṇo jñānaṃ yogānāṃ yogasādhanam | sārvajñaguhyasaṃskāraṃ saṃskārādiphalapradam || 61-10 || vāñchāsiddhikaraṃ sākṣānmahāpātakanāśanam | mahādāridryaśamanaṃ mahaiśvaryapradāyakam || 61-11 || japedyaḥ prātari prīto madhyāhne'stamite ravau | namaskṛtya japennāma dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ || 61-12 || kākinīśvarasaṃyogaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānaguṇodayam | ādau dhyānaṃ samācarya nirmalo'malacetasā || 61-13 || dhyāyed devīṃ mahākālīṃ kākinīṃ kālarūpiṇīm | parānandarasonmattāṃ śyāmāṃ kāmadughāṃ parām || 61-14 || caturbhujāṃ khaḍgacarmavarapadmadharāṃ harām | śatrukṣayakarīṃ ratnā'laṅkārakoṭimaṇḍitām || 61-15 || taruṇānandarasikāṃ pītavastrāṃ manoramām | keyūrahāralalitāṃ tāṭaṅkadvayaśobhitām || 61-16 || īśvarīṃ kāmaratnākhyāṃ kākacañcupuṭānanām | sundarīṃ vanamālāḍhyāṃ cārusiṃhāsanasthitām || 61-17 || hṛtpadmakaṇīkāmadhyākāśasaudāminīprabhām | evaṃ dhyātvā paṭhennāmamaṅgalāni punaḥ punaḥ || 61-18 || īśvaraṃ koṭisūryābhaṃ dhyāyeddhṛdayamaṇḍale | caturbhujaṃ vīrarūpaṃ lāvaṇyaṃ bhāvasambhavam || 61-19 || śyāmaṃ hiraṇyabhūṣāṅgaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam | abhayaṃ varadaṃ padmaṃ mahākhaḍgadharaṃ vibhum || 61-20 || kirīṭinaṃ mahākāyaṃ smitahāsyaṃ prakāśakam | hṛdayāmbujamadhyasthaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam || 61-21 || koṭikālānalaṃ dīptaṃ kākinīdakṣiṇasthitam | evaṃ vicintya manasā yoginaṃ parameśvaram || 61-22 || tataḥ paṭhet sahasrākhyaṃ vadāmi śṛṇu tatprabho || 61-23 || asya śrīkākinīśvarasahasranāmastotrasya brahmāṛṣirgāyatrīcchando jagadīśvara kākinī devatā nirvāṇayogārtha siddhayarthe jape viniyogaḥ | oṃ īśvaraḥ kākinīśāna īśāna kamaleśvarī | īśaḥ kākeśvarīśānī īśvarīśaḥ kuleśvarī || 61-24 || īśamokṣaḥ kāmadhenuḥ kapardīśaḥ kapadīnī | kaulaḥ kulīnāntaragā kaviḥ kāvyaprakāśinī || 61-25 || kalādeśaḥ sukavitā kāraṇaḥ karuṇāmayī | kañjapatrekṣaṇaḥ kālī kāmaḥ kolāvalīśvarī || 61-26 || kirātarūpī kaivalyā kiraṇaḥ kāmanāśanā | kārṇāṭeśaḥ sakarṇāṭī kalikaḥ kālikāpuṭā || 61-27 || kiśoraḥ kīśunamitā keśaveśaḥ kuleśvarī | keśakiñjalkakuṭilaḥ kāmarājakutūhalā || 61-28 || karakoṭidharaḥ kūṭā kriyākrūraḥ kriyāvatī | kumbhahā kumbhahantrī ca kaṭakacchakalāvatī || 61-29 || kañjavaktraḥ kālamukhī koṭisūryakarānanā | kamraḥ kalapaḥ samṛddhisthā kupo'ntasthaḥ kulācalā || 61-30 || kuṇapaḥ kaulapākāśā svakāntaḥ kāmavāsinī | sukṛtiḥ śāṅkarī vidyā kalakaḥ kalanāśrayā || 61-31 || karkandhusthaḥ kaulakanyā kulīnaḥ kanyakākulā | kumāraḥ keśarī vidyā kāmahā kulapaṇḍitā || 61-32 || kalkīśaḥ kamanīyāṅgī kuśalaḥ kuśalāvatī | ketakīpuṣpamālāḍhyaḥ ketakīkusumānvitā || 61-33 || kusumānandamālāḍhyaḥ kusumāmalamālikā | kavīndraḥ kāvyasambhūtaḥ kāmamañjīrarañjinī || 61-34 || kuśāsanasthaḥ kauśalyākulapaḥ kalpapādapā | kalpavṛkṣaḥ kalpalatā vikalpaḥ kalpagāminī || 61-35 || kaṭhorasthaḥ kācanibhā karālaḥ kālavāsinī | kālakūṭāśrayānandaḥ karkaśākāśavāhinī || 61-36 || kaṭadhūmākṛticchāyo vikaṭāsanasaṃsthitā | kāyadhārī kūpakarī karavīrāgataḥ kṛṣī || 61-37 || kālagambhīranādāntā vikalālāpamānasā | prakṛtīśaḥ satprakṛtiḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ kaṣīṇīśvarī || 61-38 || bhagavān vāruṇīvarṇā vivarṇo varṇarūpiṇī | suvarṇavarṇo hemābho mahān mahendrapūjitā || 61-39 || mahātmā mahatīśānī meheśo mattagāminī | mahāvīro mahāvegā mahālakṣmīśvaro matiḥ || 61-40 || mahādevo mahādevī mahānando mahākalā | mahākālo mahākālī mahābalo mahābalā || 61-41 || mahāmānyo mahāmānyā mahādhanyo mahādhanī | mahāmālo mahāmālā mahākāśo mahākāśā || 61-42 || mahāyaśo mahāyajñā mahārājo mahārajā | mahāvidyo mahāvidyā mahāmukhyo mahāmakhī || 61-43 || mahārātro mahārātrirmahādhīro mahāśayā | mahākṣetro mahākṣetrā kurukṣetraḥ kurupriyā || 61-44 || mahācaṇḍo mahogrā ca mahāmatto mahāmatiḥ | mahāvedo mahāvedā mahotsāho mahotsavā || 61-45 || mahākalpo mahākalpā mahāyogo mahāgatiḥ | mahābhadro mahābhadrā mahāsūkṣmo mahācalā || 61-46 || mahāvākyo mahāvāṇī mahāyajvā mahājavā | mahāmūtīrmahākāntā mahādharmo mahādhanā || 61-47 || mahāmahogro mahiṣī mahābhogyo mahāprabhā | mahākṣemo mahāmāyā mahāmāyā mahāramā || 61-48 || mahendrapūjitā mātā vibhālo maṇḍaleśvarī | mahāvikālo vikalā pratalasthalalāmagā || 61-49 || kaivalyadātā kaivalyā kautukastho vikaṣīṇī | vālāpratirvālapatnī balarāmo valāṅgajā || 61-50 || avaleśaḥ kāmavīrā prāṇeśaḥ prāṇarakṣiṇī | pañcamācāragaḥ pañcāpañcamaḥ pañcamīśvarī || 61-51 || prapañcaḥ pañcarasagā niṣprapañcaḥ kṛpāmayī | kāmarūpī kāmarūpā kāmakrodhavivajītā || 61-52 || kāmātmā kāmanilayā kāmākhyā kāmacañcalā | kāmapuṣpadharaḥ kāmā kāmeśaḥ kāmapuṣpiṇī || 61-53 || mahāmudrādharo mudrā sanmudraḥ kāmamudrikā | candrārdhakṛtabhālābho vidhukoṭimukhāmbujā || 61-54 || candrakoṭiprabhādhārī candrajyotiḥsvarūpiṇī | sūryābho vīrakiraṇā sūryakoṭivibhāvitā || 61-55 || mihireśo mānavakā antarggāmī nirāśrayā | prajāpatīśaḥ kalyāṇī dakṣeśaḥ kularohiṇī || 61-56 || apracetāḥ pracetasthā vyāseśo vyāsapūjitā | kāśyapeśaḥ kāśyapeśī bhṛgvīśo bhārgaveśvarī || 61-57 || vaśiṣṭhaḥ priyabhāvastho vaśiṣṭhabādhitāparā | pulastyapūjito devaḥ pulastyacittasaṃsthitā || 61-58 || agastyārcyo'gastyamātā prahlādeśo valīśvarī | kardameśaḥ kardamādyā bālako bālapūjitā || 61-59 || manasthaścāntarikṣasthā śabdajñānī sarasvatī | rūpātītā rūpaśūnyā virūpo rūpamohinī || 61-60 || vidyādhareśo vidyeśī vṛṣastho vṛṣavāhinī | rasajño rasikānandā viraso rasavajītā || 61-61 || saunaḥ sanatkumāreśī yogacaryeśvaraḥ priyā | durvāśāḥ prāṇanilayaḥ sāṅkhyayogasamudbhavā || 61-62 || asaṅkhyeyo māṃsabhakṣā sumāṃsāśī manoramā | naramāṃsavibhoktā ca naramāṃsavinodinī || 61-63 || mīnavaktrapriyo mīnā mīnabhuṅmīnabhakṣiṇī | rohitāśī matsyagandhā matsyanātho rasāpahā || 61-64 || pārvatīpremanikaro vidhidevādhipūjitā | vidhātṛvarado vedyā vedo pradhānamāṃsabhakṣiṇī || 61-202 || matsyamāṃsamahāmudrā rajorudhirabhukpriyā | surāmaṃsamahāmīnamudrāmaithunasupriyā || 61-203 || kuladravyapriyānando madyādikulasiddhidā | hṛtkaṇṭhabhrūsahasrārabhedano'nte vibhedinī || 61-204 || prasannahṛdayāmbhojaḥ prasannahṛdayāmbujā | prasannavaradānāḍhyaḥ prasannavaradāyinī || 61-205 || premabhaktiprakāśāḍhyaḥ premānandaprakāśinī
