|| 61-206 || prabhākaraphalodayaḥ paramasūkṣmapurapriyā | prabhātaraviraśmigaḥ prathamabhānuśobhānvitā | pracaṇḍaripumanmathaḥ pracalitendudehodgataḥ | prabhāpaṭalapāṭalapracayadharmapuñjācītā || 61-207 || surendragaṇapūjitaḥ suravareśasampūjitā | surendrakula sevito narapatīndrasaṃsevitā | gaṇendra gaṇanāyako gaṇapatīndra devātmajā | bhavārṇavagatārako jaladhikarṇadhārapriyā || 61-208 || surāsurakulodbhavaḥ suraripuprasiddhisthitā | surārigaṇaghātakaḥ suragaṇendrasaṃsiddhidā | abhīpsitaphalapradaḥ suravarādisiddhipradā | priyāṅgaja kulārthadaḥ sutadhanāpavargapradā || 61-209 || śivasvaśivakākinī haraharā ca bhīmasvanā | kṣitīśa iṣurakṣakā samanadarpahantodayā | guṇeśvara umāpatī hṛdayapadmabhedī gatiḥ | kṣapākaralalāṭadhṛk svasukhamārgasandāyinī || 61-210 || śmaśānataṭaniṣpaṭa pracaṭahāsakālaṅkṛtā | haṭhatśaṭhamanastaṭe surakapāṭasaṃchedakaḥ | smarānanavivardhanaḥ priyavasantasambāyavī | virājitamukhāmbujaḥ kamalamañjasiṃhāsanā || 61-211 || bhavo bhavapatiprabhābhavaḥ kaviśca bhāvyāsuraiḥ | kriyeśvara īlāvatī taruṇagāhitārāvatī | munīndramanusiddhidaḥ suramunīndrasiddhāyuṣī | murāriharadehagastribhuvanā vināśakriyā || 61-212 || dvikaḥ kanakakākinī kanakatuṅgakīlālakaḥ | kamalākulaḥ kulakalārkamālāmalā | subhakta tamasādhakaprakṛtiyogayogyācīto | vivekagatamānasaḥ prabhuparādihastācītā || 61-213 || tvameva kulanāyakaḥ pralayayogavidyeśvarī | pracaṇḍagaṇago nagābhuvanadarpahārī harā | carācarasahasragaḥ sakalarūpamadhyasthitaḥ | svanāmaguṇapūrakaḥ svaguṇanāmasampūraṇī || 61-214 || iti te kathitaṃ nātha sahasranāma maṅgalam | atyadbhutaṃ parānandarasasiddhāntadāyakam || 61-215 || mātṛkāmantraghaṭitaṃ sarvasiddhāntasāgaram | siddhavidyāmahollāsa mānandaguṇasādhanam || 61-216 || durlabhaṃ sarvalokeṣu yāmale tatprakāśitam | tava sneharasāmodamohitānandabhairava || 61-217 || kutrāpi nāpi kathitaṃ svasiddha hāniśaṅkayā | sarvādiyoga siddhāntasiddhaye bhuktimuktaye || 61-218 || premāhlādarasenaiva durlabhaṃ tatprakāśitam | yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavedchrībhairaveśvaraḥ || 61-219 || etannāma śubhaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na ca samarthakaḥ | koṭivarṣaśatenāpi yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 61-220 || tatphalaṃ yogināmeka kṣaṇāllabhyaṃ bhavārṇave | yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya durgagrahanivaraṇāt || 61-221 || duṣṭendriyabhayenāpi mahābhayanivāraṇāt | dhyātvā nāma japennityaṃ madhyāhne ca viśeṣataḥ || 61-222 || sandhyāyāṃ rātriyoge ca sādhayennāmasādhanam | yogābhyāse granthibhede yogadhyānanirūpaṇe || 61-223 || paṭhanād yogasiddhiḥ syād granthibhedo dine dine | yogajñānaprasiddhiḥ syād yogaḥ syādekacittataḥ || 61-224 || dehastha devavaśyāya mahāmohapraśāntaye | stambhanāyārisainyānāṃ pratyahaṃ prapaṭhecchuciḥ || 61-225 || bhaktibhāvena pāṭhena sarvakarmasu sukṣamaḥ | stambhayet parasainyāni vāraikapāṭhamātrataḥ || 61-226 || vāratrayaprapaṭhanād vaśayed bhuvanatrayam | vāratrayaṃ tu prapaṭhed yo mūrkhaḥ paṇḍito'pi vā || 61-227 || śāntimāpnoti paramāṃ vidyāṃ bhuvanamohinīm | pratiṣṭhāñca tataḥ prāpya mokṣanirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 61-228 || vināśayedarīñchīghraṃ caturvāraprapāṭhane | pañcāvṛttiprapāṭhena śatrumuccāṭayet kṣaṇāt || 61-229 || ṣaḍāvṛtyā sādhakendraḥ śatrūṇāṃ nāśako bhavet | ākarṣayet paradravyaṃ saptavāraṃ paṭhed yadi || 61-230 || evaṃ kramagataṃ dhyātvā yaḥ paṭhedatibhaktitaḥ | sa bhaved yoginīnātho mahākalpadrumopamaḥ || 61-231 || granthibhedasamarthaḥ syānmāsamātraṃ paṭhed yadi | dūradarśī mahāvīro balavān paṇḍiteśvaraḥ || 61-232 || mahājñānī lokanātho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | māsaikena samarthaḥ syānnirvāṇamokṣasiddhibhāk || 61-233 || prapaṭhed yogasiddhyarthaṃ bhāvakaḥ paramapriyaḥ | śūnyāgāre bhūmigartamaṇḍape śūnyadeśake || 61-234 || gaṅgāgarbhe mahāraṇye caikānte nirjane'pi vā | dubhīkṣavajīte deśe sarvopadravavajīte || 61-235 || śmaśāne prāntare'śvatthamūle vaṭatarusthale | iṣṭakāmayagehe vā yatra loko na vartate || 61-236 || tatra tatrānandarūpī mahāpīṭhasthale'pi ca | dṛḍhāsanasthaḥ prajapennāmamaṅgalamuttamam || 61-237 || dhyānadhāraṇaśuddhāṅgo nyāsapūjāparāyaṇaḥ | dhyātvā stauti prabhāte ca mṛtyujetā bhaved dhruvam || 61-238 || aṣṭāṅgasiddhimāpnoti cāmaratvamavāpnuyāt | gurudevamahāmantrabhakto bhavati niścitam || 61-239 || śarīre tasya duḥkhāni na bhavanti kuvṛddhayaḥ | duṣṭagrahāḥ palāyante taṃ dṛṣṭvā yoginaṃ param || 61-240 || yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ mantrī tasya haste'ṣṭasiddhayaḥ | tasya hṛtpadmaliṅgasthā devāḥ siddhyanti cāparāḥ || 61-241 || yugakoṭisahasrāṇi cirāyuryogirāḍ bhavet | śuddhaśīlo nirākāro brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ sa ca | sa nityaḥ kāryasiddhaśca sa jīvanmuktimāpnuyāt || 61-242 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane īśvaraśaktikākinyaṣṭottara(--) sahasranāmastotravinyāso nāma ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 61 ||
[atha dviṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca atha nātha pravakṣye'haṃ kākinīgurudevayoḥ | mantroddhārastava jñānaṃ yena siddho bhaved yatiḥ || 62-1 || etatstavanapāṭhena sahasrākhyāntasiddhiṣu | rājatvaṃ labhate sadyo'thavā yogī ca sampadi || 62-2 || yathā janakarājā ca viṣaye gurubhaktimān | mahāsiddho mahājñānī tathā bhavati sādhakaḥ || 62-3 || surā nāgā rudragaṇāḥ sarve vidyārthasevakāḥ | yogī jñānī tathā siddhāḥ khecarā yakṣarākṣasāḥ || 62-4 || munayaḥ krodhavetālāstathā caṇḍeśvarādayaḥ | etacchubhastavendreṇa stutvā sarvatra siddhigāḥ || 62-5 || pūrṇaḥ pūrṇendubimbānanakamalakaṭākṣādaghaughāpahārī | nārīndhātā vidhātā samavati na ca tān yogayogyān mahendrān | sampattiprāṇayogī niravadhivaradānandagoptā śarīro | bālo mṛtyuñjayasya prabhuriti bhayahā pātu me guptadeham || 62-6 || kāmakrodhāpahantā janayati bharatān bhāratān pātu pṛthvīṃ | yo yogī bhāvayogī mama kulaphaladaḥ sarvadā śaṃ karotu | tatkroḍe lokacakraṃ tilatulatulasesannibhaṃ bhāti sūkṣmaṃ | tacchrīnāthāṅghrapādadvayamajaramahaṃ bhāvaye hṛtprapañce || 62-7 || māyāṃ mohe vivekī śata(--)kitava(--)ripūcchedakaḥ prerakastha(--) | korṣāṇī guptatandrāvanibhavamanujo yo mahāmaṅgalasthaḥ | lokātīto titīro jaya jaya karuṇānātha dātā tapasvī | mantroddhārārthaguptaṃ samavati ya iha prāṇanāthaṃ tamīḍe || 62-8 || bhāvānto yo'tigurvī hṛdi jayakamale'te'marapratyatharvo | vāgdevī devatāyai nama iti manunā mohito vākpatīśaḥ | mantrārthoddīpanākhyo vijayasakhākoṭibhirveṣṭito yo | bālārkānandaraśmipracayaśatamakhaḥ pātu māṃ duḥkhajālāt || 62-9 || hṛṣṭāṅgā saṅgatāṅgānanavimalaśikhākoṭibhirvajīto yo | mantrāccaitanyahartā praṇavamayaśivaṃ tatsadānte śivaṃ ca | dhyātvā māheśvarāyāṃ nama iti japanāt te mahendrādhipaḥ syāt | kālīputraḥ sa eva tvamabhayavaradaḥ sevyate yaiḥ sa muktaḥ || 62-10 || haṃsaḥ prāṇāvihantā tvamakhilavaradastvaṃ nidānaḥ pradhānaḥ | śāntīśastvaṃ pratiṣṭhaḥ praṇavaśivasadābhadramāheśvarāya | ante'tyuccairnamo'nte manumiha japate sampade doṣabhaṅgā(--) | dānandābdhau tvamīśo gururiha capalaṃ cāpalaṃ māṃ prapāhi || 62-11 || ānandodrekakārī tvamapi sakaruṇāsāgaro bhaktidātā | dātā vidyādharīṇāṃ tvamapi suraripuḥ pārvatīprāṇanāthaḥ | tāre bindvādharāḍhyaṃ kṣaramathavidhumattaṃ mantramekākṣaraṃ te | tārāntaṃ tryakṣarantaṃ prajapati yadi yo yogirāḍ bhūtale syāt || 62-12 || sarpāṇḍasthaṃ susiddho haravidhumadharaṃ candrabindusvarūpaṃ | japtvā nityaṃ vilomaṃ praṇavamṛtiharaṃ vahnikāntā tadante | etadrūpaṃ padaṃ yo bhajati varagataṃ hemamañjīranādaṃ | mamrekṣānandacittaṃ vijayavarakulānandadaḥ prāṇagaṃ te || 62-13 || uccāṭe mohane vāpyarivaśasamaye śāntipuṣṭyāntavaśye | te mantrān yojayitvā japati yadi sudhīḥ śrīpadābjāvalambī | sidhyet ṣaṭkarmasāraṃ paramagurugataḥ sa bhavet kalpaśākhī | rājendraḥ sarvaloke dhanapatisadṛśaḥ śambhunāthaprasādāt || 62-14 || khāntaṃ śakrādirūḍhaṃ vidhunayanayutaṃ kāmabījaṃ triśaktiṃ | cādye'nte oṃ śivāyānalavadhumilitaṃ yo japennāthamantram | tenāmnāyo japitvā kulapathanirataḥ sādhakaḥ śrīvareṇyaḥ | kiṃ tasyāsādhyasiddhiṃ trijagati sa sukhī sanmukhī yogamārgī || 62-15 || sarvātīto vihārī padagatirahitaḥ sarvagāmī virāmī | hastābhāvo vinetā niravadhivaradaḥ sarvarūpī virūpī | mantrajñastvaṃ sumantrī mahamayasamayaḥ saṃśayāsārahantā | mantā viśveśvarīṇāṃ parapaśupataye'nte namaḥ pātu namram || 62-16 || yogī bhogī virāgī tvamatulavibhavaḥ sambhavaḥ pañcacūḍo | vāṇī śeṣaḥ priyeśaḥ śaśigrathitamṛḍāśobhitāṅgo hyanaṅgaḥ | kāmo māyā rameśaḥ prathamadinakaraśreṇi śobhāvaliptaḥ | sarvāṅgaṃ yaḥ prapāyādamalakamalagaḥ krodhago yo'valokam || 62-17 || etacchrīśaṅkarastotraṃ yaḥ paṭhenniyataḥ śuciḥ | saṃvatsarād bhavet siddhiḥ sarvajñānapradāyinī || 62-18 || śucau vāpyaśucau stauti bhaktyā yaḥ sādhakottamaḥ | sa sarvayātanāmukto yogī granthivibhedakaḥ || 62-19 || akasmāt siddhimāpnoti premānandasubhaktidām | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ cāsya puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 62-20 || na snānaṃ na japaḥ kāryaṃ na pūjādividhānakam | kevalaṃ stavapāṭhenānāhate susthiro bhavet || 62-21 || cirañjīvī vītarāgo vītasaṃsārabhāvanaḥ | paṭhitvā dhārayitvā ca yogabhraṣṭo na sambhavet | anāyāse yogasiddhiṃ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam || 62-22 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde īśvarastotravinyāso nāma dviṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 62 ||
[atha triṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairavī uvāca kavacaṃ śṛṇu cāsyaiva lokanātha śivāpate | īśvarasya paraṃ brahma nirvāṇayogadāyakam || 63-1 || kavacaṃ durlabhaṃ loke nāmasammohanaṃ param | kavacaṃ dhyānamātreṇa nirvāṇaphalabhāgbhavet || 63-2 || asya kiṃ (pu)tvatramāhātmyaṃ tathāpi tadvadāmyaham | kevalaṃ granthibhedāya nijadehānurakṣaṇāt || 63-3 || sarveṣāmapi yogendra devānāṃ yogināṃ tathā | bhāvādi siddhilābhāya kāyanirmalasiddhaye || 63-4 || prakāśitaṃ mahākāla tava snehavaśādapi | sarve mantrāḥ prasiddhyanti sammohakavacāśrayāḥ || 63-5 || kavacasya ṛṣirbrahmā chando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam | īśvaro devatā prokta stathā śaktiśca kākinī || 63-6 || kīlakaṃ krūṃ tathā jñeyaṃ dhyānasādhanasiddhaye | hṛdabjabhedanārthe tu viniyogaḥ prakītītaḥ || 63-7 || etacchrīsammohanamahākavacasya brahmā ṛṣiranuṣṭup chanda īśvaro devatā kākinī śaktiḥ krūṃ kīlakaṃ dhyānasādhanasiddhaye hṛdabjabhedārthe jape viniyogaḥ | praṇavo me pātu śīrṣaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca sadāśivaḥ | prāsādo hṛdayaṃ pātu bāhuyugmaṃ maheśvaraḥ || 63-8 || pṛṣṭhaṃ pātu mahādeva udaraṃ kāmanāśanaḥ | pārśvau pātu kāmarājo bālaḥ pṛṣṭhatalāntaram || 63-9 || kukṣimūlaṃ mahāvīro lalitāpatirīśvaraḥ | mṛtyuñjayo nīlakaṇṭho liṅgadeśaṃ sadāvatu || 63-10 || liṅgādho mudrikā pātu pādayugmamumāpitaḥ | aṅguṣṭhaṃ pātu satataṃ pārvatīprāṇavallabhaḥ || 63-11 || gulphaṃ pātu trayambakaśca jānunī yuvatīpatiḥ | ūrumūlaṃ sadā pātu mañjughoṣaḥ sanātanaḥ || 63-12 || simanī deśamāpātu bhairavaḥ krodhabhairavaḥ | liṅgadeśodgamaṃ pātu liṅgarūpī jagatpatiḥ || 63-13 || hṛdayāgraṃ sadā pātu maheśaḥ kākinīśvaraḥ | grīvāṃ pātu vṛṣasthaśca kaṇṭhadeśaṃ digambaraḥ || 63-14 || lambikāṃ pātu gaṇapo nāsikāṃ bhavanāśakaḥ | bhrūmadhyaṃ pātu yogīndraḥ maheśaḥ pātu mastakam || 63-15 || rmūghnideśaṃ munīndraśca dvādaśastho maheśvaraḥ | dvādaśāmbhoruhaṃ pātu kākinīprāṇavallabhaḥ || 63-16 || nābhimūlāmbujaṃ pātu mahārudro jaganmayaḥ | svādhiṣṭhānāmbujaṃ pātu sadā hariharātmakaḥ || 63-17 || mūlapadmaṃ sadā pātu brahmendro ḍākinīśvaraḥ | kuṇḍalīṃ sarvadā pātu ḍākinī yoginīśvaraḥ || 63-18 || kuṇḍalī mātṛkā pātu vaṭukeśaḥ śivo(ro?) haraḥ | rākiṇīvigrahaṃ pātu vāmadevo maheśvaraḥ || 63-19 || pañcānanaḥ sadā pātu lākinīvajravigraham | svasthānaṃ dvādaśārañca vīraḥ pātu sukākinīm || 63-20 || vīrendraḥ kaṇīkāṃ pātu dvādaśāraṃ viṣāśanaḥ | ṣoḍaśāraṃ sadā pātu krodhavīraḥ sadāśivaḥ || 63-21 || māṃ pātu vajranātheśo'ribhayāt krodhabhairavaḥ | ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvadā pātu lākinīśrīsadāśivaḥ || 63-22 || { ṣoḍaśāmbhoruhāntasthaṃ pātu dhūmrākṣapālakaḥ | diṅnātheśo mahākāyo māṃ pātu parameśvaraḥ } | ākāśagaṅgājaṭilo dvidalaṃ pātu me param | gaṅgādharaḥ sadā pātu hākinīṃ parameśvaraḥ || 63-23 || hākinī paraśivo me bhūrapadmaṃ parirakṣatu | daṇḍapāṇīśvaraḥ pātu manorūpaṃ dvipatrakam || 63-24 || sādhukeśaḥ sadā pātu manonmanyādivāsinam | piṅgākṣeśaḥ sadā pātu bhayabhūmau tanūṃ mama || 63-25 || unmanī sthānakaṃ pātu rodhinīsahitaṃ mama | sudhāghaṭaḥ sadā pātu mamānandādidevatām || 63-26 || ānandabhairavaḥ pātu gūḍhadeśādhidevatām | māyāmayopahā pātu suṣumnānāḍikākalām || 63-27 || iḍākalādharaṃ pātu koṭisūryaprabhākaraḥ | piṅgalāmihiraṃ pātu candraśekhara īśvaraḥ || 63-28 || koṭikālānalasthānaṃ suṣumnāyāṃ sadāvatu | sudhāsamudro māṃ pātu ratnakoṭimaṇīśvaraḥ || 63-29 || śivanāthaḥ sadā pātu kuṇḍalīcakrameva me | viṣṇucakraṃ mahādevaḥ kālarātraḥ kulānvitam || 63-30 || mṛtyujetā sadā pātu sahasrāraṃ sadā mama | sahasradalagaṃ śambhuṃ svayambhūḥ pātu sarvadā || 63-31 || sarva rūpiṇamīśānaṃ pātu śarvo hi sarvadā | sarvatra sarvadā pātu śrīnīlakaṇṭha īśvaraḥ || 63-32 || sarvabījasvarūpo me bījamālāṃ sadāvatu | mātṛkāṃ sarvabījeśo mātṛkārṇaṃ śivo mama || 63-33 || ahaṅkāraṃ haraḥ pātu karamālāṃ sadā mama | jale'raṇye mahābhītau parvate śūnyamaṇḍape || 63-34 || vyāghrabhallūkamahiṣapaśvādibhayadūṣite | mahāraṇye ghorayuddhe gagane bhūtale'tale || 63-35 || atyutkaṭe śastraghāte śatrucaurādibhītiṣu | mahāsiṃhabhaye krūre mattahastibhaye tathā || 63-36 || grahavyādhimahābhītau sarpabhītau ca sarvadā | piśācabhūtavetālabrahmadaityabhayādiṣu || 63-37 || apavādā pavādeṣu mithyāvādeṣu sarvadā | karālakālikānāthaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ prakharaḥ paraḥ || 63-38 || ugraḥ kapardī bhīdaṃṣṭrī kālācchannakaraḥ kaviḥ | krodhācchanno mahonmatto garuḍīśo maheśabhṛta || 63-39 || pañcānanaḥ pañcaraśmiḥ pāvanaḥ pāvamānakaḥ | śikhā mātrāmahāmudrādhārakaḥ krodhabhūpatiḥ || 63-40 || drāvakaḥ pūrakaḥ puṣṭaḥ poṣakaḥ pāribhāṣikaḥ | ete pāntu mahārudrā dvāviṃśatimahābhaye || 63-41 || ete sarve śaktiyuktā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāḥ | ahaṅkāreśvarāḥ kruddhā yoginastattvacintakāḥ || 63-42 || caturbhujā mahāvīrāḥ khaḍgakheṭakadhārakāḥ | kapālaśaṅkhamālāḍhyā nānāratnavibhūṣitāḥ || 63-43 || kikiṃṇījālamālāḍhyā hemanūpurarājitāḥ | nānālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyāścandracūḍāvibhūṣitāḥ || 63-44 || sadānandayutāḥ śrīdā mokṣadāḥ karmayoginām | sarvadā bhagavān pātu īśvarāḥ pāntu nityaśaḥ || 63-45 || brahmā pātu mūlapadmaṃ śrīviṣṇuḥ pātu ṣaḍdalam | rudraḥ pātu daśadalamīśvaraḥ pātvanāhatam || 63-46 || sadāśivaḥ pātu nityaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ sadā mama | paro dvidalamāpātu ṣaṭśivāḥ pāntu nityaśaḥ || 63-47 || aparāḥ pāntu satataṃ mama dehaṃ kuleśvarāḥ | pūrṇaṃ brahma sadā pātu sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadevatāḥ || 63-48 || kālarūpī sadā pātu manorūpī śiro mama | ātmalīnaḥ sadā pātu lalāṭaṃ vedavitprabhuḥ || 63-49 || vārāṇasīśvaraḥ pātu mama bhrūmadhyapīṭhakam | yogināthaḥ sadā pātu mama dantāvaliṃ dṛḍham || 63-50 || oṣṭhādharau sadā pātu jhilṭīśo bhautikeśvaraḥ | nāsāpuṭadvayaṃ pātu bhārabhūtīśo'tithīśvaraḥ || 63-51 || gaṇḍayugmaṃ sadā pātu sthāṇukeśo hareśvaraḥ | karṇadeśaṃ sadā pātu amaro'rdhīśvaro mama || 63-52 || mahāseneśvarastuṇḍaṃ mama pātu nirantaram | śrīkaṇṭhādimahārudrāḥ svāṅgagranthiṣu mātṛkāḥ || 63-53 || māṃ pātu kālarudraśca sarvāṃṅga kālasaṃkṣayaḥ | akāla tārakaḥ pātu udaraṃ paripūrakaḥ || 63-54 || agastyādimuniśreṣṭhāḥ pāntu yogina īśvarāḥ | śrīnātheśvara īśānaḥ pātu me sūkṣmanāḍikāḥ || 63-55 || triśūlī pātu pūrvasyāṃ dakṣiṇe mṛtyunāśanaḥ | paścime vāruṇīmatto mahākālaḥ sadā'vatu || 63-56 || uttare cāvadhūteśo bhairavaḥ kālabhairavaḥ | īśāne pātu śāntīśo vāyavyāṃ yogivallabhaḥ || 63-57 || marutkoṇe daityahantā pātu māṃ satataṃ śivaḥ | vahnikoṇe sadā pātu kālānalamukhāmbujaḥ || 63-58 || ūrdhvaṃ brahmā sadā pātu adho'nantaḥ sadā'vatu | sarvadevaḥ sadā pātu sarvadehagataṃ sukham || 63-59 || ihārhā vallabhaḥ pātu kālākhyeśo guṇo mama | ravināthaḥ sadā pātu hṛdayaṃ mānasaṃ mama || 63-60 || candreśaḥ pātu satataṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ mama kāmadaḥ | vajradaṇḍadharaḥ pātu raktāṅgeśastrilocanam || 63-61 || budhaśyāmasundareśaḥ pātu me hṛdayasthalam | suvarṇavarṇagurvīśo mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu || 63-62 || sindūrajaladacchannādyarkaśukreśvaro galam | nābhideśaṃ sadā pātu śaniśyāmeśa īśvaraḥ || 63-63 || rāhuḥ pātu mahāvaktraḥ kevalaṃ mukhamaṇḍalam | ketuḥ pātu mahākāyaḥ sadā me guhyadeśakam || 63-64 || indrādidevatāḥ pāntu parivāragaṇairyutāḥ | śiromaṇḍaladigrūpaṃ pāntu vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ || 63-65 || bhairavā bhairavīyuktāḥ sarvadehasamudbhavāḥ | bhīmadaṃṣṭra mahākāyā mama pāntu nirantaram || 63-66 || yajñabhuṅnīlakaṇṭho me hṛdayaṃ pātu sarvadā | unmattabhairavāḥ pāntu īśvarāḥ pāntu sarvadā || 63-67 || krodhabhūpatayaḥ pāntu śrīmāyāmadanānvitāḥ | ityetat kavacaṃ tāraṃ tārakabrahmamaṅgalam || 63-68 || kathitaṃ nātha yatnena kutrāpi na prakāśitam | tava snehavaśādeva prasannahṛdayānvitā || 63-69 || kṛpāṃ kuru dayānātha tavaiva kavacādbhutam | hitāya jagatāṃ mohavināśāyāmṛtāya ca || 63-70 || paṭhitavyaṃ sādhakendrairyogīndrairupavanditam | durlabhaṃ sarvalokeṣu sulabhaṃ tattvavedibhiḥ || 63-71 || asādhyaṃ sādhayedeva paṭhanāt kavacasya ca | dhāraṇāt pūjanāt sākṣāt sarvapīṭhaphalaṃ labhet || 63-72 || kākacañcupuṭaṃ kṛtvā saptadhā pañcadhāpi vā | kavacaṃ prapaṭhedvidvān gūḍhasiddhinibandhanāt || 63-73 || kākinīśvarasaṃyogaṃ suyogaṃ kavacānvitam | īśvarāṅgaṃ vibhāvyaiva kalpavṛkṣasamo bhavet || 63-74 || etatkavacapāṭhena devatvaṃ labhate dhruvam | ārogyaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ mohanaṃ jagatāṃ vaśam || 63-75 || stambhayet parasainyāni paṭhedvāratrayaṃ yadi | śāntimāpnoti śīghraṃ sa ṣaṭkarmakaraṇakṣamaḥ || 63-76 || ākāṅkṣā rasalālityaviṣayāśāvivajītaḥ | sādhakaḥ kāmadhenuḥ syādicchādisiddhibhāgbhavet || 63-77 || sarvatra gatiśaktiḥ syāt strīṇāṃ manmatharūpadhṛk | aṇimālaghimāprāptiguṇādisiddhimāpnuyāt || 63-78 || yoginīvallabho bhūtvā vicaret sādhakāgraṇīḥ | yathā guho gaṇeśaśca tathā sa me hi putrakaḥ || 63-79 || śrīmān kulīnaḥ sārajñaḥ sarvadharmavivajītaḥ | śanaiḥ śanairmudā yāti ṣoḍaśāre yatīśvaraḥ || 63-80 || yatra bhāti śākinīśaḥ sadāśivaguruḥ prabhuḥ | krameṇa paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti mama yogataḥ || 63-81 || mama yogaṃ vinā nātha tava bhaktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet | etatsammohanākhyasya kavacasya prapāṭhataḥ || 63-82 || vāṇī vaśyā sthirā lakṣmīḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | tyāgitā labhyate paścānniḥsaṅgo viharet śivaḥ | sadāśive mano yāti siddhamantrī manolayaḥ || 63-83 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairava saṃbāde'nāhateśvarasammohanākhyakavacaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 63 ||
[atha catuṣṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrī ānandabhairavī uvāca atha bhedān pravakṣyāmi sarvendriyavinigrahān | śṛṇu caikamanāḥ śambho yadi vāñchāphalecchukaḥ || 64-1 || punarjñānaṃ samāpnoti smṛtivijñānavajītam | yatra vai kurute nyāsaṃ mama tantroktasammatam || 64-2 || anāhatordhvaṃ śrīpadmaṃ dalaṣoḍaśaveṣṭitam | kaṇṭhakūpamahādhūmāvayave koṭibhāsvaram || 64-3 || pañcaraśmiyutaṃ kṣetraṃ tanmadhye keśavaprabham | tanmadhye kaṇīkāsthānaṃ paramāhlādavardhanam || 64-4 || aprakāśyaṃ sugopyantu śivarūpaṃ sadāśivam | pūjayenmatimān jñānī sākinīśaktivallabham || 64-5 || mahājanāḥ kāmakalādibījai(--) nīrudhya vaktraṃ paribhāvayanti | meghābhamugraṃ sthiravidyudābhaṃ | śyāmaṃ mahāsundaravigrahāmalam || 64-6 || nirūpaṇaṃ nāsti gatiprakāśa(--) ścālokanaṃ pañcamavarṇayogaḥ | jātevīcāraḥ pratipādako yaḥ | sadāśivaṃ śāntajanāśrayaṃ bhaje || 64-7 || akālacakraṃ kulakālacakraṃ | prakāśamānaṃ bhajatāṃ suradrumam | yajanti cakraṃ taruṇāruṇāyutaṃ | sindūraśailāmaladīptavantam || 64-8 || brahmādidevāḥ pratipūjayanti | tadādidevasya samādhibhāvam || 64-9 || bhalleśī bhallakullā kalayati valibhirvīrabhallūkabhālā(--) | bhargabhrāntivībhāntī bhayalavilakalākālasarpāturasthā | kaulā kailāsamālākulakamalajale bindulāvaṇyalīlā | kaṇṭhāmbhoje jvalantī kanakamadhugṛhe pīṭhapūre samādhau || 64-10 || dhyeyā yā cintanīyā ruciravikiraṇā sākinī pītavastrā | sā pāyānnīradābhaṃ varadasamadadaṃ candracūḍaṃ sadeśam | brarhmendrairyogimukhyaivīracayati dalagranthi saṃsthānacitraṃ | vidyutpuñjaprakāśā munigaṇanilayā sevyatāṃ sādhakendraiḥ || 64-11 || ākāśākhya prakāśe dvirasadalakalāprojjvale brahmamārge | jīvānāṃ haṃsamālā vicaritapavane dhūmadhūmenduśubhre | śrīmārtaṇḍo viśuddhe jayati kulapathoddīpanaḥ prāṇavāyuḥ | sākinyā yoginībhirvasati sukhapadāmodacintāmanīśaḥ || 64-12 || dvāveva dhattaḥ sakalañca kālaṃ | sadāśivau tau madhupūravāsinau | icchākriyājñānavirājitau yau | pradhānadevau bhajatāṃ sukhāspadau || 64-13 || viśuddhapadme prakṛtīśvarau yau | pracakratū bāṇaśivādibhedinau | akārarūpe gurumantradīptau | kulākulārthau pathi bhāvanīyau || 64-14 || mahābhairava uvāca kulaje parame vidye nityānandasvarūpiṇi | bhedān sarvānmama snehādvattumarhasi sundari || 64-15 || kālakūṭamahābhīmamadonmādasuvismṛtaḥ | ahaṃ na jāne yogārthān nityāyurbandhanapriyān || 64-16 || yadi māṃ rakṣituṃ śaktā viṣāktāṅgaṃ sadāvatu | kathaṃ vā kaṇṭhasañcāraḥ kathaṃ vā rākṣasī kriyā || 64-17 || kathaṃ vā ripuvidveṣī kathaṃ vā maṅgalodayaḥ | kiyadvā vinayāhlādaṃ kiyadvā kālasādhanam || 64-18 || navīnatvaṃ kathaṃ yāti dhyānaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ tava | tavāṅgāgurusadbhāvaṃ kulapīṭhapradarśanam || 64-19 || kuṇḍalīgamanaṃ kutra sādhakānāṃ kulaṃ kutaḥ | varṇadhyānaṃ kutra pade dalabhedaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 64-20 || sphūtīvīdyāviyogo hi pūrvajñānasamodayaḥ | kathaṃ samarasaprāptiḥ kathaṃ vā kāyakalpanam || 64-21 || mathanaṃ kāmadevasya kathaṃ dehe vyavasthitiḥ | kaṇṭhāmbhojasthiraḥ ko vā bhāvajñānī ca ko janaḥ || 64-22 || bhāvādi tvatkṛpādṛṣṭyā vada ādau patiṃ prati | śrīānandabhairavī uvāca ādau śrīkaṇṭhasañcāraḥ śrūyatāṃ parameśvara || 64-23 || śrotavyaṃ mantribhinītyaṃ kartacyaṃ pratyahaṃ prabho || 64-24 || kaṇṭhe ṣoḍaśakaṃ dalaṃ tadudare śrīkaṇīkāmaṇḍale | tadbāhye caturasrakaṃ sukhamayaṃ ṣaṭkoṇamantargatam | bāhye dvāracatuṣṭayaṃ navagṛhaṃ bhūbimbaṣaṭkaṃ tataḥ | śrīcandrātapamūrdhvake madhupurī tatkaṇīkāyāṃ yajet || 64-25 || tatkaṇīkāmadhyanigūḍhadeśe | sambhāti nityaṃ madhupūradeśaḥ | tanmadhyadeśe'ṣṭapurīprakāśaḥ | kaulakriyāsādhanasiddhaye syāt || 64-26 || pūrvāditāḥ premakalādhināthāḥ | prabhānti mādhvīrasarasārasnigdhāḥ | teṣāṃ praṇāmaḥ kriyate yatīndrai(--) rdhyeyāḥ sadā kaṇṭhadalaprakāśaḥ || 64-27 || vāmeśvaraḥ pūrvagṛhaṃ prayāti | rāhurgṛhaṃ jyeṣṭhagaṇeśvarīśaḥ | raudrātmako mṛtyupatergṛhaṃ tathā | kālīśvaro nairṛtihemamandiram || 64-28 || sakalavikaraṇīśo vāruṇāṃ mandiraṃ tat | savanadhikaraṇīśo pāvanaḥ mandiraṃ tat | sabalavimathanīśo mandiraṃ cottarasthaṃ | samavati nijagehaṃ sarvabhūtādhidevaḥ || 64-29 || madhyaṃ manonmanīnāthaḥ sarvālambhastadūrdhvakam | mandiraṃ hemajaḍitaṃ nānāratnavinimītam || 64-30 || eteṣāṃ śaktayo dhyeyāḥ svasvavāmapadojjvalāḥ | tāsāṃ nāmnā yojayitvā svamantraiḥ praṇavena vā || 64-31 || sampuṭīkṛtya japtvā ca asādhyaṃ khalu siddhyati | navakoṇordhvagehe ca pūrvasyāṃ diśi rājate || 64-32 || vāmā devī mahātejomayī bhujacatuṣṭayā | nānālaṅkāraśobhāṅgī sādhakā'bhīṣṭadā sadā || 64-33 || vahnau hemamandire ca jyeṣṭhā devī caturbhujā | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktā padmamālāvirājitā || 64-34 || dhyeyā sadā yogimukhyaiḥ sarvasiddhisamṛddhaye | yamasvarṇamandire ca raudrī paramasiddhidā || 64-35 || caturbhujā trinetrā ca dhyeyālaṅkāramaṇḍitā | nairṛte hemagehe ca kālī devī caturbhujā || 64-36 || sarvālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyā trinetrā varadāyinī | sarvāstradhāriṇī devī muṇḍamālāsuśobhitā || 64-37 || dhyeyā yogendravidyābhiḥ paramā jñānadāyinī | kalavikaraṇī devī bhāti vāruṇamandire || 64-38 || caturbhujā yogimātā trinetrā bharaṇānvitā | sā dhyeyā yogimukhyaiśca aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidā || 64-39 || pāvane svarṇagehe ca dhyeyā sādhakasattamaiḥ | bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśā keyūrahāramālinī || 64-40 || balavikaraṇī devī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | caturbhujā trinetrā ca sarvādisiddhidāyinī || 64-41 || balapramathinī devī dhanadā mokṣadā sadā | kuberahemagehasthā sarvānandakarodyatā || 64-42 || śrīsarvabhūtadamanī dhyeyā īśānamandire | prathamāruṇasaṅkāśā karavīrasrajānvitā || 64-43 || caturbhujā trinetrā ca sarvālaṅkāraśobhitā | madhye śrīkaṇīkāyāśca dhyeyā sarvajaneśvaraiḥ || 64-44 || sūryaprabhā sadā dhyeyā devī śrīdā manonmanī | caturbhujā mahādīptiralaṅkāropaśobhitā || 64-45 || trinetrā varadā sarvā sarvāntaḥ karaṇasthitā | sakalaguṇātmaśaktiyuktā devī caturbhujā || 64-46 || aruṇāyutasaṅkāśā ruṇḍamālāvirājitā | anantānantamahimā dhyeyā sādyā caturbhujā || 64-47 || trinetrā raktavasanā sarvālaṅkāramaṇḍitā | etāsāṃ dhyānamākṛtya pūjayedvidhivat tataḥ || 64-48 || manaḥkalpitadravyaiśca sākṣātkalpitadravyakaiḥ | japtvā nāmnā yojayitvā samarpya vidhivatsudhīḥ || 64-49 || kṛtvā māṃsāsavairyogī tarpayenmadhudhārayā | abhiṣekaṃ kuladravyaiḥ sādhakairyogibhiḥ saha || 64-50 || bhojayed yogimukhyāṃśca brāhmaṇān vedapāragān | nānāvidhakuladravyai rbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca yogirāṭ || 64-51 || tataḥ prakāśamāpnoti manoyogena vārpayet | etatprakāraḥ kaṇṭhasya sañcāraḥ parameśvara || 64-52 || labhyate vidhinānena divyabhāvena vārpayet | tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti sākinīdarśanaṃ tathā || 64-53 || patnyā sārdhaṃ sādhakendraḥ siddhamantramavāpnuyāt | atha vakṣye mahākāla rākṣasīṃ paramāṃ kriyām || 64-54 || yena karmasādhanena śivatvamapi labhyate | cīnācāraṃ rākṣasīnāṃ kulīnānāṃ sadāśiva || 64-55 || rākṣasī vedabhāṣā ca vedamantraviśodhitā | cīnācāraṃ rākṣasīnāṃ sādhanādeva siddhyati || 64-56 || cīnācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi rākṣasīnāṃ mahāphalam | aṣṭādaśa prakārantu cīnācāraṃ pracakṣate || 64-57 || sarvatra śuddhasadbhāvaḥ prayojanavirāgavit | uttamottamasaṃjñaṃ cānuttamottamameva ca || 64-58 || atyantottamasaṃjñaṃ cātyantānuttamameva ca | anuttamottamaṃ nātha cātyuttamamathāparam || 64-59 || uttamaṃ saptavidhañca cīnācāreṣu yojayet | atyantamadhyamaṃ cīne cātimadhyamameva ca || 64-60 || madhyamadhyamasañjñañca madhyamaṃ tu catuvīdham | atyantādhamasañjñañcātyantādhamameva ca || 64-61 || atyadhamādhamaṃ caivātyantādhamādhamaṃ tathā | atyadhamaṃ tathā nāthādhamādhamamathāparam || 64-62 || adhamaṃ saptamaṃ viddhi rākṣasīcīnasādhane | dinapakṣamāsavarṣabhedeṣu kārayet kramāt || 64-63 || ādāvuttamasiddhāntaśravaṇaṃ kuru śaṅkara | yadā ṛtumatī pṛthvī tridinaṃ cāmbuvāciṣu || 64-64 || taddanāttu dinaṃ yāvattāvaddhi māṃsacarvaṇam | cīnadrumāsavānandapañcatattvaniṣevaṇam || 64-65 || abādhato yaḥ karoti cottamottameva tat | anuttamottamaṃ vakṣye pūjākāleṣu yojayet || 64-66 || kevalaṃ guptabhāvena pañcatattvaniṣevaṇam | atyāgaṃ svīyabījaṃ tu kulapīṭhasya manthanam || 64-67 || tatpīṭhamathanoddhṛtasudhārasaniyojanam | āsaveṣu ca sarveṣu tadāsavaniṣevaṇam || 64-68 || aṣṭaprakāramāṃsāḍhyaṃ sadā carvaṇatatparam | pūjākālaṃ vinā dravyaṃ nāharet sādhakottamaḥ || 64-69 || anuttamottamaṃ taddhi sarvadeśe ca sarvadā | atyantottamacīnaṃ tu vakṣyāmyatra vidhānataḥ || 64-70 || yena siddho bhavenmantrī sadāśivādidarśanam | pratyahaṃ vatsaraṃ vyāpya niśāyāmardharātrake || 64-71 || pañcatattvaṃ samānīya aṣṭanāyikayā saha | pūjayet kramato mantrī tatkathāśravaṇotsukaḥ || 64-72 || krameṇa mathanaṃ kṛtvā''save saṃyojya nityaśaḥ | śuddhabhāvena gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇyāṃ bījamarpayet || 64-73 || tadbījena samāsiñcenmastakādiṣu paṅkaje | datvā tābhyo dakṣiṇādīn svātantryamapi cācaret || 64-74 || atyantottamametaddhi na cārambho viśāṃ vinā | atyantānuttamaṃ viddhi yena siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 64-75 || ānande tyāgamāpanne punarānandamāśrayet | sarvadānandasaṃyuktaḥ prajapedyajanādiṣu || 64-76 || na viśeṣo divārātrau sarvadārasusaṃyutaḥ | uktāsanopaviṣṭastu nirjane kulasādhanam || 64-77 || anuttamottamaṃ viddhi māyājālanikṛntanam | kālākālaṃ vihāyādau svakulaṃ parameva vā || 64-78 || tannāmnāhūya yatnena dāpayedāsanādikam | mahāśaṅkhaṃ samānīya kuladravyaṃ tathānagha || 64-79 || vidhinā pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kulavāre ca sādhakaḥ | dātā bhoktā saṃvidaśca śodhitasya kuleśvara || 64-80 || svīyāṅge nyāsajālādīn tāsāmaṅge tataḥ param | śivapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kulapūjāṃ samārabhet || 64-81 || pīṭhe saṃyojya śambhuṃ cākṣubdho'yutajapaṃ caret | japaṃ samarpayet tasyā vāmahastāmbuje sudhīḥ || 64-82 || visarjanaṃ svabījasya tato nityāpratarpaṇam | āsave yojayitvā tu tayā sārdhaṃ pibenmadhu || 64-83 || vāmabhāge kulaṃ kṛtvā lakṣajāpyaṃ samāpayet | kuladravyaiśca homaḥ syāt taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam || 64-84 || taddaśāṃśābhiṣekaṃ tu daśāṃśaṃ viprabhojanam | tataḥ kumārībhojyañca madhumāṃsāsavaiḥ prabho || 64-85 || pratyahaṃ vatsaraṃ vyāpya kulavāre kuje śanau | vatsarānte mama padāmbhojaṃ paśyati niścitam || 64-86 || anuttamottamañcaitad rākṣasīcīnasādhane | atyuttamaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 64-87 || sadā jitendriyo bhūttvā yogābhyāsaparāyaṇaḥ | māṃsāsavādyaiḥ santarpya kālikāṃ ghoraniḥsvanām || 64-88 || ekādaśīvyatīpāte kulavāre kule tithau | kulamānīya sākṣādvai paraṃbrahmamayo bhavan || 64-89 || kevalaṃ layabhāvena devīpūjāṃ samārabhet | kuladṛṣṭayā ca tadbuddhyā tattaddhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 64-90 || mūlādhāre mahācakre yoginīkoṭirājite | koṭibrahmālaye siddhe sūkṣmamārgeṇa sādhakaḥ || 64-91 || jyotirākāśagaṅgābhiryathādhārābhirāplutām | pṛthivīṃ brahmajananīṃ brahmānandasvarūpiṇīm || 64-92 || tathā kulamayīṃ nityāṃ nityānandasvarūpiṇīm | kulakuṇḍalinīṃ devīṃ viśvamātāṃ trilocanām || 64-93 || mahāghanarasollāsāṃ mahonmādādibindubhiḥ | galitābhirmahādhārājanyābdhiśatakoṭibhiḥ || 64-94 || paricchinnābhiruddhate jyotīrandhre mahāpathe | atraiva satataṃ bhāti sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarā'parā || 64-95 || bindūdbhavā mahādhārā koṭisaudāminīprabhā | tasyā rūpasya kā pūjā kuladevyā mahāprabho || 64-96 || kevalaṃ bindudhārābhistarpayāmi sadānaghām | kuladevīṃ jagadrūpāṃ sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpiṇīm || 64-97 || mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ tarpayāmi sureśvarīm | ityevaṃ manasā yasya tasya kiṃ bāhyapūjayā || 64-98 || tathāpi kalpayāmyatra sā(śā)radīye mahotsave | yathā kulavatīṃ durgāṃ tathāhaṃ kulanāyikām || 64-99 || mūlapadmātsamākṛṣya nāginīṃ nāgakanyakām | kuhakodbhavarūpasthāṃ manuṣyagaṇakanyakām || 64-100 || vāme'haṃ kalpayāmyatra kulapīṭhe manorame | kuladevīṃ vāmabhāge pūjayāmyadhunāmunā || 64-101 || tarpayāmi mahābindūdbhavāsavaghaṭāmṛtaiḥ | māṃsāṣṭakayutainītyaṃ mudrābhirmīnamiśritaiḥ || 64-102 || yathāntaḥkaraṇe sā tu tathā me bāhyatarpaṇam | śubhaṃ bhavatu nityaṃ me mahārātriśca saukhyadā || 64-103 || kulaṃ bhavatu saukhyaṃ me bāhyapūjā śubhā mama | ityevaṃ manasā yasya tasyāḥ saukhyaṃ kutaḥ prabho || 64-104 || sarvadā pūjanaṃ tasya caiva kālo nirarthakaḥ | abhedabuddhyā sarvatra pūjanaṃ bhāvasādhane || 64-105 || atyuttamamiti proktaṃ kaulānāṃ yogasādhane | jātivṛttaṃ na tatraiva yadīcchati phalodayam || 64-106 || uttamaṃ sampravakṣye'haṃ yathocitaphalodayam | atra tantre kriyā guptā guptamāmantritaṃ kulam || 64-107 || guptaṃ kularasaṃ nityaṃ guptapānaṃ sadā prabho | varṣe varṣe pūrṇasiddhiṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 64-108 || māse māse tarpaṇaṃ tu pakṣe pakṣe kulakriyā | dine dine sadā pānaṃ kaulānāmiti lakṣaṇam || 64-109 || guptakriyābhiḥ siddhyeta na prakāśyaṃ kadācana | sarvatyāgī tadaiva syāt prakāśo jāyate yadi || 64-110 || uttamaṃ bhāvamālambya kṣipraṃ siddhyati sādhakaḥ | tasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ tantranāthe nirūpitam || 64-111 || śivoktilakṣaṇe proktaṃ bhairaveṇa mayā saha | tatsarvaṃ jñānamālambya cottamastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 64-112 || atyantamadhyamaṃ vakṣye cīnācārakrameṇa tu | yatkṛtvā munayaḥ sarve kaulalakṣaṇabhāvakāḥ || 64-113 || pīṭhopapīṭhamadhye ca mahāpīṭhe kulārṇave | mahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭite sādhakānvite || 64-114 || tatraikamāsanaṃ kṛtvā tithitrayadine śubhe | uktāsanamupānīya tatra niścayacetasā || 64-115 || lakṣamekaṃ japennityaṃ kāmanāviṣayasthitaḥ | kṛṣṇe vā śuklapakṣe vā homādividhimācaret || 64-116 || kumārīṃ bhojayitvā tu kaṇṭhe tau bhāvayetsadā | māsena siddhimāpnoti kuladravyaprasādataḥ || 64-117 || atyantamadhyamaṃ cīnaṃ kathitaṃ tava yatnataḥ | atimadhyamamāvakṣye yajjñātvā yogirāḍ bhavet || 64-118 || kālākālaṃ vihāyātha sadāntaḥkaraṇasthitaḥ | bhāvayitvā sudhādevīṃ ḍākinyādisvarūpiṇīm || 64-119 || pañcaśaktiṃ samānīya pūjayetkulajai rasaiḥ | kulapuṣpaiḥ sādhakendraḥ kulīnaṃ bhāvayettataḥ || 64-120 || yathā bāhye tathā hṛdye kaṇṭhe maṇigṛhe tathā | vaikuṇṭhe viṣṇukamale mūlādhāre punaḥ punaḥ || 64-121 || dhyātvā dhyātvā tarpayedyaḥ sa kāmavijayī bhavet | atimadhyamametattu yogināmapi durlabham || 64-122 || madhyamadhyamamāvakṣye kulīnaphalasāgaram | vāñchāsiddhikaraṃ sākṣāt śivavadviharenmudā || 64-123 || māsamadhye pañcavāraṃ pañcatattvaniṣevaṇam | yajanaṃ bhāvanaṃ nityaṃ homakarma samāpayet || 64-124 || bāhyakriyāsu nipuṇaḥ śmaśāne vipine'pi vā | bhāvayet kāntaṃ śirasi kākinīṃ sākinīṃ kalām || 64-125 || pañcaśaktiṃ dvayaṃ vāpi gṛhītvā tarpaṇaṃ caret | tarpaṇānte japedvidyāmahanīśamanāturaḥ || 64-126 || homatarpaṇakāle tu kulaśaktiṃ prapūjayet | āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghamācamanīyakam || 64-127 || madhuparkaṃ ca manasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca | gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyaṃ śītalaṃ jalam || 64-128 || pakvānnaṃ pakvamāṃsañca pakvañca vyañjanādikam | karpūravāsitaṃ nīraṃ tāmbūlaṃ tadanantaram || 64-129 || lavaṅgādisamāyuktaṃ datvā gandhānulepanam | gandhamālyādikaṃ datvā prārthayetsuhitaṃ varam || 64-130 || tasyai datvā svamātmānaṃ kulapīṭhe sthiro bhavet | kaṇṭhapadme mano yāti śaktimantraprabhāvataḥ || 64-131 || madhyamadhyamametaddhi kulīnaviprabhojanam | kramaśaḥ siddhimāpnoti madhyamaṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 64-132 || yathā kāle kuladravyaṃ samānīya prayatnataḥ | navaśaktimekaśaktiṃ triśaktiṃ vāsamāharet || 64-133 || guptasthāne samānīya guptadravyaiḥ prapūjayet | daśopacāravidhinā pūjayediṣṭadevatām || 64-134 || prātaḥkāle ca madhyāhne sāyāhne madhyarātrike | sahasrajapamākṛtyārcanaṃ vāracatuṣṭayam || 64-135 || madhyarātrau śaktimātraṃ sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥ | sākṣānmūrttau digambaryāṃ mudrayā paripūjayet || 64-136 || jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī | durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namo'stu te || 64-137 || anena manunābhyarcya paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇīm | kuladravyaṃ pibet paścācchaktidattaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 64-138 || śaktiprasādaṃ vidhinā saṃśodhya pānamācaret | śodhayāmi parāṃ devīṃ kulāsyapadmanirgatām || 64-139 || pibāmi paramānandaistatprasādātkuleśvari | ityādi madhyamaṃ proktaṃ cīnācāreṣu durlabham || 64-140 || atyantādhamacīnaṃ tu vakṣyāmyatra viśeṣataḥ | māsamadhye tridinaṃ tu tarpaṇaṃ tu trayaṃ trayam || 64-141 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ jāpyaṃ kevalaṃ śaktiśodhanam | ṛṣimātṛkarāṅgādinyāsaṃ svīyatanau caret || 64-142 || kulāṅge'pi samākṛtya pīṭhe śambhuṃ niyojayet | dharmādharmakalāsnehamātmāgnau manasā srucā || 64-143 || suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham | svāhāntamantramuccārya niyojya japamācaret || 64-144 || japaṃ samarpya vidhinā stotraṃ kavacamāpaṭhet | kavacānte tato mantrī svabījahomamācaret || 64-145 || kulatrikoṇagaganavāyūjvalakulānale | kulaprakāśite padmatale ca manunāmunā || 64-146 || prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucā | dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇamagnau juhomyaham || 64-147 || svāheti mantramuccārya tatastenaiva tarpaṇam | tarpaṇānte cābhiṣekaṃ svaśaktikulajai rasaiḥ || 64-148 || śaktīnāṃ brāhmaṇasthāne bhojanañca samāpanam | kevalaṃ tridinaṃ māse cātyantādhamalakṣaṇam || 64-149 || atyantātyadhamaṃ cīnaṃ vakṣyāmi kulavallabha | rākṣasīkriyayā vyāptaṃ bhujaṅgākārabhojanam || 64-150 || ahameva paraṃbrahma buddhyātmānaṃ pratarpayet | ātmambharī svayaṃ nityaṃ śaktityāgaparo naraḥ || 64-151 || antare ca na tu tyāgo manasā karmasādhanam | pañcatattvaṃ svayaṃ pītvā sadānandasvarūpavān || 64-152 || bījatyāgaṃ na karoti liṅgaṃ vaktre punaḥ punaḥ | dantāvaliyute vaktre bījoccāraṇamuccakaiḥ || 64-153 || upāṃśu mānasaṃ vāpi japtvā brahmamayo bhavet | na tu bāhye mahāpūjā ekādaśīvrataṃ vinā || 64-154 || ekādaśyāmavaśyaṃ tu pūjayetsurasundarīm | yathāvidhi vidhānena śaktiṃ santoṣayet sudhīḥ || 64-155 || sarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe tatrāśucirna vidyate | aśucerbhāvamālabya narakaṃ khalu gacchati || 64-156 || viṣṭhāyāṃ gandhanibiḍe māṃsamedādigandhake | sugandhadeśake vāpi ekabhāvena pūjayet || 64-157 || pūjānte ṣaṭsahasrākhyastotraṃ kavacamāpaṭhet | tadante viharedvīro madanāhlādavajītaḥ || 64-158 || antare kuṇḍalīyuktaḥ kāmakartā svayaṃ bhavet | na tu bāhye svabījasya tyāga eva sureśvara || 64-159 || tadā yoge sthiro yāti cātyantātyadhamādibhiḥ | atyadhamādhamaṃ vakṣye kālātmañchṛṇu sādaram || 64-160 || māsamadhye vāramekaṃ kulācāraṃ sacīnakam | kulamālāṃ samānīya kulena puṭitaṃ manum || 64-161 || śaktiyukto japenmantrī mantradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | caturdaṇḍagato rātrau japārambha udīritaḥ || 64-162 || japettu sakalāṃ rātriṃ vedadaṇḍasthite na tu | bhayaṃ naiva tu kartavyaṃ hāsyaṃ tatra vivarjayet || 64-163 || kālītantravidhānena tārātantrakrameṇa vā | pūjājapaṃ samarpyātha śaktiṃ samprārthayanmudā || 64-164 || stotraṃ kavacamuccārya viharecca yathāvidhim | māsamadhye dinamekaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavennaraḥ | paśutvaṃ na samāyāti vīratantraprasādataḥ | etadanyadine nātha pañcatattvāktataṇḍulam || 64-165 || vadanāmbhoruhe dattvā japettadgatamānasaḥ | evaṃ vatsaraparyantaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavennaraḥ || 64-166 || atyadhamādhamaṃ kṛtvā paśutvamapi muñcati | kuleśa paramānanda vakṣye'tyantādhamādhamam || 64-167 || bhaveyuḥ sādhakāgryāśca vīrāḥ paśuguṇodayāḥ | uccadeśe gṛhaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍalākārameva ca || 64-168 || śaktiṃ binā caretkāryaṃ nṛṇāṃ muṇḍatrayodaśe | āsanaṃ tatra saṃskṛtya japettu śaṅkhamālayā || 64-169 || anukalpitadravyeṇa sākṣātkalpitadravyakaiḥ | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā svātmānaṃ śaktikuṇḍalīm || 64-170 || ekākī nirjane deśe tadgataḥ prajapenmanum | kulapūjākrameṇaiva ātmaśaktiṃ pratarpayet || 64-171 || sahasranāmayogāṅgaṃ ṣaṭcakrabhedanakramāt | paṭhitvā stotrakavacaṃ vinyasedātmano hṛdi || 64-172 || guptajāpyakrameṇaiva siddho bhavati mānavaḥ | ityetatkathitaṃ nātha mahāsiddhikaraṃ param || 64-173 || divārātrau sādhakasya viśeṣo nāsti śaṅkara | paśubhāvaṃ parityajya siddho'tyantādhamādhamam || 64-174 || atyadhamaṃ pravakṣyāmi cīnācārakrameṇa tu | yena siddho bhavenmantrī paśubhāvaṃ vimuñcati || 64-175 || śṛṇu prāṇeśa varada siddhānāmadhipādhipa | pātālamaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā gandhanirgamavajītam || 64-176 || tatrāsanaṃ samākṛtya tatra muṇḍatrayaṃ trayam | tanmadhye nivasennātha kulavidyāsamanvitaḥ || 64-177 || kulīnāṃ paṇḍitāṃ nārīṃ divyālaṅkāramaṇḍitām | sarvadānandanilayāṃ rasikāṃ krodhavajītām || 64-178 || sundarīṃ yauvanāhlādalalitāṃ devayoginīm | evaṃbhūtāṃ devaśaktiṃ vāmabhāge niyojya ca || 64-179 || pūjayetparayā bhaktyā yatheṣṭadevatāṃ prabho | kevalaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tridinaṃ kulamandire || 64-180 || atha saptadinān vāpi pūjājapavidhiṃ caret | śaktiṃ santarpayed bhaktyā navakanyāmathāpi va || 64-181 || vastrālaṅkārabhūṣādyaiḥ kuladravyairyathāvidhi | santoṣayet sadā kāmī liṅgadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 64-182 || dhūpadīpau tathā dadyāt sarvadā sādhakottamaḥ | yathā tattvāntanāśaḥ syāttathā taccittatāmasam || 64-183 || naśyatyeva mahākāla atyadhamaprasādataḥ | adhamādhamamāvakṣye yathoktaphalasiddhaye || 64-184 || mantrī pīṭhe samāgamya muktakeśo digambaraḥ | ghṛṇālajjāvirahito nirjane vipine'pi vā || 64-185 || gaṅgāgarbhe girau vāpi bilvamūle catuṣpathe | vaṭamūle'śvatthamūle cīnadrumatale'pi vā || 64-186 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ samārabhya prayatnataḥ | muṇḍamekamadhaḥ kṣiptvā gandhacandanalepitam || 64-187 || hastārdhamānato nātha cāṇḍālaṃ hīnajātigam | tatra sthitvā japenmantrī bhayamātraṃ vivarjayet || 64-188 || cāṇḍālīśaktimānīya kuladravyaṃ tathā prabho | taddanāttaddanaṃ yāvattāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 64-189 || vidhinā śodhanaṃ kṛtvā śaktyai datvā svayaṃ pibet | ānandasāgare magnaḥ sarvadarśī nirāmayaḥ || 64-190 || māṃsamudrācarvaṇaṃ tu sadānandamayo bhavan | pratyahaṃ sādhanaṃ kṛtvā varṣamadhye ca māsakam || 64-191 || māsena siddhimāpnoti rākṣasīkramataḥ prabho | adhamādhamakāryeṇa paśuścīnāśrito bhavet || 64-192 || adhamaṃ śṛṇu yatnena kaulānāmatidurlabham | adhamādikrameṇaiva vatsarānmāṃ prapaśyati || 64-193 || paśuvatsakalaṃ kāryaṃ rātrau cāpi kulakriyā | kuladevyāstrirātrau ca kulapīṭhe manorame || 64-194 || pūjayet paramānandaiḥ kuladhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | kulapuṣpaiḥ kuladravyaiḥ sāṅgopāṅgaivīdhānataḥ || 64-195 || kulapūjāṃ madhyarātrau brāhmaṇau brāhmaṇīyutaḥ | kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyāyuktau vaiśyo vaiśyānvitaḥ sadā || 64-196 || śūdraḥ śūdrakalāyukto nijābhāve parāyutaḥ | juhuyāt kālasapīṇyā vadanāmbhojasundare || 64-197 || puraścaraṇavat kāryaṃ divārātrau pratarpayet | akālamṛtyujetā syāt parānandamayo bhavan || 64-198 || anāyāsena siddhiḥ syādadhamasya prasādataḥ | ripuvidveṣaṇaṃ vakṣye devadeva śṛṇu prabho || 64-199 || yasya prasādamātreṇa niḥśatruravarān bhavet | kaṇṭhapadme dṛḍho bhūtvā sākinīṃ śrīsadāśivam || 64-200 || pūjayitvā vidhānena bhāvayet tadgato yadi | mañjughoṣasya manunā puṭīkṛtya sadāśivam || 64-201 || tārayadvayamuccārya rakṣātmānaṃ yugaṃ tathā | parapakṣaṃ chedayati yogaśatrūn vināśaya || 64-202 || yugalaṃ yugalaṃ tatra ramāvahnitrayaṃ trayam | tato mārayayugmaṃ tu khādayadvayameva ca || 64-203 || śatrukaṇṭhatriśūlyante nikaṇṭharipupañcakān | hārayadvayamuccārya svāhāntamanumājapet || 64-204 || sa bhavedripuvidveṣī yogābhyāsī svayaṃ bhavet | anyamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 64-205 || aghoramantrapuṭitaṃ sākinīnijamantrakam | tadante kāmarājaṃ tu ripuṃ me yogavighnadam || 64-206 || dārayadvayamuccārya vidveṣayadvayaṃ vadet | parapakṣaṃ chedayeti kālajālaṃ haradvayam || 64-207 || svāhāntamantramuccārya japet kaṇṭhādhidevatām | sa bhavedripuvidveṣī yogavighnādivighnahṛt || 64-208 || maṅgalodayamāvakṣye yena yogī bhavennaraḥ | rātriśeṣe samutthāya japenmadhyandināvadhi || 64-209 || yogadhyānaṃ sarvadaiva kaṇṭhapadme sthiro bhavet | maṅgalodayamāpnoti cirajīvī bhaved dhruvam || 64-210 || vismayāhlādamāvakṣye yatkṛtvā yoginīpatiḥ | svīkṛtya ca kulaṃ dravyaṃ parānandamayo bhavan || 64-211 || dhyānādvilayamāpnoti tasya nāśaḥ kutaḥ prabho | krameṇa paratāṃ yāti krayavikrayavajītaḥ || 64-212 || tasmin pralayamāpanne kuto dehaḥ kuto mṛtiḥ | tasyaiva sarvadā pūjā bāhyapūjā nirathīkā || 64-213 || etasmin pralaye yāte kutaḥ sṛṣṭisthitirbhavet | sṛṣṭisthitimayo bhūtvā vilayaṃ yāti niścitam || 64-214 || kālasādhanamāvakṣye yathā kuṇḍalinīpadam | yadā samaramānandaḥ sānandacetasānvitaḥ || 64-215 || tadaiva phaladaṃ kālaṃ tasmin kāle ca sādhayet | sādhanādeva siddhiḥ syāt tatkālasādhanañcaret || 64-216 || śṛṇu nātha navīnatvaṃ yena yāti narottamaḥ | prātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya yāvaddaṇḍacatuṣṭayam || 64-217 || śaucaṃ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā cāsanābhyāsamāśrayet | tato yogadhāraṇāñca tataḥ pūjādikaṃ prabho || 64-218 || tato japādikaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret | ṣaṭṣoḍaśadvādaśaṃ tu kuṇḍalīvāyudhāraṇam || 64-219 || tato nyāsaṃ stotrapāṭhaṃ kavacaṃ nāmamaṅgalam | paṭhitvā devatāṃ hṛdye punarānīya yatnataḥ || 64-220 || caraṇādakapānaṃ tu pañcāsavaniṣevaṇam | dugdhapānaṃ tataḥ paścāt sandhyāvadhi vidhānataḥ || 64-221 || rātrau dhyānaṃ sadā kṛtvā samādhiṃ kramato labhet | evaṃ krameṇa deveśa navīnatvaṃ samāpnuyāt || 64-222 || mama dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya | anāśrayaṃ sadā dhyāyedānandapraṇayādibhiḥ || 64-223 || nirāśrayaṃ nirākāraṃ mama dhyānamudīritam | rūpātītaṃ nivīkalpaṃ sarvajñaṃ yogavāridam || 64-224 || koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ tejobimbaṃ nirākulam | jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam || 64-225 || daṃṣṭrakarāladurdharṣaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | triśūlaṃ varahastañca ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam || 64-226 || anantānantamahimaṃ sarvagāminamīśvaram | sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tat sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 64-227 || sarvamāvṛtyaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ kaṇṭhasthaṃ kaṇṭhavāyugam | mama dhyānaṃ sadā kṛtvā paraṃ brahmamayo bhavet || 64-228 || mamājñā gurusadbhāvaṃ śṛṇu yatnena bhairava | kaṇṭhasthaṃ daivataṃ devagururūpaṃ mahāguṇam || 64-229 || ānandabhairavaṃ paścānmahākālaṃ tataḥ param | jñānānandaṃ sadānandaṃ bhairavānandameva ca || 64-230 || śyāmānandaṃ śivānandaṃ kālānandamataḥ param | sudhānandaṃ harānandaṃ surānandamataḥ param || 64-231 || kulānandaṃ priyānandaṃ yajñānandamataḥ param | dhyānānandaṃ parānandaṃ yogānandaṃ tataḥ param || 64-232 || krodhānandaṃ kriyānandaṃ bodhānandaṃ tataḥ param | devānandaṃ jayānandaṃ vijayānandameva ca || 64-233 || brahmānandaṃ prabhānandaṃ pūrṇānandaṃ tataḥ param | jagadānandarūpaṃ ca mamājñāgurucakragam || 64-234 || mamājñāgurusadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā'bhyarcya vibhāvayet | kaṇṭhapadme sthiro yāti sādhakaḥ sthiracetasā || 64-235 || vakṣye'haṃ devadeveśa kulapīṭhapradarśanam | kāmasthānaṃ kāmakalāveṣṭitaṃ yoginīpadam || 64-236 || kāmarūpaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kulapīṭhaṃ prakītītam | tasya darśanamātreṇa jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || 64-237 || tatprakāravidhiṃ vakṣye sāvadhāno'vadhāraya | kulapīṭhe samāgamya yada tadgatamānasaḥ || 64-238 || tadaiva pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale | ādau bhavet kālarūpabhūpatiḥ siddhidarśakaḥ || 64-239 || kūlapūjāvidhānena nijapīṭhe prapūjayet | kāmeśvarīṃ kālakanyāṃ kāmakautūhalojjvalām || 64-240 || kālarūpāṃ prapūjyātha sarvabhāvena pūjayet | sudhādānaṃ pādyadānaṃ arghyamāṃsādi mudrayā || 64-241 || ācamanīyaṃ sakulaṃ gandhamāliṅganādikam | nakhadaṃṣṭrakṣatādīni puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca || 64-242 || samūhadhūpadānaṃ tu kulapīṭhapradarśakam | tatsparśanaṃ bhaveddīpaḥ praveśo hi kulāntare || 64-243 || tannaivedyaṃ mahāsaukhyaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | kuladravyaṃ tu pānārthaṃ tatastāmbūlabhakṣaṇam || 64-244 || sthāpanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ viddhi mama pūjākramādikam | tanmūlena yathā nātha pūrvoktena prakārayet || 64-245 || kuṇḍalīgamanaṃ vakṣye saṃkṣepācchṛṇu vallabha | kāyaśodhanamākṛtya āsanādikamācaret || 64-246 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā bhūtanyāsaṃ samācaret | aṅganyāsakaranyāsau bījanyāseṣu ṣoḍhayā || 64-247 || vyāpakaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret | jīvenaikyaṃ vibhāvyaiva brahmarandhre niveśayet || 64-248 || brahmarandhre tato gatvā suṣumnāmukhamāśrayet | tanmadhye kaṇīkāsthānaṃ tanmadhye ca caturdalam || 64-249 || caturdalānte sā devī vibhāti tāmupāśrayet | tāmupakuñcya yatnena siddharūpī prabuddhayet || 64-250 || devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tato gacchet ṣaḍdale kākinīsthale | tayā sārdhaṃ kuṇḍalinyā devairgacched daśacchade || 64-251 || evaṃ krameṇa hṛtpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ tataḥ param | dvidalaṃ bhedamākṛtya bodhinīcakramāśrayet || 64-252 || tataḥ kaṭāhamābhedya pūrṇaśailaṃ samāśrayet | tato'sau hyunmanīṃ bhitvā ghaṭādhāre manolayam || 64-253 || tadūrdhve pralayākāraṃ brahmacakraṃ nirākulam | tadūrdhve brahmadaṇḍaṃ tu tadūrdhve kevalaṃ jalam || 64-254 || sarvaṃ jalaṃ samālambya sahasrāraṃ prabhāmayam | tadūrdhve kaṇīkāsthānaṃ siddhakhaḍgaṃ tadūrdhvake || 64-255 || sarvabījamayaṃ nātha mātṛkāmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ | mātṛkāmaṇḍalordhve ca pretabījaṃ sudhāmayam || 64-256 || pretāsanopari dhyāyenmahākālakuleśvarīm | tatraiva śrīpadāmbhojatale saṃsthāpayenmanaḥ || 64-257 || pūrvoktadevatābhistu layayogena lepayet | tatraiva sthitvā saṃdhyāyenmūle'nalamanuṃ prabho || 64-258 || vāyubījena prajvālya daheddehaṃ yatīśvaraḥ | tannetradvayaparyantaṃ karṇayugmāvadhi prabho || 64-259 || pradahya bhrūdale netre vahnau vahnilayaṃ caret | tacchikhāpaṭalenaiva kṣaranti brahmabindavaḥ || 64-260 || tadbindudhārayā dehaṃ varuṇaiḥ plāvayettataḥ | śuddhadehaṃ tato dhyāyed bījena prathamāṅkuram || 64-261 || adhomārgeṇa sandhyāyet kuṇḍalinyā gamāgamam | ityetat kathitaṃ nātha kuṇḍalīgamanādikam || 64-262 || sādhakālambanaṃ vakṣye yena siddho hi sādhakaḥ | prāṇavidyāsusiddhiḥ syādāyurārogyamālabhet || 64-263 || śrīkāruṇo'kāraṇaguptabhāve | vibhāvayāmi priyapādapadmam | evaṃ manoyogamupetya nityaṃ | śrīsādhakālambanameva sampadam || 64-264 || nityopalabdhivijñāne sundarīcaraṇāmbuje | ātmānamarpayan bhāvaiḥ sādhakālambanaṃ hi tat || 64-265 || varṇadhyānaṃ śṛṇu prītaḥ śaṅkara prāṇaśaṅkara | mūlādibrahmarandhrāntamakārādīn smared budhaḥ || 64-266 || smṛtvā grathitvā manunā vilomena punaḥ punaḥ | bhāvayenmanasāṃ yogī sattvādhiṣṭhānatatparaḥ || 64-267 || koṭisūryāyutābhāsaṃ pratyekagranthibhedataḥ | mantrākṣaraṃ paraṃbrahma dhyātvā dhyātvā vibhākaram || 64-268 || bhitvā sahasrāramadhyaṃ kṣakāraṃ bhāti candragam | anulomavilomena vibhāvya dhyānamācaret || 64-269 || akārādikṣakārāntaṃ varṇadhyānaṃ samīritam | dalabhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatra yatra pade sthitiḥ || 64-270 || visargād binduparyanto dalabhedaḥ prakītītaḥ | tathāpi śṛṇu yogendra saṅketārthavinirṇayam || 64-271 || devatādakṣiṇāvartyā yogena bhāvayeddalam | evaṃ mūlādipadmānāṃ bhedaḥ śrīkaṇṭhabhūṣaṇa || 64-272 || evaṃ sahasrārapadmadalabhedaḥ prakītītaḥ | sphūtīvidyāṃ pravakṣyāmi akasmātsiddhidāyinīm || 64-273 || nirantaraṃ japedvidyāṃ samabhāvaparāyaṇaḥ | akasmātsphūtīvidyaḥ syātkāvyavākpatirīśvaraḥ || 64-274 || vācāṃ siddhiḥ kare tasya kubjikāsiddhireva ca | yadi kaṇṭhāmbuje dhyāyet kākacañcupuṭasthitaḥ || 64-275 || ityetāḥ sphūtīvidyā hi sarvapadmadalasthitāḥ | viyogaṃ sampravakṣyāmi yena mantrī ca nirbhayaḥ || 64-276 || strīputradhanamitrādilobhamohādipātakam | varjayitvā tanukleśaṃ vivekaṃ samupāśrayet || 64-277 || viyogaḥ sa hi vijñeyo mantranyāsaparāyaṇaḥ | atha vakṣye triyogendra pūrvajñānasamodayam || 64-278 || kāle kāle kriyāsiddhiścaṇḍikāpārśvago bhavet | pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūrvāhṇe vadanāmbhojamaṇḍalaḥ || 64-279 || jñānadravyasamarasairudayaṃ bhāvayed ravim | pūrva pūrvasvajanmādijñānasamodayaṃ labhet || 64-280 || ākāśe ca mano datvā ākāśākhyaṃ smaranmanum | pūrvajanmādisañjñānaṃ jānāti samabhāvakaḥ || 64-281 || iti te kathitaṃ nātha pūrvajñānasamodayam | athātra saṃpravakṣyāmi siddhaḥ śuddhaḥ phalārthabhāk || 64-282 || yena krameṇa sambhūyāt khecarīmelanaṃ prabho | yā yā samarasaprāptiḥ sā saiva phalasiddhidā || 64-283 || śṛṇu saṃkṣepato vakṣye paścādvaktavyameva tat | āsanādikamākṛtya kāyasaṅkocamācaran || 64-284 || kāmalatā kṣudratarairbheditā vasanāgrakaiḥ | tālumūlottare mūle niyojya madhupo bhavet || 64-285 || tadaiva japamākṛtya vāyuṃ dhṛtvā madhuṃ pibet | sā syātsamarasaprāptiḥ kāmaliṅge sthiro bhavet || 64-286 || ityeṣā kathitā vidyā latābhedaṃ śṛṇu prabho | śvetavāṭyālasūtreṇa nimītā yā latā śubhā || 64-287 || athavā padmasūtreṇa latāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | aṣṭādaśāṅgulamitaṃ nātisūkṣmaṃ pramāṇavat || 64-288 || jitvādhaḥ sanniveśyātha gharṣayet kāmasundara | tadā jitvā svayaṃ yāti gharṣaṇena punaḥ punaḥ || 64-289 || paścājjitvā kriyāṃ kuryāttālumūle nidhāya ca | krameṇāmṛtamāpnoti jihvādhaśchedane dhruvam || 64-290 || sā syātsamarasaprāptiryadi mantrākṣaraṃ bhajet | jīvabrahmabuddhimantāstu tiṣṭhanti nirañjane || 64-291 || kūṣmāṇḍākāradehī ca brahmasādhanatatparaḥ | sadā samarasaprāptiranāyāsena labhyate || 64-292 || jale sthale bhūmigarte śarīraṃ nāpi naśyati | ajarāmaradehī syād yogo'yaṃ yogidurlabhaḥ || 64-293 || kāyakalpanamāvakṣye yena siddhapatirbhavet | śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śambho gṛhasthānāṃ tu durlabham || 64-294 || mahāraṇye padmavane śītale gandhaśobhite | kāyakalpanamākṛtya bhāvayet kaṇṭhapaṅkajam || 64-295 || udāracittaḥ sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ | padme padme svadehasya kalpanā ca dale dale || 64-296 || kramaśaḥ kaṇṭhapadme ca svīyadehasya kalpanā | kriyate yadi yogendraistadā dehasya rakṣaṇam || 64-297 || anyathā mṛtyuvaśyaḥ syād yogabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥ | evaṃ krameṇa sarvatra kuryāt kāyasya kalpanam || 64-298 || jarāmaraṇaduḥkhādyairmucyate mohasaṅkaṭāt | athānyat sampravakṣyāmi kāyakalpanameva tat || 64-299 || nānāpīṭhe tvasādhye ca cakṣurindriyavajīte | manogamye sthiro bhūtvā svadehamapi kalpayet || 64-300 || vārāṇasyādipīṭhe ca mahājvālāmukhīpade | kurukṣetre prayāge ca dakṣiṇe dvārakādiṣu || 64-301 || haridvārodaye tīrthe mārkaṇḍeye ca kāpile | vṛndāvane guhyapīṭhe gaṅgāyamunayostaṭe || 64-302 || puṣkare pṛthivītīrthe kāyatīrthe gayādiṣu | kālakalpanamākṛtya śraddhāvān pūjayetparam || 64-303 || sadāśivaṃ sākinīśaṃ śākinīyoginīgaṇaiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ parayā bhaktyā dhyātvā dehaṃ prakalpayet || 64-304 || prakalpya svatanuṃ tatra tato devasya kalpayet | yeṣāṃ manasi yadvaynaṃ taddhayānaṃ kāyakalpanam || 64-305 || etatkāyakalpanena maunī vāksiddhimāpnuyāt | idānīṃ kāmadevasya mathanaṃ śṛṇu bhairava || 64-306 || kāmadevasya mathanaṃ sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ param | yāvad binduḥ sthiro dehe tāvanmṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ || 64-307 || bindupātādbhavennāśastato hi bindurakṣaṇam | tattadauṣadhamāvakṣye yena binduḥ sthiro bhavet || 64-308 || nityaṃ sevanamākuryā deteṣāṃ mūlamāharan | śvetāparājitāmūlaṃ siddhimūlaṃ tataḥ param || 64-309 || śatapaṇīmūlamekaṃ kadambamūlameva ca | śvetakundapuṣpamūlaṃ karavīraṃ tathāśitam || 64-310 || kṛṣṇadhustūramūlaṃ tu sephālīmūlameva ca | citāmūlaṃ tathā śambho nirguṇḍīmūlamāharan || 64-311 || ekīkṛtya vidhānena ravivāre'rkamūlakaiḥ | samabhāgena yogendra cūrṇīkṛtya pṛthak pṛthak || 64-312 || śukravāre ca pūrvāhṇe miśraṃ kuryāddanatrayam | ṣaḍrātri śodhayet kāmamudrābhirvāmadevatāḥ || 64-313 || madhyamāṅgulimuttolya dakṣiṇenāpi muṣṭinā | dhṛtvā ca śodhayedādau dravyamūlāni sādhakaḥ || 64-314 || vijayācūrṇayogena pibeccūrṇaṃ dvitolakam | ardhatolakamunaikyaṃ vijayāḥ sārdhatolakāḥ || 64-315 || miśrīkṛtya vidhāne'pi tattatkujadine śubhe | etatprabhakṣaṇenaiva madanaṃ vaśamānayet || 64-316 || yadā manasi āyāti puṣpadhanvā mahābalī | tadā taṃ pūjayitvā ca kāmadevaṃ nivārayet || 64-317 || iti kāmasya mathanaṃ dehe vyavasthitaṃ śṛṇu | aṅguṣṭhagulphajānūrusimanīliṅganābhiṣu || 64-318 || hṛdgrīvākaṇṭhadeśeṣu lambikāyāṃ tathā nasi | bhrūmadhye mastake rmūdhni vāyvākāśapriyālaye || 64-319 || vāyurūpaṃ svadehaṃ tu sthāpayitvā manuṃ japet | kumbhakaprāṇayogena nijadehavyavasthitiḥ || 64-320 || kaṇṭhāmbhoje sthiro yo hi taṃ janaṃ śṛṇu bhairava | yogārambhāvadhiryo hi strīsaṃsargaṃ vivarjayet || 64-321 || mātṝṇāṃ gamanaṃ nāsti yasya sa kaṇṭhasaṃsthitaḥ | nityaṃ karoti yogaṃ yo dharmātmā sthiracetasā || 64-322 || sa eva kaṇṭhapadme ca sthiro bhavati niścitam | bhāvajñānī ca yo vidvān taṃ vidāmi dayārṇava || 64-323 || kuṇḍalīsparśamātreṇa tanmayo jāyate kṣaṇāt | sarva deve paraṃ bhāvaṃ kṛtvā jñānena pūjayet || 64-324 || sarvapīṭhe sthiro bhūtvā jñānātmā paripūjayet | krameṇa kaṇṭhabhedaḥ syād yogī bhavati satvaram || 64-325 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dharāṃ dharmaṃ kītīmāyuryaśaḥ śriyam | turagān dantinaḥ putrān lokān sarvasvasvodayam || 64-326 || etajjñānaprasādena labhyate parameśvaram || 64-327 || jñātvā yogendracakraṃ tribhuvanavivaradhvāntajāla prakāśaṃ | mūlāmbhoje rasākhye daśadalavimale hṛtsvapadme vilāsam | kaṇṭhāmbhoje manojñe dvidalasvakamale bhāvayantaṃ surendraiḥ | śvetāmbhoje pareśaṃ niravadhigaganaṃ pūjaye bhāvayāmi || 64-328 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--) prakāśe bhairavībhairava saṃvāde kaṇṭhapadmabhedavijñānavinyāso | nāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 64 ||
[atha pañcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca atha kānta pravakṣyāmi samudāyaphalodayam | kaṇṭhāmbhojasya varṇānāṃ dhyānaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu prabho || 65-1 || śākinīsahitaṃ nityaṃ pūjayitvā sadāśivam | mūḍho'pi yogināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kimanye dhyānayoginaḥ || 65-2 || dhyātvā sampūjayedyastu so'bhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt | tato dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi vīranātha śṛṇu prabho || 65-3 || ādau śrīśākinīdhyānaṃ paścād dhyānaṃ sadāśive | dvayorabhedabuddhyā ca kāmajetā svayaṃ bhavet || 65-4 || vande nityāṃ suśīlāṃ tribhuvanavaradāṃ śākinīṃ pītavastrāṃ | vedādyāṃ vedamātāṃ sukhamayalalitāṃ vedahastojjvalāṅgīm | dhyāye pīyūṣadhārāmalaghaṭasudhayā snigdhadehāṃ hasantīṃ | māyāṃ śambhorlalāṭe vidhukiraṇakarāṃ śrīsadānandayuktām || 65-5 || ambhojāstrādimudrāsivaradajaṭā dhārayantīṃ karālaṃ | śyāmāṃ pīnastanāḍhyāṃ trinayanakamalāṃ pretaliṅgāsanasthām | sarvāṅgālaṅkṛtāṃ śrīṃ vidhuśatavadanāmbhojaśobhāṃ vahantīṃ | śambhorānandakatrīṃ caramaguṇapadāṃ sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpām || 65-6 || evaṃ dhyāyenmahāyogī sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpiṇīm | abhedyabhedakaraṇīṃ śaṅkara premavallabha || 65-7 || yā vidyā vāgbhavāḍhyā harivadhukamalā kevale niṣphalante | māyālakṣmīstrikūṭaṃ śaśimukhitadadhaḥ śākinī kṣetrapālam | vakṣadvandvaṃ trikūṭaṃ vadhumadharamivāsiddhimiṣṭāṃ vidhehi | svāhānto'yaṃ maheśatribhuvanabhavikāhlādahetoḥ prakāśaḥ || 65-8 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya vāgbhavaṃ tadanantaram | śākinī tvaṃ tadante tu mama doṣān vināśaya || 65-9 || yugalaṃ vahnikāntāṃ ca mantrārthāḥ sāradāḥ smṛtāḥ | kāmarājaṃ samuddhṛtya hiraṇyākṣi sanātani || 65-10 || śākinyante mahāmāye māyāvahniśriyā yutam | eṣā mantrātmikā vidyā kaṇṭhāmbhojaprakāśinī || 65-11 || śākambharī mahāvidyā tasya vāme vibhāti ca | tasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi jñātvaiva yogavit prabhuḥ || 65-12 || mahāmantrasya māhātmyaṃ kathituṃ naiva śakyate | bhāvamātreṇa siddhiḥ syāt kiṃ punarmokṣasādhanam || 65-13 || vidyāṃ kāmakalāṃ vicitravasanāṃ padmāsanasthāṃ śivāṃ | kāmākhyāṃ sakalān svarān trijagatāṃ śākairmahāyoginī | nityaṃ yā paripālyate bhagavatīṃ śākambharīṃ tāṃ bhaje | sā yogādhipa(--)rakṣakā niśi diśi śrīkaṇṭhapadme prabhā || 65-14 || adyāpi priyakaṇṭhapadmanikare sambhāti śākambharī | vidyāvākkamalāyutaṃ smitamukhi prānte ca śākambhari | vahnirvāruṇavāyubījamanaladvandvaṃ hi vakṣadvayaṃ | vahnipremakalānvito manuvaraḥ sākṣājjagatkṣobhakṛt || 65-15 || śākambharīṃ mahāmāyāṃ pūjayed dvāradevatām | tadante sarvadevāśca śakrādīn paripūjayet || 65-16 || dhyātvā ca śākinīṃ devīṃ śākambharyāśca dakṣiṇe | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā pūrvoktavidhinā prabho || 65-17 || śākambharīṃ trinayanāṃ sūryenduvahniyojitām | raktapadmasthitāṃ śyāmāṃ vedabāhuśriyojjvalām || 65-18 || varābhayakarāṃ khaḍgakapālakamalānvitām | nānālaṅkāraśobhāṅgī muktakuntalabhūṣitām || 65-19 || prasannavadanāmbhojasmitahāsyavirājitām | sādhakābhīṣṭadāṃ nityāṃ mahāvidyāṃ bhajāmyaham || 65-20 || tato mānasapūjāñca dhyānānte tu samācaret | punardhyānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā cittāvāhanamācaret || 65-21 || pādyādyaiḥ pūjayennityaṃ bhaktyā ca yogasiddhaye | tato japecchataṃ vāpi cāṣṭottarasahasrakam || 65-22 || evaṃ lakṣasamāpte tu kaṇṭhe devīṃ prapaśyati | homādīn kramaśaḥ kuryād brāhmaṇānāṃ tu bhojanam || 65-23 || tadante śākinīpūjā prathame vāpi kārayet | tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu prāṇavallabhe kāmasundari || 65-24 || ādau jalaṃ śodhayitvā hastau pādau ca vigraham | kṣālayitvā dvirācamya mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 65-25 || śikhābandhanamākṛtya cāsanaṃ pariśodhayet | tato'rghyasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ nirmāya yatnataḥ || 65-26 || pīṭhacakraṃ śodhayitvā pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaret | tato dhyānaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ nyāsajālaṃ samācaret || 65-27 || punaḥ prāṇāyāmayugmaṃ kṛtvā dehaṃ dṛḍhaṃ nayet | tato dhyānaṃ mānasārcā mudrādarśanameva ca || 65-28 || tataḥ pādyaṃ tathārghyaṃ tu cāruśaṅkhena kārayet | ācamanīyaṃ tataḥ snānaṃ punarācamanaṃ tathā || 65-29 || gandhaṃ puṣpāṇi sarvāṇi bilvapatrāṇi dāpayet | nijāvaraṇadevāṃśca pūjayitvā krameṇa tu || 65-30 || dhūpadīpau nivedyātha naivedyaṃ pānakaṃ tataḥ | punarācamanaṃ datvā balidravyāṇi dāpayet || 65-31 || baliṃ datvā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ vā śatāṣṭakam | divase yajjapaṃ kuryādrātrau tajjāpyamāśrayet || 65-32 || japaṃ samarpayed vidvān guhyātiguhyamantrakaiḥ | prāṇāyāmaṃ triṣaṭkṛtvā vandanaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam || 65-33 || stotrañca kavacaṃ nityaṃ sahasranāmamaṅgalam | paṭhed bhaktyā kaṇṭhapadme kāyakalpanakṛnnaraḥ || 65-34 || evaṃ vidhividhānena pūjayitvā sadāśivam | asmiñchāstre kriyā guptā guptanārī prapūjanam || 65-35 || athavā manasā sarvaṃ pūjāyāgajapaṃ caret | yathā devyāstathā śambhorjapayāgaḥ samīritaḥ || 65-36 || evaṃ krameṇa pūjyāśca bāhyasthā munayaḥ kramāt | pūjyā varṇakalā nātha tadbāhyasthānaṃ prapūjayet || 65-37 || evaṃ hi māsakāryeṇa varaṃ siddhiṃ samāpnuyāt || 65-38 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde śākinīsadāśivārcanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 65 ||
[atha ṣaṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
ānandabhairavī uvāca kailāsaśikharārūḍha pañcavaktra trilocana | sarvabhūtaprapūjyātha śākinīyajanaṃ śṛṇu || 66-1 || pūjanaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ manaḥ sākṣādvacomayam | mānasaṃ yogināṃ proktaṃ sākṣāt pūjāgṛhaṃ prabho || 66-2 || vācāmayaṃ tāmasānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ kāmināṃ prabho | ekā pūjā ca trividhā kathitā parameśvara || 66-3 || sā pūjā siddhidā kāle trikāle sarvakālake | kāle siddhirgṛhasthānāṃ trikāle brahmacāriṇām || 66-4 || yogināṃ sarvakāle'pi viphalā duṣṭacetasām | bhāvatrayaṃ hi pūjānāṃ rajaḥ sattvatamomayam || 66-5 || triśaktipūjanaṃ nātha sarvatra parikītītam | brahmāṇīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tatra pūjayet tāṃ maheśvarīm || 66-6 || tribhāvena pūjayitvā śaktiṃ brahmatrayeṇa ca | paśurūpavīrarūpadivyarūpeṇa pūjayet || 66-7 || balidānaṃ hi sarvatra paraṃ mokṣāya kevalam | krameṇa śṛṇu yogeśa sarvāvidyādipūjanam || 66-8 || yatkṛtvā sambhaved yogī paraṃ brahmamayo'cirāt || 66-9 || sthānaṃ vīkṣya mahendra koṭisadṛśaṃ śrīlakṣaṇairlakṣitaṃ | devānāṃ divi vīranātha ruciraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ sukham | ramyaṃ devagṛhānvitaṃ parajalairvyāptaṃ tarucchāyayā | saugandhādiṣu mānyaśailapavanaṃ kāle vasante'pi vā || 66-10 || śūnye devagṛhe tale varatarościttāpītātmā yati(--) | ścāmbhojāsanasaṃsthito mṛdukaṭe vyāghrājine vāraṇe | ādau pādayugaṃ bhuvi sthitamiti vyāśodhya hastau tathā | nīraṃ nirmalagandharājamilitaṃ saṃkṣālya padmāsanaḥ || 66-11 || jalaśodhanamantrastu śrūyatāṃ parameśvara | praṇavaṃ staraṇaprānte vajrodakamataḥ param || 66-12 || śodhayāmi tataḥ svāhā jalamantra udāhṛtaḥ | prakṣipettajjalaṃ bhinnajale bhairavaśaṅkara || 66-13 || hastau pādau tajjalena kṣālayet kāmamāyayā | vigrahaṃ mūlamantreṇa cācamane dve udāhṛte || 66-14 || śikhābandhanamantrastu śṛṇūnmattakumāraka | aprakāśyaṃ mahāmantraṃ śikhābandhanamāsanam || 66-15 || śodhayet tripurānātha kālāgniśikhayojjvala | āsanaṃ śodhayāmyadya dvārapālo bhavāniśam || 66-16 || praṇavādyairnamo'ntena śodhayet parameśvara | śodhayet tripurānātha kālāgniśikhayojjvala || 66-17 || śikhāgraṃ bandhayāmyadya dvārapālo bhavāniśam | tato'rghya sthāpayed vidvān śaṅkhādhāre manorame || 66-18 || mūlamantreṇa saṃkṣālya tato mūlena pūrayet | raktacandanayuktena jalena candanena ca || 66-19 || tato dūrvārghyaṃ puṣpāṇi sādhāre dāpayet sudhīḥ | daśadhā mūlamantraṃ tu tatra japtvā sudhāmayam || 66-20 || dhenamudrāṃ matsyamudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet | japet tatra sāramantramācchādya matsyamudrayā || 66-21 || ātmānaṃ prokṣayedādau tato dravyāṇi prokṣayet | tataḥ pīṭhaṃ sunirmāya tāmre hemaśalākayā || 66-22 || navakoṇaṃ vilikhyātha ṣaṭkoṇañca tadantare | bāhye ca maṇḍaladvandvaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ tato likhet || 66-23 || tadbāhye ca caturdvāraṃ bhūbimbadvitayaṃ punaḥ | evaṃ pīṭhaṃ vinirmāya dale'rṇān vilikhettataḥ || 66-24 || oṃ surekhāyai namaḥ svāhā mantreṇa parilekhayet | praṇavañca mahārekhāśabdānte śodhayāmi yuk || 66-25 || vahnibījāyādimanūn śodhayet pīṭhacakrakam | pīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt praṇavādinamo'ntakaiḥ || 66-26 || sāṃpadaṃ pūrvamuccārya hṛdayāya namastataḥ | ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena pūjayed vāmataḥ sudhīḥ || 66-27 || pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ catudīkṣu ca madhyake | pūjayitvā ca tanmadhye varṇoccāraṇapūrvakaiḥ || 66-28 || pīṭhaśaktiṃ pūjayitvā pīṭhanāyakamarcayet | praṇavādinamo'ntena sarvatra pratipūjayet || 66-29 || pīṭhaśaktiṃ śākinīṃ tu tathā śākambharīṃ śivām | lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ caṇḍikāṃ gaṇanāyikām || 66-30 || bhadrakālīṃ viśālākṣīṃ śraddhāṃ māyāṃ dayāṃ kalām | raṇacaṇḍāṃ madhumatīṃ prasannāṃ ratnamālinīm || 66-31 || hiraṇyavarṇāṃ kaumārīṃ vāgdevīṃ trijaṭāṃ mahīm | triśūlinīṃ vedamātāṃ siddhādyāṃ madhunāyikām || 66-32 || madhupureśvarīṃ kubjāṃ tathā madhumatīṃ yajet | śākākhyāṃ śākacakṣāñca varahastāṃ hasanmukhīm || 66-33 || kapālinīṃ khaḍgahastāṃ vanamālāñca mādhavīm | vicitrāṅgī lalajjihvāṃ cekitānāṃ prabhāmayīm || 66-34 || sarvāṃ sarvākaṣīṇīñca bahurūpāṃ surāṃ sudhām | sarvamayīṃ varṇamayīṃ muṇḍamālāṃ trikālikām || 66-35 || viśveśvarīṃ viśvamātāṃ mahāvidyāṃ sanātanīm | etā vidyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ praṇavādinamo'ntikāḥ || 66-36 || tato dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu priye | śākinīṃ śrīvedavidyāṃ sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpiṇīm || 66-37 || pītavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ vedahastāṃ hasanmukhīm | sadāśivayutāṃ gaurīṃ sarvālaṅkāramaṇḍitām || 66-38 || trilocanāṃ sūryacandravahnimaṇḍalamaṇḍitām | kapālapadmavimalavarābhayakarāmbujām || 66-39 || devadānavagandharvayogisiddhaprapūjitām | ṣoḍaśāramahāpadmasaṃsthitāṃ vanamālinīm || 66-40 || śākambharīdevavidyāmādhavīśaktiśobhitām | munideva mahendrādibrahmaviṣṇuśivāśrayām || 66-41 || dhyāye'haṃ kaṇṭhapadmasthāṃ sarvasiddhisamṛddhidām | evaṃ dhyātvā kaṇṭhapadme bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataścaret || 66-42 || bhūtaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi yena kaṇṭhe sthiro bhavet | ākāśagāminī siddhirlabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 66-43 || saṃyojya jīvaṃ kulavastramadhye | śrī kuṇḍalinyā saha mūlapadmam | krameṇa bhitvā samayordhvatuṇḍo | viśuddhapadme layamācared budhaḥ || 66-44 || śākinīpārśvabhāge tu jīvaṃ saṃsthāpayet sudhīḥ | kuṇḍalinyā layaṃ kṛtvā vahnibījena bhasmasāt || 66-45 || dehaṃ tadā vidadhīta vāyubījena śoṣayet | varuṇenāmṛtaṃ kṛtvā vedanārahito bhavet || 66-46 || dhairyeṇa bhāvayeddevaṃ śākinīśaṃ sadāśivam | trailokyānvitamīśānaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam || 66-47 || pūrvoktadhyānamākuryānmantrākṣarāṇi bhāvayet | cicchaktau paramātmānaṃ bhāvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || 66-48 || ātmalagnaṃ tatra pade kṛtvā cintāmaṇiṃ bhajet | dhūmrākāraṃ mahākāśaṃ vicintya tejasāvṛtam || 66-49 || līlāmayaṃ devatāyā rūpaṃ sampūjya mānasaiḥ | krameṇa nāsikādvārāt so'haṃbījena cālayet || 66-50 || ānīya saṃmukhe pīṭhe saṃsthāpya jīvamarpayet | tatraiva saṃsthiro bhūtvā tatprāṇān tatra sthāpayet || 66-51 || āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ śabdamuccārya yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ tataḥ param | ityādyaiḥ sthāpayet prāṇān tato'rcavidhimācaret || 66-52 || nyāsajālaṃ tataḥ kuryāt śṛṇu tattvāsanādikam | sadāśiva ṛṣiścāsya mastake saṃnyaset sudhīḥ || 66-53 || sadāśivāya ṛṣaye namaḥ praṇavamādyake | mukhe praṇavamuccārya cānuṣṭupchandase namaḥ || 66-54 || hṛdi praṇavamuccārya śākinyai tadanantaram | sadāśivaprayuktāyai devatāyai namastataḥ || 66-55 || karāṅganyāsau saṅkuryāt ṣaḍdīrghasvarasaṃyutaiḥ | sakārairdevadeveśa mātṛkāṃ bījasampuṭām || 66-56 || mātṛkāsthānamālambya sāṃbījena tu vā caret | vyāpakaṣoḍaśavāraṃ prāṇayāmayugaṃ care || 66-57 || punardhyānaṃ mānasārcā yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet | padmamudrāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pādyādyaiḥ paripūjayet || 66-58 || ādau mūlaṃ samuccārya etatpādyaṃ tataḥ smaret | sadāśivaprayuktāyai śākinyai nama ityapi || 66-59 || evaṃ krameṇa pūrvārghyamācamanīyaṃ nivedayet | snānīyaṃ kramato dadyāt punarācamanīyakam || 66-60 || gandhaṃ puṣpāṇi mūlena dadyād bhaktyā sadāśive | bilvapatrāṇi mūlena datvā varuṇamarcayet || 66-61 || dhenumudrāṃ matsyamudrāṃ siṃhamudrāṃ pradarśayet | praṇavaṃ sāṃ hṛdayāya namaścāgnau prapūjayet || 66-62 || praṇavañca sīṃ śirase svāhayā nairṛte yajet | praṇavaṃ sūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaḍ vāyau yajet kramāt || 66-63 || praṇavaṃ saiṃ kavacāya kūrcamīśe prapūjayet | madhye sauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ praṇavamādyake || 66-64 || catudīkṣu tataḥ paścāt saḥ astrāya tato hi phaṭ | praṇavādyaṃ pūjayitvā mastake ṛṣimarcayet || 66-65 || praṇavaṃ mūlaṛṣaye sadāśivāya kṛttataḥ | pūrvādivāmataḥ pūjyāḥ parivārādidevatāḥ || 66-66 || ānandabhairavaṃ paścānmahākālaṃ samarcayet | ( jñānānandaṃ sadānandaṃ bhairavānandameva ca | śyāmānandaṃ śivānandaṃ kālānandaṃ tataḥ param ) sudhānandaṃ harānandaṃ surānandaṃ samarcayet || 66-67 || kulānandaṃ priyānandaṃ yajñānandamataḥ param | dhyānānandaṃ parānandaṃ yogānandaṃ samarcayet || 66-68 || krodhānandaṃ kriyānandaṃ bodhānandaṃ tathārcayet | devānandaṃ jayānandaṃ vijayānandameva ca || 66-69 || brahmānandaṃ prabhānandaṃ pūrṇānandaṃ samarcayet | jagadānandarūpaṃ tu mamājñāgurucakragam || 66-70 || pūjayitvā dehaśaktimeteṣāṃ pārśvake yajet | kalyāṇīṃ kāmakanyāṃ tripurāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ tathā || 66-71 || vidyādharīṃ nīlavarṇāṃ śyāmāṃ siṃhāsanasthitām | caṇḍikāmupakanyāñca candracūḍasarasvatīm || 66-72 || kapilāṃ meghadūtāñca dhūmravarṇāṃ jaṭādharām | trilocanāṃ khecarīñca gaganāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm || 66-73 || pīnakucāṃ vyāghramukhīṃ madhupānāṃ madonmadām | ramyāṃ snehakalāṃ dharmāṃ tathā madhumatīṃ harām || 66-74 || hāramālāṃ vanamālāṃ cakorāṃ kulakāminīm | pūjitāṃ gurusarvāṇīṃ sarvatattvasvarūpiṇīm || 66-75 || pūjayet sarvataḥ śaktyā īśānāntaṃ krameṇa tu | tanmadhye keśavaṃ dhyātvā dalasvaramupārcayet || 66-76 || akārādiṣoḍaśārṇān praṇavādinamo'ntikān | nīlavarṇān saraktāḍhyān kuṅkumālaktaveṣṭitān || 66-77 || vidyutkoṭisamābhāsapadmarāgasamojjvalān | manorathapūrṇakarān jagadānandavardhakān || 66-78 || supriyākaṇṭhatālvādiparamātmapradarśakān | teṣāṃ nāmnā pūjayitvā yathā mārtaṇḍamaṇḍale || 66-79 || tathā'tra te pūjitāḥ syuḥ svasvanāmapracoditāḥ | śṛṇu nātha mahākāya madonmatta digambara || 66-80 || sthiracetāḥ sadā bhūtvā pūjaya tvaṃ hi śākinīm | tatra padmakaṇīkāyāṃ śavarūpaṃ sadāśivam || 66-81 || dhyātvā tadgatamadhye tu pīṭhacakraṃ prapūjayet | mūlādhāre kāmarūpaṃ kāmacakraṃ trilakṣaṇam || 66-82 || pīṭhāya nama uccārya cādyatārakamuccaret | hṛdi jālandharaṃ pīṭhaṃ siddhapīṭhaṃ tricakrakam || 66-83 || lalāṭe pūrṇagiryākhyaṃ hiṅgulādaṃ supīṭhakam | uḍḍiyānaṃ tadūrdhve tu meghakuñjaṃ svapīṭhakam || 66-84 || mahāpīṭhaṃ bhruvormadhye vārāṇasīñca liṅgaka | locanatrayamadhye tu jvalantīsiddhapīṭhakam || 66-85 || jvālāmukhī triveṇī ca pīṭhatrayamudāhṛtam | trilocane tripīṭhaṃ me avaśyaṃ paripūjayet || 66-86 || mukhāmbuje pūjayed vai māyāratiṃ subhadrikām | kampillanagaraṃ vaṃśanagaraṃ kāmabhañjanam || 66-87 || hiraṇyanagaraṃ tatra ekadantārasāyanām | kapālapīṭhaṃ tālvākhyaṃ phaṇipīṭhaṃ mukhe yajet || 66-88 || kaṇṭhe madhupurīpīṭhaṃ sudhāpīṭhaṃ tadantike | āhlādapīṭhaṃ śrīpīṭhaṃ śūnyapīṭhaṃ priyāñjalam || 66-89 || purañjanākhyaṃ bhadrākhyaṃ kaṇṭhe ambhapurī mama | nābhau mahāpīṭharājamayodhyābhavapīṭhakam || 66-90 || lakṣmīpīṭhaṃ brahmapīṭhaṃ lāṅgalīpīṭhameva ca | mānapīṭhaṃ jñānapīṭhaṃ rudrapīṭhaṃ tadantike || 66-91 || lākinī kulapāpīṭhaṃ valākāpīṭhameva ca | raudraprabhāmahāpīṭhaṃ mlecchavāsisupīṭhakam || 66-92 || makkāsiddhakarīpīṭhaṃ nirañjanasvapīṭhakam | brāhmīpīṭhaṃ dattapīṭhamabhayāpīṭhameva ca || 66-93 || raṃgiṇīpīṭhamevaṃ hi phetkārīpīṭhamarcayet | gargarīsiddhapīṭhaṃ ca candraśekharaśailakam || 66-94 || haridvārākhyapīṭhaṃ tu samudrapīṭhamarcayet | kaṭyāṃ saṅketapīṭhaṃ ca kāñcīpīṭhaṃ trighargharam || 66-95 || śūlinīpīṭhamabhyarcya laṅkāpīṭhaṃ samarcayet | vāruṇīpīṭhamabhyarcya vajrapīṭhaṃ samarcayet || 66-96 || siddhakaṭāhapīṭhañca mahāsaṃhārapīṭhakam | ṣaṭpīṭhaṃ drāviḍāpīṭhaṃ viṣṇupīṭhaṃ rasānvitam || 66-97 || dalapīṭhaṃ tathā rādhāpīṭhaṃ pañcanalākhyakam | kuṇḍalīcakrapīṭhaṃ tu kāmapīṭhaṃ samarcayet || 66-98 || mahāvāyvākāśapīṭhaṃ trikālacakrapīṭhakam | brahmapīṭhaṃ dharāpīṭhaṃ śatrupīṭhaṃ samarcayet || 66-99 || kuñjarākhyaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāladharmākhyapīṭhakam | tadvāme ḍākinīpīṭhaṃ garbhapīṭhaṃ tadantike || 66-100 || mayūrapīṭhamabhyarcya gāruḍīpīṭhamarcayet | praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya cātra pīṭhasthitān svarān || 66-101 || pūjayāmi padmapuṣpaiḥ prasannāḥ prabhavantu te | pūjayitvā pīṭhalokaṃ śivalokaṃ samarcayet || 66-102 || kṣetrapālalokamevaṃ dhūmralokaṃ trilokakam | pūjayet sāgarān sapta bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 66-103 || tārāgrahagaṇakrāntalokapālayutāni ca | pūjayitvā tadbāhye ca śaktividyāḥ prapūjayet || 66-104 || ḍākinī rākiṇī pūjyā lākinī kākinī tathā | śākinī hākinī paścāt prabhā nīlā ca bodhinī || 66-105 || unmanī bhāvinī cintā priyāṅgī mānaseśvarī | ulkāmukhī krodhamukhī vipracittā subhadrikā || 66-106 || nāginī nāgamālā ca pṛthivītīrthavāsinī | akalaṅkā jāhnavī ca svargagaṅgā manonmanī || 66-107 || saṃ satvasthā raṃ rajaḥsthā taṃ tamaḥ sthā prapūjayet | sarvāṃ devīṃ pūjayed vai praṇavādinamo'ntikām || 66-108 || dhūpadīpau svamūlena dadyāt sādhakayogirāṭ | naivedyaṃ śodhayitvā ca dadyāt pānārthakaṃ prabho || 66-109 || punarācamanaṃ datvā viśeṣabalimarpayet | pūrvoktastu māmānena pañcatattvakriyādibhiḥ || 66-110 || anena manunā dadyāt balitrayamanuttamam | praṇavaṃ kālamāye'nte sarvapīṭhanivāsini || 66-111 || tadante kālikābījaṃ svabījaṃ tadanantaram | ākāśavāhinītyante baliṃ gṛhṇa tataḥ param || 66-112 || pañcatattvādimilitaṃ kapāle tadanantaram | parigṛhṇayugaṃ paścāt śabdabījaṃ tato dvijaḥ || 66-113 || anena manunā dadyād balitrayamanuttamam | sarvatra mānasairyogī dadāti pūjanaṃ balim || 66-114 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā japenmantraṃ yathāvidhi | sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi cāṣṭottarasamanvitam || 66-115 || divase yajjapaṃ kuryādrātrau tajjāpyamāśrayet | japaṃ samarpayed devyā vāmahaste tu mantrakaiḥ || 66-116 || guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu me devi tvatprasādāt sureśvari || 66-117 || prāṇāyāmaṃ triṣaṭkṛtvā vandanaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam | saṃvande varade devi trailokyakulapāvani || 66-118 || sarvasiddhiprade devi śākinī tvāṃ namāmyaham | vedavidyāprakāśe tvaṃ nānāvidyāvinodini || 66-119 || bhavāni siddhide devi varadā bhava sarvadā | sarvadānavahantrī tvaṃ mama śatrūn vināśaya || 66-120 || akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ kulakaumāriśākini | sadāśivayute nitye sadāśivavihāriṇi || 66-121 || amaratvaṃ sadā dehi bhaktiṃ muktiṃ prayaccha me | śākinī prāṇade devi devānāṃ prāṇarakṣiṇi || 66-122 || śākambhari namaste'stu mama dehaṃ samāśraya | vāñchākalpatarormūle sthāyini premadāyini || 66-123 || sarvalokācīte siddhikaṇṭhapadme sthirā bhava || 66-124 || kaṇṭhāmbhoruhamaṇḍale suvimale vāñchāphale jvālinī | kāmākhye praṇamāmi śākini padaṃ mātahī śākambhari | devānāṃ jagatāṃ hitāya vinaye samyagvaraśrīprade | sthityādikramasaṃsthitā bhava mahākāśaprabhācañcale || 66-125 || iti praṇamya bhāvena bhuktimuktī labhed dhruvam | pūjāphalamavāpnoti pradakṣiṇarato naraḥ || 66-126 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śākinīyajanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 66 ||
[atha saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kuru nātha vandanaṃ bho pūjanaṃ kavacaṃ paṭha | varṇādhyānaṃ kaṇṭhapadme sthiro bhava jagatpate || 67-1 || paramā śākinī vidyā mahāmohanivāriṇī | yoginīkoṭibhiḥ sārdhaṃ rājate sūryavat sadā || 67-2 || vārāṇasīpure sthitvā kaṇṭhapadmasthitāṃ bhaja | stotreṇānena vidhinā bhaktiṃ kuru mahāśive || 67-3 || akhaṇḍe nīlapaṅkeruhavimalakare sthāpitāṃ ṣoḍaśāre | hemābhāṃ vidyutābhāṃ sukaṇakavalayāṃ candrakoṭiprabhāvām | śrīkanyāṃ śākinīśāṃ tripuraharakarāmbhojapūjāvinodīṃ | kāmākhyāṃ rudramāyāṃ vadhunayanayutāṃ śakrakāntaprakāśām || 67-4 || sindhusthāṃ bhāvayāmi pramathagaṇavadhūprojjvalāṃ vedayuktāṃ | yogendrānandakartrīṃ kamalavalayāṃ nīlajīmūtanetrām | oṅkārāṃ kāraṇākhyāṃ madhugṛhanikarāmaṣṭagehaprakāśā(--) | mānandajñānanityāṃ dvivinadalakalāṃ kaṇṭhavaikuṇṭhaśobhām || 67-5 || dharmārthajñānadātrīṃ tribhuvanabhuvikāhlādahetoḥ prakāśyāṃ | vindhyasthāṃ pīṭhakanyāṃ trikamalanayanāṃ vedahastāṃ prasannām | smerāsyāṃ candravaktrāṃ hariharavidhibhirdhyānagamyāṃ kadāci(--) | cchambhusthāṃ cārurūpāṃ bhavabhayaharaṇīṃ tāriṇīṃ bhāvayāmi || 67-6 || sūkṣmāṃ sthūlaprabhāḍhyāṃ caraṇatalavibhākoṭibandhūkakāntiṃ | kāntānāṃ kāmakāntāṃ jayaratibhavatīṃ śākinīṃ śokahantrīm | śabdāntaḥprāntarasthāṃ sthitilayagaganāṃ padmarāgasrajāḍhyāṃ | kāntyā viśvaṃ jvalantīṃ madanavadhuramābījamālāṃ smarāmi || 67-7 || vyāghrasthāṃ vyāghravastrāṃ hariṇanayanakaiḥ kevalānandarūpāṃ | vāmāṃ śaktiṃ pravālāṃ trikulajalakalāṃ kālarājeśvarīṃ yām | ānandābdhau prabhāntīṃ prabhugaṇabhayahāṃ mātṛkābījabhūṣāṃ | ghorāmaṭṭāṭṭahāsyāṃ daśanasuhasanāṃ cārunetrāṃ bhajāmi || 67-8 || bālādityāyutābhāṃ caramapadamadāṃ madyamādhuryabhakṣāṃ | kṣoṇīsiṃhāsanasthāṃ maṇimayajapamālābhirvarānandahastām | mātallīlākalāpāṃ taratanuvimalāṃ cāmale kaṇṭhapame | nityajñānaprakāśāṃ bhajati mama sadānandacittāvasannām || 67-9 || hālāpānodyatāṅgīṃ paramasukhamayīṃ vedasantānakartrīṃ | yogānandādikartrīṃ taruṇaghanaghaṭāghorarūpāṃ karālām | ākāśāmbhojamadhye'vikalakarayuṣā vyāpakāṅgaprakāśāṃ | sā mātā śrīṃ vahantīṃ parisamayakalau mokṣabhaktiṃ bhaje tvām || 67-10 || sā vidyādharmacintāmaṇiguṇajanitā yojitā jātu bhītau | śabdabrahmaikahetusthalanilayamahājñānasākṣipratītā | tvaṃ mātā vedamātā hara hara kaluṣaṃ bāliśaṃ tārayantī | jīvātmānaṃ dvirakṣakṣayamaraṇabhayabhrāntimābhañjayantī || 67-11 || jvālā mālāvilolā kalayati kaluṣaṃ śākinī saiva mātā | yātāyātaprabhātodayadivasaniśābhrāntimohārināśā | dāsānāmāmavāsā vasati śaśigṛhe kātīkeśāsuvaṃśā | saṃsāre'śādihaṃsā cala cala capalaṃ tvaṃ kalāṣoḍaśāre || 67-12 || bījātmā yajñakuṇḍe racayati caraṇācchandasāṃ gadyapadyaiḥ | pātāle bhūkarāle kulayugadalake nirgatā vedaśaktiḥ | paśyantī madhyamādyā nayanavacanagā vaikharī vāksvarūpā | kaṇṭhe hṛtpadmamūle kathayati kavitā stambhitāstvāṃ prayāmi || 67-13 || parā sā parvā sā rahitamatahāsā praviśa me | ghanaśyāme vāme dvikamalalalāṭe'tiśikhayā | vahantī sindūraṃ trijapaparayānāmaparayā mukhāmbhoje vaśyā bhavabhavayugaṃ ṣoḍaśadale || 67-14 || ramā lajjā māyā vadhumadanakūrccāstrasahite | hite mātaḥ śākambhari dharaṇi bālā kamalayā | niśārdhe śatrvaṅgaṃ hana hana kare saṃhara ripuṃ | tritārī ṣaṭkūṭā madanavadhujāhnijāyā hara agham || 67-15 || yogendrānandamudrāṃ taratanutapanāṃ tāpinīṃ taptadehāṃ | mugdhānāṃ mohamugdhāṃ mukuṭaśaśimaṇicchāyayācchannaveśām | kāmākhyāṃ brahmabījadhvanimadanakulādyādibījapratiṣṭhāṃ | svāhāntāṃ bhāvayāmi kṣitisurapatihaṃsākhyabrahmāstravidyām || 67-16 || sāyāhne kāmalakṣmīḥ pavanavidhuyutā dīrghanetrā trinetrā | sāvitrī madhyakāle na calati calati śraddhayā mastakordhve | koṭyarkābhāsamānā na namati kuṭilaṃ tejasā vyākulālaṃ | kālolkākoṭikūṭaṃ ramayati dhavalāsyāruṇāṅgī prabhāte || 67-17 || gāyatrī varṇamātrāmitavanavanitā mānitā bhālakūpe | hālākālānalāṅgī timiraharapadālīḍhapādāravindā | tvaṃ vidyā vāgbhavādyā praṇavatanumayī devalakṣmīḥ prasādā | nādādyācārdhacandrojjvalayugalaṃ ṣoḍaśāre mamāre || 67-18 || jāyā māyā vimāyā hayamukhi vimale kevale tārahāre | hārārkacitritāṅgi svavadhuyugayuge tārayadvandvacandre | svāhā medhā svadhā tvaṃ śrutinutisunatigranthivāgvādinī tvaṃ | māmekaṃ rakṣayugmaṃ dharaṇidharasukhaṃ sañcayāgnipriyāntā || 67-19 || etat stavavaraṃ paṭhedyadi sadā dhyātvā narendraḥ sukhī | dhanyaḥ puṇyamupaiti devavilayaṃ pīṭhādisandarśanam | yogānāmapi siddhibhākpriyataraṃ jñānaṃ dhanaṃ labhyate | rājānaṃ vaśayanti te ca sahasā sākṣāt kaṭākṣai ramām || 67-20 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde śākinīstotravinyāso nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 67 ||
[athāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya pūjayāmi tavānaghe | saṃsāravilayārthāya tava śrīcaraṇāmbujam || 68-1 || mahādevi jagaddhātri paramānandavadhīni | bhavāni bhairavi prāṇe varṇadhyānaṃ vadāmalam || 68-2 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca atha kāmeśa gaurāṅga dharmādharmapradarśaka | idānīṃ śṛṇu sarvajña mahājñānanirūpaṇam || 68-3 || varṇadhyānaṃ tava snehāt kathaye mama rūpakam | akasmāt siddhidaṃ dhyānaṃ jñānamātreṇa siddhyati || 68-4 || akāraṃ dhyāye'haṃ hariharacaturvaktravibudhaiḥ | sadā dhyeyaṃ śuklaṃ vidhumukhivadhuśrīśrutibhujam | vidheyaṃ kaumāraṃ trinayanamalaṅkārajaḍitaṃ | kapālābjāstrāhimahitaśitāṃśuprabhakaram || 68-5 || āṃ bījāḍhyāṃ prabhāsāṃ kanakaghaṭamadhuprītimānāṃ vimānāṃ | śuklacchāyāṃ vahantīṃ śrutibhujasahitāṃ padmanālākhyamālām | khaḍgaṃ tāṃ dhārayantīṃ mukuṭamaṇiruciṃ krodhamākāśadeśaṃ | nānālaṅkāradīptiṃ himakarakapilāvāhanīṃ bhāvayāmi || 68-6 || iṃ māyāṃ bhuvanasthitāṃ vadhuyutāṃ śrīṣoḍaśīsaṃyutāṃ | māyālakṣaṇalakṣitāṃ trijagatāṃ vidyābhayaśrīpadām | hastāmbhojacatuṣṭayāṃ trinayanāṃ śūlāsimālāmbujāṃ | nānāratnajanūpurāṃ suranatāṃ dhyāye viśuddhāmbuje || 68-7 || koṭyarkābhāsamānāṃ kanakamayamahālaṅkṛtāṃ dhyānagamyāṃ | īkārākāramūtīṃ trinayanakamalāṃ vedahāsyojjvalāṅgīm | śaṅkhāmbhojāsighaṇṭāsahitatanuvarāṃ devasiṃhāsanasthāṃ | vedasthāṃ vedasiddhāṃ rudhiraśitayutāṃ bālalīlāṃ bhajāmi || 68-8 || ukāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ trimunisahitaṃ kāñcanarasaṃ | hayaṃ haṃsārūḍhaṃ ivarasanayutaṃ mandirājālavādyam | viśālaṃ vedāsyaṃ śataravisuvarṇaṃ trinayanaṃ | jaṭākuṇḍāhlādaṃ taruṇapuruṣaṃ naumi satatam || 68-9 || uṃ(****)kāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ vidhuśatajaṭitaṃ kāñcanābhaṃ trisargaṃ | mandārairmānasāptaṃ pracayaghanarasaṃ śuddhasūtrākṣamālam | hastau dvau saṃvahantaṃ phaṇigaṇalalanāmālayānandarūpaṃ | siddhānāmiṣṭasiddhiṃ kulakamalaghanaṃ bhāvaye ṣoḍaśāre || 68-10 || ṛṃkāraṃ saptarekhāsahitavimalayā mālayā śobhitāṅgaṃ | māyāvisthaṃ prasannānanakamalavaraṃ vāraṇākāradeham | puṇyaṃ yajñādisiddhaṃ madanaśaśikalāmādanaṃ ṣaḍbhujāḍhyaṃ | ghaṇṭācārvastrakhaḍgāmalakamalakapālāṅgamekaṃ bhajāmi || 68-11 || ṝṃ bījaṃ cātithīśaṃ śitakamalamukhaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ trinetraṃ | māyālakṣmīsvarāntaṃ taruṇaravikaraṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ nīlavastram | nānālaṅkāraśobhātaramukuṭataṭaṃ candrabimbasvabhāvaṃ | khaḍgābjajñānamudrāmadhudhara(--)sugadā pāśapāṇiṃ bhajāmi || 68-12 || ḷṃkāraṃ sthāṇukeśaṃ trinayanavadanāmbhojatejaḥprakāśaṃ | pūrṇātmānaṃ pareśaṃ triguṇaghanamayaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ tribhāvam | ṣaḍbāhuṃ piṅgakeśāmalagalitaśiromaṇḍalaṃ mālayāḍhyaṃ | vedāsijñānamālāmbujavaragadayā śobhitaṃ bhāvayāmi || 68-13 || ḷṃkāraṃ śitavasanayukśuklakiraṇaṃ | sudhāmagnaṃ dhyāye hariṇanayanaṃ vedabhujagam | bhujaṅgāmbhojāsipriyavaradabhāvaṃ śubhakaraṃ | karālaṃ bhūpālaṃ suramunigaṇaiḥ sevyamaniśam || 68-14 || eṃbījaṃ kālavarṇaṃ śatayuvatigataṃ veṣṭitaṃ devamukhyaiḥ | sūryābhaṃ bindusargaṃ bhujayugasahitaṃ padmabhālaṃ karālam | sālaṅkāraṃ kirīṭaṃ trinayanamamaraṃ nūpurenduprakāśaṃ | jhiṇṭīśaṃ śambarīśaṃ pramathasutagaṇairvyāpitaṃ bhāvayāmi || 68-15 || śuklābhaṃ vā bhavārṇaṃ trivalitanayanaṃ śuddhabandhūkavastraṃ | ratnālaṅkārahāraṃ tribhuvanavacanaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ bījasāram | dhyāye'haṃ ṣoḍaśāre trimadanaramaṇe bhāvitaṃ pañcaraśṃmi | yogādyaṃ bhautikeśaṃ gaganapathakaraṃ vahnijāyāsvarāntam || 68-16 || bhaje praṇavalakṣaṇaṃ śitakaraṃ calatkuṇḍalaṃ | caturbhujavibhākaraṃ kamalaśaṅkhaśūlābhayam | alaṅkṛtakalevaraṃ vimalapītavastraṃ mukhaṃ | śuklāṃśuśataveṣṭitaṃ mukuṭanūpurāḍhyaṃ param || 68-17 || dhyāye cānugraheśaṃ praṇavadhavala auṅkārarūpaṃ susūkṣmaṃ | brahmādvāraprabhedaṃ śrutibhujalalitaṃ khaḍgabāṇāstramālam | jantūnāṃ koṭikāntiṃ śataravimukuṭaṃ krodharājaṃ maheśaṃ | ratnālaṅkāraśobhaṃ caralatalaribhāmaṇḍalaṃ sāruṇābham || 68-18 || aṅkāraṃ bindubhāvaṃ lalitadaśabhujaṃ vyāghracarmāmbarāḍhyaṃ | pañcāsyaṃ taṃ trinetraṃ svakaṇakavalayaṃ candrakoṭiprakāśam | śūlāstrāsīṣu cakrapratanaphalagadākheṭakāmbhojamālaṃ | dhyāye cākrūradevaṃ paraśukharapadaṃ sāradaṃ sthūlasūkṣmam || 68-19 || aḥkāraṃ śrīvisargaṃ kamaladalagataṃ dīnadātāramekaṃ | śuklābhaṃ koṭisūryaṃ śatabhujalalitaṃ vedavidyāstrakhaḍgam | sarvāṃṅgāraktadhāraṃ trinayanakamalānanditaṃ mandahāsyaṃ | pañcāśadvaktraśobhābhavatanukiraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhāvayāmi || 68-20 || evaṃ dhyātvā ṣoḍaśāre sthiracetāḥ prapūjayet | varṇarūpaṃ śaktiyutaṃ lokanāthaṃ sadāśivam || 68-21 || tadā prasannā buddhiḥ syādamaro jāyate'cirāt | khecaratvaṃ vākyasiddhiṃ jalastambhādisiddhibhāk || 68-22 || pūrvādivāmato dhyāyet kāmanābhayavajītaḥ | guptasthāne dhyānakāryaṃ yatra vidyāḥ sphuranti tāḥ || 68-23 ||
