[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde viśuddhavarṇadhyānaṃ nāma aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 68 ||
[athaikonasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kailāsaśikharārūḍha pañcavaktra trilocana | abhedyabhedakaprāṇavallabha śrīsadāśiva || 69-1 || bhavaprāṇaprarakṣāya kālakūṭaharāya ca | pratyaṅgirāpādukāya dāntaṃ śabdamayaṃ priyam || 69-2 || icchāmi rakṣaṇārthāya bhaktānāṃ yogināṃ satām | avaśyaṃ kathayāmyatra sarvamaṅgalalakṣaṇam || 69-3 || aṣṭottarasahasrākhyaṃ sadāśivasamanvitam | mahāprabhāvajananaṃ damanaṃ duṣṭacetasām || 69-4 || sarvarakṣākaraṃ loke kaṇṭhapadmaprasiddhaye | akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhinivāraṇam || 69-5 || yogasiddhikaraṃ sākṣād amṛtānandakārakam | viṣajvālādiharaṇaṃ mantrasiddhikaraṃ param || 69-6 || nāmnāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa yogināṃ vallabho bhavet | sadāśivayutāṃ devīṃ sampūjya saṃsmared yadi || 69-7 || māsānte siddhimāpnoti khecarīmelanaṃ bhavet | ākāśagāminīsiddhiḥ paṭhitvā labhyate dhruvam || 69-8 || dhanaṃ ratnaṃ kriyāsiddhiṃ vibhūtisiddhimālabhet | paṭhanād dhāraṇādyogī mahādevaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 69-9 || viṣṇuścakradharaḥ sākṣād brahmā nityaṃ tapodhanaḥ | yoginaḥ sarvadevāśca munayaścāpi yoginaḥ || 69-10 || siddhāḥ sarve sañcaranti dhṛtvā ca paṭhanād yataḥ | ye ye paṭhanti nityaṃ tu te siddhā viṣṇusambhavāḥ || 69-11 || kimanyat kathanenāpi bhuktiṃ mukṃti kṣaṇāllabhet || 69-12 ||
asya śrībhuvanamaṅgalamahāstotrāṣṭottarasahasranāmnaḥ sadāśivaṛṣirgāyatrīcchandaḥ sadāśivaśākinīdevatā puruṣārthāṣṭasiddhisamayayogasamṛddhaye viniyogaḥ |
oṃ śākinī pītavastrā sadāśiva umāpatiḥ śākambharī mahādevī bhavānī bhuvanapriyaḥ || 69-13 || yoginī yogadharmātmā yogātmā śrīsadāśivaḥ | yugādyā yugadharmā ca yogavidyā suyogirāṭ || 69-14 || yoginī kṛtvā gaṇeśo mama kātīkaḥ || 69-145 || devanāmadhipo bhūtvā sarvajño bhavati prabho | yathā tathā mahāyogī bhramatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 69-146 || prātaḥkāle paṭhed yastu mastake stutidhārakaḥ | jalastambhaṃ karotyeva rasastambhaṃ tathaiva ca || 69-147 || rājyastambhaṃ narastambhaṃ vīryastambhaṃ tathaiva ca vidyāstambhaṃ sukhastambhaṃ kṣetrastambhaṃ tathaiva ca || 69-148 || rājastambhaṃ dhanastambhaṃ grāmastambhaṃ tathaiva ca madhyāhne ca paṭhed yastu vahnistambhaṃ karotyapi || 69-149 || kālastambhaṃ vayaḥstambhaṃ śvāsastambhaṃ tathaiva ca | rasastambhaṃ vāyustambhaṃ bāhustambhaṃ karotyapi || 69-150 || sāyāhne ca paṭhed yastu kaṇṭhodare ca dhārayan | mantrastambhaṃ śilāstambhaṃ śāstrastambhaṃ karotyapi || 69-151 || hiraṇyarajatastambhaṃ vajrastambhaṃ tathaiva ca | akālatvādisaṃstambhaṃ vātastambhaṃ karotyapi || 69-152 || pāradastambhanaṃ śilpakalpanā jñānastambhanam | āsanastambhanaṃ vyādhistambhanaṃ bandhanaṃ ripoḥ || 69-153 || ṣaṭpadmastambhanaṃ kṛtvā yogī bhavati niścitam | vandhyā nārī labhet putraṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam || 69-154 || bhraṣṭo manuṣyo rājendraḥ kimanye sādhavo janāḥ | śravaṇānmakare lagne citrāyoge ca parvaṇi || 69-155 || hiraṇyayoge vāyavyāṃ likhitvā māghamāsake | vaiśākhe rājayoge vā rohiṇyākhyā viśeṣataḥ || 69-156 || śrīmadbhuvanamagalaṃ nāma yaśodātṛ bhaved dhruvam | jāyante rājavallabhā amarāḥ khecarā likhanena || 69-157 || dharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca prāpnuvanti ca pāṭhakāḥ | kītīrātmadṛṣṭipātaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 69-158 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde śākinīsadāśivastavanamaṅgalāṣṭottarasahasranāma(--) vinyāso nāma ekonasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 69 ||
[atha saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca kathitaṃ śākinīsāraṃ sadāśivaphalodayam | śrutaṃ paramakalyāṇaṃ bhedabhāṣākramodayam || 70-1 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ sāradurlabham | yasya vijñānamātreṇa bhavet sākṣāt sadāśivaḥ || 70-2 || vada kānte śabdamayi yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati | ānandabhairavaṃ natvā sovācānandabhairavī || 70-3 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca guroḥ paramakalyāṇaṃ kavacaṃ kathaye tava | sadāśivasya śākinyā bhairavānandavigraha || 70-4 || śṛṇuṣva kāmadaṃ nāmādbhutaṃ kavacamaṅgalam | trailokyasārabhūtaṃ ca sarvajñānavivardhanam || 70-5 || sarvamantraughanikaraṃ jñānamātreṇa siddhyati | sarvagūḍhapriyānandaṃ sāmarasyaṃ kulāntaram || 70-6 || pracaṇḍacaṇḍikātulyaṃ sarvanirṇayasākṣiṇam | sarvabuddhikarānandaṃ kulayogimanogatam || 70-7 || rāmasevyaṃ śivaṃ śambhusevitaṃ viṣanāśanam | aprakāśyaṃ mahāyogaṃ dhanārogyavivardhanam || 70-8 || sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ sarvānandakaraṃ param | sarvatantradurlabhaṃ yat kathitaṃ rudrayāmale || 70-9 ||
asya śrīśākinīsadāśivakāmanānāmamahākavacasya sadāśivaṛṣirgāyatrīcchandaḥ śākinī devatā sakalaharīṃ jīvabījaṃ māyāstraśaktiḥ kāmasvāhā kīlakaṃ vajraṃ daṃṣṭraghoraghargharāmahogrāśākinīśaktiḥ sadāśivamahāmantrasiddhaye viniyogaḥ |
oṃ prabhāvā sadā pātu mahākāśādhiśākinī | triguṇā caṇḍikā pātu krodhadraṃṣṭra karālinī || 70-10 || anantā'nantamahimā mahāstradalapaṅkajam | pūrvāhṇaṃ pātu satataṃ gāyatrī savitā mama || 70-11 || ākāśavāhinī devī śiromaṅgalamadbhutam | sarvadā pātu me guhyaṃ liṅgaṃ cakraṃ sudhāmayam || 70-12 || mahāmaṇḍalamadhyasthā pātu me bhālamaṇḍalam | sahasraśatakoṭīnduyoginīgaṇamaṇḍalam || 70-13 || mahācakreśvarī pātu mahācakreśvaro mama | mukhābjaṃ caṇḍikā devī dantāvalimanantakaḥ || 70-14 || jihvāgraṃ tālumūlasthā tālumūlaṃ manojavaḥ | tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭra dantamadhyaṃ kaṇṭhāgraṃ cibukaṃ śivaḥ || 70-15 || sadā pātu ṣoḍaśāraṃ śākinī śrīsadāśivaḥ | kaṇṭhamadhyasthitaṃ pātu mahāmohavināśinī || 70-16 || pretarājaḥ sadā pātu mahādevī svapaṅkajam | vidyādevī mahāśaktiḥ kūṭasthānaṃ sadāśivaḥ || 70-17 || mahākāśāvalaghnī me dhūmrāṃ bhojañca dhūrjaṭī | kaumudī paṭalāṅgī me varṇaṣoḍaśasaṃjñakam || 70-18 || akārādikāntavarṇān śrīdevī paripātu me | hemacitrarathasthā me citriṇī pātu me madhu || 70-19 || aparṇā yā viśuddhaṃ me ṣoḍaśī ṣoḍaśākṣyakam | pañcadurgā sahadevaḥ pratyekaṃ pātu me dalam || 70-20 || dīpamāsahalkīṃ me pravarā pātu me balā | vyāpinī cānavacchinnā pātu me dalamaṇḍalam || 70-21 || akālatāriṇī durgā śukraṃ cakraṃ sadāvatu | śākinīśo mahāmāyā parivārānvitā'vatu || 70-22 || pañcaraśminīlakaṇṭho madhupūraṃ svapīṭhakam | sadā pātu kaṇṭhapaṅkeruhāśrayasvarānapi || 70-23 || kaṇṭhasvargaḥ sadā pātu kandarpeśo manogatiḥ | śākinī śākavibhavā śākeśī śākasambhavā || 70-24 || śākambharīśvarā pātu sumanā dalaṣoḍaśam | sadāśivaḥ sadā pātu parivāragaṇaiḥ saha || 70-25 || hṛdayaṃ śākinī devī śiraḥsthānaṃ sadāvatu | kākinīsahitaṃ pātu dvādaśāraṃ kuleśvarī || 70-26 || daladvādaśakaṃ pātu kāmanāthaḥ sadāśivaḥ | abhedarūpiṇī pātu kādiṭhāntākṣaraṃ mama || 70-27 || vāṇī me hṛdayagranthirdeśaṃ tu kapileśvaraḥ | pāyānmeghaṃ ca sūryāsyā vimāyā hṛtsu kaṇīkām || 70-28 || tālahastā mahāvāṇī pātu me hṛdayāntaram | śoṣiṇī mohinī vahniḥ pātu me hṛdayāmbujam || 70-29 || pilāpippalādeśo ratirme hṛdayepsitam | yoginīkuladantaśca pātu me hṛtsvarānapi || 70-30 || kekareśo gūḍhasaṃjñā vajradhārī hṛdambujam | ekaliṅgī sadā pātu hṛdayāntaḥ śivaṃ mama || 70-31 || tadadho maṇḍalaṃ pātu bhedābhedavivajītā | akālalakṣaṇaḥ pātu pāśinī nābhimaṇḍalam || 70-32 || kālakūṭasvarūpo me nābhipadmaṃ prapātu me | candracūḍā vidhumukhī śākinī me daśāmbujam || 70-33 || trivṛttākāramudrā me pātu rudraśca lākinīm | trikhaṇḍārohaṇaḥ pātu ḍādiphāntākṣarānapi || 70-34 || kālikā kapilā kṛṣṇā ghanāvālā kapālinī | lalitā tāriṇī sarvāṃ mahāmāyā daśacchadam || 70-35 || paripātu kāmadurgā lākinī pātu me sadā | sadāśivaḥ pātu nityaṃ maṇipūraṃ kulasthalam || 70-36 || jāḍyanāśakarī durgā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitā | māṃ pātu saptarodhātmā keśaveśī mahāpadam || 70-37 || abhayā caṇḍikā kṛṣṇā kālikā kulapaṇḍitā | vajravarṇā dhāraṇākhyā dharā dhātrī kṣamā ramā || 70-38 || vāsukī vasudhā vācyā sarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā | pārvatī sarvaśaktisthā pārvaṇe paripātu mām || 70-39 || raṇe rājakule dyūte vāde mānāpamānake | gehe'raṇye prāntare ca jale cānalamadhyake || 70-40 || sarvāṇī sarvadā pātu mahātantrārthabhūṣitā | vijayā padmanī jāyā jānakī kamalāvatī || 70-41 || etāḥ pāntu digvidikṣu mahāpātakanāśanāḥ | antaraṃ pātu liṅgasthā liṅgamūlāmbujaṃ mama || 70-42 || kaṇīkāṃ pātu satataṃ kāñcīpīṭhasthitā śivā | ativegānvitā pātu vahnimaṇḍalameva me || 70-43 || rākṣasīśā sadā pātu jambudvīpanivāsinī | jāhnavī bhāskarā maunā malayasthā malāṅgajā || 70-44 || matitaptā pāpahantrī paripātu vibhākarī | layasthānaṃ sadā pātu kuñjareśvarasaṃsthitā || 70-45 || viṃśatyarṇamahāvidyā lambamānā kulasthalī | mandire pātu māṃ nityaṃ vittasaṃhārakāriṇī || 70-46 || anantaśayanā pātu vaṭamūlanivāsinī | pralaye māṃ kālī pātu vaṭapatranivāsinī || 70-47 || kevalākhyā sadā pātu mahākūrcasvarūpiṇī | āyurārogyadātrī me dhanaṃ rājyaṃ sadāvatu || 70-48 || kāmarūpaṃ gṛhaṃ pīṭhaṃ paripātu mahābalā | balākā ghoradaṃṣṭra me udaraṃ pātu sarvadā || 70-49 || sarvarogaharā pātu muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitā | ānando nandanātho me hṛdūrdhvābjaṃ sadā'vatu || 70-50 || ṣaṭpadmaṃ sarvadā pātu nānārūpavihāriṇī | akalaṅkā nirādhārā nityapuṣṭā nirindriyā || 70-51 || ṣoḍaśordhvaṃ mahāpadmaṃ dvidalaṃ pātu sarvadā | digvidikṣu sadā pātu śākinyādyaṣṭaśaktayaḥ || 70-52 || atiguptasthalaṃ pātu pāpanāśakarī parā | kṣālanākhyā liṅgaguhye pātu me pāvanaṃ prabhā || 70-53 || vipracittā koṭarākṣī lipibhūtā sarasvatī | caturdalaṃ sadā pātu vibhūtiḥ kāmayā saha || 70-54 || pāntu vidyāḥ sadaitāśca ripupakṣavināśanāḥ | kaṭideśaṃ sadā pātu cāmuṇḍā śūladhāriṇī || 70-55 || trinetrā sarvadā pātu bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvarūpiṇī | vasantādikalāḥ pāntu pāmarograpratāpinī || 70-56 || ṣaḍbhujā sarvadā pātu vedahastā prapātu mām | atividyā sarvavidyā caṇḍavidyā prapātu mām || 70-57 || vāruṇī madirā pātu sarvāṅga śākinī mama | gṛhodarī sadā pātu sarvāṅgaṃ vajradhāriṇī || 70-58 || ulkāmukhī sadā pātu bhṛguvaṃśasamudbhavā | akālatāriṇī durgā lalitā dharmadhāriṇī || 70-59 || viṃśatyarṇā mahāvidyā sarvatra sarvadā'vatu | hasakalaharīṃ vidyā paripātu sadāśivā || 70-60 || sahasravadanā vāṇī paripātu jalodarī | jalarūpā sadā pātu mahojjvalakalevarā || 70-61 || ṣoḍaśī sakalaharīṃ sarvāṇī pātu pārvatī | mahāmattā sadā pātu kāmanāthaprapūrakā || 70-62 || vāmadevī sadā pātu sarvāṅge dehadevatā | kāmapīṭhasthitā durgā parivāragaṇāvṛtā || 70-63 || sadāśivaḥ sadā pātu sāmavedasvarūpagā | śmaśānavāsinī devī mahākālasamanvitā || 70-64 || āryā devī sadā pātu mātā pātu mahākalā | sarvatra kapilā pātu mahābhagavatīśvarī || 70-65 || iti te kathitaṃ nātha mahāvidyāphalapradam | kavacaṃ durlabhaṃ loke tava snehāt prakāśitam || 70-66 || atiguhyataraṃ jñānaṃ kavacaṃ sarvasiddhidam | amalodāracittaḥ san pūjayitvā sadāśivam || 70-67 || tathā śrīśākinīdevyāḥ pūjanaṃ sumahatphalam | rājyadaṃ dhanadaṃ vāñchāsiddhidaṃ dharmasiddhidam || 70-68 || vācāṃ siddhiṃ kare prāpya aṣṭasiddhiḥ kare bhavet | kākinīdarśanaṃ prāpya śākinīdarśanaṃ bhavet || 70-69 || mantrasiddhiṃ tantrasiddhiṃ kriyāsiddhiṃ labhed dhruvam | ākāśagāminī siddhiḥ kare tasya virājate || 70-70 || puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau yoṣidvāmabhuje tathā | dhṛtvā kavacarājaṃ tu rājatvaṃ labhate dhruvam || 70-71 || mahāpātakakoṭīśca hatvā rājatvamālabhet | vane vṛkṣatale'śvatthamūle sthitvā paṭhed yadi || 70-72 || trisandhyaṃ daśadhā japtvā śatadhā vā sahasradhā | sa bhavet kalpavṛkṣeśo bhūmīśo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 70-73 || koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi cirajīvī sa yogirāṭ | mahāsiddho bhaved dhīmān mahāpātakanāśakṛt || 70-74 || māsārdhena bhaved yogyo vipro guṇasamanvitaḥ | varṣaikeṇa kṣatriyaśca vaiśyo varṣacatuṣṭaye || 70-75 || śūdro dvādaśavarṣeṇa yogī bhavati pāṭhataḥ | evaṃ mahāphalaṃ nityaṃ kavacaṃ yaḥ paṭhet sudhīḥ || 70-76 || bhogamokṣau kare tasya kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ || 70-77 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde sadāśivaśākinīkavacaphalādeśo | nāma saptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 70 ||
[athaikasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śrūyatāṃ deva kalyāṇa trailokyavijayātmaka | sadāśivamanuṃ nātha mahāpātakanāśanam || 71-1 || āyurārogyaphaladaṃ sarvaśatrunivāraṇam | atiguhyatamaṃ dhyānaṃ bāliśānāṃ sukhāvaham || 71-2 || ādyābījaṃ samuddhṛtya kāmabījaṃ tadantaram | rudrabījaṃ ramābījaṃ kālabījaṃ tataḥ sadā || 71-3 || śivanāthapriyānandaṃ jñānaṃ dehi yugaṃ dviṭhaḥ | phaṇibījaṃ samuddhṛtya rājarājeśvarīmanum || 71-4 || vaiṣṇavībījamuddhṛtya śivabījaṃ tadantike | sadāśivāya śabdānte hṛllekhā vahnisundarī || 71-5 || ādibījaṃ samuddhṛtya tato vāmatanusthitā | śabdabījaṃ mūlabījaṃ sadāśiva namo'stu te || 71-6 || dviṭhānto'yaṃ manuḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvaratnasamṛddhidaḥ | vāsudevasamo vidvān sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ || 71-7 || vaiṣṇavo vā mahāśākto mahāśaivo'thavā punaḥ | gṛhṇīyānmanurājendraṃ yatprasādācchivo bhavet || 71-8 || vimalā vākyasiddhiḥ syātkārya siddhirna saṃśayaḥ | śivamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena sarvārthapāragaḥ || 71-9 || akāle'pi ca yogī syāt kāmadhenusvarūpavān | hālāhalaṃ samuddhṛtya tato māheśabījakam || 71-10 || śrībījaṃ dharmabījañca kṣetrapālamanuṃ tathā | nīlakaṇṭhamanuṃ paścāt priyāguṃ bījamuddharet || 71-11 || śivabījaṃ tadante tu sadāśivāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śivaḥ pracośabdāddayādevaṃ dviṭho manuḥ || 71-12 || āvāhanaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyamanantaram | gandhapuṣpabilvapatrakoṭibhiḥ paripūjayet || 71-13 || stoṣaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ puṣṭaṃ dāraṇaṃ māraṇaṃ tathā | suptaṃ kalahamuktānāṃ pūjanaṃ sumahatphalam || 71-14 || śarvādīn paripūjyātha sadyojātādimarcayet | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā japet tadgatamānasaḥ || 71-15 || devaṃ pinākapāṇiṃ ca pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam | śūlakhaṭvāṅgamuśalagadāpāṇiṃ mahābhujam || 71-16 || devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvabhūtātmakaṃ gurum | trailokyarakṣakaṃ śambhuṃ bhujaṅgahārabhūṣitam || 71-17 || aṭṭahāsādiśaktīnāṃ sahasragaṇamaṇḍitam | vṛṣāsanasthaṃ nīleśaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadāśivam || 71-18 || evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ śuciḥ | viśeṣeṇa divārātrau samabhāgena sañjapet || 71-19 || tatraiva tryambakaṃ dhyātvā tattadrūpeṇa sādhakaḥ | tadbudhvā pūjayitvā ca tryambakaṃ yo japennaraḥ || 71-20 || tasya haste tribhuvanaṃ hastāmalakavad bhavet | bhogamokṣau kare tasya kimanyat sādhanena ca || 71-21 || sadāśivena manunā sampuṭīkṛtya yo japet | tasya sarvārthasiddhiḥ syād yadyanmanasi vartate || 71-22 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya tryambakaṃ tadanantaram | yajāmahe samuddhṛtya sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam || 71-23 || urvārukamivānte tu bandhanāt padamuddharet | mṛtyormukṣīyaśabdānte māmṛtādvahnisundarī || 71-24 || sadāśivena puṭitaṃ mantraṃ yo japate naraḥ | sa bhavet kalpatarupaḥ pūjanenāmṛtaṃ labhet || 71-25 || sarvakālaṃ sukhī bhūtvā mokṣamāpnoti niścitam | anyaṃ tryambakamantraṃ tu śṛṇuṣva sarvakāmadam || 71-26 || rājyadaṃ ghanadaṃ mantraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | śabdabrahmamayaṃ sākṣāt sarvajñānaṃ labhed dhruvam || 71-27 || kālakūṭaṃ samuddhṛtya mṛtyuñjayaṃ samuddharet | mahāpātakarāśiṃ me harayugmaṃ tato dviṭhaḥ || 71-28 || anyamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya | vidyādye praṇavaṃ datvā kāmabījadvayaṃ dvayam || 71-29 || mṛtyuñjayaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ viśuddheśaṃ sthiraṃ kuru | yugalaṃ kāmabījāntaṃ devyante vahnisundarī || 71-30 || anyaṃ mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno'vadhāraya | kāmakālīyugaṃ paścāt saṃjñābījadvayaṃ tataḥ || 71-31 || vaṭukaṃ kāmabījañca ṣoḍaśāraṃ prakāśaya | yugalaṃ śaktikūṭañca śivabījaṃ tato dviṭhaḥ || 71-32 || pūrvavat sakalaṃ kuryājjapapūjādikaṃ prabho | sadāśivapūjanaṃ ca dhyānahomāditarpaṇam || 71-33 || anyaṃ mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi mahādevaṃ samuddharet | vaṭukaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca gaṇeśasya manuṃ tataḥ || 71-34 || kaṇṭhābjaṃ me sadānanda prakāśa yugaṃ dviṭhaḥ | asyāpi dhyānamākṛtya japtvā lakṣaṃ samāpayet || 71-35 || karakalitakapālaḥ kuṇḍalī daṇḍapāṇi(--) | staruṇatimiranīlo vyālayajñopavītī | kramasamayasaparyāvighnavicchedahetu(--) | rjayati vaṭukanāthaḥ siddhidaḥ kaulikānām || 71-36 || vande bālaṃ sphaṭikasadṛśaṃ kuṇḍalollāsivaktraṃ | divyākalpairnavamaṇimayaiḥ kiṅkiṇīnūpurādyaiḥ | dīptākāraṃ viśadavasanaṃ suprasannaṃ trinetraṃ | hastābjābhyāṃ dadhatamaniśaṃ śūladaṇḍau dadhānam || 71-37 || udyadbhāskarasannibhaṃ trinayanaṃ raktāṅgarāgojjvalaṃ | smerāsyaṃ varadaṃ kapālamabhayaṃ śūlaṃ dadhānaṃ karaiḥ | nīlagrīvamudārakaustubhadharaṃ śītāṃśukhaṇḍojjvalaṃ | bandhūkāruṇavāsasaṃ bhayaharaṃ devaṃ sadā bhāvaye || 71-38 || deveśaṃ vaṭukaṃ sadāśivaguruṃ trailokyarakṣākaraṃ | nānālaṅkṛtabhūṣaṇaṃ śaśadharaṃ bandhūkapuṣpojjvalam | śvetāśvetavibhūṣaṇaṃ maṇimayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sanīlaṃ śivaṃ | devānāmadhidaivataṃ sukhakaraṃ nāthaṃ sadā bhāvaye || 71-39 || evaṃ dhyātvā mahāyogī nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadāśivam | kaṇṭhapadme sthiro bhūtvā śākinīdarśanaṃ labhet || 71-40 || bhūtvā mahāvīranātho manoyogamavāpnuyāt | siddhamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena sarvatra pāragaḥ || 71-41 || ākāśagāminī siddhiḥ stambhanādisusiddhibhāk | vāksiddhiṃ kāyasiddhiñca jarāmaraṇavajītaḥ || 71-42 || śivabījaṃ samuddhṛtya vijayābījamuddharet | kāmakālīyugānte tu ramātrikūṭamuddharet || 71-43 || bījatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya (spheṃ spheṃ spheṃ) kāmanāthāya śabdataḥ | sadāśivāya śabdānte varadāya namo dviṭhaḥ || 71-44 || etanmantraprasādena yogī syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | anyaṃ mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadavadhāraya || 71-45 || kṣāntabījaṃ samuddhṛtya lāntabījatrayaṃ tathā | bhavānībījamuddhṛtya saṅghaṭṭayugalaṃ tataḥ || 71-46 || krodharājabījayugmaṃ lakṣmīśapataye tataḥ | varadāya hṛtpadānte kāmadāya tato dviṭhaḥ || 71-47 || anyaṃ mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena yogī bhavennaraḥ | gaganābījamuddhṛtya kāmarājaṃ samuddharet || 71-48 || māyānte devadevāya hṛcchivāya dviṭho manuḥ | etanmantraprasādena kinna siddhyati bhūtale || 71-49 || anāyāsena yogī syāt kiṃ punaḥ sādhanena ca | kevalaṃ japamātreṇa yogī syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 71-50 || anyaṃ vakṣye bhairavendra praṇavaṃ kāmarājakam | śrībījaṃ vahniyugalaṃ ripuharayugaṃ tataḥ || 71-51 || siddhiṃ dehi tataḥ svāhā mantro'yaṃ yogidurlabhaḥ | pūrvavaddhyānamevaṃ hi kṛtvā'maratvamaśnute || 71-52 || anyaṃ mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena pīṭhasthiro bhavet | amādibījamābhāṣya tato mahāpadaṃ smaret || 71-53 || kālāya vikaraṇāya kalānte tu samuddharet | balāya balavikaraṇāya ṣoḍaśāradalaṃ tataḥ || 71-54 || niveśāya yugaṃ vittaṃ sthāpayānte sadāśiva | kākinīśābhāvahnisundarīkāmado manuḥ || 71-55 || ekākṣaraṃ pravakṣyāmi yena siddho manurbhavet | kṣāntabījaṃ binduyuktaṃ candrabījaṃ tathoddharet || 71-56 || adho dantayutaṃ kṛtvā japet tadgatamānasaḥ | pratyekadalamadhye tu dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam || 71-57 || anāyāsena siddhiḥ syāt prāṇarakṣā sadā bhavet | punarekākṣaraṃ vakṣye yena siddhyanti mānavāḥ || 71-58 || na deyaṃ pāśvebhyaśca nindakebhyo viśeṣataḥ | śivaṃ candrabinduyuktaṃ mahāmantraṃ prakītītam || 71-59 || asya sādhanamātreṇa yogināṃ vallabho bhavet || 71-60 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde ekasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 71 ||
[atha dvisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca mahākāla śivānanda paramānandanirbhara | trailokyasiddhida prāṇavallabha śrūyatāṃ stavaḥ || 72-1 || śākinī hṛdaye bhāti sā devī jananī śivā | kālīti jagati khyātā sā devī hṛdayasthitā || 72-2 || nirañjanā nirākārā nīlāñjanavikāsinī | ādyā devī kālikākhyā kevalā niṣkalā śivā || 72-3 || anantā'nantarūpasthā śākinī hṛdayasthitā | tāmasī tāriṇī tārā mahogrā nīlavigrahā || 72-4 || kapālā muṇḍamālāḍhyā śavavāhanavāhanā | lalajjihvā sarojākṣī candrakoṭisamodayā || 72-5 || vāyvagnibhūjalāntasthā bhavānī śūnyavāsinī | tasmāt stotramaprakāśyaṃ kṛṣṇakālyāḥ kulodayam || 72-6 || śrīkṛṣṇabhagavatyāśca nīladevyā kulārṇavam | gopanīyaṃ prayatnena sāvadhāno'vadhāraya || 72-7 || mahābhairavī uvāca śrīkālīcaraṇaṃ carācaraguṇaṃ saudāminīstambhanaṃ | guñjadgarvaguruprabhānakhamukhāhlādaikakṛṣṇāsanam | pretāraṇyāsananimītāmalakajā nandopariśvāsanaṃ | śrīmannātha karāravindamilanaṃ netrāñjanaṃ rājate || 72-8 || dīptiḥ prāptiḥ samāptiḥ priyamatisugatiḥ saṅgatiḥ śītanītau | mithyāmithyāsurathyā natiraratisatī jātivṛttirguṇoktiḥ | vyāpārārthī kṣudhārthī vasati ratipatirjyotirākāśagaṅgā | śrīdurgāśambhukālīcaraṇakamalakaṃ sarvadā bhāti sūkṣmam || 72-9 || devendrāḥ pañcabhūtā raviśaśimukuṭāḥ krodhavetālakolāḥ | kailāsasthāḥ praśastāḥ stavanamapi tatpratyahaṃ sampaṭhanti | ātmānaṃ śrīdakālīkulacaraṇatalaṃ hṛtkulānandapadme | dhyātvā dhyātvā pravīrā ahamanubahudhīḥ staumi kiṃ dhyānaniṣṭhaḥ || 72-10 || śrutvā stotraguṇaṃ tavaiva caraṇāmbhojasya vācchāphalaṃ | precchāmīhayati priyāya kurute mokṣāya tattvārthataḥ | mātarmohinidānamānataruṇī kātīti manyāmahe | yogyaśrīcaraṇāmbuje trijagatāmānandapuñje sukham || 72-11 || putrau śrīdevapūjyau prakuruta itihāsādigūḍhārthaguptiṃ | śyāme mātaḥ prasannā bhava varadakarī kāraṇaṃ dehi nityam | yogānandaṃ śivāntaḥ surataruphaladaṃ sarvavedāntabhāṣyaṃ | satsaṅgaṃ sadvivekaṃ kuru kuru kavitāpañcabhūtaprakāśam || 72-12 || āhlādodrekakārī paramapadavidāṃ prolbaṇārthaprakāśaḥ | preṣyaḥ pārārthacintāmaṇiguṇa saralaḥ pāraṇaḥ premagānaḥ | sārātmā śrīstavo'yaṃ jayasuravasatāṃ śukrasaṃskāragantā | mantā mohādikānāṃ suragaṇataruṇī koṭibhirdhyeya indraiḥ || 72-13 || nāmagrahaṇavimalapāvanapuṇyajalanidhimanthanena | nirmalacittagasuraguṇapāraga sukhasudhākarasthitahāsyena | yogadharādharanaravara kuñjarabhujayugadīrghapadmamṛṇālena || 72-14 || harividhihara aparaparasarabhāvakapāla sevanena | sundarī kālī caraṇena || 72-15 || bhāsvatkoṭipracaṇḍānalaguṇalalitābhāvitā siddhakālī | proktaṃ yadyogagītāvacanasuracanāmaṅgalaṃ yoginādyā | śyāmānandadrumākhye bhajanayajanagaṅgāṅgatīraprakāśaṃ | sarvānandotsavatvaṃ varadasuravadāsambhave mayyabhāve || 72-16 || etatprathame kulaṃ gurukulaṃ lāvaṇyalīlākulaṃ | prāṇānandakulaṃ kulākulakulaṃ kālīkulaṃ saṅkulam | mātaḥ kāliyugādi kaulini śive sarvantarāṅgasthitaṃ | nityaṃ tatra niyojaya śrutigirā śrīdharmaputraṃ bhave || 72-17 || herambādi kuleśayogajanani tvaṃ yogatattvapriyā | yadyevaṃ kurute padāmbujarajo yogaṃ tavānandadam | saḥ syātsaṅkaṭapāṭalārisadanaṃ jitvā svayaṃ manmathaṃ | śrīmānmanmathamanmathaḥ pracayati hyaṣṭāṅgayogaṃ param || 72-18 || yogī yāti paraṃ padaṃ sukhapadaṃ vāñchāspadaṃ sampadaṃ | trailokyaṃ parameśvaraṃ yadi punaḥ pāraṃ bhavāmbhonidheḥ | bhāvaṃ bhūdhararājarājaduhite jñātaṃ vicāraṃ tava | śrīpādāmbujapūjanaṃ prakurute te nīradaprojjvale || 72-19 || ādāvaṣṭāṅgayogaṃ vadati bhavasukhaṃ bhaktisiddhāntamekaṃ | bhūloke pāvanākhyaṃ pavanagamanagaṃ śrīnagendrāṅgajāyāḥ | siddhīnāmaṣṭasiddhiṃ yamaniyamavaśādāsanaprāṇayogāt | pratyāhāraṃ vibhordhvāruṇaguṇavasanaṃ dhyānamevaṃ samādhim || 72-20 || mātaḥ śāntiguṇāvalambini śive śāntiprade yogināṃ | dāre devaguṇe vidhehi sakalaṃ śāntikriyāmaṅgalam | yajñānāmudayaṃ prayāti sahasā yasyāḥ prasādād bhuvaṃ | tāṃ sarvāṃ pravadāmi kāmadahanastambhāya mohakṣayāt || 72-21 || eko jīvati yogirāḍatisukhī jīvanti na śrīsutāḥ | sasarvaṃ yogabhavaṃ bhave vibhavagāḥ paśyan svakīyāyuṣam | ityevaṃ paribhāvya sarvaviṣayaṃ śāntiṃ samālambyakau | mūle vedadalojjvale kulapathe śrīkuṇḍalī bhāvaya || 72-22 || śāntibhrāntinikṛntanī svaramaṇī premodgatā bhaktidā | lāvaṇyāmbudhiratnakoṭikiraṇāhlādaikamūtīprabhā | ekākāraparākramādapayamā krodhakramakṣobhiṇī | yā mūlāmalapaṅkaje racayati śrīmādhurī tāṃ bhaje || 72-23 || re re pāmara durbhaga pratidinaṃ kiṃ karma vā rādhase | vyāpāraṃ viṣayāśrayaṃ prakuruṣe na dhyāyase śrīpadam | mithyaitatkṣaṇabhaṅguraṃ tyaja mudā saṃsārabhāvaṃ viṣaṃ | śrīkālīṃ kulapaṇḍitāṃ guṇavatīṃ śāntiṃ samārādhaya || 72-24 || śivastrī yā śāntiḥ paramasukhadā bhāvajanikā | vivekaḥ saṃjāto vahasi ca tayā bhāti niyatam | viveko'sau tyāgī janayati sudhāsindhusundara(--) | mado brahmajñānaṃ paramamamale yogini pare || 72-25 || dvayaṃ brahmajñānaṃ paramamamale cāgamamayaṃ | vivekodbhūtaṃ syādamalaparamaṃ śabdamaparam | dvayormūlībhūtā hṛdi sapadi śāntiḥ priyatamā | prabhā kālīpādāmbujayugalabhaktipralayadā || 72-26 || kulaśrīkuṇḍalyāḥ paramarasabhāvaṃ navamayaṃ | padaṃ mātuḥ kālyāḥ prathamaravikāntyāḥ sukhamayam | vadāmi protsāhe vaśaṣasaśubhe hāṭakanibhe | vidhiḥ śrīḍākinyā'marapatidharitrīti ca bhajet || 72-27 || trayaṃ sthānaṃ nityaṃ raviśaśikalāvahnighaṭitaṃ | mahātīrthaṃ samyak pavanagaganasthaṃ bhavakaram | vibhinnaṃ saṅkṛtya dvayamapi kulagranthisahitaṃ | suṣumnāśrītīrthe mahati gagane pūrṇalayavān || 72-28 || trayaṃ saṃśodhyādau paramapadavīṃ gacchati mahān | sudṛṣṭāṅgairyogaiḥ paribhavati śuddhaṃ mama tanum | ato yogāṣṭāṅgaṃ kaluṣasukhamuktaṃ vitanute | kriyādau saṅkuryādyamaniyamakāryaṃ yativaraḥ || 72-29 || ahiṃsāsatyārthī pracayati suyogaṃ tava padaṃ | dhanaste yadyogī śucidhṛtidayādānanipuṇaḥ | kṣamāladhvāhārī samaguṇaparānandanipuṇaḥ | svayaṃ siddhaḥ sadbrāhmaṇakulapatākī sukhamayī || 72-30 || tapaḥ santoṣāḍhyo harayajana āstikyamatimān | yatīnāṃ siddhāntaśravaṇahṛdayaprāṇavilayaḥ | jayānandāmagno havanamanalepaḥ prakurute | mahābhaktaḥ śrīhrīrmatirakulīnastava padaḥ || 72-31 || suṣumnāmukhāmbhoruhāgre ca padmaṃ | dalaṃ cedahemākṣaraṃ mūladeśe | sthirāpṛṣṭhavaṃśasya madhye suṣumnā(--) ntare vajiraṇī citriṇībhāsipadmaiḥ || 72-32 || suṣumnādināḍyā yugāt karṇamūlā | tprakāśaprakāśā bahiryugmanāḍī | iḍā piṅgalā vāmabhāge ca dakṣe | sudhāṃśūravī rājase tatra nityam || 72-33 || visargaṃ bindvantaṃ svaguṇanilayaṃ tvaṃ janayasi | tvamekā kalyāṇī giriśajananī kālikalayā | parānandaṃ kṛtvā yadi parijapanti priyatamāḥ | parikṣālya jñānairiha parijayanti priyapadam || 72-34 || aṣṭādaśāṅgulagataṃ ṛjudantakāṣṭhaṃ | svīyāṅgulārdhaghaṭitaṃ praśaraṃ śanairyaḥ | saṃyojya tālurasanāgalarandhramadhye | dantīkriyāmupacaret tava bhāvanāya || 72-35 || nāḍīkṣālanamākaroti yatirāḍ daṇḍe trayaṃ dhārayan | yuṣmacchrīcaraṇārpaṇo navamadaṇḍasyānilastambhanāt | prāṇāyāmaphalaṃ yatiḥ pratidinaṃ saṃvardhate suśramā(--) dānandāmbudhimajjanaṃ kularasairmukto bhavet tatkṣaṇāt || 72-36 || vadāmi paramaśriye padapadmayogaṃ śubhaṃ | hitāya jagatāṃ mama priyagaṇasya bhāgaśriye | sadā hi kurute naraḥ sakalayogasiddhiṃ mudā | tadaiva tava sevako janani mātarekākṣaram || 72-37 || karuṇāsāgare magnaḥ sadā nirmalatejasā | tavāṅghirakomalāmbhojaṃ dhvātvā yogīśvaro bhavet || 72-38 || karuṇāsāgare magno yena yogena nirmalaḥ | tadyogaṃ tava pādābjaṃ ko mūrkhaḥ kaḥ supaṇḍitaḥ || 72-39 || yamaniyamasukāle neulīyogaśikṣā | prabhavati kaphanāśā nāśarandhre trisūtrī | hṛdayakaphavināśā dhotikā yogaśikṣā | galavilagalavastraṃ ṣaṣṭihastaṃ vahantī || 72-40 || susūkṣmarasanasya ca svabhujaṣaṣṭihastaṃ gala | pramāṇamiti santataprasarapañcayugmāṅgulam | pavitraśucidhotikāraṃ bhavasi sarvapīḍāpahā | svakaṇṭhakamalodayāmamalabhītadāmā bhaje || 72-41 || bhajati yadi kumārīṃ neulī yogadṛṣṭyā | sa bhavati paravettā mohajālaṃ chinatti | smitamukhi bhavati tvāṃ mūḍha evātijīvo | bhramitamudavadhūrnā kārasiddhiṃ dadāsi || 72-42 || śanairdantī yogaṃ svapadayugapadme vitanute | śive yogī māsādapi bhavati vāyuṃ sthagayati | asau mantrī cāmrātakadalaṃ sudaṇḍaṃ galavile | niyojyādau dhyātvā tava caraṇapaṅkeruhatalam || 72-43 || kulākulacetatā parikaroṣi vilvacchadī | suśāntiguṇadā jayā paramabhaktinirguṇḍikā | mukundatulasī priyā guṇini muktidā yoginī | dadāsyamarasampadaṃ dalaviyogamūrdhvodarīm || 72-44 || pañcāmarāsādhanayogakartrī pañcāmarānāma mahauṣadhiḥ sthitā | tvameva sarveśvararūpadhāriṇī yaiḥ pūjyate so'hikapārameṣṭhī || 72-45 || paṭhati yadi bhavānyāḥ śākinīdehadevyāḥ | stavanamaruṇavarṇāmārkalakṣmyāḥ prakāśam | vrajati paramarājyaṃ devapūjyaḥ pratiṣṭho | manujapanasuśīlo līlayā śambhurūpam || 72-46 || prātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyāhne ca trisaptake | śataṃ paṭhitvā mokṣaḥ syāt puraścaryāphalaṃ labhet || 72-47 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--) | prakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde śākinīkṛta kālīstavanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 72 ||
[atha trisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrūyatāṃ komalāmbhojasthitavaktravirājite | atyadbhutaṃ mahāgītaṃ śṛṇoti sādhako hi yat || 73-1 || dhvanirantargataṃ jyotirjyotirantargataṃ manaḥ | tanmano vilayaṃ yāti dhvaniṣu jñānakoṭiṣu || 73-2 || taddhvanijñānasaṃjñānaṃ śṛṇvanti yogino janāḥ || 73-3 || paramaguṇagabhīre dhīranīre śarīre | bhavanavabhavakāntau saṃpraśātmā nitāntam | vimalamadhuravākyālaṅkṛtajñānasindhau | sakalavacanaratnaṃ sthāpayāmāsa vāṇī || 73-4 || oṃ tuṇḍograsthiravacanagā mohayañjīvavarṇaṃ | śaṅkātaṅkārahitacaritā mohitā jñānatandre | sālaṅkārā kharatarakarā vākyamālāṃ vahantī | sā paśyantī vimalakaruṇā rādhyatāṃ mūlacakre || 73-5 || saṃsāre sārabhāge sayuvatisukṛpālakṣaṇairlakṣitāṅge | siddhāntajñānajīvaṃ caramasamaguṇaṃ bhūpateryogino vā | viprendrāṇāmanantaṃ dhvanigurumadhuraṃ vyāpitaṃ pārvatīśe | he he kālaprakālapriyatanuśikhare veśamāsaṃ cayatvam || 73-6 || sañcāre paramasthire harihare vidyādhare bhūdhare | sākāre karuṇākare svavilaye te pādapaṅkeruhe | nityajñānamayaṃ jayaṃ suratarucchāyālayaṃ pūjaye | mātaḥ kāli kalādhare galabile śākambhari śākini || 73-7 || bhāsvatkoṭiravicchaṭābharasukhaśrīkaṇṭhavīrālaye | hṛtpaṅkeruhamadhyasāraghaṭitaṃ sārasvatotpattidam | śrīdevīgururūpiṇīcaraṇapadmāntaḥprabhāmaṇḍalaṃ | śailendrodayakāriṇīmaṇigṛhaṃ māpadmanābheradhaḥ || 73-8 || vāñchākalpadrumasthā sthitilayaphaladā yoginī yogamātā | sūkṣmānandapraśaṃsā taruṇaravikalā kokilālāpamugdhā | snigdhā snigdhāṅgasaṅgā navaśaśimukuṭā cāruvarṇā viśālā | sā durgā duḥkhahantrī bhavatu śivagṛhe kāmanāsiddhidātrī || 73-9 || nirāśrayamahaṃ padaṃ bhavati kāli bhaktyāśraye | śriye vimalabhāvade sakalabhāvago gogaṇaḥ | mayi priyadhanaṃ mudā vitara cārudṛṣṭyā sukhaṃ | tadaiva galabhāgakṛdgaganapadmamadhyasthale || 73-10 || nitye niṣphalarūpabhūtinikare trailokyarakṣākare | dharmadhvāntaniketane gaṇayati jñānaprayogāntaram | te pādāmbujasambhavaḥ priyagaṇaḥ prāṇāśritaḥ pāthīvo | mātaḥ parvatarājarājaduhite puṇyaṃ pavitrāptaye || 73-11 || bhībhargo bhārasargo bhavaravavibhavo bhūtibhārāvalambī | bhāvābhāvaḥ prabhāvaḥ prabhavati bhuvane bhīmabhaktiprakāśaḥ | bhūbhūtodbhūtabhītiprabhṛtibhayabhavāsambhavānandabhāvo | mātaste pādapaṅkeruhavimalatalānandasevābhivṛddhyā || 73-12 || nityaṃ pātu gaṇeśvarī gaṇapatermātā rame mātaraṃ | prāṇaṃ pratyaya pūrvasiddhikaraṇī siddhāsane rakṣatu | ānandāmbudhimajjanaikasukhadā bhālasthalasthāpinī | kaṇṭhāmbhoruhakaṇīkā suragaṇān gītā parā susvarān || 73-13 || kṛpāpārāvārā vimalapuruṣaṃ gaurivapuṣaṃ | dharāvakṣe mukhye dharaṇisutabuddhyā'dhamanaram | na jāne tvatkāmaṃ tanuvirahacintāmaṇimayaṃ | tava snehādhvīnāṃ gamayati na pāraṃ suravaraḥ || 73-14 || jayati jaya jayājyotirādhārajetā | suranaragaṇapūjyaḥ kheṭacakrasya madhye | bhavakamalakarāḍhyaṃ namrabhāvaṃ pratāpaṃ | gamayati tava pādāmbhojasevābalena || 73-15 || ityetaiḥ ślokamukhyaistu stutvā gītarasāntaraiḥ | parabrahmamayīṃ dhyātvā svayaṃ brahmatanuṃ gataḥ || 73-16 || akasmād bhogasampattirmokṣapaddhatayaḥ śubhāḥ | prabhavanti svayaṃ vidyā aṣṭādaśa guṇodayāḥ || 73-17 || nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ candraśekharamīśvaram | sadāśivaṃ mahāśaktiśākinīvāmasaṃsthitam || 73-18 || caturbhujaṃ devadevamanantamakṣaraṃ haram | bhāvagītaṃ punargītvā paraṃ brahmasamo bhavet || 73-19 || kaṇṭhaṣoḍaśasampūrṇamadhye yogī sthirāśayaḥ | aṣṭasiddhīśvaro bhūtvā bhāvasiddhiṃ labhed dhruvam || 73-20 || tvayā saha samāhlādadarśanaṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 73-21 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--) prakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde vāṇīgītavinyāso nāma trisaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 73 ||
[atha catuḥsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca śailaje devadeveśi sarvāmnāyaprapūjite | sarvaṃ me kathitaṃ devi kavacaṃ na prakāśitam || 74-1 || prāsādākhyasya mantrasya kavacaṃ me prakāśaya | sadāśivamahādevabhāvitaṃ siddhidāyakam || 74-2 || aprakāśyaṃ mahāmantraṃ bhairavībhairavodayam | sarvarakṣākaraṃ devi yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || 74-3 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śrūyatāṃ bhagavannātha mahākāla kulārṇava | prāsādamantrakavacaṃ sadāśivakulodayam || 74-4 || prāsādamantradevasya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ | paṅktiśchandaśca deveśaḥ sadāśivo'tra devatā || 74-5 || sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhau ca viniyogaḥ prakītītaḥ | śiro me sarvadā pātu prāsādākhyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 74-6 || ṣaḍakṣarasvarūpo me vadanaṃ tu maheśvaraḥ | aṣṭākṣaraśaktiruddhaścakṣuṣī me sadā'vatu || 74-7 || pañcākṣarātmā bhagavān bhujau me parirakṣatu | mṛtyuñjayastribījātmā āyū rakṣatu me sadā || 74-8 || vaṭamūlasamāsīno dakṣiṇāmūtīravyayaḥ | sadā māṃ sarvataḥ pātu ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṇarūpadhṛk || 74-9 || dvāviṃśārṇātmako rudraḥ kukṣiṃ me parirakṣatu | trivarṇāḍhyo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarvadā || 74-10 || cintāmaṇirbījarūpo'rdhanārīśvaro haraḥ | sadā rakṣatu me guhyaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥ || 74-11 || ekākṣarasvarūpātmā kūṭavyāpī maheśvaraḥ | mārtaṇḍo bhairavo nityaṃ pādau me parirakṣatu || 74-12 || tumburākhyo mahābījasvarūpastripurāntakaḥ | sadā māraṇabhūmau ca rakṣatu tridaśādhipaḥ || 74-13 || ūrdhvamūrdhvānamīśāno mama rakṣatu sarvadā | dakṣiṇāsyaṃ tatpuruṣo'vatu me girināyakaḥ || 74-14 || aghorākhyo mahādevaḥ pūrvāsyaṃ parirakṣatu | vāmadevaḥ paścimāsyaṃ sadā me parirakṣatu || 74-15 || uttarāsyaṃ sadā pātu sadyojātasvarūpadhṛk | mṛtyujetā sadā pātu jale'raṇye mahābhaye || 74-16 || parvate viṣamasthāne viṣahartā sadā'vatu | kālarudraḥ sadā pātu sarvāṅgaṃ kāladevatā || 74-17 || kālāgnirudraḥ sampātu mahāvyādhibhayādiṣu | akālatārakaḥ pātu khaḍgadhārī sadāśivaḥ || 74-18 || kavacī vāmadevaśca sadā pātu mahābhaye | kālabhakṣaḥ pātu rudro rurukaḥ kṣetrapālakaḥ || 74-19 || mātṛkāmaṇḍalaṃ pātu sampūrṇacandraśekharaḥ | cirāyuḥ śākinībhartā cāyuṣaṃ pātu me sadā || 74-20 || siṃhaskandhaḥ sadā pātu rudrāṇīvallabho'vatu | bhālaṃ pātu vajradambhālekhakaḥ krāntirūpakaḥ || 74-21 || nirūpakaḥ sadā pātu khecarīkhecarapriyaḥ | ratnamālādharaḥ pātu raktamukhīśvaro'vatu || 74-22 || vadanaṃ cakṣuṣī karṇau pātu pañcānano mama | vedadhvaniḥ sadā pātu nāsārandhradvayaṃ mama || 74-23 || kapāladhārakaḥ pātu gaṇḍayugmaṃ yugāntakṛt | raktajihvāpatiḥ pātu mamoṣṭhādharavāsinam || 74-24 || dantāvaliyugaṃ pātu bhṛgurāmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ | tālumūlaṃ sadā pātu viśvabhojī rasāmṛtam || 74-25 || jihvāgraṃ vākpatīśaśca bhavānīśaḥ śivo mama | mukhavṛttaṃ sadā pātu mahāsenaḥ kavīśvaraḥ || 74-26 || krodhanāthaḥ sadā pātu dakṣahastādimūlakam | dakṣakūrparamāpātu tadagraṃ kukkureśvaraḥ || 74-27 || cirajīvī sadā pātu cāṅgulīmūladeśakam | aṅgulyagraṃ sadā brahmā brahmaliṅgadharaḥ prabhuḥ || 74-28 || vidyāpatiḥ pārvatīśo vāmahastādimūlakam | pātu vāmakūrparaṃ me vāmakeśvara īśvaraḥ || 74-29 || kuṇḍavāsī sadā pātu kūrparāgraṃ kulācalaḥ | vedamātṛpatiḥ pātu kāmadhenupatiḥ prabhuḥ || 74-30 || mamāṅgulīmūladeśaṃ pātu pañcamukho mama | vāmāṅgulyagrabhāgaṃ me pātu parvatapūjitaḥ || 74-31 || tanumūlāgrabhāgaṃ me kūrmacakradharaḥ prabhuḥ | śākinīvallabhaḥ pātu dakṣāṅghiramadhyadeśakam || 74-32 || gulphāgraṃ gargarīnāthaḥ pādāgraṃ mūladevatā | abhayāvallabhaḥ pātu dakṣāṅgulyagrabhāgakam || 74-33 || pātu smaraharo yogī vāmorumūladeśakam | vāmapādamadhyadeśaṃ madhyadeśeśvaro'vatu || 74-34 || pātu me bhagavāñchambhurmama gulphāgradeśakam | mūladeśaṃ vāmapādaṃ pātu me'ṅguṣṭhamūlakam || 74-35 || kāraṇātmā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ prabhādhārī yamāntakaḥ | aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ sadā pātu suṣumnānāḍikeśvaraḥ || 74-36 || mahārudreśvaraḥ pātu mama nābhimanobhavam | udaraṃ gaganādhāraḥ kāmahartā hṛdambujam || 74-37 || sarvānandātmakaḥ pātu mama skandhayugaṃ śivaḥ | hṛdayād dakṣahastāgraparyantaṃ pātu śokahā || 74-38 || hṛdayād vāmahastāgraparyantaṃ parameśvaraḥ | hṛdayānmama dakṣāṅghranakhāntaṃ me śivo'vatu || 74-39 || sadānandā sadā pātu hṛdādyaṅghiraṃ tu unmadaḥ | vāsukīvallabhaḥ pātu hṛdādigudadeśakam || 74-40 || anantanātha āpātu hṛdādimūrdhadeśakam | vyāpakaḥ sarvadā pātu sadāśiva umāpatiḥ || 74-41 || tārātmakaḥ kāyasiddhaḥ śaktīśaḥ śukradevatā | pañcacūḍaḥ sadā pātu pañcatattvāṅgarūpakam || 74-42 || śīrṣādipādaparyantaṃ kāmadhenuḥ sadā'vatu | jale'raṇye ghoravane saṅkaṭe ca mahāpathe || 74-43 || prāntare pātu guptākṣaḥ kāmarājaḥ parāparaḥ | ardhanārīśvaraḥ pātu mātṛkāparameśvaraḥ || 74-44 || mātṛkāmantrapuṭitaḥ svasvasthānaṃ sadāvatu | dharmātmā dharmasanṃdhiṃ me piṅgalāṃ pātu caṇḍikām || 74-45 || vihvalaḥ sarvadā pātu bholānāthaḥ sadā'vatu | sarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kāmarūpe viśeṣataḥ || 74-46 || sarvadā yoginīnāthaḥ paramātmā sadā'vatu | kāmarūpākhyapīṭhādi pañcāśat pīṭhadevatāḥ || 74-47 || pañcāśatpīṭhamāyā tu kāmarūpaṃ sadāśivaḥ | bhavo rudro maheśaśca śaṅkaro manmathāntakaḥ || 74-48 || guhyakeśaḥ pāpahartā kapālī śūladhārakaḥ | pañcavaktro daśabhujo bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇo haraḥ || 74-49 || mahākālo mahārudro mahāvīro hṛdi sthitaḥ | mahādevo mahāguhyo mahāmāyā mahāguṇaḥ || 74-50 || paśupativīrūpākṣo harīśo dhavaleśvaraḥ | vaṭukeśaḥ kramācāryaḥ pañcaśūlī hṛdudbhavaḥ || 74-51 || unmanīśaḥ sāhasikaḥ parākhyaḥ parvateśvaraḥ | sarvātmā ca mahātmā ca śivātmā ca śmaśānagaḥ || 74-52 || krodhavīraḥ kālakārī sūkṣmadharmā dhurandharaḥ | śyāmakaḥ krūrahartā ca gaṇeśaḥ kālamāghavaḥ || 74-53 || jñānātmā kapilātmā ca siddhātmā yoginīpatiḥ | koṭisūryapratīkāśa ekapañcāśadīśvarāḥ || 74-54 || sadā pāntu mātṛkasthāḥ sthitisargalayātmakāḥ | ādipīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ kāñcīpīṭhaṃ tadantike || 74-55 || ayodhyāpīṭhanagaraṃ tadūrdhve jālakandharam | jālandharaṃ tadūrdhve tu siddhapīṭhaṃ tadantike || 74-56 || kālīpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhve tu caṇḍikāpīṭhamagrake | aṣṭapurīmahāpīṭhaṃ kaṇṭhadeśaṃ sadāśivaḥ || 74-57 || sadā pātu mahāvīraḥ kāladharmī parātparaḥ | madhupurīmahāpīṭhaṃ cāṣṭapurāntarasthitam || 74-58 || māyāvatīmahāpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhve parikītītam | vārāṇasīmahāpīṭhaṃ dharmapīṭhaṃ tadantike || 74-59 || jvālāmukhīmahāpīṭhaṃ tadantaḥsthaṃ prakītītam | tadūrdhve ca mahāpīṭhaṃ jvalantīpīṭhameva ca || 74-60 || tadūrdhve pūṇagiryākhyaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tadantike | uḍḍayānaṃ tadūrdhve tu kamalāpīṭhameva ca || 74-61 || haridvāraṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ badarīpīṭhameva ca | vyāsapīṭhaṃ nāradākhyaṃ tadūrdhve vāḍavānalam || 74-62 || hiṅgulādaṃ tadūrdhve tu laṅkāpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvake | tadūrdhve śāradāpīṭhaṃ ratipīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvake || 74-63 || liṅgapīṭhaṃ kalāpīṭhaṃ dvārakāpīṭhameva ca | kapālapīṭhaṃ haryākhye varadāpīṭhamuttare || 74-64 || kālīpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhve tu tārāpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvake | ugratārāmahāpīṭhaṃ mahogrāpīṭhameva ca || 74-65 || nīlasarasvatīpīṭhaṃ jarāpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvake | tadūrdhve gaganāpīṭhaṃ khecarīpīṭhameva ca || 74-66 || tadūrdhve tāriṇīpīṭhaṃ sahasradalamadhyake | kartrīpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhve ca devīpīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvake || 74-67 || rājarājeśvarīpīṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśīpīṭhameva ca | sahasradalamadhye tu sahasrapīṭhameva ca || 74-68 || madhye ekajaṭāpīṭhaṃ kartrītīrakalopari | ṣoḍaśīmukhavidyābhirveṣṭitā tāriṇīkalā || 74-69 || kālī nīlā mahāvidyā tvaritā chinnamastakā | vāgvādinī cānnapūrṇā devī pratyaṅgirā punaḥ || 74-70 || kāmākhyā vāsalī bālā mātaṅgī śailavāsinī | ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśānī bhairavī bagalāmukhī || 74-71 || dhūmāvatī vedamātā harasiddhā ca dakṣiṇā | etā vidyā mahāvidyāḥ śivasevanaśobhitāḥ || 74-72 || dvāviṃśatimahāvidyā dvāraṃ dvāviṃśatisthalam | mahāpīṭhe sahasrāre sarvadā pāntu māṃ kalāḥ || 74-73 || sadāśivaḥ śaktiyuktaḥ pātu caṇḍeśvaro haraḥ | pañcāmarādharaḥ pātu devīnāthaḥ sadā'vatu || 74-74 || pārvatīprāṇanātho me sarvāṅgaṃ pātu sarvadā | aghoranātha īśāno varado madanāntakaḥ || 74-75 || yajñahartā dakṣakhaṇḍo vīrabhadro digambaraḥ | aṣṭādaśabhujo raudro nīlapaṅkajalocanaḥ || 74-76 || trilocanaḥ kālakāmo mahārudro gaṇeśvaraḥ | kākinīvallabhaḥ śūlī yogakartā maheśvaraḥ || 74-77 || vāgīśvaraḥ smaraharo mahāmantro halāyudhaḥ | śrīnāthaḥ pūjito bālo bālendro balavāhanaḥ || 74-78 || balarāmaḥ kṛṣṇarāmo govindo mādhavīśvaraḥ | jitāmitreśvaraścūḍāmaṇīśo mānadaḥ sukhī || 74-79 || mukhaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ pātu ṣaḍdalāmbhoruhasthitam | vaiṣṇavīvallabhaḥ pātu brahmāṇaṃ kulakuṇḍalī || 74-80 || viṣṇunāthaḥ sadā pātu brahmāgniṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ | jvālāmālādharaḥ pātu kālānaladharo'vatu || 74-81 || kākinīvallabhaḥ pātu īśvaro bhairaveśvaraḥ | mahārudro nīlakaṇṭho maṇipūraṃ sulākinīm || 74-82 || sadā pātu maṇigṛhaṃ rudrāṇīpriyavallabhaḥ | mahārudro nīlakaṇṭho mahāviṣṇuṃ sadāvatu || 74-83 || rākiṇīṃ viṣṇulakṣmīṃ ca pātu me vaiṣṇavīṃ kalām | sadāśivo nīlakaṇṭho mama pātu hṛdi sthalam || 74-84 || īśvaraṃ paramātmānaṃ mama rakṣatu śākinīm | sadāśivaṃ sadā pātu dvidalastho'paro haraḥ || 74-85 || hākinīśaktitaḥ pātu sahasrāraṃ śivo'vatu | tārānāthavidhiḥ pātu sahasrāranivāsinīm || 74-86 || mahākāśaṃ sadā pātu tadadho vāyumaṇḍalam | vahnimaṇḍalamāpātu tadadhaḥ śākinīśvaraḥ || 74-87 || tadātmakaḥ sadā pātu kīlālaṃ kauladevatā | pṛthivīṃ pāthīvaḥ pātu sarvadaikaṃ sadāśivaḥ || 74-88 || itthaṃ rakṣākaraṃ nātha kavacaṃ devadurlabham | prātaḥkāle paṭhedyastu so'bhīṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 74-89 || pūjākāle paṭhedyastu kavacaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | kītīśrīkāntimedhāyurbṛṃhito bhavati dhruvam || 74-90 || aprakāśyaṃ mahāvīrakavacaṃ sarvasiddhidam | jñānamātreṇa bhūrloke jetā kālasya yogirāṭ || 74-91 || asya dhāraṇamātreṇa kālasūtrāntako bhavet | asya dhāraṇapāṭhena sarvajño bhavati dhruvam || 74-92 || sarve vyāsavaśiṣṭhādimahāsiddhāśca yoginaḥ | paṭhitvā dhārayitvā te pradhānāstattvacintakāḥ || 74-93 || kaṇṭhe yo dhārayedetat kavacaṃ tvatsvarūpakam | madvaktrāmbhoruhodbhūtaṃ vidyāvāksiddhidāyakam || 74-94 || yuddhe vijayamāpnoti dyūte vāde ca sādhakaḥ | kavacaṃ dhārayedyastu sādhako dakṣiṇe bhuje || 74-95 || devā manuṣyā gandharvāstasya vaśyā na saṃśayaḥ | kavacaṃ śirasā yastu dhārayed yatamānasaḥ || 74-96 || karasthāstasya deveśi aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhayaḥ | bhūrjapatre tvimāṃ vidyāṃ śuklapaṭṭena veṣṭitām || 74-97 || rajatodarasaṃviṣṭāṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayet sudhīḥ | samprāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīmante tava śarīradhṛk || 74-98 || yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana | śiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya prakāśayet || 74-99 || yogine jñānayuktāya deyaṃ dharmātmane sadā | anyathā siddhihāniḥ syātsatyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 74-100 || tava snehānmahādeva kathitaṃ kavacaṃ śubham | na deyaṃ kavacaṃ siddhaṃ yadīcchedātmano hitam || 74-101 || yadi bhāgyaphalenāpi kavacaṃ yadi labhyate | dhūrto vā kapaṭī vāpi khalo vā durgrahasthitaḥ || 74-102 || nijakarmaphalatyāgamavaśyaṃ khalu kārayet | tadā siddhimavāpnoti dharmadhārādharo bhavet || 74-103 || siddhipūjāphalaṃ tasya divase divase sudhīḥ | dhūrtatāṃ khalatāṃ mithyāṃ kāpaṭyaṃ sa vihāya ca || 74-104 || rājarājeśvaro bhūtvā jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ | yo'rcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ kavacaṃ manmukhoditam || 74-105 || tenācītā mahādeva sarvadevā na saṃśayaḥ | rājasikaṃ mānasikaṃ tāmasikaṃ parantapaḥ || 74-106 || hṛdye mānasikaṃ dhyāyan pūjā rājasikaṃ smṛtam | tāmasikaṃ lokamadhye kavacārcā tridhā matā || 74-107 || siddhakavacamākhyātaṃ kevalaṃ jñānasiddhaye | mokṣāya jagatāṃ śambhoḥ priyāya parameśvara || 74-108 || tantre'smin sārasaṅketaṃ pūjā'pyāropaṇādikam | antaḥkaraṇamadhye tu sarvakāryamudīrayet || 74-109 || rājye ca prapaṭhet stotraṃ kavacaṃ jñānasiddhaye | iti te kathitaṃ nātha paramātmani maṅgalam || 74-110 || yasyārādhanamātreṇa śivatvamuta kiṃ prabho || 74-111 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe | ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde sadāśivakavacapāṭho | nāma catuḥsaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 74 ||
[atha pañcasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
ānandabhairava uvāca kathitaṃ śāradaṃ dhāma aprakāśyaṃ phalodayam | idānīṃ kathaya prāṇavallabhe varadā bhava || 75-1 || kaṇṭhābhoje kīdṛśī yā sabhā paramamohinī | gāyantī yogibhinītyaṃ paramānandavadhīnī || 75-2 || sabhotkṛṣṭāṃ siddhasabhāṃ vartaya brahmavādini | tadā me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ saphalaṃ sāranirṇayam || 75-3 || yadi sā kathyate devi sabhā sarvapratiṣṭhitā | śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śrūyatāṃ devadeveśa sarvānandaprapūraka || 75-4 || sabhā jñānamayī nityā ṣoḍaśāraprakāśinī | vistīrṇā saptatiṃ caiva yojanānāṃ śitaprabhā || 75-5 || tapasā nimītā lakṣmīrjñānamaṅgalamaṇḍitā | rāśiprabhā khecarī sā kailāsaśikharopamā || 75-6 || guhyakairūhyamānā sā madhuradhvanipūraṇī | divyahemamayairuccaiḥ pādapairupaśobhitā || 75-7 || raśmimatī bhāsvatī ca divyagandhamanoramā | śitābhraśikharākārā hematoraṇaśobhitā || 75-8 || divyahemamayaiḥ śṛṅgaivīdyudbhariva citritā | ṣoḍaśārakaṇīkāyāṃ pratibhā viśvajitvarī || 75-9 || tasyāṃ sadāśivo nātho vicitrābharaṇāyudhaḥ | strīsahasrāvṛtaḥ śrīmānāste jvalitakuṇḍalaḥ || 75-10 || divākaranibhe ramye divyāstaraṇasaṃyute | divyapādopadhāne ca niṣaṇṇaḥ paramāsane || 75-11 || mandārāṇāmudārāṇāṃ vanāni surabhīṇi ca | saugandhikānāṃ cādāya gandhān gandhavahaḥ śuciḥ || 75-12 || nalinyāścāṇakākhyāyāścandanānāṃ vanasya ca | manohṛdayasaṃhlādī vāyustamupasevate || 75-13 || tatra devāḥ sagandharvā gaṇairapsarasāṃ vṛtāḥ | divyatālena gāyanti gītāni parameśvara || 75-14 || miśrakeśī ca rambhā ca citrasenā śucismitā | cārunetrā ghṛtācī ca menakā muñjikastanī || 75-15 || viśvācā sahajanyā ca pramlocā urvaśī irā | vargā ca saurabheyī ca samīcī buddhidā latā || 75-16 || ratnāvatī mahāmāyā kamalā gandhakeśikā | bāṇamātā mahābhargā jyotiḥ prajñā bhavā'bhavā || 75-17 || prabhavā sambhavā guñjā sārāṅgī sāravikramā | trilocanī trivedisthā ambikā saptaśāyakā || 75-18 || viralā varadā māyā siddhā kātyāyanī tathā | yoginī khecarī siddhā jīvāṅgī dīrghalocanī || 75-19 || ramaṇī ca hiraṇyākṣī padmavaktrā hiraṇmayī | etāḥ sahasraścānyā nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ || 75-20 || īśānamupatiṣṭhanti gandharvāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ | aniśaṃ divyavāditrairnṛtyagītaiśca sā srabhā || 75-21 || aśūnyā rucirā bhāti gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ | kinnaroragagandharvā narā nāma tathā pare || 75-22 || mānabhadro'tha dhanadaḥ śvetabhadro'tha guhyakaḥ | kāśavalo gaṇḍakaṇḍūḥ patyodraśca mahābalaḥ || 75-23 || kustumburuḥ piśācāśca gajakarṇe viśānakaḥ | varāhakarṇastāmrauṣṭhaḥ phalabhakṣaḥ phalodakaḥ || 75-24 || aṅgacūḍaḥ śikhāvarto hemanetro vibhīṣaṇaḥ | puṣpānanaḥ piṅgalakaḥ śoṇitodaḥ pravālakaḥ || 75-25 || vṛkavāṃścāniketaśca cīravāsāśca bhāvataḥ | bharadvājo vāridharī mahāmāyo dhanañjayaḥ || 75-26 || kapilaḥ kapilācāryo mahāyogī kṣamādharaḥ | ete cānye ca bahavo yakṣā śatasahasraśaḥ || 75-27 || sadā bhagavatī lakṣmīstathaiva nalakūbaraḥ | tayoḥ parijanāḥ sarve vāruṇīmadyakārakāḥ || 75-28 || ato madhupurī nāma cāṣṭapūraṃ madhusthalam | tadbāhye sā sabhā bhāti candrakoṭisamodayā || 75-29 || ahañca nivasāmyasyāṃ bhavantyanye ca madvidhāḥ | brahmarṣayo bhavantyatra tathā devarṣayo pare || 75-30 || kravyādā rākṣasāścānye gandharvāśca mahābalāḥ | upāsante mahātmānaṃ tasyāṃ śivadamīśvaram || 75-31 || bhagavān bhūtasaṅghaiśca vṛtaḥ śatasahasraśaḥ | umāpatiḥ paśupatiḥ śūladhṛg bhaganetrahā || 75-32 || tryambako rājaśārdūlo devī ca vigatakramāḥ vāmanaivīkaṭaiḥ kubjaiḥ priyayakṣairmahābalaiḥ || 75-33 || medomāṃsāsavairugrairugradhanvā mahābalaḥ | nānāpraharaṇairghorairghātairiva mahājavaiḥ || 75-34 || vṛtaḥ sahāyaistatrāste sadaiva śrīsadāśivaḥ | prakṛṣṭāḥ satatañcā(pi?)pyavantu śambhuparicchadāḥ || 75-35 || gandharvāṇāñca patayo viśvāvasurhāhā huhūḥ | tumburuḥ parvataścaiva śailūraśca tathāparaḥ || 75-36 || citrasenaśca gītajñastathā citraratho'pi ca | ete cānye ca gandharvāḥ sadāśivamupāsate || 75-37 || vidyādharādhipaścaiva cakravarmā (hi)mānugaḥ | upāsatustatastasyāṃ prabhuṃ dhanadamīśvaram || 75-38 || himavān pāribhadraśca vindhyakailāsamandarāḥ | kinnarāḥ śataśastatra jñānināmīśvaraṃ prabhum || 75-39 || gaṇāśca śataśastatra bhagadattapurogamāḥ | drumaḥ kiṃpuruṣaścaiva upāste varadeśvaram || 75-40 || rākṣasādhipatiścaiva mahendro gandhamādanaḥ | saha yajñaiḥ sagandharvaiḥ saha sarvainīśācaraiḥ || 75-41 || vibhīṣaṇaśca dhamīṣṭha upāste śrīsadāśivam | malayo mandaraścaiva mahendro gandhamādanaḥ || 75-42 || indrakīlaḥ sanābhaśca tathā divyau ca parvatau | ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sarve merupurogamāḥ || 75-43 || upāsate mahātmānaṃ sadāśivamadhīśvaram | nandīśvaraśca bhagavān mahākālastathaiva ca || 75-44 || śaktaṃ karṇamukhāḥ sarve devyāḥ pāriṣadāstathā | kāṣṭhabhṛkuṭī mukhodantī vijayā ca tapo'dhikā || 75-45 || śvetaśca vṛṣabhaścaiva nardannāste mahābalaḥ | varadaṃ rākṣasāścānye piśācāśca samāsate || 75-46 || pārṣadaiḥ saṃparivṛtamumayā ca maheśvaram | sadā hi devadeveśaṃ śivaṃ trailokyabhāvanam || 75-47 || praṇamya mūrdhnā paulastyo bandhurūpamumāpatim | tato'bhyanujñāṃ samprāpya mahādevāt kuleśvarāt || 75-48 || āste kadācid bhagavān bhavo dhanapateḥ sakhā | nidhipravaramukhyau ca śaṅkhapadmadhaneśvarau || 75-49 || sarvānnidhīn pragṛhyātha upāstādvai sadāśivam | samatā tādṛśī ramyā mayā guptāntarīkṣagā || 75-50 || pitāmahasabhā tasyā ūrdhve bhāti vibhāvitā | dikpālānāṃ sabhāgre tu sthiravidyutsamodayā || 75-51 || mahādevaṃ kīrtayiṣye satāṃ kaṇṭhasaroruhe | yogināṃ maunaśīlānāṃ dhyānasiddhipradā sabhām || 75-52 || mahāpātakakoṭighnī varṇanā nāsti brahmaṇaḥ | sabhāyā varṇane śakto nāhaṃ varṣaśatairapi || 75-53 || tathāpi tava siddhyarthaṃ saṃkṣepād varṇyate prabho | pitāmahasabhāṃ nātha kathyamānāṃ viśuddhaye || 75-54 || śakyate sā na nirdeṣṭumevaṃ rūpeti sojjvalā | sarvadā saṃsthirā tatra yathā nārāyaṇe sthirā || 75-55 || samarūpaṃ saṃvibhāvya sabhayā śrīpitāmahaḥ | upāsate mahātmānaṃ śākinī parameśvaram || 75-56 || aprameyāṃ sabhāṃ divyāṃ mānuṣīṃ nityarūpiṇīm | anidīśyāṃ prabhāveṇa sarvabhūtamanoramām || 75-57 || auṣadhairvā tathā yuktairuttamā yā anāśinī | manmathā sā sabhā devī na śītā na ca gharmadā || 75-58 || na kṣutpipāśe na glāniṃ na bhūtāṃ nāpi bhāvitām | nānārūpairiva kṛtā maṇibhiḥ sahitāyudhaiḥ || 75-59 || stambhairna ca dhṛtā sā tu śāśvatī na ca sākṣarā | divyairnānāvidhairbhāvairbhāsvadbharamitaprabhaiḥ || 75-60 || aticandrañca sūryañca bhāsate sā prabhā svayam | pradīptā nākapṛṣṭhasthā bhāsayantīva bhāskaram || 75-61 || tasyāṃ sa bhagavānāste vidadhad devamānuṣān | svayameko'niśaṃ nātha sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || 75-62 || upatiṣṭhanti cāpyenaṃ prajānāṃ patayaḥ prabhum | dakṣaḥ pracetā pulaho marīciḥ kaśyapo yatiḥ || 75-63 || bhṛguratrirvaśiṣṭhaśca gautamo'thāṅgirāstathā | pulastyaśca kratuścaiva prahlādaḥ kardamastathā || 75-64 || atharvāṅgirasaścaiva bālakhilyā marīcipāḥ | mano'ntarīkṣaṃ vidyāśca vāyustejo jalaṃ mahī || 75-65 || śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca dhāmīkaḥ | prakṛtiścāhaṅkāraśca yaccānyatkāraṇaṃ bhuvaḥ || 75-66 || agastyaśca mahātejā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ | jamadagnirbharadvājaḥ saṃvartaścyavanastathā || 75-67 || durvāsāścāmarirjetā ṛṣyaśṛṅgastapodhanaḥ | sanatkumāro bhagavān yogācāryo mahātapāḥ || 75-68 || asito devalaścaiva jaigīṣavyaśca tattvavit | ṛṣabho jitaśakraśca mahāvīryastapomuniḥ || 75-69 || āyurvedastathāṣṭāṅgo dehavān vīryadhārakaḥ | ūrdhvaretā mahāyogī devadatto bhagīrathaḥ || 75-70 || kapilācārya īśāpto dhanadaḥ sārasaṅgataḥ | mahāvāgmīśvaraḥ kālaḥ priyakarmā ca suvrataḥ || 75-71 || varuṇaḥ sārvabhaumaśca devācāryo dhanañjayaḥ | kāmaputro vaśiṣṭhaśca mandāro'śvattha eva ca || 75-72 || ravimukhyo vidhātā ca nairṛto yama eva ca | agniḥ śakro vibhāṇḍaśca mahāvīro gaṇeśvaraḥ || 75-73 || kātīkeyo jīvanātho grahacakraḥ śubhaṅkaraḥ | vedajñātā dharmavettā vārendro nandanaḥ prabhuḥ || 75-74 || bṛhaspatiḥ śukradevo vijñānī bhāsvarāstradhṛk | anye ca bahavaḥ santi ūrdhvaretāra īśagāḥ || 75-75 || tasyāṃ bhānti mahākāla (!) kevalānandavigrahāḥ | candramā saha nakṣatrairādityaiśca gabhastibhiḥ || 75-76 || vāyavaḥ kratavaścaiva saṅkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca | mūtīmanto mahātmāno mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ || 75-77 || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sadāśivamupāsate | artho dharmaśca kāmaśca harṣo'dveṣastapo damaḥ || 75-78 || āyānti tasyāṃ gandharvāḥ sahitāpsarasastathā | viṃśatiḥ sapta caivānye lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ || 75-79 || navagrahāstatra santi nānopacārapaṇḍitāḥ | mantro rathantaraścaiva harimān vasumānapi || 75-80 || ādityāḥ sādhirājāno nānāvṛndairupāgatāḥ | maruto viśvakarmā ca vasavaśca digīśvarāḥ || 75-81 || tathā pitṛgaṇāḥ sarve sarvāṇi ca havīṃṣyatha | ṛgvedaśca sāmavedo yajurvedaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 75-82 || atharvavedastasyāntaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi caiva ha | itihāsopadeśāśca vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 75-83 || grahā yakṣāśca somāśca daivatāni ca sarvaśaḥ | sāvitrī durgataraṇī vāṇī saptavidhā tathā || 75-84 || smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiścaiva buddhiḥ prajñā kṣamā yaśaḥ | stutiśāstrāṇi sāmāni gāthāstu vividhāstathā || 75-85 || bhāṣyāṇi tarkavaktrāṇi dehavanti vibhānti ca | nāṭakā vividhāḥ kāvyāḥ kathākhyādhikakārikāḥ || 75-86 || tatra tiṣṭhanti ye puṇyā ye cānye gurupūjakāḥ | kṣaṇā lavā muhūrtāśca divārātriḥ prabhātagā || 75-87 || ardhamāsāstathā māsā ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ ca bhairava | saṃvatsarāḥ pañca yugaṃ māsā rātriścatuvīdhāḥ || 75-88 || kālacakrañca yaddavyaṃ nityamakṣayamavyayam | dharmacakraṃ tathā cāpi nityamanteṣu vigrahāḥ || 75-89 || aditirdakṣakaścaiva surasā vinatā irā | kālakā surabhī devī saramā cātha gautamī || 75-90 || pradhā kadrūśca vai devyo devatānāñca mātaraḥ | rudrāṇī śrīśca lakṣmīśca bhadrā ṣaṣṭhī tathāparā || 75-91 || pṛthivī gāṅgatā devī hrīḥ svāhā kītīreva ca | surā devī śacī caiva tathā puṣṭirundhatī || 75-92 || saṃvṛddhirāśā niyatiriḍā devī ratistathā | kāminī paramānandā devī śrītripureśvarī || 75-93 || kāmamātā mahābālā varadādyā sarasvatī | mandākinī viyadgaṅgā svargagaṅgā manojavā || 75-94 || trisrotā candrabhāgā ca mahāvegavatī nadī | pañcatīrthakalāpadmāḥ sāgarāḥ sāgarodayāḥ || 75-95 || kālindī vaiṣṇavī siddhā taralā puṣkarodayāḥ | bhānumatī mahāvegā caṇḍaśukrā mahānadī || 75-96 || vetravatī ca kāverī mahābhargā vasundharā | vibhāvatī padmalakṣmīḥ prabhā bhadrā kirātinī || 75-97 || ambālikā tvahalyā ca trituṇḍā maṇḍaleśvarī | mandodarī mandavegā madirā śāradā nadī || 75-98 || nirmalā mandaragranthiḥ prajñā jvālāvatī ratiḥ | avantī ca raṭantī ca yugādyā māghasaptamī || 75-99 || pañcatuṇḍā ghoranādā santoṣī tuṣṭavṃśinī | bharadvājeśvarī dharmā śatadhārā dharāvatī || 75-100 || mallikā mālinī mandā hindolā liṅgavāhinī | vartulā siddhalaṅkā ca kurukṣetrasthitā nadī || 75-101 || ākāśagaṅgā siddhāṅgī gautamī bālikā gayā | daityajihvā kālajihvā catuṣkoṭikalā'malā || 75-102 || nāḍikā sārdhavahnisthā pratyekasthāna saṃsthitāḥ | mūtīmatyo vibhāntyasyāṃ sindhudevyastathā parāḥ || 75-103 || sabhāyāṃ kṛṣṇanāmnī ca nadī kulavatī balā | tasyāṃ pradhānā trinadī vāmadakṣiṇamadhyataḥ || 75-104 || iḍāvatī piṅgalākhyā suṣumnādyā sarasvatī | trimadhye pūjitā devī suṣumnā bahurūpiṇī || 75-105 || nadāścāpi ca tatsaṅkhyāḥ sārdhatrikoṭayaḥ smṛtāḥ | nadaḥ śoṇo mahāśoṇo vaṭuko balavān haraḥ || 75-106 || taruṇastārako bhadro vibhadro narmadāpatiḥ | prabhānātho vīramukhyo viśālo baladevakaḥ || 75-107 || padmarāgo māraketastrivṛtto nandano ghanaḥ | akālajihmo hiṃsāḍhyo vidhṛto hyavadhūtakaḥ || 75-108 || brahmaputro vibhākāraḥ kapilo'ñjana eva ca | sāmba eko mahāsaṃkhyo maṇḍalākhyo bṛhannalaḥ || 75-109 || śatanālādharo rudro viśvagāmī dhanañjayaḥ | sahasravadano vākyo ghargharo damanastathā || 75-110 || sitākhyo mānavo gartaḥ kulākhyo visamāpatiḥ | bhavakuṇḍo visargākhyo jyotiṣṭomḥ phalākaraḥ || 75-111 || dhavalo badarākhyaśca vīrabhadro makhastathā | marmahantā śūlagarto mānabhaṅgo divāgamaḥ || 75-112 || śūraścaiva kālakūṭo madhugāmī jalāntakaḥ | dadhidhāro ghṛtākhyaśca sudhādhāro mahānadaḥ || 75-113 || hiṅgulākhyo mālaketuḥ payasvān payasaḥ patiḥ | lavaṇākhyo dharmaputro jīvaputro dhanākaraḥ || 75-114 || māyāpatiḥ kalānātho vindhyalo lavaṇāśrayaḥ | ikṣudhārādharo māno vidhuvarṇo dharājalaḥ || 75-115 || puṣkaro duṣkarākhyaśca śaṅkaraśca sadāiśava | ete cānye ca bahavaḥ puṣkaraṃ samupāsate || 75-116 || trayāṇāṃ puṣkaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ suṣumnānāḍikāśrayaḥ | iḍāyāṃ puṣkarākhyaśca piṅgalāyāñca śaṅkaraḥ || 75-117 || nadāścāpi bahutarā mūtīmanto vibhānti ca | nadyaśca mūtīmatyaśca sadāśivamupāśritāḥ || 75-118 || pūjayanti kaṇīkāyāṃ sabhāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ prabho | sadāśivasabhāmadhye brahmaṇaḥ sabhayojjvalā || 75-119 || tasyāṃ devasabhā bhāti śakrasyāpi manoharā | pūrvādikramayogena dhyeyā ca khecarīva vā || 75-120 || vahnikoṇe'nalasabhā mahātejomayī parā | kaṇīkāyā dakṣiṇe ca dharmarājamahāsabhā || 75-121 || nairṛte rākṣasendrasya sabhā sakalamohinī | varuṇe bhāti dīptākhyā vāruṇīyā sabhā'parā || 75-122 || vāyukoṇe vāyusabhā kauberī cottare sabhā | adho nandasabhā bhāti cordhvaṃ brahmasabhā prabho || 75-123 || madhye ca bhāti sūryābhāṃ śatāyutasamodayām | sadāśivasabhāṃ nātha brahmāṇḍe maṇḍalodbhavām || 75-124 || sūkṣmamārge sadā bhāntīmīśvarasyāpi rūpiṇīm | ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaścāśvināvapi || 75-125 || viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca pitaraśca maharṣayaḥ | eka eva tu rājaṣīḥ pradhānastatra bhāti hi || 75-126 || trayodaśaguṇopetā bhānti rājarṣayastathā | pṛthuścaiva dharmarājo hariścandro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 75-127 || rāmacandro ramānātho bhagīratha ilāpatiḥ | prahlādaḥ kardamaścaiva vibhīṣaṇaśca dhāmīkaḥ || 75-128 || nalaścaiva rukmamālī vikramoddhatatāpasāḥ | vāmapārśve adhobhāge pradīptā hyāsanāvanau || 75-129 || anye ca munayaḥ santi samāveṣṭya sadāśivam | mahābhaktāḥ prapaśyanti sadāśivaparaṃ padam || 75-130 || akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam | smaraṇāt paṭhanāddhyānāt sadāśivapateḥ prabhoḥ || 75-131 || anāyāsena siddhyanti ye ye bhaktā mahītale | vṛddhā vā bālakā vāpi yauvanasthā narā api || 75-132 || anāyāsaṃ phalaṃ labdhvā prapaśyanti sadāśivam | eteṣāṃ dhyānamākṛtya cārcayanti sadāśivam || 75-133 || sa yāti sahasā nātha sadāśivaparaṃ padam | devīnāṃ yajanaṃ kṛtvā ye dhyāyanti sadāśivam || 75-134 || trailokyaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā prapaśyanti sadāśivam | yathākāle nirjane ca gavīnāṃ kuhare'pi vā || 75-135 || sthitvā caikamanā dhyāyet sadāśivaparaṃ padam | śivatvaṃ yāti sahasā dhyānād brahmāgatasya ca || 75-136 || brāhmaṇaḥ sahasā yāti sadāśivaparaṃ padam | evaṃbhūtaṃ dhyāyatīha sadāśivapadāmbujam || 75-137 || ratnanūpuranādāḍhyaṃ caladbhūṣaṇamaṇḍitam | padmarāgasyāṅgulībhirmaṇḍitaṃ raktapaṅkajam || 75-138 || siddhasabhāsevitañca siddhānāmāśrayākaram | devadānava gandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitam || 75-139 || munīndragaṇapūjyañca dharmasindhumayaṃ dhruvam | vāñchādiphaladaṃ kāntaṃ śatāruṇasamaprabham || 75-140 || sarvavidyāmayaṃ dhyāyed haṃsamārge nirañjane || 75-141 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--) prakāśe bhairavabhairavī saṃvāde'kālamṛtyuharaṇasabhāvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 75 ||
[atha ṣaṣṭhasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kathayāmi mahākāla(!) cātyantādbhutamasādhanam | kavacaṃ kākinīdevyā aṣṭottaraśatākṣaram || 76-1 || yasya gehe kare śīrṣe kaṇṭhe ca cittamadhyake | bhujamadhye ca kaṭyāṃ vā dhārayitvā mahītale || 76-2 || kiṃ na siddhiṃ karotyeva sādhako yoginīpatiḥ | yogasiddhiḥ kriyāsiddhiḥ śivāsiddhistathā parā || 76-3 || mahāsiddhiḥ khecarī ca suṣumṇāsiddhireva ca | phalasiddhiḥ kālasiddhiḥ kriyāsiddhiḥ śivāmbikā || 76-4 || jaṅghāsiddhiḥ parāsiddhiḥ khaḍgasiddhiḥ susūkṣmagā | aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhiśca kare tasya sthirā bhavet || 76-5 || kavacaṃ kākinīdevyāḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakam | akāle vā sukāle vā paṭhanād dharmasañcayam || 76-6 || jayī dharmasañcayena jayo yatra śivastataḥ | yatra śivā tatra śivaḥ kavacātmā dvayaṃ priyau || 76-7 || kartārau tau sadā tārau pārvatīparameśvarau | kāryakāraṇasraṣṭārau ubhau tatra parātparau || 76-8 || kavacātmakamūrttau ca sthātārau prabhavātmakau | tasya nāmākṣaraṃ vakṣye śṛṣṇuṣva bhairaveśvara || 76-9 || bhairavī bhīmarūpā ca virūpā rūpavivajītā | sūkṣmātisūkṣmarūpā ca svaprakāśā ca śākinī || 76-10 || japalā jañcalā bhīmā candradevī parāparā | kamalākṣī devamātā khaḍgakapāladhāriṇī || 76-11 || gurvī gaurī ghanacchāyā oṃkārādyā carupriyā | chāyā jayā jāñjanā ca oṅkārātmā kalāvatī || 76-12 || aṅkāriṇī ḍākinī ca ṭakkādevī ruṇapriyā | tāriṇī sthūlapuṣṭā ca dayādharmapriyā nutiḥ || 76-13 || paramā buddhiśaktiśca phaladā phālgunī kalā | basudhārā vāsukī ca bhadrakālī bhavābhavā || 76-14 || manasā mohinī mātā yaśodā yājñikā yaśā | rūpeśvarī raṇaprāṇā lakṣmīrlakṣaṇaśobhitā || 76-15 || vasupriyā vasuratā bālarakṣā śaśiprabhā | ṣaḍakṣarī śāradā ca haridrā hāramālinī || 76-16 || lāvaṇyaniratā laṅkā kṣayarogavināśinī | kṣetrapālā ca kṣetrī ca kṣatriyā kṣemadā kṣamā || 76-17 || kṣunnivṛttikarī kṣubdhā kṣālanākhyā kṣarākṣarā | anantākhyā umā durgā ṛṣabhā īśvarapriyā || 76-18 || ḷkārabījakuṭasthā ḷkāradīrghajīvikā | eraṇḍaraṇacāmuṇḍā endrī ḍaṭṭapriyāntarā || 76-19 || tunutuṇḍā oṣadhī ca uttamādhamamadhyamā | audveṣiṇī auṣadhasthā aṭṭahāsātmasaṅgatā || 76-20 || arthadā aṣṭahastā ca arkakoṭimayūkhagā | ardhanārīśvarā arcyā arbudāstradharā samā || 76-21 || aṣṭaiśvaryapradā arghā ambhasthā cāpyarundhatī | arpaṇākhyā arkamunī arpaṇā askhalasthitā || 76-22 || arcanāḍhyā arcanāsthā arātī aruṇādharā | aṣṭottarākhyamamṛtaṃ paṭhitvā kavacaṃ paṭhet || 76-23 || tadā phalasamṛddhiḥ syādāyurārogyasādhanam | śākinīkavacasyāsya sadāśiva ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ || 76-24 || gāyatrīcchanda evāpi śākinī dehadevatā | oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ me śiraḥ pātu blū hlū me lalāṭakam || 76-25 || cakṣuṣī khecarī pātu karṇau me śivaśākinī | gaṇḍayugmaṃ sadā pātu devaśākambharī ramā || 76-26 || svāhā pātu yugmanāsāṃ oṣṭhā'dharaṃ śiro'vatu | drīṃ hīṃ śrīṃ me dantapaṅktiṃ jihvāgraṃ dehadevatā || 76-27 || cibukaṃ kamalā devī vāgdātrī me kapālakam | vadanaṃ kālikā pātu śabdabījātmikā galam || 76-28 || kaṇṭhadevī śākinī ca pātu me kaṇṭhapaṅkajam | surādevī sadā pātu hṛtpadmaṃ kāmarūpiṇī || 76-29 || kalāvatī kāmakāmā kāmamālā viśuddhakam | sadāśivapathaṃ pātu lakṣmīrme nābhipaṅkajam || 76-30 || ulkāmukhī sadā pātu devamātā ṣaḍakṣaram | sadā pātu viṣṇupadmaṃ rākiṇī pātu me dalam || 76-31 || kaṭideśaṃ sadā pātu bhegadā jñānamokṣadā | mūlādhāraṃ sadā pātu kākinī parameśvarī || 76-32 || ekarūpā sadā pātu liṅgādhāraṃ virūpiṇī | mārkaṇḍapūjitā devī mṛkuṇḍā mūlavāsinī || 76-33 || sadā me pātu deveśi abhayā cārudeśakam | darśanākhyā mahādevī liṅgādhāraṃ padāntaram || 76-34 || pātu devī hiraṇyākṣī sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadevatā | vidhātrī sūkṣmarūpasthā sthūlāṅgī ca kṛśodarī || 76-35 || sarvatra sarvadā pātu devī śākambharī mama | hṛtkālikā sadā pātu sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadeśake || 76-36 || iti te kathitaṃ nātha kavacaṃ devadurlabham | paṭhitvā siddhiprāpnoti rājatvaṃ labhate naraḥ || 76-37 || akasmāt sūryatulyaḥ syāt kāmajetā svayaṃ bhavet | dhāraṇād dehavṛddhiḥ syādāyurārogyasampadam || 76-38 || vāyusiddhikaraṃ sākṣādamṛtānandavigraham | agnistambhaṃ jalastambhaṃ vāyustambhaṃ karoti hi || 76-39 || khecaro yogajetā syādāśākṣayakaro bhavet | tataḥ paṭhet kāmamantraṃ tadante dhyānamācaret || 76-40 || oṃśrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve | nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam | iṣṇanniṣāṇā(--) mumma iṣāṇa sarvalokamma iṣāṇa || 76-41 || japitvā kāmamantraṃ hi sarvakāmaphalaṃ labhet | tato dhyātvā ca kavacaṃ dhyāyedyaḥ śākinīśivam || 76-42 || sa vedapāramāyāti śākinīdhyānayogataḥ || 76-43 || prāṇākhyāṃ śuklapadme niravadhinilayāṃ śākinīṃ pītavastrāṃ sūkṣmāṃ bhūṣātirudodbhatanucapalāṃ cañcalāṃ siddhilolām | hastaiḥ padmaiścatubhīḥ sunayanakamalairbhāsamānāṃ śivāḍhyāṃ padmābhītipracaṇḍāsicasahitāṃ śākamātāṃ bhajāmi || 76-44 || dhyātvā yogī śmaśāne girivarakure ḍākinīdeśamadhye | śūnye gartevane vā gaganagṛhatale śūnyagehe supravāse | jñānātmā yo vaśī vā paṭhati ca satataṃ śākinīdehayogaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ svīyagarbhe kavacamabhayadaṃ sarvadaṃ yāti siddhim || 76-45 || kavacaṃ kāraṇairdevīṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi | akasmāt kāyasiddhiḥ syādaṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || 76-46 || mokṣamāpnoti bhāvena sukhaṃ tasya pade pade | mirayantu bālakā yasyāḥ kākavandhyā ca yā bhavet || 76-47 || dhārayitvā tvimāṃ vidyāmetairdoṣairna lipyate | kaṇṭhe yo dhārayedetāṃ samare kāṇḍadhāriṇīm || 76-48 || akṣayatvamavāpnoti jīvamātraḥ sadāśivaḥ | gorojanākuṅkumena kālāguruharidrayā || 76-49 || lākṣārasairlekhayitvā dhārayitvā'mṛtaṃ labhet || 76-50 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śakinīkavacaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 76 ||
[atha saptasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca idānīṃ vada kaumāri sundari prāṇavallabhe | aśītitame paṭale vada yogārthasañcayam || 77-1 || śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu bhairavarājendra sadāśivādiśākinīm | dvayorāhlādayogo hi bhogamokṣaphalāyate || 77-2 || ākāśaparamāṇūnāṃ viśiṣṭāmalacakṣuṣām | darśanaṃ vidyujjaḍitaṃ prāpnoti sahasā sudhīḥ || 77-3 || sadāśivakulasthānopari śrīśākinīpadam | dvayoryo hi viśiṣṭajño jñānakhecarasiddhaye || 77-4 || tatkulasthānamāvakṣye yathāvadavadhāraya | ṣoḍaśākhyadalāgreṣu madhyamūleṣu sarvataḥ || 77-5 || sadāśivakulasthānaṃ cakrarājaṃ vicintayet | vicintya śatadhā yogīṃ kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale || 77-6 || bhūtānāmadhipo bhūtvā sthiro bhavati bhūtale | bhagavantaṃ mahākāyaṃ paradevaṃ sadāśivam || 77-7 || cakrasthaṃ cakrabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamabhyantaraṃ param | paśyatyeva mahāyogī kālacakraṃ tataḥ param || 77-8 || anāyāsena gaganagranthiṃ bhitvā pare layam | cakrarājaprasādena sarvasañcārago bhavet || 77-9 || dvātriṃśatkaṭhinagranthiṃ bhitvākāśe khagordhvagaḥ | tataḥ paraśivānandacakraṃ śaktyātmakaṃ tataḥ || 77-10 || tato hi śabdanikaraṃ parāsthānaṃ tataḥ param | sakalāniṣkalāsthānaṃ bodhanīmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ || 77-11 || tadūrdhvañconmanīpīṭhaṃ bhitvā ca tadanantaram | bhṛgupūraṃ tato bhitvā nādapūraṃ tataḥ param || 77-12 || nādāntakaṃ tato bhitvā brahmaviṣṇughaṭākaram | kriyākaraṃ prāṇalayaṃ yajñasthānaṃ śikhāpadam || 77-13 || pūrṇagirimuḍḍayānaṃ bhitvā ca svapadaṃ tataḥ | durgasthānaṃ tato bhitvā prakāśasthānameva ca || 77-14 || tadūrdhve piṅgalāsthānaṃ tadūrdhve tatpadaṃ tataḥ | suṣumnāmaṇḍalaṃ bhitvā dhaumirakoṇaṃ mahālayam || 77-15 || mahābinduṃ tadūrdhve tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tu tadūrdhvake | tadūrdhve vāsanāpūraṃ bījapūraṃ tadūrdhvake || 77-16 || tadūrdhve viṣṇucakraṃ tu kulālicakravatsthitam | taṃ bhitvā kāmanagaraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 77-17 || tadūrdhve śakracakraṃ tu tadūrdhve bhūmicakrakam | tadūrdhve koṣacakraṃ tu tadūrdhve vāyucakrakam || 77-18 || tadūrdhve vahnicakraṃ tu tadūrdhve'mṛtacakrakam | tadūrdhve jalacakraṃ tu divācakraṃ tadūrdhvake || 77-19 || tadūrdhve yāminīcakraṃ tadūrdhve tāracakrakam | tadūrdhve dharmacakraṃ tu kālacakraṃ tadūrdhvake || 77-20 || sarvakālaṃ sadā vyāpya jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | sadā tadūrdhvanikaraṃ saptasāgaramaṇḍalam || 77-21 || tadūrdhve bhāti satataṃ śrījalāntakamaṇḍalam | tadūrdhve tu mahācakraṃ mahāpadmavanākaram || 77-22 || ṭaṅkāropari saṃdhyāyet sahasrāre supaṅkajam | taṃ bhitvā jñānapadmaṃ tu kaṇīkāyāṃ prapaśyati || 77-23 || pretarūpamahādevaśavākāraṃ tu niṣkriyam | asyorasi pretabījaṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham || 77-24 || ūrumūle ca tasyāpi krodhabījaṃ śatāruṇam | tasyopari mahākālīmavaśyaṃ paripaśyati || 77-25 || pratyālīḍhapadāmambāmambujākṣīṃ hasanmukhīm | caturbhujāṃ khaḍgamuṇḍavarābhayakarāmbujām || 77-26 || trailokyajananīṃ brahmarūpiṇīṃ mukuṭojjvalām | muṇḍamālāṃ saṃvahantīṃ sarvāstrāṃ sarvakāraṇām || 77-27 || anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍabrahmavyāpakarūpiṇīm | prasannavadanāṃ ghorāṃ śavakarṇāṃ karālinīm || 77-28 || yogīndrajananīṃ nityāṃ bhavānīṃ bhavamocinīm | vimalāṃ nirmalānandāṃ jñānānandasvarūpiṇīm || 77-29 || dharmārthakāmamokṣasthāṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarīm | lalitāṃ sundarīṃ śyāmāṃ mahākālaniṣevitām || 77-30 || mahogrāṃ candraghaṇṭāḍhyanitambaratnamekhalām | sahasrānantasūryogratejorūpāṃ kulapriyām || 77-31 || śmaśānāvāsinīṃ durgāṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīm | ghorarāvāṃ mahāraudrīṃ kālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ parām || 77-32 || karṇāvataṃsatāṃ nītaśavayugmabhayānakām | ghoradaṃṣṭraṃ karālāsyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || 77-33 || śavānāṃ karasaṅghātaiḥ kṛtakāñcīṃ priyaṃvadām | sṛkkadvaya galadraktadhārāvisphuritānanām || 77-34 || bālārka maṇḍalāmbhojanayanatrayabhūṣitām | danturāṃ dakṣiṇavyāpimuktālambikucaśriyam || 77-35 || śavarūpamahādevahṛdayopari saṃsthitām | śivābhirghorarāvābhiścatudīkṣu samanvitām || 77-36 || mahākālavyāpakena viparītaratāturām | sukhaprasannavadanāṃ smerāruṇasaroruhām || 77-37 || madhumāṃsacarbaṇāḍhyāṃ varadāṃ madanāturām | vedavedāṅgavidyābhirudāraguṇasambhavām || 77-38 || daityadānavadarpaghnīṃ bhagamālākalevarām || 77-39 || cintayet kaulikāṃ kālīṃ kulavṛkṣatalasthitām | śrīkalpalatikāṃ vidyutkoṭimaṇḍitakuṇḍalām || 77-40 || nāgayajñopavītāḍhyāṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharām | sarvālaṅkārayuktāñca vahnayarkaśaśilocanām || 77-41 || lalajjihvāṃ kāmarūpāṃ kāmapīṭhanivāsinīm | atisaundaryavadanāṃ dhārāvisphuritaprabhām || 77-42 || kāmadāṃ siddhagandharvadevacāraṇanāṭakaiḥ | stūyamānāṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivaśakramahaṣībhiḥ || 77-43 || sarvadā vanditāṃ koṭijaladābhatanuprabhām | saṃsāratāriṇīṃ tārāṃ tārabrahmasvarūpiṇīm || 77-44 || indunīlamaṇiśreṇiśobhāvidyutprakāśinīm | śrīvāsamadhurānandapriyapremadigambarīm || 77-45 || lajjātītāṃ kulātītāṃ jñānātītāṃ nirañjanām | krodhapuñja samudbhūtadvīpicarmakaṭiprabhām || 77-46 || nīlā(--)ghanā(--)balā(--)māyā(--)mātrā(--)mudrā(--)kalādibhiḥ | sarvadā pūjitāṃ dhyāyet sahasrāravarāmbuje || 77-47 || evaṃ dhyātvā mahākālīṃ śyāmāṃ kāmadughāṃ śivām | ākāśagāminīṃ siddhimavaśyaṃ labhate vaśī || 77-48 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe sadāśivakulacakrakramanirūpaṇe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde yogārthasañcayanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 77 ||
[athāṣṭasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu bhairava vakṣyāmi saṅketārthavinirṇayam | kulacakrakramaṃ siddhaṃ śaktisadāśivasya ca || 78-1 || asya vijñānamātreṇa kaṇṭhapadme sthiro bhavet | padmāgre ca sāracakraṃ yogināmatisupriyam || 78-2 || dhyānādeva mahābāho sarvacakrapradarśakam | ūrdhvaretā kāmajetā jñānī maunī digambaraḥ || 78-3 || khecaro dhārakaḥ śrīmān kaulikaḥ sādhako bhavet | taccakradhyānamevaṃ tu dvidvāramagrato mukhe || 78-4 || tadante cāpi dvidvāraṃ tilārdhaṃ bhinnarekhayā | rekhādvaye naikadvāramevaṃ dvāradvayaṃ punaḥ || 78-5 || agrāduttaraparyantaṃ dhyāyed vāradvayaṃ sudhīḥ | dvayormadhye caturvedarekhāmaṇḍalameva ca || 78-6 || tadantare ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ dviṣaṭkoṇaṃ tadantare | tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye candramaṇḍalam || 78-7 || tanmadhye śūnyarūpaṃ tu nirākāraṃ nirañjanam | tattvajñānāśritānandavidyātmānaṃ mamāspadam || 78-8 || sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ śuddhaṃ vācyavācakabhāvanam | abhedaṃ tu mamātmānaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham || 78-9 || koṭividyutprabhākāraṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam | sarvavyāpaka mīśānamabhedajñānakāraṇam || 78-10 || vidhātāraṃ parabrahma sarvajñaṃ sarvadaśīnam | sarvaśāstrapravaktāraṃ jñānajñeyaṃ carācaram || 78-11 || aṣṭahastaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śūlinaṃ muṇḍamālinam | jarātītaṃ nivīkalpaṃ taruṇaṃ tārakaṃ haram || 78-12 || hariṃ brahmāṇamīśānaṃ trilokānāṃ prabhāmayam | abhedyabhedakaṃ siddhaṃ siddhāsanakaraṃ suram || 78-13 || gandharvanagaraṃ deśaṃ viśeṣaṃ sarvatomukham | akālatārakaṃ svāhāsvadhāśaktisamanvitam || 78-14 || koṭikālānalākāraṃ raudraṃ rudrātmakaṃ bhavam | kanyāśrīsundarīkāṭimaṇḍalāntaḥprakāśakam || 78-15 || tejobimbaṃ bhāsamānaṃ sarvavyādhinikṛntanam | hṛṣīkeśānandasiddhaṃ trivikramaphalodayam || 78-16 || nṛsiṃhakrodhanilayaṃ sarvadaityavināśanam | mīnāvatāravedārthasamuddharaṇakāraṇam || 78-17 || kūrmapṛṣṭhādhāracakraṃ varāhadantabhūṣaṇam | narasiṃhākārabhaktarakṣakaṃ parameśvaram || 78-18 || mahendrarakṣakaṃ daityadarpaghnaṃ vāmanaṃ tanum | daityakṣatriyadarpaghnaṃ paraśurāmaṃ dvijādhipam || 78-19 || bhṛguvaṃśapatiṃ satyajñānāvatāramuttamam | śrīrāmaṃ pāvanaṃ rakṣohantāraṃ tāpasaṃ gurum || 78-20 || trailokyādhāramānandarūpaṃ haladharaṃ param | anantaṃ yogināmādyaṃ sahasrāṅkaphaṇānvitam || 78-21 || buddhaṃ nirākāradharmaṃ sarvaśāstrārthavardhakam | nityaśrutyuditāmodadharmādharmavivajītam || 78-22 || svayambhuvaṃ svaprakāśaṃ paramātmānaṃ maṅgalam | ekākāraṃ dharmacakravedinaṃ svacchasaṅgaram || 78-23 || duṣṭanigrahakartāraṃ mahāvīraṃ dhanañjayam | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvasevābhiḥ pūjitaṃ tanmayaṃ śubham || 78-24 || vimadaṃ rakṣakaṃ dhyānajñānamokṣaprakāśakam | rājarājeśvaraṃ vāsyaṃ sarvalokaniṣevitam || 78-25 || sarvadehasthitaṃ dharmaṃ dharmātmānaṃ vinodinam | vyāpakaṃ vyāpakādhāraṃ nivīkalpaṃ sudhāmayam || 78-26 || viśiṣṭaṃ pañcapāṣāṇamahāpīṭhanivāsinam | anantānantamahimaṃ kapālaśūladhāriṇam || 78-27 || trirekhāmaṇḍalasthānaṃ caturvedakramākaram | ekavaktraṃ dvipādaṃ ca dvimukhañca catuṣpadam || 78-28 || trimukhaṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ nāthaṃ caturvaktraṃ vidhiṃ param | aṣṭāmbhojabhujāmbhojaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam || 78-29 || śivaṃ daśabhujaṃ saukhyaṃ sundaraṃ śrīṣaḍānanam | nityaṃ dvādaśahastañca sarvāstradhāriṇaṃ dhruvam || 78-30 || saptamukhaṃ mahākāyaṃ caturdaśabhujaṃ priyam | aṣṭamukhaṃ śivāhlādaṃ bhujaṣoḍaśamaṇḍitam || 78-31 || navapadmamukhāmbhojamaṣṭādaśabhujaṃ vibhum | unmattabhairavaṃ koṭimahāvidyādyavallabham || 78-32 || amareśaṃ mahākāyamaṣṭādaśabhujāpatim | kālarāśiṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ citrasarpasumālinam || 78-33 || śatavaktraṃ koṭihastaṃ sahasravadanāmbujam | śatakoṭimukhaṃ nityānandasantānamandiram || 78-34 || anantacaraṇāmbhojamanantajanasevitam | anantahastakamalamanantālaṅkṛtojjvalam || 78-35 || antaḥprakāśanikaramanantaguṇasambhavam | anantasṛṣṭisraṣṭāramanantasthitikāraṇam || 78-36 || anantakamalāvanye cānantasaṃhṛtipriyam | anantabījanikaramanantaśāstraniścayam || 78-37 || anantatāpasantṛptamanantajalamadhyagam | anantaparamādhāramanantavahnidhāriṇam || 78-38 || anantākāśanikaramanantapṛthivīpatim | anantajvālāmālāḍhyamanantabuddhikāraṇam || 78-39 || anantasthānapūjāḍhyamanantanāmasiddhidam | anantagativijñānamanantarājyadaṃ sukham || 78-40 || anantadharmaśāstrārthakiraṇaṃ kāvyapūjitam | anantadevatāsthānamanantakarmasiddhidam || 78-41 || anantamālāguṭikājāpinaṃ nityasiddhidam | anantacittasañcāramanantānantavikramam || 78-42 || anantajīvasaṃjñānamanantabhāvanāpriyam | anantanirmalānandamanantaprāṇivallabham || 78-43 || anantagāthākartāramanantasindhusaṃsthitam | sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 78-44 || sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantamaparājitamīśvaram | dhyātvā''nandamayaṃ devaṃ pīṭhamadhye ca sādhakam || 78-45 || śākinīdevaśaktiśrīpremāhlādaparāyaṇam | devadevaṃ viśvamayaṃ śākyarūpaṃ sanātanam || 78-46 || mama rūpaṃ yadā nāmnā stauti kāmavinodinam | dhyātvā cakrapure yogī nirālambo digambaraḥ || 78-47 || gagane cakrasāraṃ tu kulanāmnā pratiṣṭhitam | dhyātvā bhavati yogīndraḥ khecaro gatabhīḥ prabhuḥ || 78-48 || anāyāsena siddhiḥ syād jñānī ca jñānavān bhavet | ūrdhvamukhaṃ kaṇṭhapadmaṃ tadagre cakramaṇḍalam || 78-49 || adhomukhaṃ netrapadmaṃ dvidalaṃ cātisundaram | tadagre ca mahācakraṃ tadākāraṃ mahāprabham || 78-50 || dvicakrasaṅgamaṃ yatra dṛśyate rātriyogataḥ | tadā bhavati deveśa caturdvāraṃ manoharam || 78-51 || cakraṃ nirañjanaṃ jñānajñeyaṃ mantramayaṃ śiva | yo jānāti mahādeva sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ || 78-52 || iti kaṇṭhasya māhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ mayā | jānāti yogī dhyānena jñānayuktena cetasā || 78-53 || paśyatyeva mahātmānaṃ jñānajñeyaṃ sudhāmayam | koṭivarṣaśatenāpi kathituṃ naiva śakyate || 78-54 || tava bhaktyā mahādeva tavāyuḥkṣetrarakṣaṇāt | idānīṃ kathitaṃ kaṇṭhapadmasañcāramaṅgalam || 78-55 || aprakāśyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ śabdabrahmasvarūpakam | nirjane doṣarahite vyādhibādhāvivajīte || 78-56 || subhikṣānindārahite sthitvā tatra dṛḍhavrataḥ | bhāvayet parayā bhaktyā tava rūpaṃ vicintayan || 78-57 || acirādyogasiddhaḥ syānnidānajñānasiddhibhāk | śrīmātṛkā mahādevī līlāvatī śubhā satī || 78-58 || ambā gurvī guruśaktiḥ pātu māmatikātaram | tāmambāmambujākṣīṃ ca praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 78-59 || idānīṃ kathaye nātha bhrūpadmajñānanirṇayam || 78-60 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--)prakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde kaṇṭhāmbhojabhedaprakāśo nāma | aṣṭasaptatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 78 ||
[athaikonāśititamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairava uvāca kathayasva varārohe kāmanāsiddhimaṅgalam | aprakāśyaṃ mahājñānaṃ yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || 79-1 || anādiśāstragopyaṃ tu sarvatantreṣu gopitam | sukhasnehakṛpādṛṣṭyā sarvatattvasumaṅgalam || 79-2 || jñānagamyaṃ śabdajālaṃ komalāntaḥprakāśakam | āyurārogyajananaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣadam || 79-3 || bhrūpadmadvidalaṃ siddhamunimaṇḍalasaṅkulam | jñānināmātmasiddhāntarūpajñānasamāgamam || 79-4 || yāmalasya mahārudrasevitasya varānane | vada vistārya yatnena jīvanmuktipadaṃ yataḥ || 79-5 || labhyate tatkṣaṇādeva kṛpayā karuṇāmayi | kālakūṭaprabhāveṇa cātmano vismṛtirgatā || 79-6 || tāṃ vismṛtiṃ samākṛtya smṛtijñānaṃ vidhehi me | paramānandanirvāhanirvāṇaprathamāṅkuram || 79-7 || śrī ānandabhairavī uvāca vakṣye'haṃ dvidalaṃ vibhāṇḍakamalaṃ kālānalavyākulaṃ | śobhāmohanarañjanaṃ sucapalāmālākapālojjvalam | dīptiśreṇi sukaṇīkāntaragataḥ śrīśākinīvallabhaḥ | prāṇiprāṇanidānagaḥ paraśivaḥ sampātu sañcāragaḥ || 79-8 || saṃhārojjvalakāntikāntanikaraṃ saṃhārakūpojjvalaṃ | tejorūpamahāśikhāsukhapadaṃ pīyūṣatailapriyam | tārādhīśadineśataijasamayaṃ māyāparādodyamaṃ | vidyāvallabhabhāvasāravinutaṃ dve patramitre bhaje || 79-9 || ākāśāgre prabhāgrogragamanadharaṇīdhārasāre pracāre | śrīnātheśaḥ kṣitīśaḥ pracuravidhumaṇiśreṇimālāgrakaṇṭhaḥ | śrīkaṇṭho nīlakaṇṭhaḥ prabhavati bhuvanānandakartārthakartā | vidyā śrīhākinīśaḥ sphaṭikamaṇigṛhe raktaśaktyā ca haṃsaḥ || 79-10 || puro vibhāti kaṇīkāsumadhyacakramaṇḍale | viśiṣṭaśaktihākinī tathāpi durgatāriṇī | yadīha bhāvyate naraiḥ sumantratantragāyanai(--) | stadā paratvamāpnuyāddavi sthiro bhavedṛte || 79-11 || dvidalakamala madhye hākinī devamātā | vibhavanavakumārī yoginī yogasiddhā | yadi carati viliptā cordhvamārge niṣaṇṇā | tribhuvanakaruṇābhiḥ sādhakasya prasannā || 79-12 || japaraṭiparamantraprāṇajāpī manuṣyo | bhavati vimalacetā hākinīhomadevyāḥ | manumapi hṛdi nityaṃ saṃvibhāvya pratiṣṭhaḥ | parapurakulagāmī dhyānavijñānapuṇyaḥ || 79-13 || viṣayamadhuratṛṣṇāvajīto nijītāriḥ | kulayugakamalāntaḥ suprakāśasvarūpaḥ | vidhikṛtakuladoṣaṃ bhāti nijītya doṣaṃ | ratipatisamakāntaḥ sādhako niṇītāntaḥ || 79-14 || japati manudhanārthaṃ bhrāntihomotsavārthaṃ | manujakulavareṇyo'nyāni kālyā vihāya | ayutaśatasumantrānnāśapuñjākṣarāṇi | prasavati ripuhantā sādhako hākinīśaḥ || 79-15 || paraśivanavabhāvaprāvaṇāntaḥpraveśī | dvidalakamalaśobhā koṭisaṃbhāṣayantī | nijakulaparidevairbhāvyate bhāvamānai(--) | rbhavati capalamādyā hākinī suprasannā || 79-16 || ājñānāma supaṅkajaṃ vidhuśatāhlādaprabhāpāṭalaṃ | vidyudraśmibhirunnataṃ dhavalapīṭhānandacidrūpadam | hastābhyāṃ kanakaprabhādīptābhyāṃ prakāśojjvalaṃ | hākinyākalābhayāpracalitaṃ dhyāyet parānandanam || 79-17 || dhyānajñānādidhāma pracayati jayati kṣobhitāriprasārī | hastābhyāṃ hemabhābhyāṃ taruṇaraviśaśīśobhitābhyāṃ vidhāya | sūkṣmātsūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ viracayati sudhāṃ hākinī prāpya nāthaṃ | koṭīndukṣemakāntiprasabhadhanarasā nanditāmabhrapīṭhe || 79-18 || dhyāyed devīṃ parāḍhyāṃ tribhuvanajananīṃ ṣaṇmukhīṃ vedahastāṃ | vidyāmudrāviruṇḍaṃ japavaṭiḍamaruṃ dhārayantīṃ jvalantīm | cetaḥ śāntipradātrīṃ vidhumaṇimukurāṃ bhīṣamānāṃ samānāṃ | ṣaṭkoṇe bindumūle yugadalakamale dvārayugmadvayāḍhye || 79-19 || etaccakrasya madhye sakalasuragaṇavidyutākāradīptā | nityaṃ saṃbhāti pārśvāvadhikamalamahāmaṇḍalākārabhāve | doṣāśeṣāpanāśe sakalabudhajanaiḥ śobhitā padmamālā | prāṇākhyā vahnijihvā sukhamayāvimalā yoginī yogamukhyā || 79-20 || manoyogacinhaṃ prasiddhaṃ susūkṣmaṃ | śubhe padmamadhye śikhākāracittam | mahāyonicakre priye kaṇīkāyāṃ | śivasthānamugraṃ vaśī vīkṣya śuklam || 79-21 || mahāvidyutākāraṇaṃ bhāsamānaṃ paraṃ brahmasūtraprabodhaṃ vinodam | mahākaulamārgaṃ sthiraprāṇabuddhiḥ krameṇaiva taccintayet sādhakendraḥ || 79-22 || mahāvedasūtrādibījaprakāśaṃ | śatānandacandraprabhaṃ bhāvyamānam | vibhāvyāśu nāthapriyaṃ pañcacūḍaṃ | mahāmokṣagāmī jitakrodhakāmaḥ || 79-23 || ya etat svacittānvitaḥ sādhakendro | vibhudhyānayuktaḥ priyātmā mahātmā | pure śīghragāmī parāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ | munīndraḥ kṣitīndro mahāvedavaktā || 79-24 || dvidhā bodhavijñānaśūnyo vareṇyo | bhavet sarvadarśī sa sarvajñarājaḥ | sadā pūrṇasiddhiprasiddho'rihantā | mahāsṛṣṭisaṃhārapālādikartā || 79-25 || kṣaṇādāvibhāvya prabhurdīrghajīvī | sudhīḥ sarvaśāstrārthavettā sumantrī | mahājñānayukto bhavedekacitto | balī bāṇatulyo vidhātuḥ praśasyaḥ || 79-26 || svacakramaṇḍalāntare trikoṇabhūmibimbake | tadantare ca ṣoḍaśacchadā vibhānti vāmake | supatrake manohare pradīpabhāśikhākṛti(--) rmahojjvalā sphu(ra)tprabhā caturgṛhaṃ tato bahiḥ || 79-27 || praṇavaviracanābhiḥ śobhitaṃ cakrarājaṃ | tadupari vilasacchrīcandrakhaṇḍaprakāśaḥ | tadupari vigalad bindukānto makāra(--) | stadupari śitanādo bhāti pīyūṣapuñjaḥ || 79-28 || dhyāyedyaḥ kramataḥ sudhīḥ priyapadālīne iha kṣetrake | badhvā cetasi bhāvapuñjanikarāṃ śrīnāthasevoditām | yogīndroditayogaśāsananirālambāṃ parāṃ sādarā(--) | mabhyāsānniyataṃ vaśī paranara ugrāṃ kalāṃ paśyati || 79-29 || tanmadhyāntaḥ prakāśāmativimalakalāmādivātmaprakāśā(--) | mādyakṣe svapratiṣṭhāmatisukhavibhavāmāśraye sthānasiddhām | hākinyāṅghraprabhāmaṇḍala kamalamahārūpalāvaṇyadhairyaṃ | saubhāgyaṃ dhyānaniṣṭhe vilasati madhuraṃ dhyānamāropayāmi || 79-30 || jvalatkoṭidīpākṛtisnehajālaṃ vahantaṃ raṭantaṃ navīnārkakāntam | sphurajjyotirākāśapṛthvīndumadhyaṃ bhaved vai mahendro vilokyāśu yogī || 79-31 || ihānandabāhye pareśo hi sākṣān mahāpūrṇabhūtiprabhāvo'vyayo hi | mahāvahnicandrārkasanmaṇḍalo vā mahāviṣṇucakropari śrīhariḥ syāt || 79-32 || mahāviṣṇuyogī mahāyogayogīndrasevyaṃ mahendraḥ | vilokyāśubhannārthatantrapratāpaṃ tadā tadviśatyatra pañcatvakāle || 79-33 || layasthānamākāśavāyoratīva pratāpapriyasyāñjanasyāśu paśyet | mahānādarūpaṃ tadūrdhve śivārdhaṃ viśālākṣarūpaṃ śivākāramānam || 79-34 || suśāntaṃ mahāntaṃ dharākāntalāntaṃ varaṃ dātumutphullahastāravindam | sabhītipradaṃ śuddhabuddhaprabodhaṃ dayādānakartāramāpaśyatīha || 79-35 || gurūṇāṃ padāmbhoruhāhlādalīno janaḥ paśyati prāṇanāthaṃ pareśam | dineśaṃ rameśaṃ dhaneśaṃ nareśaṃ sa yogī nirogī mahāśuddhaveśam || 79-36 || sa vācāṃ susiddhiṃ samāpnoti śuddhiṃ | varaṃ kāmalakṣmīśvaratvaṃ mahattvam | na bhūyāt triloke punarjanmabhāvaḥ | sadā gāyati śrīpatirnārado vā || 79-37 || śrīānandabhairava uvāca na śrutaṃ devi kalyāṇi hākinīkūṭamantrakam | tathā pūjāvidhiṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ vāyuvinirgamam || 79-38 || ityādiyogaṃ stotrāṇi sahasranāmamaṅgalam | tathā śrīvaranāthasya kṛpayā vada sundari || 79-39 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śākinīmantroddeśo nāma ekonāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 79 ||
[athāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇuṣva paramānandahetupānapriyaṅkara atyadbhutaṃ parasyāpi hākinyā mantrameva ca || 80-1 || trayāśītitame nātha paṭhanāhlādasāgare | rahasyaṃ paramānandavardhanaṃ kāmadaṃ manum || 80-2 || asyāpi bhāvakartā yaḥ sa yogī na tu mānuṣaḥ | atividyā cātidhanaṃ mahārājyaṃ sadāśiva || 80-3 || asyārādhanamātreṇa svayameva samāpnuyāt | iti hetoḥ saṅkathaye mantroddhāraṃ krameṇa
