raṇāhlādaḥ saṃgrāmapretavigrahaḥ | devībhakto devadevo divi dāruṇatatparaḥ || 87-104 || khaḍgī ca kavacī siddhaḥ śūlī dhūlistriśūladhṛk | dhanuṣmān dharmacitteśo'cinnanāgasumālyadhṛk || 87-105 || artho'narthapriyo'prāyo malātīto'tisundaraḥ | kāñcanāḍhyo hemamālī kāñcanaśṛṅgaśāsanaḥ || 87-106 || kandarpajetā puruṣaḥ kapittheśo'rkaśekharaḥ | padmagandho'tisadgandhaścandraśekharabhṛt sukhī || 87-107 || pavitrādhāranilayo vidyāvadvarabījabhṛt | kandarpasadṛśākāro māyājid vyāghracarmadhṛk || 87-108 || atisaundaryacūḍāḍhyo nāgacitramaṇipriyaḥ | atigaṇḍaḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ kurujetā kavīśvaraḥ || 87-109 || ekamukho dvituṇḍaśca dvividho vedaśāsanaḥ | ātmāśrayo gurumayo gurumantrapradāyakaḥ || 87-110 || śaurīnātho jñānamārgī siddhamārgī pracaṇḍagaḥ | nāmagaḥ kṣetragaḥ kṣetro gaganagranthibhedakaḥ || 87-111 || gāṇapatyavasācchanno gāṇapatyavasādavaḥ | gambhīro'tisusūkṣmaśca gītavādyapriyaṃvadaḥ || 87-112 || āhlādodrekakārī ca sadāhlādī manogatiḥ | śivaśaktipriyaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ paramabāndhavaḥ || 87-113 || atithipriyakaro nityo govindeśo harīśvaraḥ | sarveśo bhāvinīnātho vidyāgarbho vibhāṇḍakaḥ || 87-114 || brahmāṇḍarūpakartā ca brahmāṇḍadharmadhārakaḥ | dharmārṇavo dharmamārgī dharmacintāsusiddhidaḥ || 87-115 || asthāsthito hyāstikaśca svastisvacchandavācakaḥ | annarūpī annakastho mānadātā mahāmanāḥ || 87-116 || ādyāśaktiprabhurmātṛvarṇajālapracārakaḥ | mātṛkāmantrapūjyaśca mātṛkāmantrasiddhidaḥ || 87-117 || mātṛpriyo mātṛpūjyo mātṛkāmaṇḍaleśvaraḥ | bhrāntihantā bhrāntidātā bhrāntastho bhrāntivallabhaḥ || 87-118 || ityetat kathitaṃ nātha sahasranāmamaṅgalam | aṣṭottaraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ svargīyaṃ bhuvi durlabham || 87-119 || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet | aprakāśyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ devānāmapyagocaram || 87-120 || phalaṃ koṭivarṣaśatairvaktuṃ na śakyate budhaiḥ | yasya smaraṇamākṛtya yoginīyogapāragaḥ || 87-121 || sokṣaṇaḥ sarvasiddhīnāṃ trailokye sacarācare | devāśca bahavaḥ santi yoginastattvacintakāḥ || 87-122 || paṭhanāddhāraṇājjñānī mahāpātakanāśakaḥ | āyurārogyasampattibṛṃhito bhavati dhruvam || 87-123 || saṃgrāme grahabhītau ca mahāraṇye jale bhaye | vāramekaṃ paṭhedyastu sa bhaved devavallabhaḥ || 87-124 || sarveṣāṃ mānasambhaṅgī yogirāḍ bhavati kṣaṇāt | pūjāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa yaḥ paṭhenniyataḥ śuciḥ || 87-125 || sa sarvalokanāthaḥ syāt paramānandamāpnuyāt | ekapīṭhe japedyastu kāmarūpe viśeṣataḥ || 87-126 || trikālaṃ vātha ṣaṭkālaṃ paṭhitvā yogirāḍ bhavet | ākāśagāminīṃ siddhiṃ guṭikāsiddhimeva ca || 87-127 || prāpnoti sādhakendrastu rājatvaṃ hi dine dine | sarvadā yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ sarvajñaḥ sukuśāgradhīḥ || 87-128 || avaśyaṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kāmajetā mahītale | ajñānī jñānavān sadyo'dhanī ca dhanavān bhavet || 87-129 || sarvadā rājasammānaṃ pañcatvaṃ nāsti tasya hi | gale dakṣiṇabāhau ca dhārayedyastu bhaktitaḥ || 87-130 || acirāttasya siddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā | avadhūteśvaro bhūttvā rājate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 87-131 || araktacandanayuktena haridrākuṅkumena ca | sephālikāpuṣpadaṇḍairdalasaṅkulavajītaiḥ || 87-132 || militvā yo likhet stotraṃ kevalaṃ candanāmbhasā | sa bhavet pārvatīputraḥ kṣaṇādvā dvādaśāhani || 87-133 || ekamāsaṃ dvimāsaṃ vā trimāsaṃ varṣameva ca | jīvanmukto dhārayitvā sahasranāmakīrtanam || 87-134 || paṭhitvā taddviguṇaśaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ labhet | kimanyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sārvabhaumeśvaro bhavet || 87-135 || tribhuvanagaṇanātho yoginīśo dhanāḍhyo | matisuvimalabhāvo dīrghakālaṃ vaset saḥ | iha paṭhati bhavānīvallabhaḥ stotrasāraṃ | daśaśatamabhidheyaṃ jñānamaṣṭottaraṃ ca || 87-136 |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭkoṇaprakāśe bhrūpadmabhedavinyāse bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde paraśivahākinīśvarāṣṭottara(--) | sahasranāmapāṭhe saptāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 87 ||
[athāṣṭāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇuṣva parameśa tvaṃ durlabhaṃ yogimaṇḍale | mahāyogajñānasāraṃ trailokyamaṅgalaṃ śubham || 88-1 || yasya vijñānamātreṇa sādhako'sādhako'pi vā | mṛtyuñjayo bhavejjñānī paramānandarūpabhāk || 88-2 || homasthānaṃ śikhāmadhye dīpasya bhrūdalāntare | parabrahmasvarūpāṃ tāṃ śikhārūpāṃ jagatpriyām || 88-3 || svāhāśaktiṃ tatra nātha vicintya manasā sudhīḥ | yaḥ stutvā pratyahaṃ homakarmasiddhi samāpayet || 88-4 || ityetat paramaṃ jñānamanyajjñānaṃ śṛṇu prabho | śikhordhve ca parā śaktiḥ paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇī || 88-5 || uṣṭrmukhī raktamukhī koṭikālānalopamā | tāṃ dhyātvā kulapadmasya kaṇīkāyāṃ mahāmanāḥ || 88-6 || manoyogasthitāṃ devīṃ paramānandadāyinīm | sūkṣmātisūkṣmabhāvasthāṃ sthūlātisthūlavigrahām || 88-7 || kālātītāṃ kālarūpāṃ kālākālaprakāśinīm | dharmodayāṃ bhānumatīṃ prabandhakauśaleśvarīm || 88-8 || pārvatīṃ raṇamātaṅgīṃ mataṅgagamanāṃ parām | nirvāṇasiddhidāṃ dhātrīṃ pañcatattvaprakāśinīm || 88-9 || pañcamīṃ pañcamasthāñca pañcavaktrapriyaṃvadām | pañcaraśṃmi pañcamavān śobhitāṃ dikpaṭāmbarām || 88-10 || pravālasthūlakoṭīndranīlacandramaṇisrajām | dvibhujāṃ maunaśīlāñca jñānapustakadhāriṇīm || 88-11 || ekākārasthitāṃ raudrīṃ paradevīṃ vibhāvya ca | taccatudīkṣu satataṃ śatayoginīmaṇḍalam || 88-12 || cakrapaṅktyākāraśobhāmaṇḍalaṃ maṇḍapasthitam | tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu bhairavavallabha || 88-13 || śmaśānavāsinī durgā hariṇākṣī pracaṇḍikā | raudrī śyāmā yoginī ca śivānī śivamohinī || 88-14 || sukhinī pañcamī bālā kuṭilākṣī vasundharā | suvarṇāṅgī pāvanā ca pavitrā paramānanā || 88-15 || siddhidā maṅgalā bhāvyā surati kāmadā ratiḥ | prabalā vimalā camanā prabhā kāñcanamālinī || 88-16 || tribhaṅgadehaśyāmāṅgī taruṇā taralāvatī | sulabhā durlabhā sarvā praphullakamalāpi vā || 88-17 || pātālamukhī gomuṇḍā ghorahāsā vilāsinī | aruṇā śravaṇā mantrī mālatī mallikā tathā || 88-18 || vaiśvānarī bharadvājā trivibhāgā matiḥ kṣudhā | subhadrābhākarī liptā nartakā ciṭisundarī || 88-19 || bṛhannalī bhāgavatī viśālā viralā tathā | mānasī vānarīgrīvā krodhinī mohinī tathā || 88-20 || ākaṣīṇī stambhinī va trijaṭā rukmamālinī | saptikā sukalā gīryā gabhīrā muṣalāvatī || 88-21 || bṛhannitambā mohākṣī mandirā candrikā tathā | siddhā vidyādharā hārā ratiḥ kaiśoradhamīṇī || 88-22 || taptā śāntirbhadradā ca vikārī mañcavāsinī | mahāvidyā bhavānī ca tārabrahmasvarūpiṇī || 88-23 || mātaṅgī bagalā kṛṣṇā śivā haimavatīśvarā | samanāpaharā kālī kandarpavanitā śubhā || 88-24 || vārāṇasīśvarī bālā kamalā cāruhāsinī | ajantā himakanyā ca śarvāṇī kulacañcalā || 88-25 || tapasvinī rājaputrī comāparṇā nirañjanā | ādhārabhūtā sāvitrī vācyāvācyā carācarā || 88-26 || kalkyeśī śaśivadanā nivīkalpasupākṣaṇī | bhuvaneśī sundarī ca satī siddhipradā kalā || 88-27 || kṛpaṇā padmavadanā śabdeśī bhagamālinī | ārādhitā śokaharā harā hīrakamālinī || 88-28 || hālāhalaharā hārā ratī kālānalāpahā | bhairavī vīramātā ca mahābhāgyavatī umā || 88-29 || sulabhā durgamātā ca sugandhā gandhamālinī | amāvāsyā sitā bhadrā cāruṇī sūryaputriṇī || 88-30 || dānadā dhanadā siddhidāyinī bhogadāyinī | ilāvatī ratnamālā manoyoganivāsinī || 88-31 || manasvinī mūlamātā mūlamantrasvarūpiṇī | etāsāṃ dhyānamākṛtya catudīkṣu krameṇa tu || 88-32 || vibhāvya taijasīṃ sarvāṃ tejomālāvināśinīm | atisaundaryalaharīṃ pārijātavanāntare || 88-33 || mahāmaṇḍalamadhye tu ratnasantānanimīte | grahasyāpi mahākālaṃ caturdvāraṃ vicintayet || 88-34 || maṇikoṭivinirmāṇacatustoraṇabhūṣitam | maṇḍapasyordhvabhāge ca mahācandrātapaṃ śitam || 88-35 || śatasūryaprabhaṃ kāntaṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitam | tathā maṇḍapamadhyordhve vitālāṅkaṃ manoharam || 88-36 || tadadhaḥ svarṇanirmāṇacchatraṃ maṇimayaṃ rucim | tadadhaḥ siṃharūpākṣi yuktasiṃhāsanaṃ param || 88-37 || tadūrdhve pretabījaṃ tu pretaliṅgopamaṃ smṛtam | pretaliṅgopari dhyātvā kāñcanasyāpi maṇḍalam || 88-38 || mahāpīṭhaṃ trikoṇaṃ tu kaṇīkāyāṃ mahāprabham | śuklapadmaṃ mahāśobhaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadamaṇḍitam || 88-39 || ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ keśakeṣu ca varṇakān | dakṣiṇāvartayogena vidyudrūpaṃ vicintayet || 88-40 || catuṣkoṇatrayaṃ paścāccaturdvāraṃ manoharam | tatra saṃcintayed devīṃ vāruṇīmattavigrahām || 88-41 || parāmbārūpiṇīṃ tārāṃ taruṇādityasannibhām | caturdvāre sadā dhyāyed devānāṃ cāpi maṇḍalam || 88-42 || savāhanaṃ daivataṃ ca parivārasamanvitam | indranīlaprabhaṃ kāntaṃ pūrvadvārīndracintanam || 88-43 || vahnikoṇe tathā vahnimaṇḍalaṃ sarvatomukham | parivārānvitaṃ dhyātvā yamalokaṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 88-44 || yamaṃ śyāmaṃ mahākāntaṃ parivāragaṇānvitam | savāhanaṃ tato dhyāyennairṛtaṃ rākṣasīṃ purīm || 88-45 || taduttare sadā dhyāyed varuṇaṃ meṣavāhanam | parivārānvitaṃ śuklaṃ bhāsvaraṃ tatra cintayet || 88-46 || taduttare marullokaṃ kṛṣṇasārasvavāhanam | parivārānvitaṃ dhyātvā tatpūrve cintayet tataḥ || 88-47 || kuberamuttaradvāri parivāragaṇānvitam | savāhanaṃ kutsitañca sarvaratnopaśobhitam || 88-48 || īśāne īśalokañca parivāragaṇānvitam | savāhanaṃ sarvalokapūjitaṃ parameśvaram || 88-49 || parivārānvitaṃ dhyātvā nānāvādyasamanvitam | bherīturīdhudhurīṇāṃ sahasrakoṭimeva ca || 88-50 || dundubhikulitāmodagāyanānandapūritam | nānāsundaravādyāḍhyaṃ pūrvalokaṃ vicintayet || 88-51 || veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgānāṃ sahasrakoṭināditam | yamalokaṃ nairṛte ca mantrakoṭisamanvitam || 88-52 || karatālakāṃsyaḍhakkādhvanikoṭiprapūritam | jaleśvaramahālokaṃ dundubhidhvanimohitam || 88-53 || yantrakoṭidhvaniśreṇimohitaṃ tatra cintayet | jharjharīparparītāṅgīsvanādanāditaṃ rucim || 88-54 || marullokaṃ tathā dhyāyet kuberasthānameva ca | dundubhiśreṇiḍhakkādiyantranādavimohitam || 88-55 || rāgatālanṛtyagītaṃ mūtīmantraṃ vicintayet | dīptiśreṇidharaṃ kāntaṃ gandharvanagaraṃ tataḥ || 88-56 || apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaṃ sarvatra nagare sudhīḥ | vicintayed gānarasaṃ rasikaṃ sarvamaṅgalam || 88-57 || sarvalokasthitā śobhā śobhā sarvavimohinī | sarvasyāntu samāyāntu devaṣī yantragāyakam || 88-58 || vādyavādakamevaṃ hi cintayet paramāvṛtam | brahmaṣīmaṇḍalaṃ tasyāṃ sarveṣāṃ gāyanānvitam || 88-59 || devaṣīsarvavijñānavākyaratnasvagāyanam | vicintyaivaṃ vidhānena nijapīṭhaṃ vicintayet || 88-60 || pīṭhaśaktiṃ vicintyāśu pīṭhanāyakameva ca | vicintyānandamagnaḥ syādacirāt siddhimāpnuyāt | adho vārāṇasīpīṭhaṃ dhyāyet tat kramamāśṛṇu || 88-61 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakraprakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde parāśaktinirmūlasthānanirṇayo nāma aṣṭāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 88 ||
[athaikonanavatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca kālarūpa mahādeva kālakūṭāsavapriya | idānīṃ śṛṇu deveśa vārāṇasyāḥ priyaṃ padam || 89-1 || śatakoṭiyoginīnāṃ maṇḍalaṃ yogisevitam | taṃ dhyāyet sarvadā yogī yadi kalyāṇamicchati || 89-2 || bhrūmadhye bhāti satataṃ maṇḍalākāraśobhitam | mātṛkāyantrarūpaṃ tu sarvasāraṃ vicintayet || 89-3 || koṭisvayambhūliṅgāḍhyaṃ puṇyakoṭiphalodayam | atisiddhipradaṃ deśaṃ deśanāthapriyaṃ padam || 89-4 || amalākamalāśaktikoṭikoṭisamanvitam | triśūlopari pūraṃ tu cchatrākāraṃ phalākaram || 89-5 || koṭiliṅgapradhānaṃ tu yogeśvaraśivaṃ prabhum | aṣṭottaraśatānandavigrahaṃ manmathāntakam || 89-6 || varābhayakaraṃ siddhaṃ ḍamarucchatradhāriṇam | triśūlamudgarādyastrakheṭakādivibhūṣitam || 89-7 || pañcamukhaṃ daśabhujaṃ śaṅkhamālākapālakam | dhyātvā sañcintayecchambhuṃ daśa dikṣu krameṇa tu || 89-8 || sthāne sthāne daśa daśa mūtīcihnaṃ vicintayet | śoṇābhaṃ vidyutābhañca purīrakṣaṇakāraṇam || 89-9 || hetupriyaṃ gajārūḍhaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam | atra cintanamākṛtya pīṭhavidyāvaśaṃ nayet || 89-10 || daśakaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhanti maṇḍalākārasukramāt | ayutaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ tu daśa dikṣu daśa sthale || 89-11 || vicintayecchuklavarṇaṃ kāñcanālaṅkṛtojjvalam | pūrvasyāṃ daśarūpaṃ tu cāyutāvaraṇaṃ prabhum || 89-12 || daśa nāma pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu bhairavabhūpate | jaṭilaḥ kāla unmattaḥ krodharājaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 89-13 || paro dadhīcināthaśca suvāśī pramatheśvaraḥ | yajñanātheśvaraścaiva cāyuteśvaravallabhaḥ || 89-14 || vahnikoṇe sadā bhānti mūtīmantaḥ śivā daśa | vajradharo mahākālaḥ kapileśvara eva ca || 89-15 || pañcānano yoginātho gharghareśaḥ pinākadhṛk | paśupālaḥ kṣemadaśca brahmanātho daśa smṛtāḥ || 89-16 || ete cāyutaliṅgeśā mūtīmanto vibhānti ca | eteṣāṃ dhyānamākṛtya pūjayed ghṛtadhārayā || 89-17 || cintayed dakṣiṇe paścāddaśamūtīṃ śivasya ca | vīraḥ śūleśvaraḥ siddheśvaraḥ śrīpārvatīśvaraḥ || 89-18 || gaṇanātheśvaraḥ śambhuḥ pracaṇḍo dakṣayajñahā | kāśīpatiḥ paśupatiḥ śivā ete daśa smṛtāḥ || 89-19 || ayutānandaliṅgeśāḥ kapālaśūladhārakāḥ | mūtīmanto vibhāntyatra śivamaṇḍalamadhyagāḥ || 89-20 || etān sañcintayed bhaktyā pīṭhakṣetre ca dakṣiṇe | nairṛte cintayet paścāt kāmākhyaḥ śivaliṅgakaḥ || 89-21 || dakṣiṇāmūtīrīśāno vāmaneśo manoharaḥ | vāmadevo bāṇanātho raghuvīreśvarastataḥ || 89-22 || kāmarājeśvaraḥ kāmakaleśo daśa īśvarāḥ | mūtīmanto vibhāntyatrāyutaliṅgeśvarāḥ prabho || 89-23 || vicintya parayā bhaktyā pūjayed bilvapatrakaiḥ | sarvatra mānasārcā ca pūrvoktamūtīkalpanā || 89-24 || varuṇe ca tato dhyāyenmaṇḍalasthān daśa kramān | aruṇeśvaro yogendrakāśīrājasurāntakāḥ || 89-25 || triśūlī varuṇeśaśca kālākhyaḥ kāmadāyakaḥ | kālāgnirudro bhadreśo daśa rudrāḥ prakītītāḥ || 89-26 || śivaliṅgāyuteśāśca sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ | vāyukoṇe sthitā ete rudrāścāyutaliṅgapāḥ || 89-27 || mahārudro vātanātho rudrātmā raudrarūpakaḥ | rūpanātho hi hanumān sūryeśo vasudheśvaraḥ || 89-28 || vāsukīvallabhaḥ satyapatirete maheśvarāḥ | parivārayutāḥ śreṣṭhā mahārudrādivallabhāḥ || 89-29 || ete pūjyāścintanīyāḥ kāmanāphalasiddhaye | uttare cottarāsyaśca kubereśvara īśvaraḥ || 89-30 || pañcādhāraḥ pārameśaḥ parahaṃsaprabhākaraḥ | ananteśaḥ kāyarakṣo ratneśvara umāpatiḥ || 89-31 || ekādaśaite rudrāśca nityāyutagaṇeśvarāḥ | ete pūjyā dhyāyitavyāḥ pūrvoktamūtīkalpanāḥ || 89-32 || īśāne ca tato dhyāyedīśvarān parameśvara | īśo vaiśvānareśaśca viśvāmitreśvarastathā || 89-33 || īśāno'pi ca māyeśo baṭukeśo rameśvaraḥ | kālāntakeśaḥ kāmākhyo mahākāmapurīśvaraḥ || 89-34 || śmaśānavāsideveśaḥ sarvarūpaprakāśakaḥ | ekādaśaite rudrāśca kāmapīṭhanivāsinaḥ || 89-35 || ayutānandaliṅgeśāścintanīyāḥ prapūjitāḥ | vārāṇasīmadhyapīṭhe trayodaśa śiveśvarāḥ || 89-36 || adhomaṇḍalamadhye tu cintayitvā prapūjayet | mṛtyuñjayo mokṣadaśca śiveśo bhairaveśvaraḥ || 89-37 || bhūtanātho bhūtakartā kṣetrapālaḥ parāparaḥ | mañjughoṣeśvaraḥ kāladamanaḥ kauśaleśvaraḥ || 89-38 || muninātho varṇamālī rudrā bhairavarūpiṇaḥ | ete trayodaśānandaśivarūpāḥ sureśvarāḥ || 89-39 || ayutānandaliṅgeśāḥ pūjyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ | varābhayapradāḥ pañcatattvaprakāśakāriṇaḥ || 89-40 || vārāṇasyūrdhvapīṭhe ca trayodaśa śivān yajet | vicintya paramānandasādhakaḥ sthiracetasā || 89-41 || brahmeśo brahmakuleśo brahmaliṅgo vidhīśvaraḥ | brahmāṇḍabhedakaścātmārāmo vakreśvarastathā || 89-42 || balīśo bhārgaveśaśca sadānandeśvaro haraḥ | kṛṣṇeśvaro rāmanātho rudrāstrayodaśa smṛtāḥ || 89-43 || ayutānandaliṅgeśā bhairavendrāḥ prakītītāḥ | ete pūjyā mahākāla rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ || 89-44 || kapālīśādayo jñānajñeyā nirmalacetasā | sarvā'laṅkāraśobhāḍhyā ratnakuṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ || 89-45 || sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāro devakārye niyojitāḥ | eteṣāṃ dhyānamākṛtya pūjayeccittapuṣpakaiḥ || 89-46 || tadā siddhimavāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvara | akālatārakā ete sarvasiddhisamṛddhidāḥ || 89-47 || ānandabhairavāhlādakāriṇaḥ kulapaṇḍitāḥ | ete rudrāḥ pūjayanti mahāvidyāḥ sulakṣaṇāḥ || 89-48 || tāsāṃ nāma pravakṣyāmi kramaśaḥ śṛṇu bhairava | drāṃ drīṃ daśa mahāvidyāḥ pañcatattvaprakāśikāḥ || 89-49 || sarvasiddhipradā nātha pūjayanti mahītale | satyatretādvāpare ca kalau pūrṇaphalapradāḥ || 89-50 || tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi yā yā hi rudrapūjitāḥ | tripurāsundarī devī tathā tripurabhairavī || 89-51 || bhuvaneśī cānnapūrṇā mātaṅgī vindhyavāsinī | chinnamastā ca bagalā trikūṭā pañcamī tathā || 89-52 || kālikā tāriṇī devī kāśīnāthaprapūjitāḥ | tantroktabāhyapūjādiravaśyaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ || 89-53 || sādhakaḥ siddhimāpnoti kulapūjākrameṇa tu | yogasiddhimavāpnoti māsādeva na saṃśayaḥ || 89-54 || bhrūpadmabhedane kāle tvavaśyaṃ paripūjayet || 89-55 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe ṣaṭcakra(--) prakāśe bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde vārāṇasīpīṭhanāthāntaryajanaṃ nāma ekonanavatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 89 ||
[atha navatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrīānandabhairavī uvāca śṛṇu kānta pravakṣyāmi hākinīpañcamaṇḍalam | vārāṇasīmadhyapīṭhe pañcakoṇaṃ vicintayet || 90-1 || tatra śrīhākinīdevyāḥ pañcapīṭhaṃ vicintayet | pañcapīṭhe pañcadevaṃ ratnamālāvimaṇḍitam || 90-2 || bhūtapretapiśācādiyakṣadānavakoṭibhiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ sarvalokāḍhyaṃ pañcakoṇaṃ vicintayet || 90-3 || pañcakoṇe pañcapīṭhaṃ kāmadaṃ vyālasiddhidam | nirvāṇasiddhidaṃ deva kimanyat kathayāmi te || 90-4 || pañcakoṇe pañcatattvaṃ pañcabījaṃ svameva ca | pūrvakoṇe indrabījaṃ pṛthivyāśca trikoṇakam || 90-5 || taddakṣiṇe vāyubījaṃ vāyavīśaktimaṇḍalam | vāyumugravegadharaṃ dharaṇībhañjanākhyakam || 90-6 || tadadho gṛhapīṭhe ca trikoṇamaṇḍalojjvale | jalabījaṃ vāruṇākhyaṃ sarvaratnāsanasthitam || 90-7 || śītalaṃ bahurūpaṃ taṃ trilokavāyubhañjakam | sarvādhastaijasaṃ rūpaṃ vahnibījaṃ mahāprabham || 90-8 || sarvadā taṃ mūtīmantaṃ tejomālāsamākulam | mahograṃ sarvabhakṣañca jalīyadoṣabhañjakam || 90-9 || ākāśaṃ sarvaśeṣākhyaṃ mahāpralayasaṅgamam | kumbhakādhāracakraṃ tu ākāśabījarūpiṇam || 90-10 || sarveṣāṃ layasaṃsthānaṃ nirmalaṃ tattvasiddhidam | hākinīpañcapīṭhañca pañca prāṇān tadantare || 90-11 || prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścodānavyānau ca vāyavaḥ | mūtīmanto vibhāntyatra lokānāṃ mṛtyunāśanāt || 90-12 || eteṣu vāyukuṇḍeṣu pūjayet pañcavāyavīm | prāṇeśī gudagāpānā samāneśī kulāntarā || 90-13 || udāneśī vyānamātā vāyavyaḥ pañca pūjitāḥ | pañcaprāṇo pañcayogaṃ yaḥ karoti kuleśvara || 90-14 || vāyavīṣvarpayennityaṃ pañcatattvaṃ suyogavi | śuddhāsavaṃ śuddhamāṃsaṃ śuddhamīnaṃ tathāparam || 90-15 || śuddhamudrāṃ tathā śuddhakulacandanamarpayet | pañcatattvaṃ dāpayed yaḥ kulasiddhinibandhanāt || 90-16 || hākinīparamāyāntu paramābhiḥ pratarpayet | vārāṇasīmadhyapīṭhacakravidyā samā śṛṇu || 90-17 || vārāṇasīmaṇḍalañca trikoṇaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadam | keśaradvayamevaṃ tu patre patre pratiṣṭhitam || 90-18 || catuṣkoṇatrayaṃ tasyordhve caturdvārameva ca | etadvārāṇasīcakraṃ sarvakāmasusiddhidam || 90-19 || vārāṇasīcakramadhye trikoṇasyāntare sudhīḥ | prapañcaguṇaduḥkhāni harecca pañcakoṇakam || 90-20 || trikoṇasyāntare dhyātvā kinna siddhyati bhūtale | etatprakāśitaṃ cakraṃ yo dhyāyati nirantaram || 90-21 || manoyogasiddhibhāvaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ | manoyogasiddhikāle sadāvaśyaṃ vicintayet || 90-22 || pañcakoṇe pañcatattvaṃ kāśīpīṭhe ca liṅginaḥ | koṭirūpadharā ete cātraiva bhānti nityaśaḥ || 90-23 || hākinīmaṇḍalaṃ madhye kāśyāstrikoṇayantrake | hākinī pañcatattvākhyāṃ pañcabhūtaprakāśinīm || 90-24 || pṛthivījalarūpāñca tejorūpāñca vāyavīm | gaganāṃ kramato dhyāyed dakṣiṇāvartasatpathā || 90-25 || vibhāvya pañcamīṃ devīṃ hākinīmaṇḍale yajet | sarvatra hyantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā siddhimavāpnuyāt || 90-26 || iti vārāṇasīcakramadhyasthaṃ pañcakoṇakam | hākinīmaṇḍalaṃ devanāyikāgaṇamaṇḍitam || 90-27 || sarvālaṅkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ hemamālāvirājitam | śivaśaktyātmakaṃ cakraṃ paramasiddhidāyakam || 90-28 || aprakāśyaṃ sarvatantre kāśitaṃ rudrayāmale | ṣaṭkoṇamaṇḍalaṃ vakṣye hākinyāḥ śivaśaktigam || 90-29 || vārāṇasīmaṇḍalāgre pratibhāti nirantaram | śivaśaktimayaṃ śuddhacakrarājaṃ vicintayet || 90-30 || tadūrdhve conmanīdeśaṃ tadūrdhve bodhanīpuram | maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu yatnena yenāntaryajanaṃ labhet || 90-31 || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kaṇīkāmadhye tadbāhye maṇḍalāṣṭakam | tadūrdhve ṣoḍaśadalaṃ keśaradvayasaṃyutam || 90-32 || caturdvāraṃ tadūrdhve tu vyāpya tiṣṭhati sarvadā | ṣaṭkoṇamadhyadeśe tu paranāthaṃ parānvitam || 90-33 || ṣaṭkoṇe sarvadā bhānti ṣaṭcakrasthitiśaktayaḥ | patibhiḥ saha deveśī ḍākinī kuṇḍalīpriyā || 90-34 || rākiṇī lākinī devī kākinī śākinī tathā | hākinī ca dakṣiṇato dhyeyā śivasamīpagā || 90-35 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | tataḥ paraśivo dhyeyaḥ svamuktimaṇḍalasthitaḥ || 90-36 || dhyātvā sampūjayeccakre śivaśaktimayaṃ param | parāśaktisamākrāntaṃ svayambhuliṅgarūpiṇam || 90-37 || sarvasiddhāntanilayaṃ vedavedāṅgagāyanam | māyātītaṃ nivīkalpaṃ svaprakāśaṃ nirañjanam || 90-38 || ṣaṭkoṇāntargataṃ dhyātvā parāśaktisamanvitam | tadūrdhve'ṣṭamaṇḍalaṃ tu vyāpya koṭisahasraśaḥ || 90-39 || yoginyaḥ santi nityaṃ tu paramānandasiddhidāḥ | tadūrdhve ṣoḍaśāre ca bhānti svarasamanvitāḥ || 90-40 || parā śaktiḥ prabhākārā caturdvāre tato likhet | aṣṭavargakrameṇāpi sarvasiddhi vibhāvayet || 90-41 || siddhipūjāmavāpnoti maṇḍalākārabhāvanāt | maṇḍalaṃ yo mahākālabhrūrdhve dhyāyedyadi priyam || 90-42 || mahāsiddhimavāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvara | anāyāsena yogendra yoginīsiddhimāpnuyāt || 90-43 || etaccakraṃ vibhāvyāśu bhāvasiddhimavāpnuyāt | bhāvasiddhisthitaṃ cakraṃ manoyogasusiddhidam || 90-44 || anyacchrībodhinīcakrasyādhobhāge vicintayet | unmanījñānacakraṃ tu sārvajñasiddhidāyakam || 90-45 || navakoṇaṃ binduyuktaṃ pretabījaṃ vicintayet | taṃ vyāpya navakoṇaṃ tu maṇḍalatrayameva ca || 90-46 || ṣoḍaśāraṃ tadbahistu caturdvāraṃ tu tadbahiḥ | dale dale surān dhyāyedaṣṭavargaṃ tato likhet || 90-47 || aṣṭakoṇe caturdvāramaṇḍalasya vibhāvya ca | unmanīnagaraṃ madhye tanmadhye pararūpiṇam || 90-48 || śaktiyuktaṃ vibhāvyāśu siddhimiṣṭāṃ prayacchati | padārthanavakaṃ tatra bījayuktaṃ vibhāvayet || 90-49 || tatpadārthān pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva bhairaveśvara | pṛthivīṃ jalarekhāñca tejorūpāñca vāyavīm || 90-50 || ākāśagāminīṃ devīṃ kālarūpāṃ digambarīm | ātmaśaktiṃ manaḥśaktiṃ dakṣiṇāvartayogataḥ | likhitvā svasvabījāḍhyāṃ bhāvayet kulavartmanā || 90-51 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale uttaratantre mahātantroddīpane siddhamantraprakaraṇe] | [ṣaṭcakraprakāśebhairavībhairavasaṃvāde vārāṇasīpañcapīṭha(--)] | [prakāśo nāma navatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 90 ||
